text_en: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the chair of pestilence:
text_la: Beatus vir qui non abiit in consilio impiorum, et in via peccatorum non stetit, et in cathedra pestilentiæ non sedit;
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que não anda segundo o conselho dos ímpios, nem se detém no caminho dos pecadores, nem se assenta na roda dos escarnecedores.
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ ὃς οὐκ ἐπορεύθη ἐν βουλῇ ἀσεβῶν καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ ἁμαρτωλῶν οὐκ ἔστη καὶ ἐπὶ καθέδραν λοιμῶν οὐκ ἐκάθισεν

text_en: But his will is in the law of the Lord , and on his law he shall meditate day and night.
text_la: sed in lege Domini voluntas ejus, et in lege ejus meditabitur die ac nocte.
text_pt: Antes tem o seu prazer na lei do Senhor, e na sua lei medita de dia e de noite.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ κυρίου τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ μελετήσει ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός

text_en: And he shall be like a tree which is planted near the running waters, which shall bring forth its fruit, in due season. And his leaf shall not fall off: and all whatsoever he shall do shall prosper.
text_la: Et erit tamquam lignum quod plantatum est secus decursus aquarum, quod fructum suum dabit in tempore suo : et folium ejus non defluet; et omnia quæcumque faciet prosperabuntur.
text_pt: Pois será como a árvore plantada junto a ribeiros de águas, a qual dá o seu fruto no seu tempo; as suas folhas não cairão, e tudo quanto fizer prosperará.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς τὸ ξύλον τὸ πεφυτευμένον παρὰ τὰς διεξόδους τῶν ὑδάτων ὃ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ δώσει ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ φύλλον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπορρυήσεται καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ποιῇ κατευοδωθήσεται

text_en: Not so the wicked, not so: but like the dust, which the wind drives from the face of the earth.
text_la: Non sic impii, non sic; sed tamquam pulvis quem projicit ventus a facie terræ.
text_pt: Não são assim os ímpios; mas são como a moinha que o vento espalha.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως οἱ ἀσεβεῖς οὐχ οὕτως ἀλλ' ἢ ὡς ὁ χνοῦς ὃν ἐκριπτεῖ ὁ ἄνεμος ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: Therefore the wicked shall not rise again in judgment: nor sinners in the council of the just .
text_la: Ideo non resurgent impii in judicio, neque peccatores in concilio justorum:
text_pt: Por isso os ímpios não subsistirão no juízo, nem os pecadores na congregação dos justos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἀναστήσονται ἀσεβεῖς ἐν κρίσει οὐδὲ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐν βουλῇ δικαίων

text_en: For the Lord knows the way of the just : and the way of the wicked shall perish.
text_la: quoniam novit Dominus viam justorum, et iter impiorum peribit.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor conhece o caminho dos justos; porém o caminho dos ímpios perecerá.
text_el: ὅτι γινώσκει κύριος ὁδὸν δικαίων καὶ ὁδὸς ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται

text_en: Why have the Gentiles raged, and the people devised vain things?
text_la: Quare fremuerunt gentes, et populi meditati sunt inania?
text_pt: Por que se amotinam os gentios, e os povos imaginam coisas vàs?
text_el: ἵνα τί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά

text_en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the princes met together, against the Lord , and against his Christ .
text_la: Astiterunt reges terræ, et principes convenerunt in unum adversus Dominum, et adversus christum ejus.
text_pt: Os reis da terra se levantam e os governos consultam juntamente contra o Senhor e contra o seu ungido, dizendo:
text_el: παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: Let us break their bonds asunder: and let us cast away their yoke from us.
text_la: Dirumpamus vincula eorum, et projiciamus a nobis jugum ipsorum.
text_pt: Rompamos as suas ataduras, e sacudamos de nós as suas cordas.
text_el: διαρρήξωμεν τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπορρίψωμεν ἀφ' ἡμῶν τὸν ζυγὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: He that dwells in heaven shall laugh at them: and the Lord shall deride them.
text_la: Qui habitat in cælis irridebit eos, et Dominus subsannabit eos.
text_pt: Aquele que habita nos céus se rirá; o Senhor zombará deles.
text_el: ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἐκγελάσεται αὐτούς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἐκμυκτηριεῖ αὐτούς

text_en: Then shall he speak to them in his anger , and trouble them in his rage.
text_la: Tunc loquetur ad eos in ira sua, et in furore suo conturbabit eos.
text_pt: Então lhes falará na sua ira, e no seu furor os turbará.
text_el: τότε λαλήσει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ ταράξει αὐτούς

text_en: But I am appointed king by him over Sion, his holy mountain, preaching his commandment.
text_la: Ego autem constitutus sum rex ab eo super Sion, montem sanctum ejus, prædicans præceptum ejus.
text_pt: Eu, porém, ungi o meu Rei sobre o meu santo monte de Sião.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ κατεστάθην βασιλεὺς ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Σιων ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord has said to me: You are my son, this day have I begotten you.
text_la: Dominus dixit ad me : Filius meus es tu; ego hodie genui te.
text_pt: Proclamarei o decreto: o Senhor me disse: Tu és meu Filho, eu hoje te gerei.
text_el: διαγγέλλων τὸ πρόσταγμα κυρίου κύριος εἶπεν πρός με υἱός μου εἶ σύ ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε

text_en: Ask of me, and I will give you the Gentiles for your inheritance, and the utmost parts of the earth for your possession.
text_la: Postula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hæreditatem tuam, et possessionem tuam terminos terræ.
text_pt: Pede-me, e eu te darei os gentios por herança, e os fins da terra por tua possessão.
text_el: αἴτησαι παρ' ἐμοῦ καὶ δώσω σοι ἔθνη τὴν κληρονομίαν σου καὶ τὴν κατάσχεσίν σου τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς

text_en: You shall rule them with a rod of iron, and shall break them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
text_la: Reges eos in virga ferrea, et tamquam vas figuli confringes eos.
text_pt: Tu os esmigalharás com uma vara de ferro; tu os despedaçarás como a um vaso de oleiro.
text_el: ποιμανεῖς αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ ὡς σκεῦος κεραμέως συντρίψεις αὐτούς

text_en: And now, O you kings, understand: receive instruction, you that judge the earth.
text_la: Et nunc, reges, intelligite; erudimini, qui judicatis terram.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó reis, sede prudentes; deixai-vos instruir, juízes da terra.
text_el: καὶ νῦν βασιλεῖς σύνετε παιδεύθητε πάντες οἱ κρίνοντες τὴν γῆν

text_en: Serve the Lord with fear: and rejoice unto him with trembling.
text_la: Servite Domino in timore, et exsultate ei cum tremore.
text_pt: Servi ao Senhor com temor, e alegrai-vos com tremor.
text_el: δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε αὐτῷ ἐν τρόμῳ

text_en: Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord be angry , and you perish from the just way.
text_la: Apprehendite disciplinam, nequando irascatur Dominus, et pereatis de via justa.
text_pt: Beijai o Filho, para que se não ire, e pereçais no caminho, quando em breve se acender a sua ira; bem-aventurados todos aqueles que nele confiam.
text_el: δράξασθε παιδείας μήποτε ὀργισθῇ κύριος καὶ ἀπολεῖσθε ἐξ ὁδοῦ δικαίας

text_en: When his wrath shall be kindled in a short time, blessed are all they that trust in him.
text_la: Cum exarserit in brevi ira ejus, beati omnes qui confidunt in eo.
text_el: ὅταν ἐκκαυθῇ ἐν τάχει ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ μακάριοι πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: The psalm of David when he fled from the face of his son Absalom .
text_la: Psalmus David, cum fugeret a facie Absalom filii sui.
text_pt: Senhor, como se têm multiplicado os meus adversários! São muitos os que se levantam contra mim.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ὁπότε ἀπεδίδρασκεν ἀπὸ προσώπου Αβεσσαλωμ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Why, O Lord , are they multiplied that afflict me? many are they who rise up against me.
text_la: Domine, quid multiplicati sunt qui tribulant me? Multi insurgunt adversum me;
text_pt: Muitos dizem da minha alma: Não há salvação para ele em Deus. (Selá.)
text_el: κύριε τί ἐπληθύνθησαν οἱ θλίβοντές με πολλοὶ ἐπανίστανται ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Many say to my soul : There is no salvation for him in his God .
text_la: multi dicunt animæ meæ : Non est salus ipsi in Deo ejus.
text_pt: Porém tu, Senhor, és um escudo para mim, a minha glória, e o que exalta a minha cabeça.
text_el: πολλοὶ λέγουσιν τῇ ψυχῇ μου οὐκ ἔστιν σωτηρία αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ θεῷ αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: But you, O Lord , are my protector, my glory , and the lifter up of my head.
text_la: Tu autem Domine, susceptor meus es, gloria mea, et exaltans caput meum.
text_pt: Com a minha voz clamei ao Senhor, e ouviu-me desde o seu santo monte. (Selá.)
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ δόξα μου καὶ ὑψῶν τὴν κεφαλήν μου

text_en: I have cried to the Lord with my voice: and he has heard me from his holy hill.
text_la: Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi; et exaudivit me de monte sancto suo.
text_pt: Eu me deitei e dormi; acordei, porque o Senhor me sustentou.
text_el: φωνῇ μου πρὸς κύριον ἐκέκραξα καὶ ἐπήκουσέν μου ἐξ ὄρους ἁγίου αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: I have slept and have taken my rest: and I have risen up, because the Lord has protected me.
text_la: Ego dormivi, et soporatus sum; et exsurrexi, quia Dominus suscepit me.
text_pt: Não temerei dez milhares de pessoas que se puseram contra mim e me cercam.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐκοιμήθην καὶ ὕπνωσα ἐξηγέρθην ὅτι κύριος ἀντιλήμψεταί μου

text_en: I will not fear thousands of the people surrounding me: arise, O Lord ; save me, O my God .
text_la: Non timebo millia populi circumdantis me. Exsurge, Domine; salvum me fac, Deus meus.
text_pt: Levanta-te, Senhor; salva-me, Deus meu; pois feriste a todos os meus inimigos nos queixos; quebraste os dentes aos ímpios.
text_el: οὐ φοβηθήσομαι ἀπὸ μυριάδων λαοῦ τῶν κύκλῳ συνεπιτιθεμένων μοι

text_en: For you have struck all them who are my adversaries without cause: you have broken the teeth of sinners.
text_la: Quoniam tu percussisti omnes adversantes mihi sine causa; dentes peccatorum contrivisti.
text_pt: A salvação vem do Senhor; sobre o teu povo seja a tua bênção. (Selá.)
text_el: ἀνάστα κύριε σῶσόν με ὁ θεός μου ὅτι σὺ ἐπάταξας πάντας τοὺς ἐχθραίνοντάς μοι ματαίως ὀδόντας ἁμαρτωλῶν συνέτριψας

text_en: Salvation is of the Lord : and your blessing is upon your people.
text_la: Domini est salus; et super populum tuum benedictio tua.
text_el: τοῦ κυρίου ἡ σωτηρία καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου ἡ εὐλογία σου

text_en: Unto the end, in verses. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, in carminibus. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Ouve-me quando eu clamo, ó Deus da minha justiça, na angústia me deste largueza; tem misericórdia de mim e ouve a minha oração.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ψαλμοῖς ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me: when I was in distress, you have enlarged me. Have mercy on me: and hear my prayer .
text_la: Cum invocarem exaudivit me Deus justitiæ meæ, in tribulatione dilatasti mihi. Miserere mei, et exaudi orationem meam.
text_pt: Filhos dos homens, até quando convertereis a minha glória em infâmia? Até quando amareis a vaidade e buscareis a mentira? (Selá.)
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐπικαλεῖσθαί με εἰσήκουσέν μου ὁ θεὸς τῆς δικαιοσύνης μου ἐν θλίψει ἐπλάτυνάς μοι οἰκτίρησόν με καὶ εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου

text_en: O you sons of men , how long will you be dull of heart? Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?
text_la: Filii hominum, usquequo gravi corde? ut quid diligitis vanitatem, et quæritis mendacium?
text_pt: Sabei, pois, que o Senhor separou para si aquele que é piedoso; o Senhor ouvirá quando eu clamar a ele.
text_el: υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων ἕως πότε βαρυκάρδιοι ἵνα τί ἀγαπᾶτε ματαιότητα καὶ ζητεῖτε ψεῦδος διάψαλμα

text_en: Know also that the Lord has made his holy one wonderful: the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.
text_la: Et scitote quoniam mirificavit Dominus sanctum suum; Dominus exaudiet me cum clamavero ad eum.
text_pt: Perturbai-vos e não pequeis; falai com o vosso coração sobre a vossa cama, e calai-vos. (Selá.)
text_el: καὶ γνῶτε ὅτι ἐθαυμάστωσεν κύριος τὸν ὅσιον αὐτοῦ κύριος εἰσακούσεταί μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: Be angry , and sin not: the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.
text_la: Irascimini, et nolite peccare; quæ dicitis in cordibus vestris, in cubilibus vestris compungimini.
text_pt: Oferecei sacrifícios de justiça, e confiai no Senhor.
text_el: ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε λέγετε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς κοίταις ὑμῶν κατανύγητε διάψαλμα

text_en: Offer up the sacrifice of justice , and trust in the Lord : many say, Who shows us good things?
text_la: Sacrificate sacrificium justitiæ, et sperate in Domino. Multi dicunt : Quis ostendit nobis bona?
text_pt: Muitos dizem: Quem nos mostrará o bem? Senhor, exalta sobre nós a luz do teu rosto.
text_el: θύσατε θυσίαν δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ κύριον

text_en: The light of your countenance, O Lord , is signed upon us: you have given gladness in my heart.
text_la: Signatum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Domine : dedisti lætitiam in corde meo.
text_pt: Puseste alegria no meu coração, mais do que no tempo em que se lhes multiplicaram o trigo e o vinho.
text_el: πολλοὶ λέγουσιν τίς δείξει ἡμῖν τὰ ἀγαθά ἐσημειώθη ἐφ' ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου κύριε

text_en: By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, they rest:
text_la: A fructu frumenti, vini, et olei sui, multiplicati sunt.
text_pt: Em paz também me deitarei e dormirei, porque só tu, Senhor, me fazes habitar em segurança.
text_el: ἔδωκας εὐφροσύνην εἰς τὴν καρδίαν μου ἀπὸ καιροῦ σίτου καὶ οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου αὐτῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν

text_en: In peace in the self same I will sleep, and I will rest:
text_la: In pace in idipsum dormiam, et requiescam;
text_el: ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κοιμηθήσομαι καὶ ὑπνώσω

text_en: For you, O Lord , singularly have settled me in hope.
text_la: quoniam tu, Domine, singulariter in spe constituisti me.
text_el: ὅτι σύ κύριε κατὰ μόνας ἐπ' ἐλπίδι κατῴκισάς με

text_en: Unto the end, for her that obtains the inheritance. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, pro ea quæ hæreditatem consequitur. Psalmus David.
text_pt: DÁ ouvidos às minhas palavras, ó Senhor, atende à minha meditação.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῆς κληρονομούσης ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Give ear, O Lord , to my words, understand my cry.
text_la: Verba mea auribus percipe, Domine; intellige clamorem meum.
text_pt: Atende à voz do meu clamor, Rei meu e Deus meu, pois a ti orarei.
text_el: τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐνώτισαι κύριε σύνες τῆς κραυγῆς μου

text_en: Hearken to the voice of my prayer , O my King and my God .
text_la: Intende voci orationis meæ, rex meus et Deus meus.
text_pt: Pela manhã ouvirás a minha voz, ó Senhor; pela manhã apresentarei a ti a minha oração, e vigiarei.
text_el: πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου ὅτι πρὸς σὲ προσεύξομαι κύριε

text_en: For to you will I pray : O Lord , in the morning you shall hear my voice.
text_la: Quoniam ad te orabo, Domine : mane exaudies vocem meam.
text_pt: Porque tu não és um Deus que tenha prazer na iniqüidade, nem contigo habitará o mal.
text_el: τὸ πρωὶ εἰσακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου τὸ πρωὶ παραστήσομαί σοι καὶ ἐπόψομαι

text_en: In the morning I will stand before you, and I will see: because you are not a God that wills iniquity .
text_la: Mane astabo tibi, et videbo quoniam non Deus volens iniquitatem tu es.
text_pt: Os loucos não pararão à tua vista; odeias a todos os que praticam a maldade.
text_el: ὅτι οὐχὶ θεὸς θέλων ἀνομίαν σὺ εἶ οὐδὲ παροικήσει σοι πονηρευόμενος

text_en: Neither shall the wicked dwell near you: nor shall the unjust abide before your eyes.
text_la: Neque habitabit juxta te malignus, neque permanebunt injusti ante oculos tuos.
text_pt: Destruirás aqueles que falam a mentira; o Senhor aborrecerá o homem sanguinário e fraudulento.
text_el: οὐ διαμενοῦσιν παράνομοι κατέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου ἐμίσησας πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: You hate all the workers of iniquity : you will destroy all that speak a lie. The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor.
text_la: Odisti omnes qui operantur iniquitatem; perdes omnes qui loquuntur mendacium. Virum sanguinum et dolosum abominabitur Dominus.
text_pt: Porém eu entrarei em tua casa pela grandeza da tua benignidade; e em teu temor me inclinarei para o teu santo templo.
text_el: ἀπολεῖς πάντας τοὺς λαλοῦντας τὸ ψεῦδος ἄνδρα αἱμάτων καὶ δόλιον βδελύσσεται κύριος

text_en: But as for me in the multitude of your mercy, I will come into your house; I will worship towards your holy temple , in your fear.
text_la: Ego autem in multitudine misericordiæ tuæ introibo in domum tuam; adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum in timore tuo.
text_pt: Senhor, guia-me na tua justiça, por causa dos meus inimigos; endireita diante de mim o teu caminho.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν τῷ πλήθει τοῦ ἐλέους σου εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου ἐν φόβῳ σου

text_en: Conduct me, O Lord , in your justice : because of my enemies, direct my way in your sight.
text_la: Domine, deduc me in justitia tua : propter inimicos meos dirige in conspectu tuo viam meam.
text_pt: Porque não há retidão na boca deles; as suas entranhas são verdadeiras maldades, a sua garganta é um sepulcro aberto; lisonjeiam com a sua língua.
text_el: κύριε ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου κατεύθυνον ἐνώπιόν μου τὴν ὁδόν σου

text_en: For there is no truth in their mouth: their heart is vain.
text_la: Quoniam non est in ore eorum veritas; cor eorum vanum est.
text_pt: Declara-os culpados, ó Deus; caiam por seus próprios conselhos; lança-os fora por causa da multidão de suas transgressões, pois se rebelaram contra ti.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν ἀλήθεια ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ματαία τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν

text_en: Their throat is an open sepulchre: they dealt deceitfully with their tongues: judge them, O God . Let them fall from their devices: according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out: for they have provoked you, O Lord .
text_la: Sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum; linguis suis dolose agebant : judica illos, Deus. Decidant a cogitationibus suis; secundum multitudinem impietatum eorum expelle eos, quoniam irritaverunt te, Domine.
text_pt: Porém alegrem-se todos os que confiam em ti; exultem eternamente, porquanto tu os defendes; e em ti se gloriem os que amam o teu nome.
text_el: κρῖνον αὐτούς ὁ θεός ἀποπεσάτωσαν ἀπὸ τῶν διαβουλίων αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτῶν ἔξωσον αὐτούς ὅτι παρεπίκρανάν σε κύριε

text_en: But let all them be glad that hope in you: they shall rejoice for ever, and you shall dwell in them. And all they that love your name shall glory in you.
text_la: Et lætentur omnes qui sperant in te; in æternum exsultabunt, et habitabis in eis. Et gloriabuntur in te omnes qui diligunt nomen tuum,
text_pt: Pois tu, Senhor, abençoarás ao justo; circundá-lo-ás da tua benevolência como de um escudo.
text_el: καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπὶ σέ εἰς αἰῶνα ἀγαλλιάσονται καὶ κατασκηνώσεις ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ καυχήσονται ἐν σοὶ πάντες οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: For you will bless the just . O Lord , you have crowned us, as with a shield of your good will.
text_la: quoniam tu benedices justo. Domine, ut scuto bonæ voluntatis tuæ coronasti nos.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ εὐλογήσεις δίκαιον κύριε ὡς ὅπλῳ εὐδοκίας ἐστεφάνωσας ἡμᾶς

text_en: Unto the end, in verses, a psalm for David , for the octave.
text_la: In finem, in carminibus. Psalmus David. Pro octava.
text_pt: Senhor, não me repreendas na tua ira, nem me castigues no teu furor.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις ὑπὲρ τῆς ὀγδόης ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: O Lord , rebuke me not in your indignation, nor chastise me in your wrath .
text_la: Domine, ne in furore tuo arguas me, neque in ira tua corripias me.
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, Senhor, porque sou fraco; sara-me, Senhor, porque os meus ossos estão perturbados.
text_el: κύριε μὴ τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐλέγξῃς με μηδὲ τῇ ὀργῇ σου παιδεύσῃς με

text_en: Have mercy on me, O Lord , for I am weak: heal me, O Lord , for my bones are troubled.
text_la: Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam infirmus sum; sana me, Domine, quoniam conturbata sunt ossa mea.
text_pt: Até a minha alma está perturbada; mas tu, Senhor, até quando?.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με κύριε ὅτι ἀσθενής εἰμι ἴασαί με κύριε ὅτι ἐταράχθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου

text_en: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: but you, O Lord , how long?
text_la: Et anima mea turbata est valde; sed tu, Domine, usquequo?
text_pt: Volta-te, Senhor, livra a minha alma; salva-me por tua benignidade.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐταράχθη σφόδρα καὶ σύ κύριε ἕως πότε

text_en: Turn to me, O Lord , and deliver my soul : O save me for your mercy's sake.
text_la: Convertere, Domine, et eripe animam meam; salvum me fac propter misericordiam tuam.
text_pt: Porque na morte não há lembrança de ti; no sepulcro quem te louvará?
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον κύριε ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου σῶσόν με ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἐλέους σου

text_en: For there is no one in death, that is mindful of you: and who shall confess to you in hell?
text_la: Quoniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui; in inferno autem quis confitebitur tibi?
text_pt: Já estou cansado do meu gemido, toda a noite faço nadar a minha cama; molho o meu leito com as minhas lágrimas,
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ ὁ μνημονεύων σου ἐν δὲ τῷ ᾅδῃ τίς ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι

text_en: I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: I will water my couch with my tears.
text_la: Laboravi in gemitu meo; lavabo per singulas noctes lectum meum : lacrimis meis stratum meum rigabo.
text_pt: Já os meus olhos estão consumidos pela mágoa, e têm-se envelhecido por causa de todos os meus inimigos.
text_el: ἐκοπίασα ἐν τῷ στεναγμῷ μου λούσω καθ' ἑκάστην νύκτα τὴν κλίνην μου ἐν δάκρυσίν μου τὴν στρωμνήν μου βρέξω

text_en: My eye is troubled through indignation: I have grown old amongst all my enemies.
text_la: Turbatus est a furore oculus meus; inveteravi inter omnes inimicos meos.
text_pt: Apartai-vos de mim todos os que praticais a iniqüidade; porque o Senhor já ouviu a voz do meu pranto.
text_el: ἐταράχθη ἀπὸ θυμοῦ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπαλαιώθην ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου

text_en: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity : for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
text_la: Discedite a me omnes qui operamini iniquitatem, quoniam exaudivit Dominus vocem fletus mei.
text_pt: O Senhor já ouviu a minha súplica; o Senhor aceitará a minha oração.
text_el: ἀπόστητε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ κλαυθμοῦ μου

text_en: The Lord has heard my supplication: the Lord has received my prayer .
text_la: Exaudivit Dominus deprecationem meam; Dominus orationem meam suscepit.
text_pt: Envergonhem-se e perturbem-se todos os meus inimigos; tornem atrás e envergonhem-se num momento.
text_el: εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς δεήσεώς μου κύριος τὴν προσευχήν μου προσεδέξατο

text_en: Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.
text_la: Erubescant, et conturbentur vehementer, omnes inimici mei; convertantur, et erubescant valde velociter.
text_el: αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ταραχθείησαν σφόδρα πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἀποστραφείησαν καὶ καταισχυνθείησαν σφόδρα διὰ τάχους

text_en: The psalm of David , which he sung to the Lord , for the words of Chusi, the son of Jemini.
text_la: Psalmus David, quem cantavit Domino pro verbis Chusi, filii Jemini.
text_pt: Senhor meu Deus, em ti confio; salva-me de todos os que me perseguem, e livra-me;
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ὃν ᾖσεν τῷ κυρίῳ ὑπὲρ τῶν λόγων Χουσι υἱοῦ Ιεμενι

text_en: O Lord , my God , in you have I put my trust; same me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.
text_la: Domine Deus meus, in te speravi; salvum me fac ex omnibus persequentibus me, et libera me:
text_pt: Para que ele não arrebate a minha alma, como leão, despedaçando-a, sem que haja quem a livre.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα σῶσόν με ἐκ πάντων τῶν διωκόντων με καὶ ῥῦσαί με

text_en: Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.
text_la: nequando rapiat ut leo animam meam, dum non est qui redimat, neque qui salvum faciat.
text_pt: Senhor meu Deus, se eu fiz isto, se há perversidade nas minhas mãos,
text_el: μήποτε ἁρπάσῃ ὡς λέων τὴν ψυχήν μου μὴ ὄντος λυτρουμένου μηδὲ σῴζοντος

text_en: O Lord , my God , if I have done this thing, if there be iniquity in my hands:
text_la: Domine Deus meus, si feci istud, si est iniquitas in manibus meis,
text_pt: Se paguei com o mal àquele que tinha paz comigo (antes, livrei ao que me oprimia sem causa),
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεός μου εἰ ἐποίησα τοῦτο εἰ ἔστιν ἀδικία ἐν χερσίν μου

text_en: If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils , let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.
text_la: si reddidi retribuentibus mihi mala, decidam merito ab inimicis meis inanis.
text_pt: Persiga o inimigo a minha alma e alcance-a; calque aos pés a minha vida sobre a terra, e reduza a pó a minha glória. (Selá.)
text_el: εἰ ἀνταπέδωκα τοῖς ἀνταποδιδοῦσίν μοι κακά ἀποπέσοιν ἄρα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου κενός

text_en: Let the enemy pursue my soul , and take it, and tread down my life, on the earth, and bring down my glory to the dust.
text_la: Persequatur inimicus animam meam, et comprehendat; et conculcet in terra vitam meam, et gloriam meam in pulverem deducat.
text_pt: Levanta-te, Senhor, na tua ira; exalta-te por causa do furor dos meus opressores; e desperta por mim para o juízo que ordenaste.
text_el: καταδιώξαι ἄρα ὁ ἐχθρὸς τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ καταλάβοι καὶ καταπατήσαι εἰς γῆν τὴν ζωήν μου καὶ τὴν δόξαν μου εἰς χοῦν κατασκηνώσαι διάψαλμα

text_en: Rise up, O Lord , in your anger : and be exalted in the borders of my enemies. And arise, O Lord , my God , in the precept which you have commanded:
text_la: Exsurge, Domine, in ira tua, et exaltare in finibus inimicorum meorum : et exsurge, Domine Deus meus, in præcepto quod mandasti,
text_pt: Assim te rodeará o ajuntamento de povos; por causa deles, pois, volta-te para as alturas.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι κύριε ἐν ὀργῇ σου ὑψώθητι ἐν τοῖς πέρασι τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ἐξεγέρθητι κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐν προστάγματι ᾧ ἐνετείλω

text_en: And a congregation of people shall surround you. And for their sakes return on high.
text_la: et synagoga populorum circumdabit te : et propter hanc in altum regredere:
text_pt: O Senhor julgará os povos; julga-me, Senhor, conforme a minha justiça, e conforme a integridade que há em mim.
text_el: καὶ συναγωγὴ λαῶν κυκλώσει σε καὶ ὑπὲρ ταύτης εἰς ὕψος ἐπίστρεψον

text_en: The Lord judges the people. Judge me, O Lord , according to my justice , and according to my innocence in me.
text_la: Dominus judicat populos. Judica me, Domine, secundum justitiam meam, et secundum innocentiam meam super me.
text_pt: Tenha já fim a malícia dos ímpios; mas estabeleça-se o justo; pois tu, ó justo Deus, provas os corações e os rins.
text_el: κύριος κρινεῖ λαούς κρῖνόν με κύριε κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ κατὰ τὴν ἀκακίαν μου ἐπ' ἐμοί

text_en: The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought; and you shall direct the just : the searcher of hearts and reins is God .
text_la: Consumetur nequitia peccatorum, et diriges justum, scrutans corda et renes, Deus.
text_pt: O meu escudo é de Deus, que salva os retos de coração.
text_el: συντελεσθήτω δὴ πονηρία ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ κατευθυνεῖς δίκαιον ἐτάζων καρδίας καὶ νεφροὺς ὁ θεός

text_en: Just is my help from the Lord ; who saves the upright of heart.
text_la: Justum adjutorium meum a Domino, qui salvos facit rectos corde.
text_pt: Deus é juiz justo, um Deus que se ira todos os dias.
text_el: δικαία ἡ βοήθειά μου παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ σῴζοντος τοὺς εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: God is a just judge, strong and patient: is he angry every day?
text_la: Deus judex justus, fortis, et patiens; numquid irascitur per singulos dies?
text_pt: Se o homem não se converter, Deus afiará a sua espada; já tem armado o seu arco, e está aparelhado.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς κριτὴς δίκαιος καὶ ἰσχυρὸς καὶ μακρόθυμος μὴ ὀργὴν ἐπάγων καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν

text_en: Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.
text_la: Nisi conversi fueritis, gladium suum vibrabit; arcum suum tetendit, et paravit illum.
text_pt: E já para ele preparou armas mortais; e porá em ação as suas setas inflamadas contra os perseguidores.
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ ἐπιστραφῆτε τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ στιλβώσει τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ ἐνέτεινεν καὶ ἡτοίμασεν αὐτὸ

text_en: And in it he has prepared to instruments of death, he has made ready his arrows for them that burn.
text_la: Et in eo paravit vasa mortis, sagittas suas ardentibus effecit.
text_pt: Eis que ele está com dores de perversidade; concebeu trabalhos, e produziu mentiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἡτοίμασεν σκεύη θανάτου τὰ βέλη αὐτοῦ τοῖς καιομένοις ἐξειργάσατο

text_en: Behold he has been in labour with injustice : he has conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity .
text_la: Ecce parturiit injustitiam; concepit dolorem, et peperit iniquitatem.
text_pt: Cavou um poço e o fez fundo, e caiu na cova que fez.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὠδίνησεν ἀδικίαν συνέλαβεν πόνον καὶ ἔτεκεν ἀνομίαν

text_en: He has opened a pit and dug it: and he is fallen into the hole he made.
text_la: Lacum aperuit, et effodit eum; et incidit in foveam quam fecit.
text_pt: A sua obra cairá sobre a sua cabeça; e a sua violência descerá sobre a sua própria cabeça.
text_el: λάκκον ὤρυξεν καὶ ἀνέσκαψεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς βόθρον ὃν εἰργάσατο

text_en: His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: and his iniquity shall come down upon his crown.
text_la: Convertetur dolor ejus in caput ejus, et in verticem ipsius iniquitas ejus descendet.
text_pt: Eu louvarei ao Senhor segundo a sua justiça, e cantarei louvores ao nome do Senhor altíssimo.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψει ὁ πόνος αὐτοῦ εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ κορυφὴν αὐτοῦ ἡ ἀδικία αὐτοῦ καταβήσεται

text_en: I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice : and will sing to the name of the Lord the most high.
text_la: Confitebor Domino secundum justitiam ejus, et psallam nomini Domini altissimi.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαι κυρίῳ κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: Unto the end, for the presses: a psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, pro torcularibus. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, Senhor nosso, quão admirável é o teu nome em toda a terra, pois puseste a tua glória sobre os céus!
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: O Lord , our Lord, how admirable is your name in the whole earth! For your magnificence is elevated above the heavens .
text_la: Domine, Dominus noster, quam admirabile est nomen tuum in universa terra! quoniam elevata est magnificentia tua super cælos.
text_pt: Tu ordenaste força da boca das crianças e dos que mamam, por causa dos teus inimigos, para fazer calar ao inimigo e ao vingador.
text_el: κύριε ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ὡς θαυμαστὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ὅτι ἐπήρθη ἡ μεγαλοπρέπειά σου ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν

text_en: Out of the mouth of infants and of sucklings you have perfected praise, because of your enemies, that you may destroy the enemy and the avenger.
text_la: Ex ore infantium et lactentium perfecisti laudem propter inimicos tuos, ut destruas inimicum et ultorem.
text_pt: Quando vejo os teus céus, obra dos teus dedos, a lua e as estrelas que preparaste;
text_el: ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων κατηρτίσω αἶνον ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου τοῦ καταλῦσαι ἐχθρὸν καὶ ἐκδικητήν

text_en: For I will behold your heavens , the works of your fingers: the moon and the stars which you have founded.
text_la: Quoniam videbo cælos tuos, opera digitorum tuorum, lunam et stellas quæ tu fundasti.
text_pt: Que é o homem mortal para que te lembres dele? e o filho do homem, para que o visites?
text_el: ὅτι ὄψομαι τοὺς οὐρανούς ἔργα τῶν δακτύλων σου σελήνην καὶ ἀστέρας ἃ σὺ ἐθεμελίωσας

text_en: What is man , that you are mindful of him? Or the son of man , that you visit him?
text_la: Quid est homo, quod memor es ejus? aut filius hominis, quoniam visitas eum?
text_pt: Pois pouco menor o fizeste do que os anjos, e de glória e de honra o coroaste.
text_el: τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν

text_en: You have made him a little less than the angels , you have crowned him with glory and honour:
text_la: Minuisti eum paulominus ab angelis; gloria et honore coronasti eum;
text_pt: Fazes com que ele tenha domínio sobre as obras das tuas mãos; tudo puseste debaixo de seus pés:
text_el: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρ' ἀγγέλους δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν

text_en: And have set him over the works of your hands.
text_la: et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum.
text_pt: Todas as ovelhas e bois, assim como os animais do campo,
text_el: καὶ κατέστησας αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: You have subjected all things under his feet, all sheep and oxen: moreover, the beasts also of the fields.
text_la: Omnia subjecisti sub pedibus ejus, oves et boves universas, insuper et pecora campi,
text_pt: As aves dos céus, e os peixes do mar, e tudo o que passa pelas veredas dos mares.
text_el: πρόβατα καὶ βόας πάσας ἔτι δὲ καὶ τὰ κτήνη τοῦ πεδίου

text_en: The birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea, that pass through the paths of the sea.
text_la: volucres cæli, et pisces maris qui perambulant semitas maris.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, Senhor nosso, quão admirável é o teu nome sobre toda a terra!
text_el: τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἰχθύας τῆς θαλάσσης τὰ διαπορευόμενα τρίβους θαλασσῶν

text_en: O Lord , our Lord, how admirable is your name in the whole earth!
text_la: Domine, Dominus noster, quam admirabile est nomen tuum in universa terra!
text_el: κύριε ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ὡς θαυμαστὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: Unto the end, for the hidden things of the Son. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, pro occultis filii. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Eu te louvarei, Senhor, com todo o meu coração; contarei todas as tuas maravilhas.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν κρυφίων τοῦ υἱοῦ ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: I will give praise to you, O Lord , with my whole heart: I will relate all your wonders.
text_la: Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo; narrabo omnia mirabilia tua.
text_pt: Em ti me alegrarei e saltarei de prazer; cantarei louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου διηγήσομαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου

text_en: I will be glad, and rejoice in you: I will sing to your name , O you most high.
text_la: Lætabor et exsultabo in te; psallam nomini tuo, Altissime.
text_pt: Porquanto os meus inimigos retornaram, caíram e pereceram diante da tua face.
text_el: εὐφρανθήσομαι καὶ ἀγαλλιάσομαι ἐν σοί ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ὕψιστε

text_en: When my enemy shall be turned back: they shall be weakened, and perish before your face.
text_la: In convertendo inimicum meum retrorsum; infirmabuntur, et peribunt a facie tua.
text_pt: Pois tu tens sustentado o meu direito e a minha causa; tu te assentaste no tribunal, julgando justamente;.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἀποστραφῆναι τὸν ἐχθρόν μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἀσθενήσουσιν καὶ ἀπολοῦνται ἀπὸ προσώπου σου

text_en: For you have maintained my judgment and my cause: you have sat on the throne, who judge justice .
text_la: Quoniam fecisti judicium meum et causam meam; sedisti super thronum, qui judicas justitiam.
text_pt: Repreendeste as nações, destruíste os ímpios; apagaste o seu nome para sempre e eternamente.
text_el: ὅτι ἐποίησας τὴν κρίσιν μου καὶ τὴν δίκην μου ἐκάθισας ἐπὶ θρόνου ὁ κρίνων δικαιοσύνην

text_en: You have rebuked the Gentiles , and the wicked one has perished; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
text_la: Increpasti gentes, et periit impius : nomen eorum delesti in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Oh! inimigo! acabaram-se para sempre as assolações; e tu arrasaste as cidades, e a sua memória pereceu com elas.
text_el: ἐπετίμησας ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἀπώλετο ὁ ἀσεβής τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐξήλειψας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: and their cities you have destroyed. Their memory has perished with a noise:
text_la: Inimici defecerunt frameæ in finem, et civitates eorum destruxisti. Periit memoria eorum cum sonitu;
text_pt: Mas o Senhor está assentado perpetuamente; já preparou o seu tribunal para julgar.
text_el: τοῦ ἐχθροῦ ἐξέλιπον αἱ ῥομφαῖαι εἰς τέλος καὶ πόλεις καθεῖλες ἀπώλετο τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν μετ' ἤχους

text_en: But the Lord remains for ever. He has prepared his throne in judgment:
text_la: et Dominus in æternum permanet. Paravit in judicio thronum suum,
text_pt: Ele mesmo julgará o mundo com justiça; exercerá juízo sobre povos com retidão.
text_el: καὶ ὁ κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένει ἡτοίμασεν ἐν κρίσει τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he shall judge the world in equity, he shall judge the people in justice .
text_la: et ipse judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate : judicabit populos in justitia.
text_pt: O Senhor será também um alto refúgio para o oprimido; um alto refúgio em tempos de angústia.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ κρινεῖ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι

text_en: And the Lord has become a refuge for the poor: a helper in due time in tribulation.
text_la: Et factus est Dominus refugium pauperi; adjutor in opportunitatibus, in tribulatione.
text_pt: Em ti confiarão os que conhecem o teu nome; porque tu, Senhor, nunca desamparaste os que te buscam.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο κύριος καταφυγὴ τῷ πένητι βοηθὸς ἐν εὐκαιρίαις ἐν θλίψει

text_en: And let them trust in you who know your name : for you have not forsaken them that seek you, O Lord .
text_la: Et sperent in te qui noverunt nomen tuum, quoniam non dereliquisti quærentes te, Domine.
text_pt: Cantai louvores ao Senhor, que habita em Sião; anunciai entre os povos os seus feitos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλπισάτωσαν ἐπὶ σὲ οἱ γινώσκοντες τὸ ὄνομά σου ὅτι οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπες τοὺς ἐκζητοῦντάς σε κύριε

text_en: Sing to the Lord , who dwells in Sion: declare his ways among the Gentiles :
text_la: Psallite Domino qui habitat in Sion; annuntiate inter gentes studia ejus:
text_pt: Pois quando inquire do derramamento de sangue, lembra-se deles: não se esquece do clamor dos aflitos.
text_el: ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ κατοικοῦντι ἐν Σιων ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: For requiring their blood, he has remembered them: he has not forgotten the cry of the poor.
text_la: quoniam requirens sanguinem eorum recordatus est; non est oblitus clamorem pauperum.
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, Senhor, olha para a minha aflição, causada por aqueles que me odeiam; tu que me levantas das portas da morte;.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκζητῶν τὰ αἵματα αὐτῶν ἐμνήσθη οὐκ ἐπελάθετο τῆς κραυγῆς τῶν πενήτων

text_en: Have mercy on me, O Lord : see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.
text_la: Miserere mei, Domine : vide humilitatem meam de inimicis meis,
text_pt: Para que eu conte todos os teus louvores nas portas da filha de Sião, e me alegre na tua salvação.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με κύριε ἰδὲ τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ὁ ὑψῶν με ἐκ τῶν πυλῶν τοῦ θανάτου

text_en: You that lift me up from the gates of death, that I may declare all your praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.
text_la: qui exaltas me de portis mortis, ut annuntiem omnes laudationes tuas in portis filiæ Sion:
text_pt: Os gentios enterraram-se na cova que fizeram; na rede que ocultaram ficou preso o seu pé.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ἐξαγγείλω πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις σου ἐν ταῖς πύλαις τῆς θυγατρὸς Σιων ἀγαλλιάσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου

text_en: I will rejoice in your salvation : the Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they prepared. Their foot has been taken in the very snare which they hid.
text_la: exultabo in salutari tuo. Infixæ sunt gentes in interitu quem fecerunt; in laqueo isto quem absconderunt comprehensus est pes eorum.
text_pt: O Senhor é conhecido pelo juízo que fez; enlaçado foi o ímpio nas obras de suas mãos. (Higaiom; Selá.).
text_el: ἐνεπάγησαν ἔθνη ἐν διαφθορᾷ ᾗ ἐποίησαν ἐν παγίδι ταύτῃ ᾗ ἔκρυψαν συνελήμφθη ὁ ποὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord shall be known when he executes judgments: the sinner has been caught in the works of his own hands.
text_la: Cognoscetur Dominus judicia faciens; in operibus manuum suarum comprehensus est peccator.
text_pt: Os ímpios serão lançados no inferno, e todas as nações que se esquecem de Deus.
text_el: γινώσκεται κύριος κρίματα ποιῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ συνελήμφθη ὁ ἁμαρτωλός ᾠδὴ διαψάλματος

text_en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God .
text_la: Convertantur peccatores in infernum, omnes gentes quæ obliviscuntur Deum.
text_pt: Porque o necessitado não será esquecido para sempre, nem a expectação dos pobres perecerá perpetuamente.
text_el: ἀποστραφήτωσαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ εἰς τὸν ᾅδην πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐπιλανθανόμενα τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.
text_la: Quoniam non in finem oblivio erit pauperis; patientia pauperum non peribit in finem.
text_pt: Levanta-te, Senhor; não prevaleça o homem; sejam julgados os gentios diante da tua face.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τέλος ἐπιλησθήσεται ὁ πτωχός ἡ ὑπομονὴ τῶν πενήτων οὐκ ἀπολεῖται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Arise, O Lord , let not man be strengthened: let the Gentiles be judged in your sight.
text_la: Exsurge, Domine; non confortetur homo : judicentur gentes in conspectu tuo.
text_pt: Põe-os em medo, Senhor, para que saibam as nações que são formadas por meros homens. (Selá.).
text_el: ἀνάστηθι κύριε μὴ κραταιούσθω ἄνθρωπος κριθήτωσαν ἔθνη ἐνώπιόν σου

text_en: Appoint, O Lord , a lawgiver over them: that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men .
text_la: Constitue, Domine, legislatorem super eos, ut sciant gentes quoniam homines sunt.
text_el: κατάστησον κύριε νομοθέτην ἐπ' αὐτούς γνώτωσαν ἔθνη ὅτι ἄνθρωποί εἰσιν διάψαλμα

text_en: Why, O Lord , have you retired afar off? Why do you slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?
text_la: Ut quid, Domine, recessisti longe; despicis in opportunitatibus, in tribulatione?
text_el: ἵνα τί κύριε ἀφέστηκας μακρόθεν ὑπερορᾷς ἐν εὐκαιρίαις ἐν θλίψει

text_en: Whilst the wicked man is proud , the poor is set on fire: they are caught in the counsels which they devise.
text_la: Dum superbit impius, incenditur pauper : comprehenduntur in consiliis quibus cogitant.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ὑπερηφανεύεσθαι τὸν ἀσεβῆ ἐμπυρίζεται ὁ πτωχός συλλαμβάνονται ἐν διαβουλίοις οἷς διαλογίζονται

text_en: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul : and the unjust man is blessed .
text_la: Quoniam laudatur peccator in desideriis animæ suæ, et iniquus benedicitur.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπαινεῖται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ ἀδικῶν ἐνευλογεῖται

text_en: The sinner has provoked the Lord , according to the multitude of his wrath , he will not seek him:
text_la: Exacerbavit Dominum peccator : secundum multitudinem iræ suæ, non quæret.
text_el: παρώξυνεν τὸν κύριον ὁ ἁμαρτωλός κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐκζητήσει οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ θεὸς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: God is not before his eyes: his ways are filthy at all times. Your judgments are removed form his sight: he shall rule over all his enemies.
text_la: Non est Deus in conspectu ejus; inquinatæ sunt viæ illius in omni tempore. Auferuntur judicia tua a facie ejus; omnium inimicorum suorum dominabitur.
text_el: βεβηλοῦνται αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἀνταναιρεῖται τὰ κρίματά σου ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ κατακυριεύσει

text_en: For he has said in his heart: I shall not be moved from generation to generation , and shall be without evil .
text_la: Dixit enim in corde suo : Non movebor a generatione in generationem, sine malo.
text_el: εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεὰν ἄνευ κακοῦ

text_en: His mouth is full of cursing , and of bitterness, and of deceit: under his tongue are labour and sorrow.
text_la: Cujus maledictione os plenum est, et amaritudine, et dolo; sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.
text_el: οὗ ἀρᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ γέμει καὶ πικρίας καὶ δόλου ὑπὸ τὴν γλῶσσαν αὐτοῦ κόπος καὶ πόνος

text_en: He sits in ambush with the rich, in private places , that he may kill the innocent.
text_la: Sedet in insidiis cum divitibus in occultis, ut interficiat innocentem.
text_el: ἐγκάθηται ἐνέδρᾳ μετὰ πλουσίων ἐν ἀποκρύφοις ἀποκτεῖναι ἀθῷον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν πένητα ἀποβλέπουσιν

text_en: His eyes are upon the poor man : he lies in wait, in secret, like a lion in his den. He lies in ambush, that he may catch the poor man : so catch the poor, whilst he draws him to him.
text_la: Oculi ejus in pauperem respiciunt; insidiatur in abscondito, quasi leo in spelunca sua. Insidiatur ut rapiat pauperem; rapere pauperem dum attrahit eum.
text_el: ἐνεδρεύει ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ ὡς λέων ἐν τῇ μάνδρᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐνεδρεύει τοῦ ἁρπάσαι πτωχόν ἁρπάσαι πτωχὸν ἐν τῷ ἑλκύσαι αὐτόν

text_en: In his net he will bring him down, he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.
text_la: In laqueo suo humiliabit eum; inclinabit se, et cadet cum dominatus fuerit pauperum.
text_el: ἐν τῇ παγίδι αὐτοῦ ταπεινώσει αὐτόν κύψει καὶ πεσεῖται ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν κατακυριεῦσαι τῶν πενήτων

text_en: For he has said in his heart: God has forgotten, he has turned away his face, not to see to the end.
text_la: Dixit enim in corde suo : Oblitus est Deus; avertit faciem suam, ne videat in finem.
text_el: εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐπιλέλησται ὁ θεός ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν εἰς τέλος

text_en: Arise, O Lord God , let your hand be exalted: forget not the poor.
text_la: Exsurge, Domine Deus, exaltetur manus tua; ne obliviscaris pauperum.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι κύριε ὁ θεός ὑψωθήτω ἡ χείρ σου μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῶν πενήτων

text_en: Wherefore has the wicked provoked God ? For he has said in his heart: He will not require it.
text_la: Propter quid irritavit impius Deum? dixit enim in corde suo : Non requiret.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τίνος παρώξυνεν ὁ ἀσεβὴς τὸν θεόν εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐκζητήσει

text_en: You see it, for you consider labour and sorrow: that you may deliver them into your hands. To you is the poor man left: you will be a helper to the orphan.
text_la: Vides, quoniam tu laborem et dolorem consideras, ut tradas eos in manus tuas. Tibi derelictus est pauper; orphano tu eris adjutor.
text_el: βλέπεις ὅτι σὺ πόνον καὶ θυμὸν κατανοεῖς τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖράς σου σοὶ οὖν ἐγκαταλέλειπται ὁ πτωχός ὀρφανῷ σὺ ἦσθα βοηθῶν

text_en: Break the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.
text_la: Contere brachium peccatoris et maligni; quæretur peccatum illius, et non invenietur.
text_el: σύντριψον τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ πονηροῦ ζητηθήσεται ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ δι' αὐτήν

text_en: The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: you Gentiles shall perish from his land.
text_la: Dominus regnabit in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi; peribitis, gentes, de terra illius.
text_el: βασιλεύσει κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος ἀπολεῖσθε ἔθνη ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord has heard the desire of the poor: your ear has heard the preparation of their heart.
text_la: Desiderium pauperum exaudivit Dominus; præparationem cordis eorum audivit auris tua:
text_el: τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῶν πενήτων εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν προσέσχεν τὸ οὖς σου

text_en: To judge for the fatherless and for the humble , that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.
text_la: judicare pupillo et humili, ut non apponat ultra magnificare se homo super terram.
text_el: κρῖναι ὀρφανῷ καὶ ταπεινῷ ἵνα μὴ προσθῇ ἔτι τοῦ μεγαλαυχεῖν ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Unto the end. A psalm to David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Por que estás ao longe, SENHOR? Por que te escondes nos tempos de angústia?
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: In the Lord I put my trust: how then do you say to my soul : Get you away from hence to the mountain, like a sparrow.
text_la: In Domino confido; quomodo dicitis animæ meæ : Transmigra in montem sicut passer?
text_pt: Os ímpios na sua arrogância perseguem furiosamente o pobre; sejam apanhados nas ciladas que maquinaram.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ πέποιθα πᾶς ἐρεῖτε τῇ ψυχῇ μου μεταναστεύου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη ὡς στρουθίον

text_en: For, lo, the wicked have bent their bow: they have prepared their arrows in the quiver, to shoot in the dark the upright of heart.
text_la: Quoniam ecce peccatores intenderunt arcum; paraverunt sagittas suas in pharetra, ut sagittent in obscuro rectos corde:
text_pt: Porque o ímpio gloria-se do desejo da sua alma; bendiz ao avarento, e renuncia ao Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐνέτειναν τόξον ἡτοίμασαν βέλη εἰς φαρέτραν τοῦ κατατοξεῦσαι ἐν σκοτομήνῃ τοὺς εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: For they have destroyed the things which you have made: but what has the just man done?
text_la: quoniam quæ perfecisti destruxerunt; justus autem, quid fecit?
text_pt: Pela altivez do seu rosto o ímpio não busca a Deus; todas as suas cogitações são que não há Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἃ κατηρτίσω καθεῖλον ὁ δὲ δίκαιος τί ἐποίησεν

text_en: The Lord is in his holy temple , the Lord's throne is in heaven . His eyes look on the poor man : his eyelids examine the sons of men .
text_la: Dominus in templo sancto suo; Dominus in cælo sedes ejus. Oculi ejus in pauperem respiciunt; palpebræ ejus interrogant filios hominum.
text_pt: Os seus caminhos atormentam sempre; os teus juízos estão longe da vista dele, em grande altura, e despreza aos seus inimigos.
text_el: κύριος ἐν ναῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ κύριος ἐν οὐρανῷ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν πένητα ἀποβλέπουσιν τὰ βλέφαρα αὐτοῦ ἐξετάζει τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: The Lord tries the just and the wicked: but he that loves iniquity , hates his own soul .
text_la: Dominus interrogat justum et impium; qui autem diligit iniquitatem, odit animam suam.
text_pt: Diz em seu coração: Não serei abalado, porque nunca me verei na adversidade.
text_el: κύριος ἐξετάζει τὸν δίκαιον καὶ τὸν ἀσεβῆ ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν ἀδικίαν μισεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν

text_en: He shall rain snares upon sinners: fire and brimstone, and storms of winds, shall be the portion of their cup.
text_la: Pluet super peccatores laqueos; ignis et sulphur, et spiritus procellarum, pars calicis eorum.
text_pt: A sua boca está cheia de imprecações, de enganos e de astúcia; debaixo da sua língua há malícia e maldade.
text_el: ἐπιβρέξει ἐπὶ ἁμαρτωλοὺς παγίδας πῦρ καὶ θεῖον καὶ πνεῦμα καταιγίδος ἡ μερὶς τοῦ ποτηρίου αὐτῶν

text_en: For the Lord is just , and has loved justice : his countenance has beheld righteousness.
text_la: Quoniam justus Dominus, et justitias dilexit : æquitatem vidit vultus ejus.
text_pt: Põe-se de emboscada nas aldeias; nos lugares ocultos mata o inocente; os seus olhos estão ocultamente fixos sobre o pobre.
text_el: ὅτι δίκαιος κύριος καὶ δικαιοσύνας ἠγάπησεν εὐθύτητα εἶδεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Unto the end: for the octave, a psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, pro octava. Psalmus David.
text_pt: No SENHOR confio; como dizeis à minha alma: Fugi para a vossa montanha como pássaro?
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῆς ὀγδόης ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Save me, O Lord , for there is now no saint: truths are decayed from among the children of men .
text_la: Salvum me fac, Domine, quoniam defecit sanctus, quoniam diminutæ sunt veritates a filiis hominum.
text_pt: Pois eis que os ímpios armam o arco, põem as flechas na corda, para com elas atirarem, às escuras, aos retos de coração.
text_el: σῶσόν με κύριε ὅτι ἐκλέλοιπεν ὅσιος ὅτι ὠλιγώθησαν αἱ ἀλήθειαι ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: They have spoken vain things, every one to his neighbour: with deceitful lips, and with a double heart have they spoken.
text_la: Vana locuti sunt unusquisque ad proximum suum; labia dolosa, in corde et corde locuti sunt.
text_pt: Se forem destruídos os fundamentos, que poderá fazer o justo?
text_el: μάταια ἐλάλησεν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ χείλη δόλια ἐν καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἐλάλησαν

text_en: May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips, and the tongue that speaks proud things.
text_la: Disperdat Dominus universa labia dolosa, et linguam magniloquam.
text_pt: O Senhor está no seu santo templo, o trono do Senhor está nos céus; os seus olhos estão atentos, e as suas pálpebras provam os filhos dos homens.
text_el: ἐξολεθρεύσαι κύριος πάντα τὰ χείλη τὰ δόλια καὶ γλῶσσαν μεγαλορήμονα

text_en: Who have said: We will magnify our tongue: our lips are our own: who is Lord over us?
text_la: Qui dixerunt : Linguam nostram magnificabimus; labia nostra a nobis sunt. Quis noster dominus est?
text_pt: O Senhor prova o justo; porém ao ímpio e ao que ama a violência odeia a sua alma.
text_el: τοὺς εἰπόντας τὴν γλῶσσαν ἡμῶν μεγαλυνοῦμεν τὰ χείλη ἡμῶν παρ' ἡμῶν ἐστιν τίς ἡμῶν κύριός ἐστιν

text_en: By reason of the misery of the needy, and the groans of the poor, now will I arise, says the Lord . I will set him in safety: I will deal confidently in his regard.
text_la: Propter miseriam inopum, et gemitum pauperum, nunc exsurgam, dicit Dominus. Ponam in salutari; fiducialiter agam in eo.
text_pt: Sobre os ímpios fará chover laços, fogo, enxofre e vento tempestuoso; isto será a porção do seu copo.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς ταλαιπωρίας τῶν πτωχῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ τῶν πενήτων νῦν ἀναστήσομαι λέγει κύριος θήσομαι ἐν σωτηρίᾳ παρρησιάσομαι ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried by the fire, purged from the earth, refined seven times.
text_la: Eloquia Domini, eloquia casta; argentum igne examinatum, probatum terræ, purgatum septuplum.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor é justo, e ama a justiça; o seu rosto olha para os retos.
text_el: τὰ λόγια κυρίου λόγια ἁγνά ἀργύριον πεπυρωμένον δοκίμιον τῇ γῇ κεκαθαρισμένον ἑπταπλασίως

text_en: You, O Lord , will preserve us: and keep us from this generation for ever.
text_la: Tu, Domine, servabis nos, et custodies nos a generatione hac in æternum.
text_el: σύ κύριε φυλάξεις ἡμᾶς καὶ διατηρήσεις ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: The wicked walk round about: according to your highness, you have multiplied the children of men .
text_la: In circuitu impii ambulant: secundum altitudinem tuam multiplicasti filios hominum.
text_el: κύκλῳ οἱ ἀσεβεῖς περιπατοῦσιν κατὰ τὸ ὕψος σου ἐπολυώρησας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: How long, O Lord , will you forget me unto the end? How long do you turn away your face from me?
text_la: Usquequo, Domine, oblivisceris me in finem? usquequo avertis faciem tuam a me?
text_pt: Salva-nos, SENHOR, porque faltam os homens bons; porque são poucos os fiéis entre os filhos dos homens.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: How long shall I take counsels in my soul , sorrow in my heart all the day?
text_la: quamdiu ponam consilia in anima mea; dolorem in corde meo per diem?
text_pt: Cada um fala com falsidade ao seu próximo; falam com lábios lisonjeiros e coração dobrado.
text_el: ἕως πότε κύριε ἐπιλήσῃ μου εἰς τέλος ἕως πότε ἀποστρέψεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: How long shall my enemy be exalted over Me?
text_la: usquequo exaltabitur inimicus meus super me?
text_pt: O Senhor cortará todos os lábios lisonjeiros e a língua que fala soberbamente.
text_el: ἕως τίνος θήσομαι βουλὰς ἐν ψυχῇ μου ὀδύνας ἐν καρδίᾳ μου ἡμέρας ἕως πότε ὑψωθήσεται ὁ ἐχθρός μου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Consider, and hear me, O Lord , my God . Enlighten my eyes, that I never sleep in death:
text_la: Respice, et exaudi me, Domine Deus meus. Illumina oculos meos, ne umquam obdormiam in morte;
text_pt: Pois dizem: Com a nossa língua prevaleceremos; são nossos os lábios; quem é senhor sobre nós?
text_el: ἐπίβλεψον εἰσάκουσόν μου κύριε ὁ θεός μου φώτισον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου μήποτε ὑπνώσω εἰς θάνατον

text_en: Lest at any time my enemy say: I have prevailed against him. They that trouble me, will rejoice when I am moved:
text_la: nequando dicat inimicus meus : Prævalui adversus eum. Qui tribulant me exsultabunt si motus fuero;
text_pt: Pela opressão dos pobres, pelo gemido dos necessitados me levantarei agora, diz o Senhor; porei a salvo aquele para quem eles assopram.
text_el: μήποτε εἴπῃ ὁ ἐχθρός μου ἴσχυσα πρὸς αὐτόν οἱ θλίβοντές με ἀγαλλιάσονται ἐὰν σαλευθῶ

text_en: But I have trusted in your mercy. My heart shall rejoice in your salvation : I will sing to the Lord , who gives me good things: yea, I will sing to the name of the Lord , the most high.
text_la: ego autem in misericordia tua speravi. Exsultabit cor meum in salutari tuo. Cantabo Domino qui bona tribuit mihi; et psallam nomini Domini altissimi.
text_pt: As palavras do Senhor são palavras puras, como prata refinada em fornalha de barro, purificada sete vezes.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου ἤλπισα ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ καρδία μου ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ᾄσω τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ εὐεργετήσαντί με καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: The fool has said in his heart: There is no God . They are corrupt, and have become abominable in their ways: there is none that does good , no not one.
text_la: Dixit insipiens in corde suo : Non est Deus. Corrupti sunt, et abominabiles facti sunt in studiis suis; non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
text_pt: Até quando te esquecerás de mim, SENHOR? Para sempre? Até quando esconderás de mim o teu rosto?
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ εἶπεν ἄφρων ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν θεός διέφθειραν καὶ ἐβδελύχθησαν ἐν ἐπιτηδεύμασιν οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν χρηστότητα οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός

text_en: The Lord has looked down from heaven upon the children of men , to see if there be any that understand and seek God .
text_la: Dominus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum, ut videat si est intelligens, aut requirens Deum.
text_pt: Até quando consultarei com a minha alma, tendo tristeza no meu coração cada dia? Até quando se exaltará sobre mim o meu inimigo?
text_el: κύριος ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων τοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ ἔστιν συνίων ἢ ἐκζητῶν τὸν θεόν

text_en: They are all gone aside, they have become unprofitable together: there is none that does good : no not one. Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they acted deceitfully: the poison of asps is under their lips. Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; their feet are swift to shed blood. Destruction and unhappiness in their ways; and the way of peace they have not known: there is no fear of God before their eyes.
text_la: Omnes declinaverunt, simul inutiles facti sunt. Non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum. Sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum; linguis suis dolose agebant. Venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum, quorum os maledictione et amaritudine plenum est; veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem. Contritio et infelicitas in viis eorum, et viam pacis non cognoverunt; non est timor Dei ante oculos eorum.
text_pt: Atende-me, ouve-me, ó Senhor meu Deus; ilumina os meus olhos para que eu não adormeça na morte;
text_el: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν χρηστότητα οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν ὧν τὸ στόμα ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας γέμει ὀξεῖς οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐκχέαι αἷμα σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Shall not all they know that work iniquity , who devour my people as they eat bread?
text_la: Nonne cognoscent omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, qui devorant plebem meam sicut escam panis?
text_pt: Para que o meu inimigo não diga: Prevaleci contra ele; e os meus adversários não se alegrem, vindo eu a vacilar.
text_el: οὐχὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν οἱ κατεσθίοντες τὸν λαόν μου βρώσει ἄρτου τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο

text_en: They have not called upon the Lord : there have they trembled for fear, where there was no fear.
text_la: Dominum non invocaverunt; illic trepidaverunt timore, ubi non erat timor.
text_pt: Mas eu confio na tua benignidade; na tua salvação se alegrará o meu coração.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἐδειλίασαν φόβῳ οὗ οὐκ ἦν φόβος ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐν γενεᾷ δικαίᾳ

text_en: For the Lord is in the just generation : you have confounded the counsel of the poor man ; but the Lord is his hope.
text_la: Quoniam Dominus in generatione justa est : consilium inopis confudistis, quoniam Dominus spes ejus est.
text_pt: Cantarei ao Senhor, porquanto me tem feito muito bem.
text_el: βουλὴν πτωχοῦ κατῃσχύνατε ὅτι κύριος ἐλπὶς αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: Who shall give out of Sion the salvation of Israel ? When the Lord shall have turned away the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text_la: Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël? Cum averterit Dominus captivitatem plebis suæ, exsultabit Jacob, et lætabitur Israël.
text_el: τίς δώσει ἐκ Σιων τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσθω Ιακωβ καὶ εὐφρανθήτω Ισραηλ

text_en: Lord , who shall dwell in your tabernacle? Or who shall rest in your holy hill?
text_la: Domine, quis habitabit in tabernaculo tuo? aut quis requiescet in monte sancto tuo?
text_pt: Disse o néscio no seu coração: Não há Deus. Têm-se corrompido, fazem-se abomináveis em suas obras, não há ninguém que faça o bem.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ κύριε τίς παροικήσει ἐν τῷ σκηνώματί σου καὶ τίς κατασκηνώσει ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ ἁγίῳ σου

text_en: He that walks without blemish, and works justice :
text_la: Qui ingreditur sine macula, et operatur justitiam;
text_pt: O Senhor olhou desde os céus para os filhos dos homens, para ver se havia algum que tivesse entendimento e buscasse a Deus.
text_el: πορευόμενος ἄμωμος καὶ ἐργαζόμενος δικαιοσύνην λαλῶν ἀλήθειαν ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He that speaks truth in his heart, who has not used deceit in his tongue: Nor has done evil to his neighbour: nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.
text_la: qui loquitur veritatem in corde suo : qui non egit dolum in lingua sua, nec fecit proximo suo malum, et opprobrium non accepit adversus proximos suos.
text_pt: Desviaram-se todos e juntamente se fizeram imundos: não há quem faça o bem, não há sequer um.
text_el: ὃς οὐκ ἐδόλωσεν ἐν γλώσσῃ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἐποίησεν τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ κακὸν καὶ ὀνειδισμὸν οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔγγιστα αὐτοῦ

text_en: In his sight the malignant is brought to nothing: but he glorifies them that fear the Lord . He that swears to his neighbour, and deceives not;
text_la: Ad nihilum deductus est in conspectu ejus malignus; timentes autem Dominum glorificat. Qui jurat proximo suo, et non decipit;
text_pt: Não terão conhecimento os que praticam a iniqüidade, os quais comem o meu povo, como se comessem pão, e não invocam ao Senhor?
text_el: ἐξουδένωται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πονηρευόμενος τοὺς δὲ φοβουμένους κύριον δοξάζει ὁ ὀμνύων τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀθετῶν

text_en: he that has not put out his money to usury , nor taken bribes against the innocent: He that does these things, shall not be moved for ever.
text_la: qui pecuniam suam non dedit ad usuram, et munera super innocentem non accepit : qui facit hæc non movebitur in æternum.
text_pt: Ali se acharam em grande pavor, porque Deus está na geração dos justos.
text_el: τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἐπὶ τόκῳ καὶ δῶρα ἐπ' ἀθῴοις οὐκ ἔλαβεν ὁ ποιῶν ταῦτα οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Preserve me, O Lord , for I have put my trust in you.
text_la: Conserva me, Domine, quoniam speravi in te.
text_pt: SENHOR, quem habitará no teu tabernáculo? Quem morará no teu santo monte?
text_el: στηλογραφία τῷ Δαυιδ φύλαξόν με κύριε ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα

text_en: I have said to the Lord , you are my God , for you have no need of my goods.
text_la: Dixi Domino : Deus meus es tu, quoniam bonorum meorum non eges.
text_pt: Aquele que anda sinceramente, e pratica a justiça, e fala a verdade no seu coração.
text_el: εἶπα τῷ κυρίῳ κύριός μου εἶ σύ ὅτι τῶν ἀγαθῶν μου οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις

text_en: To the saints, who are in his land, he has made wonderful all my desires in them.
text_la: Sanctis qui sunt in terra ejus, mirificavit omnes voluntates meas in eis.
text_pt: Aquele que não difama com a sua língua, nem faz mal ao seu próximo, nem aceita nenhum opróbrio contra o seu próximo;
text_el: τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ ἐθαυμάστωσεν πάντα τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Their infirmities were multiplied: afterwards they made haste. I will not gather together their meetings for blood offerings: nor will I be mindful of their names by my lips.
text_la: Multiplicatæ sunt infirmitates eorum : postea acceleraverunt. Non congregabo conventicula eorum de sanguinibus, nec memor ero nominum eorum per labia mea.
text_pt: A cujos olhos o réprobo é desprezado; mas honra os que temem ao Senhor; aquele que jura com dano seu, e contudo não muda.
text_el: ἐπληθύνθησαν αἱ ἀσθένειαι αὐτῶν μετὰ ταῦτα ἐτάχυναν οὐ μὴ συναγάγω τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν ἐξ αἱμάτων οὐδὲ μὴ μνησθῶ τῶν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν διὰ χειλέων μου

text_en: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: it is you that will restore my inheritance to me.
text_la: Dominus pars hæreditatis meæ, et calicis mei : tu es qui restitues hæreditatem meam mihi.
text_pt: Aquele que não dá o seu dinheiro com usura, nem recebe peitas contra o inocente. Quem faz isto nunca será abalado.
text_el: κύριος ἡ μερὶς τῆς κληρονομίας μου καὶ τοῦ ποτηρίου μου σὺ εἶ ὁ ἀποκαθιστῶν τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἐμοί

text_en: The lines are fallen unto me in goodly places: for my inheritance is goodly to me.
text_la: Funes ceciderunt mihi in præclaris; etenim hæreditas mea præclara est mihi.
text_el: σχοινία ἐπέπεσάν μοι ἐν τοῖς κρατίστοις καὶ γὰρ ἡ κληρονομία μου κρατίστη μοί ἐστιν

text_en: I will bless the Lord , who has given me understanding: moreover, my reins also have corrected me even till night.
text_la: Benedicam Dominum qui tribuit mihi intellectum; insuper et usque ad noctem increpuerunt me renes mei.
text_el: εὐλογήσω τὸν κύριον τὸν συνετίσαντά με ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἕως νυκτὸς ἐπαίδευσάν με οἱ νεφροί μου

text_en: I set the Lord always in my sight: for he is at my right hand, that I be not moved.
text_la: Providebam Dominum in conspectu meo semper : quoniam a dextris est mihi, ne commovear.
text_el: προωρώμην τὸν κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ

text_en: Therefore my heart has been glad, and my tongue has rejoiced: moreover, my flesh also shall rest in hope.
text_la: Propter hoc lætatum est cor meum, et exsultavit lingua mea; insuper et caro mea requiescet in spe.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπ' ἐλπίδι

text_en: Because you will not leave my soul in hell; nor will you give your holy one to see corruption.
text_la: Quoniam non derelinques animam meam in inferno, nec dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ᾅδην οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν

text_en: You have made known to me the ways of life, you shall fill me with joy with your countenance: at your right hand are delights even to the end.
text_la: Notas mihi fecisti vias vitæ; adimplebis me lætitia cum vultu tuo : delectationes in dextera tua usque in finem.
text_el: ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου τερπνότητες ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ σου εἰς τέλος

text_en: Hear, O Lord , my justice : attend to my supplication. Give ear unto my prayer , which proceeds not from deceitful lips.
text_la: Exaudi, Domine, justitiam meam; intende deprecationem meam. Auribus percipe orationem meam, non in labiis dolosis.
text_pt: Guarda-me, ó Deus, porque em ti confio.
text_el: προσευχὴ τοῦ Δαυιδ εἰσάκουσον κύριε τῆς δικαιοσύνης μου πρόσχες τῇ δεήσει μου ἐνώτισαι τῆς προσευχῆς μου οὐκ ἐν χείλεσιν δολίοις

text_en: Let my judgment come forth from your countenance: let your eyes behold the things that are equitable.
text_la: De vultu tuo judicium meum prodeat; oculi tui videant æquitates.
text_pt: A minha alma disse ao Senhor: Tu és o meu Senhor, a minha bondade não chega à tua presença,
text_el: ἐκ προσώπου σου τὸ κρίμα μου ἐξέλθοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἰδέτωσαν εὐθύτητας

text_en: You have proved my heart, and visited it by night, you have tried me by fire: and iniquity has not been found in me.
text_la: Probasti cor meum, et visitasti nocte; igne me examinasti, et non est inventa in me iniquitas.
text_pt: Mas aos santos que estão na terra, e aos ilustres em quem está todo o meu prazer.
text_el: ἐδοκίμασας τὴν καρδίαν μου ἐπεσκέψω νυκτός ἐπύρωσάς με καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν ἐμοὶ ἀδικία

text_en: That my mouth may not speak the works of men : for the sake of the words of your lips, I have kept hard ways.
text_la: Ut non loquatur os meum opera hominum : propter verba labiorum tuorum, ego custodivi vias duras.
text_pt: As dores se multiplicarão àqueles que fazem oferendas a outro deus; eu não oferecerei as suas libações de sangue, nem tomarei os seus nomes nos meus lábios.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν μὴ λαλήσῃ τὸ στόμα μου τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἀνθρώπων διὰ τοὺς λόγους τῶν χειλέων σου ἐγὼ ἐφύλαξα ὁδοὺς σκληράς

text_en: Perfect my goings in your paths: that my footsteps be not moved.
text_la: Perfice gressus meos in semitis tuis, ut non moveantur vestigia mea.
text_pt: O Senhor é a porção da minha herança e do meu cálice; tu sustentas a minha sorte.
text_el: κατάρτισαι τὰ διαβήματά μου ἐν ταῖς τρίβοις σου ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶσιν τὰ διαβήματά μου

text_en: I have cried to you, for you, O God , have heard me: O incline your ear unto me, and hear my words.
text_la: Ego clamavi, quoniam exaudisti me, Deus; inclina aurem tuam mihi, et exaudi verba mea.
text_pt: As linhas caem-me em lugares deliciosos: sim, coube-me uma formosa herança.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐκέκραξα ὅτι ἐπήκουσάς μου ὁ θεός κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου ἐμοὶ καὶ εἰσάκουσον τῶν ῥημάτων μου

text_en: Show forth your wonderful mercies; you who save them that trust in you.
text_la: Mirifica misericordias tuas, qui salvos facis sperantes in te.
text_pt: Louvarei ao Senhor que me aconselhou; até os meus rins me ensinam de noite.
text_el: θαυμάστωσον τὰ ἐλέη σου ὁ σῴζων τοὺς ἐλπίζοντας ἐπὶ σὲ ἐκ τῶν ἀνθεστηκότων τῇ δεξιᾷ σου

text_en: From them that resist your right hand keep me, as the apple of your eye. Protect me under the shadow of your wings.
text_la: A resistentibus dexteræ tuæ custodi me ut pupillam oculi. Sub umbra alarum tuarum protege me
text_pt: Tenho posto o Senhor continuamente diante de mim; por isso que ele está à minha mão direita, nunca vacilarei.
text_el: φύλαξόν με ὡς κόραν ὀφθαλμοῦ ἐν σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου σκεπάσεις με

text_en: From the face of the wicked who have afflicted me. My enemies have surrounded my soul :
text_la: a facie impiorum qui me afflixerunt. Inimici mei animam meam circumdederunt;
text_pt: Portanto está alegre o meu coração e se regozija a minha glória; também a minha carne repousará segura.
text_el: ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀσεβῶν τῶν ταλαιπωρησάντων με οἱ ἐχθροί μου τὴν ψυχήν μου περιέσχον

text_en: They have shut up their fat: their mouth has spoken proudly .
text_la: adipem suum concluserunt : os eorum locutum est superbiam.
text_pt: Pois não deixarás a minha alma no inferno, nem permitirás que o teu Santo veja corrupção.
text_el: τὸ στέαρ αὐτῶν συνέκλεισαν τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ἐλάλησεν ὑπερηφανίαν

text_en: They have cast me forth, and now they have surrounded me: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth.
text_la: Projicientes me nunc circumdederunt me; oculos suos statuerunt declinare in terram.
text_pt: Far-me-ás ver a vereda da vida; na tua presença há fartura de alegrias; à tua mão direita há delícias perpetuamente.
text_el: ἐκβάλλοντές με νυνὶ περιεκύκλωσάν με τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν ἔθεντο ἐκκλῖναι ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: They have taken me, as a lion prepared for the prey; and as a young lion dwelling in secret places.
text_la: Susceperunt me sicut leo paratus ad prædam, et sicut catulus leonis habitans in abditis.
text_el: ὑπέλαβόν με ὡσεὶ λέων ἕτοιμος εἰς θήραν καὶ ὡσεὶ σκύμνος οἰκῶν ἐν ἀποκρύφοις

text_en: Arise, O Lord , disappoint him and supplant him; deliver my soul from the wicked one ; your sword
text_la: Exsurge, Domine : præveni eum, et supplanta eum : eripe animam meam ab impio; frameam tuam
text_el: ἀνάστηθι κύριε πρόφθασον αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑποσκέλισον αὐτούς ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ ἀσεβοῦς ῥομφαίαν σου ἀπὸ ἐχθρῶν τῆς χειρός σου

text_en: from the enemies of your hand. O Lord , divide them from the few of the earth in their life: their belly is filled from your hidden stores. They are full of children: and they have left to their little ones the rest of their substance.
text_la: ab inimicis manus tuæ. Domine, a paucis de terra divide eos in vita eorum; de absconditis tuis adimpletus est venter eorum. Saturati sunt filiis, et dimiserunt reliquias suas parvulis suis.
text_el: κύριε ἀπὸ ὀλίγων ἀπὸ γῆς διαμέρισον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν κεκρυμμένων σου ἐπλήσθη ἡ γαστὴρ αὐτῶν ἐχορτάσθησαν υἱῶν καὶ ἀφῆκαν τὰ κατάλοιπα τοῖς νηπίοις αὐτῶν

text_en: But as for me, I will appear before your sight in justice : I shall be satisfied when your glory shall appear.
text_la: Ego autem in justitia apparebo conspectui tuo; satiabor cum apparuerit gloria tua.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ὀφθήσομαι τῷ προσώπῳ σου χορτασθήσομαι ἐν τῷ ὀφθῆναι τὴν δόξαν σου

text_en: Unto the end, for David , the servant of the Lord , who spoke to the Lord the words of this canticle, in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul : and he said:
text_la: In finem. Puero Domini David, qui locutus est Domino verba cantici hujus, in die qua eripuit eum Dominus de manu omnium inimicorum ejus, et de manu Saul, et dixit:
text_pt: Ouve, SENHOR, a justiça; atende ao meu clamor; dá ouvidos à minha oração, que não é feita com lábios enganosos.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ παιδὶ κυρίου τῷ Δαυιδ ἃ ἐλάλησεν τῷ κυρίῳ τοὺς λόγους τῆς ᾠδῆς ταύτης ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐρρύσατο αὐτὸν κύριος ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς Σαουλ

text_en: I will love you, O Lord , my strength:
text_la: Diligam te, Domine, fortitudo mea.
text_pt: Saia a minha sentença de diante do teu rosto; atendam os teus olhos à razão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀγαπήσω σε κύριε ἡ ἰσχύς μου

text_en: The Lord is my firmament , my refuge, and my deliverer. My God is my helper, and in him will I put my trust. My protector, and the horn of my salvation , and my support.
text_la: Dominus firmamentum meum, et refugium meum, et liberator meus. Deus meus adjutor meus, et sperabo in eum; protector meus, et cornu salutis meæ, et susceptor meus.
text_pt: Provaste o meu coração; visitaste-me de noite; examinaste-me, e nada achaste; propus que a minha boca não transgredirá.
text_el: κύριος στερέωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου καὶ ῥύστης μου ὁ θεός μου βοηθός μου καὶ ἐλπιῶ ἐπ' αὐτόν ὑπερασπιστής μου καὶ κέρας σωτηρίας μου ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου

text_en: Praising, I will call upon the Lord : and I shall be saved from my enemies.
text_la: Laudans invocabo Dominum, et ab inimicis meis salvus ero.
text_pt: Quanto ao trato dos homens, pela palavra dos teus lábios me guardei das veredas do destruidor.
text_el: αἰνῶν ἐπικαλέσομαι κύριον καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου σωθήσομαι

text_en: The sorrows of death surrounded me: and the torrents of iniquity troubled me.
text_la: Circumdederunt me dolores mortis, et torrentes iniquitatis conturbaverunt me.
text_pt: Dirige os meus passos nos teus caminhos, para que as minhas pegadas não vacilem.
text_el: περιέσχον με ὠδῖνες θανάτου καὶ χείμαρροι ἀνομίας ἐξετάραξάν με

text_en: The sorrows of hell encompassed me: and the snares of death prevented me.
text_la: Dolores inferni circumdederunt me; præoccupaverunt me laquei mortis.
text_pt: Eu te invoquei, ó Deus, pois me queres ouvir; inclina para mim os teus ouvidos, e escuta as minhas palavras.
text_el: ὠδῖνες ᾅδου περιεκύκλωσάν με προέφθασάν με παγίδες θανάτου

text_en: In my affliction I called upon the Lord , and I cried to my God : And he heard my voice from his holy temple : and my cry before him came into his ears.
text_la: In tribulatione mea invocavi Dominum, et ad Deum meum clamavi : et exaudivit de templo sancto suo vocem meam; et clamor meus in conspectu ejus introivit in aures ejus.
text_pt: Faze maravilhosas as tuas beneficências, ó tu que livras aqueles que em ti confiam dos que se levantam contra a tua destra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸν κύριον καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεόν μου ἐκέκραξα ἤκουσεν ἐκ ναοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ φωνῆς μου καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The earth shook and trembled: the foundations of the mountains were troubled and were moved, because he was angry with them.
text_la: Commota est, et contremuit terra; fundamenta montium conturbata sunt, et commota sunt : quoniam iratus est eis.
text_pt: Guarda-me como à menina do olho; esconde-me debaixo da sombra das tuas asas,
text_el: καὶ ἐσαλεύθη καὶ ἔντρομος ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τῶν ὀρέων ἐταράχθησαν καὶ ἐσαλεύθησαν ὅτι ὠργίσθη αὐτοῖς ὁ θεός

text_en: There went up a smoke in his wrath : and a fire flamed from his face: coals were kindled by it.
text_la: Ascendit fumus in ira ejus, et ignis a facie ejus exarsit; carbones succensi sunt ab eo.
text_pt: Dos ímpios que me oprimem, dos meus inimigos mortais que me andam cercando.
text_el: ἀνέβη καπνὸς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ πῦρ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ κατεφλόγισεν ἄνθρακες ἀνήφθησαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: He bowed the heavens , and came down, and darkness was under his feet.
text_la: Inclinavit cælos, et descendit, et caligo sub pedibus ejus.
text_pt: Na sua gordura se encerram, com a boca falam soberbamente.
text_el: καὶ ἔκλινεν οὐρανὸν καὶ κατέβη καὶ γνόφος ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he ascended upon the cherubim , and he flew; he flew upon the wings of the winds.
text_la: Et ascendit super cherubim, et volavit; volavit super pennas ventorum.
text_pt: Têm-nos cercado agora nossos passos; e baixaram os seus olhos para a terra;
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβη ἐπὶ χερουβιν καὶ ἐπετάσθη ἐπετάσθη ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀνέμων

text_en: And he made darkness his covert, his pavilion round about him: dark waters in the clouds of the air.
text_la: Et posuit tenebras latibulum suum; in circuitu ejus tabernaculum ejus, tenebrosa aqua in nubibus aëris.
text_pt: Parecem-se com o leão que deseja arrebatar a sua presa, e com o leãozinho que se põe em esconderijos.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο σκότος ἀποκρυφὴν αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ ἡ σκηνὴ αὐτοῦ σκοτεινὸν ὕδωρ ἐν νεφέλαις ἀέρων

text_en: At the brightness that was before him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.
text_la: Præ fulgore in conspectu ejus nubes transierunt; grando et carbones ignis.
text_pt: Levanta-te, Senhor, detém-no, derriba-o, livra a minha alma do ímpio, com a tua espada;
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς τηλαυγήσεως ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ αἱ νεφέλαι διῆλθον χάλαζα καὶ ἄνθρακες πυρός

text_en: And the Lord thundered from heaven , and the Highest gave his voice: hail and coals of fire.
text_la: Et intonuit de cælo Dominus, et Altissimus dedit vocem suam : grando et carbones ignis.
text_pt: Dos homens com a tua mão, Senhor, dos homens do mundo, cuja porção está nesta vida, e cujo ventre enches do teu tesouro oculto. Estão fartos de filhos e dão os seus sobejos às suas crianças.
text_el: καὶ ἐβρόντησεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ κύριος καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἔδωκεν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he sent forth his arrows, and he scattered them: he multiplied lightnings, and troubled them.
text_la: Et misit sagittas suas, et dissipavit eos; fulgura multiplicavit, et conturbavit eos.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, contemplarei a tua face na justiça; eu me satisfarei da tua semelhança quando acordar.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν βέλη καὶ ἐσκόρπισεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀστραπὰς ἐπλήθυνεν καὶ συνετάραξεν αὐτούς

text_en: Then the fountains of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were discovered: At your rebuke, O Lord , at the blast of the spirit of your wrath .
text_la: Et apparuerunt fontes aquarum, et revelata sunt fundamenta orbis terrarum, ab increpatione tua, Domine, ab inspiratione spiritus iræ tuæ.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθησαν αἱ πηγαὶ τῶν ὑδάτων καὶ ἀνεκαλύφθη τὰ θεμέλια τῆς οἰκουμένης ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου κύριε ἀπὸ ἐμπνεύσεως πνεύματος ὀργῆς σου
