text_en: He sent from on high, and took me: and received me out of many waters.
text_la: Misit de summo, et accepit me; et assumpsit me de aquis multis.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐξ ὕψους καὶ ἔλαβέν με προσελάβετό με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν

text_en: He delivered me from my strongest enemies, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
text_la: Eripuit me de inimicis meis fortissimis, et ab his qui oderunt me. Quoniam confortati sunt super me;
text_el: ῥύσεταί με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου δυνατῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με ὅτι ἐστερεώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ

text_en: They prevented me in the day of my affliction: and the Lord became my protector.
text_la: prævenerunt me in die afflictionis meæ : et factus est Dominus protector meus.
text_el: προέφθασάν με ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακώσεώς μου καὶ ἐγένετο κύριος ἀντιστήριγμά μου

text_en: And he brought me forth into a large place: he saved me, because he was well pleased with me.
text_la: Et eduxit me in latitudinem; salvum me fecit, quoniam voluit me,
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγέν με εἰς πλατυσμόν ῥύσεταί με ὅτι ἠθέλησέν με ῥύσεταί με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου δυνατῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με

text_en: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice ; and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands:
text_la: et retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, et secundum puritatem manuum mearum retribuet mihi:
text_el: καὶ ἀνταποδώσει μοι κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἀνταποδώσει μοι

text_en: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord ; and have not done wickedly against my God .
text_la: quia custodivi vias Domini, nec impie gessi a Deo meo;
text_el: ὅτι ἐφύλαξα τὰς ὁδοὺς κυρίου καὶ οὐκ ἠσέβησα ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ μου

text_en: For all his judgments are in my sight: and his justices I have not put away from me.
text_la: quoniam omnia judicia ejus in conspectu meo, et justitias ejus non repuli a me.
text_el: ὅτι πάντα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιόν μου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπέστησα ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And I shall be spotless with him: and shall keep myself from my iniquity .
text_la: Et ero immaculatus cum eo; et observabo me ab iniquitate mea.
text_el: καὶ ἔσομαι ἄμωμος μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ φυλάξομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας μου

text_en: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice : and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.
text_la: Et retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, et secundum puritatem manuum mearum in conspectu oculorum ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἀνταποδώσει μοι κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: With the holy you will be holy ; and with the innocent man you will be innocent:
text_la: Cum sancto sanctus eris, et cum viro innocente innocens eris,
text_el: μετὰ ὁσίου ὁσιωθήσῃ καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἀθῴου ἀθῷος ἔσῃ

text_en: And with the elect you will be elect : and with the perverse you will be perverted.
text_la: et cum electo electus eris, et cum perverso perverteris.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ἐκλεκτοῦ ἐκλεκτὸς ἔσῃ καὶ μετὰ στρεβλοῦ διαστρέψεις

text_en: For you will save the humble people; but will bring down the eyes of the proud .
text_la: Quoniam tu populum humilem salvum facies, et oculos superborum humiliabis.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ λαὸν ταπεινὸν σώσεις καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑπερηφάνων ταπεινώσεις

text_en: For you light my lamp, O Lord : O my God , enlighten my darkness.
text_la: Quoniam tu illuminas lucernam meam, Domine; Deus meus, illumina tenebras meas.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ φωτιεῖς λύχνον μου κύριε ὁ θεός μου φωτιεῖς τὸ σκότος μου

text_en: For by you I shall be delivered from temptation; and through my God I shall go over a wall.
text_la: Quoniam in te eripiar a tentatione; et in Deo meo transgrediar murum.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν σοὶ ῥυσθήσομαι ἀπὸ πειρατηρίου καὶ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μου ὑπερβήσομαι τεῖχος

text_en: As for my God , his way is undefiled: the words of the Lord are fire-tried: he is the protector of all that trust in him.
text_la: Deus meus, impolluta via ejus; eloquia Domini igne examinata : protector est omnium sperantium in se.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου ἄμωμος ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ τὰ λόγια κυρίου πεπυρωμένα ὑπερασπιστής ἐστιν πάντων τῶν ἐλπιζόντων ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: For who is God but the Lord ? Or who is God but our God ?
text_la: Quoniam quis deus præter Dominum? aut quis deus præter Deum nostrum?
text_el: ὅτι τίς θεὸς πλὴν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τίς θεὸς πλὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: God , who has girt me with strength; and made my way blameless.
text_la: Deus qui præcinxit me virtute, et posuit immaculatam viam meam;
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν καὶ ἔθετο ἄμωμον τὴν ὁδόν μου

text_en: Who has made my feet like the feet of harts: and who sets me upon high places.
text_la: qui perfecit pedes meos tamquam cervorum, et super excelsa statuens me;
text_el: ὁ καταρτιζόμενος τοὺς πόδας μου ὡς ἐλάφου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἱστῶν με

text_en: Who teaches my hands to war : and you have made my arms like a brazen bow.
text_la: qui docet manus meas ad prælium. Et posuisti, ut arcum æreum, brachia mea,
text_el: διδάσκων χεῖράς μου εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἔθου τόξον χαλκοῦν τοὺς βραχίονάς μου

text_en: And you have given me the protection of your salvation : and your right hand has held me up: And your discipline has corrected me unto the end: and your discipline, the same shall teach me.
text_la: et dedisti mihi protectionem salutis tuæ : et dextera tua suscepit me, et disciplina tua correxit me in finem, et disciplina tua ipsa me docebit.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκάς μοι ὑπερασπισμὸν σωτηρίας μου καὶ ἡ δεξιά σου ἀντελάβετό μου καὶ ἡ παιδεία σου ἀνώρθωσέν με εἰς τέλος καὶ ἡ παιδεία σου αὐτή με διδάξει

text_en: You have enlarged my steps under me; and my feet are not weakened.
text_la: Dilatasti gressus meos subtus me, et non sunt infirmata vestigia mea.
text_el: ἐπλάτυνας τὰ διαβήματά μου ὑποκάτω μου καὶ οὐκ ἠσθένησαν τὰ ἴχνη μου

text_en: I will pursue after my enemies, and overtake them: and I will not turn again till they are consumed.
text_la: Persequar inimicos meos, et comprehendam illos; et non convertar donec deficiant.
text_el: καταδιώξω τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου καὶ καταλήμψομαι αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι ἕως ἂν ἐκλίπωσιν

text_en: I will break them, and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet.
text_la: Confringam illos, nec poterunt stare; cadent subtus pedes meos.
text_el: ἐκθλίψω αὐτούς καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆναι πεσοῦνται ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας μου

text_en: And you have girded me with strength unto battle; and have subdued under me them that rose up against me.
text_la: Et præcinxisti me virtute ad bellum, et supplantasti insurgentes in me subtus me.
text_el: καὶ περιέζωσάς με δύναμιν εἰς πόλεμον συνεπόδισας πάντας τοὺς ἐπανιστανομένους ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὑποκάτω μου

text_en: And you have made my enemies turn their back upon me, and have destroyed them that hated me.
text_la: Et inimicos meos dedisti mihi dorsum, et odientes me disperdidisti.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἔδωκάς μοι νῶτον καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντάς με ἐξωλέθρευσας

text_en: They cried, but there was none to save them, to the Lord : but he heard them not.
text_la: Clamaverunt, nec erat qui salvos faceret; ad Dominum, nec exaudivit eos.
text_el: ἐκέκραξαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ σῴζων πρὸς κύριον καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν

text_en: And I shall beat them as small as the dust before the wind; I shall bring them to nought, like the dirt in the streets.
text_la: Et comminuam eos ut pulverem ante faciem venti; ut lutum platearum delebo eos.
text_el: καὶ λεπτυνῶ αὐτοὺς ὡς χοῦν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀνέμου ὡς πηλὸν πλατειῶν λεανῶ αὐτούς

text_en: You will deliver me from the contradictions of the people; you will make me head of the Gentiles .
text_la: Eripies me de contradictionibus populi; constitues me in caput gentium.
text_el: ῥύσῃ με ἐξ ἀντιλογιῶν λαοῦ καταστήσεις με εἰς κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν λαός ὃν οὐκ ἔγνων ἐδούλευσέν μοι

text_en: A people which I knew not, has served me: at the hearing of the ear they have obeyed me.
text_la: Populus quem non cognovi servivit mihi; in auditu auris obedivit mihi.
text_el: εἰς ἀκοὴν ὠτίου ὑπήκουσέν μοι υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐψεύσαντό μοι

text_en: The children that are strangers have lied to me, strange children have faded away, and have halted from their paths.
text_la: Filii alieni mentiti sunt mihi, filii alieni inveterati sunt, et claudicaverunt a semitis suis.
text_el: υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐπαλαιώθησαν καὶ ἐχώλαναν ἀπὸ τῶν τρίβων αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord lives, and blessed by my God , and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
text_la: Vivit Dominus, et benedictus Deus meus, et exaltetur Deus salutis meæ.
text_el: ζῇ κύριος καὶ εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεός μου καὶ ὑψωθήτω ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου

text_en: O God , who avenges me, and subdues the people under me, my deliverer from my enraged enemies.
text_la: Deus qui das vindictas mihi, et subdis populos sub me; liberator meus de inimicis meis iracundis.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ὁ διδοὺς ἐκδικήσεις ἐμοὶ καὶ ὑποτάξας λαοὺς ὑπ' ἐμέ

text_en: And you will lift me up above them that rise up against me: from the unjust man you will deliver me.
text_la: Et ab insurgentibus in me exaltabis me; a viro iniquo eripies me.
text_el: ὁ ῥύστης μου ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου ὀργίλων ἀπὸ τῶν ἐπανιστανομένων ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὑψώσεις με ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἀδίκου ῥύσῃ με

text_en: Therefore will I give glory to you, O Lord , among the nations, and I will sing a psalm to your name .
text_la: Propterea confitebor tibi in nationibus, Domine, et nomini tuo psalmum dicam;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν κύριε καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ

text_en: Giving great deliverance to his king, and showing mercy to David , his anointed: and to his seed for ever.
text_la: magnificans salutes regis ejus, et faciens misericordiam christo suo David, et semini ejus usque in sæculum.
text_el: μεγαλύνων τὰς σωτηρίας τοῦ βασιλέως αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος τῷ χριστῷ αὐτοῦ τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Unto the end. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Eu te amarei, ó SENHOR, fortaleza minha.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: The heavens show forth the glory of God , and the firmament declares the work of his hands.
text_la: Cæli enarrant gloriam Dei, et opera manuum ejus annuntiat firmamentum.
text_pt: O Senhor é o meu rochedo, e o meu lugar forte, e o meu libertador; o meu Deus, a minha fortaleza, em quem confio; o meu escudo, a força da minha salvação, e o meu alto refúgio.
text_el: οἱ οὐρανοὶ διηγοῦνται δόξαν θεοῦ ποίησιν δὲ χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγέλλει τὸ στερέωμα

text_en: Day to day utters speech, and night to night shows knowledge.
text_la: Dies diei eructat verbum, et nox nocti indicat scientiam.
text_pt: Invocarei o nome do Senhor, que é digno de louvor, e ficarei livre dos meus inimigos.
text_el: ἡμέρα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐρεύγεται ῥῆμα καὶ νὺξ νυκτὶ ἀναγγέλλει γνῶσιν

text_en: There are no speeches nor languages, where their voices are not heard.
text_la: Non sunt loquelæ, neque sermones, quorum non audiantur voces eorum.
text_pt: Tristezas de morte me cercaram, e torrentes de impiedade me assombraram.
text_el: οὐκ εἰσὶν λαλιαὶ οὐδὲ λόγοι ὧν οὐχὶ ἀκούονται αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: Their sound has gone forth into all the earth: and their words unto the ends of the world.
text_la: In omnem terram exivit sonus eorum, et in fines orbis terræ verba eorum.
text_pt: Tristezas do inferno me cingiram, laços de morte me surpreenderam.
text_el: εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ ἡλίῳ ἔθετο τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has set his tabernacle in the sun: and he as a bridegroom coming out of his bridechamber, Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way:
text_la: In sole posuit tabernaculum suum; et ipse tamquam sponsus procedens de thalamo suo. Exsultavit ut gigas ad currendam viam;
text_pt: Na angústia invoquei ao Senhor, e clamei ao meu Deus; desde o seu templo ouviu a minha voz, aos seus ouvidos chegou o meu clamor perante a sua face.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ὡς νυμφίος ἐκπορευόμενος ἐκ παστοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσεται ὡς γίγας δραμεῖν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: His going out is from the end of heaven , And his circuit even to the end thereof: and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.
text_la: a summo cælo egressio ejus. Et occursus ejus usque ad summum ejus; nec est qui se abscondat a calore ejus.
text_pt: Então a terra se abalou e tremeu; e os fundamentos dos montes também se moveram e se abalaram, porquanto se indignou.
text_el: ἀπ' ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἡ ἔξοδος αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κατάντημα αὐτοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀποκρυβήσεται τὴν θέρμην αὐτοῦ

text_en: The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls : the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.
text_la: Lex Domini immaculata, convertens animas; testimonium Domini fidele, sapientiam præstans parvulis.
text_pt: Das suas narinas subiu fumaça, e da sua boca saiu fogo que consumia; carvões se acenderam dele.
text_el: ὁ νόμος τοῦ κυρίου ἄμωμος ἐπιστρέφων ψυχάς ἡ μαρτυρία κυρίου πιστή σοφίζουσα νήπια

text_en: The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.
text_la: Justitiæ Domini rectæ, lætificantes corda; præceptum Domini lucidum, illuminans oculos.
text_pt: Abaixou os céus, e desceu, e a escuridão estava debaixo de seus pés.
text_el: τὰ δικαιώματα κυρίου εὐθεῖα εὐφραίνοντα καρδίαν ἡ ἐντολὴ κυρίου τηλαυγής φωτίζουσα ὀφθαλμούς

text_en: The fear of the Lord is holy , enduring for ever and ever: the judgments of the Lord are true , justified in themselves.
text_la: Timor Domini sanctus, permanens in sæculum sæculi; judicia Domini vera, justificata in semetipsa,
text_pt: E montou num querubim, e voou; sim, voou sobre as asas do vento.
text_el: ὁ φόβος κυρίου ἁγνός διαμένων εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος τὰ κρίματα κυρίου ἀληθινά δεδικαιωμένα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: More to be desired than gold and many precious stones : and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
text_la: desiderabilia super aurum et lapidem pretiosum multum, et dulciora super mel et favum.
text_pt: Fez das trevas o seu lugar oculto; o pavilhão que o cercava era a escuridão das águas e as nuvens dos céus.
text_el: ἐπιθυμητὰ ὑπὲρ χρυσίον καὶ λίθον τίμιον πολὺν καὶ γλυκύτερα ὑπὲρ μέλι καὶ κηρίον

text_en: For your servant keeps them, and in keeping them there is a great reward.
text_la: Etenim servus tuus custodit ea; in custodiendis illis retributio multa.
text_pt: Ao resplendor da sua presença as nuvens se espalharam, e a saraiva e as brasas de fogo.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὁ δοῦλός σου φυλάσσει αὐτά ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτὰ ἀνταπόδοσις πολλή

text_en: Who can understand sins ? From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord :
text_la: Delicta quis intelligit? ab occultis meis munda me;
text_pt: E o Senhor trovejou nos céus, o Altíssimo levantou a sua voz; e houve saraiva e brasas de fogo.
text_el: παραπτώματα τίς συνήσει ἐκ τῶν κρυφίων μου καθάρισόν με

text_en: And from those of others spare your servant. If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin .
text_la: et ab alienis parce servo tuo. Si mei non fuerint dominati, tunc immaculatus ero, et emundabor a delicto maximo.
text_pt: Mandou as suas setas, e as espalhou; multiplicou raios, e os desbaratou.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ ἀλλοτρίων φεῖσαι τοῦ δούλου σου ἐὰν μή μου κατακυριεύσωσιν τότε ἄμωμος ἔσομαι καὶ καθαρισθήσομαι ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας μεγάλης

text_en: And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: and the meditation of my heart always in your sight. O Lord , my helper and my Redeemer.
text_la: Et erunt ut complaceant eloquia oris mei, et meditatio cordis mei in conspectu tuo semper. Domine, adjutor meus, et redemptor meus.
text_pt: Então foram vistas as profundezas das águas, e foram descobertos os fundamentos do mundo, pela tua repreensão, Senhor, ao sopro das tuas narinas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται εἰς εὐδοκίαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ στόματός μου καὶ ἡ μελέτη τῆς καρδίας μου ἐνώπιόν σου διὰ παντός κύριε βοηθέ μου καὶ λυτρωτά μου

text_en: Unto the end. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Os céus declaram a glória de Deus e o firmamento anuncia a obra das suas mãos.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: May the Lord hear you in the day of tribulation: may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
text_la: Exaudiat te Dominus in die tribulationis; protegat te nomen Dei Jacob.
text_pt: Um dia faz declaração a outro dia, e uma noite mostra sabedoria a outra noite.
text_el: ἐπακούσαι σου κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως ὑπερασπίσαι σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ Ιακωβ

text_en: May he send you help from the sanctuary: and defend you out of Sion.
text_la: Mittat tibi auxilium de sancto, et de Sion tueatur te.
text_pt: Não há linguagem nem fala onde não se ouça a sua voz.
text_el: ἐξαποστείλαι σοι βοήθειαν ἐξ ἁγίου καὶ ἐκ Σιων ἀντιλάβοιτό σου

text_en: May he be mindful of all your sacrifices : and may your whole burnt offering be made fat.
text_la: Memor sit omnis sacrificii tui, et holocaustum tuum pingue fiat.
text_pt: A sua linha se estende por toda a terra, e as suas palavras até ao fim do mundo. Neles pôs uma tenda para o sol,
text_el: μνησθείη πάσης θυσίας σου καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμά σου πιανάτω διάψαλμα

text_en: May he give you according to your own heart; and confirm all your counsels.
text_la: Tribuat tibi secundum cor tuum, et omne consilium tuum confirmet.
text_pt: O qual é como um noivo que sai do seu tálamo, e se alegra como um herói, a correr o seu caminho.
text_el: δῴη σοι κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν βουλήν σου πληρώσαι

text_en: We will rejoice in your salvation ; and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.
text_la: Lætabimur in salutari tuo; et in nomine Dei nostri magnificabimur.
text_pt: A sua saída é desde uma extremidade dos céus, e o seu curso até à outra extremidade, e nada se esconde ao seu calor.
text_el: ἀγαλλιασόμεθα ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου καὶ ἐν ὀνόματι θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα πληρώσαι κύριος πάντα τὰ αἰτήματά σου

text_en: The Lord fulfil all your petitions: now have I known that the Lord has saved his anointed. He will hear him from his holy heaven : the salvation of his right hand is in powers.
text_la: Impleat Dominus omnes petitiones tuas; nunc cognovi quoniam salvum fecit Dominus christum suum. Exaudiet illum de cælo sancto suo, in potentatibus salus dexteræ ejus.
text_pt: A lei do Senhor é perfeita, e refrigera a alma; o testemunho do Senhor é fiel, e dá sabedoria aos símplices.
text_el: νῦν ἔγνων ὅτι ἔσωσεν κύριος τὸν χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπακούσεται αὐτοῦ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ ἐν δυναστείαις ἡ σωτηρία τῆς δεξιᾶς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will call upon the name of the Lord , our God .
text_la: Hi in curribus, et hi in equis; nos autem in nomine Domini Dei nostri invocabimus.
text_pt: Os preceitos do Senhor são retos e alegram o coração; o mandamento do Senhor é puro, e ilumina os olhos.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐν ἅρμασιν καὶ οὗτοι ἐν ἵπποις ἡμεῖς δὲ ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα

text_en: They are bound, and have fallen: but we are risen, and are set upright.
text_la: Ipsi obligati sunt, et ceciderunt; nos autem surreximus, et erecti sumus.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é limpo, e permanece eternamente; os juízos do Senhor são verdadeiros e justos juntamente.
text_el: αὐτοὶ συνεποδίσθησαν καὶ ἔπεσαν ἡμεῖς δὲ ἀνέστημεν καὶ ἀνωρθώθημεν

text_en: O Lord , save the king: and hear us in the day that we shall call upon you.
text_la: Domine, salvum fac regem, et exaudi nos in die qua invocaverimus te.
text_pt: Mais desejáveis são do que o ouro, sim, do que muito ouro fino; e mais doces do que o mel e o licor dos favos.
text_el: κύριε σῶσον τὸν βασιλέα σου καὶ ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλεσώμεθά σε

text_en: Unto the end. A psalm for David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: O SENHOR te ouça no dia da angústia, o nome do Deus de Jacó te proteja.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: In your strength, O Lord , the king shall joy ; and in your salvation he shall rejoice exceedingly.
text_la: Domine, in virtute tua lætabitur rex, et super salutare tuum exsultabit vehementer.
text_pt: Envie-te socorro desde o seu santuário, e te sustenha desde Sião.
text_el: κύριε ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου εὐφρανθήσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ἀγαλλιάσεται σφόδρα

text_en: You have given him his heart's desire: and have not withholden from him the will of his lips.
text_la: Desiderium cordis ejus tribuisti ei, et voluntate labiorum ejus non fraudasti eum.
text_pt: Lembre-se de todas as tuas ofertas, e aceite os teus holocaustos. (Selá.)
text_el: τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν θέλησιν τῶν χειλέων αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐστέρησας αὐτόν διάψαλμα

text_en: For you have prevented him with blessings of sweetness: you have set on his head a crown of precious stones .
text_la: Quoniam prævenisti eum in benedictionibus dulcedinis; posuisti in capite ejus coronam de lapide pretioso.
text_pt: Conceda-te conforme ao teu coração, e cumpra todo o teu plano.
text_el: ὅτι προέφθασας αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις χρηστότητος ἔθηκας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ στέφανον ἐκ λίθου τιμίου

text_en: He asked life of you: and you have given him length of days for ever and ever.
text_la: Vitam petiit a te, et tribuisti ei longitudinem dierum, in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Nós nos alegraremos pela tua salvação, e em nome do nosso Deus arvoraremos pendões; cumpra o Senhor todas as tuas petições.
text_el: ζωὴν ᾐτήσατό σε καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ μακρότητα ἡμερῶν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος

text_en: His glory is great in your salvation : glory and great beauty shall you lay upon him.
text_la: Magna est gloria ejus in salutari tuo; gloriam et magnum decorem impones super eum.
text_pt: Agora sei que o Senhor salva o seu ungido; ele o ouvirá desde o seu santo céu, com a força salvadora da sua mão direita.
text_el: μεγάλη ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου δόξαν καὶ μεγαλοπρέπειαν ἐπιθήσεις ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: For you shall give him to be a blessing for ever and ever: you shall make him joyful in gladness with your countenance.
text_la: Quoniam dabis eum in benedictionem in sæculum sæculi; lætificabis eum in gaudio cum vultu tuo.
text_pt: Uns confiam em carros e outros em cavalos, mas nós faremos menção do nome do Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: ὅτι δώσεις αὐτῷ εὐλογίαν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος εὐφρανεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν χαρᾷ μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου

text_en: For the king hopes in the Lord : and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
text_la: Quoniam rex sperat in Domino, et in misericordia Altissimi non commovebitur.
text_pt: Uns encurvam-se e caem, mas nós nos levantamos e estamos de pé.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐλπίζει ἐπὶ κύριον καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει τοῦ ὑψίστου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῇ

text_en: Let your hand be found by all your enemies: let your right hand find out all them that hate you.
text_la: Inveniatur manus tua omnibus inimicis tuis; dextera tua inveniat omnes qui te oderunt.
text_pt: Salva-nos, Senhor; ouça-nos o rei quando clamarmos.
text_el: εὑρεθείη ἡ χείρ σου πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἡ δεξιά σου εὕροι πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε

text_en: You shall make them as an oven of fire, in the time of your anger : the Lord shall trouble them in his wrath , and fire shall devour them.
text_la: Pones eos ut clibanum ignis in tempore vultus tui : Dominus in ira sua conturbabit eos, et devorabit eos ignis.
text_el: θήσεις αὐτοὺς ὡς κλίβανον πυρὸς εἰς καιρὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου κύριος ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ συνταράξει αὐτούς καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτοὺς πῦρ

text_en: Their fruit shall you destroy from the earth: and their seed from among the children of men .
text_la: Fructum eorum de terra perdes, et semen eorum a filiis hominum,
text_el: τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ γῆς ἀπολεῖς καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For they have intended evils against you: they have devised counsels which they have not been able to establish.
text_la: quoniam declinaverunt in te mala; cogitaverunt consilia quæ non potuerunt stabilire.
text_el: ὅτι ἔκλιναν εἰς σὲ κακά διελογίσαντο βουλήν ἣν οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆσαι

text_en: For you shall make them turn their back: in your remnants you shall prepare their face.
text_la: Quoniam pones eos dorsum; in reliquiis tuis præparabis vultum eorum.
text_el: ὅτι θήσεις αὐτοὺς νῶτον ἐν τοῖς περιλοίποις σου ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν

text_en: Be exalted, O Lord , in your own strength: we will sing and praise your power.
text_la: Exaltare, Domine, in virtute tua; cantabimus et psallemus virtutes tuas.
text_el: ὑψώθητι κύριε ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου ᾄσομεν καὶ ψαλοῦμεν τὰς δυναστείας σου

text_en: Unto the end, for the morning protection, a psalm for David .
text_la: In finem, pro susceptione matutina. Psalmus David.
text_pt: O rei se alegra em tua força, SENHOR; e na tua salvação grandemente se regozija.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀντιλήμψεως τῆς ἑωθινῆς ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: O God my God , look upon me: why have you forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my sins .
text_la: Deus, Deus meus, respice in me : quare me dereliquisti? longe a salute mea verba delictorum meorum.
text_pt: Cumpriste-lhe o desejo do seu coração, e não negaste as súplicas dos seus lábios. (Selá.)
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου πρόσχες μοι ἵνα τί ἐγκατέλιπές με μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς σωτηρίας μου οἱ λόγοι τῶν παραπτωμάτων μου

text_en: O my God , I shall cry by day, and you will not hear: and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.
text_la: Deus meus, clamabo per diem, et non exaudies; et nocte, et non ad insipientiam mihi.
text_pt: Pois vais ao seu encontro com as bênçãos de bondade; pões na sua cabeça uma coroa de ouro fino.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου κεκράξομαι ἡμέρας καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ καὶ νυκτός καὶ οὐκ εἰς ἄνοιαν ἐμοί

text_en: But you dwell in the holy place, the praise of Israel .
text_la: Tu autem in sancto habitas, laus Israël.
text_pt: Vida te pediu, e lha deste, mesmo longura de dias para sempre e eternamente.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἐν ἁγίοις κατοικεῖς ὁ ἔπαινος Ισραηλ

text_en: In you have our fathers hoped: they have hoped, and you have delivered them.
text_la: In te speraverunt patres nostri; speraverunt, et liberasti eos.
text_pt: Grande é a sua glória pela tua salvação; glória e majestade puseste sobre ele.
text_el: ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἤλπισαν καὶ ἐρρύσω αὐτούς

text_en: They cried to you, and they were saved: they trusted in you, and were not confounded.
text_la: Ad te clamaverunt, et salvi facti sunt; in te speraverunt, et non sunt confusi.
text_pt: Pois o abençoaste para sempre; tu o enches de gozo com a tua face.
text_el: πρὸς σὲ ἐκέκραξαν καὶ ἐσώθησαν ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισαν καὶ οὐ κατῃσχύνθησαν

text_en: But I am a worm, and no man : the reproach of men , and the outcast of the people.
text_la: Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo; opprobrium hominum, et abjectio plebis.
text_pt: Porque o rei confia no Senhor, e pela misericórdia do Altíssimo nunca vacilará.
text_el: ἐγὼ δέ εἰμι σκώληξ καὶ οὐκ ἄνθρωπος ὄνειδος ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἐξουδένημα λαοῦ

text_en: All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: they have spoken with the lips, and wagged the head.
text_la: Omnes videntes me deriserunt me; locuti sunt labiis, et moverunt caput.
text_pt: A tua mão alcançará todos os teus inimigos, a tua mão direita alcançará aqueles que te odeiam.
text_el: πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντές με ἐξεμυκτήρισάν με ἐλάλησαν ἐν χείλεσιν ἐκίνησαν κεφαλήν

text_en: He hoped in the Lord , let him deliver him: let him save him, seeing he delights in him.
text_la: Speravit in Domino, eripiat eum : salvum faciat eum, quoniam vult eum.
text_pt: Tu os farás como um forno de fogo no tempo da tua ira; o Senhor os devorará na sua indignação, e o fogo os consumirá.
text_el: ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ κύριον ῥυσάσθω αὐτόν σωσάτω αὐτόν ὅτι θέλει αὐτόν

text_en: For you are he that have drawn me out of the womb: my hope from the breasts of my mother.
text_la: Quoniam tu es qui extraxisti me de ventre, spes mea ab uberibus matris meæ.
text_pt: Seu fruto destruirás da terra, e a sua semente dentre os filhos dos homens.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐκσπάσας με ἐκ γαστρός ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἀπὸ μαστῶν τῆς μητρός μου

text_en: I was cast upon you from the womb. From my mother's womb you are my God ,
text_la: In te projectus sum ex utero; de ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu:
text_pt: Porque intentaram o mal contra ti; maquinaram um ardil, mas não prevalecerão.
text_el: ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπερρίφην ἐκ μήτρας ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου θεός μου εἶ σύ

text_en: depart not from me. For tribulation is very near: for there is none to help me.
text_la: ne discesseris a me, quoniam tribulatio proxima est, quoniam non est qui adjuvet.
text_pt: Assim que tu lhes farás voltar as costas; e com tuas flechas postas nas cordas lhes apontarás ao rosto.
text_el: μὴ ἀποστῇς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὅτι θλῖψις ἐγγύς ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ βοηθῶν

text_en: Many calves have surrounded me: fat bulls have besieged me.
text_la: Circumdederunt me vituli multi; tauri pingues obsederunt me.
text_pt: Exalta-te, Senhor, na tua força; então cantaremos e louvaremos o teu poder.
text_el: περιεκύκλωσάν με μόσχοι πολλοί ταῦροι πίονες περιέσχον με

text_en: They have opened their mouths against me, as a lion ravening and roaring.
text_la: Aperuerunt super me os suum, sicut leo rapiens et rugiens.
text_el: ἤνοιξαν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ὡς λέων ὁ ἁρπάζων καὶ ὠρυόμενος

text_en: I am poured out like water; and all my bones are scattered. My heart has become like wax melting in the midst of my bowels.
text_la: Sicut aqua effusus sum, et dispersa sunt omnia ossa mea : factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquescens in medio ventris mei.
text_el: ὡσεὶ ὕδωρ ἐξεχύθην καὶ διεσκορπίσθη πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐγενήθη ἡ καρδία μου ὡσεὶ κηρὸς τηκόμενος ἐν μέσῳ τῆς κοιλίας μου

text_en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue has cleaved to my jaws: and you have brought me down into the dust of death.
text_la: Aruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhæsit faucibus meis : et in pulverem mortis deduxisti me.
text_el: ἐξηράνθη ὡς ὄστρακον ἡ ἰσχύς μου καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου κεκόλληται τῷ λάρυγγί μου καὶ εἰς χοῦν θανάτου κατήγαγές με

text_en: For many dogs have encompassed me: the council of the malignant has besieged me. They have dug my hands and feet.
text_la: Quoniam circumdederunt me canes multi; concilium malignantium obsedit me. Foderunt manus meas et pedes meos;
text_el: ὅτι ἐκύκλωσάν με κύνες πολλοί συναγωγὴ πονηρευομένων περιέσχον με ὤρυξαν χεῖράς μου καὶ πόδας

text_en: They have numbered all my bones. And they have looked and stared upon me.
text_la: dinumeraverunt omnia ossa mea. Ipsi vero consideraverunt et inspexerunt me.
text_el: ἐξηρίθμησα πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου αὐτοὶ δὲ κατενόησαν καὶ ἐπεῖδόν με

text_en: They parted my garments amongst them; and upon my vesture they cast lots.
text_la: Diviserunt sibi vestimenta mea, et super vestem meam miserunt sortem.
text_el: διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτιά μου ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἱματισμόν μου ἔβαλον κλῆρον

text_en: But you, O Lord , remove not your help to a distance from me; look towards my defence.
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, ne elongaveris auxilium tuum a me; ad defensionem meam conspice.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε μὴ μακρύνῃς τὴν βοήθειάν μου εἰς τὴν ἀντίλημψίν μου πρόσχες

text_en: Deliver, O God , my soul from the sword: my only one from the hand of the dog.
text_la: Erue a framea, Deus, animam meam, et de manu canis unicam meam.
text_el: ῥῦσαι ἀπὸ ῥομφαίας τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς κυνὸς τὴν μονογενῆ μου

text_en: Save me from the lion's mouth; and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.
text_la: Salva me ex ore leonis, et a cornibus unicornium humilitatem meam.
text_el: σῶσόν με ἐκ στόματος λέοντος καὶ ἀπὸ κεράτων μονοκερώτων τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου

text_en: I will declare your name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I praise you.
text_la: Narrabo nomen tuum fratribus meis; in medio ecclesiæ laudabo te.
text_el: διηγήσομαι τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε

text_en: You that fear the Lord , praise him: all you the seed of Jacob , glorify him.
text_la: Qui timetis Dominum, laudate eum; universum semen Jacob, glorificate eum.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον αἰνέσατε αὐτόν ἅπαν τὸ σπέρμα Ιακωβ δοξάσατε αὐτόν φοβηθήτωσαν αὐτὸν ἅπαν τὸ σπέρμα Ισραηλ

text_en: Let all the seed of Israel fear him: because he has not slighted nor despised the supplication of the poor man . Neither has he turned away his face form me: and when I cried to him he heard me.
text_la: Timeat eum omne semen Israël, quoniam non sprevit, neque despexit deprecationem pauperis, nec avertit faciem suam a me : et cum clamarem ad eum, exaudivit me.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐξουδένωσεν οὐδὲ προσώχθισεν τῇ δεήσει τοῦ πτωχοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰσήκουσέν μου

text_en: With you is my praise in a great church: I will pay my vows in the sight of them that fear him.
text_la: Apud te laus mea in ecclesia magna; vota mea reddam in conspectu timentium eum.
text_el: παρὰ σοῦ ὁ ἔπαινός μου ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ μεγάλῃ τὰς εὐχάς μου ἀποδώσω ἐνώπιον τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτόν

text_en: The poor shall eat and shall be filled: and they shall praise the Lord that seek him: their hearts shall live for ever and ever.
text_la: Edent pauperes, et saturabuntur, et laudabunt Dominum qui requirunt eum : vivent corda eorum in sæculum sæculi.
text_el: φάγονται πένητες καὶ ἐμπλησθήσονται καὶ αἰνέσουσιν κύριον οἱ ἐκζητοῦντες αὐτόν ζήσονται αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος

text_en: All the ends of the earth shall remember, and shall be converted to the Lord : And all the kindreds of the Gentiles shall adore in his sight.
text_la: Reminiscentur et convertentur ad Dominum universi fines terræ; et adorabunt in conspectu ejus universæ familiæ gentium:
text_el: μνησθήσονται καὶ ἐπιστραφήσονται πρὸς κύριον πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: For the kingdom is the Lord's ; and he shall have dominion over the nations.
text_la: quoniam Domini est regnum, et ipse dominabitur gentium.
text_el: ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ἡ βασιλεία καὶ αὐτὸς δεσπόζει τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and have adored : all they that go down to the earth shall fall before him.
text_la: Manducaverunt et adoraverunt omnes pingues terræ; in conspectu ejus cadent omnes qui descendunt in terram.
text_el: ἔφαγον καὶ προσεκύνησαν πάντες οἱ πίονες τῆς γῆς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ προπεσοῦνται πάντες οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου αὐτῷ ζῇ

text_en: And to him my soul shall live: and my seed shall serve him.
text_la: Et anima mea illi vivet; et semen meum serviet ipsi.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σπέρμα μου δουλεύσει αὐτῷ ἀναγγελήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ γενεὰ ἡ ἐρχομένη

text_en: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: and the heavens shall show forth his justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord has made.
text_la: Annuntiabitur Domino generatio ventura; et annuntiabunt cæli justitiam ejus populo qui nascetur, quem fecit Dominus.
text_el: καὶ ἀναγγελοῦσιν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ λαῷ τῷ τεχθησομένῳ ὅτι ἐποίησεν ὁ κύριος

text_en: The Lord rules me: and I shall want nothing.
text_la: Dominus regit me, et nihil mihi deerit:
text_pt: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste? Por que te alongas do meu auxílio e das palavras do meu bramido?
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ κύριος ποιμαίνει με καὶ οὐδέν με ὑστερήσει

text_en: He has set me in a place of pasture. He has brought me up, on the water of refreshment:
text_la: in loco pascuæ, ibi me collocavit. Super aquam refectionis educavit me;
text_pt: Deus meu, eu clamo de dia, e tu não me ouves; de noite, e não tenho sossego.
text_el: εἰς τόπον χλόης ἐκεῖ με κατεσκήνωσεν ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀναπαύσεως ἐξέθρεψέν με

text_en: He has converted my soul . He has led me on the paths of justice , for his own name's sake.
text_la: animam meam convertit. Deduxit me super semitas justitiæ propter nomen suum.
text_pt: Porém tu és santo, tu que habitas entre os louvores de Israel.
text_el: τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐπέστρεψεν ὡδήγησέν με ἐπὶ τρίβους δικαιοσύνης ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: For though I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evils , for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they have comforted me.
text_la: Nam etsi ambulavero in medio umbræ mortis, non timebo mala, quoniam tu mecum es. Virga tua, et baculus tuus, ipsa me consolata sunt.
text_pt: Em ti confiaram nossos pais; confiaram, e tu os livraste.
text_el: ἐὰν γὰρ καὶ πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ σκιᾶς θανάτου οὐ φοβηθήσομαι κακά ὅτι σὺ μετ' ἐμοῦ εἶ ἡ ῥάβδος σου καὶ ἡ βακτηρία σου αὐταί με παρεκάλεσαν

text_en: You have prepared a table before me against them that afflict me. You have anointed my head with oil; and my chalice which inebriates me, how goodly is it!
text_la: Parasti in conspectu meo mensam adversus eos qui tribulant me; impinguasti in oleo caput meum : et calix meus inebrians, quam præclarus est!
text_pt: A ti clamaram e escaparam; em ti confiaram, e não foram confundidos.
text_el: ἡτοίμασας ἐνώπιόν μου τράπεζαν ἐξ ἐναντίας τῶν θλιβόντων με ἐλίπανας ἐν ἐλαίῳ τὴν κεφαλήν μου καὶ τὸ ποτήριόν σου μεθύσκον ὡς κράτιστον

text_en: And your mercy will follow me all the days of my life. And that I may dwell in the house of the Lord unto length of days.
text_la: Et misericordia tua subsequetur me omnibus diebus vitæ meæ; et ut inhabitem in domo Domini in longitudinem dierum.
text_pt: Mas eu sou verme, e não homem, opróbrio dos homens e desprezado do povo.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου καταδιώξεταί με πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου καὶ τὸ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν

text_en: The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof: the world, and all they that dwell therein.
text_la: Domini est terra, et plenitudo ejus; orbis terrarum, et universi qui habitant in eo.
text_pt: O SENHOR é o meu pastor, nada me faltará.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ τῆς μιᾶς σαββάτων τοῦ κυρίου ἡ γῆ καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: For he has founded it upon the seas; and has prepared it upon the rivers.
text_la: Quia ipse super maria fundavit eum, et super flumina præparavit eum.
text_pt: Deitar-me faz em verdes pastos, guia-me mansamente a águas tranqüilas.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐπὶ θαλασσῶν ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπὶ ποταμῶν ἡτοίμασεν αὐτήν

text_en: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord : or who shall stand in his holy place?
text_la: Quis ascendet in montem Domini? aut quis stabit in loco sancto ejus?
text_pt: Refrigera a minha alma; guia-me pelas veredas da justiça, por amor do seu nome.
text_el: τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τίς στήσεται ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The innocent in hands, and clean of heart, who has not taken his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.
text_la: Innocens manibus et mundo corde, qui non accepit in vano animam suam, nec juravit in dolo proximo suo:
text_pt: Ainda que eu andasse pelo vale da sombra da morte, não temeria mal algum, porque tu estás comigo; a tua vara e o teu cajado me consolam.
text_el: ἀθῷος χερσὶν καὶ καθαρὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ ὃς οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ ματαίῳ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ὤμοσεν ἐπὶ δόλῳ τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord , and mercy from God his Saviour.
text_la: hic accipiet benedictionem a Domino, et misericordiam a Deo salutari suo.
text_pt: Preparas uma mesa perante mim na presença dos meus inimigos, unges a minha cabeça com óleo, o meu cálice transborda.
text_el: οὗτος λήμψεται εὐλογίαν παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ θεοῦ σωτῆρος αὐτοῦ

text_en: This is the generation of them that seek him, of them that seek the face of the God of Jacob .
text_la: Hæc est generatio quærentium eum, quærentium faciem Dei Jacob.
text_pt: Certamente que a bondade e a misericórdia me seguirão todos os dias da minha vida; e habitarei na casa do Senhor por longos dias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ ζητούντων αὐτόν ζητούντων τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ θεοῦ Ιακωβ διάψαλμα

text_en: Lift up your gates, O princes, and be lifted up, O eternal gates: and the King of Glory shall enter in.
text_la: Attollite portas, principes, vestras, et elevamini, portæ æternales, et introibit rex gloriæ.
text_el: ἄρατε πύλας οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπάρθητε πύλαι αἰώνιοι καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης

text_en: Who is this King of Glory? The Lord who is strong and mighty: the Lord mighty in battle.
text_la: Quis est iste rex gloriæ? Dominus fortis et potens, Dominus potens in prælio.
text_el: τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης κύριος κραταιὸς καὶ δυνατός κύριος δυνατὸς ἐν πολέμῳ

text_en: Lift up your gates, O princes, and be lifted up, O eternal gates: and the King of Glory shall enter in.
text_la: Attollite portas, principes, vestras, et elevamini, portæ æternales, et introibit rex gloriæ.
text_el: ἄρατε πύλας οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπάρθητε πύλαι αἰώνιοι καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης

text_en: Who is this King of Glory? The Lord of hosts , he is the King of Glory.
text_la: Quis est iste rex gloriæ? Dominus virtutum ipse est rex gloriæ.
text_el: τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης

text_en: To you, O Lord , have I lifted up my soul .
text_la: Ad te, Domine, levavi animam meam:
text_pt: Do SENHOR é a terra e a sua plenitude, o mundo e aqueles que nele habitam.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ πρὸς σέ κύριε ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου ὁ θεός μου

text_en: In you, O my God , I put my trust; let me not be ashamed.
text_la: Deus meus, in te confido; non erubescam.
text_pt: Porque ele a fundou sobre os mares, e a firmou sobre os rios.
text_el: ἐπὶ σοὶ πέποιθα μὴ καταισχυνθείην μηδὲ καταγελασάτωσάν μου οἱ ἐχθροί μου

text_en: Neither let my enemies laugh at me: for none of them that wait on you shall be confounded.
text_la: Neque irrideant me inimici mei : etenim universi qui sustinent te, non confundentur.
text_pt: Quem subirá ao monte do Senhor, ou quem estará no seu lugar santo?
text_el: καὶ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῶσιν αἰσχυνθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ ἀνομοῦντες διὰ κενῆς

text_en: Let all them be confounded that act unjust things without cause. Show, O Lord , your ways to me, and teach me your paths.
text_la: Confundantur omnes iniqua agentes supervacue. Vias tuas, Domine, demonstra mihi, et semitas tuas edoce me.
text_pt: Aquele que é limpo de mãos e puro de coração, que não entrega a sua alma à vaidade, nem jura enganosamente.
text_el: τὰς ὁδούς σου κύριε γνώρισόν μοι καὶ τὰς τρίβους σου δίδαξόν με

text_en: Direct me in your truth , and teach me; for you are God my Saviour; and on you have I waited all the day long.
text_la: Dirige me in veritate tua, et doce me, quia tu es Deus salvator meus, et te sustinui tota die.
text_pt: Este receberá a bênção do Senhor e a justiça do Deus da sua salvação.
text_el: ὁδήγησόν με ἐπὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου καὶ δίδαξόν με ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτήρ μου καὶ σὲ ὑπέμεινα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: Remember, O Lord, your bowels of compassion; and your mercies that are from the beginning of the world.
text_la: Reminiscere miserationum tuarum, Domine, et misericordiarum tuarum quæ a sæculo sunt.
text_pt: Esta é a geração daqueles que buscam, daqueles que buscam a tua face, ó Deus de Jacó. (Selá.)
text_el: μνήσθητι τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν σου κύριε καὶ τὰ ἐλέη σου ὅτι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνός εἰσιν

text_en: The sins of my youth and my ignorances do not remember. According to your mercy remember me: for your goodness' sake, O Lord .
text_la: Delicta juventutis meæ, et ignorantias meas, ne memineris. Secundum misericordiam tuam memento mei tu, propter bonitatem tuam, Domine.
text_pt: Levantai, ó portas, as vossas cabeças; levantai-vos, ó entradas eternas, e entrará o Rei da Glória.
text_el: ἁμαρτίας νεότητός μου καὶ ἀγνοίας μου μὴ μνησθῇς κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου μνήσθητί μου σὺ ἕνεκα τῆς χρηστότητός σου κύριε

text_en: The Lord is sweet and righteous: therefore he will give a law to sinners in the way.
text_la: Dulcis et rectus Dominus; propter hoc legem dabit delinquentibus in via.
text_pt: Quem é este Rei da Glória? O Senhor forte e poderoso, o Senhor poderoso na guerra.
text_el: χρηστὸς καὶ εὐθὴς ὁ κύριος διὰ τοῦτο νομοθετήσει ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐν ὁδῷ

text_en: He will guide the mild in judgment: he will teach the meek his ways.
text_la: Diriget mansuetos in judicio; docebit mites vias suas.
text_pt: Levantai, ó portas, as vossas cabeças, levantai-vos, ó entradas eternas, e entrará o Rei da Glória.
text_el: ὁδηγήσει πραεῖς ἐν κρίσει διδάξει πραεῖς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth , to them that seek after his covenant and his testimonies.
text_la: Universæ viæ Domini, misericordia et veritas, requirentibus testamentum ejus et testimonia ejus.
text_pt: Quem é este Rei da Glória? O Senhor dos Exércitos, ele é o Rei da Glória. (Selá.)
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ κυρίου ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ

text_en: For your name's sake, O Lord, you will pardon my sin : for it is great.
text_la: Propter nomen tuum, Domine, propitiaberis peccato meo; multum est enim.
text_el: ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου κύριε καὶ ἱλάσῃ τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ μου πολλὴ γάρ ἐστιν

text_en: Who is the man that fears the Lord ? He has appointed him a law in the way he has chosen.
text_la: Quis est homo qui timet Dominum? legem statuit ei in via quam elegit.
text_el: τίς ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον νομοθετήσει αὐτῷ ἐν ὁδῷ ᾗ ᾑρετίσατο

text_en: His soul shall dwell in good things: and his seed shall inherit the land.
text_la: Anima ejus in bonis demorabitur, et semen ejus hæreditabit terram.
text_el: ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαθοῖς αὐλισθήσεται καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ κληρονομήσει γῆν

text_en: The Lord is a firmament to them that fear him: and his covenant shall be made manifest to them.
text_la: Firmamentum est Dominus timentibus eum; et testamentum ipsius ut manifestetur illis.
text_el: κραταίωμα κύριος τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτόν καὶ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτόν καὶ ἡ διαθήκη αὐτοῦ τοῦ δηλῶσαι αὐτοῖς

text_en: My eyes are ever towards the Lord : for he shall pluck my feet out of the snare.
text_la: Oculi mei semper ad Dominum, quoniam ipse evellet de laqueo pedes meos.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου διὰ παντὸς πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐκσπάσει ἐκ παγίδος τοὺς πόδας μου

text_en: Look upon me, and have mercy on me; for I am alone and poor.
text_la: Respice in me, et miserere mei, quia unicus et pauper sum ego.
text_el: ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με ὅτι μονογενὴς καὶ πτωχός εἰμι ἐγώ

text_en: The troubles of my heart are multiplied: deliver me from my necessities.
text_la: Tribulationes cordis mei multiplicatæ sunt : de necessitatibus meis erue me.
text_el: αἱ θλίψεις τῆς καρδίας μου ἐπλατύνθησαν ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν μου ἐξάγαγέ με

text_en: See my abjection and my labour; and forgive me all my sins .
text_la: Vide humilitatem meam et laborem meum, et dimitte universa delicta mea.
text_el: ἰδὲ τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου καὶ τὸν κόπον μου καὶ ἄφες πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας μου

text_en: Consider my enemies for they are multiplied, and have hated me with an unjust hatred .
text_la: Respice inimicos meos, quoniam multiplicati sunt, et odio iniquo oderunt me.
text_el: ἰδὲ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ὅτι ἐπληθύνθησαν καὶ μῖσος ἄδικον ἐμίσησάν με

text_en: Deepen my soul , and deliver me: I shall not be ashamed, for I have hoped in you.
text_la: Custodi animam meam, et erue me : non erubescam, quoniam speravi in te.
text_el: φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ ῥῦσαί με μὴ καταισχυνθείην ὅτι ἤλπισα ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: The innocent and the upright have adhered to me: because I have waited on you.
text_la: Innocentes et recti adhæserunt mihi, quia sustinui te.
text_el: ἄκακοι καὶ εὐθεῖς ἐκολλῶντό μοι ὅτι ὑπέμεινά σε κύριε

text_en: Deliver Israel , O God , from all his tribulations.
text_la: Libera, Deus, Israël ex omnibus tribulationibus suis.
text_el: λύτρωσαι ὁ θεός τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ

text_en: Judge me, O Lord , for I have walked in my innocence: and I have put my trust in the Lord , and shall not be weakened.
text_la: Judica me, Domine, quoniam ego in innocentia mea ingressus sum, et in Domino sperans non infirmabor.
text_pt: A ti, SENHOR, levanto a minha alma.
text_el: τοῦ Δαυιδ κρῖνόν με κύριε ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν ἀκακίᾳ μου ἐπορεύθην καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ἐλπίζων οὐ μὴ ἀσθενήσω

text_en: Prove me, O Lord , and try me; burn my reins and my heart.
text_la: Proba me, Domine, et tenta me; ure renes meos et cor meum.
text_pt: Deus meu, em ti confio, não me deixes confundido, nem que os meus inimigos triunfem sobre mim.
text_el: δοκίμασόν με κύριε καὶ πείρασόν με πύρωσον τοὺς νεφρούς μου καὶ τὴν καρδίαν μου

text_en: For your mercy is before my eyes; and I am well pleased with your truth .
text_la: Quoniam misericordia tua ante oculos meos est, et complacui in veritate tua.
text_pt: Na verdade, não serão confundidos os que esperam em ti; confundidos serão os que transgridem sem causa.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ ἔλεός σου κατέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μού ἐστιν καὶ εὐηρέστησα ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου

text_en: I have not sat with the council of vanity: neither will I go in with the doers of unjust things.
text_la: Non sedi cum concilio vanitatis, et cum iniqua gerentibus non introibo.
text_pt: Faze-me saber os teus caminhos, Senhor; ensina-me as tuas veredas.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκάθισα μετὰ συνεδρίου ματαιότητος καὶ μετὰ παρανομούντων οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθω

text_en: I have hated the assembly of the malignant; and with the wicked I will not sit.
text_la: Odivi ecclesiam malignantium, et cum impiis non sedebo.
text_pt: Guia-me na tua verdade, e ensina-me, pois tu és o Deus da minha salvação; por ti estou esperando todo o dia.
text_el: ἐμίσησα ἐκκλησίαν πονηρευομένων καὶ μετὰ ἀσεβῶν οὐ μὴ καθίσω

text_en: I will wash my hands among the innocent; and will compass your altar , O Lord :
text_la: Lavabo inter innocentes manus meas, et circumdabo altare tuum, Domine:
text_pt: Lembra-te, Senhor, das tuas misericórdias e das tuas benignidades, porque são desde a eternidade.
text_el: νίψομαι ἐν ἀθῴοις τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ κυκλώσω τὸ θυσιαστήριόν σου κύριε

text_en: That I may hear the voice of your praise: and tell of all your wondrous works.
text_la: ut audiam vocem laudis, et enarrem universa mirabilia tua.
text_pt: Não te lembres dos pecados da minha mocidade, nem das minhas transgressões; mas segundo a tua misericórdia, lembra-te de mim, por tua bondade, Senhor.
text_el: τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι φωνὴν αἰνέσεως καὶ διηγήσασθαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου

text_en: I have loved , O Lord , the beauty of your house; and the place where your glory dwells.
text_la: Domine, dilexi decorem domus tuæ, et locum habitationis gloriæ tuæ.
text_pt: Bom e reto é o Senhor; por isso ensinará o caminho aos pecadores.
text_el: κύριε ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν οἴκου σου καὶ τόπον σκηνώματος δόξης σου

text_en: Take not away my soul , O God , with the wicked: nor my life with bloody men :
text_la: Ne perdas cum impiis, Deus, animam meam, et cum viris sanguinum vitam meam:
text_pt: Guiará os mansos em justiça e aos mansos ensinará o seu caminho.
text_el: μὴ συναπολέσῃς μετὰ ἀσεβῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρῶν αἱμάτων τὴν ζωήν μου

text_en: In whose hands are iniquities : their right hand is filled with gifts.
text_la: in quorum manibus iniquitates sunt; dextera eorum repleta est muneribus.
text_pt: Todas as veredas do Senhor são misericórdia e verdade para aqueles que guardam a sua aliança e os seus testemunhos.
text_el: ὧν ἐν χερσὶν ἀνομίαι ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν ἐπλήσθη δώρων

text_en: But as for me, I have walked in my innocence: redeem me, and have mercy on me.
text_la: Ego autem in innocentia mea ingressus sum; redime me, et miserere mei.
text_pt: Por amor do teu nome, Senhor, perdoa a minha iniqüidade, pois é grande.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν ἀκακίᾳ μου ἐπορεύθην λύτρωσαί με καὶ ἐλέησόν με

text_en: My foot has stood in the direct way: in the churches I will bless you, O Lord .
text_la: Pes meus stetit in directo; in ecclesiis benedicam te, Domine.
text_pt: Qual é o homem que teme ao Senhor? Ele o ensinará no caminho que deve escolher.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ πούς μου ἔστη ἐν εὐθύτητι ἐν ἐκκλησίαις εὐλογήσω σε κύριε

text_en: The Lord is my light and my salvation , whom shall I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life: of whom shall I be afraid?
text_la: Dominus illuminatio mea et salus mea : quem timebo? Dominus protector vitæ meæ : a quo trepidabo?
text_pt: Julga-me, SENHOR, pois tenho andado em minha sinceridade; tenho confiado também no SENHOR; não vacilarei.
text_el: τοῦ Δαυιδ πρὸ τοῦ χρισθῆναι κύριος φωτισμός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου τίνα φοβηθήσομαι κύριος ὑπερασπιστὴς τῆς ζωῆς μου ἀπὸ τίνος δειλιάσω

text_en: Whilst the wicked draw near against me, to eat my flesh. My enemies that trouble me, have themselves been weakened, and have fallen.
text_la: Dum appropiant super me nocentes ut edant carnes meas, qui tribulant me inimici mei, ipsi infirmati sunt et ceciderunt.
text_pt: Examina-me, Senhor, e prova-me; esquadrinha os meus rins e o meu coração.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν ἐπ' ἐμὲ κακοῦντας τοῦ φαγεῖν τὰς σάρκας μου οἱ θλίβοντές με καὶ οἱ ἐχθροί μου αὐτοὶ ἠσθένησαν καὶ ἔπεσαν

text_en: If armies in camp should stand together against me, my heart shall not fear. If a battle should rise up against me, in this will I be confident.
text_la: Si consistant adversum me castra, non timebit cor meum; si exsurgat adversum me prælium, in hoc ego sperabo.
text_pt: Porque a tua benignidade está diante dos meus olhos; e tenho andado na tua verdade.
text_el: ἐὰν παρατάξηται ἐπ' ἐμὲ παρεμβολή οὐ φοβηθήσεται ἡ καρδία μου ἐὰν ἐπαναστῇ ἐπ' ἐμὲ πόλεμος ἐν ταύτῃ ἐγὼ ἐλπίζω

text_en: One thing I have asked of the Lord , this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life. That I may see the delight of the Lord , and may visit his temple .
text_la: Unam petii a Domino, hanc requiram, ut inhabitem in domo Domini omnibus diebus vitæ meæ; ut videam voluptatem Domini, et visitem templum ejus.
text_pt: Não me tenho assentado com homens vãos, nem converso com os homens dissimulados.
text_el: μίαν ᾐτησάμην παρὰ κυρίου ταύτην ἐκζητήσω τοῦ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου τοῦ θεωρεῖν με τὴν τερπνότητα τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπισκέπτεσθαι τὸν ναὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: For he has hidden me in his tabernacle; in the day of evils , he has protected me in the secret place of his tabernacle.
text_la: Quoniam abscondit me in tabernaculo suo; in die malorum protexit me in abscondito tabernaculi sui.
text_pt: Tenho odiado a congregação de malfeitores; nem me ajunto com os ímpios.
text_el: ὅτι ἔκρυψέν με ἐν σκηνῇ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῶν μου ἐσκέπασέν με ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ ἐν πέτρᾳ ὕψωσέν με

text_en: He has exalted me upon a rock: and now he has lifted up my head above my enemies. I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord .
text_la: In petra exaltavit me, et nunc exaltavit caput meum super inimicos meos. Circuivi, et immolavi in tabernaculo ejus hostiam vociferationis; cantabo, et psalmum dicam Domino.
text_pt: Lavo as minhas mãos na inocência; e assim andarei, Senhor, ao redor do teu altar.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ὕψωσεν τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐπ' ἐχθρούς μου ἐκύκλωσα καὶ ἔθυσα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ αὐτοῦ θυσίαν ἀλαλαγμοῦ ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Hear, O Lord , my voice, with which I have cried to you: have mercy on me and hear me.
text_la: Exaudi, Domine, vocem meam, qua clamavi ad te; miserere mei, et exaudi me.
text_pt: Para publicar com voz de louvor, e contar todas as tuas maravilhas.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον κύριε τῆς φωνῆς μου ἧς ἐκέκραξα ἐλέησόν με καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου

text_en: My heart has said to you: My face has sought you: your face, O Lord , will I still seek.
text_la: Tibi dixit cor meum : Exquisivit te facies mea; faciem tuam, Domine, requiram.
text_pt: Senhor, eu tenho amado a habitação da tua casa e o lugar onde permanece a tua glória.
text_el: σοὶ εἶπεν ἡ καρδία μου ἐζήτησεν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου τὸ πρόσωπόν σου κύριε ζητήσω

text_en: Turn not away your face from me; decline not in your wrath from your servant. Be my helper, forsake me not; do not despise me, O God my Saviour.
text_la: Ne avertas faciem tuam a me; ne declines in ira a servo tuo. Adjutor meus esto; ne derelinquas me, neque despicias me, Deus salutaris meus.
text_pt: Não apanhes a minha alma com os pecadores, nem a minha vida com os homens sanguinolentos,
text_el: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ μὴ ἐκκλίνῃς ἐν ὀργῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ δούλου σου βοηθός μου γενοῦ μὴ ἀποσκορακίσῃς με καὶ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτήρ μου

text_en: For my father and my mother have left me: but the Lord has taken me up.
text_la: Quoniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquerunt me; Dominus autem assumpsit me.
text_pt: Em cujas mãos há malefício, e cuja mão direita está cheia de subornos.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ ἡ μήτηρ μου ἐγκατέλιπόν με ὁ δὲ κύριος προσελάβετό με

text_en: Set me, O Lord , a law in your way, and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.
text_la: Legem pone mihi, Domine, in via tua, et dirige me in semitam rectam, propter inimicos meos.
text_pt: Mas eu ando na minha sinceridade; livra-me e tem piedade de mim.
text_el: νομοθέτησόν με κύριε τῇ ὁδῷ σου καὶ ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τρίβῳ εὐθείᾳ ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου

text_en: Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me; and iniquity has lied to itself.
text_la: Ne tradideris me in animas tribulantium me, quoniam insurrexerunt in me testes iniqui, et mentita est iniquitas sibi.
text_pt: O meu pé está posto em caminho plano; nas congregações louvarei ao Senhor.
text_el: μὴ παραδῷς με εἰς ψυχὰς θλιβόντων με ὅτι ἐπανέστησάν μοι μάρτυρες ἄδικοι καὶ ἐψεύσατο ἡ ἀδικία ἑαυτῇ

text_en: I believe to see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
text_la: Credo videre bona Domini in terra viventium.
text_el: πιστεύω τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὰ ἀγαθὰ κυρίου ἐν γῇ ζώντων

text_en: Expect the Lord , do manfully, and let your heart take courage , and wait for the Lord .
text_la: Expecta Dominum, viriliter age : et confortetur cor tuum, et sustine Dominum.
text_el: ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον ἀνδρίζου καὶ κραταιούσθω ἡ καρδία σου καὶ ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον

text_en: Unto you will I cry, O Lord : O my God , be not silent to me: lest if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
text_la: Ad te, Domine, clamabo; Deus meus, ne sileas a me : nequando taceas a me, et assimilabor descendentibus in lacum.
text_pt: O SENHOR é a minha luz e a minha salvação; a quem temerei? O SENHOR é a força da minha vida; de quem me recearei?
text_el: τοῦ Δαυιδ πρὸς σέ κύριε ἐκέκραξα ὁ θεός μου μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ μήποτε παρασιωπήσῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ὁμοιωθήσομαι τοῖς καταβαίνουσιν εἰς λάκκον

text_en: Hear, O Lord , the voice of my supplication, when I pray to you; when I lift up my hands to your holy temple .
text_la: Exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ dum oro ad te; dum extollo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
text_pt: Quando os malvados, meus adversários e meus inimigos, se chegaram contra mim, para comerem as minhas carnes, tropeçaram e caíram.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ δέεσθαί με πρὸς σέ ἐν τῷ με αἴρειν χεῖράς μου πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου

text_en: Draw me not away together with the wicked; and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not: Who speak peace with their neighbour, but evils are in their hearts.
text_la: Ne simul trahas me cum peccatoribus, et cum operantibus iniquitatem ne perdas me; qui loquuntur pacem cum proximo suo, mala autem in cordibus eorum.
text_pt: Ainda que um exército me cercasse, o meu coração não temeria; ainda que a guerra se levantasse contra mim, nisto confiaria.
text_el: μὴ συνελκύσῃς μετὰ ἁμαρτωλῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ μετὰ ἐργαζομένων ἀδικίαν μὴ συναπολέσῃς με τῶν λαλούντων εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν πλησίον αὐτῶν κακὰ δὲ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their inventions. According to the works of their hands give to them: render to them their reward.
text_la: Da illis secundum opera eorum, et secundum nequitiam adinventionum ipsorum. Secundum opera manuum eorum tribue illis; redde retributionem eorum ipsis.
text_pt: Uma coisa pedi ao Senhor, e a buscarei: que possa morar na casa do Senhor todos os dias da minha vida, para contemplar a formosura do Senhor, e inquirir no seu templo.
text_el: δὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ τὴν πονηρίαν τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν δὸς αὐτοῖς ἀπόδος τὸ ἀνταπόδομα αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord , and the operations of his hands: you shall destroy them, and shall not build them up.
text_la: Quoniam non intellexerunt opera Domini, et in opera manuum ejus destrues illos, et non ædificabis eos.
text_pt: Porque no dia da adversidade me esconderá no seu pavilhão; no oculto do seu tabernáculo me esconderá; pôr-me-á sobre uma rocha.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ συνῆκαν εἰς τὰ ἔργα κυρίου καὶ εἰς τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ καθελεῖς αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτούς

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , for he has heard the voice of my supplication.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus, quoniam exaudivit vocem deprecationis meæ.
text_pt: Também agora a minha cabeça será exaltada sobre os meus inimigos que estão em redor de mim; por isso oferecerei sacrifício de júbilo no seu tabernáculo; cantarei, sim, cantarei louvores ao Senhor.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: The Lord is my helper and my protector: in him has my heart confided, and I have been helped. And my flesh has flourished again, and with my will I will give praise to him.
text_la: Dominus adjutor meus et protector meus; in ipso speravit cor meum, et adjutus sum : et refloruit caro mea, et ex voluntate mea confitebor ei.
text_pt: Ouve, Senhor, a minha voz quando clamo; tem também piedade de mim, e responde-me.
text_el: κύριος βοηθός μου καὶ ὑπερασπιστής μου ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἤλπισεν ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἐβοηθήθην καὶ ἀνέθαλεν ἡ σάρξ μου καὶ ἐκ θελήματός μου ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ

text_en: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the protector of the salvation of his anointed.
text_la: Dominus fortitudo plebis suæ, et protector salvationum christi sui est.
text_pt: Quando tu disseste: Buscai o meu rosto; o meu coração disse a ti: O teu rosto, Senhor, buscarei.
text_el: κύριος κραταίωμα τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς τῶν σωτηρίων τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: Save, O Lord , your people, and bless your inheritance: and rule them and exalt them for ever.
text_la: Salvum fac populum tuum, Domine, et benedic hæreditati tuæ; et rege eos, et extolle illos usque in æternum.
text_pt: Não escondas de mim a tua face, não rejeites ao teu servo com ira; tu foste a minha ajuda, não me deixes nem me desampares, ó Deus da minha salvação.
text_el: σῶσον τὸν λαόν σου καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου καὶ ποίμανον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔπαρον αὐτοὺς ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Bring to the Lord , O you children of God : bring to the Lord the offspring of rams.
text_la: Afferte Domino, filii Dei, afferte Domino filios arietum.
text_pt: A ti clamarei, ó Senhor, Rocha minha; não emudeças para comigo; não aconteça, cal ando-te tu para comigo, que eu fique semelhante aos que descem ao abismo.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ἐξοδίου σκηνῆς ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ υἱοὶ θεοῦ ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ υἱοὺς κριῶν ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν

text_en: Bring to the Lord glory and honour: bring to the Lord glory to his name : adore the Lord in his holy court .
text_la: Afferte Domino gloriam et honorem; afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus; adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus.
text_pt: Ouve a voz das minhas súplicas, quando a ti clamar, quando levantar as minhas mãos para o teu santo oráculo.
text_el: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of majesty has thundered, The Lord is upon many waters.
text_la: Vox Domini super aquas; Deus majestatis intonuit : Dominus super aquas multas.
text_pt: Não me arrastes com os ímpios e com os que praticam a iniqüidade; que falam de paz ao seu próximo, mas têm mal nos seus corações.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων ὁ θεὸς τῆς δόξης ἐβρόντησεν κύριος ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν

text_en: The voice of the Lord is in power; the voice of the Lord in magnificence.
text_la: Vox Domini in virtute; vox Domini in magnificentia.
text_pt: Dá-lhes segundo as suas obras e segundo a malícia dos seus esforços; dá-lhes conforme a obra das suas mãos; torna-lhes a sua recompensa.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου ἐν ἰσχύι φωνὴ κυρίου ἐν μεγαλοπρεπείᾳ

text_en: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars : yea, the Lord shall break the cedars of Libanus.
text_la: Vox Domini confringentis cedros, et confringet Dominus cedros Libani:
text_pt: Porquanto não atentam às obras do Senhor, nem à obra das suas mãos; pois que ele os derrubará e não os reedificará.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου συντρίβοντος κέδρους καὶ συντρίψει κύριος τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου

text_en: And shall reduce them to pieces, as a calf of Libanus, and as the beloved son of unicorns.
text_la: et comminuet eas, tamquam vitulum Libani, et dilectus quemadmodum filius unicornium.
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor, porque ouviu a voz das minhas súplicas.
text_el: καὶ λεπτυνεῖ αὐτὰς ὡς τὸν μόσχον τὸν Λίβανον καὶ ὁ ἠγαπημένος ὡς υἱὸς μονοκερώτων

text_en: The voice of the Lord divides the flame of fire:
text_la: Vox Domini intercidentis flammam ignis;
text_pt: O Senhor é a minha força e o meu escudo; nele confiou o meu coração, e fui socorrido; assim o meu coração salta de prazer, e com o meu canto o louvarei.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου διακόπτοντος φλόγα πυρός

text_en: The voice of the Lord shakes the desert : and the Lord shall shake the desert of Cades .
text_la: vox Domini concutientis desertum : et commovebit Dominus desertum Cades.
text_pt: O Senhor é a força do seu povo; também é a força salvadora do seu ungido.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου συσσείοντος ἔρημον καὶ συσσείσει κύριος τὴν ἔρημον Καδης

text_en: The voice of the Lord prepares the stags: and he will discover the thick woods: and in his temple all shall speak his glory .
text_la: Vox Domini præparantis cervos : et revelabit condensa, et in templo ejus omnes dicent gloriam.
text_pt: Salva o teu povo, e abençoa a tua herança; e apascenta-os e exalta-os para sempre.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου καταρτιζομένου ἐλάφους καὶ ἀποκαλύψει δρυμούς καὶ ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ πᾶς τις λέγει δόξαν

text_en: The Lord makes the flood to dwell: and the Lord shall sit king for ever.
text_la: Dominus diluvium inhabitare facit, et sedebit Dominus rex in æternum.
text_el: κύριος τὸν κατακλυσμὸν κατοικιεῖ καὶ καθίεται κύριος βασιλεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: The Lord will give strength to his people: the Lord will bless his people with peace.
text_la: Dominus virtutem populo suo dabit; Dominus benedicet populo suo in pace.
text_el: κύριος ἰσχὺν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ δώσει κύριος εὐλογήσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: A psalm of a canticle, at the dedication of David's house.
text_la: Psalmus cantici, in dedicatione domus David.
text_pt: Dai ao SENHOR, ó filhos dos poderosos, dai ao SENHOR glória e força.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς τοῦ ἐγκαινισμοῦ τοῦ οἴκου τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: I will extol you, O Lord , for you have upheld me: and have not made my enemies to rejoice over me.
text_la: Exaltabo te, Domine, quoniam suscepisti me, nec delectasti inimicos meos super me.
text_pt: Dai ao Senhor a glória devida ao seu nome, adorai o Senhor na beleza da santidade.
text_el: ὑψώσω σε κύριε ὅτι ὑπέλαβές με καὶ οὐκ ηὔφρανας τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: O Lord my God , I have cried to you, and you have healed me.
text_la: Domine Deus meus, clamavi ad te, et sanasti me.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor ouve-se sobre as suas águas; o Deus da glória troveja; o Senhor está sobre as muitas águas.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ καὶ ἰάσω με

text_en: You have brought forth, O Lord , my soul from hell: you have saved me from them that go down into the pit.
text_la: Domine, eduxisti ab inferno animam meam; salvasti me a descendentibus in lacum.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor é poderosa; a voz do Senhor é cheia de majestade.
text_el: κύριε ἀνήγαγες ἐξ ᾅδου τὴν ψυχήν μου ἔσωσάς με ἀπὸ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον

text_en: Sing to the Lord , O you his saints: and give praise to the memory of his holiness .
text_la: Psallite Domino, sancti ejus; et confitemini memoriæ sanctitatis ejus.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor quebra os cedros; sim, o Senhor quebra os cedros do Líbano.
text_el: ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῇ μνήμῃ τῆς ἁγιωσύνης αὐτοῦ

text_en: For wrath is in his indignation; and life in his good will. In the evening weeping shall have place, and in the morning gladness.
text_la: Quoniam ira in indignatione ejus, et vita in voluntate ejus : ad vesperum demorabitur fletus, et ad matutinum lætitia.
text_pt: Ele os faz saltar como um bezerro; ao Líbano e Siriom, como filhotes de bois selvagens.
text_el: ὅτι ὀργὴ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ θελήματι αὐτοῦ τὸ ἑσπέρας αὐλισθήσεται κλαυθμὸς καὶ εἰς τὸ πρωὶ ἀγαλλίασις

text_en: And in my abundance I said: I shall never be moved.
text_la: Ego autem dixi in abundantia mea : Non movebor in æternum.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor separa as labaredas do fogo.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ εὐθηνίᾳ μου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: O Lord , in your favour, you gave strength to my beauty. You turned away your face from me, and I became troubled.
text_la: Domine, in voluntate tua præstitisti decori meo virtutem; avertisti faciem tuam a me, et factus sum conturbatus.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor faz tremer o deserto; o Senhor faz tremer o deserto de Cades.
text_el: κύριε ἐν τῷ θελήματί σου παρέσχου τῷ κάλλει μου δύναμιν ἀπέστρεψας δὲ τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ ἐγενήθην τεταραγμένος

text_en: To you, O Lord , will I cry: and I will make supplication to my God .
text_la: Ad te, Domine, clamabo, et ad Deum meum deprecabor.
text_pt: A voz do Senhor faz parir as cervas, e descobre as brenhas; e no seu templo cada um fala da sua glória.
text_el: πρὸς σέ κύριε κεκράξομαι καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεόν μου δεηθήσομαι

text_en: What profit is there in my blood, whilst I go down to corruption? Shall dust confess to you, or declare your truth ?
text_la: Quæ utilitas in sanguine meo, dum descendo in corruptionem? numquid confitebitur tibi pulvis, aut annuntiabit veritatem tuam?
text_pt: O Senhor se assentou sobre o dilúvio; o Senhor se assenta como Rei, perpetuamente.
text_el: τίς ὠφέλεια ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου ἐν τῷ καταβῆναί με εἰς διαφθοράν μὴ ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι χοῦς ἢ ἀναγγελεῖ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου

text_en: The Lord has heard, and has had mercy on me: the Lord became my helper.
text_la: Audivit Dominus, et misertus est mei; Dominus factus est adjutor meus.
text_pt: O Senhor dará força ao seu povo; o Senhor abençoará o seu povo com paz.
text_el: ἤκουσεν κύριος καὶ ἠλέησέν με κύριος ἐγενήθη βοηθός μου

text_en: You have turned for me my mourning into joy : you have cut my sackcloth , and have compassed me with gladness:
text_la: Convertisti planctum meum in gaudium mihi; conscidisti saccum meum, et circumdedisti me lætitia:
text_el: ἔστρεψας τὸν κοπετόν μου εἰς χορὸν ἐμοί διέρρηξας τὸν σάκκον μου καὶ περιέζωσάς με εὐφροσύνην

text_en: To the end that my glory may sing to you, and I may not regret: O Lord my God , I will give praise to you for ever.
text_la: ut cantet tibi gloria mea, et non compungar. Domine Deus meus, in æternum confitebor tibi.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ψάλῃ σοι ἡ δόξα μου καὶ οὐ μὴ κατανυγῶ κύριε ὁ θεός μου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David , in an ecstasy.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David, pro extasi.
text_pt: Exaltar-te-ei, ó SENHOR, porque tu me exaltaste; e não fizeste com que meus inimigos se alegrassem sobre mim.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ἐκστάσεως

text_en: In you, O Lord , have I hoped, let me never be confounded: deliver me in your justice .
text_la: In te, Domine, speravi; non confundar in æternum : in justitia tua libera me.
text_pt: Senhor meu Deus, clamei a ti, e tu me saraste.
text_el: ἐπὶ σοί κύριε ἤλπισα μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με

text_en: Bow down your ear to me: make haste to deliver me. Be unto me a God , a protector, and a house of refuge, to save me.
text_la: Inclina ad me aurem tuam; accelera ut eruas me. Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, et in domum refugii, ut salvum me facias:
text_pt: Senhor, fizeste subir a minha alma da sepultura; conservaste-me a vida para que não descesse ao abismo.
text_el: κλῖνον πρός με τὸ οὖς σου τάχυνον τοῦ ἐξελέσθαι με γενοῦ μοι εἰς θεὸν ὑπερασπιστὴν καὶ εἰς οἶκον καταφυγῆς τοῦ σῶσαί με

text_en: For you are my strength and my refuge; and for your name's sake you will lead me, and nourish me.
text_la: quoniam fortitudo mea et refugium meum es tu; et propter nomen tuum deduces me et enutries me.
text_pt: Cantai ao Senhor, vós que sois seus santos, e celebrai a memória da sua santidade.
text_el: ὅτι κραταίωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σὺ καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ὁδηγήσεις με καὶ διαθρέψεις με

text_en: You will bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: for you are my protector.
text_la: Educes me de laqueo hoc quem absconderunt mihi, quoniam tu es protector meus.
text_pt: Porque a sua ira dura só um momento; no seu favor está a vida. O choro pode durar uma noite, mas a alegria vem pela manhã.
text_el: ἐξάξεις με ἐκ παγίδος ταύτης ἧς ἔκρυψάν μοι ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ὑπερασπιστής μου

text_en: Into your hands I commend my spirit: you have redeemed me, O Lord , the God of truth .
text_la: In manus tuas commendo spiritum meum; redemisti me, Domine Deus veritatis.
text_pt: Eu dizia na minha prosperidade: Não vacilarei jamais.
text_el: εἰς χεῖράς σου παραθήσομαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐλυτρώσω με κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἀληθείας

text_en: You have hated them that regard vanities, to no purpose. But I have hoped in the Lord :
text_la: Odisti observantes vanitates supervacue; ego autem in Domino speravi.
text_pt: Tu, Senhor, pelo teu favor fizeste forte a minha montanha; tu encobriste o teu rosto, e fiquei perturbado.
text_el: ἐμίσησας τοὺς διαφυλάσσοντας ματαιότητας διὰ κενῆς ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ἤλπισα

text_en: I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy. For you have regarded my humility , you have saved my soul out of distresses.
text_la: Exsultabo, et lætabor in misericordia tua, quoniam respexisti humilitatem meam; salvasti de necessitatibus animam meam.
text_pt: A ti, Senhor, clamei, e ao Senhor supliquei.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσομαι καὶ εὐφρανθήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου ὅτι ἐπεῖδες τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου ἔσωσας ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: And you have not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: you have set my feet in a spacious place.
text_la: Nec conclusisti me in manibus inimici : statuisti in loco spatioso pedes meos.
text_pt: Que proveito há no meu sangue, quando desço à cova? Porventura te louvará o pó? Anunciará ele a tua verdade?
text_el: καὶ οὐ συνέκλεισάς με εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ ἔστησας ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ τοὺς πόδας μου

text_en: Have mercy on me, O Lord , for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with wrath , my soul , and my belly:
text_la: Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam tribulor; conturbatus est in ira oculus meus, anima mea, et venter meus.
text_pt: Ouve, Senhor, e tem piedade de mim, Senhor; sê o meu auxílio.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με κύριε ὅτι θλίβομαι ἐταράχθη ἐν θυμῷ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἡ γαστήρ μου

text_en: For my life is wasted with grief: and my years in sighs. My strength is weakened through poverty and my bones are disturbed.
text_la: Quoniam defecit in dolore vita mea, et anni mei in gemitibus. Infirmata est in paupertate virtus mea, et ossa mea conturbata sunt.
text_pt: Tornaste o meu pranto em folguedo; desataste o meu pano de saco, e me cingiste de alegria,
text_el: ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν ἐν ὀδύνῃ ἡ ζωή μου καὶ τὰ ἔτη μου ἐν στεναγμοῖς ἠσθένησεν ἐν πτωχείᾳ ἡ ἰσχύς μου καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐταράχθησαν

text_en: I have become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours; and a fear to my acquaintance. They that saw me without fled from me.
text_la: Super omnes inimicos meos factus sum opprobrium, et vicinis meis valde, et timor notis meis; qui videbant me foras fugerunt a me.
text_pt: Para que a minha glória a ti cante louvores, e não se cale. Senhor, meu Deus, eu te louvarei para sempre.
text_el: παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐγενήθην ὄνειδος καὶ τοῖς γείτοσίν μου σφόδρα καὶ φόβος τοῖς γνωστοῖς μου οἱ θεωροῦντές με ἔξω ἔφυγον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: I am forgotten as one dead from the heart. I have become as a vessel that is destroyed.
text_la: Oblivioni datus sum, tamquam mortuus a corde; factus sum tamquam vas perditum:
text_el: ἐπελήσθην ὡσεὶ νεκρὸς ἀπὸ καρδίας ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ σκεῦος ἀπολωλός

text_en: For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about. While they assembled together against me, they consulted to take away my life.
text_la: quoniam audivi vituperationem multorum commorantium in circuitu. In eo dum convenirent simul adversum me, accipere animam meam consiliati sunt.
text_el: ὅτι ἤκουσα ψόγον πολλῶν παροικούντων κυκλόθεν ἐν τῷ ἐπισυναχθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἅμα ἐπ' ἐμὲ τοῦ λαβεῖν τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο

text_en: But I have put my trust in you, O Lord : I said: You are my God .
text_la: Ego autem in te speravi, Domine; dixi : Deus meus es tu;
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ σὲ ἤλπισα κύριε εἶπα σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός μου

text_en: My lots are in your hands. Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; and from them that persecute me.
text_la: in manibus tuis sortes meæ : eripe me de manu inimicorum meorum, et a persequentibus me.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου οἱ καιροί μου ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν μου καὶ ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με

text_en: Make your face to shine upon your servant; save me in your mercy.
text_la: Illustra faciem tuam super servum tuum; salvum me fac in misericordia tua.
text_el: ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου σῶσόν με ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου

text_en: Let me not be confounded, O Lord , for I have called upon you. Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell.
text_la: Domine, non confundar, quoniam invocavi te. Erubescant impii, et deducantur in infernum;
text_el: κύριε μὴ καταισχυνθείην ὅτι ἐπεκαλεσάμην σε αἰσχυνθείησαν οἱ ἀσεβεῖς καὶ καταχθείησαν εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: Let deceitful lips be made dumb. Which speak iniquity against the just , with pride and abuse.
text_la: muta fiant labia dolosa, quæ loquuntur adversus justum iniquitatem, in superbia, et in abusione.
text_el: ἄλαλα γενηθήτω τὰ χείλη τὰ δόλια τὰ λαλοῦντα κατὰ τοῦ δικαίου ἀνομίαν ἐν ὑπερηφανίᾳ καὶ ἐξουδενώσει

text_en: O how great is the multitude of your sweetness, O Lord , which you have hidden for them that fear you! Which you have wrought for them that hope in you, in the sight of the sons of men .
text_la: Quam magna multitudo dulcedinis tuæ, Domine, quam abscondisti timentibus te; perfecisti eis qui sperant in te in conspectu filiorum hominum!
text_el: ὡς πολὺ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς χρηστότητός σου κύριε ἧς ἔκρυψας τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε ἐξειργάσω τοῖς ἐλπίζουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: You shall hide them in the secret of your face, from the disturbance of men . You shall protect them in your tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.
text_la: Abscondes eos in abscondito faciei tuæ a conturbatione hominum; proteges eos in tabernaculo tuo, a contradictione linguarum.
text_el: κατακρύψεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀπὸ ταραχῆς ἀνθρώπων σκεπάσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν σκηνῇ ἀπὸ ἀντιλογίας γλωσσῶν

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , for he has shown his wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus, quoniam mirificavit misericordiam suam mihi in civitate munita.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὅτι ἐθαυμάστωσεν τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλει περιοχῆς

text_en: But I said in the excess of my mind: I am cast away from before your eyes. Therefore you have heard the voice of my prayer , when I cried to you.
text_la: Ego autem dixi in excessu mentis meæ : Projectus sum a facie oculorum tuorum : ideo exaudisti vocem orationis meæ, dum clamarem ad te.
