text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ ἐκστάσει μου ἀπέρριμμαι ἄρα ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου διὰ τοῦτο εἰσήκουσας τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς σέ

text_en: O love the Lord , all you his saints: for the Lord will require truth , and will repay them abundantly that act proudly .
text_la: Diligite Dominum, omnes sancti ejus, quoniam veritatem requiret Dominus, et retribuet abundanter facientibus superbiam.
text_el: ἀγαπήσατε τὸν κύριον πάντες οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀληθείας ἐκζητεῖ κύριος καὶ ἀνταποδίδωσιν τοῖς περισσῶς ποιοῦσιν ὑπερηφανίαν

text_en: Do manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, all you that hope in the Lord .
text_la: Viriliter agite, et confortetur cor vestrum, omnes qui speratis in Domino.
text_el: ἀνδρίζεσθε καὶ κραταιούσθω ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπὶ κύριον

text_en: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
text_la: Beati quorum remissæ sunt iniquitates, et quorum tecta sunt peccata.
text_pt: Em ti, SENHOR, confio; nunca me deixes confundido. Livra-me pela tua justiça.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ συνέσεως μακάριοι ὧν ἀφέθησαν αἱ ἀνομίαι καὶ ὧν ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι

text_en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not imputed sin , and in whose spirit there is no guile.
text_la: Beatus vir cui non imputavit Dominus peccatum, nec est in spiritu ejus dolus.
text_pt: Inclina para mim os teus ouvidos, livra-me depressa; sê a minha firme rocha, uma casa fortíssima que me salve.
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ οὗ οὐ μὴ λογίσηται κύριος ἁμαρτίαν οὐδὲ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ δόλος

text_en: Because I was silent my bones grew old; whilst I cried out all the day long.
text_la: Quoniam tacui, inveteraverunt ossa mea, dum clamarem tota die.
text_pt: Porque tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza; assim, por amor do teu nome, guia-me e encaminha-me.
text_el: ὅτι ἐσίγησα ἐπαλαιώθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἀπὸ τοῦ κράζειν με ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.
text_la: Quoniam die ac nocte gravata est super me manus tua, conversus sum in ærumna mea, dum configitur spina.
text_pt: Tira-me da rede que para mim esconderam, pois tu és a minha força.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐβαρύνθη ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἡ χείρ σου ἐστράφην εἰς ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν τῷ ἐμπαγῆναι ἄκανθαν διάψαλμα

text_en: I have acknowledged my sin to you, and my injustice I have not concealed. I said I will confess against my self my injustice to the Lord : and you have forgiven the wickedness of my sin .
text_la: Delictum meum cognitum tibi feci, et injustitiam meam non abscondi. Dixi : Confitebor adversum me injustitiam meam Domino; et tu remisisti impietatem peccati mei.
text_pt: Nas tuas mãos encomendo o meu espírito; tu me redimiste, Senhor Deus da verdade.
text_el: τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου ἐγνώρισα καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου οὐκ ἐκάλυψα εἶπα ἐξαγορεύσω κατ' ἐμοῦ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ σὺ ἀφῆκας τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῆς ἁμαρτίας μου διάψαλμα

text_en: For this shall every one that is holy pray to you in a seasonable time. And yet in a flood of many waters, they shall not come near unto him.
text_la: Pro hac orabit ad te omnis sanctus in tempore opportuno. Verumtamen in diluvio aquarum multarum, ad eum non approximabunt.
text_pt: Odeio aqueles que se entregam a vaidades enganosas; eu, porém, confio no Senhor.
text_el: ὑπὲρ ταύτης προσεύξεται πᾶς ὅσιος πρὸς σὲ ἐν καιρῷ εὐθέτῳ πλὴν ἐν κατακλυσμῷ ὑδάτων πολλῶν πρὸς αὐτὸν οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσιν

text_en: You are my refuge from the trouble which has encompassed me: my joy , deliver me from them that surround me.
text_la: Tu es refugium meum a tribulatione quæ circumdedit me; exsultatio mea, erue me a circumdantibus me.
text_pt: Eu me alegrarei e regozijarei na tua benignidade, pois consideraste a minha aflição; conheceste a minha alma nas angústias.
text_el: σύ μου εἶ καταφυγὴ ἀπὸ θλίψεως τῆς περιεχούσης με τὸ ἀγαλλίαμά μου λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ τῶν κυκλωσάντων με διάψαλμα

text_en: I will give you understanding, and I will instruct you in this way, in which you shall go: I will fix my eyes upon you.
text_la: Intellectum tibi dabo, et instruam te in via hac qua gradieris; firmabo super te oculos meos.
text_pt: E não me entregaste nas mãos do inimigo; puseste os meus pés num lugar espaçoso.
text_el: συνετιῶ σε καὶ συμβιβῶ σε ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ πορεύσῃ ἐπιστηριῶ ἐπὶ σὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου

text_en: Do not become like the horse and the mule, who have no understanding. With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, who come not near unto you.
text_la: Nolite fieri sicut equus et mulus, quibus non est intellectus. In camo et freno maxillas eorum constringe, qui non approximant ad te.
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Senhor, porque estou angustiado. Consumidos estão de tristeza os meus olhos, a minha alma e o meu ventre.
text_el: μὴ γίνεσθε ὡς ἵππος καὶ ἡμίονος οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν σύνεσις ἐν χαλινῷ καὶ κημῷ τὰς σιαγόνας αὐτῶν ἄγξαι τῶν μὴ ἐγγιζόντων πρὸς σέ

text_en: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy shall encompass him that hopes in the Lord .
text_la: Multa flagella peccatoris; sperantem autem in Domino misericordia circumdabit.
text_pt: Porque a minha vida está gasta de tristeza, e os meus anos de suspiros; a minha força descai por causa da minha iniqüidade, e os meus ossos se consomem.
text_el: πολλαὶ αἱ μάστιγες τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ τὸν δὲ ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ κύριον ἔλεος κυκλώσει

text_en: Be glad in the Lord , and rejoice, you just , and glory , all you right of heart.
text_la: Lætamini in Domino, et exsultate, justi; et gloriamini, omnes recti corde.
text_pt: Fui opróbrio entre todos os meus inimigos, até entre os meus vizinhos, e horror para os meus conhecidos; os que me viam na rua fugiam de mim.
text_el: εὐφράνθητε ἐπὶ κύριον καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε δίκαιοι καὶ καυχᾶσθε πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: Rejoice in the Lord , O you just : praise becomes the upright.
text_la: Exsultate, justi, in Domino; rectos decet collaudatio.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele cuja transgressão é perdoada, e cujo pecado é coberto.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε δίκαιοι ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ τοῖς εὐθέσι πρέπει αἴνεσις

text_en: Give praise to the Lord on the harp; sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.
text_la: Confitemini Domino in cithara; in psalterio decem chordarum psallite illi.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem a quem o Senhor não imputa maldade, e em cujo espírito não há engano.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν κιθάρᾳ ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ δεκαχόρδῳ ψάλατε αὐτῷ

text_en: Sing to him a new canticle, sing well unto him with a loud noise.
text_la: Cantate ei canticum novum; bene psallite ei in vociferatione.
text_pt: Quando eu guardei silêncio, envelheceram os meus ossos pelo meu bramido em todo o dia.
text_el: ᾄσατε αὐτῷ ᾆσμα καινόν καλῶς ψάλατε ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ

text_en: For the word of the Lord is right, and all his works are done with faithfulness.
text_la: Quia rectum est verbum Domini, et omnia opera ejus in fide.
text_pt: Porque de dia e de noite a tua mão pesava sobre mim; o meu humor se tornou em sequidão de estio. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι εὐθὴς ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν πίστει

text_en: He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord .
text_la: Diligit misericordiam et judicium; misericordia Domini plena est terra.
text_pt: Confessei-te o meu pecado, e a minha maldade não encobri. Dizia eu: Confessarei ao Senhor as minhas transgressões; e tu perdoaste a maldade do meu pecado. (Selá.)
text_el: ἀγαπᾷ ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ κρίσιν τοῦ ἐλέους κυρίου πλήρης ἡ γῆ

text_en: By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:
text_la: Verbo Domini cæli firmati sunt, et spiritu oris ejus omnis virtus eorum.
text_pt: Por isso, todo aquele que é santo orará a ti, a tempo de te poder achar; até no transbordar de muitas águas, estas não lhe chegarão.
text_el: τῷ λόγῳ τοῦ κυρίου οἱ οὐρανοὶ ἐστερεώθησαν καὶ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ δύναμις αὐτῶν

text_en: Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; laying up the depths in storehouses.
text_la: Congregans sicut in utre aquas maris; ponens in thesauris abyssos.
text_pt: Tu és o lugar em que me escondo; tu me preservas da angústia; tu me cinges de alegres cantos de livramento. (Selá.)
text_el: συνάγων ὡς ἀσκὸν ὕδατα θαλάσσης τιθεὶς ἐν θησαυροῖς ἀβύσσους

text_en: Let all the earth fear the Lord , and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.
text_la: Timeat Dominum omnis terra; ab eo autem commoveantur omnes inhabitantes orbem.
text_pt: Instruir-te-ei, e ensinar-te-ei o caminho que deves seguir; guiar-te-ei com os meus olhos.
text_el: φοβηθήτω τὸν κύριον πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ δὲ σαλευθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν οἰκουμένην

text_en: For he spoke and they were made: he commanded and they were created .
text_la: Quoniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt; ipse mandavit et creata sunt.
text_pt: Não sejais como o cavalo, nem como a mula, que não têm entendimento, cuja boca precisa de cabresto e freio para que não se cheguem a ti.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν καὶ ἐγενήθησαν αὐτὸς ἐνετείλατο καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν

text_en: The Lord brings to nought the counsels of nations; and he rejects the devices of people, and casts away the counsels of princes.
text_la: Dominus dissipat consilia gentium; reprobat autem cogitationes populorum, et reprobat consilia principum.
text_pt: O ímpio tem muitas dores, mas àquele que confia no Senhor a misericórdia o cercará.
text_el: κύριος διασκεδάζει βουλὰς ἐθνῶν ἀθετεῖ δὲ λογισμοὺς λαῶν καὶ ἀθετεῖ βουλὰς ἀρχόντων

text_en: But the counsel of the Lord stands for ever: the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
text_la: Consilium autem Domini in æternum manet; cogitationes cordis ejus in generatione et generationem.
text_pt: Alegrai-vos no Senhor, e regozijai-vos, vós os justos; e cantai alegremente, todos vós que sois retos de coração.
text_el: ἡ δὲ βουλὴ τοῦ κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένει λογισμοὶ τῆς καρδίας αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν

text_en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord : the people whom he has chosen for his inheritance.
text_la: Beata gens cujus est Dominus Deus ejus; populus quem elegit in hæreditatem sibi.
text_el: μακάριον τὸ ἔθνος οὗ ἐστιν κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ λαός ὃν ἐξελέξατο εἰς κληρονομίαν ἑαυτῷ

text_en: The Lord has looked from heaven : he has beheld all the sons of men .
text_la: De cælo respexit Dominus; vidit omnes filios hominum.
text_el: ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐπέβλεψεν ὁ κύριος εἶδεν πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: From his habitation which he has prepared, he has looked upon all that dwell on the earth.
text_la: De præparato habitaculo suo respexit super omnes qui habitant terram:
text_el: ἐξ ἑτοίμου κατοικητηρίου αὐτοῦ ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: He who has made the hearts of every one of them: who understands all their works.
text_la: qui finxit sigillatim corda eorum; qui intelligit omnia opera eorum.
text_el: ὁ πλάσας κατὰ μόνας τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν ὁ συνιεὶς εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν

text_en: The king is not saved by a great army: nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.
text_la: Non salvatur rex per multam virtutem, et gigas non salvabitur in multitudine virtutis suæ.
text_el: οὐ σῴζεται βασιλεὺς διὰ πολλὴν δύναμιν καὶ γίγας οὐ σωθήσεται ἐν πλήθει ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Vain is the horse for safety: neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.
text_la: Fallax equus ad salutem; in abundantia autem virtutis suæ non salvabitur.
text_el: ψευδὴς ἵππος εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν δὲ πλήθει δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ οὐ σωθήσεται

text_en: Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: and on them that hope in his mercy.
text_la: Ecce oculi Domini super metuentes eum, et in eis qui sperant super misericordia ejus:
text_el: ἰδοὺ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ἐπὶ τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτὸν τοὺς ἐλπίζοντας ἐπὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: To deliver their souls from death; and feed them in famine.
text_la: ut eruat a morte animas eorum, et alat eos in fame.
text_el: ῥύσασθαι ἐκ θανάτου τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν καὶ διαθρέψαι αὐτοὺς ἐν λιμῷ

text_en: Our soul waits for the Lord : for he is our helper and protector.
text_la: Anima nostra sustinet Dominum, quoniam adjutor et protector noster est.
text_el: ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ὑπομένει τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι βοηθὸς καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς ἡμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: For in him our heart shall rejoice: and in his holy name we have trusted.
text_la: Quia in eo lætabitur cor nostrum, et in nomine sancto ejus speravimus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐφρανθήσεται ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ ἠλπίσαμεν

text_en: Let your mercy, O Lord , be upon us, as we have hoped in you.
text_la: Fiat misericordia tua, Domine, super nos, quemadmodum speravimus in te.
text_el: γένοιτο τὸ ἔλεός σου κύριε ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καθάπερ ἠλπίσαμεν ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: For David , when he changed his countenance before Achimelech , who dismissed him, and he went his way.
text_la: Davidi, cum immutavit vultum suum coram Achimelech, et dimisit eum, et abiit.
text_pt: Regozijai-vos no SENHOR, vós justos, pois aos retos convém o louvor.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ὁπότε ἠλλοίωσεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν

text_en: I will bless the Lord at all times, his praise shall be always in my mouth.
text_la: Benedicam Dominum in omni tempore; semper laus ejus in ore meo.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor com harpa, cantai a ele com o saltério e um instrumento de dez cordas.
text_el: εὐλογήσω τὸν κύριον ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ διὰ παντὸς ἡ αἴνεσις αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ στόματί μου

text_en: In the Lord shall my soul be praised: let the meek hear and rejoice.
text_la: In Domino laudabitur anima mea : audiant mansueti, et lætentur.
text_pt: Cantai-lhe um cântico novo; tocai bem e com júbilo.
text_el: ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπαινεσθήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου ἀκουσάτωσαν πραεῖς καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν

text_en: O magnify the Lord with me; and let us extol his name together.
text_la: Magnificate Dominum mecum, et exaltemus nomen ejus in idipsum.
text_pt: Porque a palavra do Senhor é reta, e todas as suas obras são fiéis.
text_el: μεγαλύνατε τὸν κύριον σὺν ἐμοί καὶ ὑψώσωμεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: I sought the Lord , and he heard me; and he delivered me from all my troubles.
text_la: Exquisivi Dominum, et exaudivit me; et ex omnibus tribulationibus meis eripuit me.
text_pt: Ele ama a justiça e o juízo; a terra está cheia da bondade do Senhor.
text_el: ἐξεζήτησα τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐπήκουσέν μου καὶ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν παροικιῶν μου ἐρρύσατό με

text_en: Come to him and be enlightened: and your faces shall not be confounded.
text_la: Accedite ad eum, et illuminamini; et facies vestræ non confundentur.
text_pt: Pela palavra do Senhor foram feitos os céus, e todo o exército deles pelo espírito da sua boca.
text_el: προσέλθατε πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ φωτίσθητε καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ

text_en: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: and saved him out of all his troubles.
text_la: Iste pauper clamavit, et Dominus exaudivit eum, et de omnibus tribulationibus ejus salvavit eum.
text_pt: Ele ajunta as águas do mar como num montão; põe os abismos em depósitos.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ πτωχὸς ἐκέκραξεν καὶ ὁ κύριος εἰσήκουσεν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ ἔσωσεν αὐτόν

text_en: The angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: and shall deliver them.
text_la: Immittet angelus Domini in circuitu timentium eum, et eripiet eos.
text_pt: Tema toda a terra ao Senhor; temam-no todos os moradores do mundo.
text_el: παρεμβαλεῖ ἄγγελος κυρίου κύκλῳ τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν καὶ ῥύσεται αὐτούς

text_en: O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: blessed is the man that hopes in him.
text_la: Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus; beatus vir qui sperat in eo.
text_pt: Porque falou, e foi feito; mandou, e logo apareceu.
text_el: γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε ὅτι χρηστὸς ὁ κύριος μακάριος ἀνήρ ὃς ἐλπίζει ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: Fear the Lord , all you his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
text_la: Timete Dominum, omnes sancti ejus, quoniam non est inopia timentibus eum.
text_pt: O Senhor desfaz o conselho dos gentios, quebranta os intentos dos povos.
text_el: φοβήθητε τὸν κύριον οἱ ἅγιοι αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὑστέρημα τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν

text_en: The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good .
text_la: Divites eguerunt, et esurierunt; inquirentes autem Dominum non minuentur omni bono.
text_pt: O conselho do Senhor permanece para sempre; os intentos do seu coração de geração em geração.
text_el: πλούσιοι ἐπτώχευσαν καὶ ἐπείνασαν οἱ δὲ ἐκζητοῦντες τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐλαττωθήσονται παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: Come, children, hearken to me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
text_la: Venite, filii; audite me : timorem Domini docebo vos.
text_pt: Bem-aventurada é a nação cujo Deus é o Senhor, e o povo ao qual escolheu para sua herança.
text_el: δεῦτε τέκνα ἀκούσατέ μου φόβον κυρίου διδάξω ὑμᾶς

text_en: Who is the man that desires life: who lives to see good days?
text_la: Quis est homo qui vult vitam; diligit dies videre bonos?
text_pt: O Senhor olha desde os céus e está vendo a todos os filhos dos homens.
text_el: τίς ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὁ θέλων ζωὴν ἀγαπῶν ἡμέρας ἰδεῖν ἀγαθάς

text_en: Keep your tongue form evil , and your lips from speaking guile.
text_la: Prohibe linguam tuam a malo, et labia tua ne loquantur dolum.
text_pt: Do lugar da sua habitação contempla todos os moradores da terra.
text_el: παῦσον τὴν γλῶσσάν σου ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ χείλη σου τοῦ μὴ λαλῆσαι δόλον

text_en: Turn away from evil and do good : seek after peace and pursue it.
text_la: Diverte a malo, et fac bonum; inquire pacem, et persequere eam.
text_pt: Ele é que forma o coração de todos eles, que contempla todas as suas obras.
text_el: ἔκκλινον ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποίησον ἀγαθόν ζήτησον εἰρήνην καὶ δίωξον αὐτήν

text_en: The eyes of the Lord are upon the just : and his ears unto their prayers .
text_la: Oculi Domini super justos, et aures ejus in preces eorum.
text_pt: Não há rei que se salve com a grandeza dum exército, nem o homem valente se livra pela muita força.
text_el: ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ὦτα αὐτοῦ εἰς δέησιν αὐτῶν

text_en: But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
text_la: Vultus autem Domini super facientes mala, ut perdat de terra memoriam eorum.
text_pt: O cavalo é falaz para a segurança; não livra ninguém com a sua grande força.
text_el: πρόσωπον δὲ κυρίου ἐπὶ ποιοῦντας κακὰ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐκ γῆς τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν

text_en: The just cried, and the Lord heard them: and delivered them out of all their troubles.
text_la: Clamaverunt justi, et Dominus exaudivit eos; et ex omnibus tribulationibus eorum liberavit eos.
text_pt: Eis que os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os que o temem, sobre os que esperam na sua misericórdia;
text_el: ἐκέκραξαν οἱ δίκαιοι καὶ ὁ κύριος εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτῶν ἐρρύσατο αὐτούς

text_en: The Lord is near unto them that are of a contrite heart: and he will save the humble of spirit.
text_la: Juxta est Dominus iis qui tribulato sunt corde, et humiles spiritu salvabit.
text_pt: Para lhes livrar as almas da morte, e para os conservar vivos na fome.
text_el: ἐγγὺς κύριος τοῖς συντετριμμένοις τὴν καρδίαν καὶ τοὺς ταπεινοὺς τῷ πνεύματι σώσει

text_en: Many are the afflictions of the just ; but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.
text_la: Multæ tribulationes justorum; et de omnibus his liberabit eos Dominus.
text_pt: A nossa alma espera no Senhor; ele é o nosso auxílio e o nosso escudo.
text_el: πολλαὶ αἱ θλίψεις τῶν δικαίων καὶ ἐκ πασῶν αὐτῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς

text_en: The Lord is near unto them that are of a contrite heart: and he will save the humble of spirit.
text_la: Custodit Dominus omnia ossa eorum : unum ex his non conteretur.
text_pt: Pois nele se alegra o nosso coração; porquanto temos confiado no seu santo nome.
text_el: κύριος φυλάσσει πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτῶν ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐ συντριβήσεται

text_en: The death of the wicked is very evil : and they that hate the just shall be guilty.
text_la: Mors peccatorum pessima; et qui oderunt justum delinquent.
text_pt: Seja a tua misericórdia, Senhor, sobre nós, como em ti esperamos.
text_el: θάνατος ἁμαρτωλῶν πονηρός καὶ οἱ μισοῦντες τὸν δίκαιον πλημμελήσουσιν

text_en: The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall offend.
text_la: Redimet Dominus animas servorum suorum, et non delinquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
text_el: λυτρώσεται κύριος ψυχὰς δούλων αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ πλημμελήσωσιν πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: Judge, O Lord , them that wrong me: overthrow them that fight against me.
text_la: Judica, Domine, nocentes me; expugna impugnantes me.
text_pt: Louvarei ao SENHOR em todo o tempo; o seu louvor estará continuamente na minha boca.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ δίκασον κύριε τοὺς ἀδικοῦντάς με πολέμησον τοὺς πολεμοῦντάς με

text_en: Take hold of arms and shield: and rise up to help me.
text_la: Apprehende arma et scutum, et exsurge in adjutorium mihi.
text_pt: A minha alma se gloriará no Senhor; os mansos o ouvirão e se alegrarão.
text_el: ἐπιλαβοῦ ὅπλου καὶ θυρεοῦ καὶ ἀνάστηθι εἰς βοήθειάν μου

text_en: Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul : I am your salvation .
text_la: Effunde frameam, et conclude adversus eos qui persequuntur me; dic animæ meæ : Salus tua ego sum.
text_pt: Engrandecei ao Senhor comigo; e juntos exaltemos o seu nome.
text_el: ἔκχεον ῥομφαίαν καὶ σύγκλεισον ἐξ ἐναντίας τῶν καταδιωκόντων με εἰπὸν τῇ ψυχῇ μου σωτηρία σου ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek after my soul . Let them be turned back and be confounded that devise evil against me.
text_la: Confundantur et revereantur quærentes animam meam; avertantur retrorsum et confundantur cogitantes mihi mala.
text_pt: Busquei ao Senhor, e ele me respondeu; livrou-me de todos os meus temores.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἐντραπήτωσαν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀποστραφήτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ καταισχυνθήτωσαν οἱ λογιζόμενοί μοι κακά

text_en: Let them become as dust before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord straiten them.
text_la: Fiant tamquam pulvis ante faciem venti, et angelus Domini coarctans eos.
text_pt: Olharam para ele, e foram iluminados; e os seus rostos não ficaram confundidos.
text_el: γενηθήτωσαν ὡσεὶ χνοῦς κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀνέμου καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐκθλίβων αὐτούς

text_en: Let their way become dark and slippery; and let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
text_la: Fiat via illorum tenebræ et lubricum, et angelus Domini persequens eos.
text_pt: Clamou este pobre, e o Senhor o ouviu, e o salvou de todas as suas angústias.
text_el: γενηθήτω ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν σκότος καὶ ὀλίσθημα καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου καταδιώκων αὐτούς

text_en: For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: without cause they have upbraided my soul .
text_la: Quoniam gratis absconderunt mihi interitum laquei sui; supervacue exprobraverunt animam meam.
text_pt: O anjo do Senhor acampa-se ao redor dos que o temem, e os livra.
text_el: ὅτι δωρεὰν ἔκρυψάν μοι διαφθορὰν παγίδος αὐτῶν μάτην ὠνείδισαν τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: Let the snare which he knows not come upon him: and let the net which he has hidden catch him: and into that very snare let them fall.
text_la: Veniat illi laqueus quem ignorat, et captio quam abscondit apprehendat eum, et in laqueum cadat in ipsum.
text_pt: Provai, e vede que o Senhor é bom; bem-aventurado o homem que nele confia.
text_el: ἐλθέτω αὐτοῖς παγίς ἣν οὐ γινώσκουσιν καὶ ἡ θήρα ἣν ἔκρυψαν συλλαβέτω αὐτούς καὶ ἐν τῇ παγίδι πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord ; and shall be delighted in his salvation .
text_la: Anima autem mea exsultabit in Domino, et delectabitur super salutari suo.
text_pt: Temei ao Senhor, vós, os seus santos, pois nada falta aos que o temem.
text_el: ἡ δὲ ψυχή μου ἀγαλλιάσεται ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ τερφθήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: All my bones shall say: Lord , who is like to you? Who delivers the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; the needy and the poor from them that strip him.
text_la: Omnia ossa mea dicent : Domine, quis similis tibi? eripiens inopem de manu fortiorum ejus; egenum et pauperem a diripientibus eum.
text_pt: Os filhos dos leões necessitam e sofrem fome, mas àqueles que buscam ao Senhor bem nenhum faltará.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐροῦσιν κύριε τίς ὅμοιός σοι ῥυόμενος πτωχὸν ἐκ χειρὸς στερεωτέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα ἀπὸ τῶν διαρπαζόντων αὐτόν

text_en: Unjust witnesses rising up have asked me things I knew not.
text_la: Surgentes testes iniqui, quæ ignorabam interrogabant me.
text_pt: Vinde, meninos, ouvi-me; eu vos ensinarei o temor do Senhor.
text_el: ἀναστάντες μάρτυρες ἄδικοι ἃ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον ἠρώτων με

text_en: They repaid me evil for good : to the depriving me of my soul .
text_la: Retribuebant mihi mala pro bonis, sterilitatem animæ meæ.
text_pt: Quem é o homem que deseja a vida, que quer largos dias para ver o bem?
text_el: ἀνταπεδίδοσάν μοι πονηρὰ ἀντὶ καλῶν καὶ ἀτεκνίαν τῇ ψυχῇ μου

text_en: But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, I was clothed with haircloth. I humbled my soul with fasting ; and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.
text_la: Ego autem, cum mihi molesti essent, induebar cilicio; humiliabam in jejunio animam meam, et oratio mea in sinu meo convertetur.
text_pt: Guarda a tua língua do mal, e os teus lábios de falarem o engano.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς παρενοχλεῖν μοι ἐνεδυόμην σάκκον καὶ ἐταπείνουν ἐν νηστείᾳ τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ ἡ προσευχή μου εἰς κόλπον μου ἀποστραφήσεται

text_en: As a neighbour and as an own brother, so did I please: as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled .
text_la: Quasi proximum et quasi fratrem nostrum sic complacebam; quasi lugens et contristatus sic humiliabar.
text_pt: Aparta-te do mal, e faze o bem; procura a paz, e segue-a.
text_el: ὡς πλησίον ὡς ἀδελφὸν ἡμέτερον οὕτως εὐηρέστουν ὡς πενθῶν καὶ σκυθρωπάζων οὕτως ἐταπεινούμην

text_en: But they rejoiced against me, and came together: scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.
text_la: Et adversum me lætati sunt, et convenerunt; congregata sunt super me flagella, et ignoravi.
text_pt: Os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os justos, e os seus ouvidos atentos ao seu clamor.
text_el: καὶ κατ' ἐμοῦ ηὐφράνθησαν καὶ συνήχθησαν συνήχθησαν ἐπ' ἐμὲ μάστιγες καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων διεσχίσθησαν καὶ οὐ κατενύγησαν

text_en: They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
text_la: Dissipati sunt, nec compuncti; tentaverunt me, subsannaverunt me subsannatione; frenduerunt super me dentibus suis.
text_pt: A face do Senhor está contra os que fazem o mal, para desarraigar da terra a memória deles.
text_el: ἐπείρασάν με ἐξεμυκτήρισάν με μυκτηρισμόν ἔβρυξαν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτῶν

text_en: Lord , when will you look upon me? Rescue my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.
text_la: Domine, quando respicies? Restitue animam meam a malignitate eorum; a leonibus unicam meam.
text_pt: Os justos clamam, e o Senhor os ouve, e os livra de todas as suas angústias.
text_el: κύριε πότε ἐπόψῃ ἀποκατάστησον τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ τῆς κακουργίας αὐτῶν ἀπὸ λεόντων τὴν μονογενῆ μου

text_en: I will give thanks to you in a great church; I will praise you in a strong people.
text_la: Confitebor tibi in ecclesia magna; in populo gravi laudabo te.
text_pt: Perto está o Senhor dos que têm o coração quebrantado, e salva os contritos de espírito.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ πολλῇ ἐν λαῷ βαρεῖ αἰνέσω σε

text_en: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.
text_la: Non supergaudeant mihi qui adversantur mihi inique, qui oderunt me gratis, et annuunt oculis.
text_pt: Muitas são as aflições do justo, mas o Senhor o livra de todas.
text_el: μὴ ἐπιχαρείησάν μοι οἱ ἐχθραίνοντές μοι ἀδίκως οἱ μισοῦντές με δωρεὰν καὶ διανεύοντες ὀφθαλμοῖς

text_en: For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.
text_la: Quoniam mihi quidem pacifice loquebantur; et in iracundia terræ loquentes, dolos cogitabant.
text_pt: Ele lhe guarda todos os seus ossos; nem sequer um deles se quebra.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμοὶ μὲν εἰρηνικὰ ἐλάλουν καὶ ἐπ' ὀργὴν δόλους διελογίζοντο

text_en: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.
text_la: Et dilataverunt super me os suum; dixerunt : Euge, euge! viderunt oculi nostri.
text_pt: A malícia matará o ímpio, e os que odeiam o justo serão punidos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλάτυναν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν εἶπαν εὖγε εὖγε εἶδαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: You have seen, O Lord , be not silent: O Lord , depart not from me.
text_la: Vidisti, Domine : ne sileas; Domine, ne discedas a me.
text_pt: O Senhor resgata a alma dos seus servos, e nenhum dos que nele confiam será punido.
text_el: εἶδες κύριε μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς κύριε μὴ ἀποστῇς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: to my cause, my God , and my Lord .
text_la: Exsurge et intende judicio meo, Deus meus; et Dominus meus, in causam meam.
text_el: ἐξεγέρθητι κύριε καὶ πρόσχες τῇ κρίσει μου ὁ θεός μου καὶ ὁ κύριός μου εἰς τὴν δίκην μου

text_en: Judge me, O Lord my God according to your justice , and let them not rejoice over me.
text_la: Judica me secundum justitiam tuam, Domine Deus meus, et non supergaudeant mihi.
text_el: κρῖνόν με κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου κύριε ὁ θεός μου καὶ μὴ ἐπιχαρείησάν μοι

text_en: Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.
text_la: Non dicant in cordibus suis : Euge, euge, animæ nostræ; nec dicant : Devoravimus eum.
text_el: μὴ εἴπαισαν ἐν καρδίαις αὐτῶν εὖγε εὖγε τῇ ψυχῇ ἡμῶν μηδὲ εἴπαισαν κατεπίομεν αὐτόν

text_en: Let them blush: and be ashamed together, who rejoice at my evils . Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, who speak great things against me.
text_la: Erubescant et revereantur simul qui gratulantur malis meis; induantur confusione et reverentia qui magna loquuntur super me.
text_el: αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν ἅμα οἱ ἐπιχαίροντες τοῖς κακοῖς μου ἐνδυσάσθωσαν αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐντροπὴν οἱ μεγαλορρημονοῦντες ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice , and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.
text_la: Exsultent et lætentur qui volunt justitiam meam; et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui volunt pacem servi ejus.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσαιντο καὶ εὐφρανθείησαν οἱ θέλοντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ εἰπάτωσαν διὰ παντός μεγαλυνθήτω ὁ κύριος οἱ θέλοντες τὴν εἰρήνην τοῦ δούλου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And my tongue shall meditate your justice , your praise all the day long.
text_la: Et lingua mea meditabitur justitiam tuam; tota die laudem tuam.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου μελετήσει τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὸν ἔπαινόν σου

text_en: Unto the end, for the servant of God , David himself.
text_la: In finem. Servo Domini ipsi David.
text_pt: Pleiteia, SENHOR, com aqueles que pleiteiam comigo; peleja contra os que pelejam contra mim.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ δούλῳ κυρίου τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: The unjust has said within himself, that he would sin : there is no fear of God before his eyes.
text_la: Dixit injustus ut delinquat in semetipso: non est timor Dei ante oculos ejus.
text_pt: Pega do escudo e da rodela, e levanta-te em minha ajuda.
text_el: φησὶν ὁ παράνομος τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: For in his sight he has done deceitfully, that his iniquity may be found unto hatred .
text_la: Quoniam dolose egit in conspectu ejus, ut inveniatur iniquitas ejus ad odium.
text_pt: Tira da lança e obstrui o caminho aos que me perseguem; dize à minha alma: Eu sou a tua salvação.
text_el: ὅτι ἐδόλωσεν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ τοῦ εὑρεῖν τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ μισῆσαι

text_en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and guile: he would not understand that he might do well.
text_la: Verba oris ejus iniquitas, et dolus; noluit intelligere ut bene ageret.
text_pt: Sejam confundidos e envergonhados os que buscam a minha vida; voltem atrás e envergonhem-se os que contra mim tentam mal.
text_el: τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἀνομία καὶ δόλος οὐκ ἐβουλήθη συνιέναι τοῦ ἀγαθῦναι

text_en: He has devised iniquity on his bed, he has set himself on every way that is not good : but evil he has not hated .
text_la: Iniquitatem meditatus est in cubili suo; astitit omni viæ non bonæ : malitiam autem non odivit.
text_pt: Sejam como a moinha perante o vento; o anjo do Senhor os faça fugir.
text_el: ἀνομίαν διελογίσατο ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ παρέστη πάσῃ ὁδῷ οὐκ ἀγαθῇ τῇ δὲ κακίᾳ οὐ προσώχθισεν

text_en: O Lord , your mercy is in heaven , and your truth reaches even to the clouds.
text_la: Domine, in cælo misericordia tua, et veritas tua usque ad nubes.
text_pt: Seja o seu caminho tenebroso e escorregadio, e o anjo do Senhor os persiga.
text_el: κύριε ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά σου ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν

text_en: Your justice is as the mountains of God , your judgments are a great deep . Men and beasts you will preserve, O Lord :
text_la: Justitia tua sicut montes Dei; judicia tua abyssus multa. Homines et jumenta salvabis, Domine,
text_pt: Porque sem causa encobriram de mim a rede na cova, a qual sem razão cavaram para a minha alma.
text_el: ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου ὡσεὶ ὄρη θεοῦ τὰ κρίματά σου ἄβυσσος πολλή ἀνθρώπους καὶ κτήνη σώσεις κύριε

text_en: O how have you multiplied your mercy, O God ! But the children of men shall put their trust under the covert of your wings.
text_la: quemadmodum multiplicasti misericordiam tuam, Deus. Filii autem hominum in tegmine alarum tuarum sperabunt.
text_pt: Sobrevenha-lhe destruição sem o saber, e prenda-o a rede que ocultou; caia ele nessa mesma destruição.
text_el: ὡς ἐπλήθυνας τὸ ἔλεός σου ὁ θεός οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου ἐλπιοῦσιν

text_en: They shall be inebriated with the plenty of your house; and you shall make them drink of the torrent of your pleasure.
text_la: Inebriabuntur ab ubertate domus tuæ, et torrente voluptatis tuæ potabis eos:
text_pt: E a minha alma se alegrará no Senhor; alegrar-se-á na sua salvação.
text_el: μεθυσθήσονται ἀπὸ πιότητος τοῦ οἴκου σου καὶ τὸν χειμάρρουν τῆς τρυφῆς σου ποτιεῖς αὐτούς

text_en: For with you is the fountain of life; and in your light we shall see light.
text_la: quoniam apud te est fons vitæ, et in lumine tuo videbimus lumen.
text_pt: Todos os meus ossos dirão: Senhor, quem é como tu, que livras o pobre daquele que é mais forte do que ele? Sim, o pobre e o necessitado daquele que o rouba.
text_el: ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς ἐν τῷ φωτί σου ὀψόμεθα φῶς

text_en: Extend your mercy to them that know you, and your justice to them that are right in heart.
text_la: Prætende misericordiam tuam scientibus te, et justitiam tuam his qui recto sunt corde.
text_pt: Falsas testemunhas se levantaram; depuseram contra mim coisas que eu não sabia.
text_el: παράτεινον τὸ ἔλεός σου τοῖς γινώσκουσίν σε καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: Let not the foot of pride come to me, and let not the hand of the sinner move me.
text_la: Non veniat mihi pes superbiæ, et manus peccatoris non moveat me.
text_pt: Tornaram-me o mal pelo bem, roubando a minha alma.
text_el: μὴ ἐλθέτω μοι ποὺς ὑπερηφανίας καὶ χεὶρ ἁμαρτωλῶν μὴ σαλεύσαι με

text_en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen, they are cast out, and could not stand.
text_la: Ibi ceciderunt qui operantur iniquitatem; expulsi sunt, nec potuerunt stare.
text_pt: Mas, quanto a mim, quando estavam enfermos, as minhas vestes eram o saco; humilhava a minha alma com o jejum, e a minha oração voltava para o meu seio.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἔπεσον οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ἐξώσθησαν καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆναι

text_en: Be not emulous of evildoers; nor envy them that work iniquity .
text_la: Noli æmulari in malignantibus, neque zelaveris facientes iniquitatem:
text_pt: A transgressão do ímpio diz no íntimo do meu coração: Não há temor de Deus perante os seus olhos.
text_el: τοῦ Δαυιδ μὴ παραζήλου ἐν πονηρευομένοις μηδὲ ζήλου τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: For they shall shortly wither away as grass, and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.
text_la: quoniam tamquam fœnum velociter arescent, et quemadmodum olera herbarum cito decident.
text_pt: Porque em seus olhos se lisonjeia, até que a sua iniqüidade se descubra ser detestável.
text_el: ὅτι ὡσεὶ χόρτος ταχὺ ἀποξηρανθήσονται καὶ ὡσεὶ λάχανα χλόης ταχὺ ἀποπεσοῦνται

text_en: Trust in the Lord , and do good , and dwell in the land, and you shall be fed with its riches.
text_la: Spera in Domino, et fac bonitatem; et inhabita terram, et pasceris in divitiis ejus.
text_pt: As palavras da sua boca são malícia e engano; deixou de entender e de fazer o bem.
text_el: ἔλπισον ἐπὶ κύριον καὶ ποίει χρηστότητα καὶ κατασκήνου τὴν γῆν καὶ ποιμανθήσῃ ἐπὶ τῷ πλούτῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Delight in the Lord , and he will give you the requests of your heart.
text_la: Delectare in Domino, et dabit tibi petitiones cordis tui.
text_pt: Projeta a malícia na sua cama; põe-se no caminho que não é bom; não aborrece o mal.
text_el: κατατρύφησον τοῦ κυρίου καὶ δώσει σοι τὰ αἰτήματα τῆς καρδίας σου

text_en: Commit your way to the Lord , and trust in him, and he will do it.
text_la: Revela Domino viam tuam, et spera in eo, et ipse faciet.
text_pt: A tua misericórdia, Senhor, está nos céus, e a tua fidelidade chega até às mais excelsas nuvens.
text_el: ἀποκάλυψον πρὸς κύριον τὴν ὁδόν σου καὶ ἔλπισον ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ποιήσει

text_en: And he will bring forth your justice as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.
text_la: Et educet quasi lumen justitiam tuam, et judicium tuum tamquam meridiem.
text_pt: A tua justiça é como as grandes montanhas; os teus juízos são um grande abismo. Senhor, tu conservas os homens e os animais.
text_el: καὶ ἐξοίσει ὡς φῶς τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου καὶ τὸ κρίμα σου ὡς μεσημβρίαν

text_en: Be subject to the Lord and pray to him. Envy not the man who prospers in his way; the man who does unjust things.
text_la: Subditus esto Domino, et ora eum. Noli æmulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua; in homine faciente injustitias.
text_pt: Quão preciosa é, ó Deus, a tua benignidade, pelo que os filhos dos homens se abrigam à sombra das tuas asas.
text_el: ὑποτάγηθι τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἱκέτευσον αὐτόν μὴ παραζήλου ἐν τῷ κατευοδουμένῳ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ ποιοῦντι παρανομίας

text_en: Cease from anger , and leave rage; have no emulation to do evil .
text_la: Desine ab ira, et derelinque furorem; noli æmulari ut maligneris.
text_pt: Eles se fartarão da gordura da tua casa, e os farás beber da corrente das tuas delícias;
text_el: παῦσαι ἀπὸ ὀργῆς καὶ ἐγκατάλιπε θυμόν μὴ παραζήλου ὥστε πονηρεύεσθαι

text_en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but they that wait upon the Lord , they shall inherit the land.
text_la: Quoniam qui malignantur exterminabuntur; sustinentes autem Dominum, ipsi hæreditabunt terram.
text_pt: Porque em ti está o manancial da vida; na tua luz veremos a luz.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ πονηρευόμενοι ἐξολεθρευθήσονται οἱ δὲ ὑπομένοντες τὸν κύριον αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν γῆν

text_en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and you shall seek his place, and shall not find it.
text_la: Et adhuc pusillum, et non erit peccator; et quæres locum ejus, et non invenies.
text_pt: Estende a tua benignidade sobre os que te conhecem, e a tua justiça sobre os retos de coração.
text_el: καὶ ἔτι ὀλίγον καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπάρξῃ ὁ ἁμαρτωλός καὶ ζητήσεις τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρῃς

text_en: But the meek shall inherit the land, and shall delight in abundance of peace.
text_la: Mansueti autem hæreditabunt terram, et delectabuntur in multitudine pacis.
text_pt: Não venha sobre mim o pé dos soberbos, e não me mova a mão dos ímpios.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πραεῖς κληρονομήσουσιν γῆν καὶ κατατρυφήσουσιν ἐπὶ πλήθει εἰρήνης

text_en: The sinner shall watch the just man : and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.
text_la: Observabit peccator justum, et stridebit super eum dentibus suis.
text_pt: Ali caem os que praticam a iniqüidade; cairão, e não se poderão levantar.
text_el: παρατηρήσεται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς τὸν δίκαιον καὶ βρύξει ἐπ' αὐτὸν τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for he foresees that his day shall come.
text_la: Dominus autem irridebit eum, quoniam prospicit quod veniet dies ejus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐκγελάσεται αὐτόν ὅτι προβλέπει ὅτι ἥξει ἡ ἡμέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The wicked have drawn out the sword: they have bent their bow. To cast down the poor and needy, to kill the upright of heart.
text_la: Gladium evaginaverunt peccatores; intenderunt arcum suum : ut dejiciant pauperem et inopem, ut trucident rectos corde.
text_el: ῥομφαίαν ἐσπάσαντο οἱ ἁμαρτωλοί ἐνέτειναν τόξον αὐτῶν τοῦ καταβαλεῖν πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα τοῦ σφάξαι τοὺς εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: Let their sword enter into their own hearts, and let their bow be broken.
text_la: Gladius eorum intret in corda ipsorum, et arcus eorum confringatur.
text_el: ἡ ῥομφαία αὐτῶν εἰσέλθοι εἰς τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν συντριβείησαν

text_en: Better is a little to the just , than the great riches of the wicked.
text_la: Melius est modicum justo, super divitias peccatorum multas:
text_el: κρεῖσσον ὀλίγον τῷ δικαίῳ ὑπὲρ πλοῦτον ἁμαρτωλῶν πολύν

text_en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengthens the just .
text_la: quoniam brachia peccatorum conterentur : confirmat autem justos Dominus.
text_el: ὅτι βραχίονες ἁμαρτωλῶν συντριβήσονται ὑποστηρίζει δὲ τοὺς δικαίους κύριος

text_en: The Lord knows the days of the undefiled; and their inheritance shall be for ever.
text_la: Novit Dominus dies immaculatorum, et hæreditas eorum in æternum erit.
text_el: γινώσκει κύριος τὰς ὁδοὺς τῶν ἀμώμων καὶ ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσται

text_en: They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled:
text_la: Non confundentur in tempore malo, et in diebus famis saturabuntur:
text_el: οὐ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐν καιρῷ πονηρῷ καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις λιμοῦ χορτασθήσονται

text_en: Because the wicked shall perish. And the enemies of the Lord , presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.
text_la: quia peccatores peribunt. Inimici vero Domini mox ut honorificati fuerint et exaltati, deficientes quemadmodum fumus deficient.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπολοῦνται οἱ δὲ ἐχθροὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἅμα τῷ δοξασθῆναι αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑψωθῆναι ἐκλιπόντες ὡσεὶ καπνὸς ἐξέλιπον

text_en: The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; but the just shows mercy and shall give.
text_la: Mutuabitur peccator, et non solvet; justus autem miseretur et tribuet:
text_el: δανείζεται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς καὶ οὐκ ἀποτείσει ὁ δὲ δίκαιος οἰκτίρει καὶ διδοῖ

text_en: For such as bless him shall inherit the land: but such as curse him shall perish.
text_la: quia benedicentes ei hæreditabunt terram; maledicentes autem ei disperibunt.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ εὐλογοῦντες αὐτὸν κληρονομήσουσι γῆν οἱ δὲ καταρώμενοι αὐτὸν ἐξολεθρευθήσονται

text_en: With the Lord shall the steps of a man be directed, and he shall like well his way.
text_la: Apud Dominum gressus hominis dirigentur, et viam ejus volet.
text_el: παρὰ κυρίου τὰ διαβήματα ἀνθρώπου κατευθύνεται καὶ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ θελήσει

text_en: When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, for the Lord puts his hand under him.
text_la: Cum ceciderit, non collidetur, quia Dominus supponit manum suam.
text_el: ὅταν πέσῃ οὐ καταραχθήσεται ὅτι κύριος ἀντιστηρίζει χεῖρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: I have been young and now am old; and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.
text_la: Junior fui, etenim senui; et non vidi justum derelictum, nec semen ejus quærens panem.
text_el: νεώτερος ἐγενόμην καὶ γὰρ ἐγήρασα καὶ οὐκ εἶδον δίκαιον ἐγκαταλελειμμένον οὐδὲ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ζητοῦν ἄρτους

text_en: He shows mercy, and lends all the day long; and his seed shall be in blessing .
text_la: Tota die miseretur et commodat; et semen illius in benedictione erit.
text_el: ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐλεᾷ καὶ δανείζει καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ εἰς εὐλογίαν ἔσται

text_en: Decline from evil and do good , and dwell for ever and ever.
text_la: Declina a malo, et fac bonum, et inhabita in sæculum sæculi:
text_el: ἔκκλινον ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποίησον ἀγαθὸν καὶ κατασκήνου εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος

text_en: For the Lord loves judgment, and will not forsake his saints: they shall be preserved for ever. The unjust shall be punished, and the seed of the wicked shall perish.
text_la: quia Dominus amat judicium, et non derelinquet sanctos suos : in æternum conservabuntur. Injusti punientur, et semen impiorum peribit.
text_el: ὅτι κύριος ἀγαπᾷ κρίσιν καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα φυλαχθήσονται ἄνομοι δὲ ἐκδιωχθήσονται καὶ σπέρμα ἀσεβῶν ἐξολεθρευθήσεται

text_en: But the just shall inherit the land, and shall dwell therein for evermore.
text_la: Justi autem hæreditabunt terram, et inhabitabunt in sæculum sæculi super eam.
text_el: δίκαιοι δὲ κληρονομήσουσι γῆν καὶ κατασκηνώσουσιν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: and his tongue shall speak judgment.
text_la: Os justi meditabitur sapientiam, et lingua ejus loquetur judicium.
text_el: στόμα δικαίου μελετήσει σοφίαν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ λαλήσει κρίσιν

text_en: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps shall not be supplanted.
text_la: Lex Dei ejus in corde ipsius, et non supplantabuntur gressus ejus.
text_el: ὁ νόμος τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐχ ὑποσκελισθήσεται τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The wicked watches the just man , and seeks to put him to death,
text_la: Considerat peccator justum, et quærit mortificare eum.
text_el: κατανοεῖ ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς τὸν δίκαιον καὶ ζητεῖ τοῦ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν

text_en: but the Lord will not leave him in his hands; nor condemn him when he shall be judged.
text_la: Dominus autem non derelinquet eum in manibus ejus, nec damnabit eum cum judicabitur illi.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃ αὐτὸν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ μὴ καταδικάσηται αὐτόν ὅταν κρίνηται αὐτῷ

text_en: Expect the Lord and keep his way: and he will exalt you to inherit the land: when the sinners shall perish you shall see.
text_la: Exspecta Dominum, et custodi viam ejus, et exaltabit te ut hæreditate capias terram : cum perierint peccatores, videbis.
text_el: ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον καὶ φύλαξον τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑψώσει σε τοῦ κατακληρονομῆσαι γῆν ἐν τῷ ἐξολεθρεύεσθαι ἁμαρτωλοὺς ὄψῃ

text_en: I have seen the wicked highly exalted, and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.
text_la: Vidi impium superexaltatum, et elevatum sicut cedros Libani:
text_el: εἶδον ἀσεβῆ ὑπερυψούμενον καὶ ἐπαιρόμενον ὡς τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου

text_en: And I passed by, and lo, he was not: and I sought him and his place was not found.
text_la: et transivi, et ecce non erat; et quæsivi eum, et non est inventus locus ejus.
text_el: καὶ παρῆλθον καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν καὶ ἐζήτησα αὐτόν καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Keep innocence, and behold justice : for there are remnants for the peaceable man .
text_la: Custodi innocentiam, et vide æquitatem, quoniam sunt reliquiæ homini pacifico.
text_el: φύλασσε ἀκακίαν καὶ ἰδὲ εὐθύτητα ὅτι ἔστιν ἐγκατάλειμμα ἀνθρώπῳ εἰρηνικῷ

text_en: But the unjust shall be destroyed together: the remnants of the wicked shall perish.
text_la: Injusti autem disperibunt simul; reliquiæ impiorum interibunt.
text_el: οἱ δὲ παράνομοι ἐξολεθρευθήσονται ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἐξολεθρευθήσονται

text_en: But the salvation of the just is from the Lord , and he is their protector in the time of trouble.
text_la: Salus autem justorum a Domino; et protector eorum in tempore tribulationis.
text_el: σωτηρία δὲ τῶν δικαίων παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως

text_en: And the Lord will help them and deliver them: and he will rescue them from the wicked, and save them because they have hoped in him.
text_la: Et adjuvabit eos Dominus, et liberabit eos; et eruet eos a peccatoribus, et salvabit eos, quia speraverunt in eo.
text_el: καὶ βοηθήσει αὐτοῖς κύριος καὶ ῥύσεται αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξελεῖται αὐτοὺς ἐξ ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ σώσει αὐτούς ὅτι ἤλπισαν ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: A psalm for David , for a remembrance of the sabbath .
text_la: Psalmus David, in rememorationem de sabbato.
text_pt: NÃO te indignes por causa dos malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos que praticam a iniqüidade.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς ἀνάμνησιν περὶ σαββάτου

text_en: Rebuke me not, O Lord , in your indignation; nor chastise me in your wrath .
text_la: Domine, ne in furore tuo arguas me, neque in ira tua corripias me:
text_pt: Porque cedo serão ceifados como a erva, e murcharão como a verdura.
text_el: κύριε μὴ τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐλέγξῃς με μηδὲ τῇ ὀργῇ σου παιδεύσῃς με

text_en: For your arrows are fastened in me: and your hand has been strong upon me.
text_la: quoniam sagittæ tuæ infixæ sunt mihi, et confirmasti super me manum tuam.
text_pt: Confia no Senhor e faze o bem; habitarás na terra, e verdadeiramente serás alimentado.
text_el: ὅτι τὰ βέλη σου ἐνεπάγησάν μοι καὶ ἐπεστήρισας ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὴν χεῖρά σου

text_en: There is no health in my flesh, because of your wrath : there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins .
text_la: Non est sanitas in carne mea, a facie iræ tuæ; non est pax ossibus meis, a facie peccatorum meorum:
text_pt: Deleita-te também no Senhor, e te concederá os desejos do teu coração.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ὀργῆς σου οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη τοῖς ὀστέοις μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου

text_en: For my iniquities have gone over my head: and as a heavy burden have become heavy upon me.
text_la: quoniam iniquitates meæ supergressæ sunt caput meum, et sicut onus grave gravatæ sunt super me.
text_pt: Entrega o teu caminho ao Senhor; confia nele, e ele o fará.
text_el: ὅτι αἱ ἀνομίαι μου ὑπερῆραν τὴν κεφαλήν μου ὡσεὶ φορτίον βαρὺ ἐβαρύνθησαν ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: My sores are putrefied and corrupted, because of my foolishness.
text_la: Putruerunt et corruptæ sunt cicatrices meæ, a facie insipientiæ meæ.
text_pt: E ele fará sobressair a tua justiça como a luz, e o teu juízo como o meio-dia.
text_el: προσώζεσαν καὶ ἐσάπησαν οἱ μώλωπές μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ἀφροσύνης μου

text_en: I have become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: I walked sorrowful all the day long.
text_la: Miser factus sum et curvatus sum usque in finem; tota die contristatus ingrediebar.
text_pt: Descansa no Senhor, e espera nele; não te indignes por causa daquele que prospera em seu caminho, por causa do homem que executa astutos intentos.
text_el: ἐταλαιπώρησα καὶ κατεκάμφθην ἕως τέλους ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν σκυθρωπάζων ἐπορευόμην

text_en: For my loins are filled with illusions; and there is no health in my flesh.
text_la: Quoniam lumbi mei impleti sunt illusionibus, et non est sanitas in carne mea.
text_pt: Deixa a ira, e abandona o furor; não te indignes de forma alguma para fazer o mal.
text_el: ὅτι αἱ ψύαι μου ἐπλήσθησαν ἐμπαιγμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου

text_en: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: I roared with the groaning of my heart.
text_la: Afflictus sum, et humiliatus sum nimis; rugiebam a gemitu cordis mei.
text_pt: Porque os malfeitores serão desarraigados; mas aqueles que esperam no Senhor herdarão a terra.
text_el: ἐκακώθην καὶ ἐταπεινώθην ἕως σφόδρα ὠρυόμην ἀπὸ στεναγμοῦ τῆς καρδίας μου

text_en: Lord , all my desire is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you.
text_la: Domine, ante te omne desiderium meum, et gemitus meus a te non est absconditus.
text_pt: Pois ainda um pouco, e o ímpio não existirá; olharás para o seu lugar, e não aparecerá.
text_el: κύριε ἐναντίον σου πᾶσα ἡ ἐπιθυμία μου καὶ ὁ στεναγμός μου ἀπὸ σοῦ οὐκ ἐκρύβη

text_en: My heart is troubled, my strength has left me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.
text_la: Cor meum conturbatum est; dereliquit me virtus mea, et lumen oculorum meorum, et ipsum non est mecum.
text_pt: Mas os mansos herdarão a terra, e se deleitarão na abundância de paz.
text_el: ἡ καρδία μου ἐταράχθη ἐγκατέλιπέν με ἡ ἰσχύς μου καὶ τὸ φῶς τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου καὶ αὐτὸ οὐκ ἔστιν μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me. And they that were near me stood afar off:
text_la: Amici mei et proximi mei adversum me appropinquaverunt, et steterunt; et qui juxta me erant, de longe steterunt : et vim faciebant qui quærebant animam meam.
text_pt: O ímpio maquina contra o justo, e contra ele range os dentes.
text_el: οἱ φίλοι μου καὶ οἱ πλησίον μου ἐξ ἐναντίας μου ἤγγισαν καὶ ἔστησαν καὶ οἱ ἔγγιστά μου ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔστησαν

text_en: And they that sought my soul used violence . And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, and studied deceits all the day long.
text_la: Et qui inquirebant mala mihi, locuti sunt vanitates, et dolos tota die meditabantur.
text_pt: O Senhor se rirá dele, pois vê que vem chegando o seu dia.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεβιάσαντο οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι ἐλάλησαν ματαιότητας καὶ δολιότητας ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐμελέτησαν

text_en: But I, as a deaf man , heard not: and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.
text_la: Ego autem, tamquam surdus, non audiebam; et sicut mutus non aperiens os suum.
text_pt: Os ímpios puxaram da espada e armaram o arco, para derrubarem o pobre e necessitado, e para matarem os de reta conduta.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ὡσεὶ κωφὸς οὐκ ἤκουον καὶ ὡσεὶ ἄλαλος οὐκ ἀνοίγων τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I became as a man that hears not: and that has no reproofs in his mouth.
text_la: Et factus sum sicut homo non audiens, et non habens in ore suo redargutiones.
text_pt: Porém a sua espada lhes entrará no coração, e os seus arcos se quebrarão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενόμην ὡσεὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἀκούων καὶ οὐκ ἔχων ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ ἐλεγμούς

text_en: For in you, O Lord , have I hoped: you will hear me, O Lord my God .
text_la: Quoniam in te, Domine, speravi; tu exaudies me, Domine Deus meus.
text_pt: Vale mais o pouco que tem o justo, do que as riquezas de muitos ímpios.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπὶ σοί κύριε ἤλπισα σὺ εἰσακούσῃ κύριε ὁ θεός μου

text_en: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.
text_la: Quia dixi : Nequando supergaudeant mihi inimici mei; et dum commoventur pedes mei, super me magna locuti sunt.
text_pt: Pois os braços dos ímpios se quebrarão, mas o Senhor sustém os justos.
text_el: ὅτι εἶπα μήποτε ἐπιχαρῶσίν μοι οἱ ἐχθροί μου καὶ ἐν τῷ σαλευθῆναι πόδας μου ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐμεγαλορρημόνησαν

text_en: For I am ready for scourges: and my sorrow is continually before me.
text_la: Quoniam ego in flagella paratus sum, et dolor meus in conspectu meo semper.
text_pt: O Senhor conhece os dias dos retos, e a sua herança permanecerá para sempre.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ εἰς μάστιγας ἕτοιμος καὶ ἡ ἀλγηδών μου ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός

text_en: For I will declare my iniquity : and I will think for my sin .
text_la: Quoniam iniquitatem meam annuntiabo, et cogitabo pro peccato meo.
text_pt: Não serão envergonhados nos dias maus, e nos dias de fome se fartarão.
text_el: ὅτι τὴν ἀνομίαν μου ἐγὼ ἀναγγελῶ καὶ μεριμνήσω ὑπὲρ τῆς ἁμαρτίας μου

text_en: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
text_la: Inimici autem mei vivunt, et confirmati sunt super me : et multiplicati sunt qui oderunt me inique.
text_pt: Mas os ímpios perecerão, e os inimigos do Senhor serão como a gordura dos cordeiros; desaparecerão, e em fumaça se desfarão.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐχθροί μου ζῶσιν καὶ κεκραταίωνται ὑπὲρ ἐμέ καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν οἱ μισοῦντές με ἀδίκως

text_en: They that render evil for good , have detracted me, because I followed goodness.
text_la: Qui retribuunt mala pro bonis detrahebant mihi, quoniam sequebar bonitatem.
text_pt: O ímpio toma emprestado, e não paga; mas o justo se compadece e dá.
text_el: οἱ ἀνταποδιδόντες κακὰ ἀντὶ ἀγαθῶν ἐνδιέβαλλόν με ἐπεὶ κατεδίωκον δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἀπέρριψάν με τὸν ἀγαπητὸν ὡσεὶ νεκρὸν ἐβδελυγμένον

text_en: For sake me not, O Lord my God : do not depart from me.
text_la: Ne derelinquas me, Domine Deus meus; ne discesseris a me.
text_pt: Porque aqueles que ele abençoa herdarão a terra, e aqueles que forem por ele amaldiçoados serão desarraigados.
text_el: μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με κύριε ὁ θεός μου μὴ ἀποστῇς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Attend unto my help, O Lord , the God of my salvation .
text_la: Intende in adjutorium meum, Domine Deus salutis meæ.
text_pt: Os passos de um homem bom são confirmados pelo Senhor, e deleita-se no seu caminho.
text_el: πρόσχες εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου κύριε τῆς σωτηρίας μου

text_en: Unto the end, for Idithun himself, a canticle of David .
text_la: In finem, ipsi Idithun. Canticum David.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, não me repreendas na tua ira, nem me castigues no teu furor.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ Ιδιθουν ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: I said: I will take heed to my ways: that I sin not with my tongue. I have set a guard to my mouth, when the sinner stood against me.
text_la: Dixi : Custodiam vias meas : ut non delinquam in lingua mea. Posui ori meo custodiam, cum consisteret peccator adversum me.
text_pt: Porque as tuas flechas se cravaram em mim, e a tua mão sobre mim desceu.
text_el: εἶπα φυλάξω τὰς ὁδούς μου τοῦ μὴ ἁμαρτάνειν ἐν γλώσσῃ μου ἐθέμην τῷ στόματί μου φυλακὴν ἐν τῷ συστῆναι τὸν ἁμαρτωλὸν ἐναντίον μου

text_en: I was dumb, and was humbled , and kept silence from good things: and my sorrow was renewed.
text_la: Obmutui, et humiliatus sum, et silui a bonis; et dolor meus renovatus est.
text_pt: Não há coisa sã na minha carne, por causa da tua cólera; nem há paz em meus ossos, por causa do meu pecado.
text_el: ἐκωφώθην καὶ ἐταπεινώθην καὶ ἐσίγησα ἐξ ἀγαθῶν καὶ τὸ ἄλγημά μου ἀνεκαινίσθη

text_en: My heart grew hot within me: and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.
text_la: Concaluit cor meum intra me; et in meditatione mea exardescet ignis.
text_pt: Pois já as minhas iniqüidades ultrapassam a minha cabeça; como carga pesada são demais para as minhas forças.
text_el: ἐθερμάνθη ἡ καρδία μου ἐντός μου καὶ ἐν τῇ μελέτῃ μου ἐκκαυθήσεται πῦρ ἐλάλησα ἐν γλώσσῃ μου

text_en: I spoke with my tongue: O Lord , make me know my end. And what is the number of my days: that I may know what is wanting to me.
text_la: Locutus sum in lingua mea : Notum fac mihi, Domine, finem meum, et numerum dierum meorum quis est, ut sciam quid desit mihi.
text_pt: As minhas chagas cheiram mal e estão corruptas, por causa da minha loucura.
text_el: γνώρισόν μοι κύριε τὸ πέρας μου καὶ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν μου τίς ἐστιν ἵνα γνῶ τί ὑστερῶ ἐγώ

text_en: Behold you have made my days measurable and my substance is as nothing before you. And indeed all things are vanity: every man living.
text_la: Ecce mensurabiles posuisti dies meos, et substantia mea tamquam nihilum ante te. Verumtamen universa vanitas, omnis homo vivens.
text_pt: Estou encurvado, estou muito abatido, ando lamentando todo o dia.
text_el: ἰδοὺ παλαιστὰς ἔθου τὰς ἡμέρας μου καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασίς μου ὡσεὶ οὐθὲν ἐνώπιόν σου πλὴν τὰ σύμπαντα ματαιότης πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ζῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: Surely man passes as an image: yea, and he is disquieted in vain. He stores up: and he knows not for whom he shall gather these things.
text_la: Verumtamen in imagine pertransit homo; sed et frustra conturbatur : thesaurizat, et ignorat cui congregabit ea.
text_pt: Porque as minhas ilhargas estão cheias de ardor, e não há coisa sã na minha carne.
text_el: μέντοιγε ἐν εἰκόνι διαπορεύεται ἄνθρωπος πλὴν μάτην ταράσσονται θησαυρίζει καὶ οὐ γινώσκει τίνι συνάξει αὐτά

text_en: And now what is my hope? Is it not the Lord ? And my substance is with you.
text_la: Et nunc quæ est exspectatio mea : nonne Dominus? et substantia mea apud te est.
text_pt: Estou fraco e mui quebrantado; tenho rugido pela inquietação do meu coração.
text_el: καὶ νῦν τίς ἡ ὑπομονή μου οὐχὶ ὁ κύριος καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασίς μου παρὰ σοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: Deliver me from all my iniquities : you have made me a reproach to the fool.
text_la: Ab omnibus iniquitatibus meis erue me : opprobrium insipienti dedisti me.
text_pt: Senhor, diante de ti está todo o meu desejo, e o meu gemido não te é oculto.
text_el: ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν μου ῥῦσαί με ὄνειδος ἄφρονι ἔδωκάς με

text_en: I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because you have done it.
text_la: Obmutui, et non aperui os meum, quoniam tu fecisti;
text_pt: O meu coração dá voltas, a minha força me falta; quanto à luz dos meus olhos, ela me deixou.
text_el: ἐκωφώθην καὶ οὐκ ἤνοιξα τὸ στόμα μου ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ποιήσας με

text_en: Remove your scourges from me. The strength of your hand has made me faint in rebukes:
text_la: amove a me plagas tuas.
text_pt: Os meus amigos e os meus companheiros estão ao longe da minha chaga; e os meus parentes se põem à distância.
text_el: ἀπόστησον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὰς μάστιγάς σου ἀπὸ τῆς ἰσχύος τῆς χειρός σου ἐγὼ ἐξέλιπον

text_en: You have corrected man for iniquity . And you have made his soul to waste away like a spider: surely in vain is any man disquieted.
text_la: A fortitudine manus tuæ ego defeci in increpationibus : propter iniquitatem corripuisti hominem. Et tabescere fecisti sicut araneam animam ejus : verumtamen vane conturbatur omnis homo.
text_pt: Também os que buscam a minha vida me armam laços e os que procuram o meu mal falam coisas que danificam, e imaginam astúcias todo o dia.
text_el: ἐν ἐλεγμοῖς ὑπὲρ ἀνομίας ἐπαίδευσας ἄνθρωπον καὶ ἐξέτηξας ὡς ἀράχνην τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ πλὴν μάτην ταράσσεται πᾶς ἄνθρωπος διάψαλμα

text_en: Hear my prayer , O Lord , and my supplication: give ear to my tears. Be no silent: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner as all my fathers were.
text_la: Exaudi orationem meam, Domine, et deprecationem meam; auribus percipe lacrimas meas. Ne sileas, quoniam advena ego sum apud te, et peregrinus sicut omnes patres mei.
text_pt: Mas eu, como surdo, não ouvia, e era como mudo, que não abre a boca.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου κύριε καὶ τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐνώτισαι τῶν δακρύων μου μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς ὅτι πάροικος ἐγώ εἰμι παρὰ σοὶ καὶ παρεπίδημος καθὼς πάντες οἱ πατέρες μου

text_en: O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, and be no more.
text_la: Remitte mihi, ut refrigerer priusquam abeam et amplius non ero.
text_pt: Assim eu sou como homem que não ouve, e em cuja boca não há reprovação.
text_el: ἄνες μοι ἵνα ἀναψύξω πρὸ τοῦ με ἀπελθεῖν καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ ὑπάρξω

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David himself.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus ipsi David.
text_pt: Eu disse: Guardarei os meus caminhos para não pecar com a minha língua; guardarei a boca com um freio, enquanto o ímpio estiver diante de mim.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ Δαυιδ ψαλμός

text_en: With expectation I have waited for the Lord , and he was attentive to me.
text_la: Exspectans exspectavi Dominum, et intendit mihi.
text_pt: Com o silêncio fiquei mudo; calava-me mesmo acerca do bem, e a minha dor se agravou.
text_el: ὑπομένων ὑπέμεινα τὸν κύριον καὶ προσέσχεν μοι καὶ εἰσήκουσεν τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: And he heard my prayers , and brought me out of the pit of misery and the mire of dregs. And he set my feet upon a rock, and directed my steps.
text_la: Et exaudivit preces meas, et eduxit me de lacu miseriæ et de luto fæcis. Et statuit super petram pedes meos, et direxit gressus meos.
text_pt: Esquentou-se-me o coração dentro de mim; enquanto eu meditava se acendeu um fogo; então falei com a minha língua:
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγαγέν με ἐκ λάκκου ταλαιπωρίας καὶ ἀπὸ πηλοῦ ἰλύος καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ πέτραν τοὺς πόδας μου καὶ κατηύθυνεν τὰ διαβήματά μου

text_en: And he put a new canticle into my mouth, a song to our God . Many shall see, and shall fear: and they shall hope in the Lord .
text_la: Et immisit in os meum canticum novum, carmen Deo nostro. Videbunt multi, et timebunt, et sperabunt in Domino.
text_pt: Faze-me conhecer, Senhor, o meu fim, e a medida dos meus dias qual é, para que eu sinta quanto sou frágil.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέβαλεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου ᾆσμα καινόν ὕμνον τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ὄψονται πολλοὶ καὶ φοβηθήσονται καὶ ἐλπιοῦσιν ἐπὶ κύριον

text_en: Blessed is the man whose trust is in the name of the Lord ; and who has not had regard to vanities, and lying follies.
text_la: Beatus vir cujus est nomen Domini spes ejus, et non respexit in vanitates et insanias falsas.
text_pt: Eis que fizeste os meus dias como a palmos; o tempo da minha vida é como nada diante de ti; na verdade, todo homem, por mais firme que esteja, é totalmente vaidade. (Selá.)
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ οὗ ἐστιν τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἐλπὶς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐνέβλεψεν εἰς ματαιότητας καὶ μανίας ψευδεῖς

text_en: You have multiplied your wonderful works, O Lord my God : and in your thoughts there is no one like to you. I have declared and I have spoken they are multiplied above number.
text_la: Multa fecisti tu, Domine Deus meus, mirabilia tua; et cogitationibus tuis non est qui similis sit tibi. Annuntiavi et locutus sum : multiplicati sunt super numerum.
text_pt: Na verdade, todo homem anda numa và aparência; na verdade, em vão se inquietam; amontoam riquezas, e não sabem quem as levará.
text_el: πολλὰ ἐποίησας σύ κύριε ὁ θεός μου τὰ θαυμάσιά σου καὶ τοῖς διαλογισμοῖς σου οὐκ ἔστιν τίς ὁμοιωθήσεταί σοι ἀπήγγειλα καὶ ἐλάλησα ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ ἀριθμόν

text_en: Sacrifice and oblation you did not desire; but you have pierced ears for me. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not require:
text_la: Sacrificium et oblationem noluisti; aures autem perfecisti mihi. Holocaustum et pro peccato non postulasti;
text_pt: Agora, pois, Senhor, que espero eu? A minha esperança está em ti.
text_el: θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας ὠτία δὲ κατηρτίσω μοι ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ᾔτησας

text_en: Then said I, Behold I come. In the head of the book it is written of me
text_la: tunc dixi : Ecce venio. In capite libri scriptum est de me,
text_pt: Livra-me de todas as minhas transgressões; não me faças o opróbrio dos loucos.
text_el: τότε εἶπον ἰδοὺ ἥκω ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ

text_en: that I should do your will: O my God , I have desired it, and your law in the midst of my heart.
text_la: ut facerem voluntatem tuam. Deus meus, volui, et legem tuam in medio cordis mei.
text_pt: Emudeci; não abro a minha boca, porquanto tu o fizeste.
text_el: τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου ὁ θεός μου ἐβουλήθην καὶ τὸν νόμον σου ἐν μέσῳ τῆς κοιλίας μου

text_en: I have declared your justice in a great church, lo, I will not restrain my lips: O Lord , you know it.
text_la: Annuntiavi justitiam tuam in ecclesia magna; ecce labia mea non prohibebo : Domine, tu scisti.
text_pt: Tira de sobre mim a tua praga; estou desfalecido pelo golpe da tua mão.
text_el: εὐηγγελισάμην δικαιοσύνην ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ μεγάλῃ ἰδοὺ τὰ χείλη μου οὐ μὴ κωλύσω κύριε σὺ ἔγνως

text_en: I have not hid your justice within my heart: I have declared your truth and your salvation . I have not concealed your mercy and your truth from a great council.
text_la: Justitiam tuam non abscondi in corde meo; veritatem tuam et salutare tuum dixi; non abscondi misericordiam tuam et veritatem tuam a concilio multo.
text_pt: Quando castigas o homem, com repreensões por causa da iniqüidade, fazes com que a sua beleza se consuma como a traça; assim todo homem é vaidade. (Selá.)
text_el: τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου οὐκ ἔκρυψα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου εἶπα οὐκ ἔκρυψα τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἀπὸ συναγωγῆς πολλῆς

text_en: Withhold not, O Lord , your tender mercies from me: your mercy and your truth have always upheld me.
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, ne longe facias miserationes tuas a me; misericordia tua et veritas tua semper susceperunt me.
text_pt: Ouve, Senhor, a minha oração, e inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor; não te cales perante as minhas lágrimas, porque sou um estrangeiro contigo e peregrino, como todos os meus pais.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε μὴ μακρύνης τοὺς οἰκτιρμούς σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά σου διὰ παντὸς ἀντελάβοντό μου

text_en: For evils without number have surrounded me; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I was not able to see. They are multiplied above the hairs of my head: and my heart has forsaken me.
text_la: Quoniam circumdederunt me mala quorum non est numerus; comprehenderunt me iniquitates meæ, et non potui ut viderem. Multiplicatæ sunt super capillos capitis mei, et cor meum dereliquit me.
text_pt: Poupa-me, até que tome alento, antes que me vá, e não seja mais.
text_el: ὅτι περιέσχον με κακά ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός κατέλαβόν με αἱ ἀνομίαι μου καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθην τοῦ βλέπειν ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ τὰς τρίχας τῆς κεφαλῆς μου καὶ ἡ καρδία μου ἐγκατέλιπέν με

text_en: Be pleased, O Lord , to deliver me. Look down, O Lord , to help me.
text_la: Complaceat tibi, Domine, ut eruas me; Domine, ad adjuvandum me respice.
text_el: εὐδόκησον κύριε τοῦ ῥύσασθαί με κύριε εἰς τὸ βοηθῆσαί μοι πρόσχες

text_en: Let them be confounded and ashamed together, that seek after my soul to take it away. Let them be turned backward and be ashamed that desire evils to me.
text_la: Confundantur et revereantur simul, qui quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam; convertantur retrorsum et revereantur, qui volunt mihi mala.
text_el: καταισχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν ἅμα οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχήν μου τοῦ ἐξᾶραι αὐτήν ἀποστραφείησαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἐντραπείησαν οἱ θέλοντές μοι κακά

text_en: Let them immediately bear their confusion, that say to me: 'T is well, 't is well.
text_la: Ferant confestim confusionem suam, qui dicunt mihi : Euge, euge!
text_el: κομισάσθωσαν παραχρῆμα αἰσχύνην αὐτῶν οἱ λέγοντές μοι εὖγε εὖγε

text_en: Let all that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: and let such as love your salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.
text_la: Exsultent et lætentur super te omnes quærentes te; et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui diligunt salutare tuum.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσαιντο καὶ εὐφρανθείησαν ἐπὶ σοὶ πάντες οἱ ζητοῦντές σε κύριε καὶ εἰπάτωσαν διὰ παντός μεγαλυνθήτω ὁ κύριος οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ σωτήριόν σου

text_en: But I am a beggar and poor: the Lord is careful for me. You are my helper and my protector: O my God , be not slack.
text_la: Ego autem mendicus sum et pauper; Dominus sollicitus est mei. Adjutor meus et protector meus tu es; Deus meus, ne tardaveris.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ πτωχός εἰμι καὶ πένης κύριος φροντιεῖ μου βοηθός μου καὶ ὑπερασπιστής μου σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός μου μὴ χρονίσῃς

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David himself.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus ipsi David.
text_pt: Esperei com paciência no SENHOR, e ele se inclinou para mim, e ouviu o meu clamor.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Blessed is he that understands concerning the needy and the poor: the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.
text_la: Beatus qui intelligit super egenum et pauperem : in die mala liberabit eum Dominus.
text_pt: Tirou-me dum lago horrível, dum charco de lodo, pôs os meus pés sobre uma rocha, firmou os meus passos.
text_el: μακάριος ὁ συνίων ἐπὶ πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πονηρᾷ ῥύσεται αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος

text_en: The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.
text_la: Dominus conservet eum, et vivificet eum, et beatum faciat eum in terra, et non tradat eum in animam inimicorum ejus.
text_pt: E pôs um novo cântico na minha boca, um hino ao nosso Deus; muitos o verão, e temerão, e confiarão no Senhor.
text_el: κύριος διαφυλάξαι αὐτὸν καὶ ζήσαι αὐτὸν καὶ μακαρίσαι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ μὴ παραδῴη αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord help him on his bed of sorrow: you have turned all his couch in his sickness.
text_la: Dominus opem ferat illi super lectum doloris ejus; universum stratum ejus versasti in infirmitate ejus.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que põe no Senhor a sua confiança, e que não respeita os soberbos nem os que se desviam para a mentira.
text_el: κύριος βοηθήσαι αὐτῷ ἐπὶ κλίνης ὀδύνης αὐτοῦ ὅλην τὴν κοίτην αὐτοῦ ἔστρεψας ἐν τῇ ἀρρωστίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: I said: O Lord , be merciful to me: heal my soul , for I have sinned against you.
text_la: Ego dixi : Domine, miserere mei; sana animam meam, quia peccavi tibi.
text_pt: Muitas são, Senhor meu Deus, as maravilhas que tens operado para conosco, e os teus pensamentos não se podem contar diante de ti; se eu os quisera anunciar, e deles falar, são mais do que se podem contar.
text_el: ἐγὼ εἶπα κύριε ἐλέησόν με ἴασαι τὴν ψυχήν μου ὅτι ἥμαρτόν σοι

text_en: My enemies have spoken evils against me: when shall he die and his name perish?
text_la: Inimici mei dixerunt mala mihi : Quando morietur, et peribit nomen ejus?
text_pt: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste; os meus ouvidos abriste; holocausto e expiação pelo pecado não reclamaste.
text_el: οἱ ἐχθροί μου εἶπαν κακά μοι πότε ἀποθανεῖται καὶ ἀπολεῖται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And if he came in to see me, he spoke vain things: his heart gathered together iniquity to itself. He went out and spoke to the same purpose.
text_la: Et si ingrediebatur ut videret, vana loquebatur; cor ejus congregavit iniquitatem sibi. Egrediebatur foras et loquebatur.
text_pt: Então disse: Eis aqui venho; no rolo do livro de mim está escrito.
text_el: καὶ εἰ εἰσεπορεύετο τοῦ ἰδεῖν μάτην ἐλάλει ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ συνήγαγεν ἀνομίαν ἑαυτῷ ἐξεπορεύετο ἔξω καὶ ἐλάλει

text_en: All my enemies whispered together against me: they devised evils to me.
text_la: In idipsum adversum me susurrabant omnes inimici mei; adversum me cogitabant mala mihi.
text_pt: Deleito-me em fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus meu; sim, a tua lei está dentro do meu coração.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατ' ἐμοῦ ἐψιθύριζον πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου κατ' ἐμοῦ ἐλογίζοντο κακά μοι

text_en: They determined against me an unjust word: shall he that sleeps rise again no more?
text_la: Verbum iniquum constituerunt adversum me : Numquid qui dormit non adjiciet ut resurgat?
text_pt: Preguei a justiça na grande congregação; eis que não retive os meus lábios, Senhor, tu o sabes.
text_el: λόγον παράνομον κατέθεντο κατ' ἐμοῦ μὴ ὁ κοιμώμενος οὐχὶ προσθήσει τοῦ ἀναστῆναι

text_en: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has greatly supplanted me.
text_la: Etenim homo pacis meæ in quo speravi, qui edebat panes meos, magnificavit super me supplantationem.
text_pt: Não escondi a tua justiça dentro do meu coração; apregoei a tua fidelidade e a tua salvação. Não escondi da grande congregação a tua benignidade e a tua verdade.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς εἰρήνης μου ἐφ' ὃν ἤλπισα ὁ ἐσθίων ἄρτους μου ἐμεγάλυνεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ πτερνισμόν

text_en: But you, O Lord , have mercy on me, and raise my up again: and I will requite them.
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, miserere mei, et resuscita me; et retribuam eis.
text_pt: Não retires de mim, Senhor, as tuas misericórdias; guardem-me continuamente a tua benignidade e a tua verdade.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε ἐλέησόν με καὶ ἀνάστησόν με καὶ ἀνταποδώσω αὐτοῖς

text_en: By this I know, that you have had a good will for me: because my enemy shall not rejoice over me.
text_la: In hoc cognovi quoniam voluisti me, quoniam non gaudebit inimicus meus super me.
text_pt: Porque males sem número me têm rodeado; as minhas iniqüidades me prenderam de modo que não posso olhar para cima. São mais numerosas do que os cabelos da minha cabeça; assim desfalece o meu coração.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ ἔγνων ὅτι τεθέληκάς με ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἐπιχαρῇ ὁ ἐχθρός μου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: But you have upheld me by reason of my innocence: and have established me in your sight for ever.
text_la: Me autem propter innocentiam suscepisti; et confirmasti me in conspectu tuo in æternum.
text_pt: Digna-te, Senhor, livrar-me: Senhor, apressa-te em meu auxílio.
text_el: ἐμοῦ δὲ διὰ τὴν ἀκακίαν ἀντελάβου καὶ ἐβεβαίωσάς με ἐνώπιόν σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel from eternity to eternity. So be it. So be it.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël a sæculo et usque in sæculum. Fiat, fiat.
text_pt: Sejam à uma confundidos e envergonhados os que buscam a minha vida para destruí-la; tornem atrás e confundam-se os que me querem mal.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα γένοιτο γένοιτο

text_en: Unto the end, understanding for the sons of Core .
text_la: In finem. Intellectus filiis Core.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado é aquele que atende ao pobre; o SENHOR o livrará no dia do mal.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος εἰς σύνεσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε

text_en: As the hart pants after the fountains of water; so my soul pants after you, O God .
text_la: Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum, ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus.
text_pt: O Senhor o livrará, e o conservará em vida; será abençoado na terra, e tu não o entregarás à vontade de seus inimigos.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον ἐπιποθεῖ ἡ ἔλαφος ἐπὶ τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων οὕτως ἐπιποθεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου πρὸς σέ ὁ θεός

text_en: My soul has thirsted after the strong living God ; when shall I come and appear before the face of God ?
text_la: Sitivit anima mea ad Deum fortem, vivum; quando veniam, et apparebo ante faciem Dei?
text_pt: O Senhor o sustentará no leito da enfermidade; tu o restaurarás da sua cama de doença.
text_el: ἐδίψησεν ἡ ψυχή μου πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν ζῶντα πότε ἥξω καὶ ὀφθήσομαι τῷ προσώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: My tears have been my bread day and night, whilst it is said to me daily: Where is your God ?
text_la: Fuerunt mihi lacrimæ meæ panes die ac nocte, dum dicitur mihi quotidie : Ubi est Deus tuus?
text_pt: Dizia eu: Senhor, tem piedade de mim; sara a minha alma, porque pequei contra ti.
text_el: ἐγενήθη μοι τὰ δάκρυά μου ἄρτος ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαί μοι καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεός σου

text_en: These things I remembered, and poured out my soul in me: for I shall go over into the place of the wonderful tabernacle, even to the house of God : With the voice of joy and praise; the noise of one feasting.
text_la: Hæc recordatus sum, et effudi in me animam meam, quoniam transibo in locum tabernaculi admirabilis, usque ad domum Dei, in voce exsultationis et confessionis, sonus epulantis.
text_pt: Os meus inimigos falam mal de mim, dizendo: Quando morrerá ele, e perecerá o seu nome?
text_el: ταῦτα ἐμνήσθην καὶ ἐξέχεα ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὴν ψυχήν μου ὅτι διελεύσομαι ἐν τόπῳ σκηνῆς θαυμαστῆς ἕως τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν φωνῇ ἀγαλλιάσεως καὶ ἐξομολογήσεως ἤχου ἑορτάζοντος

text_en: Why are you sad, O my soul ? And why do you trouble me? Hope in God , for I will still give praise to him: the salvation of my countenance,
text_la: Quare tristis es, anima mea? et quare conturbas me? Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, salutare vultus mei,
text_pt: E, se algum deles vem me ver, fala coisas vãs; no seu coração amontoa a maldade; saindo para fora, é disso que fala.
text_el: ἵνα τί περίλυπος εἶ ψυχή καὶ ἵνα τί συνταράσσεις με ἔλπισον ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν ὅτι ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ σωτήριον τοῦ προσώπου μου ὁ θεός μου

text_en: and my God . My soul is troubled within my self: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from the little hill.
text_la: et Deus meus. Ad meipsum anima mea conturbata est : propterea memor ero tui de terra Jordanis et Hermoniim a monte modico.
text_pt: Todos os que me odeiam murmuram à uma contra mim; contra mim imaginam o mal, dizendo:
text_el: πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν ἡ ψυχή μου ἐταράχθη διὰ τοῦτο μνησθήσομαί σου ἐκ γῆς Ιορδάνου καὶ Ερμωνιιμ ἀπὸ ὄρους μικροῦ

text_en: Deep calls on deep , at the noise of your flood-gates. All your heights and your billows have passed over me.
text_la: Abyssus abyssum invocat, in voce cataractarum tuarum; omnia excelsa tua, et fluctus tui super me transierunt.
text_pt: Uma doença má se lhe tem apegado; e agora que está deitado, não se levantará mais.
