text_el: ἄβυσσος ἄβυσσον ἐπικαλεῖται εἰς φωνὴν τῶν καταρρακτῶν σου πάντες οἱ μετεωρισμοί σου καὶ τὰ κύματά σου ἐπ' ἐμὲ διῆλθον

text_en: In the daytime the Lord has commanded his mercy; and a canticle to him in the night. With me is prayer to the God of my life.
text_la: In die mandavit Dominus misericordiam suam, et nocte canticum ejus; apud me oratio Deo vitæ meæ.
text_pt: Até o meu próprio amigo íntimo, em quem eu tanto confiava, que comia do meu pão, levantou contra mim o seu calcanhar.
text_el: ἡμέρας ἐντελεῖται κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ νυκτὸς ᾠδὴ παρ' ἐμοί προσευχὴ τῷ θεῷ τῆς ζωῆς μου

text_en: I will say to God : You are my support. Why have you forgotten me? And why go I mourning, whilst my enemy afflicts me?
text_la: Dicam Deo : Susceptor meus es; quare oblitus es mei? et quare contristatus incedo, dum affligit me inimicus?
text_pt: Porém tu, Senhor, tem piedade de mim, e levanta-me, para que eu lhes dê o pago.
text_el: ἐρῶ τῷ θεῷ ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ διὰ τί μου ἐπελάθου ἵνα τί σκυθρωπάζων πορεύομαι ἐν τῷ ἐκθλίβειν τὸν ἐχθρόν μου

text_en: Whilst my bones are broken, my enemies who trouble me have reproached me; Whilst they say to me day be day: Where is your God ?
text_la: Dum confringuntur ossa mea, exprobraverunt mihi qui tribulant me inimici mei, dum dicunt mihi per singulos dies : Ubi est Deus tuus?
text_pt: Por isto conheço eu que tu me favoreces: que o meu inimigo não triunfa de mim.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καταθλάσαι τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ὠνείδισάν με οἱ θλίβοντές με ἐν τῷ λέγειν αὐτούς μοι καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεός σου

text_en: Why are you cast down, O my soul ? And why do you disquiet me? Hope in God , for I will still give praise to him: the salvation of my countenance, and my God .
text_la: Quare tristis es, anima mea? et quare conturbas me? Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, salutare vultus mei, et Deus meus.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, tu me sustentas na minha sinceridade, e me puseste diante da tua face para sempre.
text_el: ἵνα τί περίλυπος εἶ ψυχή καὶ ἵνα τί συνταράσσεις με ἔλπισον ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν ὅτι ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ προσώπου μου ὁ θεός μου

text_en: Judge me, O God , and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy : deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man .
text_la: Judica me, Deus, et discerne causam meam de gente non sancta : ab homine iniquo et doloso erue me.
text_pt: Assim como o cervo brama pelas correntes das águas, assim suspira a minha alma por ti, ó Deus!
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ κρῖνόν με ὁ θεός καὶ δίκασον τὴν δίκην μου ἐξ ἔθνους οὐχ ὁσίου ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἀδίκου καὶ δολίου ῥῦσαί με

text_en: For you are God my strength: why have you cast me off? And why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicts me?
text_la: Quia tu es, Deus, fortitudo mea : quare me repulisti? et quare tristis incedo, dum affligit me inimicus?
text_pt: A minha alma tem sede de Deus, do Deus vivo; quando entrarei e me apresentarei ante a face de Deus?
text_el: ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός κραταίωμά μου ἵνα τί ἀπώσω με καὶ ἵνα τί σκυθρωπάζων πορεύομαι ἐν τῷ ἐκθλίβειν τὸν ἐχθρόν μου

text_en: Send forth your light and your truth : they have conducted me, and brought me unto your holy hill, and into your tabernacles.
text_la: Emitte lucem tuam et veritatem tuam : ipsa me deduxerunt, et adduxerunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernacula tua.
text_pt: As minhas lágrimas servem-me de mantimento de dia e de noite, enquanto me dizem constantemente: Onde está o teu Deus?
text_el: ἐξαπόστειλον τὸ φῶς σου καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου αὐτά με ὡδήγησαν καὶ ἤγαγόν με εἰς ὄρος ἅγιόν σου καὶ εἰς τὰ σκηνώματά σου

text_en: And I will go in to the altar of God : to God who gives joy to my youth.
text_la: Et introibo ad altare Dei, ad Deum qui lætificat juventutem meam.
text_pt: Quando me lembro disto, dentro de mim derramo a minha alma; pois eu havia ido com a multidão. Fui com eles à casa de Deus, com voz de alegria e louvor, com a multidão que festejava.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν εὐφραίνοντα τὴν νεότητά μου ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν κιθάρᾳ ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου

text_en: To you, O God my God , I will give praise upon the harp: why are you sad, O my soul ? And why do you disquiet me?
text_la: Confitebor tibi in cithara, Deus, Deus meus. Quare tristis es, anima mea? et quare conturbas me?
text_pt: Por que estás abatida, ó minha alma, e por que te perturbas em mim? Espera em Deus, pois ainda o louvarei pela salvação da sua face.
text_el: ἵνα τί περίλυπος εἶ ψυχή καὶ ἵνα τί συνταράσσεις με

text_en: Hope in God , for I will still give praise to him: the salvation of my countenance, and my God .
text_la: Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, salutare vultus mei, et Deus meus.
text_pt: Ó meu Deus, dentro de mim a minha alma está abatida; por isso lembro-me de ti desde a terra do Jordão, e desde os hermonitas, desde o pequeno monte.
text_el: ἔλπισον ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν ὅτι ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ σωτήριον τοῦ προσώπου μου ὁ θεός μου

text_en: Unto the end, for the sons of Core , to give understanding.
text_la: In finem. Filiis Core ad intellectum.
text_pt: Faze-me justiça, ó Deus, e pleiteia a minha causa contra a nação ímpia. Livra-me do homem fraudulento e injusto.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε εἰς σύνεσιν ψαλμός

text_en: We have heard, O God , with our ears: our fathers have declared to us, The work you have wrought in their days, and in the days of old.
text_la: Deus, auribus nostris audivimus, patres nostri annuntiaverunt nobis, opus quod operatus es in diebus eorum, et in diebus antiquis.
text_pt: Pois tu és o Deus da minha fortaleza; por que me rejeitas? Por que ando lamentando por causa da opressão do inimigo?
text_el: ὁ θεός ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ἡμῶν ἠκούσαμεν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀνήγγειλαν ἡμῖν ἔργον ὃ εἰργάσω ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέραις ἀρχαίαις

text_en: Your hand destroyed the Gentiles , and you planted them: you afflicted the people and casted them out.
text_la: Manus tua gentes disperdidit, et plantasti eos; afflixisti populos, et expulisti eos.
text_pt: Envia a tua luz e a tua verdade, para que me guiem e me levem ao teu santo monte, e aos teus tabernáculos.
text_el: ἡ χείρ σου ἔθνη ἐξωλέθρευσεν καὶ κατεφύτευσας αὐτούς ἐκάκωσας λαοὺς καὶ ἐξέβαλες αὐτούς

text_en: For they got not the possession of the land by their own sword: neither did their own arm save them. But your right hand and your arm, and the light of your countenance: because you were pleased with them.
text_la: Nec enim in gladio suo possederunt terram, et brachium eorum non salvavit eos : sed dextera tua et brachium tuum, et illuminatio vultus tui, quoniam complacuisti in eis.
text_pt: Então irei ao altar de Deus, a Deus, que é a minha grande alegria, e com harpa te louvarei, ó Deus, Deus meu.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐκληρονόμησαν γῆν καὶ ὁ βραχίων αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔσωσεν αὐτούς ἀλλ' ἡ δεξιά σου καὶ ὁ βραχίων σου καὶ ὁ φωτισμὸς τοῦ προσώπου σου ὅτι εὐδόκησας ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: You are yourself my king and my God , who commands the saving of Jacob .
text_la: Tu es ipse rex meus et Deus meus, qui mandas salutes Jacob.
text_pt: Por que estás abatida, ó minha alma? E por que te perturbas dentro de mim? Espera em Deus, pois ainda o louvarei, o qual é a salvação da minha face e Deus meu.
text_el: σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου ὁ ἐντελλόμενος τὰς σωτηρίας Ιακωβ

text_en: Through you we will push down our enemies with the horn: and through your name we will despise them that rise up against us.
text_la: In te inimicos nostros ventilabimus cornu, et in nomine tuo spernemus insurgentes in nobis.
text_el: ἐν σοὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν κερατιοῦμεν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐξουθενώσομεν τοὺς ἐπανιστανομένους ἡμῖν

text_en: For I will not trust in my bow: neither shall my sword save me.
text_la: Non enim in arcu meo sperabo, et gladius meus non salvabit me:
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἐπὶ τῷ τόξῳ μου ἐλπιῶ καὶ ἡ ῥομφαία μου οὐ σώσει με

text_en: But you have saved us from them that afflict us: and have put them to shame that hate us.
text_la: salvasti enim nos de affligentibus nos, et odientes nos confudisti.
text_el: ἔσωσας γὰρ ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν θλιβόντων ἡμᾶς καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντας ἡμᾶς κατῄσχυνας

text_en: In God shall we glory all the day long: and in your name we will give praise for ever.
text_la: In Deo laudabimur tota die, et in nomine tuo confitebimur in sæculum.
text_el: ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἐπαινεσθησόμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐξομολογησόμεθα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διάψαλμα

text_en: But now you have cast us off, and put us to shame: and you, O God , will not go out with our armies.
text_la: Nunc autem repulisti et confudisti nos, et non egredieris, Deus, in virtutibus nostris.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπώσω καὶ κατῄσχυνας ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: You have made us turn our back to our enemies: and they that hated us plundered for themselves.
text_la: Avertisti nos retrorsum post inimicos nostros, et qui oderunt nos diripiebant sibi.
text_el: ἀπέστρεψας ἡμᾶς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω παρὰ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ μισοῦντες ἡμᾶς διήρπαζον ἑαυτοῖς

text_en: You have given us up like sheep to be eaten: you have scattered us among the nations.
text_la: Dedisti nos tamquam oves escarum, et in gentibus dispersisti nos.
text_el: ἔδωκας ἡμᾶς ὡς πρόβατα βρώσεως καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν διέσπειρας ἡμᾶς

text_en: You have sold your people for no price: and there was no reckoning in the exchange of them.
text_la: Vendidisti populum tuum sine pretio, et non fuit multitudo in commutationibus eorum.
text_el: ἀπέδου τὸν λαόν σου ἄνευ τιμῆς καὶ οὐκ ἦν πλῆθος ἐν τοῖς ἀλλάγμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: You have made us a reproach to our neighbours, a scoff and derision to them that are round about us.
text_la: Posuisti nos opprobrium vicinis nostris; subsannationem et derisum his qui sunt in circuitu nostro.
text_el: ἔθου ἡμᾶς ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν μυκτηρισμὸν καὶ καταγέλωτα τοῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν

text_en: You have made us a byword among the Gentiles : a shaking of the head among the people.
text_la: Posuisti nos in similitudinem gentibus; commotionem capitis in populis.
text_el: ἔθου ἡμᾶς εἰς παραβολὴν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν κίνησιν κεφαλῆς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς

text_en: All the day long my shame is before me: and the confusion of my face has covered me,
text_la: Tota die verecundia mea contra me est, et confusio faciei meæ cooperuit me:
text_el: ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἡ ἐντροπή μου κατεναντίον μού ἐστιν καὶ ἡ αἰσχύνη τοῦ προσώπου μου ἐκάλυψέν με

text_en: at the voice of him that reproaches and detracts me: at the face of the enemy and persecutor.
text_la: a voce exprobrantis et obloquentis, a facie inimici et persequentis.
text_el: ἀπὸ φωνῆς ὀνειδίζοντος καὶ παραλαλοῦντος ἀπὸ προσώπου ἐχθροῦ καὶ ἐκδιώκοντος

text_en: All these things have come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you: and we have not done wickedly in your covenant.
text_la: Hæc omnia venerunt super nos; nec obliti sumus te, et inique non egimus in testamento tuo.
text_el: ταῦτα πάντα ἦλθεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἐπελαθόμεθά σου καὶ οὐκ ἠδικήσαμεν ἐν διαθήκῃ σου

text_en: And our heart has not turned back: neither have you turned aside our steps from your way.
text_la: Et non recessit retro cor nostrum; et declinasti semitas nostras a via tua:
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν καὶ ἐξέκλινας τὰς τρίβους ἡμῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ σου

text_en: For you have humbled us in the place of affliction: and the shadow of death has covered us.
text_la: quoniam humiliasti nos in loco afflictionis, et cooperuit nos umbra mortis.
text_el: ὅτι ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς ἐν τόπῳ κακώσεως καὶ ἐπεκάλυψεν ἡμᾶς σκιὰ θανάτου

text_en: If we have forgotten the name of our God , and if we have spread forth our hands to a strange god:
text_la: Si obliti sumus nomen Dei nostri, et si expandimus manus nostras ad deum alienum,
text_el: εἰ ἐπελαθόμεθα τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ εἰ διεπετάσαμεν χεῖρας ἡμῶν πρὸς θεὸν ἀλλότριον

text_en: Shall not God search out these things: for he knows the secrets of the heart.
text_la: nonne Deus requiret ista? ipse enim novit abscondita cordis.
text_el: οὐχὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐκζητήσει ταῦτα αὐτὸς γὰρ γινώσκει τὰ κρύφια τῆς καρδίας

text_en: Because for your sake we are killed all the day long: we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
text_la: Quoniam propter te mortificamur tota die; æstimati sumus sicut oves occisionis.
text_el: ὅτι ἕνεκα σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς

text_en: Arise, why are you sleeping, O Lord ? Arise, and cast us not off to the end.
text_la: Exsurge; quare obdormis, Domine? exsurge, et ne repellas in finem.
text_el: ἐξεγέρθητι ἵνα τί ὑπνοῖς κύριε ἀνάστηθι καὶ μὴ ἀπώσῃ εἰς τέλος

text_en: Why do you turn your face away? And forget our want and our trouble?
text_la: Quare faciem tuam avertis? oblivisceris inopiæ nostræ et tribulationis nostræ?
text_el: ἵνα τί τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀποστρέφεις ἐπιλανθάνῃ τῆς πτωχείας ἡμῶν καὶ τῆς θλίψεως ἡμῶν

text_en: For our soul is humbled down to the dust: our belly cleaves to the earth.
text_la: Quoniam humiliata est in pulvere anima nostra; conglutinatus est in terra venter noster.
text_el: ὅτι ἐταπεινώθη εἰς χοῦν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ἐκολλήθη εἰς γῆν ἡ γαστὴρ ἡμῶν

text_en: Arise, O Lord , help us and redeem us for your name's sake.
text_la: Exsurge, Domine, adjuva nos, et redime nos propter nomen tuum.
text_el: ἀνάστα κύριε βοήθησον ἡμῖν καὶ λύτρωσαι ἡμᾶς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου

text_en: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed, for the sons of Core , for understanding. A canticle for the Beloved .
text_la: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. Filiis Core, ad intellectum. Canticum pro dilecto.
text_pt: Ó Deus, nós ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos, e nossos pais nos têm contado a obra que fizeste em seus dias, nos tempos da antiguidade.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀλλοιωθησομένων τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε εἰς σύνεσιν ᾠδὴ ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ

text_en: My heart has uttered a good word: I speak my works to the king: My tongue is the pen of a scrivener that writes swiftly.
text_la: Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum : dico ego opera mea regi. Lingua mea calamus scribæ velociter scribentis.
text_pt: Como expulsaste os gentios com a tua mão e os plantaste a eles; como afligiste os povos e os derrubaste.
text_el: ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου λόγον ἀγαθόν λέγω ἐγὼ τὰ ἔργα μου τῷ βασιλεῖ ἡ γλῶσσά μου κάλαμος γραμματέως ὀξυγράφου

text_en: You are beautiful above the sons of men : grace is poured abroad in your lips; therefore has God blessed you for ever.
text_la: Speciosus forma præ filiis hominum, diffusa est gratia in labiis tuis : propterea benedixit te Deus in æternum.
text_pt: Pois não conquistaram a terra pela sua espada, nem o seu braço os salvou, mas a tua destra e o teu braço, e a luz da tua face, porquanto te agradaste deles.
text_el: ὡραῖος κάλλει παρὰ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐξεχύθη χάρις ἐν χείλεσίν σου διὰ τοῦτο εὐλόγησέν σε ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Gird your sword upon your thigh, O you most mighty.
text_la: Accingere gladio tuo super femur tuum, potentissime.
text_pt: Tu és o meu Rei, ó Deus; ordena salvações para Jacó.
text_el: περίζωσαι τὴν ῥομφαίαν σου ἐπὶ τὸν μηρόν σου δυνατέ τῇ ὡραιότητί σου καὶ τῷ κάλλει σου

text_en: With your comeliness and your beauty set out, proceed prosperously, and reign. Because of truth and meekness and justice : and your right hand shall conduct you wonderfully.
text_la: Specie tua et pulchritudine tua intende, prospere procede, et regna, propter veritatem, et mansuetudinem, et justitiam; et deducet te mirabiliter dextera tua.
text_pt: Por ti venceremos os nossos inimigos; pelo teu nome pisaremos os que se levantam contra nós.
text_el: καὶ ἔντεινον καὶ κατευοδοῦ καὶ βασίλευε ἕνεκεν ἀληθείας καὶ πραΰτητος καὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ ὁδηγήσει σε θαυμαστῶς ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: Your arrows are sharp: under you shall people fall, into the hearts of the king's enemies.
text_la: Sagittæ tuæ acutæ : populi sub te cadent, in corda inimicorum regis.
text_pt: Pois eu não confiarei no meu arco, nem a minha espada me salvará.
text_el: τὰ βέλη σου ἠκονημένα δυνατέ λαοὶ ὑποκάτω σου πεσοῦνται ἐν καρδίᾳ τῶν ἐχθρῶν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: Your throne, O God , is forever and ever: the sceptre of your kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness.
text_la: Sedes tua, Deus, in sæculum sæculi; virga directionis virga regni tui.
text_pt: Mas tu nos salvaste dos nossos inimigos, e confundiste os que nos odiavam.
text_el: ὁ θρόνος σου ὁ θεός εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος ῥάβδος εὐθύτητος ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας σου

text_en: You have loved justice , and hated iniquity : therefore God , your God , has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
text_la: Dilexisti justitiam, et odisti iniquitatem; propterea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, oleo lætitiæ, præ consortibus tuis.
text_pt: Em Deus nos gloriamos todo o dia, e louvamos o teu nome eternamente. (Selá.)
text_el: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός σου ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου

text_en: Myrrh and stacte and cassia perfume your garments, from the ivory houses: out of which
text_la: Myrrha, et gutta, et casia a vestimentis tuis, a domibus eburneis; ex quibus delectaverunt te
text_pt: Mas agora tu nos rejeitaste e nos confundiste, e não sais com os nossos exércitos.
text_el: σμύρνα καὶ στακτὴ καὶ κασία ἀπὸ τῶν ἱματίων σου ἀπὸ βάρεων ἐλεφαντίνων ἐξ ὧν ηὔφρανάν σε

text_en: the daughters of kings have delighted you in your glory . The queen stood on your right hand, in gilded clothing; surrounded with variety.
text_la: filiæ regum in honore tuo. Astitit regina a dextris tuis in vestitu deaurato, circumdata varietate.
text_pt: Tu nos fazes retirar do inimigo, e aqueles que nos odeiam nos saqueiam para si.
text_el: θυγατέρες βασιλέων ἐν τῇ τιμῇ σου παρέστη ἡ βασίλισσα ἐκ δεξιῶν σου ἐν ἱματισμῷ διαχρύσῳ περιβεβλημένη πεποικιλμένη

text_en: Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear: and forget your people and your father's house.
text_la: Audi, filia, et vide, et inclina aurem tuam; et obliviscere populum tuum, et domum patris tui.
text_pt: Tu nos entregaste como ovelhas para comer, e nos espalhaste entre os gentios.
text_el: ἄκουσον θύγατερ καὶ ἰδὲ καὶ κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου καὶ ἐπιλάθου τοῦ λαοῦ σου καὶ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός σου

text_en: And the king shall greatly desire your beauty; for he is the Lord your God , and him they shall adore .
text_la: Et concupiscet rex decorem tuum, quoniam ipse est Dominus Deus tuus, et adorabunt eum.
text_pt: Tu vendes por nada o teu povo, e não aumentas a tua riqueza com o seu preço.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπεθύμησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῦ κάλλους σου ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ κύριός σου

text_en: And the daughters of Tyre with gifts, yea, all the rich among the people, shall entreat your countenance.
text_la: Et filiæ Tyri in muneribus vultum tuum deprecabuntur; omnes divites plebis.
text_pt: Tu nos pões por opróbrio aos nossos vizinhos, por escárnio e zombaria daqueles que estão à roda de nós.
text_el: καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτῷ θυγατέρες Τύρου ἐν δώροις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου λιτανεύσουσιν οἱ πλούσιοι τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: All the glory of the king's daughter is within in golden borders,
text_la: Omnis gloria ejus filiæ regis ab intus, in fimbriis aureis,
text_pt: Tu nos pões por provérbio entre os gentios, por movimento de cabeça entre os povos.
text_el: πᾶσα ἡ δόξα αὐτῆς θυγατρὸς βασιλέως ἔσωθεν ἐν κροσσωτοῖς χρυσοῖς περιβεβλημένη πεποικιλμένη

text_en: clothed round about with varieties. After her shall virgins be brought to the king: her neighbours shall be brought to you.
text_la: circumamicta varietatibus. Adducentur regi virgines post eam; proximæ ejus afferentur tibi.
text_pt: A minha confusão está constantemente diante de mim, e a vergonha do meu rosto me cobre,
text_el: ἀπενεχθήσονται τῷ βασιλεῖ παρθένοι ὀπίσω αὐτῆς αἱ πλησίον αὐτῆς ἀπενεχθήσονταί σοι

text_en: They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing : they shall be brought into the temple of the king.
text_la: Afferentur in lætitia et exsultatione; adducentur in templum regis.
text_pt: À voz daquele que afronta e blasfema, por causa do inimigo e do vingador.
text_el: ἀπενεχθήσονται ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσει ἀχθήσονται εἰς ναὸν βασιλέως

text_en: Instead of your fathers, sons are born to you: you shall make them princes over all the earth.
text_la: Pro patribus tuis nati sunt tibi filii; constitues eos principes super omnem terram.
text_pt: Tudo isto nos sobreveio; contudo não nos esquecemos de ti, nem nos houvemos falsamente contra a tua aliança.
text_el: ἀντὶ τῶν πατέρων σου ἐγενήθησάν σοι υἱοί καταστήσεις αὐτοὺς ἄρχοντας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: They shall remember your name throughout all generations . Therefore shall people praise you for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
text_la: Memores erunt nominis tui in omni generatione et generationem : propterea populi confitebuntur tibi in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: O nosso coração não voltou atrás, nem os nossos passos se desviaram das tuas veredas;
text_el: μνησθήσονται τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ἐν πάσῃ γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ διὰ τοῦτο λαοὶ ἐξομολογήσονταί σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Unto the end, for the sons of Core , for the hidden.
text_la: In finem, filiis Core, pro arcanis. Psalmus.
text_pt: O meu coração ferve com palavras boas, falo do que tenho feito no tocante ao Rei. A minha língua é a pena de um destro escritor.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν υἱῶν Κορε ὑπὲρ τῶν κρυφίων ψαλμός

text_en: Our God is our refuge and strength: a helper in troubles, which have found us exceedingly.
text_la: Deus noster refugium et virtus; adjutor in tribulationibus quæ invenerunt nos nimis.
text_pt: Tu és mais formoso do que os filhos dos homens; a graça se derramou em teus lábios; por isso Deus te abençoou para sempre.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καταφυγὴ καὶ δύναμις βοηθὸς ἐν θλίψεσιν ταῖς εὑρούσαις ἡμᾶς σφόδρα

text_en: Therefore we will not fear, when the earth shall be troubled; and the mountains shall be removed into the heart of the sea.
text_la: Propterea non timebimus dum turbabitur terra, et transferentur montes in cor maris.
text_pt: Cinge a tua espada à coxa, ó valente, com a tua glória e a tua majestade.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐ φοβηθησόμεθα ἐν τῷ ταράσσεσθαι τὴν γῆν καὶ μετατίθεσθαι ὄρη ἐν καρδίαις θαλασσῶν

text_en: Their waters roared and were troubled: the mountains were troubled with his strength.
text_la: Sonuerunt, et turbatæ sunt aquæ eorum; conturbati sunt montes in fortitudine ejus.
text_pt: E neste teu esplendor cavalga prosperamente, por causa da verdade, da mansidão e da justiça; e a tua destra te ensinará coisas terríveis.
text_el: ἤχησαν καὶ ἐταράχθησαν τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῶν ἐταράχθησαν τὰ ὄρη ἐν τῇ κραταιότητι αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: The stream of the river makes the city of God joyful: the most High has sanctified his own tabernacle .
text_la: Fluminis impetus lætificat civitatem Dei : sanctificavit tabernaculum suum Altissimus.
text_pt: As tuas flechas são agudas no coração dos inimigos do rei, e por elas os povos caíram debaixo de ti.
text_el: τοῦ ποταμοῦ τὰ ὁρμήματα εὐφραίνουσιν τὴν πόλιν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡγίασεν τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ ὁ ὕψιστος

text_en: God is in the midst thereof, it shall not be moved: God will help it in the morning early.
text_la: Deus in medio ejus, non commovebitur; adjuvabit eam Deus mane diluculo.
text_pt: O teu trono, ó Deus, é eterno e perpétuo; o cetro do teu reino é um cetro de eqüidade.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς οὐ σαλευθήσεται βοηθήσει αὐτῇ ὁ θεὸς τὸ πρὸς πρωί

text_en: Nations were troubled, and kingdoms were bowed down: he uttered his voice, the earth trembled.
text_la: Conturbatæ sunt gentes, et inclinata sunt regna : dedit vocem suam, mota est terra.
text_pt: Tu amas a justiça e odeias a impiedade; por isso Deus, o teu Deus, te ungiu com óleo de alegria mais do que a teus companheiros.
text_el: ἐταράχθησαν ἔθνη ἔκλιναν βασιλεῖαι ἔδωκεν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ

text_en: The Lord of armies is with us: the God of Jacob is our protector.
text_la: Dominus virtutum nobiscum; susceptor noster Deus Jacob.
text_pt: Todas as tuas vestes cheiram a mirra e aloés e cássia, desde os palácios de marfim de onde te alegram.
text_el: κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων μεθ' ἡμῶν ἀντιλήμπτωρ ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ διάψαλμα

text_en: Come and behold the works of the Lord : what wonders he has done upon earth,
text_la: Venite, et videte opera Domini, quæ posuit prodigia super terram,
text_pt: As filhas dos reis estavam entre as tuas ilustres mulheres; à tua direita estava a rainha ornada de finíssimo ouro de Ofir.
text_el: δεῦτε ἴδετε τὰ ἔργα κυρίου ἃ ἔθετο τέρατα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: making wars to cease even to the end of the earth. He shall destroy the bow, and break the weapons: and the shield he shall burn in the fire.
text_la: auferens bella usque ad finem terræ. Arcum conteret, et confringet arma, et scuta comburet igni.
text_pt: Ouve, filha, e olha, e inclina os teus ouvidos; esquece-te do teu povo e da casa do teu pai.
text_el: ἀνταναιρῶν πολέμους μέχρι τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς τόξον συντρίψει καὶ συγκλάσει ὅπλον καὶ θυρεοὺς κατακαύσει ἐν πυρί

text_en: Be still and see that I am God ; I will be exalted among the nations, and I will be exalted in the earth.
text_la: Vacate, et videte quoniam ego sum Deus; exaltabor in gentibus, et exaltabor in terra.
text_pt: Então o rei se afeiçoará da tua formosura, pois ele é teu Senhor; adora-o.
text_el: σχολάσατε καὶ γνῶτε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός ὑψωθήσομαι ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὑψωθήσομαι ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: The Lord of armies is with us: the God of Jacob is our protector.
text_la: Dominus virtutum nobiscum; susceptor noster Deus Jacob.
text_pt: E a filha de Tiro estará ali com presentes; os ricos do povo suplicarão o teu favor.
text_el: κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων μεθ' ἡμῶν ἀντιλήμπτωρ ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ

text_en: Unto the end, for the sons of Core .
text_la: In finem, pro filiis Core. Psalmus.
text_pt: Deus é o nosso refúgio e fortaleza, socorro bem presente na angústia.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν υἱῶν Κορε ψαλμός

text_en: O clap your hands, all you nations: shout unto God with the voice of joy ,
text_la: Omnes gentes, plaudite manibus; jubilate Deo in voce exsultationis:
text_pt: Portanto não temeremos, ainda que a terra se mude, e ainda que os montes se transportem para o meio dos mares.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ἔθνη κροτήσατε χεῖρας ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ ἐν φωνῇ ἀγαλλιάσεως

text_en: for the Lord is high, terrible: a great king over all the earth.
text_la: quoniam Dominus excelsus, terribilis, rex magnus super omnem terram.
text_pt: Ainda que as águas rujam e se perturbem, ainda que os montes se abalem pela sua braveza. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι κύριος ὕψιστος φοβερός βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: He has subdued the people under jus; and the nations under our feet.
text_la: Subjecit populos nobis, et gentes sub pedibus nostris.
text_pt: Há um rio cujas correntes alegram a cidade de Deus, o santuário das moradas do Altíssimo.
text_el: ὑπέταξεν λαοὺς ἡμῖν καὶ ἔθνη ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν

text_en: He has chosen for us his inheritance, the beauty of Jacob which he has love .
text_la: Elegit nobis hæreditatem suam; speciem Jacob quam dilexit.
text_pt: Deus está no meio dela; não se abalará. Deus a ajudará, já ao romper da manhã.
text_el: ἐξελέξατο ἡμῖν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ τὴν καλλονὴν Ιακωβ ἣν ἠγάπησεν διάψαλμα

text_en: God is ascended with jubilee, and the Lord with the sound of trumpet.
text_la: Ascendit Deus in jubilo, et Dominus in voce tubæ.
text_pt: Os gentios se embraveceram; os reinos se moveram; ele levantou a sua voz e a terra se derreteu.
text_el: ἀνέβη ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ κύριος ἐν φωνῇ σάλπιγγος

text_en: Sing praises to our God ; sing. Sing praises to our king; sing.
text_la: Psallite Deo nostro, psallite; psallite regi nostro, psallite:
text_pt: O Senhor dos Exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é o nosso refúgio. (Selá.)
text_el: ψάλατε τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ψάλατε ψάλατε τῷ βασιλεῖ ἡμῶν ψάλατε

text_en: For God is the king of all the earth: sing wisely.
text_la: quoniam rex omnis terræ Deus, psallite sapienter.
text_pt: Vinde, contemplai as obras do Senhor; que desolações tem feito na terra!
text_el: ὅτι βασιλεὺς πάσης τῆς γῆς ὁ θεός ψάλατε συνετῶς

text_en: God shall reign over the nations: God sits on his holy throne.
text_la: Regnabit Deus super gentes; Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.
text_pt: Ele faz cessar as guerras até ao fim da terra; quebra o arco e corta a lança; queima os carros no fogo.
text_el: ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ὁ θεὸς κάθηται ἐπὶ θρόνου ἁγίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: The princes of the people are gathered together, with the God of Abraham : for the strong gods of the earth are exceedingly exalted.
text_la: Principes populorum congregati sunt cum Deo Abraham, quoniam dii fortes terræ vehementer elevati sunt.
text_pt: Aquietai-vos, e sabei que eu sou Deus; serei exaltado entre os gentios; serei exaltado sobre a terra.
text_el: ἄρχοντες λαῶν συνήχθησαν μετὰ τοῦ θεοῦ Αβρααμ ὅτι τοῦ θεοῦ οἱ κραταιοὶ τῆς γῆς σφόδρα ἐπήρθησαν

text_en: A psalm of a canticle, for the sons of Core , on the second day of the week.
text_la: Psalmus cantici. Filiis Core, secunda sabbati.
text_pt: Batei palmas, todos os povos; aclamai a Deus com voz de triunfo.
text_el: ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε δευτέρᾳ σαββάτου

text_en: Great is the Lord , and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God , in his holy mountain.
text_la: Magnus Dominus et laudabilis nimis, in civitate Dei nostri, in monte sancto ejus.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor Altíssimo é tremendo, e Rei grande sobre toda a terra.
text_el: μέγας κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα ἐν πόλει τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ὄρει ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: With the joy of the whole earth is mount Sion founded, on the sides of the north, the city of the great king.
text_la: Fundatur exsultatione universæ terræ mons Sion; latera aquilonis, civitas regis magni.
text_pt: Ele nos subjugará os povos e as nações debaixo dos nossos pés.
text_el: εὖ ῥιζῶν ἀγαλλιάματι πάσης τῆς γῆς ὄρη Σιων τὰ πλευρὰ τοῦ βορρᾶ ἡ πόλις τοῦ βασιλέως τοῦ μεγάλου

text_en: In her houses shall God be known, when he shall protect her.
text_la: Deus in domibus ejus cognoscetur cum suscipiet eam.
text_pt: Escolherá para nós a nossa herança, a glória de Jacó, a quem amou. (Selá.)
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐν ταῖς βάρεσιν αὐτῆς γινώσκεται ὅταν ἀντιλαμβάνηται αὐτῆς

text_en: For behold the kings of the earth assembled themselves: they gathered together.
text_la: Quoniam ecce reges terræ congregati sunt; convenerunt in unum.
text_pt: Deus subiu com júbilo, o Senhor subiu ao som de trombeta.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ βασιλεῖς συνήχθησαν ἤλθοσαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: So they saw, and they wondered, they were troubled, they were moved:
text_la: Ipsi videntes, sic admirati sunt, conturbati sunt, commoti sunt.
text_pt: Cantai louvores a Deus, cantai louvores; cantai louvores ao nosso Rei, cantai louvores.
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἰδόντες οὕτως ἐθαύμασαν ἐταράχθησαν ἐσαλεύθησαν

text_en: Trembling took hold of them. There were pains as of a woman in labour.
text_la: Tremor apprehendit eos; ibi dolores ut parturientis:
text_pt: Pois Deus é o Rei de toda a terra, cantai louvores com inteligência.
text_el: τρόμος ἐπελάβετο αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: With a vehement wind you shall break in pieces the ships of Tharsis.
text_la: in spiritu vehementi conteres naves Tharsis.
text_pt: Deus reina sobre os gentios; Deus se assenta sobre o trono da sua santidade.
text_el: ἐν πνεύματι βιαίῳ συντρίψεις πλοῖα Θαρσις

text_en: As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts , in the city of our God : God has founded it for ever.
text_la: Sicut audivimus, sic vidimus, in civitate Domini virtutum, in civitate Dei nostri : Deus fundavit eam in æternum.
text_pt: Os príncipes do povo se ajuntam, o povo do Deus de Abraão; porque os escudos da terra são de Deus. Ele está muito elevado!
text_el: καθάπερ ἠκούσαμεν οὕτως εἴδομεν ἐν πόλει κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων ἐν πόλει τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διάψαλμα

text_en: We have received your mercy, O God , in the midst of your temple .
text_la: Suscepimus, Deus, misericordiam tuam in medio templi tui.
text_el: ὑπελάβομεν ὁ θεός τὸ ἔλεός σου ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ ναοῦ σου

text_en: According to your name , O God , so also is your praise unto the ends of the earth: your right hand is full of justice .
text_la: Secundum nomen tuum, Deus, sic et laus tua in fines terræ; justitia plena est dextera tua.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ ὄνομά σου ὁ θεός οὕτως καὶ ἡ αἴνεσίς σου ἐπὶ τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς δικαιοσύνης πλήρης ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: Let mount Sion rejoice, and the daughters of Juda be glad; because of your judgments, O Lord .
text_la: Lætetur mons Sion, et exsultent filiæ Judæ, propter judicia tua, Domine.
text_el: εὐφρανθήτω τὸ ὄρος Σιων ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν αἱ θυγατέρες τῆς Ιουδαίας ἕνεκεν τῶν κριμάτων σου κύριε

text_en: Surround Sion, and encompass her: tell lye in her towers.
text_la: Circumdate Sion, et complectimini eam; narrate in turribus ejus.
text_el: κυκλώσατε Σιων καὶ περιλάβετε αὐτήν διηγήσασθε ἐν τοῖς πύργοις αὐτῆς

text_en: Set your hearts on her strength; and distribute her houses, that you may relate it in another generation .
text_la: Ponite corda vestra in virtute ejus, et distribuite domos ejus, ut enarretis in progenie altera.
text_el: θέσθε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν δύναμιν αὐτῆς καὶ καταδιέλεσθε τὰς βάρεις αὐτῆς ὅπως ἂν διηγήσησθε εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν

text_en: For this is God , our God unto eternity, and for ever and ever: he shall rule us for evermore.
text_la: Quoniam hic est Deus, Deus noster in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi : ipse reget nos in sæcula.
text_el: ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος αὐτὸς ποιμανεῖ ἡμᾶς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for the sons of Core .
text_la: In finem, filiis Core. Psalmus.
text_pt: Grande é o SENHOR e mui digno de louvor, na cidade do nosso Deus, no seu monte santo.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε ψαλμός

text_en: Hear these things, all you nations: give ear, all you inhabitants of the world.
text_la: Audite hæc, omnes gentes; auribus percipite, omnes qui habitatis orbem:
text_pt: Formoso de sítio, e alegria de toda a terra é o monte Sião sobre os lados do norte, a cidade do grande Rei.
text_el: ἀκούσατε ταῦτα πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐνωτίσασθε πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν οἰκουμένην

text_en: All you that are earthborn, and you sons of men : both rich and poor together.
text_la: quique terrigenæ et filii hominum, simul in unum dives et pauper.
text_pt: Deus é conhecido nos seus palácios por um alto refúgio.
text_el: οἵ τε γηγενεῖς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ πλούσιος καὶ πένης

text_en: My mouth shall speak wisdom: and the meditation of my heart understanding.
text_la: Os meum loquetur sapientiam, et meditatio cordis mei prudentiam.
text_pt: Porque eis que os reis se ajuntaram; eles passaram juntos.
text_el: τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν καὶ ἡ μελέτη τῆς καρδίας μου σύνεσιν

text_en: I will incline my ear to a parable ; I will open my proposition on the psaltery.
text_la: Inclinabo in parabolam aurem meam; aperiam in psalterio propositionem meam.
text_pt: Viram-no e ficaram maravilhados; ficaram assombrados e se apressaram em fugir.
text_el: κλινῶ εἰς παραβολὴν τὸ οὖς μου ἀνοίξω ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ τὸ πρόβλημά μου

text_en: Why shall I fear in the evil day? The iniquity of my heel shall encompass me.
text_la: Cur timebo in die mala? iniquitas calcanei mei circumdabit me.
text_pt: Tremor ali os tomou, e dores como de mulher de parto.
text_el: ἵνα τί φοβοῦμαι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πονηρᾷ ἡ ἀνομία τῆς πτέρνης μου κυκλώσει με

text_en: They that trust in their own strength, and glory in the multitude of their riches,
text_la: Qui confidunt in virtute sua, et in multitudine divitiarum suarum, gloriantur.
text_pt: Tu quebras as naus de Társis com um vento oriental.
text_el: οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ τῇ δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ πλήθει τοῦ πλούτου αὐτῶν καυχώμενοι

text_en: no brother can redeem , nor shall man redeem : he shall not give to God his ransom,
text_la: Frater non redimit, redimet homo : non dabit Deo placationem suam,
text_pt: Como o ouvimos, assim o vimos na cidade do Senhor dos Exércitos, na cidade do nosso Deus. Deus a confirmará para sempre. (Selá.)
text_el: ἀδελφὸς οὐ λυτροῦται λυτρώσεται ἄνθρωπος οὐ δώσει τῷ θεῷ ἐξίλασμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: nor the price of the redemption of his soul : and shall labour for ever,
text_la: et pretium redemptionis animæ suæ. Et laborabit in æternum;
text_pt: Lembramo-nos, ó Deus, da tua benignidade, no meio do teu templo.
text_el: καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τῆς λυτρώσεως τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: and shall still live unto the end.
text_la: et vivet adhuc in finem.
text_pt: Segundo é o teu nome, ó Deus, assim é o teu louvor, até aos fins da terra; a tua mão direita está cheia de justiça.
text_el: καὶ ἐκόπασεν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ζήσεται εἰς τέλος ὅτι οὐκ ὄψεται καταφθοράν ὅταν ἴδῃ σοφοὺς ἀποθνῄσκοντας

text_en: He shall not see destruction, when he shall see the wise dying: the senseless and the fool shall perish together: And they shall leave their riches to strangers:
text_la: Non videbit interitum, cum viderit sapientes morientes : simul insipiens et stultus peribunt. Et relinquent alienis divitias suas,
text_pt: Alegre-se o monte de Sião; alegrem-se as filhas de Judá por causa dos teus juízos.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἄφρων καὶ ἄνους ἀπολοῦνται καὶ καταλείψουσιν ἀλλοτρίοις τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτῶν

text_en: And their sepulchres shall be their houses for ever. Their dwelling places to all generations : they have called their lands by their names .
text_la: et sepulchra eorum domus illorum in æternum; tabernacula eorum in progenie et progenie : vocaverunt nomina sua in terris suis.
text_pt: Rodeai Sião, e cercai-a, contai as suas torres.
text_el: καὶ οἱ τάφοι αὐτῶν οἰκίαι αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα σκηνώματα αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν ἐπεκαλέσαντο τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῶν γαιῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And man when he was in honour did not understand; he is compared to senseless beasts, and has become like to them.
text_la: Et homo, cum in honore esset, non intellexit. Comparatus est jumentis insipientibus, et similis factus est illis.
text_pt: Marcai bem os seus antemuros, considerai os seus palácios, para que o conteis à geração seguinte.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἐν τιμῇ ὢν οὐ συνῆκεν παρασυνεβλήθη τοῖς κτήνεσιν τοῖς ἀνοήτοις καὶ ὡμοιώθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them: and afterwards they shall delight in their mouth.
text_la: Hæc via illorum scandalum ipsis; et postea in ore suo complacebunt.
text_pt: Porque este Deus é o nosso Deus para sempre; ele será nosso guia até à morte.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν σκάνδαλον αὐτοῖς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν εὐδοκήσουσιν διάψαλμα

text_en: They are laid in hell like sheep: death shall feed upon them. And the just shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their help shall decay in hell from their glory .
text_la: Sicut oves in inferno positi sunt : mors depascet eos. Et dominabuntur eorum justi in matutino; et auxilium eorum veterascet in inferno a gloria eorum.
text_el: ὡς πρόβατα ἐν ᾅδῃ ἔθεντο θάνατος ποιμαίνει αὐτούς καὶ κατακυριεύσουσιν αὐτῶν οἱ εὐθεῖς τὸ πρωί καὶ ἡ βοήθεια αὐτῶν παλαιωθήσεται ἐν τῷ ᾅδῃ ἐκ τῆς δόξης αὐτῶν

text_en: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of hell, when he shall receive me.
text_la: Verumtamen Deus redimet animam meam de manu inferi, cum acceperit me.
text_el: πλὴν ὁ θεὸς λυτρώσεται τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ᾅδου ὅταν λαμβάνῃ με διάψαλμα

text_en: Be not afraid, when a man shall be made rich, and when the glory of his house shall be increased.
text_la: Ne timueris cum dives factus fuerit homo, et cum multiplicata fuerit gloria domus ejus:
text_el: μὴ φοβοῦ ὅταν πλουτήσῃ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ὅταν πληθυνθῇ ἡ δόξα τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ

text_en: For when he shall die he shall take nothing away; nor shall his glory descend with him.
text_la: quoniam, cum interierit, non sumet omnia, neque descendet cum eo gloria ejus.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐν τῷ ἀποθνῄσκειν αὐτὸν λήμψεται τὰ πάντα οὐδὲ συγκαταβήσεται αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ

text_en: For in his lifetime his soul will be blessed : and he will praise you when you shall do well to him.
text_la: Quia anima ejus in vita ipsius benedicetur; confitebitur tibi cum benefeceris ei.
text_el: ὅτι ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ εὐλογηθήσεται ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι ὅταν ἀγαθύνῃς αὐτῷ

text_en: He shall go in to the generations of his fathers: and he shall never see light.
text_la: Introibit usque in progenies patrum suorum; et usque in æternum non videbit lumen.
text_el: εἰσελεύσεται ἕως γενεᾶς πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος οὐκ ὄψεται φῶς

text_en: Man when he was in honour did not understand: he has been compared to senseless beasts, and made like to them.
text_la: Homo, cum in honore esset, non intellexit. Comparatus est jumentis insipientibus, et similis factus est illis.
text_el: ἄνθρωπος ἐν τιμῇ ὢν οὐ συνῆκεν παρασυνεβλήθη τοῖς κτήνεσιν τοῖς ἀνοήτοις καὶ ὡμοιώθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: The God of gods, the Lord has spoken: and he has called the earth. From the rising of the sun, to the going down thereof:
text_la: Deus deorum Dominus locutus est, et vocavit terram a solis ortu usque ad occasum.
text_pt: Ouvi isto, vós todos os povos; inclinai os ouvidos, todos os moradores do mundo,
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ θεὸς θεῶν κύριος ἐλάλησεν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ μέχρι δυσμῶν

text_en: Out of Sion the loveliness of his beauty.
text_la: Ex Sion species decoris ejus:
text_pt: Tanto baixos como altos, tanto ricos como pobres.
text_el: ἐκ Σιων ἡ εὐπρέπεια τῆς ὡραιότητος αὐτοῦ ὁ θεὸς ἐμφανῶς ἥξει

text_en: God shall come manifestly: our God shall come, and shall not keep silence. A fire shall burn before him: and a mighty tempest shall be round about him.
text_la: Deus manifeste veniet; Deus noster, et non silebit. Ignis in conspectu ejus exardescet; et in circuitu ejus tempestas valida.
text_pt: A minha boca falará de sabedoria, e a meditação do meu coração será de entendimento.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ οὐ παρασιωπήσεται πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καυθήσεται καὶ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ καταιγὶς σφόδρα

text_en: He shall call heaven from above, and the earth, to judge his people.
text_la: Advocabit cælum desursum, et terram, discernere populum suum.
text_pt: Inclinarei os meus ouvidos a uma parábola; declararei o meu enigma na harpa.
text_el: προσκαλέσεται τὸν οὐρανὸν ἄνω καὶ τὴν γῆν διακρῖναι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Gather together his saints to him: who set his covenant before sacrifices .
text_la: Congregate illi sanctos ejus, qui ordinant testamentum ejus super sacrificia.
text_pt: Por que temerei eu nos dias maus, quando me cercar a iniqüidade dos que me armam ciladas?
text_el: συναγάγετε αὐτῷ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ τοὺς διατιθεμένους τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ θυσίαις

text_en: And the heavens shall declare his justice : for God is judge.
text_la: Et annuntiabunt cæli justitiam ejus, quoniam Deus judex est.
text_pt: Aqueles que confiam na sua fazenda, e se gloriam na multidão das suas riquezas,
text_el: καὶ ἀναγγελοῦσιν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ ὅτι ὁ θεὸς κριτής ἐστιν διάψαλμα

text_en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak: O Israel , and I will testify to you: I am God , your God .
text_la: Audi, populus meus, et loquar; Israël, et testificabor tibi : Deus, Deus tuus ego sum.
text_pt: Nenhum deles de modo algum pode remir a seu irmão, ou dar a Deus o resgate dele.
text_el: ἄκουσον λαός μου καὶ λαλήσω σοι Ισραηλ καὶ διαμαρτύρομαί σοι ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός σού εἰμι ἐγώ

text_en: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices : and your burnt offerings are always in my sight.
text_la: Non in sacrificiis tuis arguam te; holocausta autem tua in conspectu meo sunt semper.
text_pt: (Pois a redenção da sua alma é caríssima, e cessará para sempre),
text_el: οὐκ ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις σου ἐλέγξω σε τὰ δὲ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου ἐνώπιόν μού ἐστιν διὰ παντός

text_en: I will not take calves out of your house: nor he goats out of your flocks.
text_la: Non accipiam de domo tua vitulos, neque de gregibus tuis hircos:
text_pt: Para que viva para sempre, e não veja corrupção.
text_el: οὐ δέξομαι ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου σου μόσχους οὐδὲ ἐκ τῶν ποιμνίων σου χιμάρους

text_en: For all the beasts of the woods are mine: the cattle on the hills, and the oxen.
text_la: quoniam meæ sunt omnes feræ silvarum, jumenta in montibus, et boves.
text_pt: Porque ele vê que os sábios morrem; perecem igualmente tanto o louco como o brutal, e deixam a outros os seus bens.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμά ἐστιν πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ δρυμοῦ κτήνη ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ βόες

text_en: I know all the fowls of the air: and with me is the beauty of the field.
text_la: Cognovi omnia volatilia cæli, et pulchritudo agri mecum est.
text_pt: O seu pensamento interior é que as suas casas serão perpétuas e as suas habitações de geração em geração; dão às suas terras os seus próprios nomes.
text_el: ἔγνωκα πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὡραιότης ἀγροῦ μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: If I should be hungry, I would not tell you: for the world is mine, and the fullness thereof.
text_la: Si esuriero, non dicam tibi : meus est enim orbis terræ et plenitudo ejus.
text_pt: Todavia o homem que está em honra não permanece; antes é como os animais, que perecem.
text_el: ἐὰν πεινάσω οὐ μή σοι εἴπω ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς

text_en: Shall I eat the flesh of bullocks? Or shall I drink the blood of goats?
text_la: Numquid manducabo carnes taurorum? aut sanguinem hircorum potabo?
text_pt: Este caminho deles é a sua loucura; contudo a sua posteridade aprova as suas palavras. (Selá.)
text_el: μὴ φάγομαι κρέα ταύρων ἢ αἷμα τράγων πίομαι

text_en: Offer to God the sacrifice of praise: and pay your vows to the most High .
text_la: Immola Deo sacrificium laudis, et redde Altissimo vota tua.
text_pt: Como ovelhas são postos na sepultura; a morte se alimentará deles e os retos terão domínio sobre eles na manhã, e a sua formosura se consumirá na sepultura, a habitação deles.
text_el: θῦσον τῷ θεῷ θυσίαν αἰνέσεως καὶ ἀπόδος τῷ ὑψίστῳ τὰς εὐχάς σου

text_en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
text_la: Et invoca me in die tribulationis : eruam te, et honorificabis me.
text_pt: Mas Deus remirá a minha alma do poder da sepultura, pois me receberá. (Selá.)
text_el: καὶ ἐπικάλεσαί με ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως καὶ ἐξελοῦμαί σε καὶ δοξάσεις με διάψαλμα

text_en: But to the sinner God has said: Why do you declare my justices, and take my covenant in your mouth?
text_la: Peccatori autem dixit Deus : Quare tu enarras justitias meas? et assumis testamentum meum per os tuum?
text_pt: Não temas, quando alguém se enriquece, quando a glória da sua casa se engrandece.
text_el: τῷ δὲ ἁμαρτωλῷ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἵνα τί σὺ διηγῇ τὰ δικαιώματά μου καὶ ἀναλαμβάνεις τὴν διαθήκην μου διὰ στόματός σου

text_en: Seeing you have hated discipline: and have cast my words behind you.
text_la: Tu vero odisti disciplinam, et projecisti sermones meos retrorsum.
text_pt: Porque, quando morrer, nada levará consigo, nem a sua glória o acompanhará.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἐμίσησας παιδείαν καὶ ἐξέβαλες τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: If you saw a thief you ran with him: and with adulterers you have been a partaker.
text_la: Si videbas furem, currebas cum eo; et cum adulteris portionem tuam ponebas.
text_pt: Ainda que na sua vida ele bendisse a sua alma; e os homens te louvarão, quando fizeres bem a ti mesmo,
text_el: εἰ ἐθεώρεις κλέπτην συνέτρεχες αὐτῷ καὶ μετὰ μοιχῶν τὴν μερίδα σου ἐτίθεις

text_en: Your mouth has abounded with evil , and your tongue framed deceits.
text_la: Os tuum abundavit malitia, et lingua tua concinnabat dolos.
text_pt: Irá para a geração de seus pais; eles nunca verão a luz.
text_el: τὸ στόμα σου ἐπλεόνασεν κακίαν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά σου περιέπλεκεν δολιότητα

text_en: Sitting you spoke against your brother, and laid a scandal against your mother's son:
text_la: Sedens adversus fratrem tuum loquebaris, et adversus filium matris tuæ ponebas scandalum.
text_pt: O homem que está em honra, e não tem entendimento, é semelhante aos animais, que perecem.
text_el: καθήμενος κατὰ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου κατελάλεις καὶ κατὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς μητρός σου ἐτίθεις σκάνδαλον

text_en: These things have you done, and I was silent. You thought unjustly that I should be like to you: but I will reprove you, and set before your face.
text_la: Hæc fecisti, et tacui. Existimasti inique quod ero tui similis : arguam te, et statuam contra faciem tuam.
text_el: ταῦτα ἐποίησας καὶ ἐσίγησα ὑπέλαβες ἀνομίαν ὅτι ἔσομαί σοι ὅμοιος ἐλέγξω σε καὶ παραστήσω κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου

text_en: Understand these things, you that forget God ; lest he snatch you away, and there be none to deliver you.
text_la: Intelligite hæc, qui obliviscimini Deum, nequando rapiat, et non sit qui eripiat.
text_el: σύνετε δὴ ταῦτα οἱ ἐπιλανθανόμενοι τοῦ θεοῦ μήποτε ἁρπάσῃ καὶ μὴ ᾖ ὁ ῥυόμενος

text_en: The sacrifice of praise shall glorify me: and there is the way by which I will show him the salvation of God .
text_la: Sacrificium laudis honorificabit me, et illic iter quo ostendam illi salutare Dei.
text_el: θυσία αἰνέσεως δοξάσει με καὶ ἐκεῖ ὁδός ᾗ δείξω αὐτῷ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm of David ,
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David,
text_pt: O Deus poderoso, o SENHOR, falou e chamou a terra desde o nascimento do sol até ao seu ocaso.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had sinned with Bethsabee.
text_la: cum venit ad eum Nathan propheta, quando intravit ad Bethsabee.
text_pt: Desde Sião, a perfeição da formosura, resplandeceu Deus.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην ἡνίκα εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς Βηρσαβεε

text_en: Have mercy on me, O God , according to your great mercy. And according to the multitude of your tender mercies blot out my iniquity .
text_la: Miserere mei, Deus, secundum magnam misericordiam tuam; et secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum, dele iniquitatem meam.
text_pt: Virá o nosso Deus, e não se calará; um fogo se irá consumindo diante dele, e haverá grande tormenta ao redor dele.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με ὁ θεός κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου καὶ κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν σου ἐξάλειψον τὸ ἀνόμημά μου

text_en: Wash me yet more from my iniquity , and cleanse me from my sin .
text_la: Amplius lava me ab iniquitate mea, et a peccato meo munda me.
text_pt: Chamará os céus lá do alto, e a terra, para julgar o seu povo.
text_el: ἐπὶ πλεῖον πλῦνόν με ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας μου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας μου καθάρισόν με

text_en: For I know my iniquity , and my sin is always before me.
text_la: Quoniam iniquitatem meam ego cognosco, et peccatum meum contra me est semper.
text_pt: Ajuntai-me os meus santos, aqueles que fizeram comigo uma aliança com sacrifícios.
text_el: ὅτι τὴν ἀνομίαν μου ἐγὼ γινώσκω καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία μου ἐνώπιόν μού ἐστιν διὰ παντός

text_en: To you only have I sinned , and have done evil before you: that you may be justified in your words, and may overcome when you are judged.
text_la: Tibi soli peccavi, et malum coram te feci; ut justificeris in sermonibus tuis, et vincas cum judicaris.
text_pt: E os céus anunciarão a sua justiça; pois Deus mesmo é o Juiz. (Selá.)
text_el: σοὶ μόνῳ ἥμαρτον καὶ τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιόν σου ἐποίησα ὅπως ἂν δικαιωθῇς ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου καὶ νικήσῃς ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαί σε

text_en: For behold I was conceived in iniquities ; and in sins did my mother conceive me.
text_la: Ecce enim in iniquitatibus conceptus sum, et in peccatis concepit me mater mea.
text_pt: Ouve, povo meu, e eu falarei; ó Israel, e eu protestarei contra ti: Sou Deus, sou o teu Deus.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἐν ἀνομίαις συνελήμφθην καὶ ἐν ἁμαρτίαις ἐκίσσησέν με ἡ μήτηρ μου

text_en: For behold you have loved truth : the uncertain and hidden things of your wisdom you have made manifest to me.
text_la: Ecce enim veritatem dilexisti; incerta et occulta sapientiæ tuæ manifestasti mihi.
text_pt: Não te repreenderei pelos teus sacrifícios, ou holocaustos, que estão continuamente perante mim.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀλήθειαν ἠγάπησας τὰ ἄδηλα καὶ τὰ κρύφια τῆς σοφίας σου ἐδήλωσάς μοι

text_en: You shall sprinkle me with hyssop , and I shall be cleansed: you shall wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.
text_la: Asperges me hyssopo, et mundabor; lavabis me, et super nivem dealbabor.
text_pt: Da tua casa não tirarei bezerro, nem bodes dos teus currais.
text_el: ῥαντιεῖς με ὑσσώπῳ καὶ καθαρισθήσομαι πλυνεῖς με καὶ ὑπὲρ χιόνα λευκανθήσομαι

text_en: To my hearing you shall give joy and gladness : and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.
text_la: Auditui meo dabis gaudium et lætitiam, et exsultabunt ossa humiliata.
text_pt: Porque meu é todo animal da selva, e o gado sobre milhares de montanhas.
text_el: ἀκουτιεῖς με ἀγαλλίασιν καὶ εὐφροσύνην ἀγαλλιάσονται ὀστᾶ τεταπεινωμένα

text_en: Turn away your face from my sins , and blot out all my iniquities .
text_la: Averte faciem tuam a peccatis meis, et omnes iniquitates meas dele.
text_pt: Conheço todas as aves dos montes; e minhas são todas as feras do campo.
text_el: ἀπόστρεψον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας μου ἐξάλειψον

text_en: Create a clean heart in me, O God : and renew a right spirit within my bowels.
text_la: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus, et spiritum rectum innova in visceribus meis.
text_pt: Se eu tivesse fome, não to diria, pois meu é o mundo e toda a sua plenitude.
text_el: καρδίαν καθαρὰν κτίσον ἐν ἐμοί ὁ θεός καὶ πνεῦμα εὐθὲς ἐγκαίνισον ἐν τοῖς ἐγκάτοις μου

text_en: Cast me not away from your face; and take not your holy spirit from me.
text_la: Ne projicias me a facie tua, et spiritum sanctum tuum ne auferas a me.
text_pt: Comerei eu carne de touros? ou beberei sangue de bodes?
text_el: μὴ ἀπορρίψῃς με ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιόν σου μὴ ἀντανέλῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Restore unto me the joy of your salvation , and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.
text_la: Redde mihi lætitiam salutaris tui, et spiritu principali confirma me.
text_pt: Oferece a Deus sacrifício de louvor, e paga ao Altíssimo os teus votos.
text_el: ἀπόδος μοι τὴν ἀγαλλίασιν τοῦ σωτηρίου σου καὶ πνεύματι ἡγεμονικῷ στήρισόν με

text_en: I will teach the unjust your ways: and the wicked shall be converted to you.
text_la: Docebo iniquos vias tuas, et impii ad te convertentur.
text_pt: E invoca-me no dia da angústia; eu te livrarei, e tu me glorificarás.
text_el: διδάξω ἀνόμους τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἀσεβεῖς ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπιστρέψουσιν

text_en: Deliver me from blood, O God , you God of my salvation : and my tongue shall extol your justice .
text_la: Libera me de sanguinibus, Deus, Deus salutis meæ, et exsultabit lingua mea justitiam tuam.
text_pt: Mas ao ímpio diz Deus: Que fazes tu em recitar os meus estatutos, e em tomar a minha aliança na tua boca?
text_el: ῥῦσαί με ἐξ αἱμάτων ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ γλῶσσά μου τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου

text_en: O Lord , you will open my lips: and my mouth shall declare your praise.
text_la: Domine, labia mea aperies, et os meum annuntiabit laudem tuam.
text_pt: Visto que odeias a correção, e lanças as minhas palavras para detrás de ti.
text_el: κύριε τὰ χείλη μου ἀνοίξεις καὶ τὸ στόμα μου ἀναγγελεῖ τὴν αἴνεσίν σου

text_en: For if you had desired sacrifice , I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings you will not be delighted.
text_la: Quoniam si voluisses sacrificium, dedissem utique; holocaustis non delectaberis.
text_pt: Quando vês o ladrão, consentes com ele, e tens a tua parte com adúlteros.
text_el: ὅτι εἰ ἠθέλησας θυσίαν ἔδωκα ἄν ὁλοκαυτώματα οὐκ εὐδοκήσεις

text_en: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God , you will not despise .
text_la: Sacrificium Deo spiritus contribulatus; cor contritum et humiliatum, Deus, non despicies.
text_pt: Soltas a tua boca para o mal, e a tua língua compõe o engano.
text_el: θυσία τῷ θεῷ πνεῦμα συντετριμμένον καρδίαν συντετριμμένην καὶ τεταπεινωμένην ὁ θεὸς οὐκ ἐξουθενώσει

text_en: Deal favourably, O Lord , in your good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.
text_la: Benigne fac, Domine, in bona voluntate tua Sion, ut ædificentur muri Jerusalem.
text_pt: Assentas-te a falar contra teu irmão; falas mal contra o filho de tua mãe.
text_el: ἀγάθυνον κύριε ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ σου τὴν Σιων καὶ οἰκοδομηθήτω τὰ τείχη Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Then shall you accept the sacrifice of justice , oblations and whole burnt offerings : then shall they lay calves upon your altar .
text_la: Tunc acceptabis sacrificium justitiæ, oblationes et holocausta; tunc imponent super altare tuum vitulos.
text_pt: Estas coisas tens feito, e eu me calei; pensavas que era tal como tu, mas eu te argüirei, e as porei por ordem diante dos teus olhos:
text_el: τότε εὐδοκήσεις θυσίαν δικαιοσύνης ἀναφορὰν καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα τότε ἀνοίσουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριόν σου μόσχους

text_en: Unto the end, understanding for David ,
text_la: In finem. Intellectus David,
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, segundo a tua benignidade; apaga as minhas transgressões, segundo a multidão das tuas misericórdias.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος συνέσεως τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul : David went to the house of Achimelech .
text_la: cum venit Doëg Idumæus, et nuntiavit Sauli : Venit David in domum Achimelech.
text_pt: Lava-me completamente da minha iniqüidade, e purifica-me do meu pecado.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν Δωηκ τὸν Ιδουμαῖον καὶ ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ Σαουλ καὶ εἰπεῖν αὐτῷ ἦλθεν Δαυιδ εἰς τὸν οἶκον Αβιμελεχ

text_en: Why do you glory in malice, you that are mighty in iniquity ?
text_la: Quid gloriaris in malitia, qui potens es in iniquitate?
text_pt: Porque eu conheço as minhas transgressões, e o meu pecado está sempre diante de mim.
text_el: τί ἐγκαυχᾷ ἐν κακίᾳ ὁ δυνατός ἀνομίαν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: All the day long your tongue has devised injustice : as a sharp razor, you have wrought deceit.
text_la: Tota die injustitiam cogitavit lingua tua; sicut novacula acuta fecisti dolum.
text_pt: Contra ti, contra ti somente pequei, e fiz o que é mal à tua vista, para que sejas justificado quando falares, e puro quando julgares.
text_el: ἀδικίαν ἐλογίσατο ἡ γλῶσσά σου ὡσεὶ ξυρὸν ἠκονημένον ἐποίησας δόλον

text_en: You have loved malice more than goodness: and iniquity rather than to speak righteousness.
text_la: Dilexisti malitiam super benignitatem; iniquitatem magis quam loqui æquitatem.
text_pt: Eis que em iniqüidade fui formado, e em pecado me concebeu minha mãe.
text_el: ἠγάπησας κακίαν ὑπὲρ ἀγαθωσύνην ἀδικίαν ὑπὲρ τὸ λαλῆσαι δικαιοσύνην διάψαλμα

text_en: You have loved all the words of ruin, O deceitful tongue.
text_la: Dilexisti omnia verba præcipitationis; lingua dolosa.
text_pt: Eis que amas a verdade no íntimo, e no oculto me fazes conhecer a sabedoria.
text_el: ἠγάπησας πάντα τὰ ῥήματα καταποντισμοῦ γλῶσσαν δολίαν

text_en: Therefore will God destroy you for ever: he will pluck you out, and remove you from your dwelling place: and your root out of the land of the living.
text_la: Propterea Deus destruet te in finem; evellet te, et emigrabit te de tabernaculo tuo, et radicem tuam de terra viventium.
text_pt: Purifica-me com hissopo, e ficarei puro; lava-me, e ficarei mais branco do que a neve.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ὁ θεὸς καθελεῖ σε εἰς τέλος ἐκτίλαι σε καὶ μεταναστεύσαι σε ἀπὸ σκηνώματος καὶ τὸ ῥίζωμά σου ἐκ γῆς ζώντων διάψαλμα

text_en: The just shall see and fear, and shall laugh at him, and say:
text_la: Videbunt justi, et timebunt; et super eum ridebunt, et dicent:
text_pt: Faze-me ouvir júbilo e alegria, para que gozem os ossos que tu quebraste.
text_el: καὶ ὄψονται δίκαιοι καὶ φοβηθήσονται καὶ ἐπ' αὐτὸν γελάσονται καὶ ἐροῦσιν

text_en: Behold the man that made not God his helper: But trusted in the abundance of his riches: and prevailed in his vanity.
text_la: Ecce homo qui non posuit Deum adjutorem suum; sed speravit in multitudine divitiarum suarum, et prævaluit in vanitate sua.
text_pt: Esconde a tua face dos meus pecados, e apaga todas as minhas iniqüidades.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ὃς οὐκ ἔθετο τὸν θεὸν βοηθὸν αὐτοῦ ἀλλ' ἐπήλπισεν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ πλούτου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐδυναμώθη ἐπὶ τῇ ματαιότητι αὐτοῦ

text_en: But I, as a fruitful olive tree in the house of God , have hoped in the mercy of God for ever, yea for ever and ever.
text_la: Ego autem, sicut oliva fructifera in domo Dei; speravi in misericordia Dei, in æternum et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Cria em mim, ó Deus, um coração puro, e renova em mim um espírito reto.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ὡσεὶ ἐλαία κατάκαρπος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ἤλπισα ἐπὶ τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: I will praise you for ever, because you have done it: and I will wait on your name , for it is good in the sight of your saints.
text_la: Confitebor tibi in sæculum, quia fecisti; et exspectabo nomen tuum, quoniam bonum est in conspectu sanctorum tuorum.
text_pt: Não me lances fora da tua presença, e não retires de mim o teu Espírito Santo.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὅτι ἐποίησας καὶ ὑπομενῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου ὅτι χρηστὸν ἐναντίον τῶν ὁσίων σου

text_en: The fool said in his heart: There is no God .
text_la: Dixit insipiens in corde suo : Non est Deus.
text_pt: Por que te glorias na malícia, ó homem poderoso? Pois a bondade de Deus permanece continuamente.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ μαελεθ συνέσεως τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: They are corrupted, and become abominable in iniquities : there is none that does good .
text_la: Corrupti sunt, et abominabiles facti sunt in iniquitatibus; non est qui faciat bonum.
text_pt: A tua língua intenta o mal, como uma navalha amolada, traçando enganos.
text_el: εἶπεν ἄφρων ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν θεός διεφθάρησαν καὶ ἐβδελύχθησαν ἐν ἀνομίαις οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν ἀγαθόν

text_en: God looked down from heaven on the children of men : to see if there were any that did understand, or did seek God .
text_la: Deus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum, ut videat si est intelligens, aut requirens Deum.
text_pt: Tu amas mais o mal do que o bem, e a mentira mais do que o falar a retidão. (Selá.)
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων τοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ ἔστιν συνίων ἢ ἐκζητῶν τὸν θεόν

text_en: All have gone aside, they have become unprofitable together, there is none that does good , no not one.
text_la: Omnes declinaverunt; simul inutiles facti sunt : non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
text_pt: Amas todas as palavras devoradoras, ó língua fraudulenta.
text_el: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν ἀγαθόν οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός

text_en: Shall not all the workers of iniquity know, who eat up my people as they eat bread?
text_la: Nonne scient omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, qui devorant plebem meam ut cibum panis?
text_pt: Também Deus te destruirá para sempre; arrebatar-te-á e arrancar-te-á da tua habitação, e desarraigar-te-á da terra dos viventes. (Selá.)
text_el: οὐχὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν οἱ ἔσθοντες τὸν λαόν μου βρώσει ἄρτου τὸν θεὸν οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο

text_en: They have not called upon God : there have they trembled for fear, where there was no fear. For God has scattered the bones of them that please men : they have been confounded, because God has despised them.
text_la: Deum non invocaverunt; illic trepidaverunt timore, ubi non erat timor. Quoniam Deus dissipavit ossa eorum qui hominibus placent : confusi sunt, quoniam Deus sprevit eos.
text_pt: E os justos o verão, e temerão: e se rirão dele, dizendo:
text_el: ἐκεῖ φοβηθήσονται φόβον οὗ οὐκ ἦν φόβος ὅτι ὁ θεὸς διεσκόρπισεν ὀστᾶ ἀνθρωπαρέσκων κατῃσχύνθησαν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐξουδένωσεν αὐτούς

text_en: Who will give out of Sion the salvation of Israel ? When God shall bring back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text_la: Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël? cum converterit Deus captivitatem plebis suæ, exsultabit Jacob, et lætabitur Israël.
text_pt: Eis aqui o homem que não pôs em Deus a sua fortaleza, antes confiou na abundância das suas riquezas, e se fortaleceu na sua maldade.
text_el: τίς δώσει ἐκ Σιων τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσεται Ιακωβ καὶ εὐφρανθήσεται Ισραηλ

text_en: Unto the end, in verses, understanding for David .
text_la: In finem, in carminibus. Intellectus David,
text_pt: Disse o néscio no seu coração: Não há Deus. Têm-se corrompido, e cometido abominável iniqüidade; não há ninguém que faça o bem.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις συνέσεως τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: When the men of Ziph had come and said to Saul : Is not David hidden with us?
text_la: cum venissent Ziphæi, et dixissent ad Saul : Nonne David absconditus est apud nos?
text_pt: Deus olhou desde os céus para os filhos dos homens, para ver se havia algum que tivesse entendimento e buscasse a Deus.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν τοὺς Ζιφαίους καὶ εἰπεῖν τῷ σαουλ οὐκ ἰδοὺ Δαυιδ κέκρυπται παρ' ἡμῖν

text_en: Save me, O God , by your name , and judge me in your strength.
text_la: Deus, in nomine tuo salvum me fac, et in virtute tua judica me.
text_pt: Desviaram-se todos, e juntamente se fizeram imundos; não há quem faça o bem, não, nem sequer um.
text_el: ὁ θεός ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου σῶσόν με καὶ ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου κρῖνόν με

text_en: O God , hear my prayer: give ear to the words of my mouth.
text_la: Deus, exaudi orationem meam; auribus percipe verba oris mei.
text_pt: Acaso não têm conhecimento os que praticam a iniqüidade, os quais comem o meu povo como se comessem pão? Eles não invocaram a Deus.
text_el: ὁ θεός εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου ἐνώτισαι τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου

text_en: For strangers have risen up against me; and the mighty have sought after my soul : and they have not set God before their eyes.
text_la: Quoniam alieni insurrexerunt adversum me, et fortes quæsierunt animam meam, et non proposuerunt Deum ante conspectum suum.
text_pt: Ali se acharam em grande temor, onde não havia temor, pois Deus espalhou os ossos daquele que te cercava; tu os confundiste, porque Deus os rejeitou.
text_el: ὅτι ἀλλότριοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ κραταιοὶ ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου οὐ προέθεντο τὸν θεὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: For behold God is my helper: and the Lord is the protector of my soul .
text_la: Ecce enim Deus adjuvat me, et Dominus susceptor est animæ meæ.
text_pt: Oh! se já de Sião viesse a salvação de Israel! Quando Deus fizer voltar os cativos do seu povo, então se regozijará Jacó e se alegrará Israel.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς βοηθεῖ μοι καὶ ὁ κύριος ἀντιλήμπτωρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου

text_en: Turn back the evils upon my enemies; and cut them off in your truth .
text_la: Averte mala inimicis meis; et in veritate tua disperde illos.
text_el: ἀποστρέψει τὰ κακὰ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ἐξολέθρευσον αὐτούς

text_en: I will freely sacrifice to you, and will give praise, O God , to your name : because it is good :
text_la: Voluntarie sacrificabo tibi, et confitebor nomini tuo, Domine, quoniam bonum est.
text_el: ἑκουσίως θύσω σοι ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου κύριε ὅτι ἀγαθόν

text_en: For you have delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has looked down upon my enemies.
text_la: Quoniam ex omni tribulatione eripuisti me, et super inimicos meos despexit oculus meus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκ πάσης θλίψεως ἐρρύσω με καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου ἐπεῖδεν ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου

text_en: Unto the end, in verses, understanding for David .
text_la: In finem, in carminibus. Intellectus David.
text_pt: Salva-me, ó Deus, pelo teu nome, e faze-me justiça pelo teu poder.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις συνέσεως τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Hear, O God , my prayer , and despise not my supplication:
text_la: Exaudi, Deus, orationem meam, et ne despexeris deprecationem meam:
text_pt: Ó Deus, ouve a minha oração, inclina os teus ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.
text_el: ἐνώτισαι ὁ θεός τὴν προσευχὴν μου καὶ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς τὴν δέησίν μου

text_en: Be attentive to me and hear me. I am grieved in my exercise; and am troubled,
text_la: intende mihi, et exaudi me. Contristatus sum in exercitatione mea, et conturbatus sum
text_pt: Porque os estranhos se levantam contra mim, e tiranos procuram a minha vida; não têm posto Deus perante os seus olhos. (Selá.)
text_el: πρόσχες μοι καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου ἐλυπήθην ἐν τῇ ἀδολεσχίᾳ μου καὶ ἐταράχθην

text_en: at the voice of the enemy, and at the tribulation of the sinner. For they have cast iniquities upon me: and in wrath they were troublesome to me.
text_la: a voce inimici, et a tribulatione peccatoris. Quoniam declinaverunt in me iniquitates, et in ira molesti erant mihi.
text_pt: Eis que Deus é o meu ajudador, o Senhor está com aqueles que sustêm a minha alma.
text_el: ἀπὸ φωνῆς ἐχθροῦ καὶ ἀπὸ θλίψεως ἁμαρτωλοῦ ὅτι ἐξέκλιναν ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἀνομίαν καὶ ἐν ὀργῇ ἐνεκότουν μοι

text_en: My heart is troubled within me: and the fear of death is fallen upon me.
text_la: Cor meum conturbatum est in me, et formido mortis cecidit super me.
text_pt: Ele recompensará com o mal os meus inimigos. Destrói-os na tua verdade.
text_el: ἡ καρδία μου ἐταράχθη ἐν ἐμοί καὶ δειλία θανάτου ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Fear and trembling have come upon me: and darkness has covered me.
text_la: Timor et tremor venerunt super me, et contexerunt me tenebræ.
text_pt: Eu te oferecerei voluntariamente sacrifícios; louvarei o teu nome, ó Senhor, porque é bom,
text_el: φόβος καὶ τρόμος ἦλθεν ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ ἐκάλυψέν με σκότος

text_en: And I said: Who will give me wings like a dove , and I will fly and be at rest?
text_la: Et dixi : Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut columbæ, et volabo, et requiescam?
text_pt: Pois me tem livrado de toda a angústia; e os meus olhos viram o meu desejo sobre os meus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τίς δώσει μοι πτέρυγας ὡσεὶ περιστερᾶς καὶ πετασθήσομαι καὶ καταπαύσω

text_en: Lo, I have gone far off flying away; and I abode in the wilderness .
text_la: Ecce elongavi fugiens, et mansi in solitudine.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐμάκρυνα φυγαδεύων καὶ ηὐλίσθην ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ διάψαλμα

text_en: I waited for him that has saved me from pusillanimity of spirit, and a storm.
text_la: Exspectabam eum qui salvum me fecit a pusillanimitate spiritus, et tempestate.
text_el: προσεδεχόμην τὸν σῴζοντά με ἀπὸ ὀλιγοψυχίας καὶ καταιγίδος

text_en: Cast down, O Lord , and divide their tongues; for I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.
text_la: Præcipita, Domine; divide linguas eorum : quoniam vidi iniquitatem et contradictionem in civitate.
text_el: καταπόντισον κύριε καὶ καταδίελε τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ὅτι εἶδον ἀνομίαν καὶ ἀντιλογίαν ἐν τῇ πόλει

text_en: Day and night shall iniquity surround it upon its walls: and in the midst thereof are labour,
text_la: Die ac nocte circumdabit eam super muros ejus iniquitas; et labor in medio ejus,
text_el: ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς κυκλώσει αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὰ τείχη αὐτῆς ἀνομία καὶ κόπος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἀδικία

text_en: and injustice . And usury and deceit have not departed from its streets.
text_la: et injustitia : et non defecit de plateis ejus usura et dolus.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐξέλιπεν ἐκ τῶν πλατειῶν αὐτῆς τόκος καὶ δόλος

text_en: For if my enemy had reviled me, I would verily have borne with it. And if he that hated me had spoken great things against me, I would perhaps have hidden my self from him.
text_la: Quoniam si inimicus meus maledixisset mihi, sustinuissem utique. Et si is qui oderat me super me magna locutus fuisset, abscondissem me forsitan ab eo.
text_el: ὅτι εἰ ἐχθρὸς ὠνείδισέν με ὑπήνεγκα ἄν καὶ εἰ ὁ μισῶν με ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐμεγαλορρημόνησεν ἐκρύβην ἂν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But you a man of one mind, my guide, and my familiar,
text_la: Tu vero homo unanimis, dux meus, et notus meus:
text_el: σὺ δέ ἄνθρωπε ἰσόψυχε ἡγεμών μου καὶ γνωστέ μου

text_en: who took sweetmeats together with me: in the house of God we walked with consent.
text_la: qui simul mecum dulces capiebas cibos; in domo Dei ambulavimus cum consensu.
text_el: ὃς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό μοι ἐγλύκανας ἐδέσματα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπορεύθημεν ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ

text_en: Let death come upon them, and let them go down alive into hell. For there is wickedness in their dwellings: in the midst of them.
text_la: Veniat mors super illos, et descendant in infernum viventes : quoniam nequitiæ in habitaculis eorum, in medio eorum.
text_el: ἐλθέτω θάνατος ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ καταβήτωσαν εἰς ᾅδου ζῶντες ὅτι πονηρίαι ἐν ταῖς παροικίαις αὐτῶν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: But I have cried to God : and the Lord will save me.
text_la: Ego autem ad Deum clamavi, et Dominus salvabit me.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἐκέκραξα καὶ ὁ κύριος εἰσήκουσέν μου

text_en: Evening and morning, and at noon I will speak and declare: and he shall hear my voice.
text_la: Vespere, et mane, et meridie, narrabo, et annuntiabo; et exaudiet vocem meam.
text_el: ἑσπέρας καὶ πρωὶ καὶ μεσημβρίας διηγήσομαι ἀπαγγελῶ καὶ εἰσακούσεται τῆς φωνῆς μου

text_en: He shall redeem my soul in peace from them that draw near to me: for among many they were with me.
text_la: Redimet in pace animam meam ab his qui appropinquant mihi : quoniam inter multos erant mecum.
text_el: λυτρώσεται ἐν εἰρήνῃ τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ τῶν ἐγγιζόντων μοι ὅτι ἐν πολλοῖς ἦσαν σὺν ἐμοί

text_en: God shall hear, and the Eternal shall humble them. For there is no change with them, and they have not feared God :
text_la: Exaudiet Deus, et humiliabit illos, qui est ante sæcula. Non enim est illis commutatio, et non timuerunt Deum.
text_el: εἰσακούσεται ὁ θεὸς καὶ ταπεινώσει αὐτούς ὁ ὑπάρχων πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων διάψαλμα οὐ γάρ ἐστιν αὐτοῖς ἀντάλλαγμα καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν θεόν

text_en: He has stretched forth his hand to repay. They have defiled his covenant,
text_la: Extendit manum suam in retribuendo; contaminaverunt testamentum ejus:
text_el: ἐξέτεινεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ἀποδιδόναι ἐβεβήλωσαν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ

text_en: they are divided by the wrath of his countenance, and his heart has drawn near. His words are smoother than oil, and the same are darts.
text_la: divisi sunt ab ira vultus ejus, et appropinquavit cor illius. Molliti sunt sermones ejus super oleum; et ipsi sunt jacula.
text_el: διεμερίσθησαν ἀπὸ ὀργῆς τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤγγισεν ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ ἡπαλύνθησαν οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ ἔλαιον καὶ αὐτοί εἰσιν βολίδες

text_en: Cast your care upon the Lord , and he shall sustain you: he shall not suffer the just to waver for ever.
text_la: Jacta super Dominum curam tuam, et ipse te enutriet; non dabit in æternum fluctuationem justo.
text_el: ἐπίρριψον ἐπὶ κύριον τὴν μέριμνάν σου καὶ αὐτός σε διαθρέψει οὐ δώσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα σάλον τῷ δικαίῳ

text_en: But you, O God , shall bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in you, O Lord .
text_la: Tu vero, Deus, deduces eos in puteum interitus. Viri sanguinum et dolosi non dimidiabunt dies suos; ego autem sperabo in te, Domine.
text_el: σὺ δέ ὁ θεός κατάξεις αὐτοὺς εἰς φρέαρ διαφθορᾶς ἄνδρες αἱμάτων καὶ δολιότητος οὐ μὴ ἡμισεύσωσιν τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτῶν ἐγὼ δὲ ἐλπιῶ ἐπὶ σέ κύριε

text_en: Unto the end, for a people that is removed at a distance form the sanctuary: for David , for an inscription of a title (or pillar) when the Philistines held him in Geth.
text_la: In finem, pro populo qui a sanctis longe factus est. David in tituli inscriptionem, cum tenuerunt eum Allophyli in Geth.
text_pt: Inclina, ó Deus, os teus ouvidos à minha oração, e não te escondas da minha súplica.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων μεμακρυμμένου τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν ὁπότε ἐκράτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐν Γεθ

text_en: Have mercy on me, O God , for man has trodden me under foot; all the day long he has afflicted me fighting against me.
text_la: Miserere mei, Deus, quoniam conculcavit me homo; tota die impugnans, tribulavit me.
text_pt: Atende-me, e ouve-me; lamento na minha queixa, e faço ruído,
text_el: ἐλέησόν με κύριε ὅτι κατεπάτησέν με ἄνθρωπος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν πολεμῶν ἔθλιψέν με

text_en: My enemies have trodden on me all the day long; for they are many that make war against me.
text_la: Conculcaverunt me inimici mei tota die, quoniam multi bellantes adversum me.
text_pt: Pelo clamor do inimigo e por causa da opressão do ímpio; pois lançam sobre mim a iniqüidade, e com furor me odeiam.
text_el: κατεπάτησάν με οἱ ἐχθροί μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ πολεμοῦντές με ἀπὸ ὕψους

text_en: From the height of the day I shall fear: but I will trust in you.
text_la: Ab altitudine diei timebo : ego vero in te sperabo.
text_pt: O meu coração está dolorido dentro de mim, e terrores da morte caíram sobre mim.
text_el: ἡμέρας φοβηθήσομαι ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ σοὶ ἐλπιῶ

text_en: In God I will praise my words, in God I have put my trust: I will not fear what flesh can do against me.
text_la: In Deo laudabo sermones meos; in Deo speravi : non timebo quid faciat mihi caro.
text_pt: Temor e tremor vieram sobre mim; e o horror me cobriu.
text_el: ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἐπαινέσω τοὺς λόγους μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ ἤλπισα οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι σάρξ

text_en: All the day long they detested my words: all their thoughts were against me unto evil .
text_la: Tota die verba mea execrabantur; adversum me omnes cogitationes eorum in malum.
text_pt: Assim eu disse: Oh! quem me dera asas como de pomba! Então voaria, e estaria em descanso.
text_el: ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τοὺς λόγους μου ἐβδελύσσοντο κατ' ἐμοῦ πάντες οἱ διαλογισμοὶ αὐτῶν εἰς κακόν

text_en: They will dwell and hide themselves: they will watch my heel. As they have waited for my soul ,
text_la: Inhabitabunt, et abscondent; ipsi calcaneum meum observabunt. Sicut sustinuerunt animam meam,
text_pt: Eis que fugiria para longe, e pernoitaria no deserto. (Selá.)
text_el: παροικήσουσιν καὶ κατακρύψουσιν αὐτοὶ τὴν πτέρναν μου φυλάξουσιν καθάπερ ὑπέμειναν τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: for nothing shall you save them: in your anger you shall break the people in pieces. O God ,
text_la: pro nihilo salvos facies illos; in ira populos confringes.
text_pt: Apressar-me-ia a escapar da fúria do vento e da tempestade.
text_el: ὑπὲρ τοῦ μηθενὸς σώσεις αὐτούς ἐν ὀργῇ λαοὺς κατάξεις ὁ θεός

text_en: I have declared to you my life: you have set me tears in your sight, As also in your promise.
text_la: Deus, vitam meam annuntiavi tibi; posuisti lacrimas meas in conspectu tuo, sicut et in promissione tua:
text_pt: Despedaça, Senhor, e divide as suas línguas, pois tenho visto violência e contenda na cidade.
text_el: τὴν ζωήν μου ἐξήγγειλά σοι ἔθου τὰ δάκρυά μου ἐνώπιόν σου ὡς καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐπαγγελίᾳ σου

text_en: Then shall my enemies be turned back. In what day soever I shall call upon you, behold I know you are my God .
text_la: tunc convertentur inimici mei retrorsum. In quacumque die invocavero te, ecce cognovi quoniam Deus meus es.
text_pt: De dia e de noite a cercam sobre os seus muros; iniqüidade e malícia estão no meio dela.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψουσιν οἱ ἐχθροί μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε ἰδοὺ ἔγνων ὅτι θεός μου εἶ σύ

text_en: In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise his speech.
text_la: In Deo laudabo verbum; in Domino laudabo sermonem.
text_pt: Maldade há dentro dela; astúcia e engano não se apartam das suas ruas.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ αἰνέσω ῥῆμα ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ αἰνέσω λόγον

text_en: In God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.
text_la: In Deo speravi : non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
text_pt: Pois não era um inimigo que me afrontava; então eu o teria suportado; nem era o que me odiava que se engrandecia contra mim, porque dele me teria escondido.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ ἤλπισα οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος

text_en: In me, O God , are vows to you, which I will pay, praises to you:
text_la: In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, quæ reddam, laudationes tibi:
text_pt: Mas eras tu, homem meu igual, meu guia e meu íntimo amigo.
text_el: ἐν ἐμοί ὁ θεός αἱ εὐχαὶ ἃς ἀποδώσω αἰνέσεώς σοι

text_en: Because you have delivered my soul from death, my feet from falling: that I may please in the sight of God , in the light of the living.
text_la: quoniam eripuisti animam meam de morte, et pedes meos de lapsu, ut placeam coram Deo in lumine viventium.
text_pt: Consultávamos juntos suavemente, e andávamos em companhia na casa de Deus.
