text_el: ὅτι ἐρρύσω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ἐξ ὀλισθήματος τοῦ εὐαρεστῆσαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν φωτὶ ζώντων

text_en: Unto the end, destroy not, for David , for an inscription of a title, when he fled from Saul into the cave.
text_la: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem, cum fugeret a facie Saul in speluncam.
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, porque o homem procura devorar-me; pelejando todo dia, me oprime.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος μὴ διαφθείρῃς τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν ἀποδιδράσκειν ἀπὸ προσώπου Σαουλ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον

text_en: Have mercy on me, O God , have mercy on me: for my soul trusts in you. And in the shadow of your wings will I hope, until iniquity pass away.
text_la: Miserere mei, Deus, miserere mei, quoniam in te confidit anima mea. Et in umbra alarum tuarum sperabo, donec transeat iniquitas.
text_pt: Os meus inimigos procuram devorar-me todo dia; pois são muitos os que pelejam contra mim, ó Altíssimo.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με ὁ θεός ἐλέησόν με ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ πέποιθεν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἐν τῇ σκιᾷ τῶν πτερύγων σου ἐλπιῶ ἕως οὗ παρέλθῃ ἡ ἀνομία

text_en: I will cry to God the most high; to God who has done good to me.
text_la: Clamabo ad Deum altissimum, Deum qui benefecit mihi.
text_pt: Em qualquer tempo em que eu temer, confiarei em ti.
text_el: κεκράξομαι πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον τὸν θεὸν τὸν εὐεργετήσαντά με

text_en: He has sent from heaven and delivered me: he has made them a reproach that trod upon me. God has sent his mercy and his truth ,
text_la: Misit de cælo, et liberavit me; dedit in opprobrium conculcantes me. Misit Deus misericordiam suam et veritatem suam,
text_pt: Em Deus louvarei a sua palavra, em Deus pus a minha confiança; não temerei o que me possa fazer a carne.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἔσωσέν με ἔδωκεν εἰς ὄνειδος τοὺς καταπατοῦντάς με διάψαλμα ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: and he has delivered my soul from the midst of the young lions. I slept troubled. The sons of men, whose teeth are weapons and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
text_la: et eripuit animam meam de medio catulorum leonum. Dormivi conturbatus. Filii hominum dentes eorum arma et sagittæ, et lingua eorum gladius acutus.
text_pt: Todos os dias torcem as minhas palavras; todos os seus pensamentos são contra mim para o mal.
text_el: καὶ ἐρρύσατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ μέσου σκύμνων ἐκοιμήθην τεταραγμένος υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτῶν ὅπλον καὶ βέλη καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν μάχαιρα ὀξεῖα

text_en: Be exalted, O God , above the heavens , and your glory above all the earth.
text_la: Exaltare super cælos, Deus, et in omnem terram gloria tua.
text_pt: Ajuntam-se, escondem-se, marcam os meus passos, como aguardando a minha alma.
text_el: ὑψώθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανούς ὁ θεός καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἡ δόξα σου

text_en: They prepared a snare for my feet; and they bowed down my soul . They dug a pit before my face, and they are fallen into it.
text_la: Laqueum paraverunt pedibus meis, et incurvaverunt animam meam. Foderunt ante faciem meam foveam, et inciderunt in eam.
text_pt: Porventura escaparão eles por meio da sua iniqüidade? Ó Deus, derruba os povos na tua ira!
text_el: παγίδα ἡτοίμασαν τοῖς ποσίν μου καὶ κατέκαμψαν τὴν ψυχήν μου ὤρυξαν πρὸ προσώπου μου βόθρον καὶ ἐνέπεσαν εἰς αὐτόν διάψαλμα

text_en: My heart is ready, O God , my heart is ready: I will sing, and rehearse a psalm.
text_la: Paratum cor meum, Deus, paratum cor meum; cantabo, et psalmum dicam.
text_pt: Tu contas as minhas vagueações; põe as minhas lágrimas no teu odre. Não estão elas no teu livro?
text_el: ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ὁ θεός ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ

text_en: Arise, O my glory , arise psaltery and harp: I will arise early.
text_la: Exsurge, gloria mea; exsurge, psalterium et cithara : exsurgam diluculo.
text_pt: Quando eu a ti clamar, então voltarão para trás os meus inimigos: isto sei eu, porque Deus é por mim.
text_el: ἐξεγέρθητι ἡ δόξα μου ἐξεγέρθητι ψαλτήριον καὶ κιθάρα ἐξεγερθήσομαι ὄρθρου

text_en: I will give praise to you, O Lord , among the people: I will sing a psalm to you among the nations.
text_la: Confitebor tibi in populis, Domine, et psalmum dicam tibi in gentibus:
text_pt: Em Deus louvarei a sua palavra; no Senhor louvarei a sua palavra.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν λαοῖς κύριε ψαλῶ σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν

text_en: For your mercy is magnified even to the heavens : and your truth unto the clouds.
text_la: quoniam magnificata est usque ad cælos misericordia tua, et usque ad nubes veritas tua.
text_pt: Em Deus tenho posto a minha confiança; não temerei o que me possa fazer o homem.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ἕως τῶν οὐρανῶν τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου

text_en: Be exalted, O God , above the heavens : and your glory above all the earth.
text_la: Exaltare super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram gloria tua.
text_pt: Os teus votos estão sobre mim, ó Deus; eu te renderei ações de graças;
text_el: ὑψώθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανούς ὁ θεός καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἡ δόξα σου

text_en: Unto the end, destroy not, for David , for an inscription of a title.
text_la: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem.
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim, porque a minha alma confia em ti; e à sombra das tuas asas me abrigo, até que passem as calamidades.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος μὴ διαφθείρῃς τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν

text_en: If in very deed you speak justice : judge right things, you sons of men .
text_la: Si vere utique justitiam loquimini, recta judicate, filii hominum.
text_pt: Clamarei ao Deus altíssimo, ao Deus que por mim tudo executa.
text_el: εἰ ἀληθῶς ἄρα δικαιοσύνην λαλεῖτε εὐθεῖα κρίνετε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For in your heart you work iniquity : your hands forge injustice in the earth.
text_la: Etenim in corde iniquitates operamini; in terra injustitias manus vestræ concinnant.
text_pt: Ele enviará desde os céus, e me salvará do desprezo daquele que procurava devorar-me. (Selá.) Deus enviará a sua misericórdia e a sua verdade.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνομίας ἐργάζεσθε ἐν τῇ γῇ ἀδικίαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν συμπλέκουσιν

text_en: The wicked are alienated from the womb; they have gone astray from the womb: they have spoken false things.
text_la: Alienati sunt peccatores a vulva; erraverunt ab utero : locuti sunt falsa.
text_pt: A minha alma está entre leões, e eu estou entre aqueles que estão abrasados, filhos dos homens, cujos dentes são lanças e flechas, e a sua língua espada afiada.
text_el: ἀπηλλοτριώθησαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ μήτρας ἐπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ γαστρός ἐλάλησαν ψεύδη

text_en: Their madness is according to the likeness of a serpent: like the deaf asp that stops her ears:
text_la: Furor illis secundum similitudinem serpentis, sicut aspidis surdæ et obturantis aures suas,
text_pt: Sê exaltado, ó Deus, sobre os céus; seja a tua glória sobre toda a terra.
text_el: θυμὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ὄφεως ὡσεὶ ἀσπίδος κωφῆς καὶ βυούσης τὰ ὦτα αὐτῆς

text_en: Which will not hear the voice of the charmers; nor of the wizard that charms wisely.
text_la: quæ non exaudiet vocem incantantium, et venefici incantantis sapienter.
text_pt: Armaram uma rede aos meus passos; a minha alma está abatida. Cavaram uma cova diante de mim, porém eles mesmos caíram no meio dela. (Selá.)
text_el: ἥτις οὐκ εἰσακούσεται φωνὴν ἐπᾳδόντων φαρμάκου τε φαρμακευομένου παρὰ σοφοῦ

text_en: God shall break in pieces their teeth in their mouth: the Lord shall break the grinders of the lions.
text_la: Deus conteret dentes eorum in ore ipsorum; molas leonum confringet Dominus.
text_pt: Preparado está o meu coração, ó Deus, preparado está o meu coração; cantarei, e darei louvores.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς συνέτριψεν τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν τὰς μύλας τῶν λεόντων συνέθλασεν κύριος

text_en: They shall come to nothing, like water running down; he has bent his bow till they be weakened.
text_la: Ad nihilum devenient tamquam aqua decurrens; intendit arcum suum donec infirmentur.
text_pt: Desperta, glória minha; despertai, saltério e harpa; eu mesmo despertarei ao romper da alva.
text_el: ἐξουδενωθήσονται ὡς ὕδωρ διαπορευόμενον ἐντενεῖ τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀσθενήσουσιν

text_en: Like wax that melts they shall be taken away: fire has fallen on them, and they shall not see the sun.
text_la: Sicut cera quæ fluit auferentur; supercecidit ignis, et non viderunt solem.
text_pt: Louvar-te-ei, Senhor, entre os povos; eu te cantarei entre as nações.
text_el: ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ὁ τακεὶς ἀνταναιρεθήσονται ἐπέπεσε πῦρ καὶ οὐκ εἶδον τὸν ἥλιον

text_en: Before your thorns could know the brier; he swallows them up, as alive, in his wrath .
text_la: Priusquam intelligerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum, sicut viventes sic in ira absorbet eos.
text_pt: Pois a tua misericórdia é grande até aos céus, e a tua verdade até às nuvens.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς ἀκάνθας ὑμῶν τὴν ῥάμνον ὡσεὶ ζῶντας ὡσεὶ ἐν ὀργῇ καταπίεται ὑμᾶς

text_en: The just shall rejoice when he shall see the revenge: he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.
text_la: Lætabitur justus cum viderit vindictam; manus suas lavabit in sanguine peccatoris.
text_pt: Sê exaltado, ó Deus, sobre os céus; e seja a tua glória sobre toda a terra.
text_el: εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος ὅταν ἴδῃ ἐκδίκησιν ἀσεβῶν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ νίψεται ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ

text_en: And man shall say: If indeed there be fruit to the just : there is indeed a God that judges them on the earth.
text_la: Et dicet homo : Si utique est fructus justo, utique est Deus judicans eos in terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος εἰ ἄρα ἔστιν καρπὸς τῷ δικαίῳ ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ θεὸς κρίνων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: Unto the end, destroy not, for David for an inscription of a title, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.
text_la: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem, quando misit Saul et custodivit domum ejus ut eum interficeret.
text_pt: Acaso falais vós, deveras, ó congregação, a justiça? Julgais retamente, ó filhos dos homens?
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος μὴ διαφθείρῃς τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν ὁπότε ἀπέστειλεν Σαουλ καὶ ἐφύλαξεν τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ τοῦ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν

text_en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God ; and defend me from them that rise up against me.
text_la: Eripe me de inimicis meis, Deus meus, et ab insurgentibus in me libera me.
text_pt: Antes no coração forjais iniqüidades; sobre a terra pesais a violência das vossas mãos.
text_el: ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ὁ θεός καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπανιστανομένων ἐπ' ἐμὲ λύτρωσαί με

text_en: Deliver me from them that work iniquity , and save me from bloody men .
text_la: Eripe me de operantibus iniquitatem, et de viris sanguinum salva me.
text_pt: Alienam-se os ímpios desde a madre; andam errados desde que nasceram, falando mentiras.
text_el: ῥῦσαί με ἐκ τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν καὶ ἐξ ἀνδρῶν αἱμάτων σῶσόν με

text_en: For behold they have caught my soul : the mighty have rushed in upon me:
text_la: Quia ecce ceperunt animam meam; irruerunt in me fortes.
text_pt: O seu veneno é semelhante ao veneno da serpente; são como a víbora surda, que tapa os ouvidos,
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἐθήρευσαν τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐπέθεντο ἐπ' ἐμὲ κραταιοί οὔτε ἡ ἀνομία μου οὔτε ἡ ἁμαρτία μου κύριε

text_en: Neither is it my iniquity , nor my sin , O Lord : without iniquity have I run, and directed my steps.
text_la: Neque iniquitas mea, neque peccatum meum, Domine; sine iniquitate cucurri, et direxi.
text_pt: Para não ouvir a voz dos encantadores, do encantador sábio em encantamentos.
text_el: ἄνευ ἀνομίας ἔδραμον καὶ κατεύθυναν ἐξεγέρθητι εἰς συνάντησίν μου καὶ ἰδέ

text_en: Rise up to meet me, and behold: even you, O Lord , the God of hosts , the God of Israel . Attend to visit all the nations: have no mercy on all them that work iniquity .
text_la: Exsurge in occursum meum, et vide : et tu, Domine Deus virtutum, Deus Israël, intende ad visitandas omnes gentes : non miserearis omnibus qui operantur iniquitatem.
text_pt: Ó Deus, quebra-lhes os dentes nas suas bocas; arranca, Senhor, os queixais aos filhos dos leões.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ πρόσχες τοῦ ἐπισκέψασθαι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη μὴ οἰκτιρήσῃς πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν διάψαλμα

text_en: They shall return at evening, and shall suffer hunger like dogs: and shall go round about the city.
text_la: Convertentur ad vesperam, et famem patientur ut canes : et circuibunt civitatem.
text_pt: Escorram como águas que correm constantemente. Quando ele armar as suas flechas, fiquem feitas em pedaços.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψουσιν εἰς ἑσπέραν καὶ λιμώξουσιν ὡς κύων καὶ κυκλώσουσιν πόλιν

text_en: Behold they shall speak with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips: for who, say they, has heard us?
text_la: Ecce loquentur in ore suo, et gladius in labiis eorum : quoniam quis audivit?
text_pt: Como a lesma se derrete, assim se vá cada um deles; como o aborto duma mulher, que nunca viu o sol.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀποφθέγξονται ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν καὶ ῥομφαία ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτῶν ὅτι τίς ἤκουσεν

text_en: But you, O Lord , shall laugh at them: you shall bring all the nations to nothing.
text_la: Et tu, Domine, deridebis eos; ad nihilum deduces omnes gentes.
text_pt: Antes que as vossas panelas sintam o calor dos espinhos, como por um redemoinho os arrebatará ele, vivo e em indignação.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριε ἐκγελάσῃ αὐτούς ἐξουδενώσεις πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: I will keep my strength to you: for you are my protector:
text_la: Fortitudinem meam ad te custodiam, quia, Deus, susceptor meus es:
text_pt: O justo se alegrará quando vir a vingança; lavará os seus pés no sangue do ímpio.
text_el: τὸ κράτος μου πρὸς σὲ φυλάξω ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ

text_en: My God , his mercy shall prevent me.
text_la: Deus meus misericordia ejus præveniet me.
text_pt: Então dirá o homem: Deveras há uma recompensa para o justo; deveras há um Deus que julga na terra.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ προφθάσει με ὁ θεὸς δείξει μοι ἐν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου

text_en: God shall let me see over my enemies: slay them not, lest at any time my people forget. Scatter them by your power; and bring them down, O Lord , my protector:
text_la: Deus ostendet mihi super inimicos meos : ne occidas eos, nequando obliviscantur populi mei. Disperge illos in virtute tua, et depone eos, protector meus, Domine:
text_el: μὴ ἀποκτείνῃς αὐτούς μήποτε ἐπιλάθωνται τοῦ λαοῦ μου διασκόρπισον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου καὶ κατάγαγε αὐτούς ὁ ὑπερασπιστής μου κύριε

text_en: For the sin of their mouth, and the word of their lips: and let them be taken in their pride . And for their cursing and lying they shall be talked of,
text_la: delictum oris eorum, sermonem labiorum ipsorum; et comprehendantur in superbia sua. Et de execratione et mendacio annuntiabuntur
text_el: ἁμαρτίαν στόματος αὐτῶν λόγον χειλέων αὐτῶν καὶ συλλημφθήτωσαν ἐν τῇ ὑπερηφανίᾳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξ ἀρᾶς καὶ ψεύδους διαγγελήσονται συντέλειαι

text_en: when they are consumed: when they are consumed by your wrath , and they shall be no more. and they shall know that God will rule Jacob , and all the ends of the earth.
text_la: in consummatione : in ira consummationis, et non erunt. Et scient quia Deus dominabitur Jacob, et finium terræ.
text_el: ἐν ὀργῇ συντελείας καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπάρξωσιν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ὁ θεὸς δεσπόζει τοῦ Ιακωβ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς διάψαλμα

text_en: They shall return at evening and shall suffer hunger like dogs: and shall go round about the city.
text_la: Convertentur ad vesperam, et famem patientur ut canes : et circuibunt civitatem.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψουσιν εἰς ἑσπέραν καὶ λιμώξουσιν ὡς κύων καὶ κυκλώσουσιν πόλιν

text_en: They shall be scattered abroad to eat, and shall murmur if they be not filled.
text_la: Ipsi dispergentur ad manducandum; si vero non fuerint saturati, et murmurabunt.
text_el: αὐτοὶ διασκορπισθήσονται τοῦ φαγεῖν ἐὰν δὲ μὴ χορτασθῶσιν καὶ γογγύσουσιν

text_en: But I will sing your strength: and will extol your mercy in the morning. For you have become my support, and my refuge, in the day of my trouble.
text_la: Ego autem cantabo fortitudinem tuam, et exsultabo mane misericordiam tuam : quia factus es susceptor meus, et refugium meum in die tribulationis meæ.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ᾄσομαι τῇ δυνάμει σου καὶ ἀγαλλιάσομαι τὸ πρωὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου ὅτι ἐγενήθης ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου καὶ καταφυγὴ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς μου

text_en: Unto you, O my helper, will I sing, for you are God my defence: my God my mercy.
text_la: Adjutor meus, tibi psallam, quia Deus susceptor meus es; Deus meus, misericordia mea.
text_el: βοηθός μου σοὶ ψαλῶ ὅτι ὁ θεός ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ ὁ θεός μου τὸ ἔλεός μου

text_en: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed, for the inscription of a title, to David himself, for doctrine,
text_la: In finem, pro his qui immutabuntur, in tituli inscriptionem ipsi David, in doctrinam,
text_pt: Livra-me, meu Deus, dos meus inimigos, defende-me daqueles que se levantam contra mim.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῖς ἀλλοιωθησομένοις ἔτι εἰς στηλογραφίαν τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς διδαχήν

text_en: when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Sobal: and Joab returned and slew of Edom , in the vale of the saltpits, twelve thousand men .
text_la: cum succendit Mesopotamiam Syriæ et Sobal, et convertit Joab, et percussit Idumæam in valle Salinarum duodecim millia.
text_pt: Livra-me dos que praticam a iniqüidade, e salva-me dos homens sanguinários.
text_el: ὁπότε ἐνεπύρισεν τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας καὶ τὴν Συρίαν Σωβα καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ιωαβ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν φάραγγα τῶν ἁλῶν δώδεκα χιλιάδας

text_en: O God , you have cast us off, and have destroyed us; you have been angry , and have had mercy on us.
text_la: Deus, repulisti nos, et destruxisti nos; iratus es, et misertus es nobis.
text_pt: Pois eis que põem ciladas à minha alma; os fortes se ajuntam contra mim, não por transgressão minha ou por pecado meu, ó Senhor.
text_el: ὁ θεός ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς καὶ καθεῖλες ἡμᾶς ὠργίσθης καὶ οἰκτίρησας ἡμᾶς

text_en: You have moved the earth, and have troubled it: heal the breaches thereof, for it has been moved.
text_la: Commovisti terram, et conturbasti eam; sana contritiones ejus, quia commota est.
text_pt: Eles correm, e se preparam, sem culpa minha; desperta para me ajudares, e olha.
text_el: συνέσεισας τὴν γῆν καὶ συνετάραξας αὐτήν ἴασαι τὰ συντρίμματα αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐσαλεύθη

text_en: You have shown your people hard things; you have made us drink the wine of sorrow.
text_la: Ostendisti populo tuo dura; potasti nos vino compunctionis.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó Senhor, Deus dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, desperta para visitares todos os gentios; não tenhas misericórdia de nenhum dos pérfidos que praticam a iniqüidade. (Selá.)
text_el: ἔδειξας τῷ λαῷ σου σκληρά ἐπότισας ἡμᾶς οἶνον κατανύξεως

text_en: You have given a warning to them that fear you: that they may flee from before the bow: That your beloved may be delivered.
text_la: Dedisti metuentibus te significationem, ut fugiant a facie arcus; ut liberentur dilecti tui.
text_pt: Voltam à tarde; dão ganidos como cães, e rodeiam a cidade.
text_el: ἔδωκας τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε σημείωσιν τοῦ φυγεῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου τόξου διάψαλμα

text_en: Save me with your right hand, and hear me.
text_la: Salvum fac dextera tua, et exaudi me.
text_pt: Eis que eles dão gritos com as suas bocas; espadas estão nos seus lábios, porque, dizem eles: Quem ouve?
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ῥυσθῶσιν οἱ ἀγαπητοί σου σῶσον τῇ δεξιᾷ σου καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου

text_en: God has spoken in his holy place: I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem ; and will mete out the vale of tabernacles.
text_la: Deus locutus est in sancto suo : lætabor, et partibor Sichimam; et convallem tabernaculorum metibor.
text_pt: Mas tu, Senhor, te rirás deles; zombarás de todos os gentios;
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσομαι καὶ διαμεριῶ Σικιμα καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν σκηνῶν διαμετρήσω

text_en: Galaad is mine, and Manasses is mine: and Ephraim is the strength of my head. Juda is my king:
text_la: Meus est Galaad, et meus est Manasses; et Ephraim fortitudo capitis mei. Juda rex meus;
text_pt: Por causa da sua força eu te aguardarei; pois Deus é a minha alta defesa.
text_el: ἐμός ἐστιν Γαλααδ καὶ ἐμός ἐστιν Μανασση καὶ Εφραιμ κραταίωσις τῆς κεφαλῆς μου Ιουδας βασιλεύς μου

text_en: Moab is the pot of my hope. Into Edom will I stretch out my shoe: to me the foreigners are made subject.
text_la: Moab olla spei meæ. In Idumæam extendam calceamentum meum : mihi alienigenæ subditi sunt.
text_pt: O Deus da minha misericórdia virá ao meu encontro; Deus me fará ver o meu desejo sobre os meus inimigos.
text_el: Μωαβ λέβης τῆς ἐλπίδος μου ἐπὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν ἐκτενῶ τὸ ὑπόδημά μου ἐμοὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ὑπετάγησαν

text_en: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom ?
text_la: Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam? quis deducet me usque in Idumæam?
text_pt: Não os mates, para que o meu povo não se esqueça; espalha-os pelo teu poder, e abate-os, ó Senhor, nosso escudo.
text_el: τίς ἀπάξει με εἰς πόλιν περιοχῆς τίς ὁδηγήσει με ἕως τῆς Ιδουμαίας

text_en: Will not you, O God , who have cast us off? And will not you, O God , go out with our armies?
text_la: nonne tu, Deus, qui repulisti nos? et non egredieris, Deus, in virtutibus nostris?
text_pt: Pelo pecado da sua boca e pelas palavras dos seus lábios, fiquem presos na sua soberba, e pelas maldições e pelas mentiras que falam.
text_el: οὐχὶ σύ ὁ θεός ὁ ἀπωσάμενος ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ὁ θεός ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the salvation of man .
text_la: Da nobis auxilium de tribulatione, quia vana salus hominis.
text_pt: Consome-os na tua indignação, consome-os, para que não existam, e para que saibam que Deus reina em Jacó até aos fins da terra. (Selá.)
text_el: δὸς ἡμῖν βοήθειαν ἐκ θλίψεως καὶ ματαία σωτηρία ἀνθρώπου

text_en: Through God we shall do mightily: and he shall bring to nothing them that afflict us.
text_la: In Deo faciemus virtutem; et ipse ad nihilum deducet tribulantes nos.
text_pt: E tornem a vir à tarde, e dêem ganidos como cães, e cerquem a cidade.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ θεῷ ποιήσομεν δύναμιν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξουδενώσει τοὺς θλίβοντας ἡμᾶς

text_en: Unto the end, in hymns, for David .
text_la: In finem. In hymnis David.
text_pt: Ó Deus, tu nos rejeitaste, tu nos espalhaste, tu te indignaste; oh, volta-te para nós.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Hear, O God , my supplication: be attentive to my prayer .
text_la: Exaudi, Deus, deprecationem meam; intende orationi meæ.
text_pt: Abalaste a terra, e a fendeste; sara as suas fendas, pois ela treme.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον ὁ θεός τῆς δεήσεώς μου πρόσχες τῇ προσευχῇ μου

text_en: To you have I cried from the ends of the earth: when my heart was in anguish, you have exalted me on a rock. You have conducted me;
text_la: A finibus terræ ad te clamavi, dum anxiaretur cor meum; in petra exaltasti me. Deduxisti me,
text_pt: Fizeste ver ao teu povo coisas árduas; fizeste-nos beber o vinho do atordoamento.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς πρὸς σὲ ἐκέκραξα ἐν τῷ ἀκηδιάσαι τὴν καρδίαν μου ἐν πέτρᾳ ὕψωσάς με

text_en: for you have been my hope; a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.
text_la: quia factus es spes mea : turris fortitudinis a facie inimici.
text_pt: Deste um estandarte aos que te temem, para o arvorarem no alto, por causa da verdade. (Selá.)
text_el: ὡδήγησάς με ὅτι ἐγενήθης ἐλπίς μου πύργος ἰσχύος ἀπὸ προσώπου ἐχθροῦ

text_en: In your tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: I shall be protected under the covert of your wings.
text_la: Inhabitabo in tabernaculo tuo in sæcula; protegar in velamento alarum tuarum.
text_pt: Para que os teus amados sejam livres, salva-nos com a tua destra, e ouve-nos;
text_el: παροικήσω ἐν τῷ σκηνώματί σου εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας σκεπασθήσομαι ἐν σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου διάψαλμα

text_en: For you, my God , have heard my prayer : you have given an inheritance to them that fear your name .
text_la: Quoniam tu, Deus meus, exaudisti orationem meam; dedisti hæreditatem timentibus nomen tuum.
text_pt: Deus falou na sua santidade; eu me regozijarei, repartirei a Siquém e medirei o vale de Sucote.
text_el: ὅτι σύ ὁ θεός εἰσήκουσας τῶν εὐχῶν μου ἔδωκας κληρονομίαν τοῖς φοβουμένοις τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: You will add days to the days of the king: his years even to generation and generation .
text_la: Dies super dies regis adjicies; annos ejus usque in diem generationis et generationis.
text_pt: Meu é Gileade, e meu é Manassés; Efraim é a força da minha cabeça; Judá é o meu legislador.
text_el: ἡμέρας ἐφ' ἡμέρας βασιλέως προσθήσεις ἔτη αὐτοῦ ἕως ἡμέρας γενεᾶς καὶ γενεᾶς

text_en: He abides for ever in the sight of God : his mercy and truth who shall search?
text_la: Permanet in æternum in conspectu Dei : misericordiam et veritatem ejus quis requiret?
text_pt: Moabe é a minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei o meu sapato; alegra-te, ó Filístia, por minha causa.
text_el: διαμενεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθειαν αὐτοῦ τίς ἐκζητήσει

text_en: So will I sing a psalm to your name for ever and ever: that I may pay my vows from day to day.
text_la: Sic psalmum dicam nomini tuo in sæculum sæculi, ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
text_pt: Quem me conduzirá à cidade forte? Quem me guiará até Edom?.
text_el: οὕτως ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος τοῦ ἀποδοῦναί με τὰς εὐχάς μου ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας

text_en: Unto the end, for Idithun, a psalm of David .
text_la: In finem, pro Idithun. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Ouve, ó Deus, o meu clamor; atende à minha oração.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ Ιδιθουν ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Shall not my soul be subject to God ? For from him is my salvation .
text_la: Nonne Deo subjecta erit anima mea? ab ipso enim salutare meum.
text_pt: Desde o fim da terra clamarei a ti, quando o meu coração estiver desmaiado; leva-me para a rocha que é mais alta do que eu.
text_el: οὐχὶ τῷ θεῷ ὑποταγήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου παρ' αὐτοῦ γὰρ τὸ σωτήριόν μου

text_en: For he is my God and my saviour: he is my protector, I shall be moved no more.
text_la: Nam et ipse Deus meus et salutaris meus; susceptor meus, non movebor amplius.
text_pt: Pois tens sido um refúgio para mim, e uma torre forte contra o inimigo.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ αὐτὸς θεός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ ἐπὶ πλεῖον

text_en: How long do you rush in upon a man ? You all kill, as if you were thrusting down a leaning wall, and a tottering fence.
text_la: Quousque irruitis in hominem? interficitis universi vos, tamquam parieti inclinato et maceriæ depulsæ.
text_pt: Habitarei no teu tabernáculo para sempre; abrigar-me-ei no esconderijo das tuas asas. (Selá.)
text_el: ἕως πότε ἐπιτίθεσθε ἐπ' ἄνθρωπον φονεύετε πάντες ὡς τοίχῳ κεκλιμένῳ καὶ φραγμῷ ὠσμένῳ

text_en: But they have thought to cast away my price; I ran in thirst: they blessed with their mouth, but cursed with their heart.
text_la: Verumtamen pretium meum cogitaverunt repellere; cucurri in siti : ore suo benedicebant, et corde suo maledicebant.
text_pt: Pois tu, ó Deus, ouviste os meus votos; deste-me a herança dos que temem o teu nome.
text_el: πλὴν τὴν τιμήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο ἀπώσασθαι ἔδραμον ἐν ψεύδει τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν εὐλογοῦσαν καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν κατηρῶντο διάψαλμα

text_en: But be, O my soul , subject to God : for from him is my patience.
text_la: Verumtamen Deo subjecta esto, anima mea, quoniam ab ipso patientia mea:
text_pt: Prolongarás os dias do rei; e os seus anos serão como muitas gerações.
text_el: πλὴν τῷ θεῷ ὑποτάγηθι ἡ ψυχή μου ὅτι παρ' αὐτοῦ ἡ ὑπομονή μου

text_en: For he is my God and my saviour: he is my helper, I shall not be moved.
text_la: quia ipse Deus meus et salvator meus, adjutor meus, non emigrabo.
text_pt: Ele permanecerá diante de Deus para sempre; prepara-lhe misericórdia e verdade que o preservem.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτὸς θεός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου οὐ μὴ μεταναστεύσω

text_en: In God is my salvation and my glory : he is the God of my help, and my hope is in God .
text_la: In Deo salutare meum et gloria mea; Deus auxilii mei, et spes mea in Deo est.
text_pt: Assim cantarei louvores ao teu nome perpetuamente, para pagar os meus votos de dia em dia.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τὸ σωτήριόν μου καὶ ἡ δόξα μου ὁ θεὸς τῆς βοηθείας μου καὶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ

text_en: Trust in him, all you congregation of people: pour out your hearts before him. God is our helper for ever.
text_la: Sperate in eo, omnis congregatio populi; effundite coram illo corda vestra : Deus adjutor noster in æternum.
text_el: ἐλπίσατε ἐπ' αὐτόν πᾶσα συναγωγὴ λαοῦ ἐκχέετε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὁ θεὸς βοηθὸς ἡμῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: But vain are the sons of men , the sons of men are liars in the balances: that by vanity they may together deceive.
text_la: Verumtamen vani filii hominum, mendaces filii hominum in stateris, ut decipiant ipsi de vanitate in idipsum.
text_el: πλὴν μάταιοι οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ψευδεῖς οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν ζυγοῖς τοῦ ἀδικῆσαι αὐτοὶ ἐκ ματαιότητος ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: Trust not in iniquity , and cover not robberies: if riches abound, set not your heart upon them.
text_la: Nolite sperare in iniquitate, et rapinas nolite concupiscere; divitiæ si affluant, nolite cor apponere.
text_el: μὴ ἐλπίζετε ἐπὶ ἀδικίαν καὶ ἐπὶ ἅρπαγμα μὴ ἐπιποθεῖτε πλοῦτος ἐὰν ῥέῃ μὴ προστίθεσθε καρδίαν

text_en: God has spoken once, these two things have I heard, that power belongs to God ,
text_la: Semel locutus est Deus; duo hæc audivi : quia potestas Dei est,
text_el: ἅπαξ ἐλάλησεν ὁ θεός δύο ταῦτα ἤκουσα

text_en: and mercy to you, O Lord ; for you will render to every man according to his works.
text_la: et tibi, Domine, misericordia : quia tu reddes unicuique juxta opera sua.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ κράτος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ σοί κύριε τὸ ἔλεος ὅτι σὺ ἀποδώσεις ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: A psalm of David while he was in the desert of Edom .
text_la: Psalmus David, cum esset in deserto Idumææ.
text_pt: A minha alma espera somente em Deus; dele vem a minha salvação.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ιουδαίας

text_en: O God , my God , to you do I watch at break of day. For you my soul has thirsted; for you my flesh, O how many ways!
text_la: Deus, Deus meus, ad te de luce vigilo. Sitivit in te anima mea; quam multipliciter tibi caro mea!
text_pt: Só ele é a minha rocha e a minha salvação; é a minha defesa; não serei grandemente abalado.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου πρὸς σὲ ὀρθρίζω ἐδίψησέν σοι ἡ ψυχή μου ποσαπλῶς σοι ἡ σάρξ μου ἐν γῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἀβάτῳ καὶ ἀνύδρῳ

text_en: In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: so in the sanctuary have I come before you, to see your power and your glory .
text_la: In terra deserta, et invia, et inaquosa, sic in sancto apparui tibi, ut viderem virtutem tuam et gloriam tuam.
text_pt: Até quando maquinareis o mal contra um homem? Sereis mortos todos vós, sereis como uma parede encurvada e uma sebe prestes a cair.
text_el: οὕτως ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὤφθην σοι τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ τὴν δόξαν σου

text_en: For your mercy is better than lives: you my lips will praise.
text_la: Quoniam melior est misericordia tua super vitas, labia mea laudabunt te.
text_pt: Eles somente consultam como o hão de derrubar da sua excelência; deleitam-se em mentiras; com a boca bendizem, mas nas suas entranhas maldizem. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι κρεῖσσον τὸ ἔλεός σου ὑπὲρ ζωάς τὰ χείλη μου ἐπαινέσουσίν σε

text_en: Thus will I bless you all my life long: and in your name I will lift up my hands.
text_la: Sic benedicam te in vita mea, et in nomine tuo levabo manus meas.
text_pt: Ó minha alma, espera somente em Deus, porque dele vem a minha esperança.
text_el: οὕτως εὐλογήσω σε ἐν τῇ ζωῇ μου ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀρῶ τὰς χεῖράς μου

text_en: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: and my mouth shall praise you with joyful lips.
text_la: Sicut adipe et pinguedine repleatur anima mea, et labiis exsultationis laudabit os meum.
text_pt: Só ele é a minha rocha e a minha salvação; é a minha defesa; não serei abalado.
text_el: ὡσεὶ στέατος καὶ πιότητος ἐμπλησθείη ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ χείλη ἀγαλλιάσεως αἰνέσει τὸ στόμα μου

text_en: If I have remembered you upon my bed, I will meditate on you in the morning:
text_la: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutinis meditabor in te.
text_pt: Em Deus está a minha salvação e a minha glória; a rocha da minha fortaleza, e o meu refúgio estão em Deus.
text_el: εἰ ἐμνημόνευόν σου ἐπὶ τῆς στρωμνῆς μου ἐν τοῖς ὄρθροις ἐμελέτων εἰς σέ

text_en: Because you have been my helper. And I will rejoice under the covert of your wings:
text_la: Quia fuisti adjutor meus, et in velamento alarum tuarum exsultabo.
text_pt: Confiai nele, ó povo, em todos os tempos; derramai perante ele o vosso coração. Deus é o nosso refúgio. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι ἐγενήθης βοηθός μου καὶ ἐν τῇ σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου ἀγαλλιάσομαι

text_en: My soul has stuck close to you: your right hand has received me.
text_la: Adhæsit anima mea post te; me suscepit dextera tua.
text_pt: Certamente que os homens de classe baixa são vaidade, e os homens de ordem elevada são mentira; pesados em balanças, eles juntos são mais leves do que a vaidade.
text_el: ἐκολλήθη ἡ ψυχή μου ὀπίσω σου ἐμοῦ ἀντελάβετο ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: But they have fought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth:
text_la: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsierunt animam meam : introibunt in inferiora terræ;
text_pt: Não confieis na opressão, nem vos ensoberbeçais na rapina; se as vossas riquezas aumentam, não ponhais nelas o coração.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς μάτην ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὰ κατώτατα τῆς γῆς

text_en: They shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.
text_la: tradentur in manus gladii : partes vulpium erunt.
text_pt: Deus falou uma vez; duas vezes ouvi isto: que o poder pertence a Deus.
text_el: παραδοθήσονται εἰς χεῖρας ῥομφαίας μερίδες ἀλωπέκων ἔσονται

text_en: But the king shall rejoice in God , all they shall be praised that swear by him: because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.
text_la: Rex vero lætabitur in Deo; laudabuntur omnes qui jurant in eo : quia obstructum est os loquentium iniqua.
text_pt: A ti também, Senhor, pertence a misericórdia; pois retribuirás a cada um segundo a sua obra.
text_el: ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ ἐπαινεσθήσεται πᾶς ὁ ὀμνύων ἐν αὐτῷ ὅτι ἐνεφράγη στόμα λαλούντων ἄδικα

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: O Deus, tu és o meu Deus, de madrugada te buscarei; a minha alma tem sede de ti; a minha carne te deseja muito em uma terra seca e cansada, onde não há água;
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Hear O God , my prayer , when I make supplication to you: deliver my soul from the fear of the enemy.
text_la: Exaudi, Deus, orationem meam cum deprecor; a timore inimici eripe animam meam.
text_pt: Para ver a tua força e a tua glória, como te vi no santuário.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον ὁ θεός τῆς φωνῆς μου ἐν τῷ δέεσθαί με ἀπὸ φόβου ἐχθροῦ ἐξελοῦ τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: You have protected me from the assembly of the malignant; from the multitude of the workers of iniquity .
text_la: Protexisti me a conventu malignantium, a multitudine operantium iniquitatem.
text_pt: Porque a tua benignidade é melhor do que a vida, os meus lábios te louvarão.
text_el: ἐσκέπασάς με ἀπὸ συστροφῆς πονηρευομένων ἀπὸ πλήθους ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: For they have whetted their tongues like a sword; they have bent their bow a bitter thing,
text_la: Quia exacuerunt ut gladium linguas suas; intenderunt arcum rem amaram,
text_pt: Assim eu te bendirei enquanto viver; em teu nome levantarei as minhas mãos.
text_el: οἵτινες ἠκόνησαν ὡς ῥομφαίαν τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐνέτειναν τόξον αὐτῶν πρᾶγμα πικρὸν

text_en: to shoot in secret the undefiled.
text_la: ut sagittent in occultis immaculatum.
text_pt: A minha alma se fartará, como de tutano e de gordura; e a minha boca te louvará com alegres lábios,
text_el: τοῦ κατατοξεῦσαι ἐν ἀποκρύφοις ἄμωμον ἐξάπινα κατατοξεύσουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσονται

text_en: They will shoot at him on a sudden, and will not fear: they are resolute in wickedness . They have talked of hiding snares; they have said: Who shall see them?
text_la: Subito sagittabunt eum, et non timebunt; firmaverunt sibi sermonem nequam. Narraverunt ut absconderent laqueos; dixerunt : Quis videbit eos?
text_pt: Quando me lembrar de ti na minha cama, e meditar em ti nas vigílias da noite.
text_el: ἐκραταίωσαν ἑαυτοῖς λόγον πονηρόν διηγήσαντο τοῦ κρύψαι παγίδας εἶπαν τίς ὄψεται αὐτούς

text_en: They have searched after iniquities : they have failed in their search. Man shall come to a deep heart:
text_la: Scrutati sunt iniquitates; defecerunt scrutantes scrutinio. Accedet homo ad cor altum,
text_pt: Porque tu tens sido o meu auxílio; então, à sombra das tuas asas me regozijarei.
text_el: ἐξηρεύνησαν ἀνομίας ἐξέλιπον ἐξερευνῶντες ἐξερευνήσει προσελεύσεται ἄνθρωπος καὶ καρδία βαθεῖα

text_en: And God shall be exalted. The arrows of children are their wounds:
text_la: et exaltabitur Deus. Sagittæ parvulorum factæ sunt plagæ eorum,
text_pt: A minha alma te segue de perto; a tua destra me sustenta.
text_el: καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὁ θεός βέλος νηπίων ἐγενήθησαν αἱ πληγαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: And their tongues against them are made weak. All that saw them were troubled;
text_la: et infirmatæ sunt contra eos linguæ eorum. Conturbati sunt omnes qui videbant eos,
text_pt: Mas aqueles que procuram a minha alma para a destruir, irão para as profundezas da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξησθένησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς αἱ γλῶσσαι αὐτῶν ἐταράχθησαν πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτούς

text_en: and every man was afraid. And they declared the works of God , and understood his doings.
text_la: et timuit omnis homo. Et annuntiaverunt opera Dei, et facta ejus intellexerunt.
text_pt: Cairão à espada; serão uma ração para as raposas.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη πᾶς ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὰ ποιήματα αὐτοῦ συνῆκαν

text_en: The just shall rejoice in the Lord , and shall hope in him: and all the upright in heart shall be praised.
text_la: Lætabitur justus in Domino, et sperabit in eo, et laudabuntur omnes recti corde.
text_pt: Mas o rei se regozijará em Deus; qualquer que por ele jurar se gloriará; porque se taparão as bocas dos que falam a mentira.
text_el: εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐλπιεῖ ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἐπαινεσθήσονται πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: To the end, a psalm of David . The canticle of Jeremiah and Ezechiel to the people of the captivity, when they began to go out.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David, canticum Jeremiæ et Ezechielis populo transmigrationis, cum inciperent exire.
text_pt: Ouve, ó Deus, a minha voz na minha oração; guarda a minha vida do temor do inimigo.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ᾠδή Ιερεμιου καὶ Ιεζεκιηλ ἐκ τοῦ λόγου τῆς παροικίας ὅτε ἔμελλον ἐκπορεύεσθαι

text_en: A hymn, O God , becomes you in Sion: and a vow shall be paid to you in Jerusalem .
text_la: Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion, et tibi reddetur votum in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Esconde-me do secreto conselho dos maus, e do tumulto dos que praticam a iniqüidade.
text_el: σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος ὁ θεός ἐν Σιων καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχὴ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: O hear my prayer : all flesh shall come to you.
text_la: Exaudi orationem meam; ad te omnis caro veniet.
text_pt: Que afiaram as suas línguas como espadas; e armaram por suas flechas palavras amargas,
text_el: εἰσάκουσον προσευχῆς μου πρὸς σὲ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἥξει

text_en: The words of the wicked have prevailed over us: and you will pardon our transgressions.
text_la: Verba iniquorum prævaluerunt super nos, et impietatibus nostris tu propitiaberis.
text_pt: A fim de atirarem em lugar oculto ao que é íntegro; disparam sobre ele repentinamente, e não temem.
text_el: λόγοι ἀνομιῶν ὑπερεδυνάμωσαν ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰς ἀσεβείας ἡμῶν σὺ ἱλάσῃ

text_en: Blessed is he whom you have chosen and taken to you: he shall dwell in your courts . We shall be filled with the good things of your house; holy is your temple ,
text_la: Beatus quem elegisti et assumpsisti : inhabitabit in atriis tuis. Replebimur in bonis domus tuæ; sanctum est templum tuum,
text_pt: Firmam-se em mau intento; falam de armar laços secretamente, e dizem: Quem os verá?
text_el: μακάριος ὃν ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου κατασκηνώσει ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου πλησθησόμεθα ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς τοῦ οἴκου σου ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: wonderful in justice . Hear us, O God our saviour, who is the hope of all the ends of the earth, and in the sea afar off.
text_la: mirabile in æquitate. Exaudi nos, Deus, salutaris noster, spes omnium finium terræ, et in mari longe.
text_pt: Andam inquirindo malícias, inquirem tudo o que se pode inquirir; e ambos, o íntimo pensamento de cada um deles, e o coração, são profundos.
text_el: ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν ἡ ἐλπὶς πάντων τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐν θαλάσσῃ μακράν

text_en: You who prepares the mountains by your strength, being girded with power:
text_la: Præparans montes in virtute tua, accinctus potentia;
text_pt: Mas Deus atirará sobre eles uma seta, e de repente ficarão feridos.
text_el: ἑτοιμάζων ὄρη ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ περιεζωσμένος ἐν δυναστείᾳ

text_en: Who troubles the depth of the sea, the noise of its waves. The Gentiles shall be troubled,
text_la: qui conturbas profundum maris, sonum fluctuum ejus. Turbabuntur gentes,
text_pt: Assim eles farão com que as suas línguas tropecem contra si mesmos; todos aqueles que os virem, fugirão.
text_el: ὁ συνταράσσων τὸ κύτος τῆς θαλάσσης ἤχους κυμάτων αὐτῆς ταραχθήσονται τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: and they that dwell in the uttermost borders shall be afraid at your signs: you shall make the outgoings of the morning and of the evening to be joyful.
text_la: et timebunt qui habitant terminos a signis tuis; exitus matutini et vespere delectabis.
text_pt: E todos os homens temerão, e anunciarão a obra de Deus; e considerarão prudentemente os feitos dele.
text_el: καὶ φοβηθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὰ πέρατα ἀπὸ τῶν σημείων σου ἐξόδους πρωίας καὶ ἑσπέρας τέρψεις

text_en: You have visited the earth, and have plentifully watered it; you have many ways enriched it. The river of God is filled with water, you have prepared their food: for so is its preparation.
text_la: Visitasti terram, et inebriasti eam; multiplicasti locupletare eam. Flumen Dei repletum est aquis; parasti cibum illorum : quoniam ita est præparatio ejus.
text_pt: O justo se alegrará no Senhor, e confiará nele, e todos os retos de coração se gloriarão.
text_el: ἐπεσκέψω τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐμέθυσας αὐτήν ἐπλήθυνας τοῦ πλουτίσαι αὐτήν ὁ ποταμὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπληρώθη ὑδάτων ἡτοίμασας τὴν τροφὴν αὐτῶν ὅτι οὕτως ἡ ἑτοιμασία σου

text_en: Fill up plentifully the streams thereof, multiply its fruits; it shall spring up and rejoice in its showers.
text_la: Rivos ejus inebria; multiplica genimina ejus : in stillicidiis ejus lætabitur germinans.
text_el: τοὺς αὔλακας αὐτῆς μέθυσον πλήθυνον τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς ἐν ταῖς σταγόσιν αὐτῆς εὐφρανθήσεται ἀνατέλλουσα

text_en: You shall bless the crown of the year of your goodness: and your fields shall be filled with plenty.
text_la: Benedices coronæ anni benignitatis tuæ, et campi tui replebuntur ubertate.
text_el: εὐλογήσεις τὸν στέφανον τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ τῆς χρηστότητός σου καὶ τὰ πεδία σου πλησθήσονται πιότητος

text_en: The beautiful places of the wilderness shall grow fat: and the hills shall be girded about with joy ,
text_la: Pinguescent speciosa deserti, et exsultatione colles accingentur.
text_el: πιανθήσονται τὰ ὡραῖα τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἀγαλλίασιν οἱ βουνοὶ περιζώσονται

text_en: the rams of the flock are clothed, and the vales shall abound with corn: they shall shout, yea they shall sing a hymn.
text_la: Induti sunt arietes ovium, et valles abundabunt frumento; clamabunt, etenim hymnum dicent.
text_el: ἐνεδύσαντο οἱ κριοὶ τῶν προβάτων καὶ αἱ κοιλάδες πληθυνοῦσι σῖτον κεκράξονται καὶ γὰρ ὑμνήσουσιν

text_en: Shout with joy to God , all the earth,
text_la: Jubilate Deo, omnis terra;
text_pt: A ti, ó Deus, espera o louvor em Sião, e a ti se pagará o voto.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ᾠδὴ ψαλμοῦ ἀναστάσεως ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: sing a psalm to his name ; give glory to his praise.
text_la: psalmum dicite nomini ejus; date gloriam laudi ejus.
text_pt: Ó tu que ouves as orações, a ti virá toda a carne.
text_el: ψάλατε δὴ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ δότε δόξαν αἰνέσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: Say unto God , How terrible are your works, O Lord ! In the multitude of your strength your enemies shall lie to you.
text_la: Dicite Deo : Quam terribilia sunt opera tua, Domine! in multitudine virtutis tuæ mentientur tibi inimici tui.
text_pt: Prevalecem as iniqüidades contra mim; porém tu limpas as nossas transgressões.
text_el: εἴπατε τῷ θεῷ ὡς φοβερὰ τὰ ἔργα σου ἐν τῷ πλήθει τῆς δυνάμεώς σου ψεύσονταί σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου

text_en: Let all the earth adore you, and sing to you: let it sing a psalm to your name .
text_la: Omnis terra adoret te, et psallat tibi; psalmum dicat nomini tuo.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele a quem tu escolhes, e fazes chegar a ti, para que habite em teus átrios; nós seremos fartos da bondade da tua casa e do teu santo templo.
text_el: πᾶσα ἡ γῆ προσκυνησάτωσάν σοι καὶ ψαλάτωσάν σοι ψαλάτωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου διάψαλμα

text_en: Come and see the works of God ; who is terrible in his counsels over the sons of men .
text_la: Venite, et videte opera Dei : terribilis in consiliis super filios hominum.
text_pt: Com coisas tremendas em justiça nos responderás, ó Deus da nossa salvação; tu és a esperança de todas as extremidades da terra, e daqueles que estão longe sobre o mar.
text_el: δεῦτε καὶ ἴδετε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ φοβερὸς ἐν βουλαῖς ὑπὲρ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: Who turns the sea into dry land, in the river they shall pass on foot: there shall we rejoice in him.
text_la: Qui convertit mare in aridam; in flumine pertransibunt pede : ibi lætabimur in ipso.
text_pt: O que pela sua força consolida os montes, cingido de fortaleza;
text_el: ὁ μεταστρέφων τὴν θάλασσαν εἰς ξηράν ἐν ποταμῷ διελεύσονται ποδί ἐκεῖ εὐφρανθησόμεθα ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: Who by his power rules for ever: his eyes behold the nations; let not them that provoke him be exalted in themselves.
text_la: Qui dominatur in virtute sua in æternum; oculi ejus super gentes respiciunt : qui exasperant non exaltentur in semetipsis.
text_pt: O que aplaca o ruído dos mares, o ruído das suas ondas, e o tumulto dos povos.
text_el: τῷ δεσπόζοντι ἐν τῇ δυναστείᾳ αὐτοῦ τοῦ αἰῶνος οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιβλέπουσιν οἱ παραπικραίνοντες μὴ ὑψούσθωσαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς διάψαλμα

text_en: O bless our God , you Gentiles : and make the voice of his praise to be heard.
text_la: Benedicite, gentes, Deum nostrum, et auditam facite vocem laudis ejus:
text_pt: E os que habitam nos fins da terra temem os teus sinais; tu fazes alegres as saídas da manhã e da tarde.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ἔθνη τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ ἀκουτίσασθε τὴν φωνὴν τῆς αἰνέσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who has set my soul to live: and has not suffered my feet to be moved:
text_la: qui posuit animam meam ad vitam, et non dedit in commotionem pedes meos.
text_pt: Tu visitas a terra, e a refrescas; tu a enriqueces grandemente com o rio de Deus, que está cheio de água; tu lhe preparas o trigo, quando assim a tens preparada.
text_el: τοῦ θεμένου τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ζωὴν καὶ μὴ δόντος εἰς σάλον τοὺς πόδας μου

text_en: For you, O God , have proved us: you have tried us by fire, as silver is tried.
text_la: Quoniam probasti nos, Deus; igne nos examinasti, sicut examinatur argentum.
text_pt: Enches de água os seus sulcos; tu lhe aplanas as leivas; tu a amoleces com a muita chuva; abençoas as suas novidades.
text_el: ὅτι ἐδοκίμασας ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός ἐπύρωσας ἡμᾶς ὡς πυροῦται τὸ ἀργύριον

text_en: You have brought us into a net, you have laid afflictions on our back:
text_la: Induxisti nos in laqueum; posuisti tribulationes in dorso nostro;
text_pt: Coroas o ano com a tua bondade, e as tuas veredas destilam gordura.
text_el: εἰσήγαγες ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν παγίδα ἔθου θλίψεις ἐπὶ τὸν νῶτον ἡμῶν

text_en: You have set men over our heads. We have passed through fire and water, and you have brought us out into a refreshment.
text_la: imposuisti homines super capita nostra. Transivimus per ignem et aquam, et eduxisti nos in refrigerium.
text_pt: Destilam sobre os pastos do deserto, e os outeiros os cingem de alegria.
text_el: ἐπεβίβασας ἀνθρώπους ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς ἡμῶν διήλθομεν διὰ πυρὸς καὶ ὕδατος καὶ ἐξήγαγες ἡμᾶς εἰς ἀναψυχήν

text_en: I will go into your house with burnt offerings : I will pay you my vows ,
text_la: Introibo in domum tuam in holocaustis; reddam tibi vota mea
text_pt: Os campos se vestem de rebanhos, e os vales se cobrem de trigo; eles se regozijam e cantam.
text_el: εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου ἐν ὁλοκαυτώμασιν ἀποδώσω σοι τὰς εὐχάς μου

text_en: which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.
text_la: quæ distinxerunt labia mea: et locutum est os meum in tribulatione mea.
text_el: ἃς διέστειλεν τὰ χείλη μου καὶ ἐλάλησεν τὸ στόμα μου ἐν τῇ θλίψει μου

text_en: I will offer up to you holocausts full of marrow, with burnt offerings of rams: I will offer to you bullocks with goats.
text_la: Holocausta medullata offeram tibi, cum incenso arietum; offeram tibi boves cum hircis.
text_el: ὁλοκαυτώματα μεμυαλωμένα ἀνοίσω σοι μετὰ θυμιάματος καὶ κριῶν ποιήσω σοι βόας μετὰ χιμάρων διάψαλμα

text_en: Come and hear, all you that fear God , and I will tell you what great things he has done for my soul .
text_la: Venite, audite, et narrabo, omnes qui timetis Deum, quanta fecit animæ meæ.
text_el: δεῦτε ἀκούσατε καὶ διηγήσομαι πάντες οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν θεόν ὅσα ἐποίησεν τῇ ψυχῇ μου

text_en: I cried to him with my mouth: and I extolled him with my tongue.
text_la: Ad ipsum ore meo clamavi, et exaltavi sub lingua mea.
text_el: πρὸς αὐτὸν τῷ στόματί μου ἐκέκραξα καὶ ὕψωσα ὑπὸ τὴν γλῶσσάν μου

text_en: If I have looked at iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me.
text_la: Iniquitatem si aspexi in corde meo, non exaudiet Dominus.
text_el: ἀδικίαν εἰ ἐθεώρουν ἐν καρδίᾳ μου μὴ εἰσακουσάτω κύριος

text_en: Therefore has God heard me, and has attended to the voice of my supplication.
text_la: Propterea exaudivit Deus, et attendit voci deprecationis meæ.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰσήκουσέν μου ὁ θεός προσέσχεν τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: Blessed be God , who has not turned away my prayer , nor his mercy from me.
text_la: Benedictus Deus, qui non amovit orationem meam, et misericordiam suam a me.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεός ὃς οὐκ ἀπέστησεν τὴν προσευχήν μου καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Unto the end, in hymns, a psalm of a canticle for David .
text_la: In finem, in hymnis. Psalmus cantici David.
text_pt: Celebrai com júbilo a Deus, todas as terras.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς

text_en: May God have mercy on us, and bless us: may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.
text_la: Deus misereatur nostri, et benedicat nobis; illuminet vultum suum super nos, et misereatur nostri:
text_pt: Cantai a glória do seu nome; dai glória ao seu louvor.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς οἰκτιρήσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ἐπιφάναι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς διάψαλμα

text_en: That we may know your way upon earth: your salvation in all nations.
text_la: ut cognoscamus in terra viam tuam, in omnibus gentibus salutare tuum.
text_pt: Dizei a Deus: Quão tremendo és tu nas tuas obras! Pela grandeza do teu poder se submeterão a ti os teus inimigos.
text_el: τοῦ γνῶναι ἐν τῇ γῇ τὴν ὁδόν σου ἐν πᾶσιν ἔθνεσιν τὸ σωτήριόν σου

text_en: Let people confess to you, O God : let all people give praise to you.
text_la: Confiteantur tibi populi, Deus : confiteantur tibi populi omnes.
text_pt: Todos os moradores da terra te adorarão e te cantarão; cantarão o teu nome. (Selá.)
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοί ὁ θεός ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ πάντες

text_en: Let the nations be glad and rejoice: for you judge the people with justice , and direct the nations upon earth.
text_la: Lætentur et exsultent gentes, quoniam judicas populos in æquitate, et gentes in terra dirigis.
text_pt: Vinde, e vede as obras de Deus: é tremendo nos seus feitos para com os filhos dos homens.
text_el: εὐφρανθήτωσαν καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἔθνη ὅτι κρινεῖς λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι καὶ ἔθνη ἐν τῇ γῇ ὁδηγήσεις διάψαλμα

text_en: Let the people, O God , confess to you: let all the people give praise to you:
text_la: Confiteantur tibi populi, Deus : confiteantur tibi populi omnes.
text_pt: Converteu o mar em terra seca; passaram o rio a pé; ali nos alegramos nele.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοί ὁ θεός ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι λαοὶ πάντες

text_en: The earth has yielded her fruit. May God , our God bless us,
text_la: Terra dedit fructum suum : benedicat nos Deus, Deus noster!
text_pt: Ele domina eternamente pelo seu poder; os seus olhos estão sobre as nações; não se exaltem os rebeldes. (Selá.)
text_el: γῆ ἔδωκεν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: may God bless us: and all the ends of the earth fear him.
text_la: Benedicat nos Deus, et metuant eum omnes fines terræ.
text_pt: Bendizei, povos, ao nosso Deus, e fazei ouvir a voz do seu louvor,
text_el: εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός καὶ φοβηθήτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm of a canticle for David himself.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus cantici ipsi David.
text_pt: Deus tenha misericórdia de nós e nos abençoe; e faça resplandecer o seu rosto sobre nós (Selá.)
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ Δαυιδ ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς

text_en: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered: and let them that hate him flee from before his face.
text_la: Exsurgat Deus, et dissipentur inimici ejus; et fugiant qui oderunt eum a facie ejus.
text_pt: Para que se conheça na terra o teu caminho, e entre todas as nações a tua salvação.
text_el: ἀναστήτω ὁ θεός καὶ διασκορπισθήτωσαν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ φυγέτωσαν οἱ μισοῦντες αὐτὸν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: As smoke vanishes, so let them vanish away: as wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God .
text_la: Sicut deficit fumus, deficiant; sicut fluit cera a facie ignis, sic pereant peccatores a facie Dei.
text_pt: Louvem-te a ti, ó Deus, os povos; louvem-te os povos todos.
text_el: ὡς ἐκλείπει καπνός ἐκλιπέτωσαν ὡς τήκεται κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου πυρός οὕτως ἀπόλοιντο οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And let the just feast, and rejoice before God : and be delighted with gladness.
text_la: Et justi epulentur, et exsultent in conspectu Dei, et delectentur in lætitia.
text_pt: Alegrem-se e regozijem-se as nações, pois julgarás os povos com eqüidade, e governarás as nações sobre a terra. (Selá.)
text_el: καὶ οἱ δίκαιοι εὐφρανθήτωσαν ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ τερφθήτωσαν ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ

text_en: Sing to God , sing a psalm to his name , make a way for him who ascends upon the west: the Lord is his name . Rejoice before him: but the wicked shall be troubled at his presence,
text_la: Cantate Deo; psalmum dicite nomini ejus : iter facite ei qui ascendit super occasum. Dominus nomen illi; exsultate in conspectu ejus. Turbabuntur a facie ejus,
text_pt: Louvem-te a ti, ó Deus, os povos; louvem-te os povos todos.
text_el: ᾄσατε τῷ θεῷ ψάλατε τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ὁδοποιήσατε τῷ ἐπιβεβηκότι ἐπὶ δυσμῶν κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ταραχθήσονται ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: who is the father of orphans, and the judge of widows. God in his holy place:
text_la: patris orphanorum, et judicis viduarum; Deus in loco sancto suo.
text_pt: Então a terra dará o seu fruto; e Deus, o nosso Deus, nos abençoará.
text_el: τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὀρφανῶν καὶ κριτοῦ τῶν χηρῶν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: God who makes men of one manner to dwell in a house: Who brings out them that were bound in strength; in like manner them that provoke, that dwell in sepulchres.
text_la: Deus qui inhabitare facit unius moris in domo; qui educit vinctos in fortitudine, similiter eos qui exasperant, qui habitant in sepulchris.
text_pt: Deus nos abençoará, e todas as extremidades da terra o temerão.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς κατοικίζει μονοτρόπους ἐν οἴκῳ ἐξάγων πεπεδημένους ἐν ἀνδρείᾳ ὁμοίως τοὺς παραπικραίνοντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τάφοις

text_en: O God , when you went forth in the sight of your people, when you passed through the desert :
text_la: Deus, cum egredereris in conspectu populi tui, cum pertransires in deserto,
text_el: ὁ θεός ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαί σε ἐνώπιον τοῦ λαοῦ σου ἐν τῷ διαβαίνειν σε ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ διάψαλμα

text_en: The earth was moved, and the heavens dropped at the presence of the God of Sina , at the presence of the God of Israel .
text_la: terra mota est, etenim cæli distillaverunt, a facie Dei Sinai, a facie Dei Israël.
text_el: γῆ ἐσείσθη καὶ γὰρ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ἔσταξαν ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦτο Σινα ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: You shall set aside for your inheritance a free rain, O God : and it was weakened, but you have made it perfect.
text_la: Pluviam voluntariam segregabis, Deus, hæreditati tuæ; et infirmata est, tu vero perfecisti eam.
text_el: βροχὴν ἑκούσιον ἀφοριεῖς ὁ θεός τῇ κληρονομίᾳ σου καὶ ἠσθένησεν σὺ δὲ κατηρτίσω αὐτήν

text_en: In it shall your animals dwell; in your sweetness, O God , you have provided for the poor.
text_la: Animalia tua habitabunt in ea; parasti in dulcedine tua pauperi, Deus.
text_el: τὰ ζῷά σου κατοικοῦσιν ἐν αὐτῇ ἡτοίμασας ἐν τῇ χρηστότητί σου τῷ πτωχῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: The Lord shall give the word to them that preach good tidings with great power.
text_la: Dominus dabit verbum evangelizantibus, virtute multa.
text_el: κύριος δώσει ῥῆμα τοῖς εὐαγγελιζομένοις δυνάμει πολλῇ

text_en: The king of powers is of the beloved, of the beloved; and the beauty of the house shall divide spoils.
text_la: Rex virtutum dilecti, dilecti; et speciei domus dividere spolia.
text_el: ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν δυνάμεων τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ καὶ ὡραιότητι τοῦ οἴκου διελέσθαι σκῦλα

text_en: If you sleep among the midst of lots, you shall be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and the hinder parts of her back with the paleness of gold.
text_la: Si dormiatis inter medios cleros, pennæ columbæ deargentatæ, et posteriora dorsi ejus in pallore auri.
text_el: ἐὰν κοιμηθῆτε ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κλήρων πτέρυγες περιστερᾶς περιηργυρωμέναι καὶ τὰ μετάφρενα αὐτῆς ἐν χλωρότητι χρυσίου διάψαλμα

text_en: When he that is in heaven appoints kings over her, they shall be whited with snow in Selmon.
text_la: Dum discernit cælestis reges super eam, nive dealbabuntur in Selmon.
text_el: ἐν τῷ διαστέλλειν τὸν ἐπουράνιον βασιλεῖς ἐπ' αὐτῆς χιονωθήσονται ἐν Σελμων

text_en: The mountain of God is a fat mountain. A curdled mountain, a fat mountain.
text_la: Mons Dei, mons pinguis : mons coagulatus, mons pinguis.
text_el: ὄρος τοῦ θεοῦ ὄρος πῖον ὄρος τετυρωμένον ὄρος πῖον

text_en: Why suspect, you curdled mountains? A mountain in which God is well pleased to dwell: for there the Lord shall dwell unto the end.
text_la: Ut quid suspicamini, montes coagulatos? mons in quo beneplacitum est Deo habitare in eo; etenim Dominus habitabit in finem.
text_el: ἵνα τί ὑπολαμβάνετε ὄρη τετυρωμένα τὸ ὄρος ὃ εὐδόκησεν ὁ θεὸς κατοικεῖν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ γὰρ ὁ κύριος κατασκηνώσει εἰς τέλος

text_en: The chariot of God is attended by ten thousands; thousands of them that rejoice: the Lord is among them in Sina , in the holy place.
text_la: Currus Dei decem millibus multiplex, millia lætantium; Dominus in eis in Sina, in sancto.
text_el: τὸ ἅρμα τοῦ θεοῦ μυριοπλάσιον χιλιάδες εὐθηνούντων ὁ κύριος ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν Σινα ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ

text_en: You have ascended on high, you have led captivity captive; you have received gifts in men . Yea for those also that do not believe , the dwelling of the Lord God .
text_la: Ascendisti in altum, cepisti captivitatem, accepisti dona in hominibus; etenim non credentes inhabitare Dominum Deum.
text_el: ἀνέβης εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσας αἰχμαλωσίαν ἔλαβες δόματα ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ καὶ γὰρ ἀπειθοῦντες τοῦ κατασκηνῶσαι κύριος ὁ θεὸς εὐλογητός

text_en: Blessed be the Lord day by day: the God of our salvation will make our journey prosperous to us.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus die quotidie : prosperum iter faciet nobis Deus salutarium nostrorum.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ἡμέραν καθ' ἡμέραν κατευοδώσει ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: Our God is the God of salvation : and of the Lord , of the Lord are the issues from death.
text_la: Deus noster, Deus salvos faciendi; et Domini, Domini exitus mortis.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν θεὸς τοῦ σῴζειν καὶ τοῦ κυρίου κυρίου αἱ διέξοδοι τοῦ θανάτου

text_en: But God shall break the heads of his enemies: the hairy crown of them that walk on in their sins .
text_la: Verumtamen Deus confringet capita inimicorum suorum, verticem capilli perambulantium in delictis suis.
text_el: πλὴν ὁ θεὸς συνθλάσει κεφαλὰς ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ κορυφὴν τριχὸς διαπορευομένων ἐν πλημμελείαις αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord said: I will turn them from Basan, I will turn them into the depth of the sea:
text_la: Dixit Dominus : Ex Basan convertam, convertam in profundum maris:
text_el: εἶπεν κύριος ἐκ Βασαν ἐπιστρέψω ἐπιστρέψω ἐν βυθοῖς θαλάσσης

text_en: That your foot may be dipped in the blood of your enemies; the tongue of your dogs be red with the same.
text_la: ut intingatur pes tuus in sanguine; lingua canum tuorum ex inimicis, ab ipso.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν βαφῇ ὁ πούς σου ἐν αἵματι ἡ γλῶσσα τῶν κυνῶν σου ἐξ ἐχθρῶν παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: They have seen your goings, O God , the goings of my God : of my king who is in his sanctuary.
text_la: Viderunt ingressus tuos, Deus, ingressus Dei mei, regis mei, qui est in sancto.
text_el: ἐθεωρήθησαν αἱ πορεῖαί σου ὁ θεός αἱ πορεῖαι τοῦ θεοῦ μου τοῦ βασιλέως τοῦ ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ

text_en: Princes went before joined with singers, in the midst of young damsels playing on timbrels.
text_la: Prævenerunt principes conjuncti psallentibus, in medio juvencularum tympanistriarum.
text_el: προέφθασαν ἄρχοντες ἐχόμενοι ψαλλόντων ἐν μέσῳ νεανίδων τυμπανιστριῶν

text_en: In the churches bless God the Lord , from the fountains of Israel .
text_la: In ecclesiis benedicite Deo Domino de fontibus Israël.
text_el: ἐν ἐκκλησίαις εὐλογεῖτε τὸν θεόν τὸν κύριον ἐκ πηγῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: There is Benjamin a youth, in ecstasy of mind. The princes of Juda are their leaders: the princes of Zabulon , the princes of Nephthali .
text_la: Ibi Benjamin adolescentulus, in mentis excessu; principes Juda, duces eorum; principes Zabulon, principes Nephthali.
text_el: ἐκεῖ Βενιαμιν νεώτερος ἐν ἐκστάσει ἄρχοντες Ιουδα ἡγεμόνες αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες Ζαβουλων ἄρχοντες Νεφθαλι

text_en: Command your strength, O God confirm, O God , what you have wrought in us.
text_la: Manda, Deus, virtuti tuæ; confirma hoc, Deus, quod operatus es in nobis.
text_el: ἔντειλαι ὁ θεός τῇ δυνάμει σου δυνάμωσον ὁ θεός τοῦτο ὃ κατειργάσω ἡμῖν

text_en: From your temple in Jerusalem , kings shall offer presents to you.
text_la: A templo tuo in Jerusalem, tibi offerent reges munera.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ ναοῦ σου ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ σοὶ οἴσουσιν βασιλεῖς δῶρα

text_en: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, the congregation of bulls with the kine of the people; who seek to exclude them who are tried with silver. Scatter the nations that delight in wars:
text_la: Increpa feras arundinis; congregatio taurorum in vaccis populorum : ut excludant eos qui probati sunt argento. Dissipa gentes quæ bella volunt.
text_el: ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ καλάμου ἡ συναγωγὴ τῶν ταύρων ἐν ταῖς δαμάλεσιν τῶν λαῶν τοῦ μὴ ἀποκλεισθῆναι τοὺς δεδοκιμασμένους τῷ ἀργυρίῳ διασκόρπισον ἔθνη τὰ τοὺς πολέμους θέλοντα

text_en: Ambassadors shall come out of Egypt : Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands to God .
text_la: Venient legati ex Ægypto; Æthiopia præveniet manus ejus Deo.
text_el: ἥξουσιν πρέσβεις ἐξ Αἰγύπτου Αἰθιοπία προφθάσει χεῖρα αὐτῆς τῷ θεῷ

text_en: Sing to God , you kingdoms of the earth: sing to the Lord : Sing to God ,
text_la: Regna terræ, cantate Deo; psallite Domino; psallite Deo.
text_el: αἱ βασιλεῖαι τῆς γῆς ᾄσατε τῷ θεῷ ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ διάψαλμα

text_en: who mounts above the heaven of heavens , to the east. Behold he will give to his voice the voice of power:
text_la: Qui ascendit super cælum cæli, ad orientem : ecce dabit voci suæ vocem virtutis.
text_el: ψάλατε τῷ θεῷ τῷ ἐπιβεβηκότι ἐπὶ τὸν οὐρανὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατὰ ἀνατολάς ἰδοὺ δώσει ἐν τῇ φωνῇ αὐτοῦ φωνὴν δυνάμεως

text_en: Give glory to God for Israel , his magnificence, and his power is in the clouds.
text_la: Date gloriam Deo super Israël; magnificentia ejus et virtus ejus in nubibus.
text_el: δότε δόξαν τῷ θεῷ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ ἡ μεγαλοπρέπεια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ δύναμις αὐτοῦ ἐν ταῖς νεφέλαις

text_en: God is wonderful in his saints: the God of Israel is he who will give power and strength to his people. Blessed be God .
text_la: Mirabilis Deus in sanctis suis; Deus Israël ipse dabit virtutem et fortitudinem plebi suæ. Benedictus Deus!
text_el: θαυμαστὸς ὁ θεὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ αὐτὸς δώσει δύναμιν καὶ κραταίωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεός

text_en: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed; for David .
text_la: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. David.
text_pt: Levante-se Deus, e sejam dissipados os seus inimigos; fugirão de diante dele os que o odeiam.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀλλοιωθησομένων τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Save me, O God : for the waters have come in even unto my soul .
text_la: Salvum me fac, Deus, quoniam intraverunt aquæ usque ad animam meam.
text_pt: Como se impele a fumaça, assim tu os impeles; assim como a cera se derrete diante do fogo, assim pereçam os ímpios diante de Deus.
text_el: σῶσόν με ὁ θεός ὅτι εἰσήλθοσαν ὕδατα ἕως ψυχῆς μου

text_en: I stick fast in the mire of the deep and there is no sure standing. I have come into the depth of the sea, and a tempest has overwhelmed me.
text_la: Infixus sum in limo profundi et non est substantia. Veni in altitudinem maris, et tempestas demersit me.
text_pt: Mas alegrem-se os justos, e se regozijem na presença de Deus, e folguem de alegria.
text_el: ἐνεπάγην εἰς ἰλὺν βυθοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑπόστασις ἦλθον εἰς τὰ βάθη τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ καταιγὶς κατεπόντισέν με

text_en: I have laboured with crying; my jaws have become hoarse, my eyes have failed, whilst I hope in my God .
text_la: Laboravi clamans, raucæ factæ sunt fauces meæ; defecerunt oculi mei, dum spero in Deum meum.
text_pt: Cantai a Deus, cantai louvores ao seu nome; louvai aquele que vai montado sobre os céus, pois o seu nome é Senhor, e exultai diante dele.
text_el: ἐκοπίασα κράζων ἐβραγχίασεν ὁ λάρυγξ μου ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλπίζειν ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν μου

text_en: They are multiplied above the hairs of my head, who hate me without cause. My enemies are grown strong who have wrongfully persecuted me: then did I pay that which I took not away.
text_la: Multiplicati sunt super capillos capitis mei qui oderunt me gratis. Confortati sunt qui persecuti sunt me inimici mei injuste; quæ non rapui, tunc exsolvebam.
text_pt: Pai de órfãos e juiz de viúvas é Deus, no seu lugar santo.
text_el: ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ τὰς τρίχας τῆς κεφαλῆς μου οἱ μισοῦντές με δωρεάν ἐκραταιώθησαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου οἱ ἐκδιώκοντές με ἀδίκως ἃ οὐχ ἥρπασα τότε ἀπετίννυον

text_en: O God , you know my foolishness; and my offences are not hidden from you:
text_la: Deus, tu scis insipientiam meam; et delicta mea a te non sunt abscondita.
text_pt: Deus faz que o solitário viva em família; liberta aqueles que estão presos em grilhões; mas os rebeldes habitam em terra seca.
text_el: ὁ θεός σὺ ἔγνως τὴν ἀφροσύνην μου καὶ αἱ πλημμέλειαί μου ἀπὸ σοῦ οὐκ ἐκρύβησαν

text_en: Let not them be ashamed for me, who look for you, O Lord , the Lord of hosts . Let them not be confounded on my account, who seek you, O God of Israel .
text_la: Non erubescant in me qui exspectant te, Domine, Domine virtutum; non confundantur super me qui quærunt te, Deus Israël.
text_pt: Ó Deus, quando saías diante do teu povo, quando caminhavas pelo deserto, (Selá.).
text_el: μὴ αἰσχυνθείησαν ἐπ' ἐμοὶ οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε κύριε κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων μὴ ἐντραπείησαν ἐπ' ἐμοὶ οἱ ζητοῦντές σε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Because for your sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face.
text_la: Quoniam propter te sustinui opprobrium; operuit confusio faciem meam.
text_pt: A terra abalava-se, e os céus destilavam perante a face de Deus; até o próprio Sinai foi comovido na presença de Deus, do Deus de Israel.
text_el: ὅτι ἕνεκα σοῦ ὑπήνεγκα ὀνειδισμόν ἐκάλυψεν ἐντροπὴ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: I have become a stranger to my brethren, and an alien to the sons of my mother.
text_la: Extraneus factus sum fratribus meis, et peregrinus filiis matris meæ.
text_pt: Tu, ó Deus, mandaste a chuva em abundância, confortaste a tua herança, quando estava cansada.
text_el: ἀπηλλοτριωμένος ἐγενήθην τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου καὶ ξένος τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς μητρός μου

text_en: For the zeal of your house has eaten me up: and the reproaches of them that reproached you are fallen upon me.
text_la: Quoniam zelus domus tuæ comedit me, et opprobria exprobrantium tibi ceciderunt super me.
text_pt: Nela habitava o teu rebanho; tu, ó Deus, fizeste provisão da tua bondade para o pobre.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου κατέφαγέν με καὶ οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: And I covered my soul in fasting : and it was made a reproach to me.
text_la: Et operui in jejunio animam meam, et factum est in opprobrium mihi.
text_pt: O Senhor deu a palavra; grande era o exército dos que anunciavam as boas novas.
text_el: καὶ συνέκαμψα ἐν νηστείᾳ τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμοί

text_en: And I made haircloth my garment: and I became a byword to them.
text_la: Et posui vestimentum meum cilicium; et factus sum illis in parabolam.
text_pt: Reis de exércitos fugiram à pressa; e aquela que ficava em casa repartia os despojos.
text_el: καὶ ἐθέμην τὸ ἔνδυμά μου σάκκον καὶ ἐγενόμην αὐτοῖς εἰς παραβολήν

text_en: They that sat in the gate spoke against me: and they that drank wine made me their song.
text_la: Adversum me loquebantur qui sedebant in porta, et in me psallebant qui bibebant vinum.
text_pt: Ainda que vos tenhais deitado entre redis, contudo sereis como as asas duma pomba, cobertas de prata, e as suas penas, de ouro amarelo.
text_el: κατ' ἐμοῦ ἠδολέσχουν οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν πύλῃ καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ ἔψαλλον οἱ πίνοντες τὸν οἶνον

text_en: But as for me, my prayer is to you, O Lord ; for the time of your good pleasure, O God . In the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation .
text_la: Ego vero orationem meam ad te, Domine; tempus beneplaciti, Deus. In multitudine misericordiæ tuæ, exaudi me in veritate salutis tuæ.
text_pt: Quando o Onipotente ali espalhou os reis, foi como a neve em Salmon.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ τῇ προσευχῇ μου πρὸς σέ κύριε καιρὸς εὐδοκίας ὁ θεός ἐν τῷ πλήθει τοῦ ἐλέους σου ἐπάκουσόν μου ἐν ἀληθείᾳ τῆς σωτηρίας σου

text_en: Draw me out of the mire, that I may not stick fast: deliver me from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
text_la: Eripe me de luto, ut non infigar; libera me ab iis qui oderunt me, et de profundis aquarum.
text_pt: O monte de Deus é como o monte de Basã, um monte elevado como o monte de Basã.
text_el: σῶσόν με ἀπὸ πηλοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐμπαγῶ ῥυσθείην ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με καὶ ἐκ τοῦ βάθους τῶν ὑδάτων

text_en: Let not the tempest of water drown me, nor the deep water swallow me up: and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
text_la: Non me demergat tempestas aquæ, neque absorbeat me profundum, neque urgeat super me puteus os suum.
text_pt: Por que saltais, ó montes elevados? Este é o monte que Deus desejou para a sua habitação, e o Senhor habitará nele eternamente.
text_el: μή με καταποντισάτω καταιγὶς ὕδατος μηδὲ καταπιέτω με βυθός μηδὲ συσχέτω ἐπ' ἐμὲ φρέαρ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hear me, O Lord , for your mercy is kind; look upon me according to the multitude of your tender mercies.
text_la: Exaudi me, Domine, quoniam benigna est misericordia tua; secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum respice in me.
text_pt: Os carros de Deus são vinte milhares, milhares de milhares. O Senhor está entre eles, como em Sinai, no lugar santo.
text_el: εἰσάκουσόν μου κύριε ὅτι χρηστὸν τὸ ἔλεός σου κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν σου ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: And turn not away your face from your servant: for I am in trouble, hear me speedily.
text_la: Et ne avertas faciem tuam a puero tuo; quoniam tribulor, velociter exaudi me.
text_pt: Tu subiste ao alto, levaste cativo o cativeiro, recebeste dons para os homens, e até para os rebeldes, para que o Senhor Deus habitasse entre eles.
text_el: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπὸ τοῦ παιδός σου ὅτι θλίβομαι ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου

text_en: Attend to my soul , and deliver it: save me because of my enemies.
text_la: Intende animæ meæ, et libera eam; propter inimicos meos, eripe me.
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor, que de dia em dia nos carrega de benefícios; o Deus que é a nossa salvação. (Selá.).
text_el: πρόσχες τῇ ψυχῇ μου καὶ λύτρωσαι αὐτήν ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ῥῦσαί με

text_en: You know my reproach, and my confusion, and my shame.
text_la: Tu scis improperium meum, et confusionem meam, et reverentiam meam;
text_pt: O nosso Deus é o Deus da salvação; e a DEUS, o Senhor, pertencem os livramentos da morte.
text_el: σὺ γὰρ γινώσκεις τὸν ὀνειδισμόν μου καὶ τὴν αἰσχύνην μου καὶ τὴν ἐντροπήν μου ἐναντίον σου πάντες οἱ θλίβοντές με

text_en: In your sight are all they that afflict me; my heart has expected reproach and misery. And I looked for one that would grieve together with me, but there was none: and for one that would comfort me, and I found none.
text_la: in conspectu tuo sunt omnes qui tribulant me. Improperium exspectavit cor meum et miseriam : et sustinui qui simul contristaretur, et non fuit; et qui consolaretur, et non inveni.
text_pt: Mas Deus ferirá gravemente a cabeça de seus inimigos e o crânio cabeludo do que anda em suas culpas.
text_el: ὀνειδισμὸν προσεδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν καὶ ὑπέμεινα συλλυπούμενον καὶ οὐχ ὑπῆρξεν καὶ παρακαλοῦντας καὶ οὐχ εὗρον

text_en: And they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
text_la: Et dederunt in escam meam fel, et in siti mea potaverunt me aceto.
text_pt: Disse o Senhor: Eu os farei voltar de Basã, farei voltar o meu povo das profundezas do mar;
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸ βρῶμά μου χολὴν καὶ εἰς τὴν δίψαν μου ἐπότισάν με ὄξος

text_en: Let their table become as a snare before them, and a recompense, and a stumbling block.
text_la: Fiat mensa eorum coram ipsis in laqueum, et in retributiones, et in scandalum.
text_pt: Para que o teu pé mergulhe no sangue de teus inimigos, e no mesmo a língua dos teus cães.
text_el: γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδοσιν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον

text_en: Let their eyes be darkened that they see not; and their back bend down always.
text_la: Obscurentur oculi eorum, ne videant, et dorsum eorum semper incurva.
text_pt: Ó Deus, eles têm visto os teus caminhos; os caminhos do meu Deus, meu Rei, no santuário.
text_el: σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ τὸν νῶτον αὐτῶν διὰ παντὸς σύγκαμψον

text_en: Pour out your indignation upon them: and let your wrathful anger take hold of them.
text_la: Effunde super eos iram tuam, et furor iræ tuæ comprehendat eos.
text_pt: Os cantores iam adiante, os tocadores de instrumentos atrás; entre eles as donzelas tocando adufes.
text_el: ἔκχεον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὴν ὀργήν σου καὶ ὁ θυμὸς τῆς ὀργῆς σου καταλάβοι αὐτούς

text_en: Let their habitation be made desolate: and let there be none to dwell in their tabernacles.
text_la: Fiat habitatio eorum deserta, et in tabernaculis eorum non sit qui inhabitet.
text_pt: Celebrai a Deus nas congregações; ao Senhor, desde a fonte de Israel.
text_el: γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτῶν ἠρημωμένη καὶ ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν

text_en: Because they have persecuted him whom you have smitten; and they have added to the grief of my wounds.
text_la: Quoniam quem tu percussisti persecuti sunt, et super dolorem vulnerum meorum addiderunt.
text_pt: Ali está o pequeno Benjamim, que domina sobre eles, os príncipes de Judá com o seu ajuntamento, os príncipes de Zebulom e os príncipes de Naftali.
text_el: ὅτι ὃν σὺ ἐπάταξας αὐτοὶ κατεδίωξαν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄλγος τῶν τραυματιῶν σου προσέθηκαν

text_en: Add iniquity upon their iniquity : and let them not come into your justice .
text_la: Appone iniquitatem super iniquitatem eorum, et non intrent in justitiam tuam.
text_pt: O teu Deus ordenou a tua força; fortalece, ó Deus, o que já fizeste para nós.
text_el: πρόσθες ἀνομίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ εἰσελθέτωσαν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ σου

text_en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; and with the just let them not be written.
text_la: Deleantur de libro viventium, et cum justis non scribantur.
text_pt: Por amor do teu templo em Jerusalém, os reis te trarão presentes.
text_el: ἐξαλειφθήτωσαν ἐκ βίβλου ζώντων καὶ μετὰ δικαίων μὴ γραφήτωσαν

text_en: But I am poor and sorrowful: your salvation , O God , has set me up.
text_la: Ego sum pauper et dolens; salus tua, Deus, suscepit me.
text_pt: Repreende asperamente as feras dos canaviais, a multidão dos touros, com os novilhos dos povos, até que cada um se submeta com peças de prata; dissipa os povos que desejam a guerra.
text_el: πτωχὸς καὶ ἀλγῶν εἰμι ἐγώ καὶ ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ προσώπου σου ὁ θεός ἀντελάβετό μου

text_en: I will praise the name of God with a canticle: and I will magnify him with praise.
text_la: Laudabo nomen Dei cum cantico, et magnificabo eum in laude:
text_pt: Príncipes virão do Egito; a Etiópia cedo estenderá para Deus as suas mãos.
text_el: αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ μετ' ᾠδῆς μεγαλυνῶ αὐτὸν ἐν αἰνέσει

text_en: And it shall please God better than a young calf, that brings forth horns and hoofs.
text_la: et placebit Deo super vitulum novellum, cornua producentem et ungulas.
text_pt: Reinos da terra, cantai a Deus, cantai louvores ao Senhor. (Selá.)
text_el: καὶ ἀρέσει τῷ θεῷ ὑπὲρ μόσχον νέον κέρατα ἐκφέροντα καὶ ὁπλάς

text_en: Let the poor see and rejoice: seek God , and your soul shall live.
text_la: Videant pauperes, et lætentur; quærite Deum, et vivet anima vestra:
text_pt: Àquele que vai montado sobre os céus dos céus, que existiam desde a antiguidade; eis que envia a sua voz, dá um brado veemente.
text_el: ἰδέτωσαν πτωχοὶ καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν ἐκζητήσατε τὸν θεόν καὶ ζήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν

text_en: For the Lord has heard the poor: and has not despised his prisoners.
text_la: quoniam exaudivit pauperes Dominus, et vinctos suos non despexit.
text_pt: Atribuí a Deus fortaleza; a sua excelência está sobre Israel e a sua fortaleza nas mais altas nuvens.
text_el: ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν τῶν πενήτων ὁ κύριος καὶ τοὺς πεπεδημένους αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξουδένωσεν

text_en: Let the heavens and the earth praise him; the sea, and everything that creeps therein.
text_la: Laudent illum cæli et terra; mare, et omnia reptilia in eis.
text_pt: Ó Deus, tu és tremendo desde os teus santuários; o Deus de Israel é o que dá força e poder ao seu povo. Bendito seja Deus!
text_el: αἰνεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ θάλασσα καὶ πάντα τὰ ἕρποντα ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: For God will save Sion, and the cities of Juda shall be built up. And they shall dwell there, and acquire it by inheritance.
text_la: Quoniam Deus salvam faciet Sion, et ædificabuntur civitates Juda, et inhabitabunt ibi, et hæreditate acquirent eam.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς σώσει τὴν Σιων καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσονται αἱ πόλεις τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐκεῖ καὶ κληρονομήσουσιν αὐτήν

text_en: And the seed of his servants shall possess it; and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
text_la: Et semen servorum ejus possidebit eam; et qui diligunt nomen ejus habitabunt in ea.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σπέρμα τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ καθέξουσιν αὐτήν καὶ οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ κατασκηνώσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David , to bring to remembrance that the Lord saved him.
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David in rememorationem, quod salvum fecerit eum Dominus.
