text_pt: Livra-me, ó Deus, pois as águas entraram até à minha alma.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς ἀνάμνησιν

text_en: O God , come to my assistance; O Lord , make haste to help me.
text_la: Deus, in adjutorium meum intende; Domine, ad adjuvandum me festina.
text_pt: Atolei-me em profundo lamaçal, onde se não pode estar em pé; entrei na profundeza das águas, onde a corrente me leva.
text_el: εἰς τὸ σῶσαί με κύριον ὁ θεός εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου πρόσχες

text_en: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek my soul :
text_la: Confundantur, et revereantur, qui quærunt animam meam.
text_pt: Estou cansado de clamar; a minha garganta se secou; os meus olhos desfalecem esperando o meu Deus.
text_el: αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν οἱ ζητοῦντές μου τὴν ψυχήν ἀποστραφείησαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ καταισχυνθείησαν οἱ βουλόμενοί μοι κακά

text_en: Let them be turned backward, and blush for shame that desire evils to me: Let them be presently turned away blushing for shame that say to me: 'Tis well, 'tis well.
text_la: Avertantur retrorsum, et erubescant, qui volunt mihi mala; avertantur statim erubescentes qui dicunt mihi : Euge, euge!
text_pt: Aqueles que me odeiam sem causa são mais do que os cabelos da minha cabeça; aqueles que procuram destruir-me, sendo injustamente meus inimigos, são poderosos; então restituí o que não furtei.
text_el: ἀποστραφείησαν παραυτίκα αἰσχυνόμενοι οἱ λέγοντές μοι εὖγε εὖγε

text_en: Let all that seek you rejoice and be glad in you; and let such as love your salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.
text_la: Exsultent et lætentur in te omnes qui quærunt te; et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui diligunt salutare tuum.
text_pt: Tu, ó Deus, bem conheces a minha estultice; e os meus pecados não te são encobertos.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν ἐπὶ σοὶ πάντες οἱ ζητοῦντές σε καὶ λεγέτωσαν διὰ παντός μεγαλυνθήτω ὁ θεός οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ σωτήριόν σου

text_en: But I am needy and poor; O God , help me. You are my helper and my deliverer: O lord, make no delay.
text_la: Ego vero egenus et pauper sum; Deus, adjuva me. Adjutor meus et liberator meus es tu; Domine, ne moreris.
text_pt: Não sejam envergonhados por minha causa aqueles que esperam em ti, ó Senhor, DEUS dos Exércitos; não sejam confundidos por minha causa aqueles que te buscam, ó Deus de Israel.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ πτωχὸς καὶ πένης ὁ θεός βοήθησόν μοι βοηθός μου καὶ ῥύστης μου εἶ σύ κύριε μὴ χρονίσῃς

text_en: In you, O Lord , I have hoped, let me never be put to confusion:
text_la: In te, Domine, speravi; non confundar in æternum.
text_pt: Apressa-te, ó Deus, em me livrar; SENHOR, apressa-te em ajudar-me.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ υἱῶν Ιωναδαβ καὶ τῶν πρώτων αἰχμαλωτισθέντων ὁ θεός ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Deliver me in your justice , and rescue me. Incline your ear unto me, and save me.
text_la: In justitia tua libera me, et eripe me : inclina ad me aurem tuam, et salva me.
text_pt: Fiquem envergonhados e confundidos os que procuram a minha alma; voltem para trás e confundam-se os que me desejam mal.
text_el: ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με κλῖνον πρός με τὸ οὖς σου καὶ σῶσόν με

text_en: Be unto me a God , a protector, and a place of strength: that you may make me safe. For you are my firmament and my refuge.
text_la: Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, et in locum munitum, ut salvum me facias : quoniam firmamentum meum et refugium meum es tu.
text_pt: Virem as costas como recompensa da sua vergonha os que dizem: Ah! Ah!
text_el: γενοῦ μοι εἰς θεὸν ὑπερασπιστὴν καὶ εἰς τόπον ὀχυρὸν τοῦ σῶσαί με ὅτι στερέωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σύ

text_en: Deliver me, O my God , out of the hand of the sinner, and out of the hand of the transgressor of the law and of the unjust .
text_la: Deus meus, eripe me de manu peccatoris, et de manu contra legem agentis, et iniqui:
text_pt: Folguem e alegrem-se em ti todos os que te buscam; e aqueles que amam a tua salvação digam continuamente: Engrandecido seja Deus.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς παρανομοῦντος καὶ ἀδικοῦντος

text_en: For you are my patience, O Lord : my hope , O Lord , from my youth.
text_la: quoniam tu es patientia mea, Domine; Domine, spes mea a juventute mea.
text_pt: Eu, porém, estou aflito e necessitado; apressa-te por mim, ó Deus. Tu és o meu auxílio e o meu libertador; Senhor, não te detenhas.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ εἶ ἡ ὑπομονή μου κύριε κύριος ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἐκ νεότητός μου

text_en: By you have I been confirmed from the womb: from my mother's womb you are my protector. Of you I shall continually sing:
text_la: In te confirmatus sum ex utero; de ventre matris meæ tu es protector meus; in te cantatio mea semper.
text_el: ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπεστηρίχθην ἀπὸ γαστρός ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου σύ μου εἶ σκεπαστής ἐν σοὶ ἡ ὕμνησίς μου διὰ παντός

text_en: I have become unto many as a wonder, but you are a strong helper.
text_la: Tamquam prodigium factus sum multis; et tu adjutor fortis.
text_el: ὡσεὶ τέρας ἐγενήθην τοῖς πολλοῖς καὶ σὺ βοηθὸς κραταιός

text_en: Let my mouth be filled with praise, that I may sing your glory ; your greatness all the day long.
text_la: Repleatur os meum laude, ut cantem gloriam tuam, tota die magnitudinem tuam.
text_el: πληρωθήτω τὸ στόμα μου αἰνέσεως ὅπως ὑμνήσω τὴν δόξαν σου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν μεγαλοπρέπειάν σου

text_en: Cast me not off in the time of old age: when my strength shall fail, do not forsake me.
text_la: Ne projicias me in tempore senectutis; cum defecerit virtus mea, ne derelinquas me.
text_el: μὴ ἀπορρίψῃς με εἰς καιρὸν γήρους ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν τὴν ἰσχύν μου μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με

text_en: For my enemies have spoken against me; and they that watched my soul have consulted together,
text_la: Quia dixerunt inimici mei mihi, et qui custodiebant animam meam consilium fecerunt in unum,
text_el: ὅτι εἶπαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἐμοὶ καὶ οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ

text_en: saying: God has forsaken him: pursue and take him, for there is none to deliver him.
text_la: dicentes : Deus dereliquit eum : persequimini et comprehendite eum, quia non est qui eripiat.
text_el: λέγοντες ὁ θεὸς ἐγκατέλιπεν αὐτόν καταδιώξατε καὶ καταλάβετε αὐτόν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ῥυόμενος

text_en: O God , be not far from me: O my God , make haste to my help.
text_la: Deus, ne elongeris a me; Deus meus, in auxilium meum respice.
text_el: ὁ θεός μὴ μακρύνῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὁ θεός μου εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου πρόσχες

text_en: Let them be confounded and come to nothing that detract my soul ; let them be covered with confusion and blame that seek my hurt.
text_la: Confundantur et deficiant detrahentes animæ meæ; operiantur confusione et pudore qui quærunt mala mihi.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἐκλιπέτωσαν οἱ ἐνδιαβάλλοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου περιβαλέσθωσαν αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐντροπὴν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι

text_en: But I will always hope ; and will add to all your praise.
text_la: Ego autem semper sperabo, et adjiciam super omnem laudem tuam.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ διὰ παντὸς ἐλπιῶ καὶ προσθήσω ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου

text_en: My mouth shall show forth your justice ; your salvation all the day long. Because I have not known learning ,
text_la: Os meum annuntiabit justitiam tuam, tota die salutare tuum. Quoniam non cognovi litteraturam,
text_el: τὸ στόμα μου ἐξαγγελεῖ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν σωτηρίαν σου ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνων γραμματείας

text_en: I will enter into the powers of the Lord : O Lord , I will be mindful of your justice alone.
text_la: introibo in potentias Domini; Domine, memorabor justitiæ tuæ solius.
text_el: εἰσελεύσομαι ἐν δυναστείᾳ κυρίου κύριε μνησθήσομαι τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου μόνου

text_en: You have taught me, O God , from my youth: and till now I will declare your wonderful works.
text_la: Deus, docuisti me a juventute mea; et usque nunc pronuntiabo mirabilia tua.
text_el: ἐδίδαξάς με ὁ θεός ἐκ νεότητός μου καὶ μέχρι νῦν ἀπαγγελῶ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου

text_en: And unto old age and grey hairs: O God , forsake me not, Until I show forth your arm to all the generation that is to come: Your power,
text_la: Et usque in senectam et senium, Deus, ne derelinquas me, donec annuntiem brachium tuum generationi omni quæ ventura est, potentiam tuam,
text_el: καὶ ἕως γήρους καὶ πρεσβείου ὁ θεός μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με ἕως ἂν ἀπαγγείλω τὸν βραχίονά σου πάσῃ τῇ γενεᾷ τῇ ἐρχομένῃ τὴν δυναστείαν σου καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου

text_en: and your justice , O God , even to the highest great things you have done: O God , who is like to you?
text_la: et justitiam tuam, Deus, usque in altissima; quæ fecisti magnalia, Deus : quis similis tibi?
text_el: ὁ θεός ἕως ὑψίστων ἃ ἐποίησας μεγαλεῖα ὁ θεός τίς ὅμοιός σοι

text_en: How great troubles have you shown me, many and grievous: and turning you have brought me to life, and have brought me back again from the depths of the earth:
text_la: Quantas ostendisti mihi tribulationes multas et malas! et conversus vivificasti me, et de abyssis terræ iterum reduxisti me.
text_el: ὅσας ἔδειξάς μοι θλίψεις πολλὰς καὶ κακάς καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐζωοποίησάς με καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀβύσσων τῆς γῆς πάλιν ἀνήγαγές με

text_en: You have multiplied your magnificence; and turning to me you have comforted me.
text_la: Multiplicasti magnificentiam tuam; et conversus consolatus es me.
text_el: ἐπλεόνασας τὴν μεγαλοσύνην σου καὶ ἐπιστρέψας παρεκάλεσάς με καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀβύσσων τῆς γῆς πάλιν ἀνήγαγές με

text_en: For I will also confess to you your truth with the instruments of psaltery: O God , I will sing to you with the harp, you holy one of Israel .
text_la: Nam et ego confitebor tibi in vasis psalmi veritatem tuam, Deus; psallam tibi in cithara, sanctus Israël.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν σκεύει ψαλμοῦ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ὁ θεός ψαλῶ σοι ἐν κιθάρᾳ ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: My lips shall greatly rejoice, when I shall sing to you; and my soul which you have redeemed .
text_la: Exsultabunt labia mea cum cantavero tibi; et anima mea quam redemisti.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσονται τὰ χείλη μου ὅταν ψάλω σοι καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου ἣν ἐλυτρώσω

text_en: Yea and my tongue shall meditate on your justice all the day; when they shall be confounded and put to shame that seek evils to me.
text_la: Sed et lingua mea tota die meditabitur justitiam tuam, cum confusi et reveriti fuerint qui quærunt mala mihi.
text_el: ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μελετήσει τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου ὅταν αἰσχυνθῶσιν καὶ ἐντραπῶσιν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι

text_en: A psalm on Solomon .
text_la: Psalmus, in Salomonem.
text_pt: Em ti, SENHOR, confio; nunca seja eu confundido.
text_el: εἰς Σαλωμων ὁ θεός τὸ κρίμα σου τῷ βασιλεῖ δὸς καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: Give to the king your judgment, O God , and to the king's son your justice : To judge your people with justice , and your poor with judgment.
text_la: Deus, judicium tuum regi da, et justitiam tuam filio regis; judicare populum tuum in justitia, et pauperes tuos in judicio.
text_pt: Livra-me na tua justiça, e faze-me escapar; inclina os teus ouvidos para mim, e salva-me.
text_el: κρίνειν τὸν λαόν σου ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ τοὺς πτωχούς σου ἐν κρίσει

text_en: Let the mountains receive peace for the people: and the hills justice .
text_la: Suscipiant montes pacem populo, et colles justitiam.
text_pt: Sê tu a minha habitação forte, à qual possa recorrer continuamente. Deste um mandamento que me salva, pois tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza.
text_el: ἀναλαβέτω τὰ ὄρη εἰρήνην τῷ λαῷ σου καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: He shall judge the poor of the people, and he shall save the children of the poor: and he shall humble the oppressor.
text_la: Judicabit pauperes populi, et salvos faciet filios pauperum, et humiliabit calumniatorem.
text_pt: Livra-me, meu Deus, das mãos do ímpio, das mãos do homem injusto e cruel.
text_el: κρινεῖ τοὺς πτωχοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ σώσει τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν πενήτων καὶ ταπεινώσει συκοφάντην

text_en: And he shall continue with the sun and before the moon, throughout all generations .
text_la: Et permanebit cum sole, et ante lunam, in generatione et generationem.
text_pt: Pois tu és a minha esperança, Senhor DEUS; tu és a minha confiança desde a minha mocidade.
text_el: καὶ συμπαραμενεῖ τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ πρὸ τῆς σελήνης γενεὰς γενεῶν

text_en: He shall come down like rain upon the fleece; and as showers falling gently upon the earth.
text_la: Descendet sicut pluvia in vellus, et sicut stillicidia stillantia super terram.
text_pt: Por ti tenho sido sustentado desde o ventre; tu és aquele que me tiraste das entranhas de minha mãe; o meu louvor será para ti constantemente.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσεται ὡς ὑετὸς ἐπὶ πόκον καὶ ὡσεὶ σταγόνες στάζουσαι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: In his days shall justice spring up, and abundance of peace, till the moon be taken away.
text_la: Orietur in diebus ejus justitia, et abundantia pacis, donec auferatur luna.
text_pt: Sou como um prodígio para muitos, mas tu és o meu refúgio forte.
text_el: ἀνατελεῖ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνη καὶ πλῆθος εἰρήνης ἕως οὗ ἀνταναιρεθῇ ἡ σελήνη

text_en: And he shall rule from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
text_la: Et dominabitur a mari usque ad mare, et a flumine usque ad terminos orbis terrarum.
text_pt: Encha-se a minha boca do teu louvor e da tua glória todo o dia.
text_el: καὶ κατακυριεύσει ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἕως θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπὸ ποταμοῦ ἕως περάτων τῆς οἰκουμένης

text_en: Before him the Ethiopians shall fall down: and his enemies shall lick the ground.
text_la: Coram illo procident Æthiopes, et inimici ejus terram lingent.
text_pt: Não me rejeites no tempo da velhice; não me desampares, quando se for acabando a minha força.
text_el: ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ προπεσοῦνται Αἰθίοπες καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ χοῦν λείξουσιν

text_en: The kings of Tharsis and the islands shall offer presents: the kings of the Arabians and of Saba shall bring gifts:
text_la: Reges Tharsis et insulæ munera offerent; reges Arabum et Saba dona adducent:
text_pt: Porque os meus inimigos falam contra mim, e os que espiam a minha alma consultam juntos,
text_el: βασιλεῖς Θαρσις καὶ αἱ νῆσοι δῶρα προσοίσουσιν βασιλεῖς Ἀράβων καὶ Σαβα δῶρα προσάξουσιν

text_en: And all kings of the earth shall adore him: all nations shall serve him.
text_la: et adorabunt eum omnes reges terræ; omnes gentes servient ei.
text_pt: Dizendo: Deus o desamparou; persegui-o e tomai-o, pois não há quem o livre.
text_el: καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη δουλεύσουσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: For he shall deliver the poor from the mighty: and the needy that had no helper.
text_la: Quia liberabit pauperem a potente, et pauperem cui non erat adjutor.
text_pt: Ó Deus, não te alongues de mim; meu Deus, apressa-te em ajudar-me.
text_el: ὅτι ἐρρύσατο πτωχὸν ἐκ χειρὸς δυνάστου καὶ πένητα ᾧ οὐχ ὑπῆρχεν βοηθός

text_en: He shall spare the poor and needy: and he shall save the souls of the poor.
text_la: Parcet pauperi et inopi, et animas pauperum salvas faciet.
text_pt: Sejam confundidos e consumidos os que são adversários da minha alma; cubram-se de opróbrio e de confusão aqueles que procuram o meu mal.
text_el: φείσεται πτωχοῦ καὶ πένητος καὶ ψυχὰς πενήτων σώσει

text_en: He shall redeem their souls from usuries and iniquity : and their names shall be honourable in his sight.
text_la: Ex usuris et iniquitate redimet animas eorum, et honorabile nomen eorum coram illo.
text_pt: Mas eu esperarei continuamente, e te louvarei cada vez mais.
text_el: ἐκ τόκου καὶ ἐξ ἀδικίας λυτρώσεται τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔντιμον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Arabia, for him they shall always adore : they shall bless him all the day.
text_la: Et vivet, et dabitur ei de auro Arabiæ; et adorabunt de ipso semper, tota die benedicent ei.
text_pt: A minha boca manifestará a tua justiça e a tua salvação todo o dia, pois não conheço o número delas.
text_el: καὶ ζήσεται καὶ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ χρυσίου τῆς Ἀραβίας καὶ προσεύξονται περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν εὐλογήσουσιν αὐτόν

text_en: And there shall be a firmament on the earth on the tops of mountains, above Libanus shall the fruit thereof be exalted: and they of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.
text_la: Et erit firmamentum in terra in summis montium; superextolletur super Libanum fructus ejus, et florebunt de civitate sicut fœnum terræ.
text_pt: Sairei na força do Senhor DEUS, farei menção da tua justiça, e só dela.
text_el: ἔσται στήριγμα ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐπ' ἄκρων τῶν ὀρέων ὑπεραρθήσεται ὑπὲρ τὸν Λίβανον ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξανθήσουσιν ἐκ πόλεως ὡσεὶ χόρτος τῆς γῆς

text_en: Let his name be blessed for evermore: his name continues before the sun. And in him shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed : all nations shall magnify him.
text_la: Sit nomen ejus benedictum in sæcula; ante solem permanet nomen ejus. Et benedicentur in ipso omnes tribus terræ; omnes gentes magnificabunt eum.
text_pt: Ensinaste-me, ó Deus, desde a minha mocidade; e até aqui tenho anunciado as tuas maravilhas.
text_el: ἔστω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ εὐλογημένον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας πρὸ τοῦ ἡλίου διαμενεῖ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ εὐλογηθήσονται ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη μακαριοῦσιν αὐτόν

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel , who alone does wonderful things.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, qui facit mirabilia solus.
text_pt: Agora também, quando estou velho e de cabelos brancos, não me desampares, ó Deus, até que tenha anunciado a tua força a esta geração, e o teu poder a todos os vindouros.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὁ ποιῶν θαυμάσια μόνος

text_en: And blessed be the name of his majesty for ever: and the whole earth shall be filled with his majesty. So be it. So be it.
text_la: Et benedictum nomen majestatis ejus in æternum, et replebitur majestate ejus omnis terra. Fiat, fiat.
text_pt: Também a tua justiça, ó Deus, está muito alta, pois fizeste grandes coisas. Ó Deus, quem é semelhante a ti?
text_el: καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ πληρωθήσεται τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ γένοιτο γένοιτο

text_en: The praises of David , the son of Jesse, are ended.
text_la: Defecerunt laudes David, filii Jesse.
text_pt: Tu, que me tens feito ver muitos males e angústias, me darás ainda a vida, e me tirarás dos abismos da terra.
text_el: ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὕμνοι Δαυιδ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ιεσσαι

text_en: How good is God to Israel , to them that are of a right heart!
text_la: Quam bonus Israël Deus, his qui recto sunt corde!
text_pt: Ó Deus, dá ao rei os teus juízos, e a tua justiça ao filho do rei.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ ὡς ἀγαθὸς τῷ Ισραηλ ὁ θεός τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: But my feet were almost moved; my steps had well near slipped.
text_la: Mei autem pene moti sunt pedes, pene effusi sunt gressus mei:
text_pt: Ele julgará ao teu povo com justiça, e aos teus pobres com juízo.
text_el: ἐμοῦ δὲ παρὰ μικρὸν ἐσαλεύθησαν οἱ πόδες παρ' ὀλίγον ἐξεχύθη τὰ διαβήματά μου

text_en: Because I had a zeal on occasion of the wicked , seeing the prosperity of sinners.
text_la: quia zelavi super iniquos, pacem peccatorum videns.
text_pt: Os montes trarão paz ao povo, e os outeiros, justiça.
text_el: ὅτι ἐζήλωσα ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνόμοις εἰρήνην ἁμαρτωλῶν θεωρῶν

text_en: For there is no regard to their death, nor is there strength in their stripes.
text_la: Quia non est respectus morti eorum, et firmamentum in plaga eorum.
text_pt: Julgará os aflitos do povo, salvará os filhos do necessitado, e quebrantará o opressor.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνάνευσις τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτῶν καὶ στερέωμα ἐν τῇ μάστιγι αὐτῶν

text_en: They are not in the labour of men : neither shall they be scourged like other men .
text_la: In labore hominum non sunt, et cum hominibus non flagellabuntur.
text_pt: Temer-te-ão enquanto durarem o sol e a lua, de geração em geração.
text_el: ἐν κόποις ἀνθρώπων οὐκ εἰσὶν καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ μαστιγωθήσονται

text_en: Therefore pride has held them fast: they are covered with their iniquity and their wickedness .
text_la: Ideo tenuit eos superbia; operti sunt iniquitate et impietate sua.
text_pt: Ele descerá como chuva sobre a erva ceifada, como os chuveiros que umedecem a terra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκράτησεν αὐτοὺς ἡ ὑπερηφανία περιεβάλοντο ἀδικίαν καὶ ἀσέβειαν αὐτῶν

text_en: Their iniquity has come forth, as it were from fatness: they have passed into the affection of the heart.
text_la: Prodiit quasi ex adipe iniquitas eorum; transierunt in affectum cordis.
text_pt: Nos seus dias florescerá o justo, e abundância de paz haverá enquanto durar a lua.
text_el: ἐξελεύσεται ὡς ἐκ στέατος ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῶν διήλθοσαν εἰς διάθεσιν καρδίας

text_en: They have thought and spoken wickedness : they have spoken iniquity on high.
text_la: Cogitaverunt et locuti sunt nequitiam; iniquitatem in excelso locuti sunt.
text_pt: Dominará de mar a mar, e desde o rio até às extremidades da terra.
text_el: διενοήθησαν καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐν πονηρίᾳ ἀδικίαν εἰς τὸ ὕψος ἐλάλησαν

text_en: They have set their mouth against heaven : and their tongue has passed through the earth.
text_la: Posuerunt in cælum os suum, et lingua eorum transivit in terra.
text_pt: Aqueles que habitam no deserto se inclinarão ante ele, e os seus inimigos lamberão o pó.
text_el: ἔθεντο εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν διῆλθεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Therefore will my people return here and full days shall be found in them.
text_la: Ideo convertetur populus meus hic, et dies pleni invenientur in eis.
text_pt: Os reis de Társis e das ilhas trarão presentes; os reis de Sabá e de Seba oferecerão dons.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπιστρέψει ὁ λαός μου ἐνταῦθα καὶ ἡμέραι πλήρεις εὑρεθήσονται αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they said: How does God know ? And is there knowledge in the most High ?
text_la: Et dixerunt : Quomodo scit Deus, et si est scientia in excelso?
text_pt: E todos os reis se prostrarão perante ele; todas as nações o servirão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πῶς ἔγνω ὁ θεός καὶ εἰ ἔστιν γνῶσις ἐν τῷ ὑψίστῳ

text_en: Behold these are sinners; and yet, abounding in the world they have obtained riches.
text_la: Ecce ipsi peccatores, et abundantes in sæculo obtinuerunt divitias.
text_pt: Porque ele livrará ao necessitado quando clamar, como também ao aflito e ao que não tem quem o ajude.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οὗτοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ καὶ εὐθηνοῦνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατέσχον πλούτου

text_en: And I said: Then have I in vain justified my heart, and washed my hands among the innocent.
text_la: Et dixi : Ergo sine causa justificavi cor meum, et lavi inter innocentes manus meas,
text_pt: Compadecer-se-á do pobre e do aflito, e salvará as almas dos necessitados.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ἄρα ματαίως ἐδικαίωσα τὴν καρδίαν μου καὶ ἐνιψάμην ἐν ἀθῴοις τὰς χεῖράς μου

text_en: And I have been scourged all the day; and my chastisement has been in the mornings.
text_la: et fui flagellatus tota die, et castigatio mea in matutinis.
text_pt: Libertará as suas almas do engano e da violência, e precioso será o seu sangue aos olhos dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενόμην μεμαστιγωμένος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ὁ ἔλεγχός μου εἰς τὰς πρωίας

text_en: If I said: I will speak thus; behold I should condemn the generation of your children.
text_la: Si dicebam : Narrabo sic; ecce nationem filiorum tuorum reprobavi.
text_pt: E viverá, e se lhe dará do ouro de Sabá; e continuamente se fará por ele oração; e todos os dias o bendirão.
text_el: εἰ ἔλεγον διηγήσομαι οὕτως ἰδοὺ τῇ γενεᾷ τῶν υἱῶν σου ἠσυνθέτηκα

text_en: I studied that I might know this thing, it is a labour in my sight:
text_la: Existimabam ut cognoscerem hoc; labor est ante me:
text_pt: Haverá um punhado de trigo na terra sobre as cabeças dos montes; o seu fruto se moverá como o Líbano, e os da cidade florescerão como a erva da terra.
text_el: καὶ ὑπέλαβον τοῦ γνῶναι τοῦτο κόπος ἐστὶν ἐναντίον μου

text_en: Until I go into the sanctuary of God , and understand concerning their last ends.
text_la: donec intrem in sanctuarium Dei, et intelligam in novissimis eorum.
text_pt: O seu nome permanecerá eternamente; o seu nome se irá propagando de pais a filhos enquanto o sol durar, e os homens serão abençoados nele; todas as nações lhe chamarão bem-aventurado.
text_el: ἕως εἰσέλθω εἰς τὸ ἁγιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ συνῶ εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα αὐτῶν

text_en: But indeed for deceits you have put it to them: when they were lifted up you have cast them down.
text_la: Verumtamen propter dolos posuisti eis; dejecisti eos dum allevarentur.
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus, o Deus de Israel, que só ele faz maravilhas.
text_el: πλὴν διὰ τὰς δολιότητας ἔθου αὐτοῖς κατέβαλες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ἐπαρθῆναι

text_en: How are they brought to desolation? They have suddenly ceased to be: they have perished by reason of their iniquity .
text_la: Quomodo facti sunt in desolationem? subito defecerunt : perierunt propter iniquitatem suam.
text_pt: E bendito seja para sempre o seu nome glorioso; e encha-se toda a terra da sua glória. Amém e Amém.
text_el: πῶς ἐγένοντο εἰς ἐρήμωσιν ἐξάπινα ἐξέλιπον ἀπώλοντο διὰ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: As the dream of them that awake, O Lord ; so in your city you shall bring their image to nothing.
text_la: Velut somnium surgentium, Domine, in civitate tua imaginem ipsorum ad nihilum rediges.
text_pt: Aqui acabam as orações de Davi, filho de Jessé.
text_el: ὡσεὶ ἐνύπνιον ἐξεγειρομένου κύριε ἐν τῇ πόλει σου τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτῶν ἐξουδενώσεις

text_en: For my heart has been inflamed, and my reins have been changed:
text_la: Quia inflammatum est cor meum, et renes mei commutati sunt;
text_el: ὅτι ἐξεκαύθη ἡ καρδία μου καὶ οἱ νεφροί μου ἠλλοιώθησαν

text_en: And I am brought to nothing, and I knew not.
text_la: et ego ad nihilum redactus sum, et nescivi:
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐξουδενωμένος καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων κτηνώδης ἐγενόμην παρὰ σοί

text_en: I have become as a beast before you: and I am always with you.
text_la: ut jumentum factus sum apud te, et ego semper tecum.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ διὰ παντὸς μετὰ σοῦ ἐκράτησας τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς μου

text_en: You have held me by my right hand; and by your will you have conducted me, and with your glory you have received me.
text_la: Tenuisti manum dexteram meam, et in voluntate tua deduxisti me, et cum gloria suscepisti me.
text_el: ἐν τῇ βουλῇ σου ὡδήγησάς με καὶ μετὰ δόξης προσελάβου με

text_en: For what have I in heaven ? And besides you what do I desire upon earth?
text_la: Quid enim mihi est in cælo? et a te quid volui super terram?
text_el: τί γάρ μοι ὑπάρχει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ παρὰ σοῦ τί ἠθέλησα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: For you my flesh and my heart has fainted away: you are the God of my heart, and the God that is my portion for ever.
text_la: Defecit caro mea et cor meum; Deus cordis mei, et pars mea, Deus in æternum.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ὁ θεὸς τῆς καρδίας μου καὶ ἡ μερίς μου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For behold they that go far from you shall perish: you have destroyed all them that are disloyal to you.
text_la: Quia ecce qui elongant se a te peribunt; perdidisti omnes qui fornicantur abs te.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ μακρύνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀπολοῦνται ἐξωλέθρευσας πάντα τὸν πορνεύοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: But it is good for me to adhere to my God , to put my hope in the Lord God : That I may declare all your praises, in the gates of the daughter of Sion.
text_la: Mihi autem adhærere Deo bonum est; ponere in Domino Deo spem meam : ut annuntiem omnes prædicationes tuas in portis filiæ Sion.
text_el: ἐμοὶ δὲ τὸ προσκολλᾶσθαι τῷ θεῷ ἀγαθόν ἐστιν τίθεσθαι ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ τὴν ἐλπίδα μου τοῦ ἐξαγγεῖλαι πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις σου ἐν ταῖς πύλαις τῆς θυγατρὸς Σιων

text_en: O God , why have you cast us off unto the end: why is your wrath enkindled against the sheep of your pasture?
text_la: Ut quid, Deus, repulisti in finem, iratus est furor tuus super oves pascuæ tuæ?
text_pt: Verdadeiramente bom é Deus para com Israel, para com os limpos de coração.
text_el: συνέσεως τῷ Ασαφ ἵνα τί ἀπώσω ὁ θεός εἰς τέλος ὠργίσθη ὁ θυμός σου ἐπὶ πρόβατα νομῆς σου

text_en: Remember your congregation, which you have possessed from the beginning. The sceptre of your inheritance which you have redeemed : mount Sion in which you have dwelt.
text_la: Memor esto congregationis tuæ, quam possedisti ab initio. Redemisti virgam hæreditatis tuæ, mons Sion, in quo habitasti in eo.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, os meus pés quase que se desviaram; pouco faltou para que escorregassem os meus passos.
text_el: μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἐλυτρώσω ῥάβδον κληρονομίας σου ὄρος Σιων τοῦτο ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: Lift up your hands against their pride unto the end; see what things the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.
text_la: Leva manus tuas in superbias eorum in finem : quanta malignatus est inimicus in sancto!
text_pt: Pois eu tinha inveja dos néscios, quando via a prosperidade dos ímpios.
text_el: ἔπαρον τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐπὶ τὰς ὑπερηφανίας αὐτῶν εἰς τέλος ὅσα ἐπονηρεύσατο ὁ ἐχθρὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις σου

text_en: And they that hate you have made their boasts, in the midst of your solemnity. They have set up their ensigns for signs,
text_la: Et gloriati sunt qui oderunt te in medio solemnitatis tuæ; posuerunt signa sua, signa:
text_pt: Porque não há apertos na sua morte, mas firme está a sua força.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεκαυχήσαντο οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἑορτῆς σου ἔθεντο τὰ σημεῖα αὐτῶν σημεῖα καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν

text_en: and they knew not both in the going out and on the highest top. As with axes in a wood of trees,
text_la: et non cognoverunt sicut in exitu super summum. Quasi in silva lignorum securibus
text_pt: Não se acham em trabalhos como outros homens, nem são afligidos como outros homens.
text_el: ὡς εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον ὑπεράνω

text_en: they have cut down at once the gates thereof, with axe and hatchet they have brought it down.
text_la: exciderunt januas ejus in idipsum; in securi et ascia dejecerunt eam.
text_pt: Por isso a soberba os cerca como um colar; vestem-se de violência como de adorno.
text_el: ὡς ἐν δρυμῷ ξύλων ἀξίναις ἐξέκοψαν τὰς θύρας αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐν πελέκει καὶ λαξευτηρίῳ κατέρραξαν αὐτήν

text_en: They have set fire to your sanctuary: they have defiled the dwelling place of your name on the earth.
text_la: Incenderunt igni sanctuarium tuum; in terra polluerunt tabernaculum nominis tui.
text_pt: Os olhos deles estão inchados de gordura; eles têm mais do que o coração podia desejar.
text_el: ἐνεπύρισαν ἐν πυρὶ τὸ ἁγιαστήριόν σου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐβεβήλωσαν τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου

text_en: They said in their heart, the whole kindred of them together: Let us abolish all the festival days of God from the land.
text_la: Dixerunt in corde suo cognatio eorum simul: Quiescere faciamus omnes dies festos Dei a terra.
text_pt: São corrompidos e tratam maliciosamente de opressão; falam arrogantemente.
text_el: εἶπαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν ἡ συγγένεια αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό δεῦτε καὶ κατακαύσωμεν πάσας τὰς ἑορτὰς τοῦ θεοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Our signs we have not seen, there is now no prophet : and he will know us no more.
text_la: Signa nostra non vidimus; jam non est propheta; et nos non cognoscet amplius.
text_pt: Põem as suas bocas contra os céus, e as suas línguas andam pela terra.
text_el: τὰ σημεῖα ἡμῶν οὐκ εἴδομεν οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι προφήτης καὶ ἡμᾶς οὐ γνώσεται ἔτι

text_en: How long, O God , shall the enemy reproach: is the adversary to provoke your name for ever?
text_la: Usquequo, Deus, improperabit inimicus? irritat adversarius nomen tuum in finem?
text_pt: Por isso o povo dele volta aqui, e águas de copo cheio se lhes espremem.
text_el: ἕως πότε ὁ θεός ὀνειδιεῖ ὁ ἐχθρός παροξυνεῖ ὁ ὑπεναντίος τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τέλος

text_en: Why do you turn away your hand: and your right hand out of the midst of your bosom for ever?
text_la: Ut quid avertis manum tuam, et dexteram tuam de medio sinu tuo in finem?
text_pt: E eles dizem: Como o sabe Deus? Há conhecimento no Altíssimo?
text_el: ἵνα τί ἀποστρέφεις τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ τὴν δεξιάν σου ἐκ μέσου τοῦ κόλπου σου εἰς τέλος

text_en: But God is our king before ages: he has wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.
text_la: Deus autem rex noster ante sæcula : operatus est salutem in medio terræ.
text_pt: Eis que estes são ímpios, e prosperam no mundo; aumentam em riquezas.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰῶνος εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς

text_en: You by your strength made the sea firm: you crushed the heads of the dragons in the waters.
text_la: Tu confirmasti in virtute tua mare; contribulasti capita draconum in aquis.
text_pt: Na verdade que em vão tenho purificado o meu coração; e lavei as minhas mãos na inocência.
text_el: σὺ ἐκραταίωσας ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου τὴν θάλασσαν σὺ συνέτριψας τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν δρακόντων ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος

text_en: You have broken the heads of the dragon: you have given him to be meat for the people of the Ethiopians .
text_la: Tu confregisti capita draconis; dedisti eum escam populis Æthiopum.
text_pt: Pois todo o dia tenho sido afligido, e castigado cada manhã.
text_el: σὺ συνέθλασας τὰς κεφαλὰς τοῦ δράκοντος ἔδωκας αὐτὸν βρῶμα λαοῖς τοῖς Αἰθίοψιν

text_en: You have broken up the fountains and the torrents: you have dried up the Ethan rivers.
text_la: Tu dirupisti fontes et torrentes; tu siccasti fluvios Ethan.
text_pt: Se eu dissesse: Falarei assim; eis que ofenderia a geração de teus filhos.
text_el: σὺ διέρρηξας πηγὰς καὶ χειμάρρους σὺ ἐξήρανας ποταμοὺς Ηθαμ

text_en: Yours is the day, and yours is the night: you have made the morning light and the sun.
text_la: Tuus est dies, et tua est nox; tu fabricatus es auroram et solem.
text_pt: Quando pensava em entender isto, foi para mim muito doloroso;
text_el: σή ἐστιν ἡ ἡμέρα καὶ σή ἐστιν ἡ νύξ σὺ κατηρτίσω φαῦσιν καὶ ἥλιον

text_en: You have made all the borders of the earth: the summer and the spring were formed by you.
text_la: Tu fecisti omnes terminos terræ; æstatem et ver tu plasmasti ea.
text_pt: Até que entrei no santuário de Deus; então entendi eu o fim deles.
text_el: σὺ ἐποίησας πάντα τὰ ὅρια τῆς γῆς θέρος καὶ ἔαρ σὺ ἔπλασας αὐτά

text_en: Remember this, the enemy has reproached the Lord : and a foolish people has provoked your name .
text_la: Memor esto hujus : inimicus improperavit Domino, et populus insipiens incitavit nomen tuum.
text_pt: Certamente tu os puseste em lugares escorregadios; tu os lanças em destruição.
text_el: μνήσθητι ταύτης ἐχθρὸς ὠνείδισεν τὸν κύριον καὶ λαὸς ἄφρων παρώξυνεν τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: Deliver not up to beasts the souls that confess to you: and forget not to the end the souls of your poor.
text_la: Ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi, et animas pauperum tuorum ne obliviscaris in finem.
text_pt: Como caem na desolação, quase num momento! Ficam totalmente consumidos de terrores.
text_el: μὴ παραδῷς τοῖς θηρίοις ψυχὴν ἐξομολογουμένην σοι τῶν ψυχῶν τῶν πενήτων σου μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ εἰς τέλος

text_en: Have regard to your covenant: for they that are the obscure of the earth have been filled with dwellings of iniquity .
text_la: Respice in testamentum tuum, quia repleti sunt qui obscurati sunt terræ domibus iniquitatum.
text_pt: Como um sonho, quando se acorda, assim, ó Senhor, quando acordares, desprezarás a aparência deles.
text_el: ἐπίβλεψον εἰς τὴν διαθήκην σου ὅτι ἐπληρώθησαν οἱ ἐσκοτισμένοι τῆς γῆς οἴκων ἀνομιῶν

text_en: Let not the humble be turned away with confusion: the poor and needy shall praise your name .
text_la: Ne avertatur humilis factus confusus; pauper et inops laudabunt nomen tuum.
text_pt: Assim o meu coração se azedou, e sinto picadas nos meus rins.
text_el: μὴ ἀποστραφήτω τεταπεινωμένος κατῃσχυμμένος πτωχὸς καὶ πένης αἰνέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: Arise, O God , judge your own cause: remember your reproaches with which the foolish man has reproached you all the day.
text_la: Exsurge, Deus, judica causam tuam; memor esto improperiorum tuorum, eorum quæ ab insipiente sunt tota die.
text_pt: Assim me embruteci, e nada sabia; fiquei como um animal perante ti.
text_el: ἀνάστα ὁ θεός δίκασον τὴν δίκην σου μνήσθητι τῶν ὀνειδισμῶν σου τῶν ὑπὸ ἄφρονος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: Forget not the voices of your enemies: the pride of them that hate you ascends continually.
text_la: Ne obliviscaris voces inimicorum tuorum : superbia eorum qui te oderunt ascendit semper.
text_pt: Todavia estou de contínuo contigo; tu me sustentaste pela minha mão direita.
text_el: μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν ἱκετῶν σου ἡ ὑπερηφανία τῶν μισούντων σε ἀνέβη διὰ παντὸς πρὸς σέ

text_en: Unto the end, corrupt not, a psalm of a canticle for Asaph.
text_la: In finem, ne corrumpas. Psalmus cantici Asaph.
text_pt: Ó Deus, por que nos rejeitaste para sempre? Por que se acende a tua ira contra as ovelhas do teu pasto?
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος μὴ διαφθείρῃς ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ ᾠδῆς

text_en: We will praise you, O God : we will praise, and we will call upon your name . We will relate your wondrous works:
text_la: Confitebimur tibi, Deus, confitebimur, et invocabimus nomen tuum; narrabimus mirabilia tua.
text_pt: Lembra-te da tua congregação, que compraste desde a antiguidade; da vara da tua herança, que remiste; deste monte Sião, em que habitaste.
text_el: ἐξομολογησόμεθά σοι ὁ θεός ἐξομολογησόμεθα καὶ ἐπικαλεσόμεθα τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: When I shall take a time, I will judge justices.
text_la: Cum accepero tempus, ego justitias judicabo.
text_pt: Levanta os teus pés para as perpétuas assolações, para tudo o que o inimigo tem feito de mal no santuário.
text_el: διηγήσομαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου ὅταν λάβω καιρόν ἐγὼ εὐθύτητας κρινῶ

text_en: The earth is melted, and all that dwell therein: I have established the pillars thereof.
text_la: Liquefacta est terra et omnes qui habitant in ea: ego confirmavi columnas ejus.
text_pt: Os teus inimigos bramam no meio dos teus lugares santos; põem neles as suas insígnias por sinais.
text_el: ἐτάκη ἡ γῆ καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐγὼ ἐστερέωσα τοὺς στύλους αὐτῆς διάψαλμα

text_en: I said to the wicked : Do not act wickedly : and to the sinners: Lift not up the horn.
text_la: Dixi iniquis : Nolite inique agere : et delinquentibus : Nolite exaltare cornu:
text_pt: Um homem se tornava famoso, conforme houvesse levantado machados, contra a espessura do arvoredo.
text_el: εἶπα τοῖς παρανομοῦσιν μὴ παρανομεῖτε καὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν μὴ ὑψοῦτε κέρας

text_en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not iniquity against God .
text_la: nolite extollere in altum cornu vestrum; nolite loqui adversus Deum iniquitatem.
text_pt: Mas agora toda obra entalhada de uma vez quebram com machados e martelos.
text_el: μὴ ἐπαίρετε εἰς ὕψος τὸ κέρας ὑμῶν μὴ λαλεῖτε κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀδικίαν

text_en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert hills:
text_la: Quia neque ab oriente, neque ab occidente, neque a desertis montibus:
text_pt: Lançaram fogo no teu santuário; profanaram, derrubando-a até ao chão, a morada do teu nome.
text_el: ὅτι οὔτε ἀπὸ ἐξόδων οὔτε ἀπὸ δυσμῶν οὔτε ἀπὸ ἐρήμων ὀρέων

text_en: For God is the judge. One he puts down, and another he lifts up:
text_la: quoniam Deus judex est. Hunc humiliat, et hunc exaltat:
text_pt: Disseram nos seus corações: Despojemo-los duma vez. Queimaram todos os lugares santos de Deus na terra.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς κριτής ἐστιν τοῦτον ταπεινοῖ καὶ τοῦτον ὑψοῖ

text_en: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup of strong wine full of mixture. And he has poured it out from this to that: but the dregs thereof are not emptied: all the sinners of the earth shall drink.
text_la: quia calix in manu Domini vini meri, plenus misto. Et inclinavit ex hoc in hoc; verumtamen fæx ejus non est exinanita : bibent omnes peccatores terræ.
text_pt: Já não vemos os nossos sinais, já não há profeta, nem há entre nós alguém que saiba até quando isto durará.
text_el: ὅτι ποτήριον ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου οἴνου ἀκράτου πλῆρες κεράσματος καὶ ἔκλινεν ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο πλὴν ὁ τρυγίας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξεκενώθη πίονται πάντες οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: But I will declare for ever: I will sing to the God of Jacob .
text_la: Ego autem annuntiabo in sæculum; cantabo Deo Jacob:
text_pt: Até quando, ó Deus, nos afrontará o adversário? Blasfemará o inimigo o teu nome para sempre?
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀγαλλιάσομαι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: And I will break all the horns of sinners: but the horns of the just shall be exalted.
text_la: et omnia cornua peccatorum confringam, et exaltabuntur cornua justi.
text_pt: Porque retiras a tua mão, a saber, a tua destra? Tira-a de dentro do teu seio.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ κέρατα τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν συγκλάσω καὶ ὑψωθήσεται τὰ κέρατα τοῦ δικαίου

text_en: ,em>Unto the end, in praises, a psalm for Asaph: a canticle to the Assyrians .
text_la: In finem, in laudibus. Psalmus Asaph, canticum ad Assyrios.
text_pt: A ti, ó Deus, glorificamos, a ti damos louvor, pois o teu nome está perto, as tuas maravilhas o declaram.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐν ὕμνοις ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ ᾠδὴ πρὸς τὸν Ἀσσύριον

text_en: In Judea God is known : his name is great in Israel .
text_la: Notus in Judæa Deus; in Israël magnum nomen ejus.
text_pt: Quando eu ocupar o lugar determinado, julgarei retamente.
text_el: γνωστὸς ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ ὁ θεός ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ μέγα τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And his place is in peace : and his abode in Sion:
text_la: Et factus est in pace locus ejus, et habitatio ejus in Sion.
text_pt: A terra e todos os seus moradores estão dissolvidos, mas eu fortaleci as suas colunas. (Selá.)
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν εἰρήνῃ ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κατοικητήριον αὐτοῦ ἐν Σιων

text_en: There has he broken the powers of bows, the shield, the sword, and the battle.
text_la: Ibi confregit potentias arcuum, scutum, gladium, et bellum.
text_pt: Disse eu aos loucos: Não enlouqueçais, e aos ímpios: Não levanteis a fronte;
text_el: ἐκεῖ συνέτριψεν τὰ κράτη τῶν τόξων ὅπλον καὶ ῥομφαίαν καὶ πόλεμον διάψαλμα

text_en: You enlighten wonderfully from the everlasting hills.
text_la: Illuminans tu mirabiliter a montibus æternis;
text_pt: Não levanteis a vossa fronte altiva, nem faleis com cerviz dura.
text_el: φωτίζεις σὺ θαυμαστῶς ἀπὸ ὀρέων αἰωνίων

text_en: All the foolish of heart were troubled. They have slept their sleep; and all the men of riches have found nothing in their hands.
text_la: turbati sunt omnes insipientes corde. Dormierunt somnum suum, et nihil invenerunt omnes viri divitiarum in manibus suis.
text_pt: Porque nem do oriente, nem do ocidente, nem do deserto vem a exaltação.
text_el: ἐταράχθησαν πάντες οἱ ἀσύνετοι τῇ καρδίᾳ ὕπνωσαν ὕπνον αὐτῶν καὶ οὐχ εὗρον οὐδὲν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ πλούτου ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob , they have all slumbered that mounted on horseback.
text_la: Ab increpatione tua, Deus Jacob, dormitaverunt qui ascenderunt equos.
text_pt: Mas Deus é o Juiz: a um abate, e a outro exalta.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ ἐνύσταξαν οἱ ἐπιβεβηκότες τοὺς ἵππους

text_en: You are terrible, and who shall resist you? From that time your wrath .
text_la: Tu terribilis es; et quis resistet tibi? ex tunc ira tua.
text_pt: Porque na mão do Senhor há um cálice cujo vinho é tinto; está cheio de mistura; e dá a beber dele; mas as escórias dele todos os ímpios da terra as sorverão e beberão.
text_el: σὺ φοβερὸς εἶ καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί σοι ἀπὸ τότε ἡ ὀργή σου

text_en: You have caused judgment to be heard from heaven : the earth trembled and was still,
text_la: De cælo auditum fecisti judicium : terra tremuit et quievit
text_pt: E eu o declararei para sempre; cantarei louvores ao Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἠκούτισας κρίσιν γῆ ἐφοβήθη καὶ ἡσύχασεν

text_en: when God arose in judgment, to save all the meek of the earth.
text_la: cum exsurgeret in judicium Deus, ut salvos faceret omnes mansuetos terræ.
text_pt: E quebrarei todas as forças dos ímpios, mas as forças dos justos serão exaltadas.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἀναστῆναι εἰς κρίσιν τὸν θεὸν τοῦ σῶσαι πάντας τοὺς πραεῖς τῆς γῆς διάψαλμα

text_en: For the thought of man shall give praise to you: and the remainders of the thought shall keep holiday to you.
text_la: Quoniam cogitatio hominis confitebitur tibi, et reliquiæ cogitationis diem festum agent tibi.
text_el: ὅτι ἐνθύμιον ἀνθρώπου ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι καὶ ἐγκατάλειμμα ἐνθυμίου ἑορτάσει σοι

text_en: Vow and pay to the Lord your God : all you that are round about him bring presents. To him that is terrible,
text_la: Vovete et reddite Domino Deo vestro, omnes qui in circuitu ejus affertis munera : terribili,
text_el: εὔξασθε καὶ ἀπόδοτε κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν πάντες οἱ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἴσουσιν δῶρα

text_en: even to him who takes away the spirit of princes: to the terrible with the kings of the earth.
text_la: et ei qui aufert spiritum principum : terribili apud reges terræ.
text_el: τῷ φοβερῷ καὶ ἀφαιρουμένῳ πνεύματα ἀρχόντων φοβερῷ παρὰ τοῖς βασιλεῦσι τῆς γῆς

text_en: Unto the end, for Idithun, a psalm of Asaph.
text_la: In finem, pro Idithun. Psalmus Asaph.
text_pt: Conhecido é Deus em Judá; grande é o seu nome em Israel.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ Ιδιθουν τῷ Ασαφ ψαλμός

text_en: I cried to the Lord with my voice; to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.
text_la: Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi; voce mea ad Deum, et intendit mihi.
text_pt: E em Salém está o seu tabernáculo, e a sua morada em Sião.
text_el: φωνῇ μου πρὸς κύριον ἐκέκραξα φωνῇ μου πρὸς τὸν θεόν καὶ προσέσχεν μοι

text_en: In the days of my trouble I sought God , with my hands lifted up to him in the night, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be comforted:
text_la: In die tribulationis meæ Deum exquisivi; manibus meis nocte contra eum, et non sum deceptus. Renuit consolari anima mea;
text_pt: Ali quebrou as flechas do arco; o escudo, e a espada, e a guerra. (Selá.)
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς μου τὸν θεὸν ἐξεζήτησα ταῖς χερσίν μου νυκτὸς ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠπατήθην ἀπηνήνατο παρακληθῆναι ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: I remembered God , and was delighted, and was exercised, and my spirit swooned away.
text_la: memor fui Dei, et delectatus sum, et exercitatus sum, et defecit spiritus meus.
text_pt: Tu és mais ilustre e glorioso do que os montes de caça.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εὐφράνθην ἠδολέσχησα καὶ ὠλιγοψύχησεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου διάψαλμα

text_en: My eyes prevented the watches: I was troubled, and I spoke not.
text_la: Anticipaverunt vigilias oculi mei; turbatus sum, et non sum locutus.
text_pt: Os que são ousados de coração são despojados; dormiram o seu sono; e nenhum dos homens de força achou as próprias mãos.
text_el: προκατελάβοντο φυλακὰς οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐταράχθην καὶ οὐκ ἐλάλησα

text_en: I thought upon the days of old: and I had in my mind the eternal years.
text_la: Cogitavi dies antiquos, et annos æternos in mente habui.
text_pt: À tua repreensão, ó Deus de Jacó, carros e cavalos são lançados num sono profundo.
text_el: διελογισάμην ἡμέρας ἀρχαίας καὶ ἔτη αἰώνια ἐμνήσθην καὶ ἐμελέτησα

text_en: And I meditated in the night with my own heart: and I was exercised and I swept my spirit .
text_la: Et meditatus sum nocte cum corde meo, et exercitabar, et scopebam spiritum meum.
text_pt: Tu, tu és temível; e quem subsistirá à tua vista, uma vez que te irares?
text_el: νυκτὸς μετὰ τῆς καρδίας μου ἠδολέσχουν καὶ ἔσκαλλεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου

text_en: Will God then cast off for ever? Or will he never be more favourable again?
text_la: Numquid in æternum projiciet Deus? aut non apponet ut complacitior sit adhuc?
text_pt: Desde os céus fizeste ouvir o teu juízo; a terra tremeu e se aquietou,
text_el: μὴ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀπώσεται κύριος καὶ οὐ προσθήσει τοῦ εὐδοκῆσαι ἔτι

text_en: Or will he cut off his mercy for ever, from generation to generation ?
text_la: aut in finem misericordiam suam abscindet, a generatione in generationem?
text_pt: Quando Deus se levantou para fazer juízo, para livrar a todos os mansos da terra. (Selá.)
text_el: ἢ εἰς τέλος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἀποκόψει ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν

text_en: Or will God forget to show mercy? Or will he in his anger shut up his mercies?
text_la: aut obliviscetur misereri Deus? aut continebit in ira sua misericordias suas?
text_pt: Certamente a cólera do homem redundará em teu louvor; o restante da cólera tu o restringirás.
text_el: ἢ ἐπιλήσεται τοῦ οἰκτιρῆσαι ὁ θεὸς ἢ συνέξει ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ τοὺς οἰκτιρμοὺς αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: And I said, Now have I begun: this is the change of the right hand of the most High .
text_la: Et dixi : Nunc cœpi; hæc mutatio dexteræ Excelsi.
text_pt: Fazei votos, e pagai ao Senhor vosso Deus; tragam presentes, os que estão em redor dele, àquele que é temível.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα νῦν ἠρξάμην αὕτη ἡ ἀλλοίωσις τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: I remembered the works of the Lord : for I will be mindful of your wonders from the beginning.
text_la: Memor fui operum Domini, quia memor ero ab initio mirabilium tuorum:
text_pt: Ele ceifará o espírito dos príncipes; é tremendo para com os reis da terra.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην τῶν ἔργων κυρίου ὅτι μνησθήσομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν θαυμασίων σου

text_en: And I will meditate on all your works: and will be employed in your inventions.
text_la: et meditabor in omnibus operibus tuis, et in adinventionibus tuis exercebor.
text_el: καὶ μελετήσω ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔργοις σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασίν σου ἀδολεσχήσω

text_en: Your way, O God , is in the holy place: who is the great God like our God ?
text_la: Deus, in sancto via tua : quis deus magnus sicut Deus noster?
text_el: ὁ θεός ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ἡ ὁδός σου τίς θεὸς μέγας ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: You are the God that does wonders. You have made your power known among the nations:
text_la: Tu es Deus qui facis mirabilia : notam fecisti in populis virtutem tuam.
text_el: σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιῶν θαυμάσια ἐγνώρισας ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς τὴν δύναμίν σου

text_en: With your arm you have redeemed your people the children of Jacob and of Joseph .
text_la: Redemisti in brachio tuo populum tuum, filios Jacob et Joseph.
text_el: ἐλυτρώσω ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τὸν λαόν σου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ιακωβ καὶ Ιωσηφ διάψαλμα

text_en: The waters saw you, O God , the waters saw you: and they were afraid, and the depths were troubled.
text_la: Viderunt te aquæ, Deus; viderunt te aquæ, et timuerunt : et turbatæ sunt abyssi.
text_el: εἴδοσάν σε ὕδατα ὁ θεός εἴδοσάν σε ὕδατα καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν καὶ ἐταράχθησαν ἄβυσσοι πλῆθος ἤχους ὑδάτων

text_en: Great was the noise of the waters: the clouds sent out a sound. For your arrows pass:
text_la: Multitudo sonitus aquarum; vocem dederunt nubes. Etenim sagittæ tuæ transeunt;
text_el: φωνὴν ἔδωκαν αἱ νεφέλαι καὶ γὰρ τὰ βέλη σου διαπορεύονται

text_en: The voice of your thunder in a wheel. Your lightnings enlightened the world: the earth shook and trembled.
text_la: vox tonitrui tui in rota. Illuxerunt coruscationes tuæ orbi terræ; commota est, et contremuit terra.
text_el: φωνὴ τῆς βροντῆς σου ἐν τῷ τροχῷ ἔφαναν αἱ ἀστραπαί σου τῇ οἰκουμένῃ ἐσαλεύθη καὶ ἔντρομος ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ

text_en: Your way is in the sea, and your paths in many waters: and your footsteps shall not be known .
text_la: In mari via tua, et semitæ tuæ in aquis multis, et vestigia tua non cognoscentur.
text_el: ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἡ ὁδός σου καὶ αἱ τρίβοι σου ἐν ὕδασι πολλοῖς καὶ τὰ ἴχνη σου οὐ γνωσθήσονται

text_en: You have conducted your people like sheep, by the hand of Moses and Aaron .
text_la: Deduxisti sicut oves populum tuum, in manu Moysi et Aaron.
text_el: ὡδήγησας ὡς πρόβατα τὸν λαόν σου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ καὶ Ααρων

text_en: Attend, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
text_la: Attendite, popule meus, legem meam; inclinate aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
text_pt: Clamei a Deus com a minha voz, a Deus levantei a minha voz, e ele inclinou para mim os ouvidos.
text_el: συνέσεως τῷ Ασαφ προσέχετε λαός μου τὸν νόμον μου κλίνατε τὸ οὖς ὑμῶν εἰς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου

text_en: I will open my mouth in parables : I will utter propositions from the beginning.
text_la: Aperiam in parabolis os meum; loquar propositiones ab initio.
text_pt: No dia da minha angústia busquei ao Senhor; a minha mão se estendeu de noite, e não cessava; a minha alma recusava ser consolada.
text_el: ἀνοίξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου φθέγξομαι προβλήματα ἀπ' ἀρχῆς

text_en: How great things have we heard and known , and our fathers have told us.
text_la: Quanta audivimus, et cognovimus ea, et patres nostri narraverunt nobis.
text_pt: Lembrava-me de Deus, e me perturbei; queixava-me, e o meu espírito desfalecia. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν καὶ ἔγνωμεν αὐτὰ καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν διηγήσαντο ἡμῖν

text_en: They have not been hidden from their children, in another generation . Declaring the praises of the Lord , and his powers, and his wonders which he has done.
text_la: Non sunt occultata a filiis eorum in generatione altera, narrantes laudes Domini et virtutes ejus, et mirabilia ejus quæ fecit.
text_pt: Sustentaste os meus olhos acordados; estou tão perturbado que não posso falar.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν ἀπαγγέλλοντες τὰς αἰνέσεις τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τὰς δυναστείας αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν

text_en: And he set up a testimony in Jacob : and made a law in Israel . How great things he commanded our fathers, that they should make the same known to their children:
text_la: Et suscitavit testimonium in Jacob, et legem posuit in Israël, quanta mandavit patribus nostris nota facere ea filiis suis:
text_pt: Considerava os dias da antiguidade, os anos dos tempos antigos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησεν μαρτύριον ἐν Ιακωβ καὶ νόμον ἔθετο ἐν Ισραηλ ὅσα ἐνετείλατο τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν τοῦ γνωρίσαι αὐτὰ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: That another generation might know them. The children that should be born and should rise up, and declare them to their children.
text_la: ut cognoscat generatio altera : filii qui nascentur et exsurgent, et narrabunt filiis suis,
text_pt: De noite chamei à lembrança o meu cântico; meditei em meu coração, e o meu espírito esquadrinhou.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν γνῷ γενεὰ ἑτέρα υἱοὶ οἱ τεχθησόμενοι καὶ ἀναστήσονται καὶ ἀπαγγελοῦσιν αὐτὰ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: That they may put their hope in God and may not forget the works of God : and may seek his commandments.
text_la: ut ponant in Deo spem suam, et non obliviscantur operum Dei, et mandata ejus exquirant:
text_pt: Rejeitará o Senhor para sempre e não tornará a ser favorável?
text_el: ἵνα θῶνται ἐπὶ τὸν θεὸν τὴν ἐλπίδα αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ ἐπιλάθωνται τῶν ἔργων τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσουσιν

text_en: That they may not become like their fathers, a perverse and exasperating generation . A generation that set not their heart aright: and whose spirit was not faithful to God .
text_la: ne fiant, sicut patres eorum, generatio prava et exasperans; generatio quæ non direxit cor suum, et non est creditus cum Deo spiritus ejus.
text_pt: Cessou para sempre a sua benignidade? Acabou-se já a promessa de geração em geração?
text_el: ἵνα μὴ γένωνται ὡς οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν γενεὰ σκολιὰ καὶ παραπικραίνουσα γενεά ἥτις οὐ κατηύθυνεν τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστώθη μετὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς

text_en: The sons of Ephraim who bend and shoot with the bow: they have turned back in the day of battle.
text_la: Filii Ephrem, intendentes et mittentes arcum, conversi sunt in die belli.
text_pt: Esqueceu-se Deus de ter misericórdia? Ou encerrou ele as suas misericórdias na sua ira? (Selá.)
text_el: υἱοὶ Εφραιμ ἐντείνοντες καὶ βάλλοντες τόξοις ἐστράφησαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου

text_en: They kept not the covenant of God : and in his law they would not walk.
text_la: Non custodierunt testamentum Dei, et in lege ejus noluerunt ambulare.
text_pt: E eu disse: Isto é enfermidade minha; mas eu me lembrarei dos anos da destra do Altíssimo.
text_el: οὐκ ἐφύλαξαν τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἤθελον πορεύεσθαι

text_en: And they forgot his benefits, and his wonders that he had shown them.
text_la: Et obliti sunt benefactorum ejus, et mirabilium ejus quæ ostendit eis.
text_pt: Eu me lembrarei das obras do Senhor; certamente que eu me lembrarei das tuas maravilhas da antiguidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐπελάθοντο τῶν εὐεργεσιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Wonderful things did he do in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt , in the field of Tanis .
text_la: Coram patribus eorum fecit mirabilia in terra Ægypti, in campo Taneos.
text_pt: Meditarei também em todas as tuas obras, e falarei dos teus feitos.
text_el: ἐναντίον τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἃ ἐποίησεν θαυμάσια ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν πεδίῳ Τάνεως

text_en: He divided the sea and brought them through: and he made the waters to stand as in a vessel.
text_la: Interrupit mare, et perduxit eos, et statuit aquas quasi in utre:
text_pt: O teu caminho, ó Deus, está no santuário. Quem é Deus tão grande como o nosso Deus?
text_el: διέρρηξεν θάλασσαν καὶ διήγαγεν αὐτούς ἔστησεν ὕδατα ὡσεὶ ἀσκὸν

text_en: And he conducted them with a cloud by day: and all the night with a light of fire.
text_la: et deduxit eos in nube diei, et tota nocte in illuminatione ignis.
text_pt: Tu és o Deus que fazes maravilhas; tu fizeste notória a tua força entre os povos.
text_el: καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν νεφέλῃ ἡμέρας καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐν φωτισμῷ πυρός

text_en: He struck the rock in the wilderness : and gave them to drink, as out of the great deep .
text_la: Interrupit petram in eremo, et adaquavit eos velut in abysso multa.
text_pt: Com o teu braço remiste o teu povo, os filhos de Jacó e de José. (Selá.)
text_el: διέρρηξεν πέτραν ἐν ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ πολλῇ

text_en: He brought forth water out of the rock: and made streams run down as rivers.
text_la: Et eduxit aquam de petra, et deduxit tamquam flumina aquas.
text_pt: As águas te viram, ó Deus, as águas te viram, e tremeram; os abismos também se abalaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ὕδωρ ἐκ πέτρας καὶ κατήγαγεν ὡς ποταμοὺς ὕδατα

text_en: And they added yet more sin against him: they provoked the most High to wrath in the place without water.
text_la: Et apposuerunt adhuc peccare ei; in iram excitaverunt Excelsum in inaquoso.
text_pt: As nuvens lançaram água, os céus deram um som; as tuas flechas correram duma para outra parte.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν αὐτῷ παρεπίκραναν τὸν ὕψιστον ἐν ἀνύδρῳ

text_en: And they tempted God in their hearts, by asking meat for their desires.
text_la: Et tentaverunt Deum in cordibus suis, ut peterent escas animabus suis.
text_pt: A voz do teu trovão estava no céu; os relâmpagos iluminaram o mundo; a terra se abalou e tremeu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπείρασαν τὸν θεὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν τοῦ αἰτῆσαι βρώματα ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: And they spoke ill of God : they said: Can God furnish a table in the wilderness ?
text_la: Et male locuti sunt de Deo; dixerunt : Numquid poterit Deus parare mensam in deserto?
text_pt: O teu caminho é no mar, e as tuas veredas nas águas grandes, e os teus passos não são conhecidos.
text_el: καὶ κατελάλησαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπαν μὴ δυνήσεται ὁ θεὸς ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν ἐν ἐρήμῳ

text_en: Because he struck the rock, and the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed. Can he also give bread, or provide a table for his people?
text_la: quoniam percussit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ, et torrentes inundaverunt. Numquid et panem poterit dare, aut parare mensam populo suo?
text_pt: Guiaste o teu povo, como a um rebanho, pela mão de Moisés e de Arão.
text_el: ἐπεὶ ἐπάταξεν πέτραν καὶ ἐρρύησαν ὕδατα καὶ χείμαρροι κατεκλύσθησαν μὴ καὶ ἄρτον δύναται δοῦναι ἢ ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore the Lord heard, and was angry : and a fire was kindled against Jacob , and wrath came up against Israel .
text_la: Ideo audivit Dominus et distulit; et ignis accensus est in Jacob, et ira ascendit in Israël:
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἤκουσεν κύριος καὶ ἀνεβάλετο καὶ πῦρ ἀνήφθη ἐν Ιακωβ καὶ ὀργὴ ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: Because they believed not in God : and trusted not in his salvation .
text_la: quia non crediderunt in Deo, nec speraverunt in salutari ejus.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν ἐν τῷ θεῷ οὐδὲ ἤλπισαν ἐπὶ τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of heaven .
text_la: Et mandavit nubibus desuper, et januas cæli aperuit.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο νεφέλαις ὑπεράνωθεν καὶ θύρας οὐρανοῦ ἀνέῳξεν

text_en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them the bread of heaven .
text_la: Et pluit illis manna ad manducandum, et panem cæli dedit eis.
text_el: καὶ ἔβρεξεν αὐτοῖς μαννα φαγεῖν καὶ ἄρτον οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Man ate the bread of angels : he sent them provisions in abundance.
text_la: Panem angelorum manducavit homo; cibaria misit eis in abundantia.
text_el: ἄρτον ἀγγέλων ἔφαγεν ἄνθρωπος ἐπισιτισμὸν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῖς εἰς πλησμονήν

text_en: He removed the south wind from heaven : and by his power brought in the southwest wind.
text_la: Transtulit austrum de cælo, et induxit in virtute sua africum.
text_el: ἀπῆρεν νότον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ἐν τῇ δυναστείᾳ αὐτοῦ λίβα

text_en: And he rained upon them flesh as dust: and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea.
text_la: Et pluit super eos sicut pulverem carnes, et sicut arenam maris volatilia pennata.
text_el: καὶ ἔβρεξεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὡσεὶ χοῦν σάρκας καὶ ὡσεὶ ἄμμον θαλασσῶν πετεινὰ πτερωτά

text_en: And they fell in the midst of their camp, round about their pavilions.
text_la: Et ceciderunt in medio castrorum eorum, circa tabernacula eorum.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέπεσον εἰς μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς αὐτῶν κύκλῳ τῶν σκηνωμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: So they ate, and were filled exceedingly, and he gave them their desire:
text_la: Et manducaverunt, et saturati sunt nimis, et desiderium eorum attulit eis:
text_el: καὶ ἐφάγοσαν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθησαν σφόδρα καὶ τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν αὐτῶν ἤνεγκεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They were not defrauded of that which they craved. As yet their meat was in their mouth:
text_la: non sunt fraudati a desiderio suo. Adhuc escæ eorum erant in ore ipsorum,
text_el: οὐκ ἐστερήθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν ἔτι τῆς βρώσεως αὐτῶν οὔσης ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: And the wrath of God came upon them. And he slew the fat ones amongst them, and brought down the chosen men of Israel .
text_la: et ira Dei ascendit super eos : et occidit pingues eorum, et electos Israël impedivit.
text_el: καὶ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνέβη ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν τοῖς πίοσιν αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς τοῦ Ισραηλ συνεπόδισεν

text_en: In all these things they sinned still: and they behaved not for his wondrous works.
text_la: In omnibus his peccaverunt adhuc, et non crediderunt in mirabilibus ejus.
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις ἥμαρτον ἔτι καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν ἐν τοῖς θαυμασίοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And their days were consumed in vanity, and their years in haste.
text_la: Et defecerunt in vanitate dies eorum, et anni eorum cum festinatione.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέλιπον ἐν ματαιότητι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἔτη αὐτῶν μετὰ σπουδῆς

text_en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned, and came to him early in the morning.
text_la: Cum occideret eos, quærebant eum et revertebantur, et diluculo veniebant ad eum.
text_el: ὅταν ἀπέκτεννεν αὐτούς ἐξεζήτουν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπέστρεφον καὶ ὤρθριζον πρὸς τὸν θεὸν

text_en: And they remembered that God was their helper: and the most high God their redeemer .
text_la: Et rememorati sunt quia Deus adjutor est eorum, et Deus excelsus redemptor eorum est.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς βοηθὸς αὐτῶν ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὕψιστος λυτρωτὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν

text_en: And they loved him with their mouth: and with their tongue they lied unto him:
text_la: Et dilexerunt eum in ore suo, et lingua sua mentiti sunt ei;
text_el: καὶ ἠπάτησαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν καὶ τῇ γλώσσῃ αὐτῶν ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ

text_en: But their heart was not right with him: nor were they counted faithful in his covenant.
text_la: cor autem eorum non erat rectum cum eo, nec fideles habiti sunt in testamento ejus.
text_el: ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν οὐκ εὐθεῖα μετ' αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἐπιστώθησαν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he is merciful, and will forgive their sins : and will not destroy them. And many a time did he turn away his anger : and did not kindle all his wrath .
text_la: Ipse autem est misericors, et propitius fiet peccatis eorum, et non disperdet eos. Et abundavit ut averteret iram suam, et non accendit omnem iram suam.
text_el: αὐτὸς δέ ἐστιν οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἱλάσεται ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ διαφθερεῖ καὶ πληθυνεῖ τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐχὶ ἐκκαύσει πᾶσαν τὴν ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he remembered that they are flesh: a wind that goes and returns not.
text_la: Et recordatus est quia caro sunt, spiritus vadens et non rediens.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὅτι σάρξ εἰσιν πνεῦμα πορευόμενον καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστρέφον

text_en: How often did they provoke him in the desert : and move him to wrath in the place without water?
text_la: Quoties exacerbaverunt eum in deserto; in iram concitaverunt eum in inaquoso?
text_el: ποσάκις παρεπίκραναν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ

text_en: And they turned back and tempted God : and grieved the holy one of Israel .
text_la: Et conversi sunt, et tentaverunt Deum, et sanctum Israël exacerbaverunt.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν καὶ ἐπείρασαν τὸν θεὸν καὶ τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ παρώξυναν

text_en: They remembered not his hand, in the day that he redeemed them from the hand of him that afflicted them:
text_la: Non sunt recordati manus ejus, die qua redemit eos de manu tribulantis:
text_el: οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας ἧς ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς θλίβοντος

text_en: How he wrought his signs in Egypt , and his wonders in the field of Tanis .
text_la: sicut posuit in Ægypto signa sua, et prodigia sua in campo Taneos;
text_el: ὡς ἔθετο ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ τὰ σημεῖα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ τέρατα αὐτοῦ ἐν πεδίῳ Τάνεως

text_en: And he turned their rivers into blood, and their showers that they might not drink.
text_la: et convertit in sanguinem flumina eorum, et imbres eorum, ne biberent.
text_el: καὶ μετέστρεψεν εἰς αἷμα τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ὀμβρήματα αὐτῶν ὅπως μὴ πίωσιν

text_en: He sent amongst them divers sorts of flies, which devoured them: and frogs which destroyed them.
text_la: Misit in eos cœnomyiam, et comedit eos, et ranam, et disperdidit eos;
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς αὐτοὺς κυνόμυιαν καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς καὶ βάτραχον καὶ διέφθειρεν αὐτούς

text_en: And he gave up their fruits to the blast, and their labours to the locust.
text_la: et dedit ærugini fructus eorum, et labores eorum locustæ;
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν τῇ ἐρυσίβῃ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς πόνους αὐτῶν τῇ ἀκρίδι

text_en: And he destroyed their vineyards with hail, and their mulberry trees with hoarfrost.
text_la: et occidit in grandine vineas eorum, et moros eorum in pruina;
text_el: ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν χαλάζῃ τὴν ἄμπελον αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς συκαμίνους αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ πάχνῃ

text_en: And he gave up their cattle to the hail, and their stock to the fire.
text_la: et tradidit grandini jumenta eorum, et possessionem eorum igni;
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν εἰς χάλαζαν τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν ὕπαρξιν αὐτῶν τῷ πυρί

text_en: And he sent upon them the wrath of his indignation: indignation and wrath and trouble, which he sent by evil angels .
text_la: misit in eos iram indignationis suæ, indignationem, et iram, et tribulationem, immissiones per angelos malos.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς αὐτοὺς ὀργὴν θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ θυμὸν καὶ ὀργὴν καὶ θλῖψιν ἀποστολὴν δι' ἀγγέλων πονηρῶν

text_en: He made a way for a path to his anger : he spared not their souls from death, and their cattle he shut up in death.
text_la: Viam fecit semitæ iræ suæ : non pepercit a morte animabus eorum, et jumenta eorum in morte conclusit:
text_el: ὡδοποίησεν τρίβον τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀπὸ θανάτου τῶν ψυχῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν εἰς θάνατον συνέκλεισεν

text_en: And he killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt : the firstfruits of all their labour in the tabernacles of Cham .
text_la: et percussit omne primogenitum in terra Ægypti; primitias omnis laboris eorum in tabernaculis Cham:
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἀπαρχὴν τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασι Χαμ

text_en: And he took away his own people as sheep: and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
text_la: et abstulit sicut oves populum suum, et perduxit eos tamquam gregem in deserto:
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ὡς πρόβατα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ὡς ποίμνιον ἐν ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And he brought them out in hope and they feared not: and the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
text_la: et deduxit eos in spe, et non timuerunt, et inimicos eorum operuit mare.
text_el: καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐλπίδι καὶ οὐκ ἐδειλίασαν καὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάλυψεν θάλασσα

text_en: And he brought them into the mountain of his sanctuary: the mountain which his right hand had purchased. And he cast out the Gentiles before them: and by lot divided to them their land by a line of distribution.
text_la: Et induxit eos in montem sanctificationis suæ, montem quem acquisivit dextera ejus; et ejecit a facie eorum gentes, et sorte divisit eis terram in funiculo distributionis;
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ὅριον ἁγιάσματος αὐτοῦ ὄρος τοῦτο ὃ ἐκτήσατο ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tabernacles.
text_la: et habitare fecit in tabernaculis eorum tribus Israël.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἔθνη καὶ ἐκληροδότησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν σχοινίῳ κληροδοσίας καὶ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν τὰς φυλὰς τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Yet they tempted , and provoked the most high God : and they kept not his testimonies.
text_la: Et tentaverunt, et exacerbaverunt Deum excelsum, et testimonia ejus non custodierunt.
text_el: καὶ ἐπείρασαν καὶ παρεπίκραναν τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο

text_en: And they turned away, and kept not the covenant: even like their fathers they were turned aside as a crooked bow.
text_la: Et averterunt se, et non servaverunt pactum : quemadmodum patres eorum, conversi sunt in arcum pravum.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν καὶ ἠσυνθέτησαν καθὼς καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ μετεστράφησαν εἰς τόξον στρεβλὸν

text_en: They provoked him to anger on their hills: and moved him to jealousy with their graven things.
text_la: In iram concitaverunt eum in collibus suis, et in sculptilibus suis ad æmulationem eum provocaverunt.
text_el: καὶ παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς βουνοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν παρεζήλωσαν αὐτόν

text_en: God heard, and despised them, and he reduced Israel exceedingly as it were to nothing.
text_la: Audivit Deus, et sprevit, et ad nihilum redegit valde Israël.
text_el: ἤκουσεν ὁ θεὸς καὶ ὑπερεῖδεν καὶ ἐξουδένωσεν σφόδρα τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he put away the tabernacle of Silo, his tabernacle where he dwelt among men .
text_la: Et repulit tabernaculum Silo, tabernaculum suum, ubi habitavit in hominibus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπώσατο τὴν σκηνὴν Σηλωμ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ οὗ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν ἀνθρώποις

text_en: And he delivered their strength into captivity: and their beauty into the hands of the enemy.
text_la: Et tradidit in captivitatem virtutem eorum, et pulchritudinem eorum in manus inimici.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν καλλονὴν αὐτῶν εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ

text_en: And he shut up his people under the sword: and he despised his inheritance.
text_la: Et conclusit in gladio populum suum, et hæreditatem suam sprevit.
text_el: καὶ συνέκλεισεν εἰς ῥομφαίαν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ ὑπερεῖδεν

text_en: Fire consumed their young men: and their maidens were not lamented.
text_la: Juvenes eorum comedit ignis, et virgines eorum non sunt lamentatæ.
text_el: τοὺς νεανίσκους αὐτῶν κατέφαγεν πῦρ καὶ αἱ παρθένοι αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπενθήθησαν

text_en: Their priests fell by the sword: and their widows did not mourn.
text_la: Sacerdotes eorum in gladio ceciderunt, et viduæ eorum non plorabantur.
text_el: οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἔπεσαν καὶ αἱ χῆραι αὐτῶν οὐ κλαυσθήσονται

text_en: And the Lord was awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that has been surfeited with wine.
text_la: Et excitatus est tamquam dormiens Dominus, tamquam potens crapulatus a vino.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηγέρθη ὡς ὁ ὑπνῶν κύριος ὡς δυνατὸς κεκραιπαληκὼς ἐξ οἴνου

text_en: And he smote his enemies on the hinder parts: he put them to an everlasting reproach.
text_la: Et percussit inimicos suos in posteriora; opprobrium sempiternum dedit illis.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ὄνειδος αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph : and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
text_la: Et repulit tabernaculum Joseph, et tribum Ephraim non elegit:
text_el: καὶ ἀπώσατο τὸ σκήνωμα Ιωσηφ καὶ τὴν φυλὴν Εφραιμ οὐκ ἐξελέξατο

text_en: But he chose the tribe of Juda , mount Sion which he loved .
text_la: sed elegit tribum Juda, montem Sion, quem dilexit.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελέξατο τὴν φυλὴν Ιουδα τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σιων ὃ ἠγάπησεν

text_en: And he built his sanctuary as of unicorns, in the land which he founded for ever.
text_la: Et ædificavit sicut unicornium sanctificium suum, in terra quam fundavit in sæcula.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ὡς μονοκερώτων τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And he chose his servant David , and took him from the flocks of sheep: he brought him from following the ewes great with young,
text_la: Et elegit David, servum suum, et sustulit eum de gregibus ovium; de post fœtantes accepit eum:
text_el: καὶ ἐξελέξατο Δαυιδ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τῶν ποιμνίων τῶν προβάτων

text_en: to feed Jacob his servant and Israel his inheritance.
text_la: pascere Jacob servum suum, et Israël hæreditatem suam.
text_el: ἐξόπισθεν τῶν λοχευομένων ἔλαβεν αὐτὸν ποιμαίνειν Ιακωβ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ Ισραηλ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he fed them in the innocence of his heart: and conducted them by the skilfulness of his hands.
text_la: Et pavit eos in innocentia cordis sui, et in intellectibus manuum suarum deduxit eos.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίμανεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀκακίᾳ τῆς καρδίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς συνέσεσι τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ὡδήγησεν αὐτούς

text_en: O God , the heathens have come into your inheritance, they have defiled your holy temple : they have made Jerusalem as a place to keep fruit.
text_la: Deus, venerunt gentes in hæreditatem tuam; polluerunt templum sanctum tuum; posuerunt Jerusalem in pomorum custodiam.
text_pt: Escutai a minha lei, povo meu; inclinai os vossos ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ ὁ θεός ἤλθοσαν ἔθνη εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου ἐμίαναν τὸν ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου ἔθεντο Ιερουσαλημ εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον

text_en: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be meat for the fowls of the air: the flesh of your saints for the beasts of the earth.
text_la: Posuerunt morticina servorum tuorum escas volatilibus cæli; carnes sanctorum tuorum bestiis terræ.
text_pt: Abrirei a minha boca numa parábola; falarei enigmas da antiguidade.
text_el: ἔθεντο τὰ θνησιμαῖα τῶν δούλων σου βρώματα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὰς σάρκας τῶν ὁσίων σου τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς

text_en: They have poured out their blood as water, round about Jerusalem and there was none to bury them.
text_la: Effuderunt sanguinem eorum tamquam aquam in circuitu Jerusalem, et non erat qui sepeliret.
text_pt: Os quais temos ouvido e sabido, e nossos pais no-los têm contado.
text_el: ἐξέχεαν τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ὡς ὕδωρ κύκλῳ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ θάπτων

text_en: We have become a reproach to our neighbours: a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
text_la: Facti sumus opprobrium vicinis nostris; subsannatio et illusio his qui in circuitu nostro sunt.
text_pt: Não os encobriremos aos seus filhos, mostrando à geração futura os louvores do Senhor, assim como a sua força e as maravilhas que fez.
text_el: ἐγενήθημεν ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν μυκτηρισμὸς καὶ χλευασμὸς τοῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν

text_en: How long, O Lord , will you be angry for ever: shall your zeal be kindled like a fire?
text_la: Usquequo, Domine, irasceris in finem? accendetur velut ignis zelus tuus?
text_pt: Porque ele estabeleceu um testemunho em Jacó, e pôs uma lei em Israel, a qual deu aos nossos pais para que a fizessem conhecer a seus filhos;
text_el: ἕως πότε κύριε ὀργισθήσῃ εἰς τέλος ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ὁ ζῆλός σου

text_en: Pour out your wrath upon the nations that have not known you: and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your name .
text_la: Effunde iram tuam in gentes quæ te non noverunt, et in regna quæ nomen tuum non invocaverunt:
text_pt: Para que a geração vindoura a soubesse, os filhos que nascessem, os quais se levantassem e a contassem a seus filhos;
text_el: ἔκχεον τὴν ὀργήν σου ἐπὶ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ γινώσκοντά σε καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας αἳ τὸ ὄνομά σου οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο

text_en: Because they have devoured Jacob ; and have laid waste his place.
text_la: quia comederunt Jacob, et locum ejus desolaverunt.
text_pt: Para que pusessem em Deus a sua esperança, e se não esquecessem das obras de Deus, mas guardassem os seus mandamentos.
text_el: ὅτι κατέφαγον τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ ἠρήμωσαν

text_en: Remember not our former iniquities : let your mercies speedily prevent us, for we have become exceeding poor.
text_la: Ne memineris iniquitatum nostrarum antiquarum; cito anticipent nos misericordiæ tuæ, quia pauperes facti sumus nimis.
text_pt: E não fossem como seus pais, geração contumaz e rebelde, geração que não regeu o seu coração, e cujo espírito não foi fiel a Deus.
text_el: μὴ μνησθῇς ἡμῶν ἀνομιῶν ἀρχαίων ταχὺ προκαταλαβέτωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ οἰκτιρμοί σου ὅτι ἐπτωχεύσαμεν σφόδρα

text_en: Help us, O God , our saviour: and for the glory of your name , O Lord , deliver us: and forgive us our sins for your name's sake:
text_la: Adjuva nos, Deus salutaris noster, et propter gloriam nominis tui, Domine, libera nos : et propitius esto peccatis nostris, propter nomen tuum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Efraim, armados e trazendo arcos, viraram as costas no dia da peleja.
text_el: βοήθησον ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν ἕνεκα τῆς δόξης τοῦ ὀνόματός σου κύριε ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ ἱλάσθητι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου

text_en: Lest they should say among the Gentiles : Where is their God ? And let him be made known among the nations before our eyes, By the revenging the blood of your servants, which has been shed:
text_la: Ne forte dicant in gentibus : Ubi est Deus eorum? et innotescat in nationibus coram oculis nostris ultio sanguinis servorum tuorum qui effusus est.
text_pt: Não guardaram a aliança de Deus, e recusaram andar na sua lei;
text_el: μήποτε εἴπωσιν τὰ ἔθνη ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ γνωσθήτω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ἡμῶν ἡ ἐκδίκησις τοῦ αἵματος τῶν δούλων σου τοῦ ἐκκεχυμένου

text_en: Let the sighing of the prisoners come in before you. According to the greatness of your arm, take possession of the children of them that have been put to death .
text_la: Introëat in conspectu tuo gemitus compeditorum; secundum magnitudinem brachii tui posside filios mortificatorum:
text_pt: E esqueceram-se das suas obras e das maravilhas que lhes fizera ver.
text_el: εἰσελθάτω ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ στεναγμὸς τῶν πεπεδημένων κατὰ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην τοῦ βραχίονός σου περιποίησαι τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν τεθανατωμένων

text_en: And render to our neighbours sevenfold in their bosom: the reproach wherewith they have reproached you, O Lord .
text_la: et redde vicinis nostris septuplum in sinu eorum; improperium ipsorum quod exprobraverunt tibi, Domine.
text_pt: Maravilhas que ele fez à vista de seus pais na terra do Egito, no campo de Zoã.
text_el: ἀπόδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν ἑπταπλασίονα εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν ὃν ὠνείδισάν σε κύριε

text_en: But we your people, and the sheep of your pasture, will give thanks to you for ever. We will show forth your praise, unto generation and generation .
text_la: Nos autem populus tuus, et oves pascuæ tuæ, confitebimur tibi in sæculum; in generationem et generationem annuntiabimus laudem tuam.
text_pt: Dividiu o mar, e os fez passar por ele; fez com que as águas parassem como num montão.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ λαός σου καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς σου ἀνθομολογησόμεθά σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἐξαγγελοῦμεν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου

text_en: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed, a testimony for Asaph, a psalm.
