text_la: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. Testimonium Asaph, psalmus.
text_pt: Ó Deus, os gentios vieram à tua herança; contaminaram o teu santo templo; reduziram Jerusalém a montões de pedras.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀλλοιωθησομένων μαρτύριον τῷ Ασαφ ψαλμὸς ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀσσυρίου

text_en: Give ear, O you that rule Israel : you that lead Joseph like a sheep. You that sit upon the cherubims , shine forth
text_la: Qui regis Israël, intende; qui deducis velut ovem Joseph. Qui sedes super cherubim, manifestare
text_pt: Deram os corpos mortos dos teus servos por comida às aves dos céus, e a carne dos teus santos às feras da terra.
text_el: ὁ ποιμαίνων τὸν Ισραηλ πρόσχες ὁ ὁδηγῶν ὡσεὶ πρόβατα τὸν Ιωσηφ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβιν ἐμφάνηθι

text_en: before Ephraim, Benjamin , and Manasses . Stir up your might, and come to save us.
text_la: coram Ephraim, Benjamin, et Manasse. Excita potentiam tuam, et veni, ut salvos facias nos.
text_pt: Derramaram o sangue deles como a água ao redor de Jerusalém, e não houve quem os enterrasse.
text_el: ἐναντίον Εφραιμ καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ Μανασση ἐξέγειρον τὴν δυναστείαν σου καὶ ἐλθὲ εἰς τὸ σῶσαι ἡμᾶς

text_en: Convert us, O God : and show us your face, and we shall be saved.
text_la: Deus, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.
text_pt: Somos feitos opróbrio para nossos vizinhos, escárnio e zombaria para os que estão à roda de nós.
text_el: ὁ θεός ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ σωθησόμεθα

text_en: O Lord God of hosts , how long will you be angry against the prayer of your servant?
text_la: Domine Deus virtutum, quousque irasceris super orationem servi tui?
text_pt: Até quando, Senhor? Acaso te indignarás para sempre? Arderá o teu zelo como fogo?
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ἕως πότε ὀργίζῃ ἐπὶ τὴν προσευχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου

text_en: How long will you feed us with the bread of tears: and give us for our drink tears in measure?
text_la: cibabis nos pane lacrimarum, et potum dabis nobis in lacrimis in mensura?
text_pt: Derrama o teu furor sobre os gentios que não te conhecem, e sobre os reinos que não invocam o teu nome.
text_el: ψωμιεῖς ἡμᾶς ἄρτον δακρύων καὶ ποτιεῖς ἡμᾶς ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν μέτρῳ

text_en: You have made us to be a contradiction to our neighbours: and our enemies have scoffed at us.
text_la: Posuisti nos in contradictionem vicinis nostris, et inimici nostri subsannaverunt nos.
text_pt: Porque devoraram a Jacó, e assolaram as suas moradas.
text_el: ἔθου ἡμᾶς εἰς ἀντιλογίαν τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ἐμυκτήρισαν ἡμᾶς

text_en: O God of hosts , convert us: and show your face, and we shall be saved.
text_la: Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.
text_pt: Não te lembres das nossas iniqüidades passadas; venham ao nosso encontro depressa as tuas misericórdias, pois já estamos muito abatidos.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ σωθησόμεθα διάψαλμα

text_en: You have brought a vineyard out of Egypt : you have cast out the Gentiles and planted it.
text_la: Vineam de Ægypto transtulisti : ejecisti gentes, et plantasti eam.
text_pt: Ajuda-nos, ó Deus da nossa salvação, pela glória do teu nome; e livra-nos, e perdoa os nossos pecados por amor do teu nome.
text_el: ἄμπελον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου μετῆρας ἐξέβαλες ἔθνη καὶ κατεφύτευσας αὐτήν

text_en: You were the guide of its journey in its sight: you planted the roots thereof, and it filled the land.
text_la: Dux itineris fuisti in conspectu ejus; plantasti radices ejus, et implevit terram.
text_pt: Porque diriam os gentios: Onde está o seu Deus? Seja ele conhecido entre os gentios, à nossa vista, pela vingança do sangue dos teus servos, que foi derramado.
text_el: ὡδοποίησας ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῆς καὶ κατεφύτευσας τὰς ῥίζας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ

text_en: The shadow of it covered the hills: and the branches thereof the cedars of God .
text_la: Operuit montes umbra ejus, et arbusta ejus cedros Dei.
text_pt: Venha perante a tua face o gemido dos presos; segundo a grandeza do teu braço preserva aqueles que estão sentenciados à morte.
text_el: ἐκάλυψεν ὄρη ἡ σκιὰ αὐτῆς καὶ αἱ ἀναδενδράδες αὐτῆς τὰς κέδρους τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: It stretched forth its branches unto the sea, and its boughs unto the river.
text_la: Extendit palmites suos usque ad mare, et usque ad flumen propagines ejus.
text_pt: E torna aos nossos vizinhos, no seu regaço, sete vezes tanto da sua injúria com a qual te injuriaram, Senhor.
text_el: ἐξέτεινεν τὰ κλήματα αὐτῆς ἕως θαλάσσης καὶ ἕως ποταμοῦ τὰς παραφυάδας αὐτῆς

text_en: Why have you broken down the hedge thereof, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck it?
text_la: Ut quid destruxisti maceriam ejus, et vindemiant eam omnes qui prætergrediuntur viam?
text_pt: Assim nós, teu povo e ovelhas de teu pasto, te louvaremos eternamente; de geração em geração cantaremos os teus louvores.
text_el: ἵνα τί καθεῖλες τὸν φραγμὸν αὐτῆς καὶ τρυγῶσιν αὐτὴν πάντες οἱ παραπορευόμενοι τὴν ὁδόν

text_en: The boar out of the wood has laid it waste: and a singular wild beast has devoured it.
text_la: Exterminavit eam aper de silva, et singularis ferus depastus est eam.
text_el: ἐλυμήνατο αὐτὴν σῦς ἐκ δρυμοῦ καὶ μονιὸς ἄγριος κατενεμήσατο αὐτήν

text_en: Turn again, O God of hosts , look down from heaven , and see, and visit this vineyard:
text_la: Deus virtutum, convertere, respice de cælo, et vide, et visita vineam istam:
text_el: ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ἐπίστρεψον δή ἐπίβλεψον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἰδὲ καὶ ἐπίσκεψαι τὴν ἄμπελον ταύτην

text_en: And perfect the same which your right hand has planted: and upon the son of man whom you have confirmed for yourself.
text_la: et perfice eam quam plantavit dextera tua, et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.
text_el: καὶ κατάρτισαι αὐτήν ἣν ἐφύτευσεν ἡ δεξιά σου καὶ ἐπὶ υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ὃν ἐκραταίωσας σεαυτῷ

text_en: Things set on fire and dug down shall perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
text_la: Incensa igni et suffossa, ab increpatione vultus tui peribunt.
text_el: ἐμπεπυρισμένη πυρὶ καὶ ἀνεσκαμμένη ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεως τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand : and upon the son of man whom you have confirmed for yourself.
text_la: Fiat manus tua super virum dexteræ tuæ, et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.
text_el: γενηθήτω ἡ χείρ σου ἐπ' ἄνδρα δεξιᾶς σου καὶ ἐπὶ υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ὃν ἐκραταίωσας σεαυτῷ

text_en: And we depart not from you, you shall quicken us: and we will call upon your name .
text_la: Et non discedimus a te : vivificabis nos, et nomen tuum invocabimus.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποστῶμεν ἀπὸ σοῦ ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς καὶ τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπικαλεσόμεθα

text_en: O Lord God of hosts , convert us and show your face, and we shall be saved.
text_la: Domine Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ σωθησόμεθα

text_en: Unto the end, for the winepresses, a psalm for Asaph himself.
text_la: In finem, pro torcularibus. Psalmus ipsi Asaph.
text_pt: Tu, que és pastor de Israel, dá ouvidos; tu, que guias a José como a um rebanho; tu, que te assentas entre os querubins, resplandece.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν τῷ Ασαφ ψαλμός

text_en: Rejoice to God our helper: sing aloud to the God of Jacob .
text_la: Exsultate Deo adjutori nostro; jubilate Deo Jacob.
text_pt: Perante Efraim, Benjamim e Manassés, desperta o teu poder, e vem salvar-nos.
text_el: ἀγαλλιᾶσθε τῷ θεῷ τῷ βοηθῷ ἡμῶν ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel: the pleasant psaltery with the harp.
text_la: Sumite psalmum, et date tympanum; psalterium jucundum cum cithara.
text_pt: Faze-nos voltar, ó Deus, e faze resplandecer o teu rosto, e seremos salvos.
text_el: λάβετε ψαλμὸν καὶ δότε τύμπανον ψαλτήριον τερπνὸν μετὰ κιθάρας

text_en: Blow up the trumpet on the new moon, on the noted day of your solemnity.
text_la: Buccinate in neomenia tuba, in insigni die solemnitatis vestræ:
text_pt: Ó Senhor Deus dos Exércitos, até quando te indignarás contra a oração do teu povo?
text_el: σαλπίσατε ἐν νεομηνίᾳ σάλπιγγι ἐν εὐσήμῳ ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς ἡμῶν

text_en: For it is a commandment in Israel , and a judgment to the God of Jacob .
text_la: quia præceptum in Israël est, et judicium Deo Jacob.
text_pt: Tu os sustentas com pão de lágrimas, e lhes dás a beber lágrimas com abundância.
text_el: ὅτι πρόσταγμα τῷ Ισραηλ ἐστὶν καὶ κρίμα τῷ θεῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: He ordained it for a testimony in Joseph , when he came out of the land of Egypt : he heard a tongue which he knew not.
text_la: Testimonium in Joseph posuit illud, cum exiret de terra Ægypti; linguam quam non noverat, audivit.
text_pt: Tu nos pões em contendas com os nossos vizinhos, e os nossos inimigos zombam de nós entre si.
text_el: μαρτύριον ἐν τῷ Ιωσηφ ἔθετο αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω ἤκουσεν

text_en: He removed his back from the burdens: his hands had served in baskets.
text_la: Divertit ab oneribus dorsum ejus; manus ejus in cophino servierunt.
text_pt: Faze-nos voltar, ó Deus dos Exércitos, e faze resplandecer o teu rosto, e seremos salvos.
text_el: ἀπέστησεν ἀπὸ ἄρσεων τὸν νῶτον αὐτοῦ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κοφίνῳ ἐδούλευσαν

text_en: You called upon me in affliction, and I delivered you: I heard you in the secret place of tempest: I proved you at the waters of contradiction.
text_la: In tribulatione invocasti me, et liberavi te. Exaudivi te in abscondito tempestatis; probavi te apud aquam contradictionis.
text_pt: Trouxeste uma vinha do Egito; lançaste fora os gentios, e a plantaste.
text_el: ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλέσω με καὶ ἐρρυσάμην σε ἐπήκουσά σου ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ καταιγίδος ἐδοκίμασά σε ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας διάψαλμα

text_en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify to you: O Israel , if you will hearken to me,
text_la: Audi, populus meus, et contestabor te. Israël, si audieris me,
text_pt: Preparaste-lhe lugar, e fizeste com que ela deitasse raízes, e encheu a terra.
text_el: ἄκουσον λαός μου καὶ διαμαρτύρομαί σοι Ισραηλ ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς μου

text_en: there shall be no new god in you: neither shall you adore a strange god.
text_la: non erit in te deus recens, neque adorabis deum alienum.
text_pt: Os montes foram cobertos da sua sombra, e os seus ramos se fizeram como os formosos cedros.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ θεὸς πρόσφατος οὐδὲ προσκυνήσεις θεῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ

text_en: For I am the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt : open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
text_la: Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus, qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti. Dilata os tuum, et implebo illud.
text_pt: Ela estendeu a sua ramagem até ao mar, e os seus ramos até ao rio.
text_el: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὁ ἀναγαγών σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου πλάτυνον τὸ στόμα σου καὶ πληρώσω αὐτό

text_en: But my people heard not my voice: and Israel hearkened not to me.
text_la: Et non audivit populus meus vocem meam, et Israël non intendit mihi.
text_pt: Por que quebraste então os seus valados, de modo que todos os que passam por ela a vindimam?
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν ὁ λαός μου τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ Ισραηλ οὐ προσέσχεν μοι

text_en: So I let them go according to the desires of their heart: they shall walk in their own inventions.
text_la: Et dimisi eos secundum desideria cordis eorum; ibunt in adinventionibus suis.
text_pt: O javali da selva a devasta, e as feras do campo a devoram.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα τῶν καρδιῶν αὐτῶν πορεύσονται ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: If my people had heard me: if Israel had walked in my ways:
text_la: Si populus meus audisset me, Israël si in viis meis ambulasset,
text_pt: Oh! Deus dos Exércitos, volta-te, nós te rogamos, atende dos céus, e vê, e visita esta vide;
text_el: εἰ ὁ λαός μου ἤκουσέν μου Ισραηλ ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου εἰ ἐπορεύθη

text_en: I should soon have humbled their enemies, and laid my hand on them that troubled them.
text_la: pro nihilo forsitan inimicos eorum humiliassem, et super tribulantes eos misissem manum meam.
text_pt: E a videira que a tua destra plantou, e o sarmento que fortificaste para ti.
text_el: ἐν τῷ μηδενὶ ἂν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐταπείνωσα καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτοὺς ἐπέβαλον τὴν χεῖρά μου

text_en: The enemies of the Lord have lied to him: and their time shall be for ever.
text_la: Inimici Domini mentiti sunt ei, et erit tempus eorum in sæcula.
text_pt: Está queimada pelo fogo, está cortada; pereceu pela repreensão da tua face.
text_el: οἱ ἐχθροὶ κυρίου ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ καὶ ἔσται ὁ καιρὸς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And he fed them with the fat of wheat, and filled them with honey out of the rock.
text_la: Et cibavit eos ex adipe frumenti, et de petra melle saturavit eos.
text_pt: Seja a tua mão sobre o homem da tua destra, sobre o filho do homem, que fortificaste para ti.
text_el: καὶ ἐψώμισεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ στέατος πυροῦ καὶ ἐκ πέτρας μέλι ἐχόρτασεν αὐτούς

text_en: God has stood in the congregation of gods: and being in the midst of them he judges gods.
text_la: Deus stetit in synagoga deorum; in medio autem deos dijudicat.
text_pt: Exultai a Deus, nossa fortaleza; jubilai ao Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Ασαφ ὁ θεὸς ἔστη ἐν συναγωγῇ θεῶν ἐν μέσῳ δὲ θεοὺς διακρίνει

text_en: How long will you judge unjustly : and accept the persons of the wicked ?
text_la: Usquequo judicatis iniquitatem, et facies peccatorum sumitis?
text_pt: Tomai um salmo, e trazei junto o tamborim, a harpa suave e o saltério.
text_el: ἕως πότε κρίνετε ἀδικίαν καὶ πρόσωπα ἁμαρτωλῶν λαμβάνετε διάψαλμα

text_en: Judge for the needy and fatherless : do justice to the humble and the poor.
text_la: Judicate egeno et pupillo; humilem et pauperem justificate.
text_pt: Tocai a trombeta na lua nova, no tempo apontado da nossa solenidade.
text_el: κρίνατε ὀρφανὸν καὶ πτωχόν ταπεινὸν καὶ πένητα δικαιώσατε

text_en: Rescue the poor; and deliver the needy out of the hand of the sinner.
text_la: Eripite pauperem, et egenum de manu peccatoris liberate.
text_pt: Porque isto era um estatuto para Israel, e uma lei do Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ἐξέλεσθε πένητα καὶ πτωχόν ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ ῥύσασθε

text_en: They have not known nor understood: they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth shall be moved.
text_la: Nescierunt, neque intellexerunt; in tenebris ambulant : movebuntur omnia fundamenta terræ.
text_pt: Ordenou-o em José por testemunho, quando saíra pela terra do Egito, onde ouvi uma língua que não entendia.
text_el: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐδὲ συνῆκαν ἐν σκότει διαπορεύονται σαλευθήσονται πάντα τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς

text_en: I have said: You are gods and all of you the sons of the most High.
text_la: Ego dixi : Dii estis, et filii Excelsi omnes.
text_pt: Tirei de seus ombros a carga; as suas mãos foram livres dos cestos.
text_el: ἐγὼ εἶπα θεοί ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ὑψίστου πάντες

text_en: But you like men shall die: and shall fall like one of the princes.
text_la: Vos autem sicut homines moriemini, et sicut unus de principibus cadetis.
text_pt: Clamaste na angústia, e te livrei; respondi-te no lugar oculto dos trovões; provei-te nas águas de Meribá. (Selá.)
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ ὡς ἄνθρωποι ἀποθνῄσκετε καὶ ὡς εἷς τῶν ἀρχόντων πίπτετε

text_en: Arise, O God , judge the earth: for you shall inherit among all the nations.
text_la: Surge, Deus, judica terram, quoniam tu hæreditabis in omnibus gentibus.
text_pt: Ouve-me, povo meu, e eu te atestarei: Ah, Israel, se me ouvires!
text_el: ἀνάστα ὁ θεός κρῖνον τὴν γῆν ὅτι σὺ κατακληρονομήσεις ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: A canticle of a psalm for Asaph.
text_la: Canticum Psalmi Asaph.
text_pt: Deus está na congregação dos poderosos; julga no meio dos deuses.
text_el: ᾠδὴ ψαλμοῦ τῷ Ασαφ

text_en: O God , who shall be like to you? Hold not your peace, neither be still, O God .
text_la: Deus, quis similis erit tibi? ne taceas, neque compescaris, Deus:
text_pt: Até quando julgareis injustamente, e aceitareis as pessoas dos ímpios? (Selá.)
text_el: ὁ θεός τίς ὁμοιωθήσεταί σοι μὴ σιγήσῃς μηδὲ καταπραΰνῃς ὁ θεός

text_en: For lo, your enemies have made a noise: and they that hate you have lifted up the head.
text_la: quoniam ecce inimici tui sonuerunt, et qui oderunt te extulerunt caput.
text_pt: Fazei justiça ao pobre e ao órfão; justificai o aflito e o necessitado.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἤχησαν καὶ οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἦραν κεφαλήν

text_en: They have taken a malicious counsel against your people, and have consulted against your saints .
text_la: Super populum tuum malignaverunt consilium, et cogitaverunt adversus sanctos tuos.
text_pt: Livrai o pobre e o necessitado; tirai-os das mãos dos ímpios.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου κατεπανουργεύσαντο γνώμην καὶ ἐβουλεύσαντο κατὰ τῶν ἁγίων σου

text_en: They have said: Come and let us destroy them, so that they be not a nation: and let the name of Israel be remembered no more.
text_la: Dixerunt : Venite, et disperdamus eos de gente, et non memoretur nomen Israël ultra.
text_pt: Eles não conhecem, nem entendem; andam em trevas; todos os fundamentos da terra vacilam.
text_el: εἶπαν δεῦτε καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσωμεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ ἔθνους καὶ οὐ μὴ μνησθῇ τὸ ὄνομα Ισραηλ ἔτι

text_en: For they have contrived with one consent: they have made a covenant together against you,
text_la: Quoniam cogitaverunt unanimiter; simul adversum te testamentum disposuerunt:
text_pt: Eu disse: Vós sois deuses, e todos vós filhos do Altíssimo.
text_el: ὅτι ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό κατὰ σοῦ διαθήκην διέθεντο

text_en: the tabernacle of the Edomites , and the Ishmahelites : Moab , and the Agarens,
text_la: tabernacula Idumæorum et Ismahelitæ, Moab et Agareni,
text_pt: Todavia morrereis como homens, e caireis como qualquer dos príncipes.
text_el: τὰ σκηνώματα τῶν Ιδουμαίων καὶ οἱ Ισμαηλῖται Μωαβ καὶ οἱ Αγαρηνοί

text_en: Gebal, and Ammon and Amalec : the Philistines , with the inhabitants of Tyre .
text_la: Gebal, et Ammon, et Amalec; alienigenæ cum habitantibus Tyrum.
text_pt: Levanta-te, ó Deus, julga a terra, pois tu possuis todas as nações.
text_el: Γεβαλ καὶ Αμμων καὶ Αμαληκ καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι μετὰ τῶν κατοικούντων Τύρον

text_en: Yea, and the Assyrian also is joined with them: they have come to the aid of the sons of Lot .
text_la: Etenim Assur venit cum illis: facti sunt in adjutorium filiis Lot.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ καὶ Ασσουρ συμπαρεγένετο μετ' αὐτῶν ἐγενήθησαν εἰς ἀντίλημψιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Λωτ διάψαλμα

text_en: Do to them as you did to Madian and to Sisara: as to Jabin at the brook of Cisson.
text_la: Fac illis sicut Madian et Sisaræ, sicut Jabin in torrente Cisson.
text_el: ποίησον αὐτοῖς ὡς τῇ Μαδιαμ καὶ τῷ Σισαρα ὡς ὁ Ιαβιν ἐν τῷ χειμάρρῳ Κισων

text_en: Who perished at Endor: and became as dung for the earth.
text_la: Disperierunt in Endor; facti sunt ut stercus terræ.
text_el: ἐξωλεθρεύθησαν ἐν Αενδωρ ἐγενήθησαν ὡσεὶ κόπρος τῇ γῇ

text_en: Make their princes like Oreb, and Zeb, and Zebee, and Salmana. All their princes,
text_la: Pone principes eorum sicut Oreb, et Zeb, et Zebee, et Salmana : omnes principes eorum,
text_el: θοῦ τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν ὡς τὸν Ωρηβ καὶ Ζηβ καὶ Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν

text_en: who have said: Let us possess the sanctuary of God for an inheritance.
text_la: qui dixerunt : Hæreditate possideamus sanctuarium Dei.
text_el: οἵτινες εἶπαν κληρονομήσωμεν ἑαυτοῖς τὸ ἁγιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: O my God , make them like a wheel; and as stubble before the wind.
text_la: Deus meus, pone illos ut rotam, et sicut stipulam ante faciem venti.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου θοῦ αὐτοὺς ὡς τροχόν ὡς καλάμην κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀνέμου

text_en: As fire which burns the wood: and as a flame burning mountains:
text_la: Sicut ignis qui comburit silvam, et sicut flamma comburens montes,
text_el: ὡσεὶ πῦρ ὃ διαφλέξει δρυμόν ὡς εἰ φλὸξ κατακαύσαι ὄρη

text_en: So shall you pursue them with your tempest: and shall trouble them in your wrath .
text_la: ita persequeris illos in tempestate tua, et in ira tua turbabis eos.
text_el: οὕτως καταδιώξεις αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ καταιγίδι σου καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ταράξεις αὐτούς

text_en: Fill their faces with shame; and they shall seek your name , O Lord .
text_la: Imple facies eorum ignominia, et quærent nomen tuum, Domine.
text_el: πλήρωσον τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἀτιμίας καὶ ζητήσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου κύριε

text_en: Let them be ashamed and troubled for ever and ever: and let them be confounded and perish.
text_la: Erubescant, et conturbentur in sæculum sæculi, et confundantur, et pereant.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ταραχθήτωσαν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἐντραπήτωσαν καὶ ἀπολέσθωσαν

text_en: And let them know that the Lord is your name : you alone are the most High over all the earth.
text_la: Et cognoscant quia nomen tibi Dominus : tu solus Altissimus in omni terra.
text_el: καὶ γνώτωσαν ὅτι ὄνομά σοι κύριος σὺ μόνος ὕψιστος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: Unto the end, for the winepresses, a psalm for the sons of Core .
text_la: In finem, pro torcularibus filiis Core. Psalmus.
text_pt: Ó Deus, não estejas em silêncio; não te cales, nem te aquietes, ó Deus,
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε ψαλμός

text_en: How lovely are your tabernacles, O Lord of hosts !
text_la: Quam dilecta tabernacula tua, Domine virtutum!
text_pt: Porque eis que teus inimigos fazem tumulto, e os que te odeiam levantaram a cabeça.
text_el: ὡς ἀγαπητὰ τὰ σκηνώματά σου κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων

text_en: My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord . My heart and my flesh have rejoiced in the living God .
text_la: Concupiscit, et deficit anima mea in atria Domini; cor meum et caro mea exsultaverunt in Deum vivum.
text_pt: Tomaram astuto conselho contra o teu povo, e consultaram contra os teus escondidos.
text_el: ἐπιποθεῖ καὶ ἐκλείπει ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς τοῦ κυρίου ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ἠγαλλιάσαντο ἐπὶ θεὸν ζῶντα

text_en: For the sparrow has found herself a house, and the turtle a nest for herself where she may lay her young ones: Your altars , O Lord of hosts , my king and my God .
text_la: Etenim passer invenit sibi domum, et turtur nidum sibi, ubi ponat pullos suos : altaria tua, Domine virtutum, rex meus, et Deus meus.
text_pt: Disseram: Vinde, e desarraiguemo-los para que não sejam nação, nem haja mais memória do nome de Israel.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ στρουθίον εὗρεν ἑαυτῷ οἰκίαν καὶ τρυγὼν νοσσιὰν ἑαυτῇ οὗ θήσει τὰ νοσσία αὐτῆς τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου

text_en: Blessed are they that dwell in your house, O Lord : they shall praise you for ever and ever.
text_la: Beati qui habitant in domo tua, Domine; in sæcula sæculorum laudabunt te.
text_pt: Porque consultaram juntos e unânimes; eles se unem contra ti:
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων αἰνέσουσίν σε διάψαλμα

text_en: Blessed is the man whose help is from you: in his heart he has disposed to ascend by steps,
text_la: Beatus vir cujus est auxilium abs te : ascensiones in corde suo disposuit,
text_pt: As tendas de Edom, e dos ismaelitas, de Moabe, e dos agarenos,
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ οὗ ἐστιν ἡ ἀντίλημψις αὐτοῦ παρὰ σοῦ κύριε ἀναβάσεις ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ διέθετο

text_en: in the vale of tears, in the place which he has set.
text_la: in valle lacrimarum, in loco quem posuit.
text_pt: De Gebal, e de Amom, e de Amaleque, a Filístia, com os moradores de Tiro;
text_el: ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τοῦ κλαυθμῶνος εἰς τόπον ὃν ἔθετο καὶ γὰρ εὐλογίας δώσει ὁ νομοθετῶν

text_en: For the lawgiver shall give a blessing , they shall go from virtue to virtue : the God of gods shall be seen in Sion.
text_la: Etenim benedictionem dabit legislator; ibunt de virtute in virtutem : videbitur Deus deorum in Sion.
text_pt: Também a Assíria se ajuntou com eles; foram ajudar aos filhos de Ló. (Selá.)
text_el: πορεύσονται ἐκ δυνάμεως εἰς δύναμιν ὀφθήσεται ὁ θεὸς τῶν θεῶν ἐν Σιων

text_en: O Lord God of hosts , hear my prayer : give ear, O God of Jacob .
text_la: Domine Deus virtutum, exaudi orationem meam; auribus percipe, Deus Jacob.
text_pt: Faze-lhes como aos midianitas; como a Sísera, como a Jabim na ribeira de Quisom;
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου ἐνώτισαι ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ διάψαλμα

text_en: Behold, O God our protector: and look on the face of your Christ .
text_la: Protector noster, aspice, Deus, et respice in faciem christi tui.
text_pt: Os quais pereceram em Endor; tornaram-se como estrume para a terra.
text_el: ὑπερασπιστὰ ἡμῶν ἰδέ ὁ θεός καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ χριστοῦ σου

text_en: For better is one day in your courts above thousands. I have chosen to be an abject in the house of my God , rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.
text_la: Quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia; elegi abjectus esse in domo Dei mei magis quam habitare in tabernaculis peccatorum.
text_pt: Faze aos seus nobres como a Orebe, e como a Zeebe; e a todos os seus príncipes, como a Zebá e como a Zalmuna,
text_el: ὅτι κρείσσων ἡμέρα μία ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου ὑπὲρ χιλιάδας ἐξελεξάμην παραρριπτεῖσθαι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ μᾶλλον ἢ οἰκεῖν ἐν σκηνώμασιν ἁμαρτωλῶν

text_en: For God loves mercy and truth : the Lord will give grace and glory .
text_la: Quia misericordiam et veritatem diligit Deus : gratiam et gloriam dabit Dominus.
text_pt: Que disseram: Tomemos para nós as casas de Deus em possessão.
text_el: ὅτι ἔλεον καὶ ἀλήθειαν ἀγαπᾷ κύριος ὁ θεός χάριν καὶ δόξαν δώσει κύριος οὐ στερήσει τὰ ἀγαθὰ τοὺς πορευομένους ἐν ἀκακίᾳ

text_en: He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: O Lord of hosts , blessed is the man that trusts in you.
text_la: Non privabit bonis eos qui ambulant in innocentia : Domine virtutum, beatus homo qui sperat in te.
text_pt: Deus meu, faze-os como um tufão, como a aresta diante do vento.
text_el: κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων μακάριος ἄνθρωπος ὁ ἐλπίζων ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: Unto the end, for the sons of Core , a psalm.
text_la: In finem, filiis Core. Psalmus.
text_pt: Quão amáveis são os teus tabernáculos, SENHOR dos Exércitos!
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε ψαλμός

text_en: Lord , you have blessed your land: you have turned away the captivity of Jacob .
text_la: Benedixisti, Domine, terram tuam; avertisti captivitatem Jacob.
text_pt: A minha alma está desejosa, e desfalece pelos átrios do Senhor; o meu coração e a minha carne clamam pelo Deus vivo.
text_el: εὐδόκησας κύριε τὴν γῆν σου ἀπέστρεψας τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ιακωβ

text_en: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people: you have covered all their sins .
text_la: Remisisti iniquitatem plebis tuæ; operuisti omnia peccata eorum.
text_pt: Até o pardal encontrou casa, e a andorinha ninho para si, onde ponha seus filhos, até mesmo nos teus altares, Senhor dos Exércitos, Rei meu e Deus meu.
text_el: ἀφῆκας τὰς ἀνομίας τῷ λαῷ σου ἐκάλυψας πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: You have mitigated all your anger : you have turned away from the wrath of your indignation.
text_la: Mitigasti omnem iram tuam; avertisti ab ira indignationis tuæ.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que habitam em tua casa; louvar-te-ão continuamente. (Selá.)
text_el: κατέπαυσας πᾶσαν τὴν ὀργήν σου ἀπέστρεψας ἀπὸ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ σου

text_en: Convert us, O God our saviour: and turn off your anger from us.
text_la: Converte nos, Deus salutaris noster, et averte iram tuam a nobis.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem cuja força está em ti, em cujo coração estão os caminhos aplanados.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν καὶ ἀπόστρεψον τὸν θυμόν σου ἀφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: Will you be angry with us for ever: or will you extend your wrath from generation to generation ?
text_la: Numquid in æternum irasceris nobis? aut extendes iram tuam a generatione in generationem?
text_pt: Que, passando pelo vale de Baca, faz dele uma fonte; a chuva também enche os tanques.
text_el: μὴ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὀργισθήσῃ ἡμῖν ἢ διατενεῖς τὴν ὀργήν σου ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν

text_en: You will turn, O God , and bring us to life: and your people shall rejoice in you.
text_la: Deus, tu conversus vivificabis nos, et plebs tua lætabitur in te.
text_pt: Vão indo de força em força; cada um deles em Sião aparece perante Deus.
text_el: ὁ θεός σὺ ἐπιστρέψας ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς καὶ ὁ λαός σου εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ σοί

text_en: Show us, O Lord , your mercy; and grant us your salvation .
text_la: Ostende nobis, Domine, misericordiam tuam, et salutare tuum da nobis.
text_pt: Senhor Deus dos Exércitos, escuta a minha oração; inclina os ouvidos, ó Deus de Jacó! (Selá.)
text_el: δεῖξον ἡμῖν κύριε τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου δῴης ἡμῖν

text_en: I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: for he will speak peace unto his people: And unto his saints : and unto them that are converted to the heart.
text_la: Audiam quid loquatur in me Dominus Deus, quoniam loquetur pacem in plebem suam, et super sanctos suos, et in eos qui convertuntur ad cor.
text_pt: Olha, ó Deus, escudo nosso, e contempla o rosto do teu ungido.
text_el: ἀκούσομαι τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ κύριος ὁ θεός ὅτι λαλήσει εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐπιστρέφοντας πρὸς αὐτὸν καρδίαν

text_en: Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: that glory may dwell in our land.
text_la: Verumtamen prope timentes eum salutare ipsius, ut inhabitet gloria in terra nostra.
text_pt: Porque vale mais um dia nos teus átrios do que mil. Preferiria estar à porta da casa do meu Deus, a habitar nas tendas dos ímpios.
text_el: πλὴν ἐγγὺς τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ τοῦ κατασκηνῶσαι δόξαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἡμῶν

text_en: Mercy and truth have met each other: justice and peace have kissed .
text_la: Misericordia et veritas obviaverunt sibi; justitia et pax osculatæ sunt.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor Deus é um sol e escudo; o Senhor dará graça e glória; não retirará bem algum aos que andam na retidão.
text_el: ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια συνήντησαν δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη κατεφίλησαν

text_en: Truth is sprung out of the earth: and justice has looked down from heaven .
text_la: Veritas de terra orta est, et justitia de cælo prospexit.
text_pt: Senhor dos Exércitos, bem-aventurado o homem que em ti põe a sua confiança.
text_el: ἀλήθεια ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἀνέτειλεν καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν

text_en: For the Lord will give goodness : and our earth shall yield her fruit.
text_la: Etenim Dominus dabit benignitatem, et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὁ κύριος δώσει χρηστότητα καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς

text_en: Justice shall walk before him: and shall set his steps in the way.
text_la: Justitia ante eum ambulabit, et ponet in via gressus suos.
text_el: δικαιοσύνη ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται καὶ θήσει εἰς ὁδὸν τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Incline your ear, O Lord , and hear me: for I am needy and poor.
text_la: Inclina, Domine, aurem tuam et exaudi me, quoniam inops et pauper sum ego.
text_pt: Abençoaste, SENHOR, a tua terra; fizeste voltar o cativeiro de Jacó.
text_el: προσευχὴ τῷ Δαυιδ κλῖνον κύριε τὸ οὖς σου καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου ὅτι πτωχὸς καὶ πένης εἰμὶ ἐγώ

text_en: Preserve my soul , for I am holy : save your servant, O my God , that trusts in you.
text_la: Custodi animam meam, quoniam sanctus sum; salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperantem in te.
text_pt: Perdoaste a iniqüidade do teu povo; cobriste todos os seus pecados. (Selá.)
text_el: φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν μου ὅτι ὅσιός εἰμι σῶσον τὸν δοῦλόν σου ὁ θεός μου τὸν ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: Have mercy on me, O Lord , for I have cried to you all the day.
text_la: Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam ad te clamavi tota die;
text_pt: Fizeste cessar toda a tua indignação; desviaste-te do ardor da tua ira.
text_el: ἐλέησόν με κύριε ὅτι πρὸς σὲ κεκράξομαι ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν

text_en: Give joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord , I have lifted up my soul .
text_la: lætifica animam servi tui, quoniam ad te, Domine, animam meam levavi.
text_pt: Torna-nos a trazer, ó Deus da nossa salvação, e faze cessar a tua ira de sobre nós.
text_el: εὔφρανον τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου ὅτι πρὸς σέ κύριε ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: For you, O Lord , are sweet and mild: and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon you.
text_la: Quoniam tu, Domine, suavis et mitis, et multæ misericordiæ omnibus invocantibus te.
text_pt: Acaso estarás sempre irado contra nós? Estenderás a tua ira a todas as gerações?
text_el: ὅτι σύ κύριε χρηστὸς καὶ ἐπιεικὴς καὶ πολυέλεος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις σε

text_en: Give ear, O Lord , to my prayer : and attend to the voice of my petition.
text_la: Auribus percipe, Domine, orationem meam, et intende voci deprecationis meæ.
text_pt: Não tornarás a vivificar-nos, para que o teu povo se alegre em ti?
text_el: ἐνώτισαι κύριε τὴν προσευχήν μου καὶ πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: I have called upon you in the day of my trouble: because you have heard me.
text_la: In die tribulationis meæ clamavi ad te, quia exaudisti me.
text_pt: Mostra-nos, Senhor, a tua misericórdia, e concede-nos a tua salvação.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς μου ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ ὅτι εἰσήκουσάς μου

text_en: There is none among the gods like unto you, O Lord : and there is none according to your works.
text_la: Non est similis tui in diis, Domine, et non est secundum opera tua.
text_pt: Escutarei o que Deus, o Senhor, falar; porque falará de paz ao seu povo, e aos santos, para que não voltem à loucura.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ὅμοιός σοι ἐν θεοῖς κύριε καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ τὰ ἔργα σου

text_en: All the nations you have made shall come and adore before you, O Lord : and they shall glorify your name .
text_la: Omnes gentes quascumque fecisti venient, et adorabunt coram te, Domine, et glorificabunt nomen tuum.
text_pt: Certamente que a salvação está perto daqueles que o temem, para que a glória habite na nossa terra.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐποίησας ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου κύριε καὶ δοξάσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: For you are great and do wonderful things: you are God alone.
text_la: Quoniam magnus es tu, et faciens mirabilia; tu es Deus solus.
text_pt: A misericórdia e a verdade se encontraram; a justiça e a paz se beijaram.
text_el: ὅτι μέγας εἶ σὺ καὶ ποιῶν θαυμάσια σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς μόνος ὁ μέγας

text_en: Conduct me, O Lord , in your way, and I will walk in your truth : let my heart rejoice that it may fear your name .
text_la: Deduc me, Domine, in via tua, et ingrediar in veritate tua; lætetur cor meum, ut timeat nomen tuum.
text_pt: A verdade brotará da terra, e a justiça olhará desde os céus.
text_el: ὁδήγησόν με κύριε τῇ ὁδῷ σου καὶ πορεύσομαι ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου εὐφρανθήτω ἡ καρδία μου τοῦ φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: I will praise you, O Lord my God , with my whole heart, and I will glorify your name for ever:
text_la: Confitebor tibi, Domine Deus meus, in toto corde meo, et glorificabo nomen tuum in æternum:
text_pt: Também o Senhor dará o que é bom, e a nossa terra dará o seu fruto.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου καὶ δοξάσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For your mercy is great towards me: and you have delivered my soul out of the lower hell.
text_la: quia misericordia tua magna est super me, et eruisti animam meam ex inferno inferiori.
text_pt: A justiça irá adiante dele, e nos porá no caminho das suas pisadas.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ ἔλεός σου μέγα ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐρρύσω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐξ ᾅδου κατωτάτου

text_en: O God , the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul : and they have not set you before their eyes.
text_la: Deus, iniqui insurrexerunt super me, et synagoga potentium quæsierunt animam meam : et non proposuerunt te in conspectu suo.
text_el: ὁ θεός παράνομοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ συναγωγὴ κραταιῶν ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ οὐ προέθεντό σε ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And you, O Lord , are a God of compassion, and merciful, patient, and of much mercy, and true .
text_la: Et tu, Domine Deus, miserator et misericors; patiens, et multæ misericordiæ, et verax.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριε ὁ θεός οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός

text_en: O look upon me, and have mercy on me: give your command to your servant, and save the son of your handmaid.
text_la: Respice in me, et miserere mei; da imperium tuum puero tuo, et salvum fac filium ancillæ tuæ.
text_el: ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με δὸς τὸ κράτος σου τῷ παιδί σου καὶ σῶσον τὸν υἱὸν τῆς παιδίσκης σου

text_en: Show me a token for good : that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, because you, O Lord , have helped me and have comforted me.
text_la: Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut videant qui oderunt me, et confundantur : quoniam tu, Domine, adjuvisti me, et consolatus es me.
text_el: ποίησον μετ' ἐμοῦ σημεῖον εἰς ἀγαθόν καὶ ἰδέτωσαν οἱ μισοῦντές με καὶ αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ὅτι σύ κύριε ἐβοήθησάς μοι καὶ παρεκάλεσάς με

text_en: The foundations thereof are the holy mountains:
text_la: Fundamenta ejus in montibus sanctis;
text_pt: Inclina, SENHOR, os teus ouvidos, e ouve-me, porque estou necessitado e aflito.
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς οἱ θεμέλιοι αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις

text_en: The Lord loves the gates of Sion above all the tabernacles of Jacob .
text_la: diligit Dominus portas Sion super omnia tabernacula Jacob.
text_pt: Guarda a minha alma, pois sou santo: ó Deus meu, salva o teu servo, que em ti confia.
text_el: ἀγαπᾷ κύριος τὰς πύλας Σιων ὑπὲρ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα Ιακωβ

text_en: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God .
text_la: Gloriosa dicta sunt de te, civitas Dei!
text_pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Senhor, pois a ti clamo todo o dia.
text_el: δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ ἡ πόλις τοῦ θεοῦ διάψαλμα

text_en: I will be mindful of Rahab and of Babylon knowing me. Behold the foreigners, and Tyre , and the people of the Ethiopians , these were there.
text_la: Memor ero Rahab et Babylonis, scientium me; ecce alienigenæ, et Tyrus, et populus Æthiopum, hi fuerunt illic.
text_pt: Alegra a alma do teu servo, pois a ti, Senhor, levanto a minha alma.
text_el: μνησθήσομαι Ρααβ καὶ Βαβυλῶνος τοῖς γινώσκουσίν με καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ Τύρος καὶ λαὸς Αἰθιόπων οὗτοι ἐγενήθησαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: Shall not Sion say: This man and that man is born in her? And the Highest himself has founded her.
text_la: Numquid Sion dicet : Homo et homo natus est in ea, et ipse fundavit eam Altissimus?
text_pt: Pois tu, Senhor, és bom, e pronto a perdoar, e abundante em benignidade para todos os que te invocam.
text_el: μήτηρ Σιων ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἐγενήθη ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν ὁ ὕψιστος

text_en: The Lord shall tell in his writings of peoples and of princes, of them that have been in her.
text_la: Dominus narrabit in scripturis populorum et principum, horum qui fuerunt in ea.
text_pt: Dá ouvidos, Senhor, à minha oração e atende à voz das minhas súplicas.
text_el: κύριος διηγήσεται ἐν γραφῇ λαῶν καὶ ἀρχόντων τούτων τῶν γεγενημένων ἐν αὐτῇ διάψαλμα

text_en: The dwelling in you is as it were of all rejoicing.
text_la: Sicut lætantium omnium habitatio est in te.
text_pt: No dia da minha angústia clamo a ti, porquanto me respondes.
text_el: ὡς εὐφραινομένων πάντων ἡ κατοικία ἐν σοί

text_en: A canticle of a psalm for the sons of Core : unto the end, for Maheleth, to answer understanding of Eman the Ezrahite.
text_la: Canticum Psalmi, filiis Core, in finem, pro Maheleth ad respondendum. Intellectus Eman Ezrahitæ.
text_pt: O seu fundamento está nos montes santos.
text_el: ᾠδὴ ψαλμοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε εἰς τὸ τέλος ὑπὲρ μαελεθ τοῦ ἀποκριθῆναι συνέσεως Αιμαν τῷ Ισραηλίτῃ

text_en: O Lord , the God of my salvation : I have cried in the day, and in the night before you.
text_la: Domine, Deus salutis meæ, in die clamavi et nocte coram te.
text_pt: O Senhor ama as portas de Sião, mais do que todas as habitações de Jacó.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου ἡμέρας ἐκέκραξα καὶ ἐν νυκτὶ ἐναντίον σου

text_en: Let my prayer come in before you: incline your ear to my petition.
text_la: Intret in conspectu tuo oratio mea, inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam.
text_pt: Coisas gloriosas se dizem de ti, ó cidade de Deus. (Selá.)
text_el: εἰσελθάτω ἐνώπιόν σου ἡ προσευχή μου κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου εἰς τὴν δέησίν μου κύριε

text_en: For my soul is filled with evils : and my life has drawn near to hell.
text_la: Quia repleta est malis anima mea, et vita mea inferno appropinquavit.
text_pt: Farei menção de Raabe e de Babilônia àqueles que me conhecem; eis que da Filístia, e de Tiro, e da Etiópia, se dirá: Este homem nasceu ali.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπλήσθη κακῶν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἡ ζωή μου τῷ ᾅδῃ ἤγγισεν

text_en: I am counted among them that go down to the pit: I have become as a man without help,
text_la: Æstimatus sum cum descendentibus in lacum, factus sum sicut homo sine adjutorio,
text_pt: E de Sião se dirá: Este e aquele homem nasceram ali; e o mesmo Altíssimo a estabelecerá.
text_el: προσελογίσθην μετὰ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον ἐγενήθην ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀβοήθητος ἐν νεκροῖς ἐλεύθερος

text_en: free among the dead. Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom you remember no more: and they are cut off from your hand.
text_la: inter mortuos liber; sicut vulnerati dormientes in sepulchris, quorum non es memor amplius, et ipsi de manu tua repulsi sunt.
text_pt: O Senhor contará na descrição dos povos que este homem nasceu ali. (Selá.)
text_el: ὡσεὶ τραυματίαι ἐρριμμένοι καθεύδοντες ἐν τάφῳ ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθης ἔτι καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου ἀπώσθησαν

text_en: They have laid me in the lower pit: in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.
text_la: Posuerunt me in lacu inferiori, in tenebrosis, et in umbra mortis.
text_pt: Assim os cantores como os tocadores de instrumentos estarão lá; todas as minhas fontes estão em ti.
text_el: ἔθεντό με ἐν λάκκῳ κατωτάτῳ ἐν σκοτεινοῖς καὶ ἐν σκιᾷ θανάτου

text_en: Your wrath is strong over me: and all your waves you have brought in upon me.
text_la: Super me confirmatus est furor tuus, et omnes fluctus tuos induxisti super me.
text_el: ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐπεστηρίχθη ὁ θυμός σου καὶ πάντας τοὺς μετεωρισμούς σου ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐπήγαγες διάψαλμα

text_en: You have put away my acquaintance far from me: they have set me an abomination to themselves. I was delivered up, and came not forth:
text_la: Longe fecisti notos meos a me; posuerunt me abominationem sibi. Traditus sum, et non egrediebar;
text_el: ἐμάκρυνας τοὺς γνωστούς μου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἔθεντό με βδέλυγμα ἑαυτοῖς παρεδόθην καὶ οὐκ ἐξεπορευόμην

text_en: My eyes languished through poverty. All the day I cried to you, O Lord : I stretched out my hands to you.
text_la: oculi mei languerunt præ inopia. Clamavi ad te, Domine, tota die; expandi ad te manus meas.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἠσθένησαν ἀπὸ πτωχείας ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ κύριε ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν διεπέτασα πρὸς σὲ τὰς χεῖράς μου

text_en: Will you show wonders to the dead? Or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to you?
text_la: Numquid mortuis facies mirabilia? aut medici suscitabunt, et confitebuntur tibi?
text_el: μὴ τοῖς νεκροῖς ποιήσεις θαυμάσια ἢ ἰατροὶ ἀναστήσουσιν καὶ ἐξομολογήσονταί σοι

text_en: Shall any one in the sepulchre declare your mercy: and your truth in destruction?
text_la: Numquid narrabit aliquis in sepulchro misericordiam tuam, et veritatem tuam in perditione?
text_el: μὴ διηγήσεταί τις ἐν τάφῳ τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν τῇ ἀπωλείᾳ

text_en: Shall your wonders be known in the dark; and your justice in the land of forgetfulness?
text_la: Numquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia tua? et justitia tua in terra oblivionis?
text_el: μὴ γνωσθήσεται ἐν τῷ σκότει τὰ θαυμάσιά σου καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου ἐν γῇ ἐπιλελησμένῃ

text_en: But I, O Lord , have cried to you: and in the morning my prayer shall prevent you.
text_la: Et ego ad te, Domine, clamavi, et mane oratio mea præveniet te.
text_el: κἀγὼ πρὸς σέ κύριε ἐκέκραξα καὶ τὸ πρωὶ ἡ προσευχή μου προφθάσει σε

text_en: Lord , why do you cast off my prayer : why do you turn your face from me?
text_la: Ut quid, Domine, repellis orationem meam; avertis faciem tuam a me?
text_el: ἵνα τί κύριε ἀπωθεῖς τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀποστρέφεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: I am poor, and in labours from my youth: and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.
text_la: Pauper sum ego, et in laboribus a juventute mea; exaltatus autem, humiliatus sum et conturbatus.
text_el: πτωχός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἐν κόποις ἐκ νεότητός μου ὑψωθεὶς δὲ ἐταπεινώθην καὶ ἐξηπορήθην

text_en: Your wrath has come upon me: and your terrors have troubled me.
text_la: In me transierunt iræ tuæ, et terrores tui conturbaverunt me:
text_el: ἐπ' ἐμὲ διῆλθον αἱ ὀργαί σου καὶ οἱ φοβερισμοί σου ἐξετάραξάν με

text_en: They have come round about me like water all the day: they have compassed me about together.
text_la: circumdederunt me sicut aqua tota die; circumdederunt me simul.
text_el: ἐκύκλωσάν με ὡς ὕδωρ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν περιέσχον με ἅμα

text_en: Friend and neighbour you have put far from me: and my acquaintance, because of misery.
text_la: Elongasti a me amicum et proximum, et notos meos a miseria.
text_el: ἐμάκρυνας ἀπ' ἐμοῦ φίλον καὶ πλησίον καὶ τοὺς γνωστούς μου ἀπὸ ταλαιπωρίας

text_en: Of understanding, for Ethan the Ezrahite.
text_la: Intellectus Ethan Ezrahitæ.
text_pt: SENHOR Deus da minha salvação, diante de ti tenho clamado de dia e de noite.
text_el: συνέσεως Αιθαν τῷ Ισραηλίτῃ

text_en: The mercies of the Lord I will sing for ever. I will show forth your truth with my mouth to generation and generation .
text_la: Misericordias Domini in æternum cantabo; in generationem et generationem annuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo.
text_pt: Chegue a minha oração perante a tua face, inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor;
text_el: τὰ ἐλέη σου κύριε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ᾄσομαι εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἀπαγγελῶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν τῷ στόματί μου

text_en: For you have said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens : your truth shall be prepared in them.
text_la: Quoniam dixisti : In æternum misericordia ædificabitur in cælis; præparabitur veritas tua in eis.
text_pt: Porque a minha alma está cheia de angústia, e a minha vida se aproxima da sepultura.
text_el: ὅτι εἶπας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔλεος οἰκοδομηθήσεται ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἑτοιμασθήσεται ἡ ἀλήθειά σου

text_en: I have made a covenant with my elect : I have sworn to David my servant:
text_la: Disposui testamentum electis meis; juravi David servo meo:
text_pt: Estou contado com aqueles que descem ao abismo; estou como homem sem forças,
text_el: διεθέμην διαθήκην τοῖς ἐκλεκτοῖς μου ὤμοσα Δαυιδ τῷ δούλῳ μου

text_en: Your seed will I settle for ever. And I will build up your throne unto generation and generation .
text_la: Usque in æternum præparabo semen tuum, et ædificabo in generationem et generationem sedem tuam.
text_pt: Livre entre os mortos, como os feridos de morte que jazem na sepultura, dos quais te não lembras mais, e estão cortados da tua mão.
text_el: ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ἑτοιμάσω τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ οἰκοδομήσω εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν τὸν θρόνον σου διάψαλμα

text_en: The heavens shall confess your wonders, O Lord : and your truth in the church of the saints .
text_la: Confitebuntur cæli mirabilia tua, Domine; etenim veritatem tuam in ecclesia sanctorum.
text_pt: Puseste-me no abismo mais profundo, em trevas e nas profundezas.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσονται οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου κύριε καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἁγίων

text_en: For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord : or who among the sons of God shall be like to God ?
text_la: Quoniam quis in nubibus æquabitur Domino; similis erit Deo in filiis Dei?
text_pt: Sobre mim pesa o teu furor; tu me afligiste com todas as tuas ondas. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι τίς ἐν νεφέλαις ἰσωθήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ τίς ὁμοιωθήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν υἱοῖς θεοῦ

text_en: God , who is glorified in the assembly of the saints : great and terrible above all them that are about him.
text_la: Deus, qui glorificatur in consilio sanctorum, magnus et terribilis super omnes qui in circuitu ejus sunt.
text_pt: Alongaste de mim os meus conhecidos, puseste-me em extrema abominação para com eles. Estou fechado, e não posso sair.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐνδοξαζόμενος ἐν βουλῇ ἁγίων μέγας καὶ φοβερὸς ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς περικύκλῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: O Lord God of hosts , who is like to you? You are mighty, O Lord , and your truth is round about you.
text_la: Domine Deus virtutum, quis similis tibi? potens es, Domine, et veritas tua in circuitu tuo.
text_pt: A minha vista desmaia por causa da aflição. Senhor, tenho clamado a ti todo o dia, tenho estendido para ti as minhas mãos.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων τίς ὅμοιός σοι δυνατὸς εἶ κύριε καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά σου κύκλῳ σου

text_en: You rule the power of the sea: and appease the motion of the waves thereof.
text_la: Tu dominaris potestati maris; motum autem fluctuum ejus tu mitigas.
text_pt: Mostrarás, tu, maravilhas aos mortos, ou os mortos se levantarão e te louvarão? (Selá.)
text_el: σὺ δεσπόζεις τοῦ κράτους τῆς θαλάσσης τὸν δὲ σάλον τῶν κυμάτων αὐτῆς σὺ καταπραΰνεις

text_en: You have humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: with the arm of your strength you have scattered your enemies.
text_la: Tu humiliasti, sicut vulneratum, superbum; in brachio virtutis tuæ dispersisti inimicos tuos.
text_pt: Será anunciada a tua benignidade na sepultura, ou a tua fidelidade na perdição?
text_el: σὺ ἐταπείνωσας ὡς τραυματίαν ὑπερήφανον καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονι τῆς δυνάμεώς σου διεσκόρπισας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου

text_en: Yours are the heavens , and yours is the earth: the world and the fullness thereof you have founded:
text_la: Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra : orbem terræ, et plenitudinem ejus tu fundasti;
text_pt: Saber-se-ão as tuas maravilhas nas trevas, e a tua justiça na terra do esquecimento?
text_el: σοί εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί καὶ σή ἐστιν ἡ γῆ τὴν οἰκουμένην καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς σὺ ἐθεμελίωσας

text_en: The north and the sea you have created . Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in your name :
text_la: aquilonem et mare tu creasti. Thabor et Hermon in nomine tuo exsultabunt:
text_pt: Eu, porém, Senhor, tenho clamado a ti, e de madrugada te esperará a minha oração.
text_el: τὸν βορρᾶν καὶ θαλάσσας σὺ ἔκτισας Θαβωρ καὶ Ερμων ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: Your arm is with might. Let your hand be strengthened, and your right hand exalted:
text_la: tuum brachium cum potentia. Firmetur manus tua, et exaltetur dextera tua:
text_pt: Senhor, porque rejeitas a minha alma? Por que escondes de mim a tua face?
text_el: σὸς ὁ βραχίων μετὰ δυναστείας κραταιωθήτω ἡ χείρ σου ὑψωθήτω ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: Justice and judgment are the preparation of your throne. Mercy and truth shall go before your face:
text_la: justitia et judicium præparatio sedis tuæ : misericordia et veritas præcedent faciem tuam.
text_pt: Estou aflito, e prestes tenho estado a morrer desde a minha mocidade; enquanto sofro os teus terrores, estou perturbado.
text_el: δικαιοσύνη καὶ κρίμα ἑτοιμασία τοῦ θρόνου σου ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια προπορεύσεται πρὸ προσώπου σου

text_en: Blessed is the people that knows jubilation. They shall walk, O Lord , in the light of your countenance:
text_la: Beatus populus qui scit jubilationem : Domine, in lumine vultus tui ambulabunt,
text_pt: A tua ardente indignação sobre mim vai passando; os teus terrores me têm retalhado.
text_el: μακάριος ὁ λαὸς ὁ γινώσκων ἀλαλαγμόν κύριε ἐν τῷ φωτὶ τοῦ προσώπου σου πορεύσονται

text_en: And in your name they shall rejoice all the day, and in your justice they shall be exalted.
text_la: et in nomine tuo exsultabunt tota die, et in justitia tua exaltabuntur.
text_pt: Eles me rodeiam todo o dia como água; eles juntos me sitiam.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ὑψωθήσονται

text_en: For you are the glory of their strength: and in your good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.
text_la: Quoniam gloria virtutis eorum tu es, et in beneplacito tuo exaltabitur cornu nostrum.
text_pt: Desviaste para longe de mim amigos e companheiros, e os meus conhecidos estão em trevas.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ καύχημα τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν εἶ σύ καὶ ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ σου ὑψωθήσεται τὸ κέρας ἡμῶν

text_en: For our protection is of the Lord , and of our king the holy one of Israel .
text_la: Quia Domini est assumptio nostra, et sancti Israël regis nostri.
text_el: ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ἡ ἀντίλημψις καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Ισραηλ βασιλέως ἡμῶν

text_en: Then you spoke in a vision to your saints , and said: I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.
text_la: Tunc locutus es in visione sanctis tuis, et dixisti : Posui adjutorium in potente, et exaltavi electum de plebe mea.
text_el: τότε ἐλάλησας ἐν ὁράσει τοῖς ὁσίοις σου καὶ εἶπας ἐθέμην βοήθειαν ἐπὶ δυνατόν ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου

text_en: I have found David my servant: with my holy oil I have anointed him.
text_la: Inveni David, servum meum; oleo sancto meo unxi eum.
text_el: εὗρον Δαυιδ τὸν δοῦλόν μου ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἁγίῳ μου ἔχρισα αὐτόν

text_en: For my hand shall help him: and my arm shall strengthen him.
text_la: Manus enim mea auxiliabitur ei, et brachium meum confortabit eum.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ χείρ μου συναντιλήμψεται αὐτῷ καὶ ὁ βραχίων μου κατισχύσει αὐτόν

text_en: The enemy shall have no advantage over him: nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.
text_la: Nihil proficiet inimicus in eo, et filius iniquitatis non apponet nocere ei.
text_el: οὐκ ὠφελήσει ἐχθρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ υἱὸς ἀνομίας οὐ προσθήσει τοῦ κακῶσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And I will cut down his enemies before his face; and them that hate him I will put to flight.
text_la: Et concidam a facie ipsius inimicos ejus, et odientes eum in fugam convertam.
text_el: καὶ συγκόψω τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντας αὐτὸν τροπώσομαι

text_en: And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
text_la: Et veritas mea et misericordia mea cum ipso, et in nomine meo exaltabitur cornu ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά μου καὶ τὸ ἔλεός μου μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ὑψωθήσεται τὸ κέρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will set his hand in the sea; and his right hand in the rivers.
text_la: Et ponam in mari manum ejus, et in fluminibus dexteram ejus.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι ἐν θαλάσσῃ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ποταμοῖς δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall cry out to me: You are my father: my God , and the support of my salvation .
text_la: Ipse invocabit me : Pater meus es tu, Deus meus, et susceptor salutis meæ.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐπικαλέσεταί με πατήρ μου εἶ σύ θεός μου καὶ ἀντιλήμπτωρ τῆς σωτηρίας μου

text_en: And I will make him my firstborn , high above the kings of the earth.
text_la: Et ego primogenitum ponam illum, excelsum præ regibus terræ.
text_el: κἀγὼ πρωτότοκον θήσομαι αὐτόν ὑψηλὸν παρὰ τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν τῆς γῆς

text_en: I will keep my mercy for him for ever: and my covenant faithful to him.
text_la: In æternum servabo illi misericordiam meam, et testamentum meum fidele ipsi.
text_el: εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα φυλάξω αὐτῷ τὸ ἔλεός μου καὶ ἡ διαθήκη μου πιστὴ αὐτῷ

text_en: And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: and his throne as the days of heaven .
text_la: Et ponam in sæculum sæculi semen ejus, et thronum ejus sicut dies cæli.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ὡς τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And if his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments:
text_la: Si autem dereliquerint filii ejus legem meam, et in judiciis meis non ambulaverint;
text_el: ἐὰν ἐγκαταλίπωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν νόμον μου καὶ τοῖς κρίμασίν μου μὴ πορευθῶσιν

text_en: If they profane my justices: and keep not my commandments:
text_la: si justitias meas profanaverint, et mandata mea non custodierint:
text_el: ἐὰν τὰ δικαιώματά μου βεβηλώσουσιν καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς μου μὴ φυλάξωσιν

text_en: I will visit their iniquities with a rod and their sins with stripes.
text_la: visitabo in virga iniquitates eorum, et in verberibus peccata eorum;
text_el: ἐπισκέψομαι ἐν ῥάβδῳ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν μάστιξιν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν

text_en: But my mercy I will not take away from him: nor will I suffer my truth to fail.
text_la: misericordiam autem meam non dispergam ab eo, neque nocebo in veritate mea,
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἔλεός μου οὐ μὴ διασκεδάσω ἀπ' αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ μὴ ἀδικήσω ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μου

text_en: Neither will I profane my covenant: and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.
text_la: neque profanabo testamentum meum : et quæ procedunt de labiis meis non faciam irrita.
text_el: οὐδὲ μὴ βεβηλώσω τὴν διαθήκην μου καὶ τὰ ἐκπορευόμενα διὰ τῶν χειλέων μου οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσω

text_en: Once have I sworn by my holiness : I will not lie unto David :
text_la: Semel juravi in sancto meo, si David mentiar:
text_el: ἅπαξ ὤμοσα ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ μου εἰ τῷ Δαυιδ ψεύσομαι

text_en: His seed shall endure for ever.
text_la: semen ejus in æternum manebit. Et thronus ejus sicut sol in conspectu meo,
text_el: τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μενεῖ καὶ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος ἐναντίον μου

text_en: And his throne as the sun before me: and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven .
text_la: et sicut luna perfecta in æternum, et testis in cælo fidelis.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἡ σελήνη κατηρτισμένη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ὁ μάρτυς ἐν οὐρανῷ πιστός διάψαλμα

text_en: But you have rejected and despised : you have been angry with my anointed.
text_la: Tu vero repulisti et despexisti; distulisti christum tuum.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἀπώσω καὶ ἐξουδένωσας ἀνεβάλου τὸν χριστόν σου

text_en: You have overthrown the covenant of your servant: you have profaned his sanctuary on the earth.
text_la: Evertisti testamentum servi tui; profanasti in terra sanctuarium ejus.
text_el: κατέστρεψας τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ δούλου σου ἐβεβήλωσας εἰς τὴν γῆν τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: You have broken down all his hedges: you have made his strength fear.
text_la: Destruxisti omnes sepes ejus; posuisti firmamentum ejus formidinem.
text_el: καθεῖλες πάντας τοὺς φραγμοὺς αὐτοῦ ἔθου τὰ ὀχυρώματα αὐτοῦ δειλίαν

text_en: All that pass by the way have robbed him: he has become a reproach to his neighbours.
text_la: Diripuerunt eum omnes transeuntes viam; factus est opprobrium vicinis suis.
text_el: διήρπασαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ διοδεύοντες ὁδόν ἐγενήθη ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: You have set up the right hand of them that oppress him: you have made all his enemies to rejoice.
text_la: Exaltasti dexteram deprimentium eum; lætificasti omnes inimicos ejus.
text_el: ὕψωσας τὴν δεξιὰν τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ εὔφρανας πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: You have turned away the help of his sword; and have not assisted him in battle.
text_la: Avertisti adjutorium gladii ejus, et non es auxiliatus ei in bello.
text_el: ἀπέστρεψας τὴν βοήθειαν τῆς ῥομφαίας αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀντελάβου αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ

text_en: You have made his purification to cease: and you have cast his throne down to the ground.
text_la: Destruxisti eum ab emundatione, et sedem ejus in terram collisisti.
text_el: κατέλυσας ἀπὸ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτόν τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν κατέρραξας

text_en: You have shortened the days of his time: you have covered him with confusion.
text_la: Minorasti dies temporis ejus; perfudisti eum confusione.
text_el: ἐσμίκρυνας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ χρόνου αὐτοῦ κατέχεας αὐτοῦ αἰσχύνην διάψαλμα

text_en: How long, O Lord , will you turn away unto the end? Shall your anger burn like fire?
text_la: Usquequo, Domine, avertis in finem? exardescet sicut ignis ira tua?
text_el: ἕως πότε κύριε ἀποστρέψεις εἰς τέλος ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ἡ ὀργή σου

text_en: Remember what my substance is: for have you made all the children of men in vain?
text_la: Memorare quæ mea substantia : numquid enim vane constituisti omnes filios hominum?
text_el: μνήσθητι τίς μου ἡ ὑπόστασις μὴ γὰρ ματαίως ἔκτισας πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: Who is the man that shall live, and not see death: that shall deliver his soul from the hand of hell?
text_la: Quis est homo qui vivet et non videbit mortem? eruet animam suam de manu inferi?
text_el: τίς ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὃς ζήσεται καὶ οὐκ ὄψεται θάνατον ῥύσεται τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς ᾅδου διάψαλμα

text_en: Lord , where are your ancient mercies, according to what you swore to David in your truth ?
text_la: Ubi sunt misericordiæ tuæ antiquæ, Domine, sicut jurasti David in veritate tua?
text_el: ποῦ εἰσιν τὰ ἐλέη σου τὰ ἀρχαῖα κύριε ἃ ὤμοσας τῷ Δαυιδ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου

text_en: Be mindful, O Lord , of the reproach of your servants (which I have held in my bosom) of many nations:
text_la: Memor esto, Domine, opprobrii servorum tuorum, quod continui in sinu meo, multarum gentium:
text_el: μνήσθητι κύριε τοῦ ὀνειδισμοῦ τῶν δούλων σου οὗ ὑπέσχον ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ μου πολλῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: Wherewith your enemies have reproached, O Lord ; wherewith they have reproached the change of your anointed.
text_la: quod exprobraverunt inimici tui, Domine; quod exprobraverunt commutationem christi tui.
text_el: οὗ ὠνείδισαν οἱ ἐχθροί σου κύριε οὗ ὠνείδισαν τὸ ἀντάλλαγμα τοῦ χριστοῦ σου

text_en: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. So be it. So be it.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus in æternum. Fiat, fiat.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα γένοιτο γένοιτο

text_en: Lord , you have been our refuge from generation to generation .
text_la: Domine, refugium factus es nobis a generatione in generationem.
text_pt: As benignidades do SENHOR cantarei perpetuamente; com a minha boca manifestarei a tua fidelidade de geração em geração.
text_el: προσευχὴ τοῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ κύριε καταφυγὴ ἐγενήθης ἡμῖν ἐν γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ

text_en: Before the mountains were made, or the earth and the world was formed; from eternity and to eternity you are God .
text_la: Priusquam montes fierent, aut formaretur terra et orbis, a sæculo et usque in sæculum tu es, Deus.
text_pt: Pois disse eu: A tua benignidade será edificada para sempre; tu confirmarás a tua fidelidade até nos céus, dizendo:
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη γενηθῆναι καὶ πλασθῆναι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ

text_en: Turn not man away to be brought low: and you have said: Be converted , O you sons of men .
text_la: Ne avertas hominem in humilitatem : et dixisti : Convertimini, filii hominum.
text_pt: Fiz uma aliança com o meu escolhido, e jurei ao meu servo Davi, dizendo:
text_el: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἄνθρωπον εἰς ταπείνωσιν καὶ εἶπας ἐπιστρέψατε υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For a thousand years in your sight are as yesterday, which is past. And as a watch in the night,
text_la: Quoniam mille anni ante oculos tuos tamquam dies hesterna quæ præteriit: et custodia in nocte
text_pt: A tua semente estabelecerei para sempre, e edificarei o teu trono de geração em geração. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι χίλια ἔτη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἐχθές ἥτις διῆλθεν καὶ φυλακὴ ἐν νυκτί

text_en: things that are counted nothing, shall their years be.
text_la: quæ pro nihilo habentur, eorum anni erunt.
text_pt: E os céus louvarão as tuas maravilhas, ó Senhor, a tua fidelidade também na congregação dos santos.
text_el: τὰ ἐξουδενώματα αὐτῶν ἔτη ἔσονται τὸ πρωὶ ὡσεὶ χλόη παρέλθοι

text_en: In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.
text_la: Mane sicut herba transeat; mane floreat, et transeat; vespere decidat, induret, et arescat.
text_pt: Pois quem no céu se pode igualar ao Senhor? Quem entre os filhos dos poderosos pode ser semelhante ao Senhor?
text_el: τὸ πρωὶ ἀνθήσαι καὶ παρέλθοι τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποπέσοι σκληρυνθείη καὶ ξηρανθείη

text_en: For in your wrath we have fainted away: and are troubled in your indignation.
text_la: Quia defecimus in ira tua, et in furore tuo turbati sumus.
text_pt: Deus é muito formidável na assembléia dos santos, e para ser reverenciado por todos os que o cercam.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξελίπομεν ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐταράχθημεν

text_en: You have set our iniquities before your eyes: our life in the light of your countenance.
text_la: Posuisti iniquitates nostras in conspectu tuo; sæculum nostrum in illuminatione vultus tui.
text_pt: Ó Senhor Deus dos Exércitos, quem é poderoso como tu, Senhor, com a tua fidelidade ao redor de ti?
text_el: ἔθου τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ αἰὼν ἡμῶν εἰς φωτισμὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου

text_en: For all our days are spent; and in your wrath we have fainted away. Our years shall be considered as a spider:
text_la: Quoniam omnes dies nostri defecerunt, et in ira tua defecimus. Anni nostri sicut aranea meditabuntur;
text_pt: Tu dominas o ímpeto do mar; quando as suas ondas se levantam, tu as fazes aquietar.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ἐξελίπομεν τὰ ἔτη ἡμῶν ὡς ἀράχνην ἐμελέτων

text_en: The days of our years in them are threescore and ten years. But if in the strong they be fourscore years: and what is more of them is labour and sorrow. For mildness has come upon us: and we shall be corrected.
text_la: dies annorum nostrorum in ipsis septuaginta anni. Si autem in potentatibus octoginta anni, et amplius eorum labor et dolor; quoniam supervenit mansuetudo, et corripiemur.
text_pt: Tu quebraste a Raabe como se fora ferida de morte; espalhaste os teus inimigos com o teu braço forte.
text_el: αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν ἡμῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ἐὰν δὲ ἐν δυναστείαις ὀγδοήκοντα ἔτη καὶ τὸ πλεῖον αὐτῶν κόπος καὶ πόνος ὅτι ἐπῆλθεν πραΰτης ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ παιδευθησόμεθα

text_en: Who knows the power of your anger , and for your fear
text_la: Quis novit potestatem iræ tuæ, et præ timore tuo iram tuam
text_pt: Teus são os céus, e tua é a terra; o mundo e a sua plenitude tu os fundaste.
text_el: τίς γινώσκει τὸ κράτος τῆς ὀργῆς σου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου σου τὸν θυμόν σου

text_en: can number your wrath ? So make your right hand known : and men learned in heart, in wisdom.
text_la: dinumerare? Dexteram tuam sic notam fac, et eruditos corde in sapientia.
text_pt: O norte e o sul tu os criaste; Tabor e Hermom jubilam em teu nome.
text_el: ἐξαριθμήσασθαι τὴν δεξιάν σου οὕτως γνώρισον καὶ τοὺς πεπεδημένους τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐν σοφίᾳ

text_en: Return, O Lord , how long? And be entreated in favour of your servants.
text_la: Convertere, Domine; usquequo? et deprecabilis esto super servos tuos.
text_pt: Tu tens um braço poderoso; forte é a tua mão, e alta está a tua destra.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον κύριε ἕως πότε καὶ παρακλήθητι ἐπὶ τοῖς δούλοις σου

text_en: We are filled in the morning with your mercy: and we have rejoiced, and are delighted all our days.
text_la: Repleti sumus mane misericordia tua; et exsultavimus, et delectati sumus omnibus diebus nostris.
text_pt: Justiça e juízo são a base do teu trono; misericórdia e verdade irão adiante do teu rosto.
text_el: ἐνεπλήσθημεν τὸ πρωὶ τοῦ ἐλέους σου καὶ ἠγαλλιασάμεθα καὶ εὐφράνθημεν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν

text_en: We have rejoiced for the days in which you have humbled us: for the years in which we have seen evils .
text_la: Lætati sumus pro diebus quibus nos humiliasti; annis quibus vidimus mala.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o povo que conhece o som alegre; andará, ó Senhor, na luz da tua face.
text_el: εὐφράνθημεν ἀνθ' ὧν ἡμερῶν ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς ἐτῶν ὧν εἴδομεν κακά

text_en: Look upon your servants and upon their works: and direct their children.
text_la: Respice in servos tuos et in opera tua, et dirige filios eorum.
text_pt: Em teu nome se alegrará todo o dia, e na tua justiça se exaltará.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὲ ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ ὁδήγησον τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct the works of our hands over us; yea, the work of our hands do you direct.
text_la: Et sit splendor Domini Dei nostri super nos, et opera manuum nostrarum dirige super nos, et opus manuum nostrarum dirige.
text_pt: Pois tu és a glória da sua força; e no teu favor será exaltado o nosso poder.
text_el: καὶ ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: He that dwells in the aid of the most High , shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob .
text_la: Qui habitat in adjutorio Altissimi, in protectione Dei cæli commorabitur.
text_pt: SENHOR, tu tens sido o nosso refúgio, de geração em geração.
text_el: αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυιδ ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν βοηθείᾳ τοῦ ὑψίστου ἐν σκέπῃ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ αὐλισθήσεται

text_en: He shall say to the Lord : You are my protector, and my refuge: my God , in him will I trust.
text_la: Dicet Domino : Susceptor meus es tu, et refugium meum; Deus meus, sperabo in eum.
text_pt: Antes que os montes nascessem, ou que tu formasses a terra e o mundo, mesmo de eternidade a eternidade, tu és Deus.
text_el: ἐρεῖ τῷ κυρίῳ ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ καὶ καταφυγή μου ὁ θεός μου ἐλπιῶ ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: For he has delivered me from the snare of the hunters: and from the sharp word.
text_la: Quoniam ipse liberavit me de laqueo venantium, et a verbo aspero.
text_pt: Tu reduzes o homem à destruição; e dizes: Tornai-vos, filhos dos homens.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτὸς ῥύσεταί με ἐκ παγίδος θηρευτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ λόγου ταραχώδους

text_en: He will overshadow you with his shoulders: and under his wings you shall trust.
text_la: Scapulis suis obumbrabit tibi, et sub pennis ejus sperabis.
text_pt: Porque mil anos são aos teus olhos como o dia de ontem que passou, e como a vigília da noite.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς μεταφρένοις αὐτοῦ ἐπισκιάσει σοι καὶ ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτοῦ ἐλπιεῖς ὅπλῳ κυκλώσει σε ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ

text_en: His truth shall compass you with a shield: you shall not be afraid of the terror of the night.
text_la: Scuto circumdabit te veritas ejus : non timebis a timore nocturno;
text_pt: Tu os levas como uma corrente de água; são como um sono; de manhã são como a erva que cresce.
text_el: οὐ φοβηθήσῃ ἀπὸ φόβου νυκτερινοῦ ἀπὸ βέλους πετομένου ἡμέρας

text_en: Of the arrow that flies in the day, of the business that walks about in the dark: of invasion, or of the noonday devil .
text_la: a sagitta volante in die, a negotio perambulante in tenebris, ab incursu, et dæmonio meridiano.
text_pt: De madrugada floresce e cresce; à tarde corta-se e seca.
text_el: ἀπὸ πράγματος διαπορευομένου ἐν σκότει ἀπὸ συμπτώματος καὶ δαιμονίου μεσημβρινοῦ

text_en: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand: but it shall not come near you.
text_la: Cadent a latere tuo mille, et decem millia a dextris tuis; ad te autem non appropinquabit.
text_pt: Pois somos consumidos pela tua ira, e pelo teu furor somos angustiados.
text_el: πεσεῖται ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους σου χιλιὰς καὶ μυριὰς ἐκ δεξιῶν σου πρὸς σὲ δὲ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ

text_en: But you shall consider with your eyes: and shall see the reward of the wicked .
text_la: Verumtamen oculis tuis considerabis, et retributionem peccatorum videbis.
text_pt: Diante de ti puseste as nossas iniqüidades, os nossos pecados ocultos, à luz do teu rosto.
text_el: πλὴν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου κατανοήσεις καὶ ἀνταπόδοσιν ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄψῃ

text_en: Because you, O Lord , are my hope : you have made the most High your refuge.
text_la: Quoniam tu es, Domine, spes mea; Altissimum posuisti refugium tuum.
text_pt: Pois todos os nossos dias vão passando na tua indignação; passamos os nossos anos como um conto que se conta.
text_el: ὅτι σύ κύριε ἡ ἐλπίς μου τὸν ὕψιστον ἔθου καταφυγήν σου

text_en: There shall no evil come to you: nor shall the scourge come near your dwelling.
text_la: Non accedet ad te malum, et flagellum non appropinquabit tabernaculo tuo.
text_pt: Os dias da nossa vida chegam a setenta anos, e se alguns, pela sua robustez, chegam a oitenta anos, o orgulho deles é canseira e enfado, pois cedo se corta e vamos voando.
text_el: οὐ προσελεύσεται πρὸς σὲ κακά καὶ μάστιξ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ τῷ σκηνώματί σου

text_en: For he has given his angels charge over you; to keep you in all your ways.
text_la: Quoniam angelis suis mandavit de te, ut custodiant te in omnibus viis tuis.
text_pt: Quem conhece o poder da tua ira? Segundo és tremendo, assim é o teu furor.
text_el: ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου

text_en: In their hands they shall bear you up: lest you dash your foot against a stone.
text_la: In manibus portabunt te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
text_pt: Ensina-nos a contar os nossos dias, de tal maneira que alcancemos corações sábios.
text_el: ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μήποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου

text_en: You shall walk upon the asp and the basilisk: and you shall trample under foot the lion and the dragon.
text_la: Super aspidem et basiliscum ambulabis, et conculcabis leonem et draconem.
text_pt: Volta-te para nós, Senhor; até quando? Aplaca-te para com os teus servos.
text_el: ἐπ' ἀσπίδα καὶ βασιλίσκον ἐπιβήσῃ καὶ καταπατήσεις λέοντα καὶ δράκοντα

text_en: Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: I will protect him because he has known my name .
text_la: Quoniam in me speravit, liberabo eum; protegam eum, quoniam cognovit nomen meum.
text_pt: Farta-nos de madrugada com a tua benignidade, para que nos regozijemos, e nos alegremos todos os nossos dias.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἤλπισεν καὶ ῥύσομαι αὐτόν σκεπάσω αὐτόν ὅτι ἔγνω τὸ ὄνομά μου

text_en: He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.
text_la: Clamabit ad me, et ego exaudiam eum; cum ipso sum in tribulatione : eripiam eum, et glorificabo eum.
text_pt: Alegra-nos pelos dias em que nos afligiste, e pelos anos em que vimos o mal.
text_el: ἐπικαλέσεταί με καὶ εἰσακούσομαι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰμι ἐν θλίψει καὶ ἐξελοῦμαι καὶ δοξάσω αὐτόν

text_en: I will fill him with length of days; and I will show him my salvation .
text_la: Longitudine dierum replebo eum, et ostendam illi salutare meum.
text_pt: Apareça a tua obra aos teus servos, e a tua glória sobre seus filhos.
text_el: μακρότητα ἡμερῶν ἐμπλήσω αὐτὸν καὶ δείξω αὐτῷ τὸ σωτήριόν μου

text_en: A psalm of a canticle on the sabbath day .
text_la: Psalmus cantici, in die sabbati.
text_pt: Aquele que habita no esconderijo do Altíssimo, à sombra do Onipotente descansará.
text_el: ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ σαββάτου

text_en: It is good to give praise to the Lord : and to sing to your name , O most High .
text_la: Bonum est confiteri Domino, et psallere nomini tuo, Altissime:
text_pt: Direi do Senhor: Ele é o meu Deus, o meu refúgio, a minha fortaleza, e nele confiarei.
text_el: ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ψάλλειν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ὕψιστε

text_en: To show forth your mercy in the morning, and your truth in the night:
text_la: ad annuntiandum mane misericordiam tuam, et veritatem tuam per noctem,
text_pt: Porque ele te livrará do laço do passarinheiro, e da peste perniciosa.
text_el: τοῦ ἀναγγέλλειν τὸ πρωὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου κατὰ νύκτα

text_en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: with a canticle upon the harp.
text_la: in decachordo, psalterio; cum cantico, in cithara.
text_pt: Ele te cobrirá com as suas penas, e debaixo das suas asas te confiarás; a sua verdade será o teu escudo e broquel.
text_el: ἐν δεκαχόρδῳ ψαλτηρίῳ μετ' ᾠδῆς ἐν κιθάρᾳ

text_en: For you have given me, O Lord , a delight in your doings: and in the works of your hands I shall rejoice.
text_la: Quia delectasti me, Domine, in factura tua; et in operibus manuum tuarum exsultabo.
text_pt: Não terás medo do terror de noite nem da seta que voa de dia,.
text_el: ὅτι εὔφρανάς με κύριε ἐν τῷ ποιήματί σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν σου ἀγαλλιάσομαι

text_en: O Lord , how great are your works! your thoughts are exceeding deep.
text_la: Quam magnificata sunt opera tua, Domine! nimis profundæ factæ sunt cogitationes tuæ.
text_pt: Nem da peste que anda na escuridão, nem da mortandade que assola ao meio-dia.
text_el: ὡς ἐμεγαλύνθη τὰ ἔργα σου κύριε σφόδρα ἐβαθύνθησαν οἱ διαλογισμοί σου

text_en: The senseless man shall not know : nor will the fool understand these things.
text_la: Vir insipiens non cognoscet, et stultus non intelliget hæc.
text_pt: Mil cairão ao teu lado, e dez mil à tua direita, mas não chegará a ti.
text_el: ἀνὴρ ἄφρων οὐ γνώσεται καὶ ἀσύνετος οὐ συνήσει ταῦτα

text_en: When the wicked shall spring up as grass: and all the workers of iniquity shall appear: That they may perish for ever and ever:
text_la: Cum exorti fuerint peccatores sicut fœnum, et apparuerint omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, ut intereant in sæculum sæculi:
text_pt: Somente com os teus olhos contemplarás, e verás a recompensa dos ímpios.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἀνατεῖλαι τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς ὡς χόρτον καὶ διέκυψαν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ὅπως ἂν ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: But you, O Lord , are most high for evermore.
text_la: tu autem Altissimus in æternum, Domine.
text_pt: Porque tu, ó Senhor, és o meu refúgio. No Altíssimo fizeste a tua habitação.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ὕψιστος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κύριε

text_en: For behold your enemies, O lord, for behold your enemies shall perish: and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
text_la: Quoniam ecce inimici tui, Domine, quoniam ecce inimici tui peribunt; et dispergentur omnes qui operantur iniquitatem.
text_pt: Nenhum mal te sucederá, nem praga alguma chegará à tua tenda.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἀπολοῦνται καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: and my old age in plentiful mercy.
text_la: Et exaltabitur sicut unicornis cornu meum, et senectus mea in misericordia uberi.
text_pt: Porque aos seus anjos dará ordem a teu respeito, para te guardarem em todos os teus caminhos.
text_el: καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὡς μονοκέρωτος τὸ κέρας μου καὶ τὸ γῆράς μου ἐν ἐλαίῳ πίονι

text_en: My eye also has looked down upon my enemies: and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.
text_la: Et despexit oculus meus inimicos meos, et in insurgentibus in me malignantibus audiet auris mea.
text_pt: Eles te sustentarão nas suas mãos, para que não tropeces com o teu pé em pedra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεῖδεν ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπανιστανομένοις ἐπ' ἐμὲ πονηρευομένοις ἀκούσεται τὸ οὖς μου

text_en: The just shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus .
text_la: Justus ut palma florebit; sicut cedrus Libani multiplicabitur.
text_pt: Pisarás o leão e a cobra; calcarás aos pés o filho do leão e a serpente.
text_el: δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει ὡσεὶ κέδρος ἡ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ πληθυνθήσεται

text_en: They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God .
text_la: Plantati in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri florebunt.
text_pt: Porquanto tão encarecidamente me amou, também eu o livrarei; pô-lo-ei em retiro alto, porque conheceu o meu nome.
text_el: πεφυτευμένοι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξανθήσουσιν

text_en: They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: and shall be well treated,
text_la: Adhuc multiplicabuntur in senecta uberi, et bene patientes erunt:
text_pt: Ele me invocará, e eu lhe responderei; estarei com ele na angústia; dela o retirarei, e o glorificarei.
text_el: ἔτι πληθυνθήσονται ἐν γήρει πίονι καὶ εὐπαθοῦντες ἔσονται

text_en: that they may show, That the Lord our God is righteous, and there is no iniquity in him.
text_la: ut annuntient quoniam rectus Dominus Deus noster, et non est iniquitas in eo.
text_pt: Fartá-lo-ei com longura de dias, e lhe mostrarei a minha salvação.
text_el: τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι ὅτι εὐθὴς κύριος ὁ θεός μου καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: The Lord has reigned, he is clothed with beauty: the Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded himself. For he has established the world which shall not be moved.
text_la: Dominus regnavit, decorem indutus est : indutus est Dominus fortitudinem, et præcinxit se. Etenim firmavit orbem terræ, qui non commovebitur.
text_pt: Bom é louvar ao SENHOR, e cantar louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo;
text_el: εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ προσαββάτου ὅτε κατῴκισται ἡ γῆ αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυιδ ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν εὐπρέπειαν ἐνεδύσατο ἐνεδύσατο κύριος δύναμιν καὶ περιεζώσατο καὶ γὰρ ἐστερέωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται

text_en: My throne is prepared from of old: you are from everlasting.
text_la: Parata sedes tua ex tunc; a sæculo tu es.
