text_pt: Para de manhã anunciar a tua benignidade, e todas as noites a tua fidelidade;
text_el: ἕτοιμος ὁ θρόνος σου ἀπὸ τότε ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ

text_en: The floods have lifted up, O Lord : the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods have lifted up their waves,
text_la: Elevaverunt flumina, Domine, elevaverunt flumina vocem suam; elevaverunt flumina fluctus suos,
text_pt: Sobre um instrumento de dez cordas, e sobre o saltério; sobre a harpa com som solene.
text_el: ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοί κύριε ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοὶ φωνὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: with the noise of many waters. Wonderful are the surges of the sea: wonderful is the Lord on high.
text_la: a vocibus aquarum multarum. Mirabiles elationes maris; mirabilis in altis Dominus.
text_pt: Pois tu, Senhor, me alegraste pelos teus feitos; exultarei nas obras das tuas mãos.
text_el: ἀπὸ φωνῶν ὑδάτων πολλῶν θαυμαστοὶ οἱ μετεωρισμοὶ τῆς θαλάσσης θαυμαστὸς ἐν ὑψηλοῖς ὁ κύριος

text_en: Your testimonies have become exceedingly credible: holiness becomes your house, O Lord , unto length of days.
text_la: Testimonia tua credibilia facta sunt nimis; domum tuam decet sanctitudo, Domine, in longitudinem dierum.
text_pt: Quão grandes são, Senhor, as tuas obras! Mui profundos são os teus pensamentos.
text_el: τὰ μαρτύριά σου ἐπιστώθησαν σφόδρα τῷ οἴκῳ σου πρέπει ἁγίασμα κύριε εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν

text_en: The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongs: the God of revenge has acted freely.
text_la: Deus ultionum Dominus; Deus ultionum libere egit.
text_pt: O SENHOR reina; está vestido de majestade. O SENHOR se revestiu e cingiu de poder; o mundo também está firmado, e não poderá vacilar.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ τετράδι σαββάτων ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων ἐπαρρησιάσατο

text_en: Lift up yourself, you that judge the earth: render a reward to the proud .
text_la: Exaltare, qui judicas terram; redde retributionem superbis.
text_pt: O teu trono está firme desde então; tu és desde a eternidade.
text_el: ὑψώθητι ὁ κρίνων τὴν γῆν ἀπόδος ἀνταπόδοσιν τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις

text_en: How long shall sinners, O Lord : how long shall sinners glory ?
text_la: Usquequo peccatores, Domine, usquequo peccatores gloriabuntur;
text_pt: Os rios levantam, ó Senhor, os rios levantam o seu ruído, os rios levantam as suas ondas.
text_el: ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοί κύριε ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοὶ καυχήσονται

text_en: Shall they utter, and speak iniquity : shall all speak who work injustice ?
text_la: effabuntur et loquentur iniquitatem; loquentur omnes qui operantur injustitiam?
text_pt: Mas o Senhor nas alturas é mais poderoso do que o ruído das grandes águas e do que as grandes ondas do mar.
text_el: φθέγξονται καὶ λαλήσουσιν ἀδικίαν λαλήσουσιν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: Your people, O Lord , they have brought low: and they have afflicted your inheritance.
text_la: Populum tuum, Domine, humiliaverunt, et hæreditatem tuam vexaverunt.
text_pt: Mui fiéis são os teus testemunhos; a santidade convém à tua casa, Senhor, para sempre.
text_el: τὸν λαόν σου κύριε ἐταπείνωσαν καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν σου ἐκάκωσαν

text_en: They have slain the widow and the stranger: and they have murdered the fatherless .
text_la: Viduam et advenam interfecerunt, et pupillos occiderunt.
text_el: χήραν καὶ προσήλυτον ἀπέκτειναν καὶ ὀρφανοὺς ἐφόνευσαν

text_en: And they have said: The Lord shall not see: neither shall the God of Jacob understand.
text_la: Et dixerunt : Non videbit Dominus, nec intelliget Deus Jacob.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ὄψεται κύριος οὐδὲ συνήσει ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ιακωβ

text_en: Understand, you senseless among the people: and, you fools, be wise at last.
text_la: Intelligite, insipientes in populo; et stulti, aliquando sapite.
text_el: σύνετε δή ἄφρονες ἐν τῷ λαῷ καί μωροί ποτὲ φρονήσατε

text_en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? Or he that formed the eye, does he not consider?
text_la: Qui plantavit aurem non audiet? aut qui finxit oculum non considerat?
text_el: ὁ φυτεύσας τὸ οὖς οὐχὶ ἀκούει ἢ ὁ πλάσας τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν οὐ κατανοεῖ

text_en: He that chastises nations, shall he not rebuke: he that teaches man knowledge ?
text_la: Qui corripit gentes non arguet, qui docet hominem scientiam?
text_el: ὁ παιδεύων ἔθνη οὐχὶ ἐλέγξει ὁ διδάσκων ἄνθρωπον γνῶσιν

text_en: The Lord knows the thoughts of men , that they are vain.
text_la: Dominus scit cogitationes hominum, quoniam vanæ sunt.
text_el: κύριος γινώσκει τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὅτι εἰσὶν μάταιοι

text_en: Blessed is the man whom you shall instruct, O Lord : and shall teach him out of your law.
text_la: Beatus homo quem tu erudieris, Domine, et de lege tua docueris eum:
text_el: μακάριος ἄνθρωπος ὃν ἂν σὺ παιδεύσῃς κύριε καὶ ἐκ τοῦ νόμου σου διδάξῃς αὐτὸν

text_en: That you may give him rest from the evil days: till a pit be dug for the wicked .
text_la: ut mitiges ei a diebus malis, donec fodiatur peccatori fovea.
text_el: τοῦ πραῦναι αὐτῷ ἀφ' ἡμερῶν πονηρῶν ἕως οὗ ὀρυγῇ τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ βόθρος

text_en: For the Lord will not cast off his people: neither will he forsake his own inheritance.
text_la: Quia non repellet Dominus plebem suam, et hæreditatem suam non derelinquet,
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἀπώσεται κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει

text_en: Until justice be turned into judgment: and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.
text_la: quoadusque justitia convertatur in judicium : et qui juxta illam, omnes qui recto sunt corde.
text_el: ἕως οὗ δικαιοσύνη ἐπιστρέψῃ εἰς κρίσιν καὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῆς πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ διάψαλμα

text_en: Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? Or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity ?
text_la: Quis consurget mihi adversus malignantes? aut quis stabit mecum adversus operantes iniquitatem?
text_el: τίς ἀναστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ πονηρευομένους ἢ τίς συμπαραστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: Unless the Lord had been my helper, my soul had almost dwelt in hell.
text_la: Nisi quia Dominus adjuvit me, paulominus habitasset in inferno anima mea.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ὅτι κύριος ἐβοήθησέν μοι παρὰ βραχὺ παρῴκησεν τῷ ᾅδῃ ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: If I said: My foot is moved: your mercy, O Lord , assisted me.
text_la: Si dicebam : Motus est pes meus : misericordia tua, Domine, adjuvabat me.
text_el: εἰ ἔλεγον σεσάλευται ὁ πούς μου τὸ ἔλεός σου κύριε βοηθεῖ μοι

text_en: According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, your comforts have given joy to my soul .
text_la: Secundum multitudinem dolorum meorum in corde meo, consolationes tuæ lætificaverunt animam meam.
text_el: κύριε κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ὀδυνῶν μου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου αἱ παρακλήσεις σου ἠγάπησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: Does the seat of iniquity stick to you, who frames labour in commandment?
text_la: Numquid adhæret tibi sedes iniquitatis, qui fingis laborem in præcepto?
text_el: μὴ συμπροσέσται σοι θρόνος ἀνομίας ὁ πλάσσων κόπον ἐπὶ προστάγματι

text_en: They will hunt after the soul of the just , and will condemn innocent blood.
text_la: Captabunt in animam justi, et sanguinem innocentem condemnabunt.
text_el: θηρεύσουσιν ἐπὶ ψυχὴν δικαίου καὶ αἷμα ἀθῷον καταδικάσονται

text_en: But the Lord is my refuge: and my God the help of my hope .
text_la: Et factus est mihi Dominus in refugium, et Deus meus in adjutorium spei meæ.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετό μοι κύριος εἰς καταφυγὴν καὶ ὁ θεός μου εἰς βοηθὸν ἐλπίδος μου

text_en: And he will render them their iniquity : and in their malice he will destroy them: the Lord our God will destroy them.
text_la: Et reddet illis iniquitatem ipsorum, et in malitia eorum disperdet eos : disperdet illos Dominus Deus noster.
text_el: καὶ ἀποδώσει αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ τὴν πονηρίαν αὐτῶν ἀφανιεῖ αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy : let us joyfully sing to God our saviour.
text_la: Venite, exsultemus Domino; jubilemus Deo salutari nostro;
text_pt: Ó Senhor Deus, a quem a vingança pertence, ó Deus, a quem a vingança pertence, mostra-te resplandecente.
text_el: αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυιδ δεῦτε ἀγαλλιασώμεθα τῷ κυρίῳ ἀλαλάξωμεν τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν

text_en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
text_la: præoccupemus faciem ejus in confessione, et in psalmis jubilemus ei:
text_pt: Exalta-te, tu, que és juiz da terra; dá a paga aos soberbos.
text_el: προφθάσωμεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει καὶ ἐν ψαλμοῖς ἀλαλάξωμεν αὐτῷ

text_en: For the Lord is a great God , and a great King above all gods.
text_la: quoniam Deus magnus Dominus, et rex magnus super omnes deos.
text_pt: Até quando os ímpios, Senhor, até quando os ímpios saltarão de prazer?
text_el: ὅτι θεὸς μέγας κύριος καὶ βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς

text_en: For in his hand are all the ends of the earth: and the heights of the mountains are his.
text_la: Quia in manu ejus sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitudines montium ipsius sunt;
text_pt: Até quando proferirão, e falarão coisas duras, e se gloriarão todos os que praticam a iniqüidade?
text_el: ὅτι ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ ὕψη τῶν ὀρέων αὐτοῦ εἰσιν

text_en: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
text_la: quoniam ipsius est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et siccam manus ejus formaverunt.
text_pt: Reduzem a pedaços o teu povo, ó Senhor, e afligem a tua herança.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ θάλασσα καὶ αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν αὐτήν καὶ τὴν ξηρὰν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἔπλασαν

text_en: Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us.
text_la: Venite, adoremus, et procidamus, et ploremus ante Dominum qui fecit nos:
text_pt: Matam a viúva e o estrangeiro, e ao órfão tiram a vida.
text_el: δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν αὐτῷ καὶ κλαύσωμεν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος ἡμᾶς

text_en: For he is the Lord our God : and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.
text_la: quia ipse est Dominus Deus noster, et nos populus pascuæ ejus, et oves manus ejus.
text_pt: Contudo dizem: O Senhor não o verá; nem para isso atenderá o Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἡμεῖς λαὸς νομῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα χειρὸς αὐτοῦ σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε

text_en: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts:
text_la: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra
text_pt: Atendei, ó brutais dentre o povo; e vós, loucos, quando sereis sábios?
text_el: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness : where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
text_la: sicut in irritatione, secundum diem tentationis in deserto, ubi tentaverunt me patres vestri : probaverunt me, et viderunt opera mea.
text_pt: Aquele que fez o ouvido não ouvirá? E o que formou o olho, não verá?
text_el: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐδοκίμασαν καὶ εἴδοσαν τὰ ἔργα μου

text_en: Forty years long was I offended with that generation , and I said: These always err in heart.
text_la: Quadraginta annis offensus fui generationi illi, et dixi : Semper hi errant corde.
text_pt: Aquele que argüi os gentios não castigará? E o que ensina ao homem o conhecimento, não saberá?
text_el: τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπα ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου

text_en: And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.
text_la: Et isti non cognoverunt vias meas : ut juravi in ira mea : Si introibunt in requiem meam.
text_pt: O Senhor conhece os pensamentos do homem, que são vaidade.
text_el: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου

text_en: Sing to the Lord a new canticle: sing to the Lord , all the earth.
text_la: Cantate Domino canticum novum; cantate Domino omnis terra.
text_pt: Vinde, cantemos ao SENHOR; jubilemos à rocha da nossa salvação.
text_el: ὅτε ὁ οἶκος ᾠκοδομεῖτο μετὰ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυιδ ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: Sing to the Lord and bless his name : show forth his salvation from day to day.
text_la: Cantate Domino, et benedicite nomini ejus; annuntiate de die in diem salutare ejus.
text_pt: Apresentemo-nos ante a sua face com louvores, e celebremo-lo com salmos.
text_el: ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ εὐλογήσατε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Declare his glory among the Gentiles : his wonders among all people.
text_la: Annuntiate inter gentes gloriam ejus; in omnibus populis mirabilia ejus.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor é Deus grande, e Rei grande sobre todos os deuses.
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ

text_en: For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
text_la: Quoniam magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis : terribilis est super omnes deos.
text_pt: Nas suas mãos estão as profundezas da terra, e as alturas dos montes são suas.
text_el: ὅτι μέγας κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα φοβερός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς

text_en: For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils : but the Lord made the heavens .
text_la: Quoniam omnes dii gentium dæmonia; Dominus autem cælos fecit.
text_pt: Seu é o mar, e ele o fez, e as suas mãos formaram a terra seca.
text_el: ὅτι πάντες οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν δαιμόνια ὁ δὲ κύριος τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἐποίησεν

text_en: Praise and beauty are before him: holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.
text_la: Confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu ejus; sanctimonia et magnificentia in sanctificatione ejus.
text_pt: Ó, vinde, adoremos e prostremo-nos; ajoelhemos diante do Senhor que nos criou.
text_el: ἐξομολόγησις καὶ ὡραιότης ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἁγιωσύνη καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια ἐν τῷ ἁγιάσματι αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bring to the Lord , O you kindreds of the Gentiles , bring to the Lord glory and honour :
text_la: Afferte Domino, patriæ gentium, afferte Domino gloriam et honorem;
text_pt: Porque ele é o nosso Deus, e nós povo do seu pasto e ovelhas da sua mão. Se hoje ouvirdes a sua voz,
text_el: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν

text_en: Bring to the Lord glory unto his name . Bring up sacrifices , and come into his courts :
text_la: afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus. Tollite hostias, et introite in atria ejus;
text_pt: Não endureçais os vossos corações, assim como na provocação e como no dia da tentação no deserto;
text_el: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἄρατε θυσίας καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Adore the Lord in his holy court . Let all the earth be moved at his presence.
text_la: adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus. Commoveatur a facie ejus universa terra;
text_pt: Quando vossos pais me tentaram, me provaram, e viram a minha obra.
text_el: προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ σαλευθήτω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: Say among the Gentiles , the Lord has reigned. For he has corrected the world, which shall not be moved: he will judge the people with justice .
text_la: dicite in gentibus, quia Dominus regnavit. Etenim correxit orbem terræ, qui non commovebitur; judicabit populos in æquitate.
text_pt: Quarenta anos estive desgostado com esta geração, e disse: É um povo que erra de coração, e não tem conhecido os meus caminhos.
text_el: εἴπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν καὶ γὰρ κατώρθωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται κρινεῖ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι

text_en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fullness thereof:
text_la: Lætentur cæli, et exsultet terra; commoveatur mare et plenitudo ejus;
text_pt: A quem jurei na minha ira que não entrarão no meu repouso.
text_el: εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς

text_en: The fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful. Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice
text_la: gaudebunt campi, et omnia quæ in eis sunt. Tunc exsultabunt omnia ligna silvarum
text_el: χαρήσεται τὰ πεδία καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς τότε ἀγαλλιάσονται πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ δρυμοῦ

text_en: before the face of the Lord , because he comes: because he comes to judge the earth. He shall judge the world with justice , and the people with his truth .
text_la: a facie Domini, quia venit, quoniam venit judicare terram. Judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate, et populos in veritate sua.
text_el: πρὸ προσώπου κυρίου ὅτι ἔρχεται ὅτι ἔρχεται κρῖναι τὴν γῆν κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord has reigned, let the earth rejoice: let many islands be glad.
text_la: Dominus regnavit : exsultet terra; lætentur insulæ multæ.
text_pt: Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo, cantai ao SENHOR toda a terra.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ὅτε ἡ γῆ αὐτοῦ καθίσταται ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ εὐφρανθήτωσαν νῆσοι πολλαί

text_en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.
text_la: Nubes et caligo in circuitu ejus; justitia et judicium correctio sedis ejus.
text_pt: Cantai ao Senhor, bendizei o seu nome; anunciai a sua salvação de dia em dia.
text_el: νεφέλη καὶ γνόφος κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνη καὶ κρίμα κατόρθωσις τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ

text_en: A fire shall go before him, and shall burn his enemies round about.
text_la: Ignis ante ipsum præcedet, et inflammabit in circuitu inimicos ejus.
text_pt: Anunciai entre as nações a sua glória; entre todos os povos as suas maravilhas.
text_el: πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται καὶ φλογιεῖ κύκλῳ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: His lightnings have shone forth to the world: the earth saw and trembled.
text_la: Illuxerunt fulgura ejus orbi terræ; vidit, et commota est terra.
text_pt: Porque grande é o Senhor, e digno de louvor, mais temível do que todos os deuses.
text_el: ἔφαναν αἱ ἀστραπαὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ εἶδεν καὶ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ

text_en: The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord : at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
text_la: Montes sicut cera fluxerunt a facie Domini; a facie Domini omnis terra.
text_pt: Porque todos os deuses dos povos são ídolos, mas o Senhor fez os céus.
text_el: τὰ ὄρη ἐτάκησαν ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: The heavens declared his justice : and all people saw his glory .
text_la: Annuntiaverunt cæli justitiam ejus, et viderunt omnes populi gloriam ejus.
text_pt: Glória e majestade estão ante a sua face, força e formosura no seu santuário.
text_el: ἀνήγγειλαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ καὶ εἴδοσαν πάντες οἱ λαοὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, and that glory in their idols . Adore him, all you his angels :
text_la: Confundantur omnes qui adorant sculptilia, et qui gloriantur in simulacris suis. Adorate eum omnes angeli ejus.
text_pt: Dai ao Senhor, ó famílias dos povos, dai ao Senhor glória e força.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ προσκυνοῦντες τοῖς γλυπτοῖς οἱ ἐγκαυχώμενοι ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν προσκυνήσατε αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sion heard, and was glad. And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, because of your judgments, O Lord .
text_la: Audivit, et lætata est Sion, et exsultaverunt filiæ Judæ propter judicia tua, Domine.
text_pt: Dai ao Senhor a glória devida ao seu nome; trazei oferenda, e entrai nos seus átrios.
text_el: ἤκουσεν καὶ εὐφράνθη Σιων καὶ ἠγαλλιάσαντο αἱ θυγατέρες τῆς Ιουδαίας ἕνεκεν τῶν κριμάτων σου κύριε

text_en: For you are the most high Lord over all the earth: you are exalted exceedingly above all gods.
text_la: Quoniam tu Dominus altissimus super omnem terram; nimis exaltatus es super omnes deos.
text_pt: Adorai ao Senhor na beleza da santidade; tremei diante dele toda a terra.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ εἶ κύριος ὁ ὕψιστος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν σφόδρα ὑπερυψώθης ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς θεούς

text_en: You that love the Lord , hate evil : the Lord preserves the souls of his saints , he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.
text_la: Qui diligitis Dominum, odite malum : custodit Dominus animas sanctorum suorum; de manu peccatoris liberabit eos.
text_pt: Dizei entre os gentios que o Senhor reina. O mundo também se firmará para que se não abale; julgará os povos com retidão.
text_el: οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸν κύριον μισεῖτε πονηρόν φυλάσσει κύριος τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ὁσίων αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς

text_en: Light is risen to the just , and joy to the right of heart.
text_la: Lux orta est justo, et rectis corde lætitia.
text_pt: Alegrem-se os céus, e regozije-se a terra; brame o mar e a sua plenitude.
text_el: φῶς ἀνέτειλεν τῷ δικαίῳ καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ εὐφροσύνη

text_en: Rejoice, you just , in the Lord : and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness .
text_la: Lætamini, justi, in Domino, et confitemini memoriæ sanctificationis ejus.
text_pt: Alegre-se o campo com tudo o que há nele; então se regozijarão todas as árvores do bosque,
text_el: εὐφράνθητε δίκαιοι ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῇ μνήμῃ τῆς ἁγιωσύνης αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sing to the Lord a new canticle: because he has done wonderful things. His right hand has wrought for him salvation , and his arm is holy .
text_la: Cantate Domino canticum novum, quia mirabilia fecit. Salvavit sibi dextera ejus, et brachium sanctum ejus.
text_pt: O SENHOR reina; regozije-se a terra; alegrem-se as muitas ilhas.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν ὅτι θαυμαστὰ ἐποίησεν κύριος ἔσωσεν αὐτῷ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ βραχίων ὁ ἅγιος αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord has made known his salvation : he has revealed his justice in the sight of the Gentiles .
text_la: Notum fecit Dominus salutare suum; in conspectu gentium revelavit justitiam suam.
text_pt: Nuvens e escuridão estão ao redor dele; justiça e juízo são a base do seu trono.
text_el: ἐγνώρισεν κύριος τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον τῶν ἐθνῶν ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel . All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God .
text_la: Recordatus est misericordiæ suæ, et veritatis suæ domui Israël. Viderunt omnes termini terræ salutare Dei nostri.
text_pt: Um fogo vai adiante dele, e abrasa os seus inimigos em redor.
text_el: ἐμνήσθη τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας αὐτοῦ τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Sing joyfully to God , all the earth; make melody, rejoice and sing.
text_la: Jubilate Deo, omnis terra; cantate, et exsultate, et psallite.
text_pt: Os seus relâmpagos iluminam o mundo; a terra viu e tremeu.
text_el: ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ᾄσατε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε καὶ ψάλατε

text_en: Sing praise to the Lord on the harp, on the harp, and with the voice of a psalm:
text_la: Psallite Domino in cithara; in cithara et voce psalmi;
text_pt: Os montes derretem como cera na presença do Senhor, na presença do Senhor de toda a terra.
text_el: ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν κιθάρᾳ ἐν κιθάρᾳ καὶ φωνῇ ψαλμοῦ

text_en: With long trumpets, and sound of cornet. Make a joyful noise before the Lord our king:
text_la: in tubis ductilibus, et voce tubæ corneæ. Jubilate in conspectu regis Domini:
text_pt: Os céus anunciam a sua justiça, e todos os povos vêem a sua glória.
text_el: ἐν σάλπιγξιν ἐλαταῖς καὶ φωνῇ σάλπιγγος κερατίνης ἀλαλάξατε ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως κυρίου

text_en: Let the sea be moved and the fullness thereof: the world and they that dwell therein.
text_la: moveatur mare, et plenitudo ejus; orbis terrarum, et qui habitant in eo.
text_pt: Confundidos sejam todos os que servem imagens de escultura, que se gloriam de ídolos; prostrai-vos diante dele todos os deuses.
text_el: σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: The rivers shall clap their hands, the mountains shall rejoice together
text_la: Flumina plaudent manu; simul montes exsultabunt
text_pt: Sião ouviu e se alegrou; e os filhos de Judá se alegraram por causa da tua justiça, ó Senhor.
text_el: ποταμοὶ κροτήσουσιν χειρὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό τὰ ὄρη ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: at the presence of the Lord : because he comes to judge the earth. He shall judge the world with justice , and the people with equity.
text_la: a conspectu Domini : quoniam venit judicare terram. Judicabit orbem terrarum in justitia, et populos in æquitate.
text_pt: Pois tu, Senhor, és o mais alto sobre toda a terra; tu és muito mais exaltado do que todos os deuses.
text_el: ὅτι ἥκει κρῖναι τὴν γῆν κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι

text_en: The Lord has reigned, let the people be angry : he that sits on the cherubims : let the earth be moved.
text_la: Dominus regnavit : irascantur populi; qui sedet super cherubim : moveatur terra.
text_pt: Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo, porque fez maravilhas; a sua destra e o seu braço santo lhe alcançaram a salvação.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν ὀργιζέσθωσαν λαοί ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβιν σαλευθήτω ἡ γῆ

text_en: The lord is great in Sion, and high above all people.
text_la: Dominus in Sion magnus, et excelsus super omnes populos.
text_pt: O Senhor fez notória a sua salvação, manifestou a sua justiça perante os olhos dos gentios.
text_el: κύριος ἐν Σιων μέγας καὶ ὑψηλός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λαούς

text_en: Let them give praise to your great name : for it is terrible and holy :
text_la: Confiteantur nomini tuo magno, quoniam terribile et sanctum est,
text_pt: Lembrou-se da sua benignidade e da sua verdade para com a casa de Israel; todas as extremidades da terra viram a salvação do nosso Deus.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου τῷ μεγάλῳ ὅτι φοβερὸν καὶ ἅγιόν ἐστιν

text_en: And the king's honour loves judgment. You have prepared directions: you have done judgment and justice in Jacob .
text_la: et honor regis judicium diligit. Tu parasti directiones; judicium et justitiam in Jacob tu fecisti.
text_pt: Exultai no Senhor toda a terra; exclamai e alegrai-vos de prazer, e cantai louvores.
text_el: καὶ τιμὴ βασιλέως κρίσιν ἀγαπᾷ σὺ ἡτοίμασας εὐθύτητας κρίσιν καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐν Ιακωβ σὺ ἐποίησας

text_en: Exalt the Lord our God , and adore his footstool , for it is holy .
text_la: Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, et adorate scabellum pedum ejus, quoniam sanctum est.
text_pt: Cantai louvores ao Senhor com a harpa; com a harpa e a voz do canto.
text_el: ὑψοῦτε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἅγιός ἐστιν

text_en: Moses and Aaron among his priests : and Samuel among them that call upon his name . They called upon the Lord , and he heard them:
text_la: Moyses et Aaron in sacerdotibus ejus, et Samuel inter eos qui invocant nomen ejus : invocabant Dominum, et ipse exaudiebat eos;
text_pt: Com trombetas e som de cornetas, exultai perante a face do Senhor, do Rei.
text_el: Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαμουηλ ἐν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπεκαλοῦντο τὸν κύριον καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῶν

text_en: He spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud . They kept his testimonies, and the commandment which he gave them.
text_la: in columna nubis loquebatur ad eos. Custodiebant testimonia ejus, et præceptum quod dedit illis.
text_pt: Brame o mar e a sua plenitude; o mundo, e os que nele habitam.
text_el: ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης ἐλάλει πρὸς αὐτούς ἐφύλασσον τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ προστάγματα ἃ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: You heard them, O Lord our God : you were a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.
text_la: Domine Deus noster, tu exaudiebas eos; Deus, tu propitius fuisti eis, et ulciscens in omnes adinventiones eorum.
text_pt: Os rios batam as palmas; regozijem-se também as montanhas,
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν σὺ ἐπήκουες αὐτῶν ὁ θεός σὺ εὐίλατος ἐγίνου αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκδικῶν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν

text_en: Exalt the Lord our God , and adore at his holy mountain: for the Lord our God is holy .
text_la: Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, et adorate in monte sancto ejus, quoniam sanctus Dominus Deus noster.
text_pt: Perante a face do Senhor, porque vem a julgar a terra; com justiça julgará o mundo, e o povo com eqüidade.
text_el: ὑψοῦτε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε εἰς ὄρος ἅγιον αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἅγιος κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: A psalm of praise.
text_la: Psalmus in confessione.
text_pt: O SENHOR reina; tremam os povos. Ele está assentado entre os querubins; comova-se a terra.
text_el: ψαλμὸς εἰς ἐξομολόγησιν ἀλαλάξατε τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: Sing joyfully to God , all the earth: serve the Lord with gladness . Come in before his presence with exceeding great joy .
text_la: Jubilate Deo, omnis terra; servite Domino in lætitia. Introite in conspectu ejus in exsultatione.
text_pt: O Senhor é grande em Sião, e mais alto do que todos os povos.
text_el: δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ εἰσέλθατε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει

text_en: Know that the Lord he is God : he made us, and not we ourselves. We are his people and the sheep of his pasture.
text_la: Scitote quoniam Dominus ipse est Deus; ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos : populus ejus, et oves pascuæ ejus.
text_pt: Louvem o teu nome, grande e tremendo, pois é santo.
text_el: γνῶτε ὅτι κύριος αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεός αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐχ ἡμεῖς λαὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Go into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him. Praise his name :
text_la: Introite portas ejus in confessione; atria ejus in hymnis : confitemini illi. Laudate nomen ejus,
text_pt: Também o poder do Rei ama o juízo; tu firmas a eqüidade, fazes juízo e justiça em Jacó.
text_el: εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὰς πύλας αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν ὕμνοις ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: For the Lord is sweet, his mercy endures for ever, and his truth to generation and generation .
text_la: quoniam suavis est Dominus, in æternum misericordia ejus, et usque in generationem et generationem veritas ejus.
text_pt: Exaltai ao Senhor nosso Deus, e prostrai-vos diante do escabelo de seus pés, pois é santo.
text_el: ὅτι χρηστὸς κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕως γενεᾶς καὶ γενεᾶς ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ

text_en: Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, O Lord : I will sing,
text_la: Misericordiam et judicium cantabo tibi, Domine; psallam,
text_pt: Celebrai com júbilo ao SENHOR, todas as terras.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ψαλμός ἔλεος καὶ κρίσιν ᾄσομαί σοι κύριε

text_en: and I will understand in the unspotted way, when you shall come to me. I walked in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house.
text_la: et intelligam in via immaculata : quando venies ad me? Perambulabam in innocentia cordis mei, in medio domus meæ.
text_pt: Servi ao Senhor com alegria; e entrai diante dele com canto.
text_el: ψαλῶ καὶ συνήσω ἐν ὁδῷ ἀμώμῳ πότε ἥξεις πρός με διεπορευόμην ἐν ἀκακίᾳ καρδίας μου ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου μου

text_en: I will not set before my eyes any unjust thing: I hated the workers of iniquities .
text_la: Non proponebam ante oculos meos rem injustam; facientes prævaricationes odivi; non adhæsit mihi
text_pt: Sabei que o Senhor é Deus; foi ele que nos fez, e não nós a nós mesmos; somos povo seu e ovelhas do seu pasto.
text_el: οὐ προεθέμην πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν μου πρᾶγμα παράνομον ποιοῦντας παραβάσεις ἐμίσησα

text_en: The perverse heart did not cleave to me: and the malignant, that turned aside from me, I would not know .
text_la: cor pravum; declinantem a me malignum non cognoscebam.
text_pt: Entrai pelas portas dele com gratidão, e em seus átrios com louvor; louvai-o, e bendizei o seu nome.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκολλήθη μοι καρδία σκαμβή ἐκκλίνοντος ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τοῦ πονηροῦ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον

text_en: The man that in private detracted his neighbour, him did I persecute. With him that had a proud eye, and an unsatiable heart, I would not eat.
text_la: Detrahentem secreto proximo suo, hunc persequebar : superbo oculo, et insatiabili corde, cum hoc non edebam.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor é bom, e eterna a sua misericórdia; e a sua verdade dura de geração em geração.
text_el: τὸν καταλαλοῦντα λάθρᾳ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ τοῦτον ἐξεδίωκον ὑπερηφάνῳ ὀφθαλμῷ καὶ ἀπλήστῳ καρδίᾳ τούτῳ οὐ συνήσθιον

text_en: My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, to sit with me: the man that walked in the perfect way, he served me.
text_la: Oculi mei ad fideles terræ, ut sedeant mecum; ambulans in via immaculata, hic mihi ministrabat.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπὶ τοὺς πιστοὺς τῆς γῆς τοῦ συγκαθῆσθαι αὐτοὺς μετ' ἐμοῦ πορευόμενος ἐν ὁδῷ ἀμώμῳ οὗτός μοι ἐλειτούργει

text_en: He that works pride shall not dwell in the midst of my house: he that speaks unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.
text_la: Non habitabit in medio domus meæ qui facit superbiam; qui loquitur iniqua non direxit in conspectu oculorum meorum.
text_el: οὐ κατῴκει ἐν μέσῳ τῆς οἰκίας μου ποιῶν ὑπερηφανίαν λαλῶν ἄδικα οὐ κατεύθυνεν ἐναντίον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου

text_en: In the morning I put to death all the wicked of the land: that I might cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the Lord .
text_la: In matutino interficiebam omnes peccatores terræ, ut disperderem de civitate Domini omnes operantes iniquitatem.
text_el: εἰς τὰς πρωίας ἀπέκτεννον πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς τῆς γῆς τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐκ πόλεως κυρίου πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: The prayer of the poor man , when he was anxious, and poured out his supplication before the Lord .
text_la: Oratio pauperis, cum anxius fuerit, et in conspectu Domini effuderit precem suam.
text_pt: Cantarei a misericórdia e o juízo; a ti, SENHOR, cantarei.
text_el: προσευχὴ τῷ πτωχῷ ὅταν ἀκηδιάσῃ καὶ ἐναντίον κυρίου ἐκχέῃ τὴν δέησιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hear, O Lord , my prayer : and let my cry come to you.
text_la: Domine, exaudi orationem meam, et clamor meus ad te veniat.
text_pt: Portar-me-ei com inteligência no caminho reto. Quando virás a mim? Andarei em minha casa com um coração sincero.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον κύριε τῆς προσευχῆς μου καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου πρὸς σὲ ἐλθάτω

text_en: Turn not away your face from me: in the day when I am in trouble, incline your ear to me. In what day soever I shall call upon you, hear me speedily.
text_la: Non avertas faciem tuam a me : in quacumque die tribulor, inclina ad me aurem tuam; in quacumque die invocavero te, velociter exaudi me.
text_pt: Não porei coisa má diante dos meus olhos. Odeio a obra daqueles que se desviam; não se me pegará a mim.
text_el: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ θλίβωμαι κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου πρός με ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε ταχὺ εἰσάκουσόν μου

text_en: For my days are vanished like smoke, and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.
text_la: Quia defecerunt sicut fumus dies mei, et ossa mea sicut cremium aruerunt.
text_pt: Um coração perverso se apartará de mim; não conhecerei o homem mau.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξέλιπον ὡσεὶ καπνὸς αἱ ἡμέραι μου καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ὡσεὶ φρύγιον συνεφρύγησαν

text_en: I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: because I forgot to eat my bread.
text_la: Percussus sum ut fœnum, et aruit cor meum, quia oblitus sum comedere panem meum.
text_pt: Aquele que murmura do seu próximo às escondidas, eu o destruirei; aquele que tem olhar altivo e coração soberbo, não suportarei.
text_el: ἐπλήγη ὡσεὶ χόρτος καὶ ἐξηράνθη ἡ καρδία μου ὅτι ἐπελαθόμην τοῦ φαγεῖν τὸν ἄρτον μου

text_en: Through the voice of my groaning, my bone has cleaved to my flesh.
text_la: A voce gemitus mei adhæsit os meum carni meæ.
text_pt: Os meus olhos estarão sobre os fiéis da terra, para que se assentem comigo; o que anda num caminho reto, esse me servirá.
text_el: ἀπὸ φωνῆς τοῦ στεναγμοῦ μου ἐκολλήθη τὸ ὀστοῦν μου τῇ σαρκί μου

text_en: I have become like to a pelican of the wilderness : I am like a night raven in the house.
text_la: Similis factus sum pellicano solitudinis; factus sum sicut nycticorax in domicilio.
text_pt: O que usa de engano não ficará dentro da minha casa; o que fala mentiras não estará firme perante os meus olhos.
text_el: ὡμοιώθην πελεκᾶνι ἐρημικῷ ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ νυκτικόραξ ἐν οἰκοπέδῳ

text_en: I have watched, and have become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.
text_la: Vigilavi, et factus sum sicut passer solitarius in tecto.
text_pt: Pela manhã destruirei todos os ímpios da terra, para desarraigar da cidade do Senhor todos os que praticam a iniqüidade.
text_el: ἠγρύπνησα καὶ ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ στρουθίον μονάζον ἐπὶ δώματι

text_en: All the day long my enemies reproached me: and they that praised me did swear against me.
text_la: Tota die exprobrabant mihi inimici mei, et qui laudabant me adversum me jurabant:
text_el: ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὠνείδιζόν με οἱ ἐχθροί μου καὶ οἱ ἐπαινοῦντές με κατ' ἐμοῦ ὤμνυον

text_en: For I ate ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
text_la: quia cinerem tamquam panem manducabam, et potum meum cum fletu miscebam,
text_el: ὅτι σποδὸν ὡσεὶ ἄρτον ἔφαγον καὶ τὸ πόμα μου μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ ἐκίρνων

text_en: Because of your anger and indignation: for having lifted me up you have thrown me down.
text_la: a facie iræ et indignationis tuæ : quia elevans allisisti me.
text_el: ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ὀργῆς σου καὶ τοῦ θυμοῦ σου ὅτι ἐπάρας κατέρραξάς με

text_en: My days have declined like a shadow, and I am withered like grass.
text_la: Dies mei sicut umbra declinaverunt, et ego sicut fœnum arui.
text_el: αἱ ἡμέραι μου ὡσεὶ σκιὰ ἐκλίθησαν καὶ ἐγὼ ὡσεὶ χόρτος ἐξηράνθην

text_en: But you, O Lord , endure for ever: and your memorial to all generations .
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, in æternum permanes, et memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένεις καὶ τὸ μνημόσυνόν σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν

text_en: You shall arise and have mercy on Sion: for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time has come.
text_la: Tu exsurgens misereberis Sion, quia tempus miserendi ejus, quia venit tempus:
text_el: σὺ ἀναστὰς οἰκτιρήσεις τὴν Σιων ὅτι καιρὸς τοῦ οἰκτιρῆσαι αὐτήν ὅτι ἥκει καιρός

text_en: For the stones thereof have pleased your servants: and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.
text_la: quoniam placuerunt servis tuis lapides ejus, et terræ ejus miserebuntur.
text_el: ὅτι εὐδόκησαν οἱ δοῦλοί σου τοὺς λίθους αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν χοῦν αὐτῆς οἰκτιρήσουσιν

text_en: All the Gentiles shall fear your name , O Lord , and all the kings of the earth your glory .
text_la: Et timebunt gentes nomen tuum, Domine, et omnes reges terræ gloriam tuam:
text_el: καὶ φοβηθήσονται τὰ ἔθνη τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου καὶ πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς τὴν δόξαν σου

text_en: For the Lord has built up Sion: and he shall be seen in his glory .
text_la: quia ædificavit Dominus Sion, et videbitur in gloria sua.
text_el: ὅτι οἰκοδομήσει κύριος τὴν Σιων καὶ ὀφθήσεται ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has had regard to the prayer of the humble : and he has not despised their petition.
text_la: Respexit in orationem humilium et non sprevit precem eorum.
text_el: ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν προσευχὴν τῶν ταπεινῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐξουδένωσεν τὴν δέησιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Let these things be written unto another generation : and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord :
text_la: Scribantur hæc in generatione altera, et populus qui creabitur laudabit Dominum.
text_el: γραφήτω αὕτη εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν καὶ λαὸς ὁ κτιζόμενος αἰνέσει τὸν κύριον

text_en: Because he has looked forth from his high sanctuary: from heaven the Lord has looked upon the earth.
text_la: Quia prospexit de excelso sancto suo; Dominus de cælo in terram aspexit:
text_el: ὅτι ἐξέκυψεν ἐξ ὕψους ἁγίου αὐτοῦ κύριος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐπέβλεψεν

text_en: That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: that he might release the children of the slain:
text_la: ut audiret gemitus compeditorum; ut solveret filios interemptorum:
text_el: τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι τὸν στεναγμὸν τῶν πεπεδημένων τοῦ λῦσαι τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν τεθανατωμένων

text_en: That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: and his praise in Jerusalem ;
text_la: ut annuntient in Sion nomen Domini, et laudem ejus in Jerusalem:
text_el: τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι ἐν Σιων τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου καὶ τὴν αἴνεσιν αὐτοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: when the people assemble together, and kings, to serve the Lord .
text_la: in conveniendo populos in unum, et reges, ut serviant Domino.
text_el: ἐν τῷ συναχθῆναι λαοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ βασιλείας τοῦ δουλεύειν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: He answered him in the way of his strength: Declare unto me the fewness of my days.
text_la: Respondit ei in via virtutis suæ : Paucitatem dierum meorum nuntia mihi:
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ἐν ὁδῷ ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ τὴν ὀλιγότητα τῶν ἡμερῶν μου ἀνάγγειλόν μοι

text_en: Call me not away in the midst of my days: your years are unto generation and generation .
text_la: ne revoces me in dimidio dierum meorum, in generationem et generationem anni tui.
text_el: μὴ ἀναγάγῃς με ἐν ἡμίσει ἡμερῶν μου ἐν γενεᾷ γενεῶν τὰ ἔτη σου

text_en: In the beginning, O Lord , you founded the earth: and the heavens are the works of your hands.
text_la: Initio tu, Domine, terram fundasti, et opera manuum tuarum sunt cæli.
text_el: κατ' ἀρχὰς σύ κύριε τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί

text_en: They shall perish but you remain: and all of them shall grow old like a garment: And as a vesture you shall change them, and they shall be changed.
text_la: Ipsi peribunt, tu autem permanes; et omnes sicut vestimentum veterascent. Et sicut opertorium mutabis eos, et mutabuntur;
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται σὺ δὲ διαμενεῖς καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἀλλάξεις αὐτούς καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται

text_en: But you are always the selfsame, and your years shall not fail.
text_la: tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non deficient.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν

text_en: The children of your servants shall continue and their seed shall be directed for ever.
text_la: Filii servorum tuorum habitabunt, et semen eorum in sæculum dirigetur.
text_el: οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν δούλων σου κατασκηνώσουσιν καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατευθυνθήσεται

text_en: Bless the Lord , O my soul : and let all that is within me bless his holy name .
text_la: Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et omnia quæ intra me sunt nomini sancto ejus.
text_pt: SENHOR, ouve a minha oração, e chegue a ti o meu clamor.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον καί πάντα τὰ ἐντός μου τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bless the Lord , O my soul , and never forget all he has done for you.
text_la: Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones ejus.
text_pt: Não escondas de mim o teu rosto no dia da minha angústia, inclina para mim os teus ouvidos; no dia em que eu clamar, ouve-me depressa.
text_el: εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον καὶ μὴ ἐπιλανθάνου πάσας τὰς ἀνταποδόσεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who forgives all your iniquities : who heals all your diseases.
text_la: Qui propitiatur omnibus iniquitatibus tuis; qui sanat omnes infirmitates tuas:
text_pt: Porque os meus dias se consomem como a fumaça, e os meus ossos ardem como lenha.
text_el: τὸν εὐιλατεύοντα πάσαις ταῖς ἀνομίαις σου τὸν ἰώμενον πάσας τὰς νόσους σου

text_en: Who redeems your life from destruction: who crowns you with mercy and compassion.
text_la: qui redimit de interitu vitam tuam; qui coronat te in misericordia et miserationibus:
text_pt: O meu coração está ferido e seco como a erva, por isso me esqueço de comer o meu pão.
text_el: τὸν λυτρούμενον ἐκ φθορᾶς τὴν ζωήν σου τὸν στεφανοῦντά σε ἐν ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς

text_en: Who satisfies your desire with good things: your youth shall be renewed like the eagle's.
text_la: qui replet in bonis desiderium tuum; renovabitur ut aquilæ juventus tua:
text_pt: Por causa da voz do meu gemido os meus ossos se apegam à minha pele.
text_el: τὸν ἐμπιπλῶντα ἐν ἀγαθοῖς τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν σου ἀνακαινισθήσεται ὡς ἀετοῦ ἡ νεότης σου

text_en: The Lord does mercies, and judgment for all that suffer wrong.
text_la: faciens misericordias Dominus, et judicium omnibus injuriam patientibus.
text_pt: Sou semelhante ao pelicano no deserto; sou como um mocho nas solidões.
text_el: ποιῶν ἐλεημοσύνας ὁ κύριος καὶ κρίμα πᾶσι τοῖς ἀδικουμένοις

text_en: He has made his ways known to Moses : his wills to the children of Israel .
text_la: Notas fecit vias suas Moysi; filiis Israël voluntates suas.
text_pt: Vigio, sou como o pardal solitário no telhado.
text_el: ἐγνώρισεν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ τῷ Μωυσῇ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord is compassionate and merciful: longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.
text_la: Miserator et misericors Dominus : longanimis, et multum misericors.
text_pt: Os meus inimigos me afrontam todo o dia; os que se enfurecem contra mim têm jurado contra mim.
text_el: οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων ὁ κύριος μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος

text_en: He will not always be angry : nor will he threaten for ever.
text_la: Non in perpetuum irascetur, neque in æternum comminabitur.
text_pt: Pois tenho comido cinza como pão, e misturado com lágrimas a minha bebida,
text_el: οὐκ εἰς τέλος ὀργισθήσεται οὐδὲ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μηνιεῖ

text_en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins : nor rewarded us according to our iniquities .
text_la: Non secundum peccata nostra fecit nobis, neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuit nobis.
text_pt: Por causa da tua ira e da tua indignação, pois tu me levantaste e me arremessaste.
text_el: οὐ κατὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν ἐποίησεν ἡμῖν οὐδὲ κατὰ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν ἀνταπέδωκεν ἡμῖν

text_en: For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: he has strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.
text_la: Quoniam secundum altitudinem cæli a terra, corroboravit misericordiam suam super timentes se;
text_pt: Os meus dias são como a sombra que declina, e como a erva me vou secando.
text_el: ὅτι κατὰ τὸ ὕψος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἐκραταίωσεν κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτόν

text_en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our iniquities from us.
text_la: quantum distat ortus ab occidente, longe fecit a nobis iniquitates nostras.
text_pt: Mas tu, Senhor, permanecerás para sempre, a tua memória de geração em geração.
text_el: καθ' ὅσον ἀπέχουσιν ἀνατολαὶ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν ἐμάκρυνεν ἀφ' ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν

text_en: As a father has compassion on his children, so has the Lord compassion on them that fear him:
text_la: Quomodo miseretur pater filiorum, misertus est Dominus timentibus se.
text_pt: Tu te levantarás e terás piedade de Sião; pois o tempo de te compadeceres dela, o tempo determinado, já chegou.
text_el: καθὼς οἰκτίρει πατὴρ υἱούς οἰκτίρησεν κύριος τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτόν

text_en: For he knows our frame. He remembers that we are dust:
text_la: Quoniam ipse cognovit figmentum nostrum; recordatus est quoniam pulvis sumus.
text_pt: Porque os teus servos têm prazer nas suas pedras, e se compadecem do seu pó.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτὸς ἔγνω τὸ πλάσμα ἡμῶν μνήσθητι ὅτι χοῦς ἐσμεν

text_en: Man's days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.
text_la: Homo, sicut fœnum dies ejus; tamquam flos agri, sic efflorebit:
text_pt: Então os gentios temerão o nome do Senhor, e todos os reis da terra a tua glória.
text_el: ἄνθρωπος ὡσεὶ χόρτος αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ ἄνθος τοῦ ἀγροῦ οὕτως ἐξανθήσει

text_en: For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: and he shall know his place no more.
text_la: quoniam spiritus pertransibit in illo, et non subsistet, et non cognoscet amplius locum suum.
text_pt: Quando o Senhor edificar a Sião, aparecerá na sua glória.
text_el: ὅτι πνεῦμα διῆλθεν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξει καὶ οὐκ ἐπιγνώσεται ἔτι τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity and unto eternity upon them that fear him: And his justice unto children's children,
text_la: Misericordia autem Domini ab æterno, et usque in æternum super timentes eum. Et justitia illius in filios filiorum,
text_pt: Ele atenderá à oração do desamparado, e não desprezará a sua oração.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἔλεος τοῦ κυρίου ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐπὶ τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτόν καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ υἱοὺς υἱῶν

text_en: to such as keep his covenant, And are mindful of his commandments to do them.
text_la: his qui servant testamentum ejus, et memores sunt mandatorum ipsius ad faciendum ea.
text_pt: Isto se escreverá para a geração futura; e o povo que se criar louvará ao Senhor.
text_el: τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ καὶ μεμνημένοις τῶν ἐντολῶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτάς

text_en: The lord has prepared his throne in heaven : and his kingdom shall rule over all.
text_la: Dominus in cælo paravit sedem suam, et regnum ipsius omnibus dominabitur.
text_pt: Pois olhou desde o alto do seu santuário, desde os céus o Senhor contemplou a terra,
text_el: κύριος ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἡτοίμασεν τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ πάντων δεσπόζει

text_en: Bless the Lord , all you his angels : you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.
text_la: Benedicite Domino, omnes angeli ejus : potentes virtute, facientes verbum illius, ad audiendam vocem sermonum ejus.
text_pt: Para ouvir o gemido dos presos, para soltar os sentenciados à morte;
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ δυνατοὶ ἰσχύι ποιοῦντες τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι τῆς φωνῆς τῶν λόγων αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bless the Lord , all you his hosts : you ministers of his that do his will.
text_la: Benedicite Domino, omnes virtutes ejus; ministri ejus, qui facitis voluntatem ejus.
text_pt: Para anunciarem o nome do Senhor em Sião, e o seu louvor em Jerusalém,
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ λειτουργοὶ αὐτοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bless the Lord , all his works: in every place of his dominion, O my soul , bless the Lord .
text_la: Benedicite Domino, omnia opera ejus : in omni loco dominationis ejus, benedic, anima mea, Domino.
text_pt: Quando os povos se ajuntarem, e os reinos, para servirem ao Senhor.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ τῆς δεσποτείας αὐτοῦ εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον

text_en: Bless the Lord , O my soul : O Lord my God , you are exceedingly great. You have put on praise and beauty:
text_la: Benedic, anima mea, Domino : Domine Deus meus, magnificatus es vehementer. Confessionem et decorem induisti,
text_pt: Bendize, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR, e tudo o que há em mim bendiga o seu santo nome.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐμεγαλύνθης σφόδρα ἐξομολόγησιν καὶ εὐπρέπειαν ἐνεδύσω

text_en: And are clothed with light as with a garment. Who stretches out the heaven like a pavilion:
text_la: amictus lumine sicut vestimento. Extendens cælum sicut pellem,
text_pt: Bendize, ó minha alma, ao Senhor, e não te esqueças de nenhum de seus benefícios.
text_el: ἀναβαλλόμενος φῶς ὡς ἱμάτιον ἐκτείνων τὸν οὐρανὸν ὡσεὶ δέρριν

text_en: Who covers the higher rooms thereof with water. Who make the clouds your chariot: who walks upon the wings of the winds.
text_la: qui tegis aquis superiora ejus : qui ponis nubem ascensum tuum; qui ambulas super pennas ventorum:
text_pt: Ele é o que perdoa todas as tuas iniqüidades, que sara todas as tuas enfermidades,
text_el: ὁ στεγάζων ἐν ὕδασιν τὰ ὑπερῷα αὐτοῦ ὁ τιθεὶς νέφη τὴν ἐπίβασιν αὐτοῦ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀνέμων

text_en: Who make your angels spirits: and your ministers a burning fire.
text_la: qui facis angelos tuos spiritus, et ministros tuos ignem urentem.
text_pt: Que redime a tua vida da perdição; que te coroa de benignidade e de misericórdia,
text_el: ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πῦρ φλέγον

text_en: Who have founded the earth upon its own bases: it shall not be moved for ever and ever.
text_la: Qui fundasti terram super stabilitatem suam : non inclinabitur in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Que farta a tua boca de bens, de sorte que a tua mocidade se renova como a da águia.
text_el: ἐθεμελίωσεν τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀσφάλειαν αὐτῆς οὐ κλιθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: The deep like a garment is its clothing: above the mountains shall the waters stand.
text_la: Abyssus sicut vestimentum amictus ejus; super montes stabunt aquæ.
text_pt: O Senhor faz justiça e juízo a todos os oprimidos.
text_el: ἄβυσσος ὡς ἱμάτιον τὸ περιβόλαιον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων στήσονται ὕδατα

text_en: At your rebuke they shall flee: at the voice of your thunder they shall fear.
text_la: Ab increpatione tua fugient; a voce tonitrui tui formidabunt.
text_pt: Fez conhecidos os seus caminhos a Moisés, e os seus feitos aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου φεύξονται ἀπὸ φωνῆς βροντῆς σου δειλιάσουσιν

text_en: The mountains ascend, and the plains descend into the place which you have founded for them.
text_la: Ascendunt montes, et descendunt campi, in locum quem fundasti eis.
text_pt: Misericordioso e piedoso é o Senhor; longânimo e grande em benignidade.
text_el: ἀναβαίνουσιν ὄρη καὶ καταβαίνουσιν πεδία εἰς τόπον ὃν ἐθεμελίωσας αὐτοῖς

text_en: You have set a bound which they shall not pass over; neither shall they return to cover the earth.
text_la: Terminum posuisti quem non transgredientur, neque convertentur operire terram.
text_pt: Não reprovará perpetuamente, nem para sempre reterá a sua ira.
text_el: ὅριον ἔθου ὃ οὐ παρελεύσονται οὐδὲ ἐπιστρέψουσιν καλύψαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: You send forth springs in the vales: between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.
text_la: Qui emittis fontes in convallibus; inter medium montium pertransibunt aquæ.
text_pt: Não nos tratou segundo os nossos pecados, nem nos recompensou segundo as nossas iniqüidades.
text_el: ὁ ἐξαποστέλλων πηγὰς ἐν φάραγξιν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὀρέων διελεύσονται ὕδατα

text_en: All the beasts of the field shall drink: the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.
text_la: Potabunt omnes bestiæ agri; expectabunt onagri in siti sua.
text_pt: Pois assim como o céu está elevado acima da terra, assim é grande a sua misericórdia para com os que o temem.
text_el: ποτιοῦσιν πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ προσδέξονται ὄναγροι εἰς δίψαν αὐτῶν

text_en: Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.
text_la: Super ea volucres cæli habitabunt; de medio petrarum dabunt voces.
text_pt: Assim como está longe o oriente do ocidente, assim afasta de nós as nossas transgressões.
text_el: ἐπ' αὐτὰ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσει ἐκ μέσου τῶν πετρῶν δώσουσιν φωνήν

text_en: You water the hills from your upper rooms: the earth shall be filled with the fruit of your works:
text_la: Rigans montes de superioribus suis; de fructu operum tuorum satiabitur terra:
text_pt: Assim como um pai se compadece de seus filhos, assim o Senhor se compadece daqueles que o temem.
text_el: ποτίζων ὄρη ἐκ τῶν ὑπερῴων αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ καρποῦ τῶν ἔργων σου χορτασθήσεται ἡ γῆ

text_en: Bringing forth grass for cattle, and herb for the service of men . That you may bring bread out of the earth:
text_la: producens fœnum jumentis, et herbam servituti hominum, ut educas panem de terra,
text_pt: Pois ele conhece a nossa estrutura; lembra-se de que somos pó.
text_el: ἐξανατέλλων χόρτον τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ χλόην τῇ δουλείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν ἄρτον ἐκ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And that wine may cheer the heart of man . That he may make the face cheerful with oil: and that bread may strengthen man's heart.
text_la: et vinum lætificet cor hominis : ut exhilaret faciem in oleo, et panis cor hominis confirmet.
text_pt: Quanto ao homem, os seus dias são como a erva, como a flor do campo assim floresce.
text_el: καὶ οἶνος εὐφραίνει καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου τοῦ ἱλαρῦναι πρόσωπον ἐν ἐλαίῳ καὶ ἄρτος καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου στηρίζει

text_en: The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which he has planted:
text_la: Saturabuntur ligna campi, et cedri Libani quas plantavit:
text_pt: Passando por ela o vento, logo se vai, e o seu lugar não será mais conhecido.
text_el: χορτασθήσεται τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου αἱ κέδροι τοῦ Λιβάνου ἃς ἐφύτευσεν

text_en: There the sparrows shall make their nests. The highest of them is the house of the heron.
text_la: illic passeres nidificabunt : herodii domus dux est eorum.
text_pt: Mas a misericórdia do Senhor é desde a eternidade e até a eternidade sobre aqueles que o temem, e a sua justiça sobre os filhos dos filhos;
text_el: ἐκεῖ στρουθία ἐννοσσεύσουσιν τοῦ ἐρωδιοῦ ἡ οἰκία ἡγεῖται αὐτῶν

text_en: The high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.
text_la: Montes excelsi cervis; petra refugium herinaciis.
text_pt: Sobre aqueles que guardam a sua aliança, e sobre os que se lembram dos seus mandamentos para os cumprir.
text_el: ὄρη τὰ ὑψηλὰ ταῖς ἐλάφοις πέτρα καταφυγὴ τοῖς χοιρογρυλλίοις

text_en: He has made the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.
text_la: Fecit lunam in tempora; sol cognovit occasum suum.
text_pt: O Senhor tem estabelecido o seu trono nos céus, e o seu reino domina sobre tudo.
text_el: ἐποίησεν σελήνην εἰς καιρούς ὁ ἥλιος ἔγνω τὴν δύσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: You have appointed darkness, and it is night: in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about:
text_la: Posuisti tenebras, et facta est nox; in ipsa pertransibunt omnes bestiæ silvæ:
text_pt: Bendizei ao Senhor, todos os seus anjos, vós que excedeis em força, que guardais os seus mandamentos, obedecendo à voz da sua palavra.
text_el: ἔθου σκότος καὶ ἐγένετο νύξ ἐν αὐτῇ διελεύσονται πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ δρυμοῦ

text_en: The young lions roaring after their prey, and seeking their meat from God .
text_la: catuli leonum rugientes ut rapiant, et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
text_pt: Bendizei ao Senhor, todos os seus exércitos, vós ministros seus, que executais o seu beneplácito.
text_el: σκύμνοι ὠρυόμενοι ἁρπάσαι καὶ ζητῆσαι παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ βρῶσιν αὐτοῖς

text_en: The sun arises, and they are gathered together: and they shall lie down in their dens.
text_la: Ortus est sol, et congregati sunt, et in cubilibus suis collocabuntur.
text_pt: Bendizei ao Senhor, todas as suas obras, em todos os lugares do seu domínio; bendize, ó minha alma, ao Senhor.
text_el: ἀνέτειλεν ὁ ἥλιος καὶ συνήχθησαν καὶ ἐν ταῖς μάνδραις αὐτῶν κοιτασθήσονται

text_en: Man shall go forth to his work, and to his labour until the evening.
text_la: Exibit homo ad opus suum, et ad operationem suam usque ad vesperum.
text_el: ἐξελεύσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ἐργασίαν αὐτοῦ ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: How great are your works, O Lord ? You have made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with your riches.
text_la: Quam magnificata sunt opera tua, Domine! omnia in sapientia fecisti; impleta est terra possessione tua.
text_el: ὡς ἐμεγαλύνθη τὰ ἔργα σου κύριε πάντα ἐν σοφίᾳ ἐποίησας ἐπληρώθη ἡ γῆ τῆς κτήσεώς σου

text_en: So is this great sea, which stretches wide its arms: there are creeping things without number: Creatures little and great.
text_la: Hoc mare magnum et spatiosum manibus; illic reptilia quorum non est numerus : animalia pusilla cum magnis.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη καὶ εὐρύχωρος ἐκεῖ ἑρπετά ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός ζῷα μικρὰ μετὰ μεγάλων

text_en: There the ships shall go. This sea dragon which you have formed to play therein.
text_la: Illic naves pertransibunt; draco iste quem formasti ad illudendum ei.
text_el: ἐκεῖ πλοῖα διαπορεύονται δράκων οὗτος ὃν ἔπλασας ἐμπαίζειν αὐτῷ

text_en: All expect of you that you give them food in season.
text_la: Omnia a te expectant ut des illis escam in tempore.
text_el: πάντα πρὸς σὲ προσδοκῶσιν δοῦναι τὴν τροφὴν αὐτοῖς εὔκαιρον

text_en: What you give to them they shall gather up: when you open your hand, they shall all be filled with good .
text_la: Dante te illis, colligent; aperiente te manum tuam, omnia implebuntur bonitate.
text_el: δόντος σου αὐτοῖς συλλέξουσιν ἀνοίξαντος δέ σου τὴν χεῖρα τὰ σύμπαντα πλησθήσονται χρηστότητος

text_en: But if you turn away your face, they shall be troubled: you shall take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.
text_la: Avertente autem te faciem, turbabuntur; auferes spiritum eorum, et deficient, et in pulverem suum revertentur.
text_el: ἀποστρέψαντος δέ σου τὸ πρόσωπον ταραχθήσονται ἀντανελεῖς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκλείψουσιν καὶ εἰς τὸν χοῦν αὐτῶν ἐπιστρέψουσιν

text_en: You shall send forth your spirit, and they shall be created : and you shall renew the face of the earth.
text_la: Emittes spiritum tuum, et creabuntur, et renovabis faciem terræ.
text_el: ἐξαποστελεῖς τὸ πνεῦμά σου καὶ κτισθήσονται καὶ ἀνακαινιεῖς τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς

text_en: May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.
text_la: Sit gloria Domini in sæculum; lætabitur Dominus in operibus suis.
text_el: ἤτω ἡ δόξα κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εὐφρανθήσεται κύριος ἐπὶ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: He looks upon the earth, and makes it tremble: he troubles the mountains, and they smoke.
text_la: Qui respicit terram, et facit eam tremere; qui tangit montes, et fumigant.
text_el: ὁ ἐπιβλέπων ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ποιῶν αὐτὴν τρέμειν ὁ ἁπτόμενος τῶν ὀρέων καὶ καπνίζονται

text_en: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
text_la: Cantabo Domino in vita mea; psallam Deo meo quamdiu sum.
text_el: ᾄσω τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ μου ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἕως ὑπάρχω

text_en: Let my speech be acceptable to him: but I will take delight in the Lord .
text_la: Jucundum sit ei eloquium meum; ego vero delectabor in Domino.
text_el: ἡδυνθείη αὐτῷ ἡ διαλογή μου ἐγὼ δὲ εὐφρανθήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust , so that they be no more: O my soul , bless the Lord .
text_la: Deficiant peccatores a terra, et iniqui, ita ut non sint. Benedic, anima mea, Domino.
text_el: ἐκλίποισαν ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἄνομοι ὥστε μὴ ὑπάρχειν αὐτούς εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον

text_en: Give glory to the Lord , and call upon his name : declare his deeds among the Gentiles .
text_la: Confitemini Domino, et invocate nomen ejus; annuntiate inter gentes opera ejus.
text_pt: Bendize, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR! SENHOR Deus meu, tu és magnificentíssimo; estás vestido de glória e de majestade.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἀπαγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: relate all his wondrous works.
text_la: Cantate ei, et psallite ei; narrate omnia mirabilia ejus.
text_pt: Ele se cobre de luz como de um vestido, estende os céus como uma cortina.
text_el: ᾄσατε αὐτῷ καὶ ψάλατε αὐτῷ διηγήσασθε πάντα τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ

text_en: Glory in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord .
text_la: Laudamini in nomine sancto ejus; lætetur cor quærentium Dominum.
text_pt: Põe nas águas as vigas das suas câmaras; faz das nuvens o seu carro, anda sobre as asas do vento.
text_el: ἐπαινεῖσθε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ εὐφρανθήτω καρδία ζητούντων τὸν κύριον

text_en: Seek the lord, and be strengthened: seek his face evermore.
text_la: Quærite Dominum, et confirmamini; quærite faciem ejus semper.
text_pt: Faz dos seus anjos espíritos, dos seus ministros um fogo abrasador.
text_el: ζητήσατε τὸν κύριον καὶ κραταιώθητε ζητήσατε τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός

text_en: Remember his marvellous works which he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.
text_la: Mementote mirabilium ejus quæ fecit; prodigia ejus, et judicia oris ejus:
text_pt: Lançou os fundamentos da terra; ela não vacilará em tempo algum.
text_el: μνήσθητε τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐποίησεν τὰ τέρατα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ κρίματα τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: O you seed of Abraham his servant; you sons of Jacob his chosen.
text_la: semen Abraham servi ejus; filii Jacob electi ejus.
text_pt: Tu a cobriste com o abismo, como com um vestido; as águas estavam sobre os montes.
text_el: σπέρμα Αβρααμ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ ἐκλεκτοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He is the Lord our God : his judgments are in all the earth.
text_la: Ipse Dominus Deus noster; in universa terra judicia ejus.
text_pt: À tua repreensão fugiram; à voz do teu trovão se apressaram.
text_el: αὐτὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has remembered his covenant for ever: the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
text_la: Memor fuit in sæculum testamenti sui; verbi quod mandavit in mille generationes:
text_pt: Subiram aos montes, desceram aos vales, até ao lugar que para elas fundaste.
text_el: ἐμνήσθη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διαθήκης αὐτοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐνετείλατο εἰς χιλίας γενεάς

text_en: Which he made to Abraham ; and his oath to Isaac :
text_la: quod disposuit ad Abraham, et juramenti sui ad Isaac:
text_pt: Termo lhes puseste, que não ultrapassarão, para que não tornem mais a cobrir a terra.
text_el: ὃν διέθετο τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ τοῦ ὅρκου αὐτοῦ τῷ Ισαακ

text_en: And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting testament:
text_la: et statuit illud Jacob in præceptum, et Israël in testamentum æternum,
text_pt: Tu, que fazes sair as fontes nos vales, as quais correm entre os montes.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὴν τῷ Ιακωβ εἰς πρόσταγμα καὶ τῷ Ισραηλ διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: Saying: To you will I give the land of Chanaan , the lot of your inheritance.
text_la: dicens : Tibi dabo terram Chanaan, funiculum hæreditatis vestræ:
text_pt: Dão de beber a todo o animal do campo; os jumentos monteses matam a sua sede.
text_el: λέγων σοὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν Χανααν σχοίνισμα κληρονομίας ὑμῶν

text_en: When they were but a small number: yea very few, and sojourners therein:
text_la: cum essent numero brevi, paucissimi, et incolæ ejus.
text_pt: Junto delas as aves do céu terão a sua habitação, cantando entre os ramos.
text_el: ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἀριθμῷ βραχεῖς ὀλιγοστοὺς καὶ παροίκους ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And they passed from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.
text_la: Et pertransierunt de gente in gentem, et de regno ad populum alterum.
text_pt: Ele rega os montes desde as suas câmaras; a terra farta-se do fruto das suas obras.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθον ἐξ ἔθνους εἰς ἔθνος ἐκ βασιλείας εἰς λαὸν ἕτερον

text_en: He suffered no man to hurt them: and he reproved kings for their sakes.
text_la: Non reliquit hominem nocere eis : et corripuit pro eis reges.
text_pt: Faz crescer a erva para o gado, e a verdura para o serviço do homem, para fazer sair da terra o pão,
text_el: οὐκ ἀφῆκεν ἄνθρωπον ἀδικῆσαι αὐτοὺς καὶ ἤλεγξεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν βασιλεῖς

text_en: Touch not my anointed: and do no evil to my prophets .
text_la: Nolite tangere christos meos, et in prophetis meis nolite malignari.
text_pt: E o vinho que alegra o coração do homem, e o azeite que faz reluzir o seu rosto, e o pão que fortalece o coração do homem.
text_el: μὴ ἅπτεσθε τῶν χριστῶν μου καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις μου μὴ πονηρεύεσθε

text_en: And he called a famine upon the land: and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.
text_la: Et vocavit famem super terram, et omne firmamentum panis contrivit.
text_pt: As árvores do Senhor fartam-se de seiva, os cedros do Líbano que ele plantou,
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν λιμὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν πᾶν στήριγμα ἄρτου συνέτριψεν

text_en: He sent a man before them: Joseph , who was sold for a slave.
text_la: Misit ante eos virum : in servum venundatus est, Joseph.
text_pt: Onde as aves se aninham; quanto à cegonha, a sua casa é nas faias.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπον εἰς δοῦλον ἐπράθη Ιωσηφ

text_en: They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul ,
text_la: Humiliaverunt in compedibus pedes ejus; ferrum pertransiit animam ejus:
text_pt: Os altos montes são para as cabras monteses, e os rochedos são refúgio para os coelhos.
text_el: ἐταπείνωσαν ἐν πέδαις τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ σίδηρον διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: until his word came. The word of the Lord inflamed him.
text_la: donec veniret verbum ejus. Eloquium Domini inflammavit eum.
text_pt: Designou a lua para as estações; o sol conhece o seu ocaso.
text_el: μέχρι τοῦ ἐλθεῖν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τὸ λόγιον κυρίου ἐπύρωσεν αὐτόν

text_en: The king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.
text_la: Misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populorum, et dimisit eum.
text_pt: Ordenas a escuridão, e faz-se noite, na qual saem todos os animais da selva.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν βασιλεὺς καὶ ἔλυσεν αὐτόν ἄρχων λαῶν καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτόν

text_en: He made him master of his house, and ruler of all his possession.
text_la: Constituit eum dominum domus suæ, et principem omnis possessionis suæ:
text_pt: Os leõezinhos bramam pela presa, e de Deus buscam o seu sustento.
text_el: κατέστησεν αὐτὸν κύριον τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἄρχοντα πάσης τῆς κτήσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: That he might instruct his princes as himself, and teach his ancients wisdom.
text_la: ut erudiret principes ejus sicut semetipsum, et senes ejus prudentiam doceret.
text_pt: Nasce o sol e logo se acolhem, e se deitam nos seus covis.
text_el: τοῦ παιδεῦσαι τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτοῦ ὡς ἑαυτὸν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους αὐτοῦ σοφίσαι

text_en: And Israel went into Egypt : and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham .
text_la: Et intravit Israël in Ægyptum, et Jacob accola fuit in terra Cham.
text_pt: Então sai o homem à sua obra e ao seu trabalho, até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ισραηλ εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ Ιακωβ παρῴκησεν ἐν γῇ Χαμ

text_en: And he increased his people exceedingly: and strengthened them over their enemies.
text_la: Et auxit populum suum vehementer, et firmavit eum super inimicos ejus.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, quão variadas são as tuas obras! Todas as coisas fizeste com sabedoria; cheia está a terra das tuas riquezas.
text_el: καὶ ηὔξησεν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ σφόδρα καὶ ἐκραταίωσεν αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: He turned their heart to hate his people: and to deal deceitfully with his servants.
text_la: Convertit cor eorum, ut odirent populum ejus, et dolum facerent in servos ejus.
text_pt: Assim é este mar grande e muito espaçoso, onde há seres sem número, animais pequenos e grandes.
text_el: μετέστρεψεν τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν τοῦ μισῆσαι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ τοῦ δολιοῦσθαι ἐν τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: He sent Moses his servant: Aaron the man whom he had chosen.
text_la: Misit Moysen servum suum; Aaron quem elegit ipsum.
text_pt: Ali andam os navios; e o leviatã que formaste para nele folgar.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν Μωυσῆν τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ Ααρων ὃν ἐξελέξατο αὐτόν

text_en: He gave them power to show them signs, and his wonders in the land of Cham .
text_la: Posuit in eis verba signorum suorum, et prodigiorum in terra Cham.
text_pt: Todos esperam de ti, que lhes dês o seu sustento em tempo oportuno.
text_el: ἔθετο ἐν αὐτοῖς τοὺς λόγους τῶν σημείων αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν τεράτων ἐν γῇ Χαμ

text_en: He sent darkness, and made it obscure: and grieved not his words.
text_la: Misit tenebras, et obscuravit; et non exacerbavit sermones suos.
text_pt: Dando-lho tu, eles o recolhem; abres a tua mão, e se enchem de bens.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν σκότος καὶ ἐσκότασεν καὶ παρεπίκραναν τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ

text_en: He turned their waters into blood, and destroyed their fish.
text_la: Convertit aquas eorum in sanguinem, et occidit pisces eorum.
text_pt: Escondes o teu rosto, e ficam perturbados; se lhes tiras o fôlego, morrem, e voltam para o seu pó.
text_el: μετέστρεψεν τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῶν εἰς αἷμα καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν τοὺς ἰχθύας αὐτῶν

text_en: Their land brought forth frogs, in the inner chambers of their kings.
text_la: Edidit terra eorum ranas in penetralibus regum ipsorum.
text_pt: Envias o teu Espírito, e são criados, e assim renovas a face da terra.
text_el: ἐξῆρψεν ἡ γῆ αὐτῶν βατράχους ἐν τοῖς ταμιείοις τῶν βασιλέων αὐτῶν

text_en: He spoke, and there came divers sorts of flies and sciniphs in all their coasts.
text_la: Dixit, et venit cœnomyia et ciniphes in omnibus finibus eorum.
text_pt: A glória do Senhor durará para sempre; o Senhor se alegrará nas suas obras.
text_el: εἶπεν καὶ ἦλθεν κυνόμυια καὶ σκνῖπες ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν

text_en: He gave them hail for rain, a burning fire in the land.
text_la: Posuit pluvias eorum grandinem : ignem comburentem in terra ipsorum.
text_pt: Olhando ele para a terra, ela treme; tocando nos montes, logo fumegam.
text_el: ἔθετο τὰς βροχὰς αὐτῶν χάλαζαν πῦρ καταφλέγον ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: And he destroyed their vineyards and their fig trees: and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.
text_la: Et percussit vineas eorum, et ficulneas eorum, et contrivit lignum finium eorum.
text_pt: Cantarei ao Senhor enquanto eu viver; cantarei louvores ao meu Deus, enquanto eu tiver existência.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὰς ἀμπέλους αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς συκᾶς αὐτῶν καὶ συνέτριψεν πᾶν ξύλον ὁρίου αὐτῶν

text_en: He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, of which there was no number.
text_la: Dixit, et venit locusta, et bruchus cujus non erat numerus:
text_pt: A minha meditação acerca dele será suave; eu me alegrarei no Senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν καὶ ἦλθεν ἀκρὶς καὶ βροῦχος οὗ οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμός

text_en: And they devoured all the grass in their land, and consumed all the fruit of their ground.
text_la: et comedit omne fœnum in terra eorum, et comedit omnem fructum terræ eorum.
text_pt: Desapareçam da terra os pecadores, e os ímpios não sejam mais. Bendize, ó minha alma, ao Senhor. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κατέφαγεν πάντα τὸν χόρτον ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν καὶ κατέφαγεν τὸν καρπὸν τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: And he slew all the firstborn in their land: the firstfruits of all their labour.
text_la: Et percussit omne primogenitum in terra eorum, primitias omnis laboris eorum.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν ἀπαρχὴν παντὸς πόνου αὐτῶν

text_en: And he brought them out with silver and gold: and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.
text_la: Et eduxit eos cum argento et auro, et non erat in tribubus eorum infirmus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀργυρίῳ καὶ χρυσίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν ἀσθενῶν

text_en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them lay upon them.
text_la: Lætata est Ægyptus in profectione eorum, quia incubuit timor eorum super eos.
text_el: εὐφράνθη Αἴγυπτος ἐν τῇ ἐξόδῳ αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐπέπεσεν ὁ φόβος αὐτῶν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: He spread a cloud for their protection, and fire to give them light in the night.
text_la: Expandit nubem in protectionem eorum, et ignem ut luceret eis per noctem.
text_el: διεπέτασεν νεφέλην εἰς σκέπην αὐτοῖς καὶ πῦρ τοῦ φωτίσαι αὐτοῖς τὴν νύκτα

text_en: They asked, and the quail came: and he filled them with the bread of heaven .
text_la: Petierunt, et venit coturnix, et pane cæli saturavit eos.
text_el: ᾔτησαν καὶ ἦλθεν ὀρτυγομήτρα καὶ ἄρτον οὐρανοῦ ἐνέπλησεν αὐτούς

text_en: He opened the rock, and waters flowed: rivers ran down in the dry land.
text_la: Dirupit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ : abierunt in sicco flumina.
text_el: διέρρηξεν πέτραν καὶ ἐρρύησαν ὕδατα ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν ἀνύδροις ποταμοί

text_en: Because he remembered his holy word, which he had spoken to his servant Abraham .
text_la: Quoniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui, quod habuit ad Abraham puerum suum.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμνήσθη τοῦ λόγου τοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ τοῦ πρὸς Αβρααμ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness .
text_la: Et eduxit populum suum in exsultatione, et electos suos in lætitia.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ

text_en: And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles : and they possessed the labours of the people:
text_la: Et dedit illis regiones gentium, et labores populorum possederunt:
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς χώρας ἐθνῶν καὶ πόνους λαῶν ἐκληρονόμησαν

text_en: That they might observe his justifications, and seek after his law.
text_la: ut custodiant justificationes ejus, et legem ejus requirant.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν φυλάξωσιν τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσωσιν

text_en: Give glory to the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR, e invocai o seu nome; fazei conhecidas as suas obras entre os povos.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι χρηστός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who shall declare the powers of the Lord ? Who shall set forth all his praises?
text_la: Quis loquetur potentias Domini; auditas faciet omnes laudes ejus?
text_pt: Cantai-lhe, cantai-lhe salmos; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.
text_el: τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας τοῦ κυρίου ἀκουστὰς ποιήσει πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and do justice at all times.
text_la: Beati qui custodiunt judicium, et faciunt justitiam in omni tempore.
text_pt: Gloriai-vos no seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração daqueles que buscam ao Senhor.
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ φυλάσσοντες κρίσιν καὶ ποιοῦντες δικαιοσύνην ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ

text_en: Remember us, O Lord , in the favour of your people: visit us with your salvation .
text_la: Memento nostri, Domine, in beneplacito populi tui; visita nos in salutari tuo:
text_pt: Buscai ao Senhor e a sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.
text_el: μνήσθητι ἡμῶν κύριε ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου ἐπίσκεψαι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου

text_en: That we may see the good of your chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of your nation: that you may be praised with your inheritance.
text_la: ad videndum in bonitate electorum tuorum; ad lætandum in lætitia gentis tuæ : ut lauderis cum hæreditate tua.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos das maravilhas que fez, dos seus prodígios e dos juízos da sua boca;
text_el: τοῦ ἰδεῖν ἐν τῇ χρηστότητι τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν σου τοῦ εὐφρανθῆναι ἐν τῇ εὐφροσύνῃ τοῦ ἔθνους σου τοῦ ἐπαινεῖσθαι μετὰ τῆς κληρονομίας σου

text_en: We have sinned with our fathers: we have acted unjustly , we have wrought iniquity .
text_la: Peccavimus cum patribus nostris : injuste egimus; iniquitatem fecimus.
text_pt: Vós, semente de Abraão, seu servo, vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.
text_el: ἡμάρτομεν μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἠνομήσαμεν ἠδικήσαμεν

text_en: Our fathers understood not your wonders in Egypt : they remembered not the multitude of your mercies: And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, even the Red Sea .
text_la: Patres nostri in Ægypto non intellexerunt mirabilia tua; non fuerunt memores multitudinis misericordiæ tuæ. Et irritaverunt ascendentes in mare, mare Rubrum;
text_pt: Ele é o Senhor nosso Deus; os seus juízos estão em toda a terra.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ οὐ συνῆκαν τὰ θαυμάσιά σου οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τοῦ πλήθους τοῦ ἐλέους σου καὶ παρεπίκραναν ἀναβαίνοντες ἐν τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ

text_en: And he saved them for his own name's sake: that he might make his power known .
text_la: et salvavit eos propter nomen suum, ut notam faceret potentiam suam.
text_pt: Lembrou-se da sua aliança para sempre, da palavra que mandou a milhares de gerações.
text_el: καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ τοῦ γνωρίσαι τὴν δυναστείαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he rebuked the Red Sea and it was dried up: and he led them through the depths , as in a wilderness .
text_la: Et increpuit mare Rubrum et exsiccatum est, et deduxit eos in abyssis sicut in deserto.
text_pt: A qual aliança fez com Abraão, e o seu juramento a Isaque.
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐξηράνθη καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ ὡς ἐν ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
text_la: Et salvavit eos de manu odientium, et redemit eos de manu inimici.
text_pt: E confirmou o mesmo a Jacó por lei, e a Israel por aliança eterna,
text_el: καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς μισούντων καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ

text_en: And the water covered them that afflicted them: there was not one of them left.
text_la: Et operuit aqua tribulantes eos; unus ex eis non remansit.
text_pt: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a região da vossa herança.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ὕδωρ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτούς εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐχ ὑπελείφθη

text_en: And they believed his words: and they sang his praises.
text_la: Et crediderunt verbis ejus, et laudaverunt laudem ejus.
text_pt: Quando eram poucos homens em número, sim, mui poucos, e estrangeiros nela;
text_el: καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ἐν τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ᾖσαν τὴν αἴνεσιν αὐτοῦ
