text_en: They had quickly done, they forgot his works: and they waited not for his counsel.
text_la: Cito fecerunt; obliti sunt operum ejus : et non sustinuerunt consilium ejus.
text_pt: Quando andavam de nação em nação e dum reino para outro povo;
text_el: ἐτάχυναν ἐπελάθοντο τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ οὐχ ὑπέμειναν τὴν βουλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they coveted their desire in the desert : and they tempted God in the place without water.
text_la: Et concupierunt concupiscentiam in deserto, et tentaverunt Deum in inaquoso.
text_pt: Não permitiu a ninguém que os oprimisse, e por amor deles repreendeu a reis, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐπεθύμησαν ἐπιθυμίαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἐπείρασαν τὸν θεὸν ἐν ἀνύδρῳ

text_en: And he gave them their request: and sent fullness into their souls .
text_la: Et dedit eis petitionem ipsorum, et misit saturitatem in animas eorum.
text_pt: Não toqueis os meus ungidos, e não maltrateis os meus profetas.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ αἴτημα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν πλησμονὴν εἰς τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And they provoked Moses in the camp, Aaron the holy one of the Lord .
text_la: Et irritaverunt Moysen in castris; Aaron, sanctum Domini.
text_pt: Chamou a fome sobre a terra, quebrantou todo o sustento do pão.
text_el: καὶ παρώργισαν Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ καὶ Ααρων τὸν ἅγιον κυρίου

text_en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan : and covered the congregation of Abiron .
text_la: Aperta est terra, et deglutivit Dathan, et operuit super congregationem Abiron.
text_pt: Mandou perante eles um homem, José, que foi vendido por escravo;
text_el: ἠνοίχθη ἡ γῆ καὶ κατέπιεν Δαθαν καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἐπὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν Αβιρων

text_en: And a fire was kindled in their congregation: the flame burned the wicked .
text_la: Et exarsit ignis in synagoga eorum : flamma combussit peccatores.
text_pt: Cujos pés apertaram com grilhões; foi posto em ferros;
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκαύθη πῦρ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν φλὸξ κατέφλεξεν ἁμαρτωλούς

text_en: They made also a calf in Horeb : and they adored the graven thing.
text_la: Et fecerunt vitulum in Horeb, et adoraverunt sculptile.
text_pt: Até ao tempo em que chegou a sua palavra; a palavra do Senhor o provou.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν μόσχον ἐν Χωρηβ καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ γλυπτῷ

text_en: And they changed their glory into the likeness of a calf that eats grass.
text_la: Et mutaverunt gloriam suam in similitudinem vituli comedentis fœnum.
text_pt: Mandou o rei, e o fez soltar; o governador dos povos, e o soltou.
text_el: καὶ ἠλλάξαντο τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ἐν ὁμοιώματι μόσχου ἔσθοντος χόρτον

text_en: They forgot God , who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt ,
text_la: Obliti sunt Deum qui salvavit eos; qui fecit magnalia in Ægypto,
text_pt: Fê-lo senhor da sua casa, e governador de toda a sua fazenda;
text_el: ἐπελάθοντο τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ σῴζοντος αὐτούς τοῦ ποιήσαντος μεγάλα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: wondrous works in the land of Cham : terrible things in the Red Sea .
text_la: mirabilia in terra Cham, terribilia in mari Rubro.
text_pt: Para sujeitar os seus príncipes a seu gosto, e instruir os seus anciãos.
text_el: θαυμαστὰ ἐν γῇ Χαμ φοβερὰ ἐπὶ θαλάσσης ἐρυθρᾶς

text_en: And he said that he would destroy them: had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach: To turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them.
text_la: Et dixit ut disperderet eos, si non Moyses, electus ejus, stetisset in confractione in conspectu ejus, ut averteret iram ejus, ne disperderet eos.
text_pt: Então Israel entrou no Egito, e Jacó peregrinou na terra de Cão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτούς εἰ μὴ Μωυσῆς ὁ ἐκλεκτὸς αὐτοῦ ἔστη ἐν τῇ θραύσει ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὴν ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι

text_en: And they set at nought the desirable land. They believed not his word,
text_la: Et pro nihilo habuerunt terram desiderabilem; non crediderunt verbo ejus.
text_pt: E aumentou o seu povo em grande maneira, e o fez mais poderoso do que os seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξουδένωσαν γῆν ἐπιθυμητήν οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν τῷ λόγῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and they murmured in their tents: they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord .
text_la: Et murmuraverunt in tabernaculis suis; non exaudierunt vocem Domini.
text_pt: Virou o coração deles para que odiassem o seu povo, para que tratassem astutamente aos seus servos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγόγγυσαν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου

text_en: And he lifted up his hand over them: to overthrow them in the desert ;
text_la: Et elevavit manum suam super eos ut prosterneret eos in deserto:
text_pt: Enviou Moisés, seu servo, e Arão, a quem escolhera.
text_el: καὶ ἐπῆρεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ αὐτοῖς τοῦ καταβαλεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: and to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the countries.
text_la: et ut dejiceret semen eorum in nationibus, et dispergeret eos in regionibus.
text_pt: Mostraram entre eles os seus sinais e prodígios, na terra de Cão.
text_el: καὶ τοῦ καταβαλεῖν τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ διασκορπίσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς χώραις

text_en: They also were initiated to Beelphegor : and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
text_la: Et initiati sunt Beelphegor, et comederunt sacrificia mortuorum.
text_pt: Mandou trevas, e a fez escurecer; e não foram rebeldes à sua palavra.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελέσθησαν τῷ Βεελφεγωρ καὶ ἔφαγον θυσίας νεκρῶν

text_en: And they provoked him with their inventions: and destruction was multiplied among them.
text_la: Et irritaverunt eum in adinventionibus suis, et multiplicata est in eis ruina.
text_pt: Converteu as suas águas em sangue, e matou os seus peixes.
text_el: καὶ παρώξυναν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπληθύνθη ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡ πτῶσις

text_en: Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: and the slaughter ceased.
text_la: Et stetit Phinees, et placavit, et cessavit quassatio.
text_pt: A sua terra produziu rãs em abundância, até nas câmaras dos seus reis.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη Φινεες καὶ ἐξιλάσατο καὶ ἐκόπασεν ἡ θραῦσις

text_en: And it was reputed to him unto justice , to generation and generation for evermore.
text_la: Et reputatum est ei in justitiam, in generationem et generationem usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Falou ele, e vieram enxames de moscas e piolhos em todo o seu termo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: and Moses was afflicted for their sakes:
text_la: Et irritaverunt eum ad aquas contradictionis, et vexatus est Moyses propter eos:
text_pt: Converteu as suas chuvas em saraiva, e fogo abrasador na sua terra.
text_el: καὶ παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐφ' ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας καὶ ἐκακώθη Μωυσῆς δι' αὐτούς

text_en: Because they exasperated his spirit. And he distinguished with his lips.
text_la: quia exacerbaverunt spiritum ejus, et distinxit in labiis suis.
text_pt: Feriu as suas vinhas e os seus figueirais, e quebrou as árvores dos seus termos.
text_el: ὅτι παρεπίκραναν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ διέστειλεν ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: They did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.
text_la: Non disperdiderunt gentes quas dixit Dominus illis:
text_pt: Falou ele e vieram gafanhotos e pulgão sem número.
text_el: οὐκ ἐξωλέθρευσαν τὰ ἔθνη ἃ εἶπεν κύριος αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they were mingled among the heathens , and learned their works:
text_la: et commisti sunt inter gentes, et didicerunt opera eorum;
text_pt: E comeram toda a erva da sua terra, e devoraram o fruto dos seus campos.
text_el: καὶ ἐμίγησαν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἔμαθον τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν

text_en: And served their idols , and it became a stumbling block to them.
text_la: et servierunt sculptilibus eorum, et factum est illis in scandalum.
text_pt: Feriu também a todos os primogênitos da sua terra, as primícias de todas as suas forças.
text_el: καὶ ἐδούλευσαν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς εἰς σκάνδαλον

text_en: And they sacrificed their sons, and their daughters to devils .
text_la: Et immolaverunt filios suos et filias suas dæmoniis.
text_pt: E tirou-os para fora com prata e ouro, e entre as suas tribos não houve um só fraco.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσαν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν τοῖς δαιμονίοις

text_en: And they shed innocent blood: the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan . And the land was polluted with blood,
text_la: Et effuderunt sanguinem innocentem, sanguinem filiorum suorum et filiarum suarum, quas sacrificaverunt sculptilibus Chanaan. Et infecta est terra in sanguinibus,
text_pt: O Egito se alegrou quando eles saíram, porque o seu temor caíra sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέχεαν αἷμα ἀθῷον αἷμα υἱῶν αὐτῶν καὶ θυγατέρων ὧν ἔθυσαν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς Χανααν καὶ ἐφονοκτονήθη ἡ γῆ ἐν τοῖς αἵμασιν

text_en: and was defiled with their works: and they went aside after their own inventions.
text_la: et contaminata est in operibus eorum : et fornicati sunt in adinventionibus suis.
text_pt: Estendeu uma nuvem por coberta, e um fogo para iluminar de noite.
text_el: καὶ ἐμιάνθη ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: and he abhorred his inheritance.
text_la: Et iratus est furore Dominus in populum suum, et abominatus est hæreditatem suam.
text_pt: Oraram, e ele fez vir codornizes, e os fartou de pão do céu.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐβδελύξατο τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: and they that hated them had dominion over them.
text_la: Et tradidit eos in manus gentium; et dominati sunt eorum qui oderunt eos.
text_pt: Abriu a penha, e dela correram águas; correram pelos lugares secos, como um rio.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐκυρίευσαν αὐτῶν οἱ μισοῦντες αὐτούς

text_en: And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands:
text_la: Et tribulaverunt eos inimici eorum, et humiliati sunt sub manibus eorum;
text_pt: Porque se lembrou da sua santa palavra, e de Abraão, seu servo.
text_el: καὶ ἔθλιψαν αὐτοὺς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐταπεινώθησαν ὑπὸ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: Many times did he deliver them. But they provoked him with their counsel: and they were brought low by their iniquities .
text_la: sæpe liberavit eos. Ipsi autem exacerbaverunt eum in consilio suo, et humiliati sunt in iniquitatibus suis.
text_pt: E tirou dali o seu povo com alegria, e os seus escolhidos com regozijo.
text_el: πλεονάκις ἐρρύσατο αὐτούς αὐτοὶ δὲ παρεπίκραναν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ βουλῇ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐταπεινώθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: And he saw when they were in tribulation: and he heard their prayer .
text_la: Et vidit cum tribularentur, et audivit orationem eorum.
text_pt: E deu-lhes as terras dos gentios; e herdaram o trabalho dos povos;
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν εἰσακοῦσαι τῆς δεήσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: And he was mindful of his covenant: and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
text_la: Et memor fuit testamenti sui, et pœnituit eum secundum multitudinem misericordiæ suæ:
text_pt: Para que guardassem os seus preceitos, e observassem as suas leis. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ καὶ μετεμελήθη κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he gave them unto mercies, in the sight of all those that had made them captives.
text_la: et dedit eos in misericordias, in conspectu omnium qui ceperant eos.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἰκτιρμοὺς ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν αἰχμαλωτισάντων αὐτούς

text_en: Save us, O Lord , our God : and gather us from among the nations: That we may give thanks to your holy name , and may glory in your praise.
text_la: Salvos nos fac, Domine Deus noster, et congrega nos de nationibus : ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, et gloriemur in laude tua.
text_el: σῶσον ἡμᾶς κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπισυνάγαγε ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἁγίῳ σου τοῦ ἐγκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν τῇ αἰνέσει σου

text_en: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel , from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, a sæculo et usque in sæculum; et dicet omnis populus : Fiat, fiat.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἐρεῖ πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο γένοιτο

text_en: Give glory to the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvai ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque a sua misericórdia dura para sempre.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι χρηστός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord , whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.
text_la: Dicant qui redempti sunt a Domino, quos redemit de manu inimici, et de regionibus congregavit eos,
text_pt: Quem pode contar as obras poderosas do Senhor? Quem anunciará os seus louvores?
text_el: εἰπάτωσαν οἱ λελυτρωμένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου οὓς ἐλυτρώσατο ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ

text_en: From the rising and from the setting of the sun, from the north and from the sea.
text_la: a solis ortu, et occasu, ab aquilone, et mari.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que guardam o juízo, o que pratica justiça em todos os tempos.
text_el: ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ βορρᾶ καὶ θαλάσσης

text_en: They wandered in a wilderness , in a place without water: they found not the way of a city for their habitation.
text_la: Erraverunt in solitudine, in inaquoso; viam civitatis habitaculi non invenerunt.
text_pt: Lembra-te de mim, Senhor, segundo a tua boa vontade para com o teu povo; visita-me com a tua salvação.
text_el: ἐπλανήθησαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν ἀνύδρῳ ὁδὸν πόλεως κατοικητηρίου οὐχ εὗρον

text_en: They were hungry and thirsty: their soul fainted in them.
text_la: Esurientes et sitientes, anima eorum in ipsis defecit.
text_pt: Para que eu veja os bens de teus escolhidos, para que eu me alegre com a alegria da tua nação, para que me glorie com a tua herança.
text_el: πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐξέλιπεν

text_en: And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: and he delivered them out of their distresses.
text_la: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur, et de necessitatibus eorum eripuit eos;
text_pt: Nós pecamos como os nossos pais, cometemos a iniqüidade, andamos perversamente.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἐρρύσατο αὐτοὺς

text_en: And he led them into the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
text_la: et deduxit eos in viam rectam, ut irent in civitatem habitationis.
text_pt: Nossos pais não entenderam as tuas maravilhas no Egito; não se lembraram da multidão das tuas misericórdias; antes o provocaram no mar, sim no Mar Vermelho.
text_el: καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ὁδὸν εὐθεῖαν τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς πόλιν κατοικητηρίου

text_en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: and his wonderful works to the children of men .
text_la: Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum.
text_pt: Não obstante, ele os salvou por amor do seu nome, para fazer conhecido o seu poder.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For he has satisfied the empty soul , and has filled the hungry soul with good things.
text_la: Quia satiavit animam inanem, et animam esurientem satiavit bonis.
text_pt: Repreendeu, também, o Mar Vermelho, e este se secou, e os fez caminhar pelos abismos como pelo deserto.
text_el: ὅτι ἐχόρτασεν ψυχὴν κενὴν καὶ ψυχὴν πεινῶσαν ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν

text_en: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: bound in want and in iron.
text_la: Sedentes in tenebris et umbra mortis; vinctos in mendicitate et ferro.
text_pt: E os livrou da mão daquele que os odiava, e os remiu da mão do inimigo.
text_el: καθημένους ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου πεπεδημένους ἐν πτωχείᾳ καὶ σιδήρῳ

text_en: Because they had exasperated the words of God : and provoked the counsel of the most High :
text_la: Quia exacerbaverunt eloquia Dei, et consilium Altissimi irritaverunt.
text_pt: E as águas cobriram os seus adversários; nem um só deles ficou.
text_el: ὅτι παρεπίκραναν τὰ λόγια τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ ὑψίστου παρώξυναν

text_en: And their heart was humbled with labours: they were weakened, and there was none to help them.
text_la: Et humiliatum est in laboribus cor eorum; infirmati sunt, nec fuit qui adjuvaret.
text_pt: Então creram nas suas palavras, e cantaram os seus louvores.
text_el: καὶ ἐταπεινώθη ἐν κόποις ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἠσθένησαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν

text_en: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and he delivered them out of their distresses.
text_la: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur; et de necessitatibus eorum liberavit eos.
text_pt: Porém cedo se esqueceram das suas obras; não esperaram o seu conselho.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς

text_en: And he brought them out of darkness, and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.
text_la: Et eduxit eos de tenebris et umbra mortis, et vincula eorum dirupit.
text_pt: Mas deixaram-se levar à cobiça no deserto, e tentaram a Deus na solidão.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ σκότους καὶ σκιᾶς θανάτου καὶ τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν διέρρηξεν

text_en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, and his wonderful works to the children of men .
text_la: Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum.
text_pt: E ele lhes cumpriu o seu desejo, mas enviou magreza às suas almas.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: Because he has broken gates of brass, and burst iron bars.
text_la: Quia contrivit portas æreas, et vectes ferreos confregit.
text_pt: E invejaram a Moisés no campo, e a Arão, o santo do Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι συνέτριψεν πύλας χαλκᾶς καὶ μοχλοὺς σιδηροῦς συνέκλασεν

text_en: He took them out of the way of their iniquity : for they were brought low for their injustices .
text_la: Suscepit eos de via iniquitatis eorum; propter injustitias enim suas humiliati sunt.
text_pt: Abriu-se a terra, e engoliu a Datã, e cobriu o grupo de Abirão.
text_el: ἀντελάβετο αὐτῶν ἐξ ὁδοῦ ἀνομίας αὐτῶν διὰ γὰρ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν ἐταπεινώθησαν

text_en: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: and they drew near even to the gates of death.
text_la: Omnem escam abominata est anima eorum, et appropinquaverunt usque ad portas mortis.
text_pt: E um fogo se acendeu no seu grupo; a chama abrasou os ímpios.
text_el: πᾶν βρῶμα ἐβδελύξατο ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν καὶ ἤγγισαν ἕως τῶν πυλῶν τοῦ θανάτου

text_en: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and he delivered them out of their distresses.
text_la: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur, et de necessitatibus eorum liberavit eos.
text_pt: Fizeram um bezerro em Horebe e adoraram a imagem fundida.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἔσωσεν αὐτούς

text_en: He sent his word, and healed them: and delivered them from their destructions.
text_la: Misit verbum suum, et sanavit eos, et eripuit eos de interitionibus eorum.
text_pt: E converteram a sua glória na figura de um boi que come erva.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰάσατο αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐρρύσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν διαφθορῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: and his wonderful works to the children of men .
text_la: Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum.
text_pt: Esqueceram-se de Deus, seu Salvador, que fizera grandezas no Egito,
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: and declare his works with joy .
text_la: Et sacrificent sacrificium laudis, et annuntient opera ejus in exsultatione.
text_pt: Maravilhas na terra de Cão, coisas tremendas no Mar Vermelho.
text_el: καὶ θυσάτωσαν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως καὶ ἐξαγγειλάτωσαν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει

text_en: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in the great waters:
text_la: Qui descendunt mare in navibus, facientes operationem in aquis multis:
text_pt: Por isso disse que os destruiria, não houvesse Moisés, seu escolhido, ficado perante ele na brecha, para desviar a sua indignação, a fim de não os destruir.
text_el: οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν ἐν πλοίοις ποιοῦντες ἐργασίαν ἐν ὕδασι πολλοῖς

text_en: These have seen the works of the Lord , and his wonders in the deep.
text_la: ipsi viderunt opera Domini, et mirabilia ejus in profundo.
text_pt: Também desprezaram a terra aprazível; não creram na sua palavra.
text_el: αὐτοὶ εἴδοσαν τὰ ἔργα κυρίου καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ βυθῷ

text_en: He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: and the waves thereof were lifted up.
text_la: Dixit, et stetit spiritus procellæ, et exaltati sunt fluctus ejus.
text_pt: Antes murmuraram nas suas tendas, e não deram ouvidos à voz do Senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν καὶ ἔστη πνεῦμα καταιγίδος καὶ ὑψώθη τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς

text_en: They mount up to the heavens , and they go down to the depths : their soul pined away with evils .
text_la: Ascendunt usque ad cælos, et descendunt usque ad abyssos; anima eorum in malis tabescebat.
text_pt: Por isso levantou a sua mão contra eles, para os derrubar no deserto;
text_el: ἀναβαίνουσιν ἕως τῶν οὐρανῶν καὶ καταβαίνουσιν ἕως τῶν ἀβύσσων ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ἐν κακοῖς ἐτήκετο

text_en: They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man ; and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
text_la: Turbati sunt, et moti sunt sicut ebrius, et omnis sapientia eorum devorata est.
text_pt: Para derrubar também a sua semente entre as nações, e espalhá-los pelas terras.
text_el: ἐταράχθησαν ἐσαλεύθησαν ὡς ὁ μεθύων καὶ πᾶσα ἡ σοφία αὐτῶν κατεπόθη

text_en: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and he brought them out of their distresses.
text_la: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur; et de necessitatibus eorum eduxit eos.
text_pt: Também se juntaram com Baal-Peor, e comeram os sacrifícios dos mortos.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς

text_en: And he turned the storm into a breeze: and its waves were still.
text_la: Et statuit procellam ejus in auram, et siluerunt fluctus ejus.
text_pt: Assim o provocaram à ira com as suas invenções; e a peste rebentou entre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέταξεν τῇ καταιγίδι καὶ ἔστη εἰς αὔραν καὶ ἐσίγησαν τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς

text_en: And they rejoiced because they were still: and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.
text_la: Et lætati sunt quia siluerunt; et deduxit eos in portum voluntatis eorum.
text_pt: Então se levantou Finéias, e fez juízo, e cessou aquela peste.
text_el: καὶ εὐφράνθησαν ὅτι ἡσύχασαν καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ λιμένα θελήματος αὐτῶν

text_en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, and his wonderful works to the children of men .
text_la: Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum.
text_pt: E isto lhe foi contado como justiça, de geração em geração, para sempre.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And let them exalt him in the church of the people: and praise him in the chair of the ancients.
text_la: Et exaltent eum in ecclesia plebis, et in cathedra seniorum laudent eum.
text_pt: Indignaram-no também junto às águas da contenda, de sorte que sucedeu mal a Moisés, por causa deles;
text_el: ὑψωσάτωσαν αὐτὸν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ λαοῦ καὶ ἐν καθέδρᾳ πρεσβυτέρων αἰνεσάτωσαν αὐτόν

text_en: He has turned rivers into a wilderness : and the sources of waters into dry ground:
text_la: Posuit flumina in desertum, et exitus aquarum in sitim;
text_pt: Porque irritaram o seu espírito, de modo que falou imprudentemente com seus lábios.
text_el: ἔθετο ποταμοὺς εἰς ἔρημον καὶ διεξόδους ὑδάτων εἰς δίψαν

text_en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
text_la: terram fructiferam in salsuginem, a malitia inhabitantium in ea.
text_pt: Não destruíram os povos, como o Senhor lhes dissera.
text_el: γῆν καρποφόρον εἰς ἅλμην ἀπὸ κακίας τῶν κατοικούντων ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: He has turned a wilderness into pools of waters, and a dry land into water springs.
text_la: Posuit desertum in stagna aquarum, et terram sine aqua in exitus aquarum.
text_pt: Antes se misturaram com os gentios, e aprenderam as suas obras.
text_el: ἔθετο ἔρημον εἰς λίμνας ὑδάτων καὶ γῆν ἄνυδρον εἰς διεξόδους ὑδάτων

text_en: And has placed there the hungry; and they made a city for their habitation.
text_la: Et collocavit illic esurientes, et constituerunt civitatem habitationis:
text_pt: E serviram aos seus ídolos, que vieram a ser-lhes um laço.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐκεῖ πεινῶντας καὶ συνεστήσαντο πόλιν κατοικεσίας

text_en: Anti they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: and they yielded fruit of birth.
text_la: et seminaverunt agros et plantaverunt vineas, et fecerunt fructum nativitatis.
text_pt: Demais disto, sacrificaram seus filhos e suas filhas aos demônios,
text_el: καὶ ἔσπειραν ἀγροὺς καὶ ἐφύτευσαν ἀμπελῶνας καὶ ἐποίησαν καρπὸν γενήματος

text_en: And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.
text_la: Et benedixit eis, et multiplicati sunt nimis; et jumenta eorum non minoravit.
text_pt: E derramaram sangue inocente, o sangue de seus filhos e de suas filhas que sacrificaram aos ídolos de Canaã; e a terra foi manchada com sangue.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν σφόδρα καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐσμίκρυνεν

text_en: Then they were brought to be few: and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.
text_la: Et pauci facti sunt et vexati sunt, a tribulatione malorum et dolore.
text_pt: Assim se contaminaram com as suas obras, e se corromperam com os seus feitos.
text_el: καὶ ὠλιγώθησαν καὶ ἐκακώθησαν ἀπὸ θλίψεως κακῶν καὶ ὀδύνης

text_en: Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.
text_la: Effusa est contemptio super principes : et errare fecit eos in invio, et non in via.
text_pt: Então se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra o seu povo, de modo que abominou a sua herança.
text_el: ἐξεχύθη ἐξουδένωσις ἐπ' ἄρχοντας καὶ ἐπλάνησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀβάτῳ καὶ οὐχ ὁδῷ

text_en: And he helped the poor out of poverty: and made him families like a flock of sheep.
text_la: Et adjuvit pauperem de inopia, et posuit sicut oves familias.
text_pt: E os entregou nas mãos dos gentios; e aqueles que os odiavam se assenhorearam deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐβοήθησεν πένητι ἐκ πτωχείας καὶ ἔθετο ὡς πρόβατα πατριάς

text_en: The just shall see, and shall rejoice, and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
text_la: Videbunt recti, et lætabuntur; et omnis iniquitas oppilabit os suum.
text_pt: E os seus inimigos os oprimiram, e foram humilhados debaixo das suas mãos.
text_el: ὄψονται εὐθεῖς καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται καὶ πᾶσα ἀνομία ἐμφράξει τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς

text_en: Who is wise, and will keep these things; and will understand the mercies of the Lord ?
text_la: Quis sapiens, et custodiet hæc, et intelliget misericordias Domini?
text_pt: Muitas vezes os livrou, mas o provocaram com o seu conselho, e foram abatidos pela sua iniqüidade.
text_el: τίς σοφὸς καὶ φυλάξει ταῦτα καὶ συνήσουσιν τὰ ἐλέη τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: A canticle of a psalm for David himself.
text_la: Canticum Psalmi, ipsi David.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: ᾠδὴ ψαλμοῦ τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: My heart is ready, O God , my heart is ready: I will sing, and will give praise, with my glory .
text_la: Paratum cor meum, Deus, paratum cor meum; cantabo, et psallam in gloria mea.
text_pt: Digam-no os remidos do Senhor, os que remiu da mão do inimigo,
text_el: ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ὁ θεός ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία μου ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ μου

text_en: Arise, my glory ; arise, psaltery and harp: I will arise in the morning early.
text_la: Exsurge, gloria mea; exsurge, psalterium et cithara; exsurgam diluculo.
text_pt: E os que congregou das terras do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.
text_el: ἐξεγέρθητι ψαλτήριον καὶ κιθάρα ἐξεγερθήσομαι ὄρθρου

text_en: I will praise you, O Lord , among the people: and I will sing unto you among the nations.
text_la: Confitebor tibi in populis, Domine, et psallam tibi in nationibus:
text_pt: Andaram desgarrados pelo deserto, por caminhos solitários; não acharam cidade para habitarem.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν λαοῖς κύριε καὶ ψαλῶ σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν

text_en: For your mercy is great above the heavens : and your truth even unto the clouds.
text_la: quia magna est super cælos misericordia tua, et usque ad nubes veritas tua.
text_pt: Famintos e sedentos, a sua alma neles desfalecia.
text_el: ὅτι μέγα ἐπάνω τῶν οὐρανῶν τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου

text_en: Be exalted, O God , above the heavens , and your glory over all the earth:
text_la: Exaltare super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram gloria tua:
text_pt: E clamaram ao Senhor na sua angústia, e os livrou das suas dificuldades.
text_el: ὑψώθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανούς ὁ θεός καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἡ δόξα σου

text_en: That your beloved may be delivered. Save with your right hand and hear me.
text_la: ut liberentur dilecti tui. Salvum fac dextera tua, et exaudi me.
text_pt: E os levou por caminho direito, para irem a uma cidade de habitação.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ῥυσθῶσιν οἱ ἀγαπητοί σου σῶσον τῇ δεξιᾷ σου καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου

text_en: God has spoken in his holiness . I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem and I will mete out the vale of tabernacles.
text_la: Deus locutus est in sancto suo : Exsultabo, et dividam Sichimam; et convallem tabernaculorum dimetiar.
text_pt: Louvem ao Senhor pela sua bondade, e pelas suas maravilhas para com os filhos dos homens.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ ὑψωθήσομαι καὶ διαμεριῶ Σικιμα καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν σκηνῶν διαμετρήσω

text_en: Galaad is mine: and Manasses is mine and Ephraim the protection of my head. Juda is my king:
text_la: Meus est Galaad, et meus est Manasses, et Ephraim susceptio capitis mei. Juda rex meus;
text_pt: Pois fartou a alma sedenta, e encheu de bens a alma faminta.
text_el: ἐμός ἐστιν Γαλααδ καὶ ἐμός ἐστιν Μανασση καὶ Εφραιμ ἀντίλημψις τῆς κεφαλῆς μου Ιουδας βασιλεύς μου

text_en: Moab the pot of my hope . Over Edom I will stretch out my shoe: the aliens have become my friends.
text_la: Moab lebes spei meæ : in Idumæam extendam calceamentum meum; mihi alienigenæ amici facti sunt.
text_pt: Tal como a que se assenta nas trevas e sombra da morte, presa em aflição e em ferro;
text_el: Μωαβ λέβης τῆς ἐλπίδος μου ἐπὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν ἐκτενῶ τὸ ὑπόδημά μου ἐμοὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ὑπετάγησαν

text_en: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom ?
text_la: Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam? quis deducet me usque in Idumæam?
text_pt: Porquanto se rebelaram contra as palavras de Deus, e desprezaram o conselho do Altíssimo.
text_el: τίς ἀπάξει με εἰς πόλιν περιοχῆς τίς ὁδηγήσει με ἕως τῆς Ιδουμαίας

text_en: Will not you, O God , who have cast us off? And will not you, O God , go forth with our armies?
text_la: nonne tu, Deus, qui repulisti nos? et non exibis, Deus, in virtutibus nostris?
text_pt: Portanto, lhes abateu o coração com trabalho; tropeçaram, e não houve quem os ajudasse.
text_el: οὐχὶ σύ ὁ θεός ὁ ἀπωσάμενος ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ὁ θεός ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: O grant us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man .
text_la: Da nobis auxilium de tribulatione, quia vana salus hominis.
text_pt: Então clamaram ao Senhor na sua angústia, e os livrou das suas dificuldades.
text_el: δὸς ἡμῖν βοήθειαν ἐκ θλίψεως καὶ ματαία σωτηρία ἀνθρώπου

text_en: Through God we shall do mightily: and he will bring our enemies to nothing.
text_la: In Deo faciemus virtutem; et ipse ad nihilum deducet inimicos nostros.
text_pt: Tirou-os das trevas e sombra da morte; e quebrou as suas prisões.
text_el: ἐν τῷ θεῷ ποιήσομεν δύναμιν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξουδενώσει τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm for David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: Preparado está o meu coração, ó Deus; cantarei e darei louvores até com a minha glória.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος τῷ Δαυιδ ψαλμός ὁ θεός τὴν αἴνεσίν μου μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς

text_en: O God , be not silent in my praise: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.
text_la: Deus, laudem meam ne tacueris, quia os peccatoris et os dolosi super me apertum est.
text_pt: Despertai, saltério e harpa; eu mesmo despertarei ao romper da alva.
text_el: ὅτι στόμα ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ στόμα δολίου ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἠνοίχθη ἐλάλησαν κατ' ἐμοῦ γλώσσῃ δολίᾳ

text_en: They have spoken against me with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred ; and have fought against me without cause.
text_la: Locuti sunt adversum me lingua dolosa, et sermonibus odii circumdederunt me : et expugnaverunt me gratis.
text_pt: Louvar-te-ei entre os povos, Senhor, e a ti cantarei louvores entre as nações.
text_el: καὶ λόγοις μίσους ἐκύκλωσάν με καὶ ἐπολέμησάν με δωρεάν

text_en: Instead of making me a return of love , they detracted me: but I gave myself to prayer .
text_la: Pro eo ut me diligerent, detrahebant mihi; ego autem orabam.
text_pt: Porque a tua benignidade se estende até aos céus, e a tua verdade chega até às mais altas nuvens.
text_el: ἀντὶ τοῦ ἀγαπᾶν με ἐνδιέβαλλόν με ἐγὼ δὲ προσευχόμην

text_en: And they repaid me evil for good : and hatred for my love .
text_la: Et posuerunt adversum me mala pro bonis, et odium pro dilectione mea.
text_pt: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus, e a tua glória sobre toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔθεντο κατ' ἐμοῦ κακὰ ἀντὶ ἀγαθῶν καὶ μῖσος ἀντὶ τῆς ἀγαπήσεώς μου

text_en: Set the sinner over him: and may the devil stand at his right hand.
text_la: Constitue super eum peccatorem, et diabolus stet a dextris ejus.
text_pt: Para que sejam livres os teus amados, salva-nos com a tua destra, e ouve-nos.
text_el: κατάστησον ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἁμαρτωλόν καὶ διάβολος στήτω ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: When he is judged, may he go out condemned; and may his prayer be turned to sin .
text_la: Cum judicatur, exeat condemnatus; et oratio ejus fiat in peccatum.
text_pt: Deus falou na sua santidade; eu me regozijarei; repartirei a Siquém, e medirei o vale de Sucote.
text_el: ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαι αὐτὸν ἐξέλθοι καταδεδικασμένος καὶ ἡ προσευχὴ αὐτοῦ γενέσθω εἰς ἁμαρτίαν

text_en: May his days be few: and his bishopric let another take.
text_la: Fiant dies ejus pauci, et episcopatum ejus accipiat alter.
text_pt: Meu é Gileade, meu é Manassés; e Efraim a força da minha cabeça, Judá o meu legislador.
text_el: γενηθήτωσαν αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὀλίγαι καὶ τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λάβοι ἕτερος

text_en: May his children be fatherless , and his wife a widow .
text_la: Fiant filii ejus orphani, et uxor ejus vidua.
text_pt: Moabe a minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei o meu sapato, sobre a Filístia jubilarei.
text_el: γενηθήτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ὀρφανοὶ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ χήρα

text_en: Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; and let them be cast out of their dwellings.
text_la: Nutantes transferantur filii ejus et mendicent, et ejiciantur de habitationibus suis.
text_pt: Quem me levará à cidade forte? Quem me guiará até Edom?
text_el: σαλευόμενοι μεταναστήτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπαιτησάτωσαν ἐκβληθήτωσαν ἐκ τῶν οἰκοπέδων αὐτῶν

text_en: May the usurer search all his substance: and let strangers plunder his labours.
text_la: Scrutetur fœnerator omnem substantiam ejus, et diripiant alieni labores ejus.
text_pt: Porventura não serás tu, ó Deus, que nos rejeitaste? E não sairás, ó Deus, com os nossos exércitos?
text_el: ἐξερευνησάτω δανειστὴς πάντα ὅσα ὑπάρχει αὐτῷ διαρπασάτωσαν ἀλλότριοι τοὺς πόνους αὐτοῦ

text_en: May there be none to help him: nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.
text_la: Non sit illi adjutor, nec sit qui misereatur pupillis ejus.
text_pt: Dá-nos auxílio para sair da angústia, porque vão é o socorro da parte do homem.
text_el: μὴ ὑπαρξάτω αὐτῷ ἀντιλήμπτωρ μηδὲ γενηθήτω οἰκτίρμων τοῖς ὀρφανοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: May his posterity be cut off; in one generation may his name be blotted out.
text_la: Fiant nati ejus in interitum; in generatione una deleatur nomen ejus.
text_pt: Em Deus faremos proezas, pois ele calcará aos pés os nossos inimigos.
text_el: γενηθήτω τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ εἰς ἐξολέθρευσιν ἐν γενεᾷ μιᾷ ἐξαλειφθήτω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord : and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
text_la: In memoriam redeat iniquitas patrum ejus in conspectu Domini, et peccatum matris ejus non deleatur.
text_el: ἀναμνησθείη ἡ ἀνομία τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐξαλειφθείη

text_en: May they be before the Lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth:
text_la: Fiant contra Dominum semper, et dispereat de terra memoria eorum:
text_el: γενηθήτωσαν ἔναντι κυρίου διὰ παντός καὶ ἐξολεθρευθείη ἐκ γῆς τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν

text_en: Because he remembered not to show mercy,
text_la: pro eo quod non est recordatus facere misericordiam,
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθη τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἔλεος καὶ κατεδίωξεν ἄνθρωπον πένητα καὶ πτωχὸν καὶ κατανενυγμένον τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ θανατῶσαι

text_en: but persecuted the poor man and the beggar; and the broken in heart, to put him to death.
text_la: et persecutus est hominem inopem et mendicum, et compunctum corde, mortificare.
text_el: καὶ ἠγάπησεν κατάραν καὶ ἥξει αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν εὐλογίαν καὶ μακρυνθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he loved cursing , and it shall come unto him: and he would not have blessing , and it shall be far from him. And he put on cursing , like a garment: and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.
text_la: Et dilexit maledictionem, et veniet ei; et noluit benedictionem, et elongabitur ab eo. Et induit maledictionem sicut vestimentum; et intravit sicut aqua in interiora ejus, et sicut oleum in ossibus ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεδύσατο κατάραν ὡς ἱμάτιον καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὡς ὕδωρ εἰς τὰ ἔγκατα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὡσεὶ ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ὀστέοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: May it be unto him like a garment which covers him; and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.
text_la: Fiat ei sicut vestimentum quo operitur, et sicut zona qua semper præcingitur.
text_el: γενηθήτω αὐτῷ ὡς ἱμάτιον ὃ περιβάλλεται καὶ ὡσεὶ ζώνη ἣν διὰ παντὸς περιζώννυται

text_en: This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord ; and who speak evils against my soul .
text_la: Hoc opus eorum qui detrahunt mihi apud Dominum, et qui loquuntur mala adversus animam meam.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον τῶν ἐνδιαβαλλόντων με παρὰ κυρίου καὶ τῶν λαλούντων πονηρὰ κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς μου

text_en: But you, O Lord , do with me for your name's sake: because your mercy is sweet. Deliver me,
text_la: Et tu, Domine, Domine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum, quia suavis est misericordia tua.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριε κύριε ποίησον μετ' ἐμοῦ ἔλεος ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ὅτι χρηστὸν τὸ ἔλεός σου

text_en: for I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.
text_la: Libera me, quia egenus et pauper ego sum, et cor meum conturbatum est intra me.
text_el: ῥῦσαί με ὅτι πτωχὸς καὶ πένης ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ ἡ καρδία μου τετάρακται ἐντός μου

text_en: I am taken away like the shadow when it declines: and I am shaken off as locusts.
text_la: Sicut umbra cum declinat ablatus sum, et excussus sum sicut locustæ.
text_el: ὡσεὶ σκιὰ ἐν τῷ ἐκκλῖναι αὐτὴν ἀντανῃρέθην ἐξετινάχθην ὡσεὶ ἀκρίδες

text_en: My knees are weakened through fasting : and my flesh is changed for oil.
text_la: Genua mea infirmata sunt a jejunio, et caro mea immutata est propter oleum.
text_el: τὰ γόνατά μου ἠσθένησαν ἀπὸ νηστείας καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ἠλλοιώθη δι' ἔλαιον

text_en: And I have become a reproach to them: they saw me and they shaked their heads.
text_la: Et ego factus sum opprobrium illis; viderunt me, et moverunt capita sua.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐγενήθην ὄνειδος αὐτοῖς εἴδοσάν με ἐσάλευσαν κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: Help me, O Lord my God ; save me; according to your mercy.
text_la: Adjuva me, Domine Deus meus; salvum me fac secundum misericordiam tuam.
text_el: βοήθησόν μοι κύριε ὁ θεός μου σῶσόν με κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου

text_en: And let them know that this is your hand: and that you, O Lord , have done it.
text_la: Et sciant quia manus tua hæc, et tu, Domine, fecisti eam.
text_el: καὶ γνώτωσαν ὅτι ἡ χείρ σου αὕτη καὶ σύ κύριε ἐποίησας αὐτήν

text_en: They will curse and you will bless : let them that rise up against me be confounded: but your servant shall rejoice.
text_la: Maledicent illi, et tu benedices : qui insurgunt in me confundantur; servus autem tuus lætabitur.
text_el: καταράσονται αὐτοί καὶ σὺ εὐλογήσεις οἱ ἐπανιστανόμενοί μοι αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ὁ δὲ δοῦλός σου εὐφρανθήσεται

text_en: Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: and let them be covered with their confusion as with a double cloak.
text_la: Induantur qui detrahunt mihi pudore, et operiantur sicut diploide confusione sua.
text_el: ἐνδυσάσθωσαν οἱ ἐνδιαβάλλοντές με ἐντροπὴν καὶ περιβαλέσθωσαν ὡσεὶ διπλοΐδα αἰσχύνην αὐτῶν

text_en: I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: and in the midst of many I will praise him.
text_la: Confitebor Domino nimis in ore meo, et in medio multorum laudabo eum:
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ κυρίῳ σφόδρα ἐν τῷ στόματί μου καὶ ἐν μέσῳ πολλῶν αἰνέσω αὐτόν

text_en: Because he has stood at the right hand of the poor, to save my soul from persecutors.
text_la: quia astitit a dextris pauperis, ut salvam faceret a persequentibus animam meam.
text_el: ὅτι παρέστη ἐκ δεξιῶν πένητος τοῦ σῶσαι ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.
text_la: Dixit Dominus Domino meo : Sede a dextris meis, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
text_pt: Ó Deus do meu louvor, não te cales,
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ψαλμός εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου

text_en: The Lord will send forth the sceptre of your power out of Sion: rule in the midst of your enemies.
text_la: Virgam virtutis tuæ emittet Dominus ex Sion : dominare in medio inimicorum tuorum.
text_pt: Pois a boca do ímpio e a boca do enganador estão abertas contra mim. Têm falado contra mim com uma língua mentirosa.
text_el: ῥάβδον δυνάμεώς σου ἐξαποστελεῖ κύριος ἐκ Σιων καὶ κατακυρίευε ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου

text_en: With you is the principality in the day of your strength: in the brightness of the saints : from the womb before the day star I begot you.
text_la: Tecum principium in die virtutis tuæ in splendoribus sanctorum : ex utero, ante luciferum, genui te.
text_pt: Eles me cercaram com palavras odiosas, e pelejaram contra mim sem causa.
text_el: μετὰ σοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τῆς δυνάμεώς σου ἐν ταῖς λαμπρότησιν τῶν ἁγίων ἐκ γαστρὸς πρὸ ἑωσφόρου ἐξεγέννησά σε

text_en: The Lord has sworn, and he will not repent: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech .
text_la: Juravit Dominus, et non pœnitebit eum : Tu es sacerdos in æternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
text_pt: Em recompensa do meu amor são meus adversários; mas eu faço oração.
text_el: ὤμοσεν κύριος καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται σὺ εἶ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισεδεκ

text_en: The Lord at your right hand has broken kings in the day of his wrath .
text_la: Dominus a dextris tuis; confregit in die iræ suæ reges.
text_pt: E me deram mal pelo bem, e ódio pelo meu amor.
text_el: κύριος ἐκ δεξιῶν σου συνέθλασεν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ βασιλεῖς

text_en: He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: he shall crush the heads in the land of many.
text_la: Judicabit in nationibus, implebit ruinas; conquassabit capita in terra multorum.
text_pt: Põe sobre ele um ímpio, e Satanás esteja à sua direita.
text_el: κρινεῖ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν πληρώσει πτώματα συνθλάσει κεφαλὰς ἐπὶ γῆς πολλῶν

text_en: He shall drink of the torrent in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
text_la: De torrente in via bibet; propterea exaltabit caput.
text_pt: Quando for julgado, saia condenado; e a sua oração se lhe torne em pecado.
text_el: ἐκ χειμάρρου ἐν ὁδῷ πίεται διὰ τοῦτο ὑψώσει κεφαλήν

text_en: I will praise you, O Lord , with my whole heart; in the council of the just , and in the congregation.
text_la: Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo, in consilio justorum, et congregatione.
text_pt: Disse o SENHOR ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha mão direita, até que ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo dos teus pés.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ἐν βουλῇ εὐθείων καὶ συναγωγῇ

text_en: Great are the works of the Lord : sought out according to all his wills.
text_la: Magna opera Domini : exquisita in omnes voluntates ejus.
text_pt: O Senhor enviará o cetro da tua fortaleza desde Sião, dizendo: Domina no meio dos teus inimigos.
text_el: μεγάλα τὰ ἔργα κυρίου ἐξεζητημένα εἰς πάντα τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: His work is praise and magnificence: and his justice continues for ever and ever.
text_la: Confessio et magnificentia opus ejus, et justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: O teu povo será mui voluntário no dia do teu poder; nos ornamentos de santidade, desde a madre da alva, tu tens o orvalho da tua mocidade.
text_el: ἐξομολόγησις καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: He has made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord :
text_la: Memoriam fecit mirabilium suorum, misericors et miserator Dominus.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor, e não se arrependerá: tu és um sacerdote eterno, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
text_el: μνείαν ἐποιήσατο τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτίρμων ὁ κύριος

text_en: He has given food to them that fear him. He will be mindful for ever of his covenant:
text_la: Escam dedit timentibus se; memor erit in sæculum testamenti sui.
text_pt: O Senhor, à tua direita, ferirá os reis no dia da sua ira.
text_el: τροφὴν ἔδωκεν τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν μνησθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διαθήκης αὐτοῦ

text_en: He will show forth to his people the power of his works.
text_la: Virtutem operum suorum annuntiabit populo suo,
text_pt: Julgará entre os gentios; tudo encherá de corpos mortos; ferirá os cabeças de muitos países.
text_el: ἰσχὺν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ἀνήγγειλεν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς κληρονομίαν ἐθνῶν

text_en: That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles : the works of his hands are truth and judgment.
text_la: ut det illis hæreditatem gentium. Opera manuum ejus veritas et judicium.
text_pt: Beberá do ribeiro no caminho, por isso exaltará a cabeça.
text_el: ἔργα χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ἀλήθεια καὶ κρίσις πισταὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, made in truth and equity.
text_la: Fidelia omnia mandata ejus, confirmata in sæculum sæculi, facta in veritate et æquitate.
text_el: ἐστηριγμέναι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος πεποιημέναι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ εὐθύτητι

text_en: He has sent redemption to his people: he has commanded his covenant for ever. Holy and terrible is his name :
text_la: Redemptionem misit populo suo; mandavit in æternum testamentum suum. Sanctum et terribile nomen ejus.
text_el: λύτρωσιν ἀπέστειλεν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐνετείλατο εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἅγιον καὶ φοβερὸν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. A good understanding to all that do it: his praise continues for ever and ever.
text_la: Initium sapientiæ timor Domini; intellectus bonus omnibus facientibus eum : laudatio ejus manet in sæculum sæculi.
text_el: ἀρχὴ σοφίας φόβος κυρίου σύνεσις ἀγαθὴ πᾶσι τοῖς ποιοῦσιν αὐτήν ἡ αἴνεσις αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Blessed is the man that fears the Lord : he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.
text_la: Beatus vir qui timet Dominum : in mandatis ejus volet nimis.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvarei ao SENHOR de todo o meu coração, na assembléia dos justos e na congregação.
text_el: αλληλουια μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ θελήσει σφόδρα

text_en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the righteous shall be blessed .
text_la: Potens in terra erit semen ejus; generatio rectorum benedicetur.
text_pt: Grandes são as obras do Senhor, procuradas por todos os que nelas tomam prazer.
text_el: δυνατὸν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ γενεὰ εὐθείων εὐλογηθήσεται

text_en: Glory and wealth shall be in his house: and his justice remains for ever and ever.
text_la: Gloria et divitiæ in domo ejus, et justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: A sua obra tem glória e majestade, e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
text_el: δόξα καὶ πλοῦτος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: he is merciful, and compassionate and just .
text_la: Exortum est in tenebris lumen rectis : misericors, et miserator, et justus.
text_pt: Fez com que as suas maravilhas fossem lembradas; piedoso e misericordioso é o Senhor.
text_el: ἐξανέτειλεν ἐν σκότει φῶς τοῖς εὐθέσιν ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτίρμων καὶ δίκαιος

text_en: Acceptable is the man that shows mercy and lends: he shall order his words with judgment:
text_la: Jucundus homo qui miseretur et commodat; disponet sermones suos in judicio:
text_pt: Deu mantimento aos que o temem; lembrar-se-á sempre da sua aliança.
text_el: χρηστὸς ἀνὴρ ὁ οἰκτίρων καὶ κιχρῶν οἰκονομήσει τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἐν κρίσει

text_en: Because he shall not be moved for ever.
text_la: quia in æternum non commovebitur.
text_pt: Anunciou ao seu povo o poder das suas obras, para lhe dar a herança dos gentios.
text_el: ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος

text_en: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: he shall not fear the evil hearing. His heart is ready to hope in the Lord :
text_la: In memoria æterna erit justus; ab auditione mala non timebit. Paratum cor ejus sperare in Domino,
text_pt: As obras das suas mãos são verdade e juízo, seguros todos os seus mandamentos.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἀκοῆς πονηρᾶς οὐ φοβηθήσεται ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ ἐλπίζειν ἐπὶ κύριον

text_en: His heart is strengthened, he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.
text_la: confirmatum est cor ejus; non commovebitur donec despiciat inimicos suos.
text_pt: Permanecem firmes para todo o sempre; e são feitos em verdade e retidão.
text_el: ἐστήρικται ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῇ ἕως οὗ ἐπίδῃ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has distributed, he has given to the poor: his justice remains for ever and ever: his horn shall be exalted in glory .
text_la: Dispersit, dedit pauperibus; justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi : cornu ejus exaltabitur in gloria.
text_pt: Redenção enviou ao seu povo; ordenou a sua aliança para sempre; santo e tremendo é o seu nome.
text_el: ἐσκόρπισεν ἔδωκεν τοῖς πένησιν ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος τὸ κέρας αὐτοῦ ὑψωθήσεται ἐν δόξῃ

text_en: The wicked shall see, and shall be angry , he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
text_la: Peccator videbit, et irascetur; dentibus suis fremet et tabescet : desiderium peccatorum peribit.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é o princípio da sabedoria; bom entendimento têm todos os que cumprem os seus mandamentos; o seu louvor permanece para sempre.
text_el: ἁμαρτωλὸς ὄψεται καὶ ὀργισθήσεται τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτοῦ βρύξει καὶ τακήσεται ἐπιθυμία ἁμαρτωλῶν ἀπολεῖται

text_en: Praise the Lord , you children: praise the name of the Lord .
text_la: Laudate, pueri, Dominum; laudate nomen Domini.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Bem-aventurado o homem que teme ao SENHOR, que em seus mandamentos tem grande prazer.
text_el: αλληλουια αἰνεῖτε παῖδες κύριον αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου

text_en: Blessed be the name of the Lord , from henceforth now and for ever.
text_la: Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
text_pt: A sua semente será poderosa na terra; a geração dos retos será abençoada.
text_el: εἴη τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου εὐλογημένον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.
text_la: A solis ortu usque ad occasum laudabile nomen Domini.
text_pt: Prosperidade e riquezas haverá na sua casa, e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου μέχρι δυσμῶν αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου

text_en: The Lord is high above all nations; and his glory above the heavens .
text_la: Excelsus super omnes gentes Dominus, et super cælos gloria ejus.
text_pt: Aos justos nasce luz nas trevas; ele é piedoso, misericordioso e justo.
text_el: ὑψηλὸς ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who is as the Lord our God , who dwells on high:
text_la: Quis sicut Dominus Deus noster, qui in altis habitat,
text_pt: O homem bom se compadece, e empresta; disporá as suas coisas com juízo;
text_el: τίς ὡς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὁ ἐν ὑψηλοῖς κατοικῶν

text_en: And looks down on the low things in heaven and in earth?
text_la: et humilia respicit in cælo et in terra?
text_pt: Porque nunca será abalado; o justo estará em memória eterna.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: Raising up the needy from the earth, and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:
text_la: Suscitans a terra inopem, et de stercore erigens pauperem:
text_pt: Não temerá maus rumores; o seu coração está firme, confiando no Senhor.
text_el: ὁ ἐγείρων ἀπὸ γῆς πτωχὸν καὶ ἀπὸ κοπρίας ἀνυψῶν πένητα

text_en: That he may place him with princes, with the princes of his people.
text_la: ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui.
text_pt: O seu coração está bem confirmado, ele não temerá, até que veja o seu desejo sobre os seus inimigos.
text_el: τοῦ καθίσαι αὐτὸν μετὰ ἀρχόντων μετὰ ἀρχόντων λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who makes a barren woman to dwell in a house, the joyful mother of children.
text_la: Qui habitare facit sterilem in domo, matrem filiorum lætantem.
text_pt: Ele espalhou, deu aos necessitados; a sua justiça permanece para sempre, e a sua força se exaltará em glória.
text_el: ὁ κατοικίζων στεῖραν ἐν οἴκῳ μητέρα τέκνων εὐφραινομένην

text_en: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a barbarous people:
text_la: In exitu Israël de Ægypto, domus Jacob de populo barbaro,
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvai, servos do SENHOR, louvai o nome do SENHOR.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐν ἐξόδῳ Ισραηλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου οἴκου Ιακωβ ἐκ λαοῦ βαρβάρου

text_en: Judea was made his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
text_la: facta est Judæa sanctificatio ejus; Israël potestas ejus.
text_pt: Seja bendito o nome do Senhor, desde agora para sempre.
text_el: ἐγενήθη Ιουδαία ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ ἐξουσία αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sea saw and fled: Jordan was turned back.
text_la: Mare vidit, et fugit; Jordanis conversus est retrorsum.
text_pt: Desde o nascimento do sol até ao ocaso, seja louvado o nome do Senhor.
text_el: ἡ θάλασσα εἶδεν καὶ ἔφυγεν ὁ Ιορδάνης ἐστράφη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the hills like the lambs of the flock.
text_la: Montes exsultaverunt ut arietes, et colles sicut agni ovium.
text_pt: Exaltado está o Senhor acima de todas as nações, e a sua glória sobre os céus.
text_el: τὰ ὄρη ἐσκίρτησαν ὡσεὶ κριοὶ καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ ὡς ἀρνία προβάτων

text_en: What ailed you, O you sea, that you fled: and you, O Jordan , that you were turned back?
text_la: Quid est tibi, mare, quod fugisti? et tu, Jordanis, quia conversus es retrorsum?
text_pt: Quem é como o Senhor nosso Deus, que habita nas alturas?
text_el: τί σοί ἐστιν θάλασσα ὅτι ἔφυγες καὶ σοί Ιορδάνη ὅτι ἀνεχώρησας εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: You mountains, that you skipped like rams, and you hills, like lambs of the flock?
text_la: montes, exsultastis sicut arietes? et colles, sicut agni ovium?
text_pt: O qual se inclina, para ver o que está nos céus e na terra!
text_el: τὰ ὄρη ὅτι ἐσκιρτήσατε ὡσεὶ κριοί καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ ὡς ἀρνία προβάτων

text_en: At the presence of the Lord the earth was moved, at the presence of the God of Jacob :
text_la: A facie Domini mota est terra, a facie Dei Jacob:
text_pt: Levanta o pobre do pó e do monturo levanta o necessitado,
text_el: ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ Ιακωβ

text_en: Who turned the rock into pools of water, and the stony hill into fountains of waters.
text_la: qui convertit petram in stagna aquarum, et rupem in fontes aquarum.
text_pt: Para o fazer assentar com os príncipes, mesmo com os príncipes do seu povo.
text_el: τοῦ στρέψαντος τὴν πέτραν εἰς λίμνας ὑδάτων καὶ τὴν ἀκρότομον εἰς πηγὰς ὑδάτων

text_en: Not to us, O Lord , not to us; but to your name give glory .
text_la: Non nobis, Domine, non nobis, sed nomini tuo da gloriam:
text_pt: Faz com que a mulher estéril habite em casa, e seja alegre mãe de filhos. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: μὴ ἡμῖν κύριε μὴ ἡμῖν ἀλλ' ἢ τῷ ὀνόματί σου δὸς δόξαν ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου

text_en: For your mercy, and for your truth's sake: lest the Gentiles should say: Where is their God ?
text_la: super misericordia tua et veritate tua; nequando dicant gentes : Ubi est Deus eorum?
text_el: μήποτε εἴπωσιν τὰ ἔθνη ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: But our God is in heaven : he has done all things whatsoever he would.
text_la: Deus autem noster in cælo; omnia quæcumque voluit fecit.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν

text_en: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, the works of the hands of men .
text_la: Simulacra gentium argentum et aurum, opera manuum hominum.
text_el: τὰ εἴδωλα τῶν ἐθνῶν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: They have mouths and speak not: they have eyes and see not.
text_la: Os habent, et non loquentur; oculos habent, et non videbunt.
text_el: στόμα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ λαλήσουσιν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὄψονται

text_en: They have ears and hear not: they have noses and smell not.
text_la: Aures habent, et non audient; nares habent, et non odorabunt.
text_el: ὦτα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ἀκούσονται ῥῖνας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὀσφρανθήσονται

text_en: They have hands and feel not: they have feet and walk not: neither shall they cry out through their throat.
text_la: Manus habent, et non palpabunt; pedes habent, et non ambulabunt; non clamabunt in gutture suo.
text_el: χεῖρας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ ψηλαφήσουσιν πόδας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ περιπατήσουσιν οὐ φωνήσουσιν ἐν τῷ λάρυγγι αὐτῶν

text_en: Let them that make them become like unto them: and all such as trust in them.
text_la: Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea, et omnes qui confidunt in eis.
text_el: ὅμοιοι αὐτοῖς γένοιντο οἱ ποιοῦντες αὐτὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord : he is their helper and their protector.
text_la: Domus Israël speravit in Domino; adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
text_el: οἶκος Ισραηλ ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ κύριον βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν

text_en: The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord : he is their helper and their protector.
text_la: Domus Aaron speravit in Domino; adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
text_el: οἶκος Ααρων ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ κύριον βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν

text_en: They that fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord : he is their helper and their protector.
text_la: Qui timent Dominum speraverunt in Domino; adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον ἤλπισαν ἐπὶ κύριον βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν

text_en: The Lord has been mindful of us, and has blessed us. He has blessed the house of Israel : he has blessed the house of Aaron .
text_la: Dominus memor fuit nostri, et benedixit nobis. Benedixit domui Israël; benedixit domui Aaron.
text_el: κύριος ἐμνήσθη ἡμῶν καὶ εὐλόγησεν ἡμᾶς εὐλόγησεν τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ εὐλόγησεν τὸν οἶκον Ααρων

text_en: He has blessed all that fear the Lord , both little and great.
text_la: Benedixit omnibus qui timent Dominum, pusillis cum majoribus.
text_el: εὐλόγησεν τοὺς φοβουμένους τὸν κύριον τοὺς μικροὺς μετὰ τῶν μεγάλων

text_en: May the Lord add blessings upon you: upon you, and upon your children.
text_la: Adjiciat Dominus super vos, super vos et super filios vestros.
text_el: προσθείη κύριος ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς ὑμῶν

text_en: Blessed be you of the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
text_la: Benedicti vos a Domino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text_el: εὐλογημένοι ὑμεῖς τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ ποιήσαντι τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: The heaven of heaven is the Lord's : but the earth he has given to the children of men .
text_la: Cælum cæli Domino; terram autem dedit filiis hominum.
text_el: ὁ οὐρανὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ τὴν δὲ γῆν ἔδωκεν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: The dead shall not praise you, O Lord : nor any of them that go down to hell.
text_la: Non mortui laudabunt te, Domine, neque omnes qui descendunt in infernum:
text_el: οὐχ οἱ νεκροὶ αἰνέσουσίν σε κύριε οὐδὲ πάντες οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: But we that live bless the Lord : from this time now and for ever.
text_la: sed nos qui vivimus, benedicimus Domino, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες εὐλογήσομεν τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: I have loved , because the Lord will hear the voice of my prayer .
text_la: Dilexi, quoniam exaudiet Dominus vocem orationis meæ.
text_pt: Quando Israel saiu do Egito, e a casa de Jacó de um povo de língua estranha,
text_el: αλληλουια ἠγάπησα ὅτι εἰσακούσεται κύριος τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: Because he has inclined his ear unto me: and in my days I will call upon him.
text_la: Quia inclinavit aurem suam mihi, et in diebus meis invocabo.
text_pt: Judá foi seu santuário, e Israel seu domínio.
text_el: ὅτι ἔκλινεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ ἐμοί καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου ἐπικαλέσομαι

text_en: The sorrows of death have compassed me: and the perils of hell have found me. I met with trouble and sorrow:
text_la: Circumdederunt me dolores mortis; et pericula inferni invenerunt me. Tribulationem et dolorem inveni,
text_pt: O mar viu isto, e fugiu; o Jordão voltou para trás.
text_el: περιέσχον με ὠδῖνες θανάτου κίνδυνοι ᾅδου εὕροσάν με θλῖψιν καὶ ὀδύνην εὗρον

text_en: And I called upon the name of the Lord . O Lord , deliver my soul .
text_la: et nomen Domini invocavi : o Domine, libera animam meam.
text_pt: Os montes saltaram como carneiros, e os outeiros como cordeiros.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἐπεκαλεσάμην ὦ κύριε ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: The Lord is merciful and just , and our God shows mercy.
text_la: Misericors Dominus et justus, et Deus noster miseretur.
text_pt: Que tiveste tu, ó mar, que fugiste, e tu, ó Jordão, que voltaste para trás?
text_el: ἐλεήμων ὁ κύριος καὶ δίκαιος καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐλεᾷ

text_en: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: I was humbled , and he delivered me.
text_la: Custodiens parvulos Dominus; humiliatus sum, et liberavit me.
text_pt: Montes, que saltastes como carneiros, e outeiros, como cordeiros?
text_el: φυλάσσων τὰ νήπια ὁ κύριος ἐταπεινώθην καὶ ἔσωσέν με

text_en: Turn, O my soul , into your rest: for the Lord has been bountiful to you.
text_la: Convertere, anima mea, in requiem tuam, quia Dominus benefecit tibi:
text_pt: Treme, terra, na presença do Senhor, na presença do Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὴν ἀνάπαυσίν σου ὅτι κύριος εὐηργέτησέν σε

text_en: For he has delivered my soul from death: my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.
text_la: quia eripuit animam meam de morte, oculos meos a lacrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
text_pt: O qual converteu o rochedo em lago de águas, e o seixo em fonte de água.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξείλατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἀπὸ δακρύων καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ἀπὸ ὀλισθήματος

text_en: I will please the Lord in the land of the living.
text_la: Placebo Domino in regione vivorum.
text_el: εὐαρεστήσω ἐναντίον κυρίου ἐν χώρᾳ ζώντων

text_en: Alleluia . I have believed , therefore have I spoken; but I have been humbled exceedingly.
text_la: Alleluja. Credidi, propter quod locutus sum; ego autem humiliatus sum nimis.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐπίστευσα διὸ ἐλάλησα ἐγὼ δὲ ἐταπεινώθην σφόδρα

text_en: I said in my excess: Every man is a liar .
text_la: Ego dixi in excessu meo : Omnis homo mendax.
text_el: ἐγὼ εἶπα ἐν τῇ ἐκστάσει μου πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης

text_en: What shall I render to the Lord , for all the things that he has rendered to me?
text_la: Quid retribuam Domino pro omnibus quæ retribuit mihi?
text_el: τί ἀνταποδώσω τῷ κυρίῳ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἀνταπέδωκέν μοι

text_en: I will take the chalice of salvation ; and I will call upon the name of the Lord .
text_la: Calicem salutaris accipiam, et nomen Domini invocabo.
text_el: ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήμψομαι καὶ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἐπικαλέσομαι

text_en: I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people:
text_la: Vota mea Domino reddam coram omni populo ejus.

text_en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints .
text_la: Pretiosa in conspectu Domini mors sanctorum ejus.
text_el: τίμιος ἐναντίον κυρίου ὁ θάνατος τῶν ὁσίων αὐτοῦ

text_en: O Lord , for I am your servant: I am your servant, and the son of your handmaid. You have broken my bonds:
text_la: O Domine, quia ego servus tuus; ego servus tuus, et filius ancillæ tuæ. Dirupisti vincula mea:
text_el: ὦ κύριε ἐγὼ δοῦλος σός ἐγὼ δοῦλος σὸς καὶ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης σου διέρρηξας τοὺς δεσμούς μου

text_en: I will sacrifice to you the sacrifice of praise, and I will call upon the name of the Lord .
text_la: tibi sacrificabo hostiam laudis, et nomen Domini invocabo.
text_el: σοὶ θύσω θυσίαν αἰνέσεως

text_en: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all his people:
text_la: Vota mea Domino reddam in conspectu omnis populi ejus;
text_el: τὰς εὐχάς μου τῷ κυρίῳ ἀποδώσω ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: In the courts of the house of the Lord , in the midst of you, O Jerusalem .
text_la: in atriis domus Domini, in medio tui, Jerusalem.
text_el: ἐν αὐλαῖς οἴκου κυρίου ἐν μέσῳ σου Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: O Praise the Lord , all you nations: praise him, all you people.
text_la: Laudate Dominum, omnes gentes; laudate eum, omnes populi.
text_pt: Amo ao SENHOR, porque ele ouviu a minha voz e a minha súplica.
text_el: αλληλουια αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐπαινέσατε αὐτόν πάντες οἱ λαοί

text_en: For his mercy is confirmed upon us: and the truth of the Lord remains for ever.
text_la: Quoniam confirmata est super nos misericordia ejus, et veritas Domini manet in æternum.
text_pt: Porque inclinou a mim os seus ouvidos; portanto, o invocarei enquanto viver.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Give praise to the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR todas as nações, louvai-o todos os povos.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι ἀγαθός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let Israel now say, that he is good : that his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Dicat nunc Israël : Quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Porque a sua benignidade é grande para conosco, e a verdade do Senhor dura para sempre. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: εἰπάτω δὴ οἶκος Ισραηλ ὅτι ἀγαθός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Dicat nunc domus Aaron : Quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_el: εἰπάτω δὴ οἶκος Ααρων ὅτι ἀγαθός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let them that fear the Lord now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Dicant nunc qui timent Dominum : Quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_el: εἰπάτωσαν δὴ πάντες οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον ὅτι ἀγαθός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: In my trouble I called upon the Lord : and the Lord heard me, and enlarged me.
text_la: De tribulatione invocavi Dominum, et exaudivit me in latitudine Dominus.
text_el: ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐπήκουσέν μου εἰς πλατυσμόν

text_en: The Lord is my helper: I will not fear what man can do unto me.
text_la: Dominus mihi adjutor; non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
text_el: κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος

text_en: The Lord is my helper: and I will look over my enemies.
text_la: Dominus mihi adjutor, et ego despiciam inimicos meos.
text_el: κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός κἀγὼ ἐπόψομαι τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου

text_en: It is good to confide in the Lord , rather than to have confidence in man .
text_la: Bonum est confidere in Domino, quam confidere in homine.
text_el: ἀγαθὸν πεποιθέναι ἐπὶ κύριον ἢ πεποιθέναι ἐπ' ἄνθρωπον

text_en: It is good to trust in the Lord , rather than to trust in princes.
text_la: Bonum est sperare in Domino, quam sperare in principibus.
text_el: ἀγαθὸν ἐλπίζειν ἐπὶ κύριον ἢ ἐλπίζειν ἐπ' ἄρχοντας

text_en: All nations compassed me about; and, in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.
text_la: Omnes gentes circuierunt me, et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐκύκλωσάν με καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς

text_en: Surrounding me they compassed me about: and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.
text_la: Circumdantes circumdederunt me, et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos.
text_el: κυκλώσαντες ἐκύκλωσάν με καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς

text_en: They surrounded me like bees, and they burned like fire among thorns: and in the name of the Lord I was revenged on them.
text_la: Circumdederunt me sicut apes, et exarserunt sicut ignis in spinis : et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos.
text_el: ἐκύκλωσάν με ὡσεὶ μέλισσαι κηρίον καὶ ἐξεκαύθησαν ὡσεὶ πῦρ ἐν ἀκάνθαις καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς

text_en: Being pushed I was overturned that I might fall: but the Lord supported me.
text_la: Impulsus eversus sum, ut caderem, et Dominus suscepit me.
text_el: ὠσθεὶς ἀνετράπην τοῦ πεσεῖν καὶ ὁ κύριος ἀντελάβετό μου

text_en: The Lord is my strength and my praise: and he has become my salvation .
text_la: Fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus, et factus est mihi in salutem.
text_el: ἰσχύς μου καὶ ὕμνησίς μου ὁ κύριος καὶ ἐγένετό μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν

text_en: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation is in the tabernacles of the just .
text_la: Vox exsultationis et salutis in tabernaculis justorum.
text_el: φωνὴ ἀγαλλιάσεως καὶ σωτηρίας ἐν σκηναῖς δικαίων δεξιὰ κυρίου ἐποίησεν δύναμιν

text_en: The right hand of the Lord has wrought strength: the right hand of the Lord has exalted me: the right hand of the Lord has wrought strength.
text_la: Dextera Domini fecit virtutem; dextera Domini exaltavit me : dextera Domini fecit virtutem.
text_el: δεξιὰ κυρίου ὕψωσέν με δεξιὰ κυρίου ἐποίησεν δύναμιν

text_en: I shall not die, but live: and shall declare the works of the Lord .
text_la: Non moriar, sed vivam, et narrabo opera Domini.
text_el: οὐκ ἀποθανοῦμαι ἀλλὰ ζήσομαι καὶ ἐκδιηγήσομαι τὰ ἔργα κυρίου

text_en: The Lord chastising has chastised me: but he has not delivered me over to death.
text_la: Castigans castigavit me Dominus, et morti non tradidit me.
text_el: παιδεύων ἐπαίδευσέν με ὁ κύριος καὶ τῷ θανάτῳ οὐ παρέδωκέν με

text_en: Open to me the gates of justice : I will go in to them, and give praise to the Lord .
text_la: Aperite mihi portas justitiæ: ingressus in eas confitebor Domino.
text_el: ἀνοίξατέ μοι πύλας δικαιοσύνης εἰσελθὼν ἐν αὐταῖς ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: This is the gate of the Lord , the just shall enter into it.
text_la: Hæc porta Domini : justi intrabunt in eam.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ πύλη τοῦ κυρίου δίκαιοι εἰσελεύσονται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: I will give glory to you because you have heard me: and have become my salvation .
text_la: Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, et factus es mihi in salutem.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ὅτι ἐπήκουσάς μου καὶ ἐγένου μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν

text_en: The stone which the builders rejected; the same has become the head of the corner .
text_la: Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli.
text_el: λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας

text_en: This is the Lord's doing, and it is wonderful in our eyes.
text_la: A Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris.
text_el: παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν

text_en: This is the day which the Lord has made: let us be glad and rejoice therein.
text_la: Hæc est dies quam fecit Dominus; exsultemus, et lætemur in ea.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα ἣν ἐποίησεν ὁ κύριος ἀγαλλιασώμεθα καὶ εὐφρανθῶμεν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: O Lord , save me: O Lord , give good success.
text_la: O Domine, salvum me fac; o Domine, bene prosperare.
text_el: ὦ κύριε σῶσον δή ὦ κύριε εὐόδωσον δή

text_en: Blessed be he that comes in the name of the Lord . We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord .
text_la: Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini : benediximus vobis de domo Domini.
text_el: εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου εὐλογήκαμεν ὑμᾶς ἐξ οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: The Lord is God , and he has shone upon us. Appoint a solemn day, with shady boughs, even to the horn of the altar .
text_la: Deus Dominus, et illuxit nobis. Constituite diem solemnem in condensis, usque ad cornu altaris.
text_el: θεὸς κύριος καὶ ἐπέφανεν ἡμῖν συστήσασθε ἑορτὴν ἐν τοῖς πυκάζουσιν ἕως τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: You are my God , and I will praise you: you are my God , and I will exalt you. I will praise you, because you have heard me, and have become my salvation .
text_la: Deus meus es tu, et confitebor tibi; Deus meus es tu, et exaltabo te. Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, et factus es mihi in salutem.
text_el: θεός μου εἶ σύ καὶ ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι θεός μου εἶ σύ καὶ ὑψώσω σε ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ὅτι ἐπήκουσάς μου καὶ ἐγένου μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν

text_en: O praise the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι ἀγαθός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Aleph. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord .
text_la: Aleph. Beati immaculati in via, qui ambulant in lege Domini.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: αλφ. μακάριοι οἱ ἄμωμοι ἐν ὁδῷ οἱ πορευόμενοι ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου

text_en: Blessed are they that search his testimonies: that seek him with their whole heart.
text_la: Beati qui scrutantur testimonia ejus; in toto corde exquirunt eum.
text_pt: Diga agora Israel que a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ ἐξερευνῶντες τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ ἐκζητήσουσιν αὐτόν

text_en: For they that work iniquity , have not walked in his ways.
text_la: Non enim qui operantur iniquitatem in viis ejus ambulaverunt.
text_pt: Diga agora a casa de Arão que a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύθησαν

text_en: You have commanded your commandments to be kept most diligently.
text_la: Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis.
text_pt: Digam agora os que temem ao Senhor que a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: σὺ ἐνετείλω τὰς ἐντολάς σου φυλάξασθαι σφόδρα

text_en: O! That my ways may be directed to keep your justifications.
text_la: Utinam dirigantur viæ meæ ad custodiendas justificationes tuas.
text_pt: Invoquei o Senhor na angústia; o Senhor me ouviu, e me tirou para um lugar largo.
text_el: ὄφελον κατευθυνθείησαν αἱ ὁδοί μου τοῦ φυλάξασθαι τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: Then shall I not be confounded, when I shall look into all your commandments.
text_la: Tunc non confundar, cum perspexero in omnibus mandatis tuis.
text_pt: O Senhor está comigo; não temerei o que me pode fazer o homem.
text_el: τότε οὐ μὴ ἐπαισχυνθῶ ἐν τῷ με ἐπιβλέπειν ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: I will praise you with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned the judgments of your justice .
text_la: Confitebor tibi in directione cordis, in eo quod didici judicia justitiæ tuæ.
text_pt: O Senhor está comigo entre aqueles que me ajudam; por isso verei cumprido o meu desejo sobre os que me odeiam.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν εὐθύτητι καρδίας ἐν τῷ μεμαθηκέναι με τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: I will keep your justifications: O! Do not utterly forsake me.
text_la: Justificationes tuas custodiam; non me derelinquas usquequaque.
text_pt: É melhor confiar no Senhor do que confiar no homem.
text_el: τὰ δικαιώματά σου φυλάξω μή με ἐγκαταλίπῃς ἕως σφόδρα

text_en: Beth. By what does a young man correct his way? By observing your words.
text_la: Beth. In quo corrigit adolescentior viam suam? in custodiendo sermones tuos.
text_pt: É melhor confiar no Senhor do que confiar nos príncipes.
text_el: βηθ. ἐν τίνι κατορθώσει ὁ νεώτερος τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φυλάσσεσθαι τοὺς λόγους σου

text_en: With my whole heart have I sought after you: let me not stray from your commandments.
text_la: In toto corde meo exquisivi te; ne repellas me a mandatis tuis.
text_pt: Todas as nações me cercaram, mas no nome do Senhor as despedaçarei.
text_el: ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ἐξεζήτησά σε μὴ ἀπώσῃ με ἀπὸ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου

text_en: Your words have I hidden in my heart, that I may not sin against you.
text_la: In corde meo abscondi eloquia tua, ut non peccem tibi.
text_pt: Cercaram-me, e tornaram a cercar-me; mas no nome do Senhor eu as despedaçarei.
text_el: ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου ἔκρυψα τὰ λόγιά σου ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἁμάρτω σοι

text_en: Blessed are you, O Lord : teach me your justifications.
text_la: Benedictus es, Domine; doce me justificationes tuas.
text_pt: Cercaram-me como abelhas; porém apagaram-se como o fogo de espinhos; pois no nome do Senhor as despedaçarei.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς εἶ κύριε δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: With my lips I have pronounced all the judgments of your mouth.
text_la: In labiis meis pronuntiavi omnia judicia oris tui.
text_pt: Com força me impeliste para me fazeres cair, porém o Senhor me ajudou.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς χείλεσίν μου ἐξήγγειλα πάντα τὰ κρίματα τοῦ στόματός σου

text_en: I have been delighted in the way of your testimonies, as in all riches.
text_la: In via testimoniorum tuorum delectatus sum, sicut in omnibus divitiis.
text_pt: O Senhor é a minha força e o meu cântico; e se fez a minha salvação.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τῶν μαρτυρίων σου ἐτέρφθην ὡς ἐπὶ παντὶ πλούτῳ

text_en: I will meditate on your commandments: and I will consider your ways.
text_la: In mandatis tuis exercebor, et considerabo vias tuas.
text_pt: Nas tendas dos justos há voz de júbilo e de salvação; a destra do Senhor faz proezas.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου ἀδολεσχήσω καὶ κατανοήσω τὰς ὁδούς σου

text_en: I will think of your justifications: I will not forget your words.
text_la: In justificationibus tuis meditabor : non obliviscar sermones tuos.
text_pt: A destra do Senhor se exalta; a destra do Senhor faz proezas.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου μελετήσω οὐκ ἐπιλήσομαι τῶν λόγων σου

text_en: Gimel. Give bountifully to your servant, enliven me: and I shall keep your words.
text_la: Ghimel. Retribue servo tuo, vivifica me, et custodiam sermones tuos.
text_pt: Não morrerei, mas viverei; e contarei as obras do Senhor.
text_el: γιμαλ. ἀνταπόδος τῷ δούλῳ σου ζήσομαι καὶ φυλάξω τοὺς λόγους σου

text_en: Open my eyes: and I will consider the wondrous things of your law.
text_la: Revela oculos meos, et considerabo mirabilia de lege tua.
text_pt: O Senhor me castigou muito, mas não me entregou à morte.
text_el: ἀποκάλυψον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ κατανοήσω τὰ θαυμάσιά σου ἐκ τοῦ νόμου σου
