text_en: I am a sojourner on the earth: hide not your commandments from me.
text_la: Incola ego sum in terra : non abscondas a me mandata tua.
text_pt: Abri-me as portas da justiça; entrarei por elas, e louvarei ao Senhor.
text_el: πάροικος ἐγώ εἰμι ἐν τῇ γῇ μὴ ἀποκρύψῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: My soul has coveted to long for your justifications, at all times.
text_la: Concupivit anima mea desiderare justificationes tuas in omni tempore.
text_pt: Esta é a porta do Senhor, pela qual os justos entrarão.
text_el: ἐπεπόθησεν ἡ ψυχή μου τοῦ ἐπιθυμῆσαι τὰ κρίματά σου ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ

text_en: You have rebuked the proud : they are cursed who decline from your commandments.
text_la: Increpasti superbos; maledicti qui declinant a mandatis tuis.
text_pt: Louvar-te-ei, pois me escutaste, e te fizeste a minha salvação.
text_el: ἐπετίμησας ὑπερηφάνοις ἐπικατάρατοι οἱ ἐκκλίνοντες ἀπὸ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου

text_en: Remove from me reproach and contempt : because I have sought after your testimonies.
text_la: Aufer a me opprobrium et contemptum, quia testimonia tua exquisivi.
text_pt: A pedra que os edificadores rejeitaram tornou-se a cabeça da esquina.
text_el: περίελε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὄνειδος καὶ ἐξουδένωσιν ὅτι τὰ μαρτύριά σου ἐξεζήτησα

text_en: For princes sat, and spoke against me: but your servant was employed in your justifications.
text_la: Etenim sederunt principes, et adversum me loquebantur; servus autem tuus exercebatur in justificationibus tuis.
text_pt: Da parte do Senhor se fez isto; maravilhoso é aos nossos olhos.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐκάθισαν ἄρχοντες καὶ κατ' ἐμοῦ κατελάλουν ὁ δὲ δοῦλός σου ἠδολέσχει ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου

text_en: For your testimonies are my meditation: and your justifications my counsel.
text_la: Nam et testimonia tua meditatio mea est, et consilium meum justificationes tuæ.
text_pt: Este é o dia que fez o Senhor; regozijemo-nos, e alegremo-nos nele.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ τὰ μαρτύριά σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν καὶ αἱ συμβουλίαι μου τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: Daleth. My soul has cleaved to the pavement: quicken me according to your word.
text_la: Daleth. Adhæsit pavimento anima mea : vivifica me secundum verbum tuum.
text_pt: Salva-nos, agora, te pedimos, ó Senhor; ó Senhor, te pedimos, prospera-nos.
text_el: δελθ. ἐκολλήθη τῷ ἐδάφει ἡ ψυχή μου ζῆσόν με κατὰ τὸν λόγον σου

text_en: I have declared my ways, and you have heard me: teach me your justifications.
text_la: Vias meas enuntiavi, et exaudisti me; doce me justificationes tuas.
text_pt: Bendito aquele que vem em nome do Senhor; nós vos bendizemos desde a casa do Senhor.
text_el: τὰς ὁδούς μου ἐξήγγειλα καὶ ἐπήκουσάς μου δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: Make me to understand the way of your justifications: and I shall be exercised in your wondrous works.
text_la: Viam justificationum tuarum instrue me, et exercebor in mirabilibus tuis.
text_pt: Deus é o Senhor que nos mostrou a luz; atai a vítima da festa com cordas, até às pontas do altar.
text_el: ὁδὸν δικαιωμάτων σου συνέτισόν με καὶ ἀδολεσχήσω ἐν τοῖς θαυμασίοις σου

text_en: My soul has slumbered through heaviness: strengthen me in your words.
text_la: Dormitavit anima mea præ tædio : confirma me in verbis tuis.
text_pt: Tu és o meu Deus, e eu te louvarei; tu és o meu Deus, e eu te exaltarei.
text_el: ἔσταξεν ἡ ψυχή μου ἀπὸ ἀκηδίας βεβαίωσόν με ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου

text_en: Remove from me the way of iniquity : and out of your law have mercy on me.
text_la: Viam iniquitatis amove a me, et de lege tua miserere mei.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor, porque ele é bom; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: ὁδὸν ἀδικίας ἀπόστησον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ τῷ νόμῳ σου ἐλέησόν με

text_en: I have chosen the way of truth : your judgments I have not forgotten.
text_la: Viam veritatis elegi; judicia tua non sum oblitus.
text_el: ὁδὸν ἀληθείας ᾑρετισάμην τὰ κρίματά σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: I have stuck to your testimonies, O Lord : put me not to shame.
text_la: Adhæsi testimoniis tuis, Domine; noli me confundere.
text_el: ἐκολλήθην τοῖς μαρτυρίοις σου κύριε μή με καταισχύνῃς

text_en: I have run the way of your commandments, when you did enlarge my heart.
text_la: Viam mandatorum tuorum cucurri, cum dilatasti cor meum.
text_el: ὁδὸν ἐντολῶν σου ἔδραμον ὅταν ἐπλάτυνας τὴν καρδίαν μου

text_en: He. Set before me for a law the way of your justifications, O Lord : and I will always seek after it.
text_la: He. Legem pone mihi, Domine, viam justificationum tuarum, et exquiram eam semper.
text_el: η. νομοθέτησόν με κύριε τὴν ὁδὸν τῶν δικαιωμάτων σου καὶ ἐκζητήσω αὐτὴν διὰ παντός

text_en: Give me understanding, and I will search your law; and I will keep it with my whole heart.
text_la: Da mihi intellectum, et scrutabor legem tuam, et custodiam illam in toto corde meo.
text_el: συνέτισόν με καὶ ἐξερευνήσω τὸν νόμον σου καὶ φυλάξω αὐτὸν ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου

text_en: Lead me into the path of your commandments; for this same I have desired.
text_la: Deduc me in semitam mandatorum tuorum, quia ipsam volui.
text_el: ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τρίβῳ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου ὅτι αὐτὴν ἠθέλησα

text_en: Incline my heart into your testimonies and not to covetousness .
text_la: Inclina cor meum in testimonia tua, et non in avaritiam.
text_el: κλῖνον τὴν καρδίαν μου εἰς τὰ μαρτύριά σου καὶ μὴ εἰς πλεονεξίαν

text_en: Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: quicken me in your way.
text_la: Averte oculos meos, ne videant vanitatem; in via tua vivifica me.
text_el: ἀπόστρεψον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου τοῦ μὴ ἰδεῖν ματαιότητα ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: Establish your word to your servant, in your fear.
text_la: Statue servo tuo eloquium tuum in timore tuo.
text_el: στῆσον τῷ δούλῳ σου τὸ λόγιόν σου εἰς τὸν φόβον σου

text_en: Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: for your judgments are delightful.
text_la: Amputa opprobrium meum quod suspicatus sum, quia judicia tua jucunda.
text_el: περίελε τὸν ὀνειδισμόν μου ὃν ὑπώπτευσα τὰ γὰρ κρίματά σου χρηστά

text_en: Behold I have longed after your precepts : quicken me in your justice .
text_la: Ecce concupivi mandata tua : in æquitate tua vivifica me.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐπεθύμησα τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: Vau. Let your mercy also come upon me, O Lord : your salvation according to your word.
text_la: Vau. Et veniat super me misericordia tua, Domine; salutare tuum secundum eloquium tuum.
text_el: ουαυ. καὶ ἔλθοι ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὸ ἔλεός σου κύριε τὸ σωτήριόν σου κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου

text_en: So shall I answer them that reproach me in anything; that I have trusted in your words.
text_la: Et respondebo exprobrantibus mihi verbum, quia speravi in sermonibus tuis.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθήσομαι τοῖς ὀνειδίζουσί με λόγον ὅτι ἤλπισα ἐπὶ τοὺς λόγους σου

text_en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: for in your words, I have hoped exceedingly.
text_la: Et ne auferas de ore meo verbum veritatis usquequaque, quia in judiciis tuis supersperavi.
text_el: καὶ μὴ περιέλῃς ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου λόγον ἀληθείας ἕως σφόδρα ὅτι ἐπὶ τὰ κρίματά σου ἐπήλπισα

text_en: So shall I always keep your law, for ever and ever.
text_la: Et custodiam legem tuam semper, in sæculum et in sæculum sæculi.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξω τὸν νόμον σου διὰ παντός εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: And I walked at large: because I have sought after your commandments.
text_la: Et ambulabam in latitudine, quia mandata tua exquisivi.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορευόμην ἐν πλατυσμῷ ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἐξεζήτησα

text_en: And I spoke of your testimonies before kings: and I was not ashamed.
text_la: Et loquebar in testimoniis tuis in conspectu regum, et non confundebar.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλουν ἐν τοῖς μαρτυρίοις σου ἐναντίον βασιλέων καὶ οὐκ ᾐσχυνόμην

text_en: I meditated also on your commandments, which I loved .
text_la: Et meditabar in mandatis tuis, quæ dilexi.
text_el: καὶ ἐμελέτων ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου αἷς ἠγάπησα σφόδρα

text_en: And I lifted up my hands to your commandments, which I loved : and I was exercised in your justifications.
text_la: Et levavi manus meas ad mandata tua, quæ dilexi, et exercebar in justificationibus tuis.
text_el: καὶ ἦρα τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἃς ἠγάπησα καὶ ἠδολέσχουν ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου

text_en: Zain. Be mindful of your word to your servant, in which you have given me hope .
text_la: Zain. Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, in quo mihi spem dedisti.
text_el: ζαι. μνήσθητι τὸν λόγον σου τῷ δούλῳ σου ᾧ ἐπήλπισάς με

text_en: This has comforted me in my humiliation: because your word has enlivened me.
text_la: Hæc me consolata est in humilitate mea, quia eloquium tuum vivificavit me.
text_el: αὕτη με παρεκάλεσεν ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει μου ὅτι τὸ λόγιόν σου ἔζησέν με

text_en: The proud did iniquitously altogether: but I declined not from your law.
text_la: Superbi inique agebant usquequaque; a lege autem tua non declinavi.
text_el: ὑπερήφανοι παρηνόμουν ἕως σφόδρα ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ νόμου σου οὐκ ἐξέκλινα

text_en: I remembered, O Lord , your judgments of old: and I was comforted.
text_la: Memor fui judiciorum tuorum a sæculo, Domine, et consolatus sum.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην τῶν κριμάτων σου ἀπ' αἰῶνος κύριε καὶ παρεκλήθην

text_en: A fainting has taken hold of me, because of the wicked that forsake your law.
text_la: Defectio tenuit me, pro peccatoribus derelinquentibus legem tuam.
text_el: ἀθυμία κατέσχεν με ἀπὸ ἁμαρτωλῶν τῶν ἐγκαταλιμπανόντων τὸν νόμον σου

text_en: Your justifications were the subject of my song, in the place of my pilgrimage.
text_la: Cantabiles mihi erant justificationes tuæ in loco peregrinationis meæ.
text_el: ψαλτὰ ἦσάν μοι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐν τόπῳ παροικίας μου

text_en: In the night I have remembered your name , O Lord : and have kept your law.
text_la: Memor fui nocte nominis tui, Domine, et custodivi legem tuam.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην ἐν νυκτὶ τοῦ ὀνόματός σου κύριε καὶ ἐφύλαξα τὸν νόμον σου

text_en: This happened to me: because I sought after your justifications.
text_la: Hæc facta est mihi, quia justificationes tuas exquisivi.
text_el: αὕτη ἐγενήθη μοι ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐξεζήτησα

text_en: Heth. O Lord , my portion, I have said, I would keep your law.
text_la: Heth. Portio mea, Domine, dixi custodire legem tuam.
text_el: ηθ. μερίς μου κύριε εἶπα φυλάξασθαι τὸν νόμον σου

text_en: I entreated your face with all my heart: have mercy on me according to your word.
text_la: Deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo; miserere mei secundum eloquium tuum.
text_el: ἐδεήθην τοῦ προσώπου σου ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ἐλέησόν με κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου

text_en: I have thought on my ways: and turned my feet unto your testimonies.
text_la: Cogitavi vias meas, et converti pedes meos in testimonia tua.
text_el: διελογισάμην τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἐπέστρεψα τοὺς πόδας μου εἰς τὰ μαρτύριά σου

text_en: I am ready, and am not troubled: that I may keep your commandments.
text_la: Paratus sum, et non sum turbatus, ut custodiam mandata tua.
text_el: ἡτοιμάσθην καὶ οὐκ ἐταράχθην τοῦ φυλάξασθαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: but I have not forgotten your law.
text_la: Funes peccatorum circumplexi sunt me, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.
text_el: σχοινία ἁμαρτωλῶν περιεπλάκησάν μοι καὶ τοῦ νόμου σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: I rose at midnight to give praise to you; for the judgments of your justification.
text_la: Media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi, super judicia justificationis tuæ.
text_el: μεσονύκτιον ἐξηγειρόμην τοῦ ἐξομολογεῖσθαί σοι ἐπὶ τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: I am a partaker with all them that fear you, and that keep your commandments.
text_la: Particeps ego sum omnium timentium te, et custodientium mandata tua.
text_el: μέτοχος ἐγώ εἰμι πάντων τῶν φοβουμένων σε καὶ τῶν φυλασσόντων τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: The earth, O Lord , is full of your mercy: teach me your justifications.
text_la: Misericordia tua, Domine, plena est terra; justificationes tuas doce me.
text_el: τοῦ ἐλέους σου κύριε πλήρης ἡ γῆ τὰ δικαιώματά σου δίδαξόν με

text_en: Teth. You have done well with your servant, O Lord , according to your word.
text_la: Teth. Bonitatem fecisti cum servo tuo, Domine, secundum verbum tuum.
text_el: τηθ. χρηστότητα ἐποίησας μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου κύριε κατὰ τὸν λόγον σου

text_en: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge ; for I have believed your commandments.
text_la: Bonitatem, et disciplinam, et scientiam doce me, quia mandatis tuis credidi.
text_el: χρηστότητα καὶ παιδείαν καὶ γνῶσιν δίδαξόν με ὅτι ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου ἐπίστευσα

text_en: Before I was humbled I offended; therefore have I kept your word.
text_la: Priusquam humiliarer ego deliqui : propterea eloquium tuum custodivi.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ με ταπεινωθῆναι ἐγὼ ἐπλημμέλησα διὰ τοῦτο τὸ λόγιόν σου ἐφύλαξα

text_en: You are good ; and in your goodness teach me your justifications.
text_la: Bonus es tu, et in bonitate tua doce me justificationes tuas.
text_el: χρηστὸς εἶ σύ κύριε καὶ ἐν τῇ χρηστότητί σου δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: The iniquity of the proud has been multiplied over me: but I will seek your commandments with my whole heart.
text_la: Multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum; ego autem in toto corde meo scrutabor mandata tua.
text_el: ἐπληθύνθη ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἀδικία ὑπερηφάνων ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ἐξερευνήσω τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: Their heart is curdled like milk: but I have meditated on your law.
text_la: Coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum; ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum.
text_el: ἐτυρώθη ὡς γάλα ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἐγὼ δὲ τὸν νόμον σου ἐμελέτησα

text_en: It is good for me that you have humbled me, that I may learn your justifications.
text_la: Bonum mihi quia humiliasti me, ut discam justificationes tuas.
text_el: ἀγαθόν μοι ὅτι ἐταπείνωσάς με ὅπως ἂν μάθω τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: The law of your mouth is good to me, above thousands of gold and silver.
text_la: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, super millia auri et argenti.
text_el: ἀγαθόν μοι ὁ νόμος τοῦ στόματός σου ὑπὲρ χιλιάδας χρυσίου καὶ ἀργυρίου

text_en: Jod. Your hands have made me and formed me: give me understanding, and I will learn your commandments.
text_la: Jod. Manus tuæ fecerunt me, et plasmaverunt me : da mihi intellectum, et discam mandata tua.
text_el: ιωθ. αἱ χεῖρές σου ἐποίησάν με καὶ ἔπλασάν με συνέτισόν με καὶ μαθήσομαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: They that fear you shall see me, and shall be glad: because I have greatly hoped in your words.
text_la: Qui timent te videbunt me et lætabuntur, quia in verba tua supersperavi.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοί σε ὄψονταί με καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται ὅτι εἰς τοὺς λόγους σου ἐπήλπισα

text_en: I know , O Lord , that your judgments are equity: and in your truth you have humbled me.
text_la: Cognovi, Domine, quia æquitas judicia tua, et in veritate tua humiliasti me.
text_el: ἔγνων κύριε ὅτι δικαιοσύνη τὰ κρίματά σου καὶ ἀληθείᾳ ἐταπείνωσάς με

text_en: O! let your mercy be for my comfort, according to your word unto your servant.
text_la: Fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me, secundum eloquium tuum servo tuo.
text_el: γενηθήτω δὴ τὸ ἔλεός σου τοῦ παρακαλέσαι με κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου τῷ δούλῳ σου

text_en: Let your tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: for your law is my meditation.
text_la: Veniant mihi miserationes tuæ, et vivam, quia lex tua meditatio mea est.
text_el: ἐλθέτωσάν μοι οἱ οἰκτιρμοί σου καὶ ζήσομαι ὅτι ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν

text_en: Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: but I will be employed in your commandments.
text_la: Confundantur superbi, quia injuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me; ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ὑπερήφανοι ὅτι ἀδίκως ἠνόμησαν εἰς ἐμέ ἐγὼ δὲ ἀδολεσχήσω ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου

text_en: Let them that fear you turn to me: and they that know your testimonies.
text_la: Convertantur mihi timentes te, et qui noverunt testimonia tua.
text_el: ἐπιστρεψάτωσάν μοι οἱ φοβούμενοί σε καὶ οἱ γινώσκοντες τὰ μαρτύριά σου

text_en: Let my heart be undefiled in your justifications, that I may not be confounded.
text_la: Fiat cor meum immaculatum in justificationibus tuis, ut non confundar.
text_el: γενηθήτω ἡ καρδία μου ἄμωμος ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου ὅπως ἂν μὴ αἰσχυνθῶ

text_en: Caph. My soul has fainted after your salvation : and in your word I have very much hoped.
text_la: Caph. Defecit in salutare tuum anima mea, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.
text_el: χαφ. ἐκλείπει εἰς τὸ σωτήριόν σου ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ εἰς τὸν λόγον σου ἐπήλπισα

text_en: My eyes have failed for your word, saying: When will you comfort me?
text_la: Defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum, dicentes : Quando consolaberis me?
text_el: ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου εἰς τὸ λόγιόν σου λέγοντες πότε παρακαλέσεις με

text_en: For I have become like a bottle in the frost: I have not forgotten your justifications.
text_la: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγενήθην ὡς ἀσκὸς ἐν πάχνῃ τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: How many are the days of your servant: when will you execute judgment on them that persecute me?
text_la: Quot sunt dies servi tui? quando facies de persequentibus me judicium?
text_el: πόσαι εἰσὶν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ δούλου σου πότε ποιήσεις μοι ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με κρίσιν

text_en: The wicked have told me fables: but not as your law.
text_la: Narraverunt mihi iniqui fabulationes, sed non ut lex tua.
text_el: διηγήσαντό μοι παράνομοι ἀδολεσχίας ἀλλ' οὐχ ὡς ὁ νόμος σου κύριε

text_en: All your statutes are truth : they have persecuted me unjustly ; help me.
text_la: Omnia mandata tua veritas : inique persecuti sunt me, adjuva me.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου ἀλήθεια ἀδίκως κατεδίωξάν με βοήθησόν μοι

text_en: They had almost made an end of me upon earth: but I have not forsaken your commandments.
text_la: Paulominus consummaverunt me in terra; ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua.
text_el: παρὰ βραχὺ συνετέλεσάν με ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐγὼ δὲ οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπον τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: Quicken me according to your mercy: and I shall keep the testimonies of your mouth.
text_la: Secundum misericordiam tuam vivifica me, et custodiam testimonia oris tui.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου ζῆσόν με καὶ φυλάξω τὰ μαρτύρια τοῦ στόματός σου

text_en: Lamed. Forever, O Lord , your word stands firm in heaven .
text_la: Lamed. In æternum, Domine, verbum tuum permanet in cælo.
text_el: λαβδ. εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κύριε ὁ λόγος σου διαμένει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ

text_en: Your truth unto all generations : you have founded the earth, and it continues.
text_la: In generationem et generationem veritas tua; fundasti terram, et permanet.
text_el: εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου ἐθεμελίωσας τὴν γῆν καὶ διαμένει

text_en: By your ordinance the day goes on: for all things serve you.
text_la: Ordinatione tua perseverat dies, quoniam omnia serviunt tibi.
text_el: τῇ διατάξει σου διαμένει ἡ ἡμέρα ὅτι τὰ σύμπαντα δοῦλα σά

text_en: Unless your law had been my meditation, I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.
text_la: Nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est, tunc forte periissem in humilitate mea.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ὅτι ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν τότε ἂν ἀπωλόμην ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει μου

text_en: Your justifications I will never forget: for by them you have given me life.
text_la: In æternum non obliviscar justificationes tuas, quia in ipsis vivificasti me.
text_el: εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐ μὴ ἐπιλάθωμαι τῶν δικαιωμάτων σου ὅτι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἔζησάς με κύριε

text_en: I am yours, save me: for I have sought your justifications.
text_la: Tuus sum ego; salvum me fac : quoniam justificationes tuas exquisivi.
text_el: σός εἰμι ἐγώ σῶσόν με ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐξεζήτησα

text_en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I have understood your testimonies.
text_la: Me exspectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me; testimonia tua intellexi.
text_el: ἐμὲ ὑπέμειναν ἁμαρτωλοὶ τοῦ ἀπολέσαι με τὰ μαρτύριά σου συνῆκα

text_en: I have seen an end of all perfection: your commandment is exceeding broad.
text_la: Omnis consummationis vidi finem, latum mandatum tuum nimis.
text_el: πάσης συντελείας εἶδον πέρας πλατεῖα ἡ ἐντολή σου σφόδρα

text_en: Mem. O how have I loved your law, O Lord ! It is my meditation all the day.
text_la: Mem. Quomodo dilexi legem tuam, Domine! tota die meditatio mea est.
text_el: μημ. ὡς ἠγάπησα τὸν νόμον σου κύριε ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μελέτη μού ἐστιν

text_en: Through your commandment, you have made me wiser than my enemies: for it is ever with me.
text_la: Super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo, quia in æternum mihi est.
text_el: ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐσόφισάς με τὴν ἐντολήν σου ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνά μοί ἐστιν

text_en: I have understood more than all my teachers: because your testimonies are my meditation.
text_la: Super omnes docentes me intellexi, quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est.
text_el: ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς διδάσκοντάς με συνῆκα ὅτι τὰ μαρτύριά σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν

text_en: I have had understanding above ancients: because I have sought your commandments.
text_la: Super senes intellexi, quia mandata tua quæsivi.
text_el: ὑπὲρ πρεσβυτέρους συνῆκα ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἐξεζήτησα

text_en: I have restrained my feet from every evil way: that I may keep your words.
text_la: Ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos, ut custodiam verba tua.
text_el: ἐκ πάσης ὁδοῦ πονηρᾶς ἐκώλυσα τοὺς πόδας μου ὅπως ἂν φυλάξω τοὺς λόγους σου

text_en: I have not declined from your judgments, because you have set me a law.
text_la: A judiciis tuis non declinavi, quia tu legem posuisti mihi.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν κριμάτων σου οὐκ ἐξέκλινα ὅτι σὺ ἐνομοθέτησάς μοι

text_en: How sweet are your words to my palate! More than honey to my mouth.
text_la: Quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua! super mel ori meo.
text_el: ὡς γλυκέα τῷ λάρυγγί μου τὰ λόγιά σου ὑπὲρ μέλι καὶ κηρίον τῷ στόματί μου

text_en: By your commandments I have had understanding: therefore have I hated every way of iniquity .
text_la: A mandatis tuis intellexi; propterea odivi omnem viam iniquitatis.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου συνῆκα διὰ τοῦτο ἐμίσησα πᾶσαν ὁδὸν ἀδικίας ὅτι σὺ ἐνομοθέτησάς μοι

text_en: Nun. Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my paths.
text_la: Nun. Lucerna pedibus meis verbum tuum, et lumen semitis meis.
text_el: νουν. λύχνος τοῖς ποσίν μου ὁ λόγος σου καὶ φῶς ταῖς τρίβοις μου

text_en: I have sworn and am determined to keep the judgments of your justice .
text_la: Juravi et statui custodire judicia justitiæ tuæ.
text_el: ὀμώμοκα καὶ ἔστησα τοῦ φυλάξασθαι τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: I have been humbled , O Lord , exceedingly: quicken me according to your word.
text_la: Humiliatus sum usquequaque, Domine; vivifica me secundum verbum tuum.
text_el: ἐταπεινώθην ἕως σφόδρα κύριε ζῆσόν με κατὰ τὸν λόγον σου

text_en: The free offerings of my mouth make acceptable, O Lord : and teach me your judgments.
text_la: Voluntaria oris mei beneplacita fac, Domine, et judicia tua doce me.
text_el: τὰ ἑκούσια τοῦ στόματός μου εὐδόκησον δή κύριε καὶ τὰ κρίματά σου δίδαξόν με

text_en: My soul is continually in my hands: and I have not forgotten your law.
text_la: Anima mea in manibus meis semper, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.
text_el: ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν ταῖς χερσίν μου διὰ παντός καὶ τοῦ νόμου σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: Sinners have laid a snare for me: but I have not erred from your precepts .
text_la: Posuerunt peccatores laqueum mihi, et de mandatis tuis non erravi.
text_el: ἔθεντο ἁμαρτωλοὶ παγίδα μοι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου οὐκ ἐπλανήθην

text_en: I have purchased your testimonies for an inheritance for ever: because they are the joy of my heart.
text_la: Hæreditate acquisivi testimonia tua in æternum, quia exsultatio cordis mei sunt.
text_el: ἐκληρονόμησα τὰ μαρτύριά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὅτι ἀγαλλίαμα τῆς καρδίας μού εἰσιν

text_en: I have inclined my heart to do your justifications for ever, for the reward.
text_la: Inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas justificationes tuas in æternum, propter retributionem.
text_el: ἔκλινα τὴν καρδίαν μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὰ δικαιώματά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα δι' ἀντάμειψιν

text_en: Samech. I have hated the unjust : and have loved your law.
text_la: Samech. Iniquos odio habui, et legem tuam dilexi.
text_el: σαμχ. παρανόμους ἐμίσησα καὶ τὸν νόμον σου ἠγάπησα

text_en: You are my helper and my protector: and in your word I have greatly hoped.
text_la: Adjutor et susceptor meus es tu, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.
text_el: βοηθός μου καὶ ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ σύ εἰς τὸν λόγον σου ἐπήλπισα

text_en: Depart from me, you malignant: and I will search the commandments of my God .
text_la: Declinate a me, maligni, et scrutabor mandata Dei mei.
text_el: ἐκκλίνατε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ πονηρευόμενοι καὶ ἐξερευνήσω τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ θεοῦ μου

text_en: Uphold me according to your word, and I shall live: and let me not be confounded in my expectation.
text_la: Suscipe me secundum eloquium tuum, et vivam, et non confundas me ab exspectatione mea.
text_el: ἀντιλαβοῦ μου κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου καὶ ζήσομαι καὶ μὴ καταισχύνῃς με ἀπὸ τῆς προσδοκίας μου

text_en: Help me, and I shall be saved: and I will meditate always on your justifications.
text_la: Adjuva me, et salvus ero, et meditabor in justificationibus tuis semper.
text_el: βοήθησόν μοι καὶ σωθήσομαι καὶ μελετήσω ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου διὰ παντός

text_en: You have despised all them that fall off from your judgments; for their thought is unjust .
text_la: Sprevisti omnes discedentes a judiciis tuis, quia injusta cogitatio eorum.
text_el: ἐξουδένωσας πάντας τοὺς ἀποστατοῦντας ἀπὸ τῶν δικαιωμάτων σου ὅτι ἄδικον τὸ ἐνθύμημα αὐτῶν

text_en: I have accounted all the sinners of the earth prevaricators: therefore have I loved your testimonies.
text_la: Prævaricantes reputavi omnes peccatores terræ; ideo dilexi testimonia tua.
text_el: παραβαίνοντας ἐλογισάμην πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς τῆς γῆς διὰ τοῦτο ἠγάπησα τὰ μαρτύριά σου διὰ παντός

text_en: Pierce my flesh with your fear: for I am afraid of your judgments.
text_la: Confige timore tuo carnes meas; a judiciis enim tuis timui.
text_el: καθήλωσον ἐκ τοῦ φόβου σου τὰς σάρκας μου ἀπὸ γὰρ τῶν κριμάτων σου ἐφοβήθην

text_en: Ain. I have done judgment and justice : give me not up to them that slander me.
text_la: Ain. Feci judicium et justitiam : non tradas me calumniantibus me.
text_el: αιν. ἐποίησα κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην μὴ παραδῷς με τοῖς ἀδικοῦσίν με

text_en: Uphold your servant unto good : let not the proud calumniate me.
text_la: Suscipe servum tuum in bonum : non calumnientur me superbi.
text_el: ἔκδεξαι τὸν δοῦλόν σου εἰς ἀγαθόν μὴ συκοφαντησάτωσάν με ὑπερήφανοι

text_en: My eyes have fainted after your salvation : and for the word of your justice .
text_la: Oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum, et in eloquium justitiæ tuæ.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐξέλιπον εἰς τὸ σωτήριόν σου καὶ εἰς τὸ λόγιον τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: Deal with your servant according to your mercy: and teach me your justifications.
text_la: Fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam, et justificationes tuas doce me.
text_el: ποίησον μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά σου δίδαξόν με

text_en: I am your servant: give me understanding that I may know your testimonies.
text_la: Servus tuus sum ego : da mihi intellectum, ut sciam testimonia tua.
text_el: δοῦλός σού εἰμι ἐγώ συνέτισόν με καὶ γνώσομαι τὰ μαρτύριά σου

text_en: It is time, O Lord , to do: they have dissipated your law.
text_la: Tempus faciendi, Domine : dissipaverunt legem tuam.
text_el: καιρὸς τοῦ ποιῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ διεσκέδασαν τὸν νόμον σου

text_en: Therefore have I loved your commandments above gold and the topaz.
text_la: Ideo dilexi mandata tua super aurum et topazion.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἠγάπησα τὰς ἐντολάς σου ὑπὲρ χρυσίον καὶ τοπάζιον

text_en: Therefore was I directed to all your commandments: I have hated all wicked ways.
text_la: Propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar; omnem viam iniquam odio habui.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πρὸς πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς σου κατωρθούμην πᾶσαν ὁδὸν ἄδικον ἐμίσησα

text_en: Phe. Your testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul has sought them.
text_la: Phe. Mirabilia testimonia tua : ideo scrutata est ea anima mea.
text_el: φη. θαυμαστὰ τὰ μαρτύριά σου διὰ τοῦτο ἐξηρεύνησεν αὐτὰ ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: The declaration of your words gives light: and gives understanding to little ones.
text_la: Declaratio sermonum tuorum illuminat, et intellectum dat parvulis.
text_el: ἡ δήλωσις τῶν λόγων σου φωτιεῖ καὶ συνετιεῖ νηπίους

text_en: I opened my mouth, and panted: because I longed for your commandments.
text_la: Os meum aperui, et attraxi spiritum : quia mandata tua desiderabam.
text_el: τὸ στόμα μου ἤνοιξα καὶ εἵλκυσα πνεῦμα ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἐπεπόθουν

text_en: Look upon me, and have mercy on me according to the judgment of them that love your name .
text_la: Aspice in me, et miserere mei, secundum judicium diligentium nomen tuum.
text_el: ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με κατὰ τὸ κρίμα τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: Direct my steps according to your word: and let no iniquity have dominion over me.
text_la: Gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum, et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia.
text_el: τὰ διαβήματά μου κατεύθυνον κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου καὶ μὴ κατακυριευσάτω μου πᾶσα ἀνομία

text_en: Redeem me from the calumnies of men : that I may keep your commandments.
text_la: Redime me a calumniis hominum ut custodiam mandata tua.
text_el: λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ συκοφαντίας ἀνθρώπων καὶ φυλάξω τὰς ἐντολάς σου

text_en: Make your face to shine upon your servant: and teach me your justifications.
text_la: Faciem tuam illumina super servum tuum, et doce me justificationes tuas.
text_el: τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπίφανον ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου καὶ δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: My eyes have sent forth springs of water: because they have not kept your law.
text_la: Exitus aquarum deduxerunt oculi mei, quia non custodierunt legem tuam.
text_el: διεξόδους ὑδάτων κατέβησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἐφύλαξαν τὸν νόμον σου

text_en: Sade. You are just , O Lord : and your judgment is right.
text_la: Sade. Justus es, Domine, et rectum judicium tuum.
text_el: σαδη. δίκαιος εἶ κύριε καὶ εὐθὴς ἡ κρίσις σου

text_en: You have commanded justice your testimonies: and your truth exceedingly.
text_la: Mandasti justitiam testimonia tua, et veritatem tuam nimis.
text_el: ἐνετείλω δικαιοσύνην τὰ μαρτύριά σου καὶ ἀλήθειαν σφόδρα

text_en: My zeal has made me pine away: because my enemies forgot your words.
text_la: Tabescere me fecit zelus meus, quia obliti sunt verba tua inimici mei.
text_el: ἐξέτηξέν με ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου ὅτι ἐπελάθοντο τῶν λόγων σου οἱ ἐχθροί μου

text_en: Your word is exceedingly refined: and your servant has loved it.
text_la: Ignitum eloquium tuum vehementer, et servus tuus dilexit illud.
text_el: πεπυρωμένον τὸ λόγιόν σου σφόδρα καὶ ὁ δοῦλός σου ἠγάπησεν αὐτό

text_en: I am very young and despised ; but I forget not your justifications.
text_la: Adolescentulus sum ego et contemptus; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.
text_el: νεώτερός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἐξουδενωμένος τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: Your justice is justice for ever: and your law is the truth .
text_la: Justitia tua, justitia in æternum, et lex tua veritas.
text_el: ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου δικαιοσύνη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ὁ νόμος σου ἀλήθεια

text_en: Trouble and anguish have found me: your commandments are my meditation.
text_la: Tribulatio et angustia invenerunt me; mandata tua meditatio mea est.
text_el: θλῖψις καὶ ἀνάγκη εὕροσάν με αἱ ἐντολαί σου μελέτη μου

text_en: Your testimonies are justice for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.
text_la: Æquitas testimonia tua in æternum : intellectum da mihi, et vivam.
text_el: δικαιοσύνη τὰ μαρτύριά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα συνέτισόν με καὶ ζήσομαι

text_en: Coph. I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord : I will seek your justifications.
text_la: Coph. Clamavi in toto corde meo : exaudi me, Domine; justificationes tuas requiram.
text_el: κωφ. ἐκέκραξα ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ἐπάκουσόν μου κύριε τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐκζητήσω

text_en: I cried unto you, save me: that I may keep your commandments.
text_la: Clamavi ad te; salvum me fac : ut custodiam mandata tua.
text_el: ἐκέκραξά σε σῶσόν με καὶ φυλάξω τὰ μαρτύριά σου

text_en: I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: because in your words I very much hoped.
text_la: Præveni in maturitate, et clamavi : quia in verba tua supersperavi.
text_el: προέφθασα ἐν ἀωρίᾳ καὶ ἐκέκραξα εἰς τοὺς λόγους σου ἐπήλπισα

text_en: My eyes to you have prevented the morning: that I might meditate on your words.
text_la: Prævenerunt oculi mei ad te diluculo, ut meditarer eloquia tua.
text_el: προέφθασαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου πρὸς ὄρθρον τοῦ μελετᾶν τὰ λόγιά σου

text_en: Hear my voice, O Lord , according to your mercy: and quicken me according to your judgment.
text_la: Vocem meam audi secundum misericordiam tuam, Domine, et secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.
text_el: τῆς φωνῆς μου ἄκουσον κύριε κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου κατὰ τὸ κρίμα σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: They that persecute me have drawn near to iniquity ; but they have gone far off from your law.
text_la: Appropinquaverunt persequentes me iniquitati : a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.
text_el: προσήγγισαν οἱ καταδιώκοντές με ἀνομίᾳ ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ νόμου σου ἐμακρύνθησαν

text_en: You are near, O Lord : and all your ways are truth .
text_la: Prope es tu, Domine, et omnes viæ tuæ veritas.
text_el: ἐγγὺς εἶ σύ κύριε καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου ἀλήθεια

text_en: I have known from the beginning concerning your testimonies: that you have founded them for ever.
text_la: Initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis, quia in æternum fundasti ea.
text_el: κατ' ἀρχὰς ἔγνων ἐκ τῶν μαρτυρίων σου ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐθεμελίωσας αὐτά

text_en: Res. See my humiliation and deliver me for I have not forgotten your law.
text_la: Res. Vide humilitatem meam, et eripe me, quia legem tuam non sum oblitus.
text_el: ρης. ἰδὲ τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου καὶ ἐξελοῦ με ὅτι τὸν νόμον σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: Judge my judgment and redeem me: quicken me for your word's sake.
text_la: Judica judicium meum, et redime me : propter eloquium tuum vivifica me.
text_el: κρῖνον τὴν κρίσιν μου καὶ λύτρωσαί με διὰ τὸν λόγον σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: Salvation is far from sinners; because they have not sought your justifications.
text_la: Longe a peccatoribus salus, quia justificationes tuas non exquisierunt.
text_el: μακρὰν ἀπὸ ἁμαρτωλῶν σωτηρία ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐξεζήτησαν

text_en: Many, O Lord , are your mercies: quicken me according to your judgment.
text_la: Misericordiæ tuæ multæ, Domine; secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.
text_el: οἱ οἰκτιρμοί σου πολλοί κύριε κατὰ τὸ κρίμα σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: Many are they that persecute me and afflict me; but I have not declined from your testimonies.
text_la: Multi qui persequuntur me, et tribulant me; a testimoniis tuis non declinavi.
text_el: πολλοὶ οἱ ἐκδιώκοντές με καὶ ἐκθλίβοντές με ἐκ τῶν μαρτυρίων σου οὐκ ἐξέκλινα

text_en: I beheld the transgressors, and pined away; because they kept not your word.
text_la: Vidi prævaricantes et tabescebam, quia eloquia tua non custodierunt.
text_el: εἶδον ἀσυνθετοῦντας καὶ ἐξετηκόμην ὅτι τὰ λόγιά σου οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο

text_en: Behold I have loved your commandments, O Lord ; quicken me in your mercy.
text_la: Vide quoniam mandata tua dilexi, Domine : in misericordia tua vivifica me.
text_el: ἰδὲ ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἠγάπησα κύριε ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου ζῆσόν με

text_en: The beginning of your words is truth : all the judgments of your justice are for ever.
text_la: Principium verborum tuorum veritas; in æternum omnia judicia justitiæ tuæ.
text_el: ἀρχὴ τῶν λόγων σου ἀλήθεια καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα πάντα τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: Sin. Princes have persecuted me without cause: and my heart has been in awe of your words.
text_la: Sin. Principes persecuti sunt me gratis, et a verbis tuis formidavit cor meum.
text_el: σεν. ἄρχοντες κατεδίωξάν με δωρεάν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων σου ἐδειλίασεν ἡ καρδία μου

text_en: I will rejoice at your words, as one that has found great spoil.
text_la: Lætabor ego super eloquia tua, sicut qui invenit spolia multa.
text_el: ἀγαλλιάσομαι ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τὰ λόγιά σου ὡς ὁ εὑρίσκων σκῦλα πολλά

text_en: I have hated and abhorred iniquity ; but I have loved your law.
text_la: Iniquitatem odio habui, et abominatus sum, legem autem tuam dilexi.
text_el: ἀδικίαν ἐμίσησα καὶ ἐβδελυξάμην τὸν δὲ νόμον σου ἠγάπησα

text_en: Seven times a day I have given praise to you, for the judgments of your justice .
text_la: Septies in die laudem dixi tibi, super judicia justitiæ tuæ.
text_el: ἑπτάκις τῆς ἡμέρας ᾔνεσά σοι ἐπὶ τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου

text_en: Much peace have they that love your law, and to them there is no stumbling block.
text_la: Pax multa diligentibus legem tuam, et non est illis scandalum.
text_el: εἰρήνη πολλὴ τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν νόμον σου καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς σκάνδαλον

text_en: I looked for your salvation , O Lord : and I loved your commandments.
text_la: Exspectabam salutare tuum, Domine, et mandata tua dilexi.
text_el: προσεδόκων τὸ σωτήριόν σου κύριε καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἠγάπησα

text_en: My soul has kept your testimonies and has loved them exceedingly.
text_la: Custodivit anima mea testimonia tua, et dilexit ea vehementer.
text_el: ἐφύλαξεν ἡ ψυχή μου τὰ μαρτύριά σου καὶ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὰ σφόδρα

text_en: I have kept your commandments and your testimonies: because all my ways are in your sight.
text_la: Servavi mandata tua et testimonia tua, quia omnes viæ meæ in conspectu tuo.
text_el: ἐφύλαξα τὰς ἐντολάς σου καὶ τὰ μαρτύριά σου ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοί μου ἐναντίον σου κύριε

text_en: Tau. Let my supplication, O Lord , come near in your sight: give me understanding according to your word.
text_la: Tau. Appropinquet deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, Domine; juxta eloquium tuum da mihi intellectum.
text_el: θαυ. ἐγγισάτω ἡ δέησίς μου ἐνώπιόν σου κύριε κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου συνέτισόν με

text_en: Let my request come in before you; deliver me according to your word.
text_la: Intret postulatio mea in conspectu tuo; secundum eloquium tuum eripe me.
text_el: εἰσέλθοι τὸ ἀξίωμά μου ἐνώπιόν σου κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου ῥῦσαί με

text_en: My lips shall utter a hymn, when you shall teach me your justifications.
text_la: Eructabunt labia mea hymnum, cum docueris me justificationes tuas.
text_el: ἐξερεύξαιντο τὰ χείλη μου ὕμνον ὅταν διδάξῃς με τὰ δικαιώματά σου

text_en: My tongue shall pronounce your word: because all your commandments are justice .
text_la: Pronuntiabit lingua mea eloquium tuum, quia omnia mandata tua æquitas.
text_el: φθέγξαιτο ἡ γλῶσσά μου τὸ λόγιόν σου ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου δικαιοσύνη

text_en: Let your hand be with me to save me; for I have chosen your precepts .
text_la: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me, quoniam mandata tua elegi.
text_el: γενέσθω ἡ χείρ σου τοῦ σῶσαί με ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ᾑρετισάμην

text_en: I have longed for your salvation , O Lord ; and your law is my meditation.
text_la: Concupivi salutare tuum, Domine, et lex tua meditatio mea est.
text_el: ἐπεπόθησα τὸ σωτήριόν σου κύριε καὶ ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν

text_en: My soul shall live and shall praise you: and your judgments shall help me.
text_la: Vivet anima mea, et laudabit te, et judicia tua adjuvabunt me.
text_el: ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ αἰνέσει σε καὶ τὰ κρίματά σου βοηθήσει μοι

text_en: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: seek your servant, because I have not forgotten your commandments.
text_la: Erravi sicut ovis quæ periit : quære servum tuum, quia mandata tua non sum oblitus.
text_el: ἐπλανήθην ὡς πρόβατον ἀπολωλός ζήτησον τὸν δοῦλόν σου ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: In my trouble I cried to the Lord : and he heard me.
text_la: Ad Dominum cum tribularer clamavi, et exaudivit me.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os retos em seus caminhos, que andam na lei do Senhor.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐκέκραξα καὶ εἰσήκουσέν μου

text_en: O Lord , deliver my soul from wicked lips, and a deceitful tongue.
text_la: Domine, libera animam meam a labiis iniquis et a lingua dolosa.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados os que guardam os seus testemunhos, e que o buscam com todo o coração.
text_el: κύριε ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ χειλέων ἀδίκων καὶ ἀπὸ γλώσσης δολίας

text_en: What shall be given to you, or what shall be added to you, to a deceitful tongue?
text_la: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponatur tibi ad linguam dolosam?
text_pt: E não praticam iniqüidade, mas andam nos seus caminhos.
text_el: τί δοθείη σοι καὶ τί προστεθείη σοι πρὸς γλῶσσαν δολίαν

text_en: The sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals that lay waste.
text_la: Sagittæ potentis acutæ, cum carbonibus desolatoriis.
text_pt: Tu ordenaste os teus mandamentos, para que diligentemente os observássemos.
text_el: τὰ βέλη τοῦ δυνατοῦ ἠκονημένα σὺν τοῖς ἄνθραξιν τοῖς ἐρημικοῖς

text_en: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar :
text_la: Heu mihi, quia incolatus meus prolongatus est! habitavi cum habitantibus Cedar;
text_pt: Quem dera que os meus caminhos fossem dirigidos a observar os teus mandamentos.
text_el: οἴμμοι ὅτι ἡ παροικία μου ἐμακρύνθη κατεσκήνωσα μετὰ τῶν σκηνωμάτων Κηδαρ

text_en: My soul has been long a sojourner.
text_la: multum incola fuit anima mea.
text_pt: Então não ficaria confundido, atentando eu para todos os teus mandamentos.
text_el: πολλὰ παρῴκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.
text_la: Cum his qui oderunt pacem eram pacificus; cum loquebar illis, impugnabant me gratis.
text_pt: Louvar-te-ei com retidão de coração quando tiver aprendido os teus justos juízos.
text_el: μετὰ τῶν μισούντων τὴν εἰρήνην ἤμην εἰρηνικός ὅταν ἐλάλουν αὐτοῖς ἐπολέμουν με δωρεάν

text_en: I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, from whence help shall come to me.
text_la: Levavi oculos meos in montes, unde veniet auxilium mihi.
text_pt: Na minha angústia clamei ao SENHOR, e me ouviu.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου εἰς τὰ ὄρη πόθεν ἥξει ἡ βοήθειά μου

text_en: My help is from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
text_la: Auxilium meum a Domino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text_pt: Senhor, livra a minha alma dos lábios mentirosos e da língua enganadora.
text_el: ἡ βοήθειά μου παρὰ κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: May he not suffer your foot to be moved: neither let him slumber that keeps you.
text_la: Non det in commotionem pedem tuum, neque dormitet qui custodit te.
text_pt: Que te será dado, ou que te será acrescentado, língua enganadora?
text_el: μὴ δῷς εἰς σάλον τὸν πόδα σου μηδὲ νυστάξῃ ὁ φυλάσσων σε

text_en: Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, that keeps Israel .
text_la: Ecce non dormitabit neque dormiet qui custodit Israël.
text_pt: Flechas agudas do poderoso, com brasas vivas de zimbro.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οὐ νυστάξει οὐδὲ ὑπνώσει ὁ φυλάσσων τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: The Lord is your keeper, the Lord is your protection upon your right hand.
text_la: Dominus custodit te; Dominus protectio tua super manum dexteram tuam.
text_pt: Ai de mim, que peregrino em Meseque, e habito nas tendas de Quedar.
text_el: κύριος φυλάξει σε κύριος σκέπη σου ἐπὶ χεῖρα δεξιάν σου

text_en: The sun shall not burn you by day: nor the moon by night.
text_la: Per diem sol non uret te, neque luna per noctem.
text_pt: A minha alma bastante tempo habitou com os que detestam a paz.
text_el: ἡμέρας ὁ ἥλιος οὐ συγκαύσει σε οὐδὲ ἡ σελήνη τὴν νύκτα

text_en: The Lord keeps you from all evil : may the Lord keep your soul .
text_la: Dominus custodit te ab omni malo; custodiat animam tuam Dominus.
text_pt: Pacífico sou, mas quando eu falo já eles procuram a guerra.
text_el: κύριος φυλάξει σε ἀπὸ παντὸς κακοῦ φυλάξει τὴν ψυχήν σου

text_en: May the Lord keep your coming in and your going out; from henceforth now and for ever.
text_la: Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
text_el: κύριος φυλάξει τὴν εἴσοδόν σου καὶ τὴν ἔξοδόν σου ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: We shall go into the house of the Lord .
text_la: Lætatus sum in his quæ dicta sunt mihi : In domum Domini ibimus.
text_pt: Levantarei os meus olhos para os montes, de onde vem o meu socorro.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν εὐφράνθην ἐπὶ τοῖς εἰρηκόσιν μοι εἰς οἶκον κυρίου πορευσόμεθα

text_en: Our feet were standing in your courts , O Jerusalem .
text_la: Stantes erant pedes nostri in atriis tuis, Jerusalem.
text_pt: O meu socorro vem do Senhor que fez o céu e a terra.
text_el: ἑστῶτες ἦσαν οἱ πόδες ἡμῶν ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Jerusalem , which is built as a city, which is compact together.
text_la: Jerusalem, quæ ædificatur ut civitas, cujus participatio ejus in idipsum.
text_pt: Não deixará vacilar o teu pé; aquele que te guarda não tosquenejará.
text_el: Ιερουσαλημ οἰκοδομουμένη ὡς πόλις ἧς ἡ μετοχὴ αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord : the testimony of Israel , to praise the name of the Lord .
text_la: Illuc enim ascenderunt tribus, tribus Domini : testimonium Israël, ad confitendum nomini Domini.
text_pt: Eis que não tosquenejará nem dormirá o guarda de Israel.
text_el: ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἀνέβησαν αἱ φυλαί φυλαὶ κυρίου μαρτύριον τῷ Ισραηλ τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: Because their seats have sat in judgment, seats upon the house of David .
text_la: Quia illic sederunt sedes in judicio, sedes super domum David.
text_pt: O Senhor é quem te guarda; o Senhor é a tua sombra à tua direita.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐκάθισαν θρόνοι εἰς κρίσιν θρόνοι ἐπὶ οἶκον Δαυιδ

text_en: Pray for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem : and abundance for them that love you.
text_la: Rogate quæ ad pacem sunt Jerusalem, et abundantia diligentibus te.
text_pt: O sol não te molestará de dia nem a lua de noite.
text_el: ἐρωτήσατε δὴ τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ εὐθηνία τοῖς ἀγαπῶσίν σε

text_en: Let peace be in your strength: and abundance in your towers.
text_la: Fiat pax in virtute tua, et abundantia in turribus tuis.
text_pt: O Senhor te guardará de todo o mal; guardará a tua alma.
text_el: γενέσθω δὴ εἰρήνη ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου καὶ εὐθηνία ἐν ταῖς πυργοβάρεσίν σου

text_en: For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, I spoke peace of you.
text_la: Propter fratres meos et proximos meos, loquebar pacem de te.
text_pt: O Senhor guardará a tua entrada e a tua saída, desde agora e para sempre.
text_el: ἕνεκα τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου καὶ τῶν πλησίον μου ἐλάλουν δὴ εἰρήνην περὶ σοῦ

text_en: Because of the house of the Lord our God , I have sought good things for you.
text_la: Propter domum Domini Dei nostri, quæsivi bona tibi.
text_el: ἕνεκα τοῦ οἴκου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξεζήτησα ἀγαθά σοι

text_en: To you have I lifted up my eyes, who dwell in heaven .
text_la: Ad te levavi oculos meos, qui habitas in cælis.
text_pt: Alegrei-me quando me disseram: Vamos á casa do SENHOR.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν πρὸς σὲ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ

text_en: Behold as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters, As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: so are our eyes unto the Lord our God , until he have mercy on us.
text_la: Ecce sicut oculi servorum in manibus dominorum suorum; sicut oculi ancillæ in manibus dominæ suæ : ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum, donec misereatur nostri.
text_pt: Os nossos pés estão dentro das tuas portas, ó Jerusalém.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ δούλων εἰς χεῖρας τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ παιδίσκης εἰς χεῖρας τῆς κυρίας αὐτῆς οὕτως οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν ἕως οὗ οἰκτιρήσαι ἡμᾶς

text_en: Have mercy on us, O Lord , have mercy on us: for we are greatly filled with contempt .
text_la: Miserere nostri, Domine, miserere nostri, quia multum repleti sumus despectione;
text_pt: Jerusalém está edificada como uma cidade que é compacta.
text_el: ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς κύριε ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὅτι ἐπὶ πολὺ ἐπλήσθημεν ἐξουδενώσεως

text_en: For our soul is greatly filled: we are a reproach to the rich , and contempt to the proud .
text_la: quia multum repleta est anima nostra opprobrium abundantibus, et despectio superbis.
text_pt: Onde sobem as tribos, as tribos do Senhor, até ao testemunho de Israel, para darem graças ao nome do Senhor.
text_el: ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἐπλήσθη ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν τὸ ὄνειδος τοῖς εὐθηνοῦσιν καὶ ἡ ἐξουδένωσις τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις

text_en: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, let Israel now say:
text_la: Nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israël,
text_pt: A ti levanto os meus olhos, ó tu que habitas nos céus.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν εἰ μὴ ὅτι κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν εἰπάτω δὴ Ισραηλ

text_en: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, When men rose up against us,
text_la: nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis : cum exsurgerent homines in nos,
text_pt: Assim como os olhos dos servos atentam para as mãos dos seus senhores, e os olhos da serva para as mãos de sua senhora, assim os nossos olhos atentam para o SENHOR nosso Deus, até que tenha piedade de nós.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ὅτι κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ ἐπαναστῆναι ἀνθρώπους ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: perhaps they had swallowed us up alive. When their fury was enkindled against us,
text_la: forte vivos deglutissent nos; cum irasceretur furor eorum in nos,
text_pt: Tem piedade de nós, ó Senhor, tem piedade de nós, pois estamos assaz fartos de desprezo.
text_el: ἄρα ζῶντας ἂν κατέπιον ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ὀργισθῆναι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτῶν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.
text_la: forsitan aqua absorbuisset nos;
text_pt: A nossa alma está extremamente farta da zombaria daqueles que estão à sua vontade e do desprezo dos soberbos.
text_el: ἄρα τὸ ὕδωρ κατεπόντισεν ἡμᾶς χείμαρρον διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν

text_en: Our soul has passed through a torrent: perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.
text_la: torrentem pertransivit anima nostra; forsitan pertransisset anima nostra aquam intolerabilem.
text_el: ἄρα διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἀνυπόστατον

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , who has not given us to be a prey to their teeth.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus, qui non dedit nos in captionem dentibus eorum.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὃς οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἡμᾶς εἰς θήραν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Our soul has been delivered as a sparrow out of the snare of the fowlers. The snare is broken, and we are delivered.
text_la: Anima nostra sicut passer erepta est de laqueo venantium; laqueus contritus est, et nos liberati sumus.
text_el: ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ὡς στρουθίον ἐρρύσθη ἐκ τῆς παγίδος τῶν θηρευόντων ἡ παγὶς συνετρίβη καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐρρύσθημεν

text_en: Our help is in the name of the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
text_la: Adjutorium nostrum in nomine Domini, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text_el: ἡ βοήθεια ἡμῶν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: he shall not be moved for ever that dwells
text_la: Qui confidunt in Domino, sicut mons Sion : non commovebitur in æternum, qui habitat
text_pt: Se não fora o Senhor, que esteve ao nosso lado, ora diga Israel;
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ κύριον ὡς ὄρος Σιων οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὁ κατοικῶν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: in Jerusalem . Mountains are round about it: so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth now and for ever.
text_la: in Jerusalem. Montes in circuitu ejus; et Dominus in circuitu populi sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
text_pt: Se não fora o Senhor, que esteve ao nosso lado, quando os homens se levantaram contra nós,
text_el: ὄρη κύκλῳ αὐτῆς καὶ κύριος κύκλῳ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just : that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity .
text_la: Quia non relinquet Dominus virgam peccatorum super sortem justorum : ut non extendant justi ad iniquitatem manus suas,
text_pt: Eles então nos teriam engolido vivos, quando a sua ira se acendeu contra nós.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἀφήσει τὴν ῥάβδον τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐπὶ τὸν κλῆρον τῶν δικαίων ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἐκτείνωσιν οἱ δίκαιοι ἐν ἀνομίᾳ χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: Do good , O Lord , to those that are good , and to the upright of heart.
text_la: benefac, Domine, bonis, et rectis corde.
text_pt: Então as águas teriam transbordado sobre nós, e a corrente teria passado sobre a nossa alma;
text_el: ἀγάθυνον κύριε τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity : peace upon Israel .
text_la: Declinantes autem in obligationes, adducet Dominus cum operantibus iniquitatem. Pax super Israël!
text_pt: Então as águas altivas teriam passado sobre a nossa alma;
text_el: τοὺς δὲ ἐκκλίνοντας εἰς τὰς στραγγαλιὰς ἀπάξει κύριος μετὰ τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, we became like men comforted.
text_la: In convertendo Dominus captivitatem Sion, facti sumus sicut consolati.
text_pt: Os que confiam no SENHOR serão como o monte de Sião, que não se abala, mas permanece para sempre.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Σιων ἐγενήθημεν ὡς παρακεκλημένοι

text_en: Then was our mouth filled with gladness ; and our tongue with joy . Then shall they say among the Gentiles : The Lord has done great things for them.
text_la: Tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum, et lingua nostra exsultatione. Tunc dicent inter gentes : Magnificavit Dominus facere cum eis.
text_pt: Assim como estão os montes à roda de Jerusalém, assim o Senhor está em volta do seu povo desde agora e para sempre.
text_el: τότε ἐπλήσθη χαρᾶς τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα ἡμῶν ἀγαλλιάσεως τότε ἐροῦσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐμεγάλυνεν κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord has done great things for us;we have become joyful.
text_la: Magnificavit Dominus facere nobiscum; facti sumus lætantes.
text_pt: Porque o cetro da impiedade não permanecerá sobre a sorte dos justos, para que o justo não estenda as suas mãos para a iniqüidade.
text_el: ἐμεγάλυνεν κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μεθ' ἡμῶν ἐγενήθημεν εὐφραινόμενοι

text_en: Turn again our captivity, O Lord , as a stream in the south.
text_la: Converte, Domine, captivitatem nostram, sicut torrens in austro.
text_pt: Faze bem, ó Senhor, aos bons e aos que são retos de coração.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον κύριε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἡμῶν ὡς χειμάρρους ἐν τῷ νότῳ

text_en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy .
text_la: Qui seminant in lacrimis, in exsultatione metent.
text_pt: Quanto àqueles que se desviam para os seus caminhos tortuosos, levá-los-á o SENHOR com os que praticam a maldade; paz haverá sobre Israel.
text_el: οἱ σπείροντες ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει θεριοῦσιν

text_en: Going they went and wept, casting their seeds.
text_la: Euntes ibant et flebant, mittentes semina sua.
text_el: πορευόμενοι ἐπορεύοντο καὶ ἔκλαιον αἴροντες τὰ σπέρματα αὐτῶν

text_en: But coming they shall come with joyfulness, carrying their sheaves.
text_la: Venientes autem venient cum exsultatione, portantes manipulos suos.
text_el: ἐρχόμενοι δὲ ἥξουσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει αἴροντες τὰ δράγματα αὐτῶν

text_en: Unless the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it. Unless the Lord keep the city, he watches in vain that keeps it.
text_la: Nisi Dominus ædificaverit domum, in vanum laboraverunt qui ædificant eam. Nisi Dominus custodierit civitatem, frustra vigilat qui custodit eam.
text_pt: Quando o SENHOR trouxe do cativeiro os que voltaram a Sião, estávamos como os que sonham.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν τῷ Σαλωμων ἐὰν μὴ κύριος οἰκοδομήσῃ οἶκον εἰς μάτην ἐκοπίασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες αὐτόν ἐὰν μὴ κύριος φυλάξῃ πόλιν εἰς μάτην ἠγρύπνησεν ὁ φυλάσσων

text_en: It is vain for you to rise before light, rise after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow. When he shall give sleep to his beloved,
text_la: Vanum est vobis ante lucem surgere : surgite postquam sederitis, qui manducatis panem doloris. Cum dederit dilectis suis somnum,
text_pt: Então a nossa boca se encheu de riso e a nossa língua de cântico; então se dizia entre os gentios: Grandes coisas fez o Senhor a estes.
text_el: εἰς μάτην ὑμῖν ἐστιν τοῦ ὀρθρίζειν ἐγείρεσθαι μετὰ τὸ καθῆσθαι οἱ ἔσθοντες ἄρτον ὀδύνης ὅταν δῷ τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς αὐτοῦ ὕπνον

text_en: behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.
text_la: ecce hæreditas Domini, filii; merces, fructus ventris.
text_pt: Grandes coisas fez o Senhor por nós, pelas quais estamos alegres.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡ κληρονομία κυρίου υἱοί ὁ μισθὸς τοῦ καρποῦ τῆς γαστρός

text_en: As arrows in the hand of the mighty, so the children of them that have been shaken.
text_la: Sicut sagittæ in manu potentis, ita filii excussorum.
text_pt: Traze-nos outra vez, ó Senhor, do cativeiro, como as correntes das águas no sul.
text_el: ὡσεὶ βέλη ἐν χειρὶ δυνατοῦ οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἐκτετιναγμένων

text_en: Blessed is the man that has filled the desire with them; he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.
text_la: Beatus vir qui implevit desiderium suum ex ipsis : non confundetur cum loquetur inimicis suis in porta.
text_pt: Os que semeiam em lágrimas segarão com alegria.
text_el: μακάριος ἄνθρωπος ὃς πληρώσει τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐ καταισχυνθήσονται ὅταν λαλῶσι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πύλῃ

text_en: Blessed are all they that fear the Lord : that walk in his ways.
text_la: Beati omnes qui timent Dominum, qui ambulant in viis ejus.
text_pt: Se o SENHOR não edificar a casa, em vão trabalham os que a edificam; se o SENHOR não guardar a cidade, em vão vigia a sentinela.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν μακάριοι πάντες οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον οἱ πορευόμενοι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: For you shall eat the labours of your hands: blessed are you, and it shall be well with you.
text_la: Labores manuum tuarum quia manducabis : beatus es, et bene tibi erit.
text_pt: Inútil vos será levantar de madrugada, repousar tarde, comer o pão de dores, pois assim dá ele aos seus amados o sono.
text_el: τοὺς πόνους τῶν καρπῶν σου φάγεσαι μακάριος εἶ καὶ καλῶς σοι ἔσται

text_en: Your wife as a fruitful vine, on the sides of your house. Your children as olive plants, round about your table.
text_la: Uxor tua sicut vitis abundans in lateribus domus tuæ; filii tui sicut novellæ olivarum in circuitu mensæ tuæ.
text_pt: Eis que os filhos são herança do Senhor, e o fruto do ventre o seu galardão.
text_el: ἡ γυνή σου ὡς ἄμπελος εὐθηνοῦσα ἐν τοῖς κλίτεσι τῆς οἰκίας σου οἱ υἱοί σου ὡς νεόφυτα ἐλαιῶν κύκλῳ τῆς τραπέζης σου

text_en: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that fears the Lord .
text_la: Ecce sic benedicetur homo qui timet Dominum.
text_pt: Como flechas na mão de um homem poderoso, assim são os filhos da mocidade.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οὕτως εὐλογηθήσεται ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον

text_en: May the Lord bless you out of Sion: and may you see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
text_la: Benedicat tibi Dominus ex Sion, et videas bona Jerusalem omnibus diebus vitæ tuæ.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que enche deles a sua aljava; não serão confundidos, mas falarão com os seus inimigos à porta.
text_el: εὐλογήσαι σε κύριος ἐκ Σιων καὶ ἴδοις τὰ ἀγαθὰ Ιερουσαλημ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου

text_en: And may you see your children's children, peace upon Israel .
text_la: Et videas filios filiorum tuorum : pacem super Israël.
text_el: καὶ ἴδοις υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν σου εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: Often have they fought against me from my youth, let Israel now say.
text_la: Sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea, dicat nunc Israël;
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele que teme ao SENHOR e anda nos seus caminhos.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου εἰπάτω δὴ Ισραηλ

text_en: Often have they fought against me from my youth: but they could not prevail over me.
text_la: sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea : etenim non potuerunt mihi.
text_pt: Pois comerás do trabalho das tuas mãos; feliz serás, e te irá bem.
text_el: πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησάν μοι

text_en: The wicked have wrought upon my back: they have lengthened their iniquity .
text_la: Supra dorsum meum fabricaverunt peccatores; prolongaverunt iniquitatem suam.
text_pt: A tua mulher será como a videira frutífera aos lados da tua casa; os teus filhos como plantas de oliveira à roda da tua mesa.
text_el: ἐπὶ τοῦ νώτου μου ἐτέκταινον οἱ ἁμαρτωλοί ἐμάκρυναν τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord who is just will cut the necks of sinners:
text_la: Dominus justus concidit cervices peccatorum.
text_pt: Eis que assim será abençoado o homem que teme ao Senhor.
text_el: κύριος δίκαιος συνέκοψεν αὐχένας ἁμαρτωλῶν

text_en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Sion.
text_la: Confundantur, et convertantur retrorsum omnes qui oderunt Sion.
text_pt: O Senhor te abençoará desde Sião, e tu verás o bem de Jerusalém em todos os dias da tua vida.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἀποστραφήτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω πάντες οἱ μισοῦντες Σιων

text_en: Let them be as grass upon the tops of houses: which withers before it be plucked up:
text_la: Fiant sicut fœnum tectorum, quod priusquam evellatur exaruit:
text_pt: E verás os filhos de teus filhos, e a paz sobre Israel.
text_el: γενηθήτωσαν ὡς χόρτος δωμάτων ὃς πρὸ τοῦ ἐκσπασθῆναι ἐξηράνθη

text_en: Who with the mower fills not his hand: nor he that gathers sheaves his bosom.
text_la: de quo non implevit manum suam qui metit, et sinum suum qui manipulos colligit.
text_el: οὗ οὐκ ἐπλήρωσεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ὁ θερίζων καὶ τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ ὁ τὰ δράγματα συλλέγων

text_en: And they that passed by have not said: The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we have blessed you in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Et non dixerunt qui præteribant : Benedictio Domini super vos. Benediximus vobis in nomine Domini.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἶπαν οἱ παράγοντες εὐλογία κυρίου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς εὐλογήκαμεν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: Out of the depths I have cried to you, O Lord :
text_la: De profundis clamavi ad te, Domine;
text_pt: Muitas vezes me angustiaram desde a minha mocidade, diga agora Israel;
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν ἐκ βαθέων ἐκέκραξά σε κύριε

text_en: Lord , hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.
text_la: Domine, exaudi vocem meam. Fiant aures tuæ intendentes in vocem deprecationis meæ.
text_pt: Muitas vezes me angustiaram desde a minha mocidade; todavia não prevaleceram contra mim.
text_el: κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς μου γενηθήτω τὰ ὦτά σου προσέχοντα εἰς τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: If you, O Lord , will mark iniquities : Lord , who shall stand it.
text_la: Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, Domine, quis sustinebit?
text_pt: Os lavradores araram sobre as minhas costas; compridos fizeram os seus sulcos.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀνομίας παρατηρήσῃ κύριε κύριε τίς ὑποστήσεται

text_en: For with you there is merciful forgiveness: and by reason of your law, I have waited for you, O Lord . My soul has relied on his word:
text_la: Quia apud te propitiatio est; et propter legem tuam sustinui te, Domine. Sustinuit anima mea in verbo ejus:
text_pt: O Senhor é justo; cortou as cordas dos ímpios.
text_el: ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ ὁ ἱλασμός ἐστιν

text_en: My soul has hoped in the Lord .
text_la: speravit anima mea in Domino.
text_pt: Sejam confundidos, e voltem para trás todos os que odeiam a Sião.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τοῦ νόμου σου ὑπέμεινά σε κύριε ὑπέμεινεν ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὸν λόγον σου

text_en: From the morning watch even until night, let Israel hope in the Lord .
text_la: A custodia matutina usque ad noctem, speret Israël in Domino.
text_pt: Sejam como a erva dos telhados que se seca antes que a arranquem.
text_el: ἤλπισεν ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ φυλακῆς πρωίας μέχρι νυκτός ἀπὸ φυλακῆς πρωίας ἐλπισάτω Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον

text_en: Because with the Lord there is mercy: and with him plentiful redemption .
text_la: Quia apud Dominum misericordia, et copiosa apud eum redemptio.
text_pt: Com a qual o segador não enche a sua mão, nem o que ata os feixes enche o seu braço.
text_el: ὅτι παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ ἔλεος καὶ πολλὴ παρ' αὐτῷ λύτρωσις

text_en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities .
text_la: Et ipse redimet Israël ex omnibus iniquitatibus ejus.
text_pt: Nem tampouco os que passam dizem: A bênção do Senhor seja sobre vós; nós vos abençoamos em nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς λυτρώσεται τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Lord , my heart is not exalted: nor are my eyes lofty. Neither have I walked in great matters, nor in wonderful things above me.
text_la: Domine, non est exaltatum cor meum, neque elati sunt oculi mei, neque ambulavi in magnis, neque in mirabilibus super me.
text_pt: Das profundezas a ti clamo, ó SENHOR.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν τῷ Δαυιδ κύριε οὐχ ὑψώθη μου ἡ καρδία οὐδὲ ἐμετεωρίσθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου οὐδὲ ἐπορεύθην ἐν μεγάλοις οὐδὲ ἐν θαυμασίοις ὑπὲρ ἐμέ

text_en: If I was not humbly minded, but exalted my soul : As a child that is weaned is towards his mother, so reward in my soul .
text_la: Si non humiliter sentiebam, sed exaltavi animam meam : sicut ablactatus est super matre sua, ita retributio in anima mea.
text_pt: Senhor, escuta a minha voz; sejam os teus ouvidos atentos à voz das minhas súplicas.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ἐταπεινοφρόνουν ἀλλὰ ὕψωσα τὴν ψυχήν μου ὡς τὸ ἀπογεγαλακτισμένον ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀνταπόδοσις ἐπὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: Let Israel hope in the Lord , from henceforth now and for ever.
text_la: Speret Israël in Domino, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
text_pt: Se tu, Senhor, observares as iniqüidades, Senhor, quem subsistirá?
text_el: ἐλπισάτω Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: O Lord , remember David , and all his meekness.
text_la: Memento, Domine, David, et omnis mansuetudinis ejus:
text_pt: SENHOR, o meu coração não se elevou nem os meus olhos se levantaram; não me exercito em grandes matérias, nem em coisas muito elevadas para mim.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν μνήσθητι κύριε τοῦ Δαυιδ καὶ πάσης τῆς πραΰτητος αὐτοῦ

text_en: How he swore to the Lord , he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob :
text_la: sicut juravit Domino; votum vovit Deo Jacob:
text_pt: Certamente que me tenho portado e sossegado como uma criança desmamada de sua mãe; a minha alma está como uma criança desmamada.
text_el: ὡς ὤμοσεν τῷ κυρίῳ ηὔξατο τῷ θεῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:
text_la: Si introiero in tabernaculum domus meæ; si ascendero in lectum strati mei;
text_pt: Espere Israel no Senhor, desde agora e para sempre.
text_el: εἰ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς σκήνωμα οἴκου μου εἰ ἀναβήσομαι ἐπὶ κλίνης στρωμνῆς μου

text_en: If I shall give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
text_la: si dedero somnum oculis meis, et palpebris meis dormitationem,
text_el: εἰ δώσω ὕπνον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου καὶ τοῖς βλεφάροις μου νυσταγμὸν καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν τοῖς κροτάφοις μου

text_en: or rest to my temples : until I find out a place for the Lord , a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
text_la: et requiem temporibus meis, donec inveniam locum Domino, tabernaculum Deo Jacob.
text_el: ἕως οὗ εὕρω τόπον τῷ κυρίῳ σκήνωμα τῷ θεῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata : we have found it in the fields of the wood.
text_la: Ecce audivimus eam in Ephrata; invenimus eam in campis silvæ.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἠκούσαμεν αὐτὴν ἐν Εφραθα εὕρομεν αὐτὴν ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ

text_en: We will go into his tabernacle: we will adore in the place where his feet stood.
text_la: Introibimus in tabernaculum ejus; adorabimus in loco ubi steterunt pedes ejus.
text_el: εἰσελευσόμεθα εἰς τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτοῦ προσκυνήσομεν εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ ἔστησαν οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ

text_en: Arise, O Lord , into your resting place: you and the ark , which you have sanctified .
text_la: Surge, Domine, in requiem tuam, tu et arca sanctificationis tuæ.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι κύριε εἰς τὴν ἀνάπαυσίν σου σὺ καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ ἁγιάσματός σου

text_en: Let your priests be clothed with justice : and let your saints rejoice.
text_la: Sacerdotes tui induantur justitiam, et sancti tui exsultent.
text_el: οἱ ἱερεῖς σου ἐνδύσονται δικαιοσύνην καὶ οἱ ὅσιοί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: For your servant David's sake, turn not away the face of your anointed.
text_la: Propter David servum tuum non avertas faciem christi tui.
text_el: ἕνεκεν Δαυιδ τοῦ δούλου σου μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ χριστοῦ σου

text_en: The Lord has sworn truth to David , and he will not make it void: of the fruit of your womb I will set upon your throne.
text_la: Juravit Dominus David veritatem, et non frustrabitur eam : De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
text_el: ὤμοσεν κύριος τῷ Δαυιδ ἀλήθειαν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσει αὐτήν ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς κοιλίας σου θήσομαι ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον σου

text_en: If your children will keep my covenant, and these my testimonies which I shall teach them: Their children also for evermore shall sit upon your throne.
text_la: Si custodierint filii tui testamentum meum, et testimonia mea hæc quæ docebo eos, et filii eorum usque in sæculum sedebunt super sedem tuam.
text_el: ἐὰν φυλάξωνται οἱ υἱοί σου τὴν διαθήκην μου καὶ τὰ μαρτύριά μου ταῦτα ἃ διδάξω αὐτούς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος καθιοῦνται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σου

text_en: For the Lord has chosen Sion: he has chosen it for his dwelling.
text_la: Quoniam elegit Dominus Sion : elegit eam in habitationem sibi.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξελέξατο κύριος τὴν Σιων ᾑρετίσατο αὐτὴν εἰς κατοικίαν ἑαυτῷ

text_en: This is my rest for ever and ever: here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.
text_la: Hæc requies mea in sæculum sæculi; hic habitabo, quoniam elegi eam.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κατάπαυσίς μου εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος ὧδε κατοικήσω ὅτι ᾑρετισάμην αὐτήν

text_en: Blessing I will bless her widow : I will satisfy her poor with bread.
text_la: Viduam ejus benedicens benedicam; pauperes ejus saturabo panibus.
text_el: τὴν θήραν αὐτῆς εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω τοὺς πτωχοὺς αὐτῆς χορτάσω ἄρτων

text_en: I will clothe her priests with salvation , and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy .
text_la: Sacerdotes ejus induam salutari, et sancti ejus exsultatione exsultabunt.
text_el: τοὺς ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἐνδύσω σωτηρίαν καὶ οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτῆς ἀγαλλιάσει ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: There will I bring forth a horn to David : I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.
text_la: Illuc producam cornu David; paravi lucernam christo meo.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαυιδ ἡτοίμασα λύχνον τῷ χριστῷ μου

text_en: His enemies I will clothe with confusion: but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.
text_la: Inimicos ejus induam confusione; super ipsum autem efflorebit sanctificatio mea.
text_el: τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ ἐνδύσω αἰσχύνην ἐπὶ δὲ αὐτὸν ἐξανθήσει τὸ ἁγίασμά μου

text_en: Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity:
text_la: Ecce quam bonum et quam jucundum, habitare fratres in unum!
text_pt: Lembra-te, SENHOR, de Davi, e de todas as suas aflições.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν τῷ Δαυιδ ἰδοὺ δὴ τί καλὸν ἢ τί τερπνὸν ἀλλ' ἢ τὸ κατοικεῖν ἀδελφοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: Like the precious ointment on the head, that ran down upon the beard , the beard of Aaron , which ran down to the skirt of his garment:
text_la: Sicut unguentum in capite, quod descendit in barbam, barbam Aaron, quod descendit in oram vestimenti ejus;
text_pt: Como jurou ao Senhor, e fez votos ao poderoso Deus de Jacó, dizendo:
text_el: ὡς μύρον ἐπὶ κεφαλῆς τὸ καταβαῖνον ἐπὶ πώγωνα τὸν πώγωνα τὸν Ααρων τὸ καταβαῖνον ἐπὶ τὴν ᾤαν τοῦ ἐνδύματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: As the dew of Hermon , which descends upon mount Sion. For there the Lord has commanded blessing , and life for evermore.
text_la: sicut ros Hermon, qui descendit in montem Sion. Quoniam illic mandavit Dominus benedictionem, et vitam usque in sæculum.
text_pt: Certamente que não entrarei na tenda de minha casa, nem subirei à minha cama,
text_el: ὡς δρόσος Αερμων ἡ καταβαίνουσα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Σιων ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τὴν εὐλογίαν καὶ ζωὴν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Behold now bless the Lord , all you servants of the Lord : Who stand in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God .
text_la: Ecce nunc benedicite Dominum, omnes servi Domini : qui statis in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri.
text_pt: Oh! quão bom e quão suave é que os irmãos vivam em união.
text_el: ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν ἰδοὺ δὴ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον πάντες οἱ δοῦλοι κυρίου οἱ ἑστῶτες ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν αὐλαῖς οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, and bless the Lord .
text_la: In noctibus extollite manus vestras in sancta, et benedicite Dominum.
text_pt: É como o óleo precioso sobre a cabeça, que desce sobre a barba, a barba de Arão, e que desce à orla das suas vestes.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς νυξὶν ἐπάρατε τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν εἰς τὰ ἅγια καὶ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον

text_en: May the Lord out of Sion bless you, he that made heaven and earth.
text_la: Benedicat te Dominus ex Sion, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text_pt: Como o orvalho de Hermom, e como o que desce sobre os montes de Sião, porque ali o Senhor ordena a bênção e a vida para sempre.
text_el: εὐλογήσει σε κύριος ἐκ Σιων ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Praise the name of the Lord : O you his servants, praise the Lord :
text_la: Laudate nomen Domini; laudate, servi, Dominum:
text_pt: Eis aqui, bendizei ao SENHOR todos vós, servos do SENHOR, que assistis na casa do SENHOR todas as noites.
text_el: αλληλουια αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου αἰνεῖτε δοῦλοι κύριον

text_en: You that stand in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God .
text_la: qui statis in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri.
text_pt: Levantai as vossas mãos no santuário, e bendizei ao Senhor.
text_el: οἱ ἑστῶτες ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν αὐλαῖς οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good : sing to his name , for it is sweet.
text_la: Laudate Dominum, quia bonus Dominus; psallite nomini ejus, quoniam suave.
text_pt: O Senhor que fez o céu e a terra te abençoe desde Sião.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ὅτι ἀγαθὸς κύριος ψάλατε τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ὅτι καλόν

text_en: For the Lord has chosen Jacob unto himself: Israel for his own possession.
text_la: Quoniam Jacob elegit sibi Dominus; Israël in possessionem sibi.
text_el: ὅτι τὸν Ιακωβ ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ ὁ κύριος Ισραηλ εἰς περιουσιασμὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: For I have known that the Lord is great, and our God is above all gods.
text_la: Quia ego cognovi quod magnus est Dominus, et Deus noster præ omnibus diis.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἔγνων ὅτι μέγας κύριος καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν παρὰ πάντας τοὺς θεούς

text_en: Whatsoever the Lord pleased he has done, in heaven , in earth, in the sea, and in all the deeps .
text_la: Omnia quæcumque voluit Dominus fecit, in cælo, in terra, in mari et in omnibus abyssis.
text_el: πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ὁ κύριος ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐν ταῖς θαλάσσαις καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀβύσσοις

text_en: He brings up clouds from the end of the earth: he has made lightnings for the rain. He brings forth winds out of his stores:
text_la: Educens nubes ab extremo terræ, fulgura in pluviam fecit; qui producit ventos de thesauris suis.
text_el: ἀνάγων νεφέλας ἐξ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἀστραπὰς εἰς ὑετὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ ἐξάγων ἀνέμους ἐκ θησαυρῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man even unto beast.
text_la: Qui percussit primogenita Ægypti, ab homine usque ad pecus.
text_el: ὃς ἐπάταξεν τὰ πρωτότοκα Αἰγύπτου ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους

text_en: He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of you, O Egypt : upon Pharao , and upon all his servants.
text_la: Et misit signa et prodigia in medio tui, Ægypte : in Pharaonem, et in omnes servos ejus.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν μέσῳ σου Αἴγυπτε ἐν Φαραω καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: He smote many nations, and slew mighty kings:
text_la: Qui percussit gentes multas, et occidit reges fortes:
text_el: ὃς ἐπάταξεν ἔθνη πολλὰ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν βασιλεῖς κραταιούς

text_en: Sehon king of the Amorrhites , and Og king of Basan, and all the kingdoms of Chanaan .
text_la: Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, et Og, regem Basan, et omnia regna Chanaan:
text_el: τὸν Σηων βασιλέα τῶν Αμορραίων καὶ τὸν Ωγ βασιλέα τῆς Βασαν καὶ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας Χανααν

text_en: And gave their land for an inheritance, for an inheritance to his people Israel .
text_la: et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, hæreditatem Israël populo suo.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν κληρονομίαν κληρονομίαν Ισραηλ λαῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Your name , O Lord , is for ever: your memorial, O Lord , unto all generations .
text_la: Domine, nomen tuum in æternum; Domine, memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem.
text_el: κύριε τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κύριε τὸ μνημόσυνόν σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν

text_en: For the Lord will judge his people, and will be entreated in favour of his servants.
text_la: Quia judicabit Dominus populum suum, et in servis suis deprecabitur.
text_el: ὅτι κρινεῖ κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ παρακληθήσεται

text_en: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, the works of men's hands.
text_la: Simulacra gentium argentum et aurum, opera manuum hominum.
text_el: τὰ εἴδωλα τῶν ἐθνῶν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: They have a mouth, but they speak not: they have eyes, but they see not.
text_la: Os habent, et non loquentur; oculos habent, et non videbunt.
text_el: στόμα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ λαλήσουσιν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὄψονται

text_en: They have ears, but they hear not: neither is there any breath in their mouths.
text_la: Aures habent, et non audient; neque enim est spiritus in ore ipsorum.
text_el: ὦτα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ἐνωτισθήσονται ῥῖνας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὀσφρανθήσονται χεῖρας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ ψηλαφήσουσιν πόδας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ περιπατήσουσιν οὐ φωνήσουσιν ἐν τῷ λάρυγγι αὐτῶν οὐδὲ γάρ ἐστιν πνεῦμα ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: Let them that make them be like to them: and every one that trusts in them.
text_la: Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea, et omnes qui confidunt in eis.
text_el: ὅμοιοι αὐτοῖς γένοιντο οἱ ποιοῦντες αὐτὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: Bless the Lord , O house of Israel : bless the Lord , O house of Aaron .
text_la: Domus Israël, benedicite Domino; domus Aaron, benedicite Domino.
text_el: οἶκος Ισραηλ εὐλογήσατε τὸν κύριον οἶκος Ααρων εὐλογήσατε τὸν κύριον

text_en: Bless the Lord , O house of Levi : you that fear the Lord , bless the Lord .
text_la: Domus Levi, benedicite Domino; qui timetis Dominum, benedicite Domino.
text_el: οἶκος Λευι εὐλογήσατε τὸν κύριον οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον εὐλογήσατε τὸν κύριον

text_en: Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, who dwells in Jerusalem .
text_la: Benedictus Dominus ex Sion, qui habitat in Jerusalem.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ἐκ Σιων ὁ κατοικῶν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Praise the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvai o nome do SENHOR; louvai-o, servos do SENHOR.
text_el: αλληλουια ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι χρηστός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise the God of gods: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Deo deorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Vós que assistis na casa do Senhor, nos átrios da casa do nosso Deus.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ θεῷ τῶν θεῶν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise the Lord of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor, porque o Senhor é bom; cantai louvores ao seu nome, porque é agradável.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ τῶν κυρίων ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who alone does great wonders: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui facit mirabilia magna solus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor escolheu para si a Jacó, e a Israel para seu próprio tesouro.
text_el: τῷ ποιοῦντι θαυμάσια μεγάλα μόνῳ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ
