text_en: Who made the heavens in understanding: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui fecit cælos in intellectu, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Porque eu conheço que o Senhor é grande e que o nosso Senhor está acima de todos os deuses.
text_el: τῷ ποιήσαντι τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἐν συνέσει ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who established the earth above the waters: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui firmavit terram super aquas, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Tudo o que o Senhor quis, fez, nos céus e na terra, nos mares e em todos os abismos.
text_el: τῷ στερεώσαντι τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who made the great lights: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui fecit luminaria magna, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:
text_pt: Faz subir os vapores das extremidades da terra; faz os relâmpagos para a chuva; tira os ventos dos seus tesouros.
text_el: τῷ ποιήσαντι φῶτα μεγάλα μόνῳ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sun to rule the day: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: solem in potestatem diei, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: O que feriu os primogênitos do Egito, desde os homens até os animais;
text_el: τὸν ἥλιον εἰς ἐξουσίαν τῆς ἡμέρας ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: The moon and the stars to rule the night: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: lunam et stellas in potestatem noctis, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: O que enviou sinais e prodígios no meio de ti, ó Egito, contra Faraó e contra os seus servos;
text_el: τὴν σελήνην καὶ τὰ ἄστρα εἰς ἐξουσίαν τῆς νυκτός ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who smote Egypt with their firstborn : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui percussit Ægyptum cum primogenitis eorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: O que feriu muitas nações, e matou poderosos reis:
text_el: τῷ πατάξαντι Αἴγυπτον σὺν τοῖς πρωτοτόκοις αὐτῶν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui eduxit Israël de medio eorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus,
text_pt: A Siom, rei dos amorreus, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, e a todos os reinos de Canaã;
text_el: καὶ ἐξαγαγόντι τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: With a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: in manu potenti et brachio excelso, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: E deu a sua terra em herança, em herança a Israel, seu povo.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who divided the Red Sea into parts: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui divisit mare Rubrum in divisiones, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: O teu nome, ó Senhor, dura perpetuamente, e a tua memória, ó Senhor, de geração em geração.
text_el: τῷ καταδιελόντι τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν εἰς διαιρέσεις ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And brought out Israel through the midst thereof: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et eduxit Israël per medium ejus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: Pois o Senhor julgará o seu povo, e se arrependerá com respeito aos seus servos.
text_el: καὶ διαγαγόντι τὸν Ισραηλ διὰ μέσου αὐτῆς ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red Sea : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et excussit Pharaonem et virtutem ejus in mari Rubro, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Os ídolos dos gentios são prata e ouro, obra das mãos dos homens.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτινάξαντι Φαραω καὶ τὴν δύναμιν αὐτοῦ εἰς θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who led his people through the desert : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui traduxit populum suum per desertum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, e não vêem,
text_el: τῷ διαγαγόντι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ τῷ ἐξαγαγόντι ὕδωρ ἐκ πέτρας ἀκροτόμου ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who smote great kings: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui percussit reges magnos, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: Têm ouvidos, mas não ouvem, nem há respiro algum nas suas bocas.
text_el: τῷ πατάξαντι βασιλεῖς μεγάλους ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And slew strong kings: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et occidit reges fortes, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:
text_pt: Semelhantes a eles se tornem os que os fazem, e todos os que confiam neles.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκτείναντι βασιλεῖς κραταιούς ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sehon king of the Amorrhites : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: Casa de Israel, bendizei ao Senhor; casa de Arão, bendizei ao Senhor;
text_el: τὸν Σηων βασιλέα τῶν Αμορραίων ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Og king of Basan: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et Og, regem Basan, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus:
text_pt: Casa de Levi, bendizei ao Senhor; vós os que temeis ao Senhor, louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ωγ βασιλέα τῆς Βασαν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he gave their land for an inheritance: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor desde Sião, que habita em Jerusalém. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ δόντι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν κληρονομίαν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: For an inheritance to his servant Israel : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: hæreditatem Israël, servo suo, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_el: κληρονομίαν Ισραηλ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: For he was mindful of us in our affliction: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Quia in humilitate nostra memor fuit nostri, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus;
text_el: ὅτι ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει ἡμῶν ἐμνήσθη ἡμῶν ὁ κύριος ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: et redemit nos ab inimicis nostris, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Qui dat escam omni carni, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_el: ὁ διδοὺς τροφὴν πάσῃ σαρκί ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Give glory to the God of heaven : for his mercy endures for ever. Give glory to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Deo cæli, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ τῶν κυρίων ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Upon the rivers of Babylon , there we sat and wept: when we remembered Sion:
text_la: Super flumina Babylonis illic sedimus et flevimus, cum recordaremur Sion.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ἐπὶ τῶν ποταμῶν Βαβυλῶνος ἐκεῖ ἐκαθίσαμεν καὶ ἐκλαύσαμεν ἐν τῷ μνησθῆναι ἡμᾶς τῆς Σιων

text_en: On the willows in the midst thereof we hung up our instruments.
text_la: In salicibus in medio ejus suspendimus organa nostra:
text_pt: Louvai ao Deus dos deuses; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: ἐπὶ ταῖς ἰτέαις ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκρεμάσαμεν τὰ ὄργανα ἡμῶν

text_en: For there they that led us into captivity required of us the words of songs. And they that carried us away, said: Sing to us a hymn of the songs of Sion.
text_la: quia illic interrogaverunt nos, qui captivos duxerunt nos, verba cantionum; et qui abduxerunt nos : Hymnum cantate nobis de canticis Sion.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor dos senhores; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐπηρώτησαν ἡμᾶς οἱ αἰχμαλωτεύσαντες ἡμᾶς λόγους ᾠδῶν καὶ οἱ ἀπαγαγόντες ἡμᾶς ὕμνον ᾄσατε ἡμῖν ἐκ τῶν ᾠδῶν Σιων

text_en: How shall we sing the song of the Lord in a strange land?
text_la: Quomodo cantabimus canticum Domini in terra aliena?
text_pt: Aquele que só faz maravilhas; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: πῶς ᾄσωμεν τὴν ᾠδὴν κυρίου ἐπὶ γῆς ἀλλοτρίας

text_en: If I forget you, O Jerusalem , let my right hand be forgotten.
text_la: Si oblitus fuero tui, Jerusalem, oblivioni detur dextera mea.
text_pt: Aquele que por entendimento fez os céus; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐπιλάθωμαί σου Ιερουσαλημ ἐπιλησθείη ἡ δεξιά μου

text_en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws, if I do not remember you: If I make not Jerusalem the beginning of my joy .
text_la: Adhæreat lingua mea faucibus meis, si non meminero tui; si non proposuero Jerusalem in principio lætitiæ meæ.
text_pt: Aquele que estendeu a terra sobre as águas; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.
text_el: κολληθείη ἡ γλῶσσά μου τῷ λάρυγγί μου ἐὰν μή σου μνησθῶ ἐὰν μὴ προανατάξωμαι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἀρχῇ τῆς εὐφροσύνης μου

text_en: Remember, O Lord , the children of Edom , in the day of Jerusalem : Who say: Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
text_la: Memor esto, Domine, filiorum Edom, in die Jerusalem : qui dicunt : Exinanite, exinanite usque ad fundamentum in ea.
text_pt: Aquele que fez os grandes luminares; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre;
text_el: μνήσθητι κύριε τῶν υἱῶν Εδωμ τὴν ἡμέραν Ιερουσαλημ τῶν λεγόντων ἐκκενοῦτε ἐκκενοῦτε ἕως ὁ θεμέλιος ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: O daughter of Babylon , miserable: blessed shall he be who shall repay you your payment which you have paid us.
text_la: Filia Babylonis misera! beatus qui retribuet tibi retributionem tuam quam retribuisti nobis.
text_pt: O sol para governar de dia; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre;
text_el: θυγάτηρ Βαβυλῶνος ἡ ταλαίπωρος μακάριος ὃς ἀνταποδώσει σοι τὸ ἀνταπόδομά σου ὃ ἀνταπέδωκας ἡμῖν

text_en: Blessed be he that shall take and dash your little ones against the rock.
text_la: Beatus qui tenebit, et allidet parvulos tuos ad petram.
text_pt: A lua e as estrelas para presidirem à noite; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre;
text_el: μακάριος ὃς κρατήσει καὶ ἐδαφιεῖ τὰ νήπιά σου πρὸς τὴν πέτραν

text_en: I will praise you, O Lord , with my whole heart: for you have heard the words of my mouth. I will sing praise to you in the sight of the angels :
text_la: Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo, quoniam audisti verba oris mei. In conspectu angelorum psallam tibi;
text_pt: Junto aos rios da Babilônia, ali nos assentamos e choramos, quando nos lembramos de Sião.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ὅτι ἤκουσας τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου καὶ ἐναντίον ἀγγέλων ψαλῶ σοι

text_en: I will worship towards your holy temple , and I will give glory to your name . For your mercy, and for your truth : for you have magnified your holy name above all.
text_la: adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitebor nomini tuo : super misericordia tua et veritate tua; quoniam magnificasti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
text_pt: Sobre os salgueiros que há no meio dela, penduramos as nossas harpas.
text_el: προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου καὶ ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνας ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄνομα τὸ λόγιόν σου

text_en: In what day soever I shall call upon you, hear me: you shall multiply strength in my soul .
text_la: In quacumque die invocavero te, exaudi me; multiplicabis in anima mea virtutem.
text_pt: Pois lá aqueles que nos levaram cativos nos pediam uma canção; e os que nos destruíram, que os alegrássemos, dizendo: Cantai-nos uma das canções de Sião.
text_el: ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου πολυωρήσεις με ἐν ψυχῇ μου ἐν δυνάμει

text_en: May all the kings of the earth give glory to you: for they have heard all the words of your mouth.
text_la: Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnes reges terræ, quia audierunt omnia verba oris tui.
text_pt: Como cantaremos a canção do Senhor em terra estranha?
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι κύριε πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἤκουσαν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός σου

text_en: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord : for great is the glory of the Lord .
text_la: Et cantent in viis Domini, quoniam magna est gloria Domini;
text_pt: Se eu me esquecer de ti, ó Jerusalém, esqueça-se a minha direita da sua destreza.
text_el: καὶ ᾀσάτωσαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς κυρίου ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ δόξα κυρίου

text_en: For the Lord is high, and looks on the low: and the high he knows afar off.
text_la: quoniam excelsus Dominus, et humilia respicit, et alta a longe cognoscit.
text_pt: Se me não lembrar de ti, apegue-se-me a língua ao meu paladar; se não preferir Jerusalém à minha maior alegria.
text_el: ὅτι ὑψηλὸς κύριος καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορᾷ καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν γινώσκει

text_en: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, you will quicken me: and you have stretched forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies: and your right hand has saved me.
text_la: Si ambulavero in medio tribulationis, vivificabis me; et super iram inimicorum meorum extendisti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit dextera tua.
text_pt: Lembra-te, Senhor, dos filhos de Edom no dia de Jerusalém, que diziam: Descobri-a, descobri-a até aos seus alicerces.
text_el: ἐὰν πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ θλίψεως ζήσεις με ἐπ' ὀργὴν ἐχθρῶν μου ἐξέτεινας χεῖρά σου καὶ ἔσωσέν με ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: The Lord will repay for me: your mercy, O Lord , endures for ever: O despise not the works of your hands.
text_la: Dominus retribuet pro me. Domine, misericordia tua in sæculum; opera manuum tuarum ne despicias.
text_pt: Ah! filha de babilônia, que vais ser assolada; feliz aquele que te retribuir o pago que tu nos pagaste a nós.
text_el: κύριος ἀνταποδώσει ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ κύριε τὸ ἔλεός σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου μὴ παρῇς

text_en: Lord , you have proved me, and known me:
text_la: Domine, probasti me, et cognovisti me;
text_pt: Eu te louvarei, de todo o meu coração; na presença dos deuses a ti cantarei louvores.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ κύριε ἐδοκίμασάς με καὶ ἔγνως με

text_en: You have known my sitting down, and my rising up.
text_la: tu cognovisti sessionem meam et resurrectionem meam.
text_pt: Inclinar-me-ei para o teu santo templo, e louvarei o teu nome pela tua benignidade, e pela tua verdade; pois engrandeceste a tua palavra acima de todo o teu nome.
text_el: σὺ ἔγνως τὴν καθέδραν μου καὶ τὴν ἔγερσίν μου σὺ συνῆκας τοὺς διαλογισμούς μου ἀπὸ μακρόθεν

text_en: You have understood my thoughts afar off: my path and my line you have searched out.
text_la: Intellexisti cogitationes meas de longe; semitam meam et funiculum meum investigasti:
text_pt: No dia em que eu clamei, me escutaste; e alentaste com força a minha alma.
text_el: τὴν τρίβον μου καὶ τὴν σχοῖνόν μου σὺ ἐξιχνίασας καὶ πάσας τὰς ὁδούς μου προεῖδες

text_en: And you have foreseen all my ways: for there is no speech in my tongue.
text_la: et omnes vias meas prævidisti, quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
text_pt: Todos os reis da terra te louvarão, ó Senhor, quando ouvirem as palavras da tua boca;
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν λόγος ἐν γλώσσῃ μου

text_en: Behold, O Lord , you have known all things, the last and those of old: you have formed me, and have laid your hand upon me.
text_la: Ecce, Domine, tu cognovisti omnia, novissima et antiqua. Tu formasti me, et posuisti super me manum tuam.
text_pt: E cantarão os caminhos do Senhor; pois grande é a glória do Senhor.
text_el: ἰδού κύριε σὺ ἔγνως πάντα τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ τὰ ἀρχαῖα σὺ ἔπλασάς με καὶ ἔθηκας ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὴν χεῖρά σου

text_en: Your knowledge has become wonderful to me: it is high, and I cannot reach to it.
text_la: Mirabilis facta est scientia tua ex me; confortata est, et non potero ad eam.
text_pt: Ainda que o Senhor é excelso, atenta todavia para o humilde; mas ao soberbo conhece-o de longe.
text_el: ἐθαυμαστώθη ἡ γνῶσίς σου ἐξ ἐμοῦ ἐκραταιώθη οὐ μὴ δύνωμαι πρὸς αὐτήν

text_en: Whither shall I go from your spirit? Or whither shall I flee from your face?
text_la: Quo ibo a spiritu tuo? et quo a facie tua fugiam?
text_pt: Andando eu no meio da angústia, tu me reviverás; estenderás a tua mão contra a ira dos meus inimigos, e a tua destra me salvará.
text_el: ποῦ πορευθῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός σου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου ποῦ φύγω

text_en: If I ascend into heaven , you are there: if I descend into hell, you are present.
text_la: Si ascendero in cælum, tu illic es; si descendero in infernum, ades.
text_pt: O Senhor aperfeiçoará o que me toca; a tua benignidade, ó Senhor, dura para sempre; não desampares as obras das tuas mãos.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀναβῶ εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν σὺ εἶ ἐκεῖ ἐὰν καταβῶ εἰς τὸν ᾅδην πάρει

text_en: If I take my wings early in the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:
text_la: Si sumpsero pennas meas diluculo, et habitavero in extremis maris,
text_el: ἐὰν ἀναλάβοιμι τὰς πτέρυγάς μου κατ' ὄρθρον καὶ κατασκηνώσω εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: Even there also shall your hand lead me: and your right hand shall hold me.
text_la: etenim illuc manus tua deducet me, et tenebit me dextera tua.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐκεῖ ἡ χείρ σου ὁδηγήσει με καὶ καθέξει με ἡ δεξιά σου

text_en: And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: and night shall be my light in my pleasures.
text_la: Et dixi : Forsitan tenebræ conculcabunt me; et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ἄρα σκότος καταπατήσει με καὶ νὺξ φωτισμὸς ἐν τῇ τρυφῇ μου

text_en: But darkness shall not be dark to you, and night shall be light all the day: the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to you.
text_la: Quia tenebræ non obscurabuntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminabitur : sicut tenebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus.
text_el: ὅτι σκότος οὐ σκοτισθήσεται ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ νὺξ ὡς ἡμέρα φωτισθήσεται ὡς τὸ σκότος αὐτῆς οὕτως καὶ τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς

text_en: For you have possessed my reins: you have protected me from my mother's womb.
text_la: Quia tu possedisti renes meos; suscepisti me de utero matris meæ.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ ἐκτήσω τοὺς νεφρούς μου κύριε ἀντελάβου μου ἐκ γαστρὸς μητρός μου

text_en: I will praise you, for you are fearfully magnified: wonderful are your works, and my soul knows right well.
text_la: Confitebor tibi, quia terribiliter magnificatus es; mirabilia opera tua, et anima mea cognoscit nimis.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ὅτι φοβερῶς ἐθαυμαστώθην θαυμάσια τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου γινώσκει σφόδρα

text_en: My bone is not hidden from you, which you have made in secret: and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.
text_la: Non est occultatum os meum a te, quod fecisti in occulto; et substantia mea in inferioribus terræ.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκρύβη τὸ ὀστοῦν μου ἀπὸ σοῦ ὃ ἐποίησας ἐν κρυφῇ καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασίς μου ἐν τοῖς κατωτάτοις τῆς γῆς

text_en: Your eyes did see my imperfect being, and in your book all shall be written: days shall be formed, and no one in them.
text_la: Imperfectum meum viderunt oculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribentur. Dies formabuntur, et nemo in eis.
text_el: τὸ ἀκατέργαστόν μου εἴδοσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον σου πάντες γραφήσονται ἡμέρας πλασθήσονται καὶ οὐθεὶς ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: But to me your friends, O God , are made exceedingly honourable : their principality is exceedingly strengthened.
text_la: Mihi autem nimis honorificati sunt amici tui, Deus; nimis confortatus est principatus eorum.
text_el: ἐμοὶ δὲ λίαν ἐτιμήθησαν οἱ φίλοι σου ὁ θεός λίαν ἐκραταιώθησαν αἱ ἀρχαὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand, I rose up and am still with you.
text_la: Dinumerabo eos, et super arenam multiplicabuntur. Exsurrexi, et adhuc sum tecum.
text_el: ἐξαριθμήσομαι αὐτούς καὶ ὑπὲρ ἄμμον πληθυνθήσονται ἐξηγέρθην καὶ ἔτι εἰμὶ μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: If you will kill the wicked , O God : you men of blood, depart from me:
text_la: Si occideris, Deus, peccatores, viri sanguinum, declinate a me:
text_el: ἐὰν ἀποκτείνῃς ἁμαρτωλούς ὁ θεός ἄνδρες αἱμάτων ἐκκλίνατε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Because you say in thought: They shall receive your cities in vain.
text_la: quia dicitis in cogitatione : Accipient in vanitate civitates tuas.
text_el: ὅτι ἐρεῖς εἰς διαλογισμόν λήμψονται εἰς ματαιότητα τὰς πόλεις σου

text_en: Have I not hated them, O Lord , that hated you: and pined away because of your enemies?
text_la: Nonne qui oderunt te, Domine, oderam, et super inimicos tuos tabescebam?
text_el: οὐχὶ τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε κύριε ἐμίσησα καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἐξετηκόμην

text_en: I have hated them with a perfect hatred : and they have become enemies to me.
text_la: Perfecto odio oderam illos, et inimici facti sunt mihi.
text_el: τέλειον μῖσος ἐμίσουν αὐτούς εἰς ἐχθροὺς ἐγένοντό μοι

text_en: Prove me, O God , and know my heart: examine me, and know my paths.
text_la: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum; interroga me, et cognosce semitas meas.
text_el: δοκίμασόν με ὁ θεός καὶ γνῶθι τὴν καρδίαν μου ἔτασόν με καὶ γνῶθι τὰς τρίβους μου

text_en: And see if there be in me the way of iniquity : and lead me in the eternal way.
text_la: Et vide si via iniquitatis in me est, et deduc me in via æterna.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὲ εἰ ὁδὸς ἀνομίας ἐν ἐμοί καὶ ὁδήγησόν με ἐν ὁδῷ αἰωνίᾳ

text_en: Unto the end, a psalm of David .
text_la: In finem. Psalmus David.
text_pt: SENHOR, tu me sondaste, e me conheces.
text_el: εἰς τὸ τέλος ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: Deliver me, O Lord , from the evil man : rescue me from the unjust man .
text_la: Eripe me, Domine, ab homine malo; a viro iniquo eripe me.
text_pt: Tu sabes o meu assentar e o meu levantar; de longe entendes o meu pensamento.
text_el: ἐξελοῦ με κύριε ἐξ ἀνθρώπου πονηροῦ ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἀδίκου ῥῦσαί με

text_en: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: all the day long they designed battles.
text_la: Qui cogitaverunt iniquitates in corde, tota die constituebant prælia.
text_pt: Cercas o meu andar, e o meu deitar; e conheces todos os meus caminhos.
text_el: οἵτινες ἐλογίσαντο ἀδικίας ἐν καρδίᾳ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν παρετάσσοντο πολέμους

text_en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: the venom of asps is under their lips.
text_la: Acuerunt linguas suas sicut serpentis; venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum.
text_pt: Não havendo ainda palavra alguma na minha língua, eis que logo, ó Senhor, tudo conheces.
text_el: ἠκόνησαν γλῶσσαν αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ ὄφεως ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν διάψαλμα

text_en: Keep me, O Lord , from the hand of the wicked : and from unjust men deliver me. Who have proposed to supplant my steps:
text_la: Custodi me, Domine, de manu peccatoris, et ab hominibus iniquis eripe me. Qui cogitaverunt supplantare gressus meos:
text_pt: Tu me cercaste por detrás e por diante, e puseste sobre mim a tua mão.
text_el: φύλαξόν με κύριε ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων ἀδίκων ἐξελοῦ με οἵτινες ἐλογίσαντο ὑποσκελίσαι τὰ διαβήματά μου

text_en: The proud have hidden a net for me. And they have stretched out cords for a snare: they have laid for me a stumbling block by the wayside.
text_la: absconderunt superbi laqueum mihi. Et funes extenderunt in laqueum; juxta iter, scandalum posuerunt mihi.
text_pt: Tal ciência é para mim maravilhosíssima; tão alta que não a posso atingir.
text_el: ἔκρυψαν ὑπερήφανοι παγίδα μοι καὶ σχοινία διέτειναν παγίδας τοῖς ποσίν μου ἐχόμενα τρίβου σκάνδαλον ἔθεντό μοι διάψαλμα

text_en: I said to the Lord : You are my God : hear, O Lord , the voice of my supplication.
text_la: Dixi Domino : Deus meus es tu; exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ.
text_pt: Para onde me irei do teu espírito, ou para onde fugirei da tua face?
text_el: εἶπα τῷ κυρίῳ θεός μου εἶ σύ ἐνώτισαι κύριε τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου

text_en: O Lord , Lord , the strength of my salvation : you have overshadowed my head in the day of battle.
text_la: Domine, Domine, virtus salutis meæ, obumbrasti super caput meum in die belli.
text_pt: Se subir ao céu, lá tu estás; se fizer no inferno a minha cama, eis que tu ali estás também.
text_el: κύριε κύριε δύναμις τῆς σωτηρίας μου ἐπεσκίασας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου

text_en: Give me not up, O Lord , from my desire to the wicked : they have plotted against me; do not forsake me, lest they should triumph.
text_la: Ne tradas me, Domine, a desiderio meo peccatori : cogitaverunt contra me; ne derelinquas me, ne forte exaltentur.
text_pt: Se tomar as asas da alva, se habitar nas extremidades do mar,
text_el: μὴ παραδῷς με κύριε ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιθυμίας μου ἁμαρτωλῷ διελογίσαντο κατ' ἐμοῦ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με μήποτε ὑψωθῶσιν διάψαλμα

text_en: The head of them compassing me about: the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.
text_la: Caput circuitus eorum : labor labiorum ipsorum operiet eos.
text_pt: Até ali a tua mão me guiará e a tua destra me susterá.
text_el: ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ κυκλώματος αὐτῶν κόπος τῶν χειλέων αὐτῶν καλύψει αὐτούς

text_en: Burning coals shall fall upon them; you will cast them down into the fire: in miseries they shall not be able to stand.
text_la: Cadent super eos carbones; in ignem dejicies eos : in miseriis non subsistent.
text_pt: Se disser: Decerto que as trevas me encobrirão; então a noite será luz à roda de mim.
text_el: πεσοῦνται ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἄνθρακες ἐν πυρὶ καταβαλεῖς αὐτούς ἐν ταλαιπωρίαις οὐ μὴ ὑποστῶσιν

text_en: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.
text_la: Vir linguosus non dirigetur in terra; virum injustum mala capient in interitu.
text_pt: Nem ainda as trevas me encobrem de ti; mas a noite resplandece como o dia; as trevas e a luz são para ti a mesma coisa;
text_el: ἀνὴρ γλωσσώδης οὐ κατευθυνθήσεται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἄνδρα ἄδικον κακὰ θηρεύσει εἰς διαφθοράν

text_en: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, and will revenge the poor.
text_la: Cognovi quia faciet Dominus judicium inopis, et vindictam pauperum.
text_pt: Pois possuíste os meus rins; cobriste-me no ventre de minha mãe.
text_el: ἔγνων ὅτι ποιήσει κύριος τὴν κρίσιν τοῦ πτωχοῦ καὶ τὴν δίκην τῶν πενήτων

text_en: But as for the just , they shall give glory to your name : and the upright shall dwell with your countenance.
text_la: Verumtamen justi confitebuntur nomini tuo, et habitabunt recti cum vultu tuo.
text_pt: Eu te louvarei, porque de um modo assombroso, e tão maravilhoso fui feito; maravilhosas são as tuas obras, e a minha alma o sabe muito bem.
text_el: πλὴν δίκαιοι ἐξομολογήσονται τῷ ὀνόματί σου καὶ κατοικήσουσιν εὐθεῖς σὺν τῷ προσώπῳ σου

text_en: I have cried to you, O Lord , hear me: hearken to my voice, when I cry to you.
text_la: Domine, clamavi ad te : exaudi me; intende voci meæ, cum clamavero ad te.
text_pt: Livra-me, ó SENHOR, do homem mau; guarda-me do homem violento,
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ κύριε ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ εἰσάκουσόν μου πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς σέ

text_en: Let my prayer be directed as incense in your sight; the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice .
text_la: Dirigatur oratio mea sicut incensum in conspectu tuo; elevatio manuum mearum sacrificium vespertinum.
text_pt: Que pensa o mal no coração; continuamente se ajuntam para a guerra.
text_el: κατευθυνθήτω ἡ προσευχή μου ὡς θυμίαμα ἐνώπιόν σου ἔπαρσις τῶν χειρῶν μου θυσία ἑσπερινή

text_en: Set a watch, O Lord , before my mouth: and a door round about my lips.
text_la: Pone, Domine, custodiam ori meo, et ostium circumstantiæ labiis meis.
text_pt: Aguçaram as línguas como a serpente; o veneno das víboras está debaixo dos seus lábios. (Selá.)
text_el: θοῦ κύριε φυλακὴν τῷ στόματί μου καὶ θύραν περιοχῆς περὶ τὰ χείλη μου

text_en: Incline not my heart to evil words; to make excuses in sins . With men that work iniquity : and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.
text_la: Non declines cor meum in verba malitiæ, ad excusandas excusationes in peccatis; cum hominibus operantibus iniquitatem, et non communicabo cum electis eorum.
text_pt: Guarda-me, ó Senhor, das mãos do ímpio; guarda-me do homem violento; os quais se propuseram transtornar os meus passos.
text_el: μὴ ἐκκλίνῃς τὴν καρδίαν μου εἰς λόγους πονηρίας τοῦ προφασίζεσθαι προφάσεις ἐν ἁμαρτίαις σὺν ἀνθρώποις ἐργαζομένοις ἀνομίαν καὶ οὐ μὴ συνδυάσω μετὰ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: The just man shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head. For my prayer shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased:
text_la: Corripiet me justus in misericordia, et increpabit me : oleum autem peccatoris non impinguet caput meum. Quoniam adhuc et oratio mea in beneplacitis eorum:
text_pt: Os soberbos armaram-me laços e cordas; estenderam a rede ao lado do caminho; armaram-me laços corrediços. (Selá.)
text_el: παιδεύσει με δίκαιος ἐν ἐλέει καὶ ἐλέγξει με ἔλαιον δὲ ἁμαρτωλοῦ μὴ λιπανάτω τὴν κεφαλήν μου ὅτι ἔτι καὶ ἡ προσευχή μου ἐν ταῖς εὐδοκίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: Their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up. They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed:
text_la: absorpti sunt juncti petræ judices eorum. Audient verba mea, quoniam potuerunt.
text_pt: Eu disse ao Senhor: Tu és o meu Deus; ouve a voz das minhas súplicas, ó Senhor.
text_el: κατεπόθησαν ἐχόμενα πέτρας οἱ κριταὶ αὐτῶν ἀκούσονται τὰ ῥήματά μου ὅτι ἡδύνθησαν

text_en: As when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground: Our bones are scattered by the side of hell.
text_la: Sicut crassitudo terræ erupta est super terram, dissipata sunt ossa nostra secus infernum.
text_pt: Ó Deus o Senhor, fortaleza da minha salvação, tu cobriste a minha cabeça no dia da batalha.
text_el: ὡσεὶ πάχος γῆς διερράγη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς διεσκορπίσθη τὰ ὀστᾶ ἡμῶν παρὰ τὸν ᾅδην

text_en: But to you, O Lord , Lord , are my eyes: in you have I put my trust, take not away my soul .
text_la: Quia ad te, Domine, Domine, oculi mei; in te speravi, non auferas animam meam.
text_pt: Não concedas, ó Senhor, ao ímpio os seus desejos; não promovas o seu mau propósito, para que não se exalte. (Selá.)
text_el: ὅτι πρὸς σέ κύριε κύριε οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπὶ σὲ ἤλπισα μὴ ἀντανέλῃς τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling blocks of them that work iniquity .
text_la: Custodi me a laqueo quem statuerunt mihi, et a scandalis operantium iniquitatem.
text_pt: Quanto à cabeça dos que me cercam, cubra-os a maldade dos seus lábios.
text_el: φύλαξόν με ἀπὸ παγίδος ἧς συνεστήσαντό μοι καὶ ἀπὸ σκανδάλων τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν

text_en: The wicked shall fall in his net: I am alone until I pass.
text_la: Cadent in retiaculo ejus peccatores : singulariter sum ego, donec transeam.
text_pt: Caiam sobre eles brasas vivas; sejam lançados no fogo, em covas profundas, para que se não tornem a levantar.
text_el: πεσοῦνται ἐν ἀμφιβλήστρῳ αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτωλοί κατὰ μόνας εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἕως οὗ ἂν παρέλθω

text_en: Of understanding for David , A prayer when he was in the cave.
text_la: Intellectus David, cum esset in spelunca, oratio.
text_pt: SENHOR, a ti clamo, escuta-me; inclina os teus ouvidos à minha voz, quando a ti clamar.
text_el: συνέσεως τῷ Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ προσευχή

text_en: I cried to the Lord with my voice: with my voice I made supplication to the Lord .
text_la: Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi, voce mea ad Dominum deprecatus sum.
text_pt: Suba a minha oração perante a tua face como incenso, e as minhas mãos levantadas sejam como o sacrifício da tarde.
text_el: φωνῇ μου πρὸς κύριον ἐκέκραξα φωνῇ μου πρὸς κύριον ἐδεήθην

text_en: In his sight I pour out my prayer , and before him I declare my trouble:
text_la: Effundo in conspectu ejus orationem meam, et tribulationem meam ante ipsum pronuntio:
text_pt: Põe, ó Senhor, uma guarda à minha boca; guarda a porta dos meus lábios.
text_el: ἐκχεῶ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ τὴν δέησίν μου τὴν θλῖψίν μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἀπαγγελῶ

text_en: When my spirit failed me, then you knew my paths. In this way wherein I walked, they have hidden a snare for me.
text_la: in deficiendo ex me spiritum meum, et tu cognovisti semitas meas. In via hac qua ambulabam absconderunt laqueum mihi.
text_pt: Não inclines o meu coração a coisas más, a praticar obras más, com aqueles que praticam a iniqüidade; e não coma das suas delícias.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν ἐξ ἐμοῦ τὸ πνεῦμά μου καὶ σὺ ἔγνως τὰς τρίβους μου ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην ἔκρυψαν παγίδα μοι

text_en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me. Flight has failed me: and there is no one that has regard to my soul .
text_la: Considerabam ad dexteram, et videbam, et non erat qui cognosceret me : periit fuga a me, et non est qui requirat animam meam.
text_pt: Fira-me o justo, será isso uma benignidade; e repreenda-me, será um excelente óleo, que não me quebrará a cabeça; pois a minha oração também ainda continuará nas suas próprias calamidades.
text_el: κατενόουν εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ ἐπέβλεπον ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπιγινώσκων με ἀπώλετο φυγὴ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: I cried to you, O Lord : I said: You are my hope , my portion in the land of the living.
text_la: Clamavi ad te, Domine; dixi : Tu es spes mea, portio mea in terra viventium.
text_pt: Quando os seus juízes forem derrubados pelos lados da rocha, ouvirão as minhas palavras, pois são agradáveis.
text_el: ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ κύριε εἶπα σὺ εἶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου μερίς μου ἐν γῇ ζώντων

text_en: Attend to my supplication: for I am brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
text_la: Intende ad deprecationem meam, quia humiliatus sum nimis. Libera me a persequentibus me, quia confortati sunt super me.
text_pt: Os nossos ossos são espalhados à boca da sepultura como se alguém fendera e partira lenha na terra.
text_el: πρόσχες πρὸς τὴν δέησίν μου ὅτι ἐταπεινώθην σφόδρα ῥῦσαί με ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με ὅτι ἐκραταιώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ

text_en: Bring my soul out of prison , that I may praise your name : the just wait for me, until you reward me.
text_la: Educ de custodia animam meam ad confitendum nomini tuo; me exspectant justi donec retribuas mihi.
text_pt: Mas os meus olhos te contemplam, ó DEUS o Senhor; em ti confio; não desnudes a minha alma.
text_el: ἐξάγαγε ἐκ φυλακῆς τὴν ψυχήν μου τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου κύριε ἐμὲ ὑπομενοῦσιν δίκαιοι ἕως οὗ ἀνταποδῷς μοι

text_en: Hear, O Lord , my prayer : give ear to my supplication in your truth : hear me in your justice .
text_la: Domine, exaudi orationem meam; auribus percipe obsecrationem meam in veritate tua; exaudi me in tua justitia.
text_pt: Com a minha voz clamei ao SENHOR; com a minha voz supliquei ao SENHOR.
text_el: ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυιδ ὅτε αὐτὸν ὁ υἱὸς καταδιώκει κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου ἐνώτισαι τὴν δέησίν μου ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ἐπάκουσόν μου ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου

text_en: And enter not into judgment with your servant: for in your sight no man living shall be justified.
text_la: Et non intres in judicium cum servo tuo, quia non justificabitur in conspectu tuo omnis vivens.
text_pt: Derramei a minha queixa perante a sua face; expus-lhe a minha angústia.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς κρίσιν μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου ὅτι οὐ δικαιωθήσεται ἐνώπιόν σου πᾶς ζῶν

text_en: For the enemy has persecuted my soul : he has brought down my life to the earth. He has made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old:
text_la: Quia persecutus est inimicus animam meam; humiliavit in terra vitam meam; collocavit me in obscuris, sicut mortuos sæculi.
text_pt: Quando o meu espírito estava angustiado em mim, então conheceste a minha vereda. No caminho em que eu andava, esconderam-me um laço.
text_el: ὅτι κατεδίωξεν ὁ ἐχθρὸς τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐταπείνωσεν εἰς γῆν τὴν ζωήν μου ἐκάθισέν με ἐν σκοτεινοῖς ὡς νεκροὺς αἰῶνος

text_en: And my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.
text_la: Et anxiatus est super me spiritus meus; in me turbatum est cor meum.
text_pt: Olhei para a minha direita, e vi; mas não havia quem me conhecesse. Refúgio me faltou; ninguém cuidou da minha alma.
text_el: καὶ ἠκηδίασεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐταράχθη ἡ καρδία μου

text_en: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all your works: I meditated upon the works of your hands.
text_la: Memor fui dierum antiquorum; meditatus sum in omnibus operibus tuis : in factis manuum tuarum meditabar.
text_pt: A ti, ó Senhor, clamei; eu disse: Tu és o meu refúgio, e a minha porção na terra dos viventes.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων καὶ ἐμελέτησα ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις σου ἐν ποιήμασιν τῶν χειρῶν σου ἐμελέτων

text_en: I stretched forth my hands to you: my soul is as earth without water unto you.
text_la: Expandi manus meas ad te; anima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
text_pt: Atende ao meu clamor; porque estou muito abatido. Livra-me dos meus perseguidores; porque são mais fortes do que eu.
text_el: διεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς σέ ἡ ψυχή μου ὡς γῆ ἄνυδρός σοι διάψαλμα

text_en: Hear me speedily, O Lord : my spirit has fainted away. Turn not away your face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
text_la: Velociter exaudi me, Domine; defecit spiritus meus. Non avertas faciem tuam a me, et similis ero descendentibus in lacum.
text_pt: Tira a minha alma da prisão, para que louve o teu nome; os justos me rodearão, pois me fizeste bem.
text_el: ταχὺ εἰσάκουσόν μου κύριε ἐξέλιπεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ὁμοιωθήσομαι τοῖς καταβαίνουσιν εἰς λάκκον

text_en: Cause me to hear your mercy in the morning; for in you have I hoped. Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: for I have lifted up my soul to you.
text_la: Auditam fac mihi mane misericordiam tuam, quia in te speravi. Notam fac mihi viam in qua ambulem, quia ad te levavi animam meam.
text_el: ἀκουστὸν ποίησόν μοι τὸ πρωὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα γνώρισόν μοι κύριε ὁδὸν ἐν ᾗ πορεύσομαι ὅτι πρὸς σὲ ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord , to you have I fled:
text_la: Eripe me de inimicis meis, Domine : ad te confugi.
text_el: ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου κύριε ὅτι πρὸς σὲ κατέφυγον

text_en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God . Your good spirit shall lead me into the right land:
text_la: Doce me facere voluntatem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu. Spiritus tuus bonus deducet me in terram rectam.
text_el: δίδαξόν με τοῦ ποιεῖν τὸ θέλημά σου ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός μου τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθὸν ὁδηγήσει με ἐν γῇ εὐθείᾳ

text_en: For your name's sake, O Lord , you will quicken me in your justice . You will bring my soul out of trouble:
text_la: Propter nomen tuum, Domine, vivificabis me : in æquitate tua, educes de tribulatione animam meam,
text_el: ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου κύριε ζήσεις με ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ἐξάξεις ἐκ θλίψεως τὴν ψυχήν μου

text_en: And in your mercy you will destroy my enemies. And you will cut off all them that afflict my soul : for I am your servant.
text_la: et in misericordia tua disperdes inimicos meos, et perdes omnes qui tribulant animam meam, quoniam ego servus tuus sum.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου ἐξολεθρεύσεις τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου καὶ ἀπολεῖς πάντας τοὺς θλίβοντας τὴν ψυχήν μου ὅτι δοῦλός σού εἰμι ἐγώ

text_en: Blessed be the Lord my God , who teaches my hands to fight, and my fingers to war .
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prælium, et digitos meos ad bellum.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, ouve a minha oração, inclina os ouvidos às minhas súplicas; escuta-me segundo a tua verdade, e segundo a tua justiça.
text_el: τῷ Δαυιδ πρὸς τὸν Γολιαδ εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεός μου ὁ διδάσκων τὰς χεῖράς μου εἰς παράταξιν τοὺς δακτύλους μου εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: My mercy, and my refuge: my support, and my deliverer: My protector, and I have hoped in him: who subdues my people under me.
text_la: Misericordia mea et refugium meum; susceptor meus et liberator meus; protector meus, et in ipso speravi, qui subdit populum meum sub me.
text_pt: E não entres em juízo com o teu servo, porque à tua vista não se achará justo nenhum vivente.
text_el: ἔλεός μου καὶ καταφυγή μου ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου καὶ ῥύστης μου ὑπερασπιστής μου καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἤλπισα ὁ ὑποτάσσων τὸν λαόν μου ὑπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Lord , what is man , that you are made known to him? Or the son of man , that you make account of him?
text_la: Domine, quid est homo, quia innotuisti ei? aut filius hominis, quia reputas eum?
text_pt: Pois o inimigo perseguiu a minha alma; atropelou-me até ao chão; fez-me habitar na escuridão, como aqueles que morreram há muito.
text_el: κύριε τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι ἐγνώσθης αὐτῷ ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι λογίζῃ αὐτόν

text_en: Man is like to vanity: his days pass away like a shadow.
text_la: Homo vanitati similis factus est; dies ejus sicut umbra prætereunt.
text_pt: Pois que o meu espírito se angustia em mim; e o meu coração em mim está desolado.
text_el: ἄνθρωπος ματαιότητι ὡμοιώθη αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ σκιὰ παράγουσιν

text_en: Lord , bow down your heavens and descend: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
text_la: Domine, inclina cælos tuos, et descende; tange montes, et fumigabunt.
text_pt: Lembro-me dos dias antigos; considero todos os teus feitos; medito na obra das tuas mãos.
text_el: κύριε κλῖνον οὐρανούς σου καὶ κατάβηθι ἅψαι τῶν ὀρέων καὶ καπνισθήσονται

text_en: Send forth lightning, and you shall scatter them: shoot out your arrows, and you shall trouble them.
text_la: Fulgura coruscationem, et dissipabis eos; emitte sagittas tuas, et conturbabis eos.
text_pt: Estendo para ti as minhas mãos; a minha alma tem sede de ti, como terra sedenta. (Selá.)
text_el: ἄστραψον ἀστραπὴν καὶ σκορπιεῖς αὐτούς ἐξαπόστειλον τὰ βέλη σου καὶ συνταράξεις αὐτούς

text_en: Put forth your hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: from the hand of strange children:
text_la: Emitte manum tuam de alto : eripe me, et libera me de aquis multis, de manu filiorum alienorum:
text_pt: Ouve-me depressa, ó Senhor; o meu espírito desmaia. Não escondas de mim a tua face, para que não seja semelhante aos que descem à cova.
text_el: ἐξαπόστειλον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐξ ὕψους ἐξελοῦ με καὶ ῥῦσαί με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων

text_en: Whose mouth has spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity .
text_la: quorum os locutum est vanitatem, et dextera eorum dextera iniquitatis.
text_pt: Faze-me ouvir a tua benignidade pela manhã, pois em ti confio; faze-me saber o caminho que devo seguir, porque a ti levanto a minha alma.
text_el: ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησεν ματαιότητα καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας

text_en: To you, O God , I will sing a new canticle: on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to you.
text_la: Deus, canticum novum cantabo tibi; in psalterio decachordo psallam tibi.
text_pt: Livra-me, ó Senhor, dos meus inimigos; fujo para ti, para me esconder.
text_el: ὁ θεός ᾠδὴν καινὴν ᾄσομαί σοι ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ δεκαχόρδῳ ψαλῶ σοι

text_en: Who give salvation to kings: who have redeemed your servant David from the malicious sword:
text_la: Qui das salutem regibus, qui redemisti David servum tuum de gladio maligno,
text_pt: Ensina-me a fazer a tua vontade, pois és o meu Deus. O teu Espírito é bom; guie-me por terra plana.
text_el: τῷ διδόντι τὴν σωτηρίαν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν τῷ λυτρουμένῳ Δαυιδ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ ἐκ ῥομφαίας πονηρᾶς

text_en: Deliver me, And rescue me out of the hand of strange children; whose mouth has spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity :
text_la: eripe me, et erue me de manu filiorum alienorum, quorum os locutum est vanitatem, et dextera eorum dextera iniquitatis.
text_pt: Vivifica-me, ó Senhor, por amor do teu nome; por amor da tua justiça, tira a minha alma da angústia.
text_el: ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησεν ματαιότητα καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας

text_en: Whose sons are as new plants in their youth: Their daughters decked out, adorned round about after the similitude of a temple :
text_la: Quorum filii sicut novellæ plantationes in juventute sua; filiæ eorum compositæ, circumornatæ ut similitudo templi.
text_pt: E por tua misericórdia desarraiga os meus inimigos, e destrói a todos os que angustiam a minha alma; pois sou teu servo.
text_el: ὧν οἱ υἱοὶ ὡς νεόφυτα ἡδρυμμένα ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῶν αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν κεκαλλωπισμέναι περικεκοσμημέναι ὡς ὁμοίωμα ναοῦ

text_en: Their storehouses full, flowing out of this into that. Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth:
text_la: Promptuaria eorum plena, eructantia ex hoc in illud; oves eorum fœtosæ, abundantes in egressibus suis;
text_el: τὰ ταμίεια αὐτῶν πλήρη ἐξερευγόμενα ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῶν πολυτόκα πληθύνοντα ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις αὐτῶν

text_en: Their oxen fat. There is no breach of wall, nor passage, nor crying out in their streets.
text_la: boves eorum crassæ. Non est ruina maceriæ, neque transitus, neque clamor in plateis eorum.
text_el: οἱ βόες αὐτῶν παχεῖς οὐκ ἔστιν κατάπτωμα φραγμοῦ οὐδὲ διέξοδος οὐδὲ κραυγὴ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῶν

text_en: They have called the people happy , that has these things: but happy is that people whose God is the Lord .
text_la: Beatum dixerunt populum cui hæc sunt; beatus populus cujus Dominus Deus ejus.
text_el: ἐμακάρισαν τὸν λαόν ᾧ ταῦτά ἐστιν μακάριος ὁ λαός οὗ κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: I will extol you, O God my king: and I will bless your name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
text_la: Exaltabo te, Deus meus rex, et benedicam nomini tuo in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR, minha rocha, que ensina as minhas mãos para a peleja e os meus dedos para a guerra;
text_el: αἴνεσις τῷ Δαυιδ ὑψώσω σε ὁ θεός μου ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ εὐλογήσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Every day will I bless you: and I will praise your name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
text_la: Per singulos dies benedicam tibi, et laudabo nomen tuum in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Benignidade minha e fortaleza minha; alto retiro meu e meu libertador és tu; escudo meu, em quem eu confio, e que me sujeita o meu povo.
text_el: καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Great is the Lord , and greatly to be praised: and of his greatness there is no end.
text_la: Magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis, et magnitudinis ejus non est finis.
text_pt: Senhor, que é o homem, para que o conheças, e o filho do homem, para que o estimes?
text_el: μέγας κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα καὶ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν πέρας

text_en: Generation and generation shall praise your works: and they shall declare your power.
text_la: Generatio et generatio laudabit opera tua, et potentiam tuam pronuntiabunt.
text_pt: O homem é semelhante à vaidade; os seus dias são como a sombra que passa.
text_el: γενεὰ καὶ γενεὰ ἐπαινέσει τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ τὴν δύναμίν σου ἀπαγγελοῦσιν

text_en: They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of your holiness : and shall tell your wondrous works.
text_la: Magnificentiam gloriæ sanctitatis tuæ loquentur, et mirabilia tua narrabunt.
text_pt: Abaixa, ó Senhor, os teus céus, e desce; toca os montes, e fumegarão.
text_el: τὴν μεγαλοπρέπειαν τῆς δόξης τῆς ἁγιωσύνης σου λαλήσουσιν καὶ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου διηγήσονται

text_en: And they shall speak of the might of your terrible acts: and shall declare your greatness.
text_la: Et virtutem terribilium tuorum dicent, et magnitudinem tuam narrabunt.
text_pt: Vibra os teus raios e dissipa-os; envia as tuas flechas, e desbarata-os.
text_el: καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῶν φοβερῶν σου ἐροῦσιν καὶ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην σου διηγήσονται

text_en: They shall publish the memory of the abundance of your sweetness: and shall rejoice in your justice .
text_la: Memoriam abundantiæ suavitatis tuæ eructabunt, et justitia tua exsultabunt.
text_pt: Estende as tuas mãos desde o alto; livra-me, e arrebata-me das muitas águas e das mãos dos filhos estranhos,
text_el: μνήμην τοῦ πλήθους τῆς χρηστότητός σου ἐξερεύξονται καὶ τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: The Lord is gracious and merciful: patient and plenteous in mercy.
text_la: Miserator et misericors Dominus : patiens, et multum misericors.
text_pt: Cuja boca fala vaidade, e a sua mão direita é a destra de falsidade.
text_el: οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων ὁ κύριος μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος

text_en: The Lord is sweet to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
text_la: Suavis Dominus universis, et miserationes ejus super omnia opera ejus.
text_pt: A ti, ó Deus, cantarei um cântico novo; com o saltério e instrumento de dez cordas te cantarei louvores;
text_el: χρηστὸς κύριος τοῖς σύμπασιν καὶ οἱ οἰκτιρμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let all your works, O lord, praise you: and let your saints bless you.
text_la: Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnia opera tua, et sancti tui benedicant tibi.
text_pt: A ti, que dás a salvação aos reis, e que livras a Davi, teu servo, da espada maligna.
text_el: ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι κύριε πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ οἱ ὅσιοί σου εὐλογησάτωσάν σε

text_en: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom: and shall tell of your power:
text_la: Gloriam regni tui dicent, et potentiam tuam loquentur:
text_pt: Livra-me, e tira-me das mãos dos filhos estranhos, cuja boca fala vaidade, e a sua mão direita é a destra de iniqüidade,
text_el: δόξαν τῆς βασιλείας σου ἐροῦσιν καὶ τὴν δυναστείαν σου λαλήσουσιν

text_en: To make your might known to the sons of men : and the glory of the magnificence of your kingdom.
text_la: ut notam faciant filiis hominum potentiam tuam, et gloriam magnificentiæ regni tui.
text_pt: Para que nossos filhos sejam como plantas crescidas na sua mocidade; para que as nossas filhas sejam como pedras de esquina lavradas à moda de palácio;
text_el: τοῦ γνωρίσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὴν δυναστείαν σου καὶ τὴν δόξαν τῆς μεγαλοπρεπείας τῆς βασιλείας σου

text_en: Your kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: and your dominion endures throughout all generations .
text_la: Regnum tuum regnum omnium sæculorum; et dominatio tua in omni generatione et generationem.
text_pt: Para que as nossas despensas se encham de todo provimento; para que os nossos rebanhos produzam a milhares e a dezenas de milhares nas nossas ruas.
text_el: ἡ βασιλεία σου βασιλεία πάντων τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἡ δεσποτεία σου ἐν πάσῃ γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ

text_en: The Lord lifts up all that fall: and sets up all that are cast down.
text_la: Allevat Dominus omnes qui corruunt, et erigit omnes elisos.
text_pt: Para que os nossos bois sejam fortes para o trabalho; para que não haja nem assaltos, nem saídas, nem gritos nas nossas ruas.
text_el: ὑποστηρίζει κύριος πάντας τοὺς καταπίπτοντας καὶ ἀνορθοῖ πάντας τοὺς κατερραγμένους

text_en: The eyes of all hope in you, O Lord : and you give them meat in due season.
text_la: Oculi omnium in te sperant, Domine, et tu das escam illorum in tempore opportuno.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o povo ao qual assim acontece; bem-aventurado é o povo cujo Deus é o Senhor.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ πάντων εἰς σὲ ἐλπίζουσιν καὶ σὺ δίδως τὴν τροφὴν αὐτῶν ἐν εὐκαιρίᾳ

text_en: You open your hand, and fill with blessing every living creature.
text_la: Aperis tu manum tuam, et imples omne animal benedictione.
text_el: ἀνοίγεις σὺ τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ἐμπιπλᾷς πᾶν ζῷον εὐδοκίας

text_en: The Lord is just in all his ways: and holy in all his works.
text_la: Justus Dominus in omnibus viis suis, et sanctus in omnibus operibus suis.
text_el: δίκαιος κύριος ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅσιος ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord is near unto all them that call upon him: to all that call upon him in truth .
text_la: Prope est Dominus omnibus invocantibus eum, omnibus invocantibus eum in veritate.
text_el: ἐγγὺς κύριος πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις αὐτόν πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις αὐτὸν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ

text_en: He will do the will of them that fear him: and he will hear their prayer , and save them.
text_la: Voluntatem timentium se faciet, et deprecationem eorum exaudiet, et salvos faciet eos.
text_el: θέλημα τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν ποιήσει καὶ τῆς δεήσεως αὐτῶν ἐπακούσεται καὶ σώσει αὐτούς

text_en: The Lord keeps all them that love him; but all the wicked he will destroy.
text_la: Custodit Dominus omnes diligentes se, et omnes peccatores disperdet.
text_el: φυλάσσει κύριος πάντας τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας αὐτὸν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἐξολεθρεύσει

text_en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord : and let all flesh bless his holy name forever; yea, for ever and ever.
text_la: Laudationem Domini loquetur os meum; et benedicat omnis caro nomini sancto ejus in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
text_el: αἴνεσιν κυρίου λαλήσει τὸ στόμα μου καὶ εὐλογείτω πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Alleluia , of Aggeus and Zacharias.
text_la: Alleluja, Aggæi et Zachariæ.
text_pt: Eu te exaltarei, ó Deus, rei meu, e bendirei o teu nome pelos séculos dos séculos e para sempre.
text_el: αλληλουια Αγγαιου καὶ Ζαχαριου αἴνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον

text_en: Praise the Lord , O my soul , in my life I will praise the Lord : I will sing to my God as long as I shall be. Put not your trust in princes:
text_la: Lauda, anima mea, Dominum. Laudabo Dominum in vita mea; psallam Deo meo quamdiu fuero. Nolite confidere in principibus,
text_pt: Cada dia te bendirei, e louvarei o teu nome pelos séculos dos séculos e para sempre.
text_el: αἰνέσω κύριον ἐν ζωῇ μου ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἕως ὑπάρχω

text_en: In the children of men , in whom there is no salvation .
text_la: in filiis hominum, in quibus non est salus.
text_pt: Grande é o Senhor, e muito digno de louvor, e a sua grandeza inescrutável.
text_el: μὴ πεποίθατε ἐπ' ἄρχοντας καὶ ἐφ' υἱοὺς ἀνθρώπων οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν σωτηρία

text_en: His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: in that day all their thoughts shall perish.
text_la: Exibit spiritus ejus, et revertetur in terram suam; in illa die peribunt omnes cogitationes eorum.
text_pt: Uma geração louvará as tuas obras à outra geração, e anunciarão as tuas proezas.
text_el: ἐξελεύσεται τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιστρέψει εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἀπολοῦνται πάντες οἱ διαλογισμοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: Blessed is he who has the God of Jacob for his helper, whose hope is in the Lord his God :
text_la: Beatus cujus Deus Jacob adjutor ejus, spes ejus in Domino Deo ipsius:
text_pt: Falarei da magnificência gloriosa da tua majestade e das tuas obras maravilhosas.
text_el: μακάριος οὗ ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ βοηθός ἡ ἐλπὶς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.
text_la: qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et omnia quæ in eis sunt.
text_pt: E se falará da força dos teus feitos terríveis; e contarei a tua grandeza.
text_el: τὸν ποιήσαντα τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸν φυλάσσοντα ἀλήθειαν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Who keeps truth for ever: who executes judgment for them that suffer wrong: who gives food to the hungry. The Lord loosens them that are fettered:
text_la: Qui custodit veritatem in sæculum; facit judicium injuriam patientibus; dat escam esurientibus. Dominus solvit compeditos;
text_pt: Proferirão abundantemente a memória da tua grande bondade, e cantarão a tua justiça.
text_el: ποιοῦντα κρίμα τοῖς ἀδικουμένοις διδόντα τροφὴν τοῖς πεινῶσιν κύριος λύει πεπεδημένους

text_en: The Lord enlightens the blind. The Lord lifts up them that are cast down: the Lord loves the just .
text_la: Dominus illuminat cæcos. Dominus erigit elisos; Dominus diligit justos.
text_pt: Piedoso e benigno é o Senhor, sofredor e de grande misericórdia.
text_el: κύριος ἀνορθοῖ κατερραγμένους κύριος σοφοῖ τυφλούς κύριος ἀγαπᾷ δικαίους

text_en: The Lord keeps the strangers, he will support the fatherless and the widow : and the ways of sinners he will destroy.
text_la: Dominus custodit advenas, pupillum et viduam suscipiet, et vias peccatorum disperdet.
text_pt: O Senhor é bom para todos, e as suas misericórdias são sobre todas as suas obras.
text_el: κύριος φυλάσσει τοὺς προσηλύτους ὀρφανὸν καὶ χήραν ἀναλήμψεται καὶ ὁδὸν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἀφανιεῖ

text_en: The Lord shall reign for ever: your God , O Sion, unto generation and generation .
text_la: Regnabit Dominus in sæcula; Deus tuus, Sion, in generationem et generationem.
text_pt: Todas as tuas obras te louvarão, ó Senhor, e os teus santos te bendirão.
text_el: βασιλεύσει κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὁ θεός σου Σιων εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν

text_en: Praise the Lord , because psalm is good : to our God be joyful and comely praise.
text_la: Laudate Dominum, quoniam bonus est psalmus; Deo nostro sit jucunda, decoraque laudatio.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor. Ó minha alma, louva ao Senhor.
text_el: αλληλουια Αγγαιου καὶ Ζαχαριου αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ὅτι ἀγαθὸν ψαλμός τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἡδυνθείη αἴνεσις

text_en: The Lord builds up Jerusalem : he will gather together the dispersed of Israel .
text_la: Ædificans Jerusalem Dominus, dispersiones Israëlis congregabit:
text_pt: Louvarei ao Senhor durante a minha vida; cantarei louvores ao meu Deus enquanto eu for vivo.
text_el: οἰκοδομῶν Ιερουσαλημ ὁ κύριος καὶ τὰς διασπορὰς τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπισυνάξει

text_en: Who heals the broken of heart, and binds up their bruises.
text_la: qui sanat contritos corde, et alligat contritiones eorum;
text_pt: Não confieis em príncipes, nem em filho de homem, em quem não há salvação.
text_el: ὁ ἰώμενος τοὺς συντετριμμένους τὴν καρδίαν καὶ δεσμεύων τὰ συντρίμματα αὐτῶν

text_en: Who tells the number of the stars: and calls them all by their names .
text_la: qui numerat multitudinem stellarum, et omnibus eis nomina vocat.
text_pt: Sai-lhe o espírito, volta para a terra; naquele mesmo dia perecem os seus pensamentos.
text_el: ὁ ἀριθμῶν πλήθη ἄστρων καὶ πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς ὀνόματα καλῶν

text_en: Great is our Lord, and great is his power: and of his wisdom there is no number.
text_la: Magnus Dominus noster, et magna virtus ejus, et sapientiæ ejus non est numerus.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele que tem o Deus de Jacó por seu auxílio, e cuja esperança está posta no Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: μέγας ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν καὶ μεγάλη ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς συνέσεως αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός

text_en: The Lord lifts up the meek, and brings the wicked down even to the ground.
text_la: Suscipiens mansuetos Dominus; humilians autem peccatores usque ad terram.
text_pt: O que fez os céus e a terra, o mar e tudo quanto há neles, e o que guarda a verdade para sempre;
text_el: ἀναλαμβάνων πραεῖς ὁ κύριος ταπεινῶν δὲ ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἕως τῆς γῆς

text_en: Sing to the Lord with praise: sing to our God upon the harp.
text_la: Præcinite Domino in confessione; psallite Deo nostro in cithara.
text_pt: O que faz justiça aos oprimidos, o que dá pão aos famintos. O Senhor solta os encarcerados.
text_el: ἐξάρξατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει ψάλατε τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἐν κιθάρᾳ

text_en: Who covers the heaven with clouds, and prepares rain for the earth. Who makes grass to grow on the mountains, and herbs for the service of men .
text_la: Qui operit cælum nubibus, et parat terræ pluviam; qui producit in montibus fœnum, et herbam servituti hominum;
text_pt: O Senhor abre os olhos aos cegos; o Senhor levanta os abatidos; o Senhor ama os justos;
text_el: τῷ περιβάλλοντι τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐν νεφέλαις τῷ ἑτοιμάζοντι τῇ γῇ ὑετόν τῷ ἐξανατέλλοντι ἐν ὄρεσι χόρτον καὶ χλόην τῇ δουλείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: Who gives to beasts their food: and to the young ravens that call upon him.
text_la: qui dat jumentis escam ipsorum, et pullis corvorum invocantibus eum.
text_pt: O Senhor guarda os estrangeiros; sustém o órfão e a viúva, mas transtorna o caminho dos ímpios.
text_el: διδόντι τοῖς κτήνεσι τροφὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τοῖς νεοσσοῖς τῶν κοράκων τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις αὐτόν

text_en: He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: nor take pleasure in the legs of a man .
text_la: Non in fortitudine equi voluntatem habebit, nec in tibiis viri beneplacitum erit ei.
text_pt: O Senhor reinará eternamente; o teu Deus, ó Sião, de geração em geração. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ ἐν τῇ δυναστείᾳ τοῦ ἵππου θελήσει οὐδὲ ἐν ταῖς κνήμαις τοῦ ἀνδρὸς εὐδοκεῖ

text_en: The Lord takes pleasure in them that fear him: and in them that hope in his mercy.
text_la: Beneplacitum est Domino super timentes eum, et in eis qui sperant super misericordia ejus.
text_el: εὐδοκεῖ κύριος ἐν τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτὸν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐλπίζουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise the Lord , O Jerusalem : praise your God , O Sion.
text_la: Lauda, Jerusalem, Dominum; lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
text_el: Αγγαιου καὶ Ζαχαριου ἐπαίνει Ιερουσαλημ τὸν κύριον αἴνει τὸν θεόν σου Σιων

text_en: Because he has strengthened the bolts of your gates, he has blessed your children within you.
text_la: Quoniam confortavit seras portarum tuarum; benedixit filiis tuis in te.
text_el: ὅτι ἐνίσχυσεν τοὺς μοχλοὺς τῶν πυλῶν σου εὐλόγησεν τοὺς υἱούς σου ἐν σοί

text_en: Who has placed peace in your borders: and fills you with the fat of corn.
text_la: Qui posuit fines tuos pacem, et adipe frumenti satiat te.
text_el: ὁ τιθεὶς τὰ ὅριά σου εἰρήνην καὶ στέαρ πυροῦ ἐμπιπλῶν σε

text_en: Who sends forth his speech to the earth: his word runs swiftly.
text_la: Qui emittit eloquium suum terræ : velociter currit sermo ejus.
text_el: ὁ ἀποστέλλων τὸ λόγιον αὐτοῦ τῇ γῇ ἕως τάχους δραμεῖται ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who gives snow like wool: scatters mists like ashes.
text_la: Qui dat nivem sicut lanam; nebulam sicut cinerem spargit.
text_el: τοῦ διδόντος χιόνα ὡσεὶ ἔριον ὁμίχλην ὡσεὶ σποδὸν πάσσοντος

text_en: He sends his crystal like morsels: who shall stand before the face of his cold?
text_la: Mittit crystallum suam sicut buccellas : ante faciem frigoris ejus quis sustinebit?
text_el: βάλλοντος κρύσταλλον αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ ψωμούς κατὰ πρόσωπον ψύχους αὐτοῦ τίς ὑποστήσεται

text_en: He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.
text_la: Emittet verbum suum, et liquefaciet ea; flabit spiritus ejus, et fluent aquæ.
text_el: ἀποστελεῖ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ καὶ τήξει αὐτά πνεύσει τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ῥυήσεται ὕδατα

text_en: Who declares his word to Jacob : his justices and his judgments to Israel .
text_la: Qui annuntiat verbum suum Jacob, justitias et judicia sua Israël.
text_el: ἀπαγγέλλων τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τῷ Ιακωβ δικαιώματα καὶ κρίματα αὐτοῦ τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: He has not done in like manner to every nation: and his judgments he has not made manifest to them. Alleluia .
text_la: Non fecit taliter omni nationi, et judicia sua non manifestavit eis. Alleluja.
text_el: οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὕτως παντὶ ἔθνει καὶ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐδήλωσεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Praise the Lord from the heavens : praise him in the high places.
text_la: Laudate Dominum de cælis; laudate eum in excelsis.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvai ao SENHOR desde os céus, louvai-o nas alturas.
text_el: αλληλουια Αγγαιου καὶ Ζαχαριου αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις

text_en: Praise him, all his angels , praise him, all his hosts .
text_la: Laudate eum, omnes angeli ejus; laudate eum, omnes virtutes ejus.
text_pt: Louvai-o, todos os seus anjos; louvai-o, todos os seus exércitos.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise him, O sun and moon: praise him, all you stars and light.
text_la: Laudate eum, sol et luna; laudate eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
text_pt: Louvai-o, sol e lua; louvai-o, todas as estrelas luzentes.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν ἥλιος καὶ σελήνη αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πάντα τὰ ἄστρα καὶ τὸ φῶς

text_en: Praise him, you heavens of heavens : and let all the waters that are above the heavens
text_la: Laudate eum, cæli cælorum; et aquæ omnes quæ super cælos sunt,
text_pt: Louvai-o, céus dos céus, e as águas que estão sobre os céus.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τῶν οὐρανῶν καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν

text_en: praise the name of the Lord . For he spoke, and they were made: he commanded, and they were created .
text_la: laudent nomen Domini. Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt; ipse mandavit, et creata sunt.
text_pt: Louvem o nome do Senhor, pois mandou, e logo foram criados.
text_el: αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν καὶ ἐγενήθησαν αὐτὸς ἐνετείλατο καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν

text_en: He has established them for ever, and for ages of ages: he has made a decree, and it shall not pass away.
text_la: Statuit ea in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi; præceptum posuit, et non præteribit.
text_pt: E os confirmou eternamente para sempre, e lhes deu um decreto que não ultrapassarão.
text_el: ἔστησεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος πρόσταγμα ἔθετο καὶ οὐ παρελεύσεται

text_en: Praise the Lord from the earth, you dragons, and all you deeps :
text_la: Laudate Dominum de terra, dracones et omnes abyssi;
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor desde a terra: vós, baleias, e todos os abismos;
text_el: αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ἐκ τῆς γῆς δράκοντες καὶ πᾶσαι ἄβυσσοι

text_en: Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds, which fulfil his word:
text_la: ignis, grando, nix, glacies, spiritus procellarum, quæ faciunt verbum ejus;
text_pt: Fogo e saraiva, neve e vapores, e vento tempestuoso que executa a sua palavra;
text_el: πῦρ χάλαζα χιών κρύσταλλος πνεῦμα καταιγίδος τὰ ποιοῦντα τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Mountains and all hills, fruitful trees and all cedars :
text_la: montes, et omnes colles; ligna fructifera, et omnes cedri;
text_pt: Montes e todos os outeiros, árvores frutíferas e todos os cedros;
text_el: τὰ ὄρη καὶ πάντες οἱ βουνοί ξύλα καρποφόρα καὶ πᾶσαι κέδροι

text_en: Beasts and all cattle: serpents and feathered fowls:
text_la: bestiæ, et universa pecora; serpentes, et volucres pennatæ;
text_pt: As feras e todos os gados, répteis e aves voadoras;
text_el: τὰ θηρία καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη ἑρπετὰ καὶ πετεινὰ πτερωτά

text_en: Kings of the earth and all people: princes and all judges of the earth:
text_la: reges terræ et omnes populi; principes et omnes judices terræ;
text_pt: Reis da terra e todos os povos, príncipes e todos os juízes da terra;
text_el: βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντες λαοί ἄρχοντες καὶ πάντες κριταὶ γῆς

text_en: Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord :
text_la: juvenes et virgines; senes cum junioribus, laudent nomen Domini:
text_pt: Moços e moças, velhos e crianças.
text_el: νεανίσκοι καὶ παρθένοι πρεσβῦται μετὰ νεωτέρων

text_en: For his name alone is exalted.
text_la: quia exaltatum est nomen ejus solius.
text_pt: Louvem o nome do Senhor, pois só o seu nome é exaltado; a sua glória está sobre a terra e o céu.
text_el: αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ὅτι ὑψώθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ μόνου ἡ ἐξομολόγησις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ γῆς καὶ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: The praise of him is above heaven and earth: and he has exalted the horn of his people. A hymn to all his saints to the children of Israel , a people approaching to him. Alleluia .
text_la: Confessio ejus super cælum et terram; et exaltavit cornu populi sui. Hymnus omnibus sanctis ejus; filiis Israël, populo appropinquanti sibi. Alleluja.
text_pt: Ele também exalta o poder do seu povo, o louvor de todos os seus santos, dos filhos de Israel, um povo que lhe é chegado. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ὑψώσει κέρας λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ὕμνος πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λαῷ ἐγγίζοντι αὐτῷ

text_en: Sing to the Lord a new canticle: let his praise be in the church of the saints .
text_la: Cantate Domino canticum novum; laus ejus in ecclesia sanctorum.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo, e o seu louvor na congregação dos santos.
text_el: αλληλουια ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν ἡ αἴνεσις αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ὁσίων

text_en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.
text_la: Lætetur Israël in eo qui fecit eum, et filii Sion exsultent in rege suo.
text_pt: Alegre-se Israel naquele que o fez, regozijem-se os filhos de Sião no seu Rei.
text_el: εὐφρανθήτω Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτόν καὶ υἱοὶ Σιων ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἐπὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῶν

text_en: Let them praise his name in choir: let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.
text_la: Laudent nomen ejus in choro; in tympano et psalterio psallant ei.
text_pt: Louvem o seu nome com danças; cantem-lhe o seu louvor com tamborim e harpa.
text_el: αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐν χορῷ ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ ψαλτηρίῳ ψαλάτωσαν αὐτῷ

text_en: For the Lord is well pleased with his people: and he will exalt the meek unto salvation .
text_la: Quia beneplacitum est Domino in populo suo, et exaltabit mansuetos in salutem.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor se agrada do seu povo; ornará os mansos com a salvação.
text_el: ὅτι εὐδοκεῖ κύριος ἐν λαῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑψώσει πραεῖς ἐν σωτηρίᾳ

text_en: The saints shall rejoice in glory : they shall be joyful in their beds.
text_la: Exsultabunt sancti in gloria; lætabuntur in cubilibus suis.
text_pt: Exultem os santos na glória; alegrem-se nas suas camas.
text_el: καυχήσονται ὅσιοι ἐν δόξῃ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται ἐπὶ τῶν κοιτῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: and two-edged swords in their hands:
text_la: Exaltationes Dei in gutture eorum, et gladii ancipites in manibus eorum:
text_pt: Estejam na sua garganta os altos louvores de Deus, e espada de dois fios nas suas mãos,
text_el: αἱ ὑψώσεις τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν τῷ λάρυγγι αὐτῶν καὶ ῥομφαῖαι δίστομοι ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: To execute vengeance upon the nations, chastisements among the people:
text_la: ad faciendam vindictam in nationibus, increpationes in populis;
text_pt: Para tomarem vingança dos gentios, e darem repreensões aos povos;
text_el: τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐλεγμοὺς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς

text_en: To bind their kings with fetters, and their nobles with manacles of iron.
text_la: ad alligandos reges eorum in compedibus, et nobiles eorum in manicis ferreis;
text_pt: Para prenderem os seus reis com cadeias, e os seus nobres com grilhões de ferro;
text_el: τοῦ δῆσαι τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πέδαις καὶ τοὺς ἐνδόξους αὐτῶν ἐν χειροπέδαις σιδηραῖς

text_en: To execute upon them the judgment that is written: this glory is to all his saints . Alleluia .
text_la: ut faciant in eis judicium conscriptum : gloria hæc est omnibus sanctis ejus. Alleluja.
text_pt: Para fazerem neles o juízo escrito; esta será a honra de todos os seus santos. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς κρίμα ἔγγραπτον δόξα αὕτη ἐστὶν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise the Lord in his holy places: praise him in the firmament of his power.
text_la: Laudate Dominum in sanctis ejus; laudate eum in firmamento virtutis ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao SENHOR. Louvai a Deus no seu santuário; louvai-o no firmamento do seu poder.
text_el: αλληλουια αἰνεῖτε τὸν θεὸν ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν στερεώματι δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to the multitude of his greatness.
text_la: Laudate eum in virtutibus ejus; laudate eum secundum multitudinem magnitudinis ejus.
text_pt: Louvai-o pelos seus atos poderosos; louvai-o conforme a excelência da sua grandeza.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ταῖς δυναστείαις αὐτοῦ αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise him with the sound of trumpet: praise him with psaltery and harp.
text_la: Laudate eum in sono tubæ; laudate eum in psalterio et cithara.
text_pt: Louvai-o com o som de trombeta; louvai-o com o saltério e a harpa.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ἤχῳ σάλπιγγος αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ καὶ κιθάρᾳ

text_en: Praise him with timbrel and choir: praise him with strings and organs.
text_la: Laudate eum in tympano et choro; laudate eum in chordis et organo.
text_pt: Louvai-o com o tamborim e a dança, louvai-o com instrumentos de cordas e com órgãos.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ χορῷ αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν χορδαῖς καὶ ὀργάνῳ

text_en: Praise him on high sounding cymbals: praise him on cymbals of joy :
text_la: Laudate eum in cymbalis benesonantibus; laudate eum in cymbalis jubilationis.
text_pt: Louvai-o com os címbalos sonoros; louvai-o com címbalos altissonantes.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις εὐήχοις αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις ἀλαλαγμοῦ

text_en: Let every spirit praise the Lord . Alleluia .
text_la: Omnis spiritus laudet Dominum! Alleluja.
text_pt: Tudo quanto tem fôlego louve ao Senhor. Louvai ao Senhor.
text_el: πᾶσα πνοὴ αἰνεσάτω τὸν κύριον αλληλουια
